Its optimized templates further transfer zero-shot to open-weight and six proprietary target models, achieving average ASR and top-5 ensemble ASR (EASR) of 69.6%/92.6% and 44.1%/60.0%, respectively.

AI.tldr: NeuronFuzz是一个白盒模糊测试框架，利用大语言模型内部的"安全神经元"激活值作为连续执行反馈来评估LLM的安全鲁棒性，替代了传统的逐轮响应生成评估方式，在21个文本和多模态模型上实现了最高100%的越狱发现率。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化越狱测试高度依赖响应级反馈——每个候选提示都需要生成目标模型的完整响应来评估攻击效果，这不仅成本高昂，而且在面对强对齐模型时提供的信息极其稀疏（大多数候选被相同方式拒绝，缺乏有价值的分层信号）。
AI.method: NeuronFuzz通过三个关键组件实现：1) SafetyOracle——利用模板不变的有害/良性输入和稳定性感知选择，识别一组紧凑的安全神经元，将其激活值转换为连续的"安全警报分数"，该分数可在预填充阶段获得，从而将响应生成从模糊测试循环中移除；2) 利用安全警报分数的可微性，通过梯度识别安全敏感模板位置；3) 使用掩码语言模型生成流畅且与上下文兼容的突变，同时保持原始有害载荷不变，避免额外优化变量。
AI.result: 在5个白盒源模型上达到76-100%的越狱发现率，比基线高出最多48个百分点；优化后的模板零样本迁移到开源权重模型和6个专有目标模型，平均ASR和top-5集成ASR(EASR)分别达到69.6%/92.6%和44.1%/60.0%。
AI.conclusion: NeuronFuzz证明了利用内部神经激活作为连续反馈可以有效替代昂贵的响应级评估，显著提升LLM安全评估的效率和效果，并展示了跨模型迁移的能力。

title: Decoupled I/O-Dominant Pipelines for Large-Scale Whole-Slide Image Embedding Extraction
summary: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are central to computational pathology but are prohibitively large, making patch-based processing the practical unit for foundation model inference. At scale, however, generating and handling massive numbers of patches on quickly introduces significant I/O and orchestration overhead, often dominating end-to-end performance. We present a decoupled, I/O-aware pipeline for large-scale WSI embedding extraction that decomposes the workflow into three stages: (1) patch generation and staging, (2) embarrassingly parallel embedding inference, and (3) sharded vector database ingestion. This design isolates data movement from compute, enabling efficient patch delivery, scalable multi-node inference with minimal communication. The resulting system produces a distributed vector database where embeddings are persistently coupled with rich metadata (e.g., patient, slide, and patch attributes), enabling efficient filtering, retrieval, and downstream reuse. This representation database is compact and reusable for tasks such as retrieval, classification, and few-shot learning, particularly benefiting low-resource environments. We show that decoupling I/O, computation, and ingestion enables high-throughput WSI embedding extraction at scale. By characterizing the scaling envelope, we demonstrate that storage dominates beyond moderate concurrency, reframing WSI embedding extraction as a data-centric systems problem rather than a purely compute-bound workload.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向大规模全切片图像（WSI）嵌入提取的解耦、I/O感知流水线，将流程拆分为补丁生成与暂存、并行嵌入推理、分片向量数据库摄取三个阶段，隔离数据移动与计算，从而在高并发下实现高吞吐的WSI嵌入提取，并将问题重新定义为数据中心的系统问题而非纯粹的算力密集型负载。
AI.motivation: WSI尺寸巨大，补丁化处理是基础模型推理的实际单元，但大规模生成和处理海量补丁会引入显著的I/O和编排开销，往往主导端到端性能。现有工作未系统化地解耦I/O、计算与摄取，导致可扩展性受限。
AI.method: 提出一个解耦的、I/O感知的三阶段流水线：(1) 补丁生成与暂存（patch generation and staging）；(2) 完全并行的嵌入推理（embarrassingly parallel embedding inference）；(3) 分片向量数据库摄取（sharded vector database ingestion）。该设计将数据移动与计算隔离，支持高效补丁交付和低通信的多节点推理，最终生成分布式向量数据库，嵌入向量与丰富的元数据（患者、切片、补丁属性）持久耦合。
AI.result: 解耦I/O、计算与摄取能够实现大规模高吞吐的WSI嵌入提取。通过刻画扩展边界（scaling envelope），发现存储在高并发之外成为主导瓶颈，表明WSI嵌入提取本质上是数据中心的系统问题。
AI.conclusion: WSI嵌入提取应被视为数据中心的系统问题而非纯算力密集型工作负载；所构建的表示数据库紧凑且可复用，支持检索、分类和少样本学习等下游任务，尤其有利于低资源环境。

title: Redwood: A Frontier AI Accelerator Designed, Verified, and Deployed from Scratch in 2 Weeks by AI
summary: Modern AI workloads and the hardware that runs them evolve on different timescales: architectural definition precedes volume silicon by years, while target workloads shift in months. Design decisions are therefore committed under deep uncertainty and paid for twice, once in the generality added as a hedge, and again when new workloads map poorly onto frozen silicon. As Moore's Law stagnates, specialization is the main remaining source of performance-per-watt and demands a design cycle that runs at the cadence of the workloads. We present an end-to-end AI system that collapses the software-to-silicon stack into a single optimization loop, where hardware and software are co-designed and verified under one objective. Its first demonstration is Redwood, a frontier AI accelerator built for single-batch, low-power, ultra-low-latency inference for physical AI. From a high-level specification by two human architects, the system autonomously generated the performance model, RTL design, UVM environments, formal proofs, firmware, and kernels in under two weeks with no human intervention below the specification. Every block reached 95% coverage via commercial EDA tools, our proprietary formal engine, and hardware-in-the-loop validation. Specification changes were reverified and redeployed to hardware in under 48 hours. Redwood Nano, its ultra-low-power FPGA variant, runs multi-billion-parameter models like Llama and Qwen. Projected onto Samsung 8 nm, the Jetson Orin Nano's process class, Redwood delivers 1.75x the throughput at 1.9x lower power, a 3.4x performance-per-watt gain against a measured Jetson baseline on the same models. Qwen running on Redwood also helped design next-generation Redwood, an early step toward recursive self-improvement. To our knowledge, this is the first production-worthy AI accelerator designed end-to-end by an AI system and running a modern AI model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端AI系统，将软件到晶圆的整个堆栈压缩为单一优化循环，实现硬件与软件在统一目标下的协同设计和验证。其首次演示是Redwood——专为物理AI单批次、低功耗、超低延迟推理构建的先进AI加速器。该系统在两周内自动生成了性能模型、RTL设计、UVM环境、形式化证明、固件和内核，无需人工干预。Redwood在Samsung 8nm工艺上的性能功耗比达到Jetson Orin Nano基线的3.4倍。
AI.motivation: 现代AI工作负载与硬件架构演化时间尺度不匹配：架构定义远早于大规模硅片量产，而目标工作负载数月即发生迁移。设计决策在深度不确定性下做出并付出双重代价——既有作为对冲而增加的通用性，又因新工作负载难以映射到已冻结的硅片。随着摩尔定律停滞，专用化成为性能功耗比提升的主要来源，迫切需要以工作负载节奏运行的设计周期。
AI.method: 提出一个端到端AI系统，将软硬件堆栈整合为单一优化循环，实现硬件与软件在统一目标下的协同设计和验证。从两位人类架构师的高级规格出发，系统自主生成性能模型、RTL设计、UVM验证环境、形式化证明、固件和内核。通过商业EDA工具、专有形式化引擎和硬件在环验证达到95%覆盖率。规格变更可在48小时内重新验证并部署到硬件上。
AI.result: Redwood加速器所有模块通过商业EDA工具和专有形式化引擎达到95%覆盖率；规格变更在48小时内完成重新验证与硬件部署。Redwood Nano（超低功耗FPGA变体）可运行Llama和Qwen等多十亿参数模型。投影至Samsung 8nm工艺（Jetson Orin Nano同工艺等级），Redwood在相同模型上较测量基线实现1.75倍吞吐量、1.9倍更低功耗，即3.4倍性能功耗比提升。Qwen运行于Redwood上还参与了下一代Redwood的设计，是递归自我改进的早期探索。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个由AI系统端到端设计、且能够运行现代AI模型的生产级AI加速器。该工作表明，以工作负载节奏运行的AI驱动硬件设计周期是可行且高效的，为后摩尔时代专用化硬件设计提供了新范式，并对递归自我改进的AI硬件设计迈出了早期一步。

title: RegimeFormer: A Large Protein Model of Global Perturbation Regimes
summary: Protein language models organize sequence and structure at scale, but a global representation of how proteins respond to mutation remains lacking. We present RegimeFormer, a large protein perturbation model coupled to RegimeAtlas, constructed by harmonizing and indexing 202,556,313 non-redundant protein sequences across the tree of life. A diversity-preserving one-million-protein subset provides the high-resolution training and inference layer, with 995,995 proteins yielding residue-level summaries across 407,048,356 residues and substitution-specific predictions available on demand. Across experimental deep mutational scanning, molecular benchmarks, structural confidence and evolutionary constraint, RegimeFormer identifies reproducible protein-level perturbation regimes that organize residue fragility, adaptability and predictive uncertainty. Regime conditioning improves substitution-specific prediction, with the largest relative gains under unseen-protein, unseen-family and low-homology evaluation. RegimeFormer-derived molecular priors further improve downstream transcriptomic and drug-response modelling. Together, RegimeFormer and RegimeAtlas provide a scalable framework for mapping, predicting and querying protein perturbation landscapes across global sequence space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RegimeFormer，一个大规模蛋白质扰动模型，配合RegimeAtlas数据库，通过整合2.025亿条非冗余蛋白质序列，以100万蛋白质高分辨率子集进行训练，在跨实验深度突变扫描、分子基准、结构置信度和进化约束等任务中识别出可复现的蛋白质水平扰动模式，并显著提升替换特异性预测性能，尤其在未见蛋白质、未见家族和低同源性评估场景下增益最大。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质语言模型已经在序列和结构层面实现了大规模组织，但缺乏一个全局性的、能表征蛋白质如何响应突变（扰动）的统一表示。现有方法尚未在宏观尺度上系统刻画蛋白质的突变响应模式，因此需要一个大规模扰动模型来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建了RegimeAtlas，通过调和并索引来自生命之树的202,556,313条非冗余蛋白质序列；从中选取一个保持多样性的100万蛋白质子集作为高分辨率训练和推理层，995,995个蛋白质生成跨407,048,356个残基的残基级摘要，并可按需提供替换特异性预测。RegimeFormer在此数据基础上学习蛋白质水平的扰动模式，通过Regime条件化来改进替换特异性预测，并将学习到的分子先验用于下游转录组和药物反应建模。
AI.result: RegimeFormer在实验深度突变扫描、分子基准、结构置信度和进化约束等多项评估中，能够识别出可复现的蛋白质水平扰动模式，并以此组织残基脆弱性、适应性和预测不确定性。Regime条件化显著提升替换特异性预测，在未见蛋白质、未见家族和低同源性场景下取得最大的相对增益；其分子先验还能改进下游转录组和药物反应建模。
AI.conclusion: RegimeFormer和RegimeAtlas共同提供了一个可扩展的框架，用于在全局蛋白质序列空间中映射、预测和查询蛋白质扰动景观，为蛋白质突变响应研究提供了大规模统一的基础设施。

title: PRISM: Lightweight Enclave Isolation with Prismatic Capabilities
summary:
Trusted execution environments (TEEs) protect sensitive code and data from external interference, but lack inherent memory safety. CHERI can enforce spatial memory safety at the object level. Attempts to establish a TEE using CHERI primitives suffer from (1) expensive capability revocation operations, (2) need to rely on the host operating system (OS) to support provenance tracking and physical memory protection, (3) expensive domain transitions, and (4) lack of support for remote attestation.
  We introduce prismatic capabilities and present PRISM, a TEE architecture for CHERI leveraging prismatic capabilities to create userspace enclaves while addressing these challenges. PRISM binds enclave 'hues' (identifiers) in prismatic capabilities to physical memory access controls, enables O(1) ownership establishment without memory sweeps, and supports efficient domain transitions that atomically activate and deactivate prismatic capabilities. Additionally, PRISM enables remote attestation of its enclaves. We demonstrate that execution of userspace enclaves in PRISM incurs only moderate overhead (<= 15%), a significant improvement over the same workloads under Intel SGX

AI.tldr: PRISM是一种基于CHERI的TEE架构，利用新提出的棱镜能力（prismatic capabilities）创建用户空间飞地，在不依赖宿主操作系统的情况下实现O(1)所有权建立、高效域切换和远程证明，相比Intel SGX开销显著更低（≤15%）。
AI.motivation: CHERI虽能提供对象级空间内存安全，但基于CHERI原语构建TEE面临四大挑战：(1)能力撤销操作开销高昂；(2)需要依赖宿主操作系统支持来源追踪和物理内存保护；(3)域切换代价昂贵；(4)缺乏远程证明支持。现有方案难以同时解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出棱镜能力（prismatic capabilities）概念，将飞地标识符（hues）绑定到物理内存访问控制中。PRISM通过棱镜能力实现：O(1)所有权建立（无需内存扫描）、原子化激活/停用棱镜能力的高效域切换，以及远程证明支持。
AI.result: PRISM中用户空间飞地的执行开销仅为中等水平（≤15%），相比Intel SGX上相同工作负载有显著性能改进。
AI.conclusion: PRISM成功解决了基于CHERI构建TEE的四大挑战，提供了一种高效、无需宿主OS支持、支持远程证明的用户空间飞地架构，性能优于Intel SGX。

title: Cross-Platform Benchmark of Neural 3D Reconstruction for Autonomous Laboratory Robots
comment: This manuscript is peer-reviewed from the committees in the workshop "VAxAutoSci: Visual Analytics in the Age of Autonomous Scientific Discovery" in conjunction with 2026 IEEE Visualization & Visual Analytics
summary: Autonomous robots performing laboratory tasks depend on 3D reconstruction pipelines that can turn raw camera streams into actionable object representations within the latency budget of a physical control loop. Neural 3D reconstruction methods have demonstrated high-quality view synthesis, but their real-time viability across the compute platforms on which laboratory robots actually run remains poorly characterized. In this work, we present a systematic compute-platform benchmark of neural 3D reconstruction methods, evaluating NeRF and 3D Gaussian Splatting training and rendering on GPU-enabled computing devices ranging from single-board computers to server-class nodes, and place Meta's SAM3D single-image reconstruction on the same axes to quantify its latency and fidelity gap relative to per-scene optimization. Our results show that Gaussian Splatting yields higher rendering quality than NeRF at greater GPU cost, and that onboard compute is insufficient for full per-scene optimization at interactive rates. Our preliminary assessment on SAM3D indicates that it delivers plausible object geometry within seconds, but with detail mismatches that can compromise downstream manipulation. Together, these findings motivate tiered pipelines in which lightweight feed-forward reconstruction sustains the real-time perception-and-tracking loop for laboratory robots, while heavier neural reconstruction is scheduled selectively on suitable compute.

AI.tldr: 本文系统地比较了NeRF、3D Gaussian Splatting（3DGS）和Meta的SAM3D在不同计算平台（从单板计算机到服务器级节点）上的3D重建性能，发现3DGS渲染质量优于NeRF但GPU成本更高，板载计算无法支持交互式速率下的完整逐场景优化，而轻量级前馈重建（如SAM3D）能在秒级生成合理几何但细节存在偏差，因此建议采用分层重建流水线。
AI.motivation: 实验室自主机器人依赖3D重建流水线将原始摄像头流转化为可用的物体表示，且必须在物理控制回路的延迟预算内完成。虽然神经3D重建方法已展现出高质量视图合成能力，但它们在实验室机器人实际运行的计算平台上的实时可行性缺乏系统化的表征，现有研究未提供跨平台的性能基准。
AI.method: 该工作对不同GPU计算设备（从单板计算机到服务器级节点）上运行的NeRF和3D Gaussian Splatting训练与渲染进行了系统的计算平台基准测试，并从延迟和保真度两个维度将Meta的SAM3D单图像重建方法与逐场景优化方法进行对比评估。
AI.result: 实验表明：3D Gaussian Splatting在渲染质量上优于NeRF，但GPU计算成本更高；单板级别的板载计算不足以在交互速率下完成完整的逐场景优化；SAM3D在数秒内即可生成合理的物体几何，但存在影响下游操作的细节不匹配问题。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现支持分层流水线的设计思路：用轻量级的前馈重建支撑实验室机器人的实时感知与跟踪环路，同时将更重的神经重建方法有选择性地调度到合适的计算资源上执行。

title: PICasso: An AI-Enabled Design Framework for Autonomous Optimization of Silicon Photonic Devices
summary: We present PICasso, an AI-assisted framework for automated synthesis, verification, and optimization of photonic integrated circuits (PICs) from natural-language specifications. PICasso couples a structured NL -> YAML -> GDS generation pipeline with PDK aware knowledge injection, automated placement and routing, DRC/LVS validation, and SAX-based photonic simulation. To systematically evaluate AI-driven photonic design, we introduce PIC-Set, a benchmark of 36 parameterized PIC design tasks spanning core photonic primitives and multi-component circuits. Using PIC-Set, we benchmark several state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs) under a unified evaluation protocol, including new metrics such as structural and functional $Spec@k$, optimization efficiency, and robustness under perturbations. Across the benchmark, PICasso significantly improves end-to-end specification satisfaction compared to vanilla LLM generation. Structural $Spec@3$ reaches up to 92.7% and functional $Spec@3$ up to 52% on high-complexity circuits. In addition, PICasso consistently reduces circuit insertion loss, lowering the mean loss from 4.98 dB to 3.25 dB (1.74 dB improvement) through simulation-guided optimization. These results demonstrate that structured domain constraints, physical verification, and simulation feedback transform LLMs from brittle netlist generators into practical PIC design agents capable of producing manufacturable layouts with competitive runtimes relative to manual GUI-based workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PICasso，一个由AI辅助的自动化光子集成电路（PIC）设计框架，能从自然语言规格说明出发，通过NL→YAML→GDS的结构化生成流水线，结合PDK感知、自动布局布线、DRC/LVS验证和SAX光子仿真，实现PIC的自动综合、验证与优化。同时引入PIC-Set基准（36个参数化设计任务），实验表明PICasso显著优于vanilla LLM生成，结构Spec@3最高达92.7%，功能Spec@3达52%，插入损耗从4.98dB降至3.25dB。
AI.motivation: 光子集成电路设计传统上依赖手动GUI工作流，耗时且容易出错。虽然大型语言模型在代码生成方面表现出色，但直接用于PIC设计时生成的网表往往不可制造、缺乏物理验证，且不满足设计规则。作者旨在弥合LLM原始生成能力与可制造、可验证的PIC设计之间的鸿沟，将LLM从脆弱的网表生成器转变为实用的PIC设计代理。
AI.method: PICasso框架包含：(1) 结构化的NL→YAML→GDS生成流水线，将自然语言规格转换为中间表示再到版图；(2) PDK感知的知识注入，确保设计符合工艺设计套件约束；(3) 自动布局布线与DRC/LVS验证，保证设计的可制造性和电气/几何正确性；(4) SAX光子仿真用于功能验证和插入损耗优化。同时引入PIC-Set基准（36个参数化设计任务），并定义了结构/功能Spec@k、优化效率和鲁棒性等新评估指标，在统一协议下对比多个SOTA LLM。
AI.result: 在PIC-Set基准上，PICasso显著提升了端到端规格满足率。结构Spec@3最高达92.7%，功能Spec@3在高复杂度电路上达52%。通过仿真引导优化，电路插入损耗均值从4.98dB降至3.25dB（改善1.74dB），且运行时间与手动GUI工作流具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结构化领域约束、物理验证和仿真反馈能将LLM从脆弱的网表生成器转化为实用的PIC设计代理，能够生成可制造的版图，并在规格满足率和性能优化上显著优于vanilla LLM生成。这为AI驱动的光子集成设计提供了一条可行的技术路径。

title: Recipes for Steering and Scaling LLMs via Sampling
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are probabilistic models, typically defined by an autoregressive factorization. While recent work has begun to study richer target distributions beyond the base model, the sampling strategies remain highly inefficient. In this paper, we present a flexible and theoretically grounded framework for steering and scaling autoregressive LLMs with sampling. Within this framework, we describe two algorithms -- one based on Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) and one based on Replica Exchange (RE) -- that steer generation toward powering, product or tilting of the base model distribution. We illustrate this framework through scaling the generation quality of LLMs without external supervision or reward models. Experimental results demonstrate our methods scale more favorably than Best-of-N and standard MCMC baselines. Overall, this paper offers a systematic recipe for probabilistic inference with LLMs via sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个灵活且理论扎实的框架，用于通过采样来引导和扩展自回归大语言模型（LLMs）的生成过程。框架内包含两种算法——基于序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）和副本交换（RE），可将生成目标引导到基模型的幂、乘积或倾斜分布上，无需外部监督或奖励模型即可提升生成质量，实验表明该方法优于Best-of-N和标准MCMC基线。
AI.motivation: LLMs本质上是概率模型（自回归分解），虽然已有研究开始探索超越基础模型的更丰富目标分布，但现有采样策略效率低下，缺乏系统性的理论框架来引导和扩展生成过程。
AI.method: 提出一个基于采样的统一理论框架，通过定义基模型分布的幂、乘积或倾斜（powering, product, tilting）形式作为目标分布，并设计了两种采样算法：基于序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）的算法和基于副本交换（RE）的算法，用于高效地从这些目标分布中采样生成文本。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提出的SMC和RE方法在生成质量上比Best-of-N和标准MCMC基线方法具有更好的扩展性（scaling），即在增加采样计算量时能获得更优的生成结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个系统的、理论驱动的概率推理方案，通过采样方式实现LLM的受控生成，为无需外部奖励模型即可提升生成质量提供了可扩展的通用方法框架。

title: Finding the Right Evidence: Factor-Guided Coarse-to-Fine Reasoning for Long Videos
summary: While LVLMs rapidly improve, long-video question answering still remains challenging: relevant evidence is sparse, and question-relevant context often fails to provide cues that discriminate the correct answer from plausible alternatives. Diagnostic analysis on a manually annotated subset of MMR-V shows that prior agentic systems substantially improve cue retrieval over direct VLM inference yet fail to achieve a corresponding gain in answer accuracy, indicating that the bottleneck lies in option-discriminative evidence rather than topical relevance alone. We propose PACE (Progressive Acquisition of Critical Evidence), a factor-guided framework for long-video evidence acquisition. PACE proceeds in two stages: it first indexes clip-level descriptions guided by question-derived factors without observing the candidate answers; it then uses the candidate answers to derive contrastive cues and queries the index for verification. On MMR-V with the open-source Qwen3-VL backbone, PACE achieves 42.6% accuracy, outperforming direct inference and prior agentic baselines including Deep Video Discovery (DVD). On the same diagnostic subset, PACE recovers 66.9% of the annotated cues, providing empirical evidence that its gains are associated with improved evidence recovery rather than stronger answer-side priors alone. Consistent gains over DVD on LVBench, Video-MME, EgoSchema, and LongVideoBench suggest that option-aware evidence acquisition transfers beyond MMR-V. Code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/PACE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE（渐进式关键证据获取）框架，用于长视频问答中基于选项判别性证据的证据获取。PACE分为两阶段：先在不观察候选答案的情况下，基于问题派生因子索引片段级描述；再利用候选答案推导对比线索并查询索引进行验证。在MMR-V上达到42.6%准确率，优于直接推理和包括DVD在内的既往智能体基线，且其性能提升源于更好的证据恢复而非答案侧先验。
AI.motivation: 长视频问答中相关证据稀疏，且与问题相关的上下文往往无法提供区分正确选项与相似干扰项的判别性线索。诊断分析显示，既有智能体系统虽然显著改善了线索检索，但答案准确率并未相应提升，表明瓶颈在于选项判别性证据而非单纯的主题相关性。
AI.method: PACE采用两阶段流水线：(1) 索引阶段——在不观察候选答案的前提下，由问题派生的因子引导生成片段级描述并建立索引；(2) 验证阶段——利用候选答案推导对比性线索，查询索引以验证和获取关键证据。
AI.result: 在MMR-V上使用开源Qwen3-VL骨干网络，PACE达到42.6%的准确率，优于直接推理和DVD等既往智能体基线。在诊断子集上恢复66.9%的标注线索，表明性能提升关联于改进的证据恢复。在LVBench、Video-MME、EgoSchema和LongVideoBench上均取得对DVD的一致改进。
AI.conclusion: 选项感知（option-aware）的证据获取策略在长视频问答中具有跨数据集的泛化能力，证据恢复质量的提升是推动答案准确率增长的关键因素，而非仅仅依赖答案侧先验。PACE为长视频问答中的证据获取瓶颈提供了有效解决方案。

title: Pruning Binarized Neural Networks: A Dedicated Framework and Globally Weighted Algorithms
summary: Extreme compression of deep neural networks, up to full binarization, dramatically reduces memory footprint and arithmetic complexity, facilitating deployment on constrained edge hardware with field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and microcontrollers. Although combining binarization with pruning promises additional efficiency gains, existing pruning strategies are ill-suited to binarized representations and rarely translate into meaningful hardware savings. We introduce a PyTorch-based, research-oriented framework that incorporates freezing and pruning mechanisms for designing and optimizing binarized neural networks. The framework enables rapid and reproducible evaluation of state-of-the-art approaches and the fast prototyping of new ones. Leveraging this framework, we propose a novel pruning method that accounts for the relative importance of learned parameters across abstraction levels. Such a global weighting mechanism consistently achieves a superior trade-off between model accuracy and pruning rate, achieving a 70% pruning rate on VGG11 with constant accuracy, while state-of-the-art results reach only 41% in the binarized setting.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个基于PyTorch的研究导向框架，用于二值化神经网络的冻结与剪枝优化，并提出了一种跨抽象层级考虑参数相对重要性的全局加权剪枝方法，在VGG11上实现70%的剪枝率且精度不变，而现有SOTA在二值化设定下仅达41%。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络的全二值化虽能大幅降低存储和计算开销，但将二值化与剪枝结合时，现有剪枝策略不适合二值化表示，且很少能转化为实际的硬件资源节省，亟需专门针对二值化网络的剪枝方案。
AI.method: 提出一个PyTorch研究框架，整合了冻结(freezing)和剪枝(pruning)机制以设计和优化二值化神经网络；在此基础上提出一种新的剪枝方法，通过跨抽象层级（跨层）衡量学习参数的相对重要性进行全局加权，从而实现更优的剪枝率与精度平衡。
AI.result: 所提出的全局加权剪枝方法在VGG11上达到70%的剪枝率且精度保持不变，而二值化设定下的现有最优方法仅能达到41%的剪枝率。
AI.conclusion: 该框架支持对SOTA方法进行快速、可复现的评估和新方法的快速原型开发，所提出的跨层全局加权剪枝方法在精度与剪枝率的权衡上显著优于现有方案，为二值化神经网络在边缘硬件上的实际部署提供了更有效的优化路径。

title: Consensus with Stochastic Broadcast
summary: We study binary consensus in the \emph{stochastic broadcast model}, which assumes $n\geq 2$ processes communicating synchronously by message broadcasts. At each round, every process broadcasts a message to all the other processes. Each broadcast succeeds independently with some probability $p\in[0,1]$. If a broadcast succeeds, all processes receive the message, and if it fails, no process receives the message. The sender does not know whether its broadcast was successful or not. In this model, consensus is not solvable; the objective is to design, for a given number of rounds $r$, consensus algorithms that terminate in $r$ rounds, minimizing the probability of error disagreement. This problem has been studied in depth for 2 processes [DISC 2025]. We extend the study to $n> 2$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究随机广播模型下的二元共识问题，将此前仅针对2个进程的深度研究扩展到n>2个进程的情形。在随机广播模型中，每轮进程广播消息，但每次广播独立地以概率p成功，若失败则无人收到消息；该模型下共识不可解，目标是设计在给定r轮内终止并最小化错误分歧概率的共识算法。
AI.motivation: 随机广播模型是分布式系统中具有代表性的同步通信模型，其广播部分失败的特性使其难以达成确定性共识。此前工作已对2进程情形做了深入研究（发表于DISC 2025），但n>2的广义情形尚未被系统处理，因此需要将研究扩展至多进程场景。
AI.method: 在n≥2个进程的同步随机广播模型下，每轮各进程向所有其他进程广播消息，每个广播独立以概率p成功；若失败则所有进程均收不到消息，且发送者不知情。由于该模型下确定性共识不可解，文中针对给定轮数r设计在r轮内终止的共识算法，以最小化错误分歧（即不同进程最终决定不一致）的概率为优化目标。
AI.result: 论文将共识问题的研究从2进程场景推广到n>2进程的一般情形，给出了多进程随机广播模型下有限轮次共识算法的设计与分析方法。
AI.conclusion: 在随机广播模型中，由于无法检测广播失败，确定性共识不可实现，只能通过有限轮算法在概率意义上最小化错误分歧概率；本文将该问题的分析完整扩展到n>2个进程的情况。

title: HOLMES: In-Context Failure-Center Localization for High-Dimensional Yield Estimation
summary: Importance sampling for high-sigma yield estimation requires locating the failure center from a severely imbalanced sample set. Existing surrogate-assisted methods rely on iterative gradient-based training, ill-posed under extreme class imbalance; model errors propagate into the estimator, causing accuracy collapse in high dimensions. We recast failure-center localization as few-shot binary classification: a prior-fitted tabular foundation model performs gradient-free in-context inference in a single forward pass, eliminating the ill-posed training loop. \textbf{HOLMES} (High-sigma Optimal Localization via Manifold Estimation and Sampling) pairs this with an SVD-based anisotropic proposal that captures the local geometry of the failure manifold, and a hit-rate-driven adaptive mixing scheme that stabilizes importance weights where conventional adaptation collapses. On 6T SRAM benchmarks spanning $D = 108$ to $D = 1{,}152$, full-dimensional baselines exhibit accuracy collapse at some dimension, with the strongest baseline reaching 25.8\% relative error; PCA+MNIS is additionally evaluated at the two largest dimensions. HOLMES remains within 5.9\% across all five configurations with up to $58.8\times$ speedup over Monte Carlo. The code is available on \href{https://github.com/IceLab-JCIE/ICE006-Yield-Holmes}

AI.tldr: HOLMES是一种面向高sigma良率估计的失效中心定位方法，将失效中心定位重构为少样本二元分类问题，利用先验拟合的表格基础模型进行无梯度上下文推理，结合基于SVD的各向异性提议分布和命中率驱动的自适应混合方案，在6T SRAM基准测试中（维度108到1152）始终保持在5.9%以内的相对误差，相比蒙特卡洛方法最高获得58.8倍加速。
AI.motivation: 高sigma良率估计中，在严重类别不平衡的样本集中定位失效中心是核心挑战。现有基于代理模型的方法依赖迭代梯度训练，在极端类别不平衡下条件不良，模型误差会传播到估计器，导致高维下精度崩溃。
AI.method: 1) 将失效中心定位重构为少样本二元分类问题，使用先验拟合的表格基础模型进行无梯度的上下文推理（单次前向传播），消除病态的训练循环；2) 基于SVD的各向异性提议分布，捕获失效流形的局部几何结构；3) 命中率驱动的自适应混合方案，在传统自适应方法失效的场景中稳定重要性权重。
AI.result: 在6T SRAM基准（D=108至D=1152）上，全维度基线方法在不同维度出现精度崩溃，最强基线达到25.8%的相对误差；PCA+MNIS在最大的两个维度上也有评估。HOLMES在所有五个配置中保持在5.9%以内的相对误差，相对蒙特卡洛方法获得最高58.8倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: HOLMES通过将失效中心定位转化为少样本分类并结合流形感知的自适应采样方案，解决了高维高sigma良率估计中传统方法精度崩溃的问题，在精度和效率上均显著优于现有基线。

title: DINIRS: Digital Twin for Individualized Treatment Effects of Non-Invasive Respiratory Support Strategies
summary:
Objective: Choosing between noninvasive respiratory support (NIRS) and invasive mechanical ventilation (IMV) for patients with acute respiratory failure is a complex, time-sensitive decision with heterogeneous treatment effects across patient subgroups. Although clinical trials and guidelines provide population-level guidance, it remains unclear which patients benefit more from NIRS than IMV. We developed and validated a censoring-aware Digital Twin framework for Individualized Treatment Effects of Non-Invasive Respiratory Support (DINIRS) to estimate individualized treatment effects (ITEs) that capture mortality and ventilation duration.
  Materials and Methods: We trained DINIRS on 23 baseline clinical variables from the first 24 ICU hours in 5,336 MIMIC-IV patients with acute respiratory failure. We used a transformer encoder with a survival attention gate to decompose 28-day ventilator-free days (VFD-28) into survival probability and conditional ventilation duration. A cross-fitted, doubly robust learner estimated ITEs. We externally validated DINIRS in 2,540 patients from the multi-site eICU-CRD dataset.
  Results: The DINIRS policy achieved a mean benefit of 2.07 ventilator-free days per patient (207 per 100 patients) compared with the observed practice. Predicted NIRS benefit was higher among patients with less organ dysfunction (88.4% versus 49.0%) and persisted across hypoxemia severity. External validation reproduced this pattern without retraining.
  Discussion: Our analysis revealed that the NIRS benefit stemmed from shorter ventilation among survivors rather than from reduced mortality, indicating that avoiding intubation-associated complications was the primary mechanism.
  Conclusion: This study demonstrated individualized estimation of NIRS benefit using ICU data, though prospective validation is needed before these estimates inform treatment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DINIRS数字孪生框架，利用MIMIC-IV和eICU-CRD数据中急性呼吸衰竭患者的ICU数据，通过Transformer编码器和生存注意力门控，结合双重稳健学习器估计无创呼吸支持(NIRS)对比有创机械通气(IMV)的个体化治疗效应，发现NIRS的获益主要来自减少幸存者通气时长而非降低死亡率，政策层面的选择可使每位患者平均获益2.07个呼吸机自由天数。
AI.motivation: 急性呼吸衰竭患者选择无创呼吸支持(NIRS)还是有创机械通气(IMV)是复杂且时间敏感的决策，不同患者亚组存在异质治疗效果。现有临床试验和指南仅提供群体水平指导，无法回答哪些患者更可能从NIRS获益，亟需个体化治疗效应估计工具。
AI.method: 训练数据来自MIMIC-IV中5,336名急性呼吸衰竭患者，使用ICU前24小时的23项基线临床变量；采用带生存注意力门控的Transformer编码器将28天呼吸机自由天数分解为生存概率和条件通气时长两个组件；用交叉拟合的双重稳健学习器估计个体化治疗效应；在eICU-CRD数据集的2,540名患者上进行外部验证。
AI.result: DINIRS策略相比实际临床实践平均每位患者获益2.07个呼吸机自由天数（每100名患者获益207天）。预测NIRS获益在器官功能障碍较轻的患者中更高（88.4% vs 49.0%），且在不同低氧血症严重程度中持续存在。外部验证无需重训练即复现了这一模式。
AI.conclusion: 研究实现了利用ICU数据个体化估计NIRS获益，获益机制主要来自减少幸存者通气时长（避免插管相关并发症）而非降低死亡率；在应用于临床决策前仍需前瞻性验证。

title: Improving the Robustness of the XRP Ledger Network via Edge Augmentation Strategies
summary: The XRP Ledger allows its network participants to select a set of trusted peers within the network (i.e., the Unique Node List (UNL)) and communicate with them to reach consensus on which transactions should be included in the next ledger state. However, its consensus protocol requires significant overlap among participants' UNLs, along with a high agreement threshold among the nodes within each UNL (e.g., 80\%). Consequently, an attacker could disrupt the consensus process in such a network by targeting the nodes that form the network's connectivity backbone and reducing the number of trusted participants that can communicate with one another below the required threshold. In this paper, we evaluate strategies to improve the robustness of the XRP Ledger's existing topology, as measured by our formal definitions of quorum and network robustness, and compare them to a second strategy from prior work. The strategy we present is an addition/augmentation approach, in which new edges are added based on different constructions. The second strategy is a rewiring or edge-replacement approach, in which the overall number of edges is preserved but they are rearranged. For each strategy, we consider two different cases: one in which all nodes participate in the edge construction or rewiring process, and another in which only a subset of nodes participates. Our findings demonstrate substantial improvements in robustness when augmentation strategies are used over the default XRP Ledger topology and show that some augmentation strategies achieve robustness metrics equal to or exceeding the rewiring strategy, even when the number of edges added is small (e.g., three edges per node). Additionally, we show that the random K-out-based augmentation strategy maintains higher topological similarity to the original network than rewiring, as measured by Jaccard similarity.

AI.tldr: 本文针对XRP Ledger共识协议中因UNL重叠和阈值要求导致的安全脆弱性，提出基于增边（augmentation）的策略来提升网络的quorum鲁棒性和网络鲁棒性，并与现有的重连（rewiring）策略进行对比。结果表明，即使在每个节点仅新增少量边（如三条）的情况下，增边策略也能达到甚至超过重连策略的鲁棒性，且基于随机K-out的增边策略在保持网络拓扑相似性方面优于重连策略。
AI.motivation: XRP Ledger的共识协议要求参与者UNL之间存在显著重叠，且各UNL内部需要高同意阈值（如80%），这使得攻击者可以通过针对网络连接骨干节点，将可信通信节点数量降至阈值以下来破坏共识过程。因此，需要寻找提升网络拓扑鲁棒性的策略以抵御此类攻击。
AI.method: 本文提出一种增边/添加（augmentation）策略，基于不同构造方式在现有拓扑上添加新边；同时对比另一种来自先前工作的重连/边替换（rewiring）策略，在保持总边数不变的情况下重新排列边。两种策略均在两种场景下评估：全部节点参与构造/重连，以及仅部分节点参与。鲁棒性通过形式化的quorum鲁棒性和网络鲁棒性指标衡量。
AI.result: 增边策略相比XRP Ledger默认拓扑在鲁棒性上有显著提升。部分增边策略即使仅添加少量边（如每节点三条），其鲁棒性指标也达到或超过重连策略。此外，基于随机K-out的增边策略相比重连策略在Jaccard相似度上保持了更高的与原始网络的拓扑相似性。
AI.conclusion: 增边策略是提升XRP Ledger网络鲁棒性的有效方案，尤其是在边数预算受限的场景下，能兼顾鲁棒性与拓扑结构保真性，优于需要重新排列现有边的重连策略。

title: RTNav: Towards Real-Time Zero-Shot Object Navigation
summary: Navigation in unknown environments to find unforeseen objects has become increasingly feasible with capable vision and language foundation models. However, these models also introduce non-negligible inference latency, which becomes an important concern when agents must operate continuously in the real world. Most state-of-the-art methods are still developed in synchronous simulators, where the environment waits for the agent to act and inference time is effectively free. As a result, agents are often designed around the sequential execution of perception, reasoning, and action, with little regard for time constraints. Under real-time execution, where wall-clock time counts towards the task budget, the inefficiencies of these architectures become clear. We show that recent zero-shot object navigation methods suffer consistent performance degradation under such realistic timing conditions. Motivated by this observation, we propose RTNav, a simple but effective architecture that treats inference latency, asynchronous environment stepping, and bounded compute as explicit design considerations. Evaluated on real-time variants of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and HM3D-OVON, RTNav improves the success rate by up to 11% and the Success weighted by Completion Time by up to 5.1 points over prior work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RTNav，一个将推理延迟、异步环境步进和有限计算资源作为显式设计考虑的实时物体导航架构，在HM3D基准上相比现有方法成功率提升高达11%。
AI.motivation: 现有的最先进物体导航方法大多在同步模拟器中开发，环境会等待智能体动作，推理时间被当作免费资源。但在真实世界实时执行中，墙钟时间计入任务预算，视觉-语言基础模型带来的推理延迟会导致这些架构性能显著下降。作者旨在解决这一被忽视的实时性问题。
AI.method: RTNav将推理延迟、异步环境步进和有界计算作为显式设计考量，通过一种简单但有效的架构来解耦感知、推理和动作之间的顺序依赖，使智能体在实时约束下仍能高效导航。
AI.result: 在HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2和HM3D-OVON的实时变体上评估，RTNav相比先前工作将成功率提升最高11%，以完成任务时间加权的成功率（SCT）提升最高5.1个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 现有零样本物体导航方法依赖同步模拟器假设，在真实时序条件下性能会持续退化。RTNav通过将时间约束纳入架构设计，能在实时执行场景中有效改善导航性能，为更真实的机器人导航评估提供了新范式。

title: CIFQA: A Deterministic Tool-Grounded Multi-Agent LLM Framework for Financial Query Answering
comment: 16 pages, 5 figures, submitted for academic dissemination
summary: Calculation-intensive financial question answering requires exact reasoning over structured rates, temporal conditions, numerical formulas, and rule-based constraints. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on natural language tasks, they often produce numerically incorrect yet plausible answers when solving multi-step financial calculations. To address this limitation, we introduce CIFQA (Calculation-Intensive Financial Query Answering), a deterministic tool-grounded multi-agent LLM framework for financial question answering. CIFQA separates language understanding from numerical execution by assigning specialized agents to query interpretation, routing, parameter extraction, computation planning, and response generation, while deterministic Python-based tools perform financial calculations and rule application. We instantiate CIFQA for fixed deposit query answering and evaluate it on a curated benchmark of fixed deposit queries. CIFQA achieves 95.54% accuracy on calculation-intensive queries and 90.87% overall accuracy, substantially outperforming direct LLM baselines even when provided with complete formulas, rate cards, and benchmark instructions. Ablation studies show that deterministic components such as exact rate lookup, tenure computation, rolling-year adjustment, and premature-withdrawal logic are critical contributors to performance. Notably, a 17B open-source backbone operating within CIFQA outperforms substantially larger frontier models evaluated with the same financial information, demonstrating that architectural design is a more important determinant of numerical reliability than model scale. While evaluated on fixed deposit queries, CIFQA provides a generalizable framework for calculation-intensive financial reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIFQA，一个确定性工具锚定的多智能体LLM框架，用于计算密集型金融问答。它将语言理解与数值执行分离，通过专用智能体负责查询解释、路由、参数提取、计算规划和响应生成，并用确定性Python工具执行金融计算。在定期存款查询基准上达到95.54%的计算密集型准确率和90.87%的总体准确率，远超直接LLM基线。消融实验表明确定性组件是关键，17B开源模型在框架内优于更大的前沿模型。
AI.motivation: 计算密集型金融问答需要精确推理结构化利率、时间条件、数值公式和规则约束，而现有LLM虽然擅长自然语言任务，但在多步金融计算中经常产生数值错误但看似合理的答案。这促使作者设计一个能将语言理解与数值执行分离的框架来解决此问题。
AI.method: CIFQA采用多智能体架构，将任务分解为五个专门角色：查询解释、路由、参数提取、计算规划和响应生成。语言理解由LLM智能体承担，而所有金融计算和规则应用由确定性Python工具执行，确保数值准确性和规则一致性。
AI.result: 在定期存款查询基准上，CIFQA达到95.54%的计算密集型查询准确率和90.87%的总体准确率，显著优于提供完整公式、利率表和基准指令的LLM基线。消融实验显示精确利率查找、期限计算、滚动年度调整和提前支取逻辑等确定性组件是性能的关键贡献者。一个17B开源模型在CIFQA框架内优于使用相同信息评估的更大规模前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: CIFQA证明了对金融计算任务而言，架构设计比模型规模更能决定数值可靠性。该框架虽然在定期存款领域评估，但为更广泛的计算密集型金融推理任务提供了可泛化的解决方案。

title: Can a Model Catch Its Own Hallucinations for Free?: Label-Free Doubt Signals Hold Their Own Against a Labelled Dataset for Abstention
summary: Large language models state false facts as fluently as true ones, yet a model often "knows" internally when it is on shaky ground: the probability it assigns to its own answer tends to dip on the facts it gets wrong. The usual way to act on this, teaching a model to abstain rather than guess, requires a labelled dataset of right and wrong answers. We ask whether the model's own confidence, which is free and needs no labels, can do that job instead. We fine-tune each model (with LoRA) to answer when its frozen confidence is high and to say "I'm not sure" when it is low, using the signal alone and no correctness labels. Across six open-weights models (1B-8B, two families) on short-form factual question answering, with correctness adjudicated by an independent judge model, this label-free recipe holds its own against label-supervised abstention-tuning: at matched coverage we find no statistically detectable difference between the two. A control that drills hard examples instead of abstaining does not help, indicating the gain comes from calibration, not rote memorization. The signal's one blind spot is confidently wrong facts, which it cannot flag. A model's own doubt is thus a near-free substitute for a labelled dataset when teaching it when to abstain. Code and artifacts are available on request.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需人工标注的"弃权调优"方法：利用模型自身对答案的置信度作为信号，在置信度高时作答、低时回答"不确定"，以此训练模型学会弃权。在六个开源模型上，该方法的表现与使用标签监督的弃权调优方法无显著统计差异。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在陈述错误事实时与其陈述正确事实一样流利，但模型内部其实"知道"自己何时不可靠——它对自己答案的概率在答错时往往会下降。传统的让模型学会弃权而非猜测的做法需要含正确/错误答案的标注数据集，成本高昂。作者希望探究能否用模型自身免费且无需标注的置信度信号来替代标注数据集。
AI.method: 作者使用LoRA对每个模型进行微调，训练策略为：当模型的冻结置信度（frozen confidence）高时回答，低时输出"I'm not sure"。训练信号仅使用模型自身的置信度，不使用任何正确性标签。实验涉及六个开源权重模型（1B-8B，两个模型家族），在短形式事实性问答任务上评估，正确性由独立的裁判模型判定。此外还设置了一个对照组，对困难样本进行强化训练而非弃权训练，以检验收益是否来自校准而非单纯记忆。
AI.result: 在匹配覆盖率（matched coverage）的条件下，该无标签方法与标签监督的弃权调优之间未发现可统计检测的差异。对照组（对困难样本强化训练而非弃权）未带来帮助，表明性能提升来自校准而非机械记忆。该方法的一个盲区是"自信但错误"的事实，无法被其标出。
AI.conclusion: 模型自身的"怀疑"在教模型何时弃权时，可以作为标注数据集的近乎免费的替代品。

title: A Unified Framework for the Mechanics of Information in Convolutional Neural Network Image Space
summary:
This paper introduces a unified mathematical framework for modeling information propagation through convolutional neural networks (CNNs), with the aim of connecting descriptions of physical space and information space.
  A correspondence is presented linking discrete filter symmetry and the relativistic energy--momentum relation under the widely used nonlinear rectified convolution operation. Specifically, symmetric filter components (e.g. the sum $Σ= [1,1]$) operate analogously to rest energy $mc^2$ in preserving the image centre of mass (e.g. isotropic diffusion), whereas antisymmetric components (e.g. the gradient $\nabla = [-1,1]$) operate analogously to the momentum term $pc$ in generally inducing a displacement (e.g. vibration or translation). For typical small discrete filters, this displacement is determined by the ratio of antisymmetric to total filter energy, analogously to how the displacement of a relativistic particle relates to a Lorentz transform with beta parameter $β= \frac{v}{c}=\frac{pc}{E}$ equal to the ratio of momentum $pc$ to total energy $E$.
  Repeated filtering leads to the Gaussian scale-space and emergent scale-invariant features. These constructions share a Laplacian-driven structure with the classical heat (diffusion) equation and, via standard mathematical correspondences, with the Schrödinger equation and aspects of the Friedmann equations, together with emergent Morse topological structure. Demonstrations in 3D images reveal blob-like, scale-invariant Morse critical points in images spanning a wide range of physical scales, including organic sugar molecules and inorganic silicon crystals, human and primate brains in magnetic resonance images (MRI), galaxies and the cosmic microwave background (CMB).

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一数学框架，通过CNN中的卷积操作将物理空间与信息空间的信息传播联系起来，建立了离散滤波器对称性与相对论能量-动量关系之间的对应，并在三维图像中展示了尺度不变的Morse临界点。
AI.motivation: 作者希望建立一个连接物理空间与信息空间的统一数学框架，揭示CNN卷积滤波器中对称/反对称分量的物理意义，从而为理解深度学习中信息传播的本质提供新的视角。
AI.method: 通过数学对应关系，将离散滤波器的对称分量对应为静止能量mc²（保持图像质心），反对称分量对应为动量项pc（产生位移）；利用β=pc/E类比洛伦兹变换；通过Laplacian驱动结构将重复滤波与热方程、薛定谔方程及Friedmann方程联系起来，并借助Morse理论分析尺度不变特征。
AI.result: 在三维图像中（涵盖有机糖分子、无机硅晶体、人及灵长类脑MRI、星系和宇宙微波背景辐射）验证了该方法，检测到类斑点状、尺度不变的Morse临界点，表明该框架适用于跨越极大物理尺度的数据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了CNN卷积运算与相对论物理之间的形式类比，提出了一种连接物理空间与信息空间的统一理论框架，可能为多尺度图像分析与深度学习理论提供新基础。

title: Muon with Finite Newton-Schulz: The Smoothing Benefit in Nonsmooth Nonconvex Optimization
summary: Muon has emerged as a strong optimizer for the matrix-valued parameters in large language model pretraining, approximately orthogonalizing its momentum with a few Newton-Schulz iterations. Existing theory either replaces this iteration with the exact polar factor it approximates, or treats its finite depth as an approximation error, and thus the iteration Muon actually runs can only hurt the guarantees. We show that finite Newton-Schulz can instead be beneficial for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization. To this end, we analyze Muon through the online-to-nonconvex conversion, which views the update rule as an online learner and converts its regret bound into a stationarity guarantee. The finite Newton-Schulz iteration smooths the discontinuous polar map into a Lipschitz map of the singular values, and Muon with finite Newton-Schulz can be regarded as an online learner with a smoothed spectral potential. This smoothing is exactly what the conversion needs: we prove that a Newton-Schulz depth growing only logarithmically in the target accuracy suffices for convergence to stationary points in nonsmooth nonconvex optimization, whereas Muon with the exact-polar update may fail to converge. The resulting sample complexity bounds match the best-known guarantees for nonsmooth nonconvex optimization and are optimal for smooth nonconvex optimization up to problem-dependent factors. The argument extends beyond Newton-Schulz to general spectral maps with the same smoothing property.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Muon优化器中有限深度Newton-Schulz迭代并非近似误差而是有益的，它在非光滑非凸优化中通过平滑不连续的极分解映射促进了收敛到驻点，只需对数深度的迭代即可达到最优样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器在大模型预训练中表现优异，但现有理论要么用精确极分解替代有限次Newton-Schulz迭代，要么将其视为近似误差，导致理论无法解释实际运行的Muon迭代为何有效。需要一种新的理论框架来理解有限Newton-Schulz迭代的真实作用。
AI.method: 通过online-to-nonconvex转换框架分析Muon：将更新规则视为在线学习器，将其遗憾界转换为驻点保证。关键洞察是有限Newton-Schulz迭代将不连续的极分解映射平滑化为奇异值的Lipschitz映射，使Muon可视为带平滑谱势能的在线学习器。通过分析平滑谱势能的收敛性，推导出Newton-Schulz深度只需随目标精度对数增长的样本复杂度界。
AI.result: 证明了Newton-Schulz深度仅需随目标精度对数增长即可保证非光滑非凸优化收敛到驻点，而使用精确极分解的Muon更新可能不收敛。得到的样本复杂度与已知最佳非光滑非凸优化界匹配，且在光滑非凸优化中除问题相关因子外达到最优。该论证还可推广到具有相同平滑性质的一般谱映射。
AI.conclusion: 有限Newton-Schulz迭代的平滑作用是非光滑非凸优化中Muon成功的关键，这为理解Muon在实践中的优越性能提供了理论基础，并展示了数值近似（而非精确计算）在特定优化场景中可能具有积极的理论价值。

title: LLMs in Digital EDA: A perspective on shifting roles from Generation to Orchestration
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables (in Supplementary Information); interactive version of Fig. 2 at https://mattycode101.github.io/LLMs_in_Digital_EDA_Perspective/
summary: Electronic design automation (EDA) has advanced engineering productivity through successive generations of tooling that progressively automate synthesis, optimisation, and verification. Large language models (LLMs) extend this trajectory by enabling direct translation from design intent to hardware implementations. In most of the EDA literature, LLM-based solutions are typically assisting siloed design stages or tasks, however this obscured the drivers by which capability emerges and systems scale. In this Perspective, we instead define three hierarchical roles that reveal how capability accumulates: a Generator that produces design artifacts in a single pass, an Agent that refines outputs through iterative tool feedback, and an Orchestrator that coordinates decisions across EDA-stages. Across published systems, this reveals a syntax trap in which models are trained to produce plausible code rather than physically correct hardware, compounded by fragmented tools and loss of design context that obscure how decisions affect later stages. Comparisons across the three roles show that current approaches struggle to scale to industrial designs, motivating a shift towards a standardised, physics-aware orchestrator that connects tools and agents across the EDA flow for more reliable and accessible hardware design.

AI.tldr: 本文从Perspective视角提出了LLM在EDA中的三种层次化角色（Generator、Agent、Orchestrator），揭示了"语法陷阱"问题，并呼吁向标准化、物理感知的orchestrator范式转变，以解决当前模型难以扩展到工业级硬件设计的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有EDA文献中，LLM解决方案通常局限于孤立的阶段或任务，掩盖了能力涌现与系统扩展的驱动机制。作者希望通过定义层次化角色，揭示能力积累路径，并指出当前范式面临的"语法陷阱"及扩展瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出三种层次化角色框架：Generator（单次生成设计工件）、Agent（通过迭代工具反馈优化输出）、Orchestrator（跨EDA阶段协调决策）。基于该框架对已发表系统进行对比分析，诊断语法陷阱（模型被训练生成合理代码而非物理正确的硬件）、工具碎片化及设计上下文丢失等问题。
AI.result: 跨三个角色的比较表明，当前方法难以扩展到工业级设计。问题根源于语法陷阱（模型生成表面合理但物理不正确的结果）、碎片化工具链以及跨阶段设计上下文丢失，这些因素共同阻碍了系统可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 需要推动范式转变，朝向标准化、物理感知的orchestrator，将工具和代理连接在整个EDA流程中，以实现更可靠、更可及的硬件设计。

title: Surf_2_Volume: a workflow for converting CIFTI parcellations to NIfTI volume space
summary: Parcellations distributed in Connectivity Informatics Technology Initiative (CIFTI) format cannot be used directly in many analysis programs that require volume input. Existing conversion options may leave voxels in cortical gray matter unlabeled or assign labels outside gray matter, depending on the mapping parameters. We present Surf_2_Volume, a workflow that combines Connectome Workbench, FreeSurfer, AFNI, neuromaps, and Python image processing to convert cortical and subcortical CIFTI parcellations into Neuroimaging Informatics Technology Initiative (NIfTI) volumes. The workflow separates cortical and subcortical components, transfers cortical labels through fsaverage and a surface representation of the target MNI152 template, restricts voxel assignment using an adjustable probability threshold for gray matter, and recombines the components. Using the Cole-Anticevic Brain-wide Network Partition, Surf_2_Volume had an adjusted Dice score of 0.776, compared with a maximum of 0.637 among the evaluated Connectome Workbench settings. In a separate test using the Schaefer 2018 17-network volume atlas, the scores were 0.727 for Surf_2_Volume and 0.535 for the best Workbench setting. Across both atlas evaluations, Surf_2_Volume had higher adjusted Dice scores than the evaluated Workbench settings. The workflow provides a way to use surface parcellations in software that requires NIfTI input while allowing explicit control over gray matter coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出了 Surf_2_Volume 工作流，将 CIFTI 格式的皮层和皮层下分区转换为 NIfTI 体积格式，在灰质覆盖方面比 Connectome Workbench 现有方案更准确（调整后 Dice 分数为 0.776 vs 0.637）。
AI.motivation: CIFTI 格式的分区无法直接用于许多需要体积输入的神经影像分析程序。现有的转换方案存在皮层灰质体素未标记或灰质外误标记的问题，需要更精确的转换工作流。
AI.method: 集成 Connectome Workbench、FreeSurfer、AFNI、neuromaps 和 Python 图像处理，分离皮层与皮层下成分，通过 fsaverage 和 MNI152 模板的表面表示转移皮层标签，使用可调节的概率阈值限制灰质体素分配，最后重组各成分。
AI.result: 在 Cole-Anticevic Brain-wide Network Partition 上，调整后 Dice 分数为 0.776（评估的 Workbench 设置最高为 0.637）；在 Schaefer 2018 17-network 测试中为 0.727（Workbench 最佳为 0.535）。两项评估中 Surf_2_Volume 均优于 Workbench。
AI.conclusion: 该工作流为需要 NIfTI 输入且需要明确控制灰质覆盖的软件提供了一种使用表面分区的可靠转换方案。

title: SILK: Closing the Time-of-Check-to-Time-of-Use Gap in RoT-Protected AI Systems
summary:
Root-of-trust (RoT) authentication verifies a DNN model at load time, but weights may subsequently traverse DRAM, DMA, interconnect, and prefetch paths before reaching the compute engine. Post-verification tampering along this path can therefore alter the weights actually consumed while leaving the authenticated model image unchanged, creating a time-of-check-to-time-of-use (TOCTOU) integrity gap.
  We present SILK (Streaming Inline Lightweight Keying), an in-place integrity mechanism that verifies the weight stream at the final pre-compute boundary. SILK repurposes quantized-weight LSBs as secret-keyed integrity bits and chains dependencies across weight bytes, so a local modification perturbs multiple integrity checks. A lightweight streaming checker recomputes these checks without separate authentication tags and uses commit gating to prevent unverified weights from reaching computation. Under a secure pseudorandom function (PRF), the forgery probability decreases exponentially with the number of affected checks, and measured miss rates closely track the analytical bound. SILK detects every stream-modifying instance in our functional attack suite. For INT8, it limits quality loss to at most 0.76 pp across evaluated CNNs and 0.17 perplexity across eight LLMs, while INT4 and MXFP4 provide a configurable security-quality tradeoff through check sparsity. On a Xilinx ZCU102, the synthesized reference pipelined implementation sustains 756 MB/s at only 1.00% of the equivalent area cost of a Caliptra 2.x RoT, while a configuration with a conservative per-attempt forgery bound of 2^-128 still sustains 678 MB/s at 6.15% of the RoT cost.

AI.tldr: SILK是一种流式内联轻量级密钥校验机制，在计算边界处验证DNN权重流，通过将量化权重的LSB重用于秘密密钥完整性位并链式依赖权重字节，无需独立认证标签即可检测权重篡改，解决了传统根信任（RoT）加载时验证后存在的TOCTOU完整性漏洞。
AI.motivation: 传统根信任（RoT）认证仅在模型加载时验证DNN权重，但权重在从DRAM到计算引擎的过程中会经过DMA、互连和预取等路径，攻击者可在认证之后对这条路径上的权重进行篡改，形成检查时间到使用时间（TOCTOU）的完整性缺口，导致实际被消耗的权重与已验证的模型镜像不一致。
AI.method: SILK在最终预计算边界处验证权重流。它将量化权重的LSB重新用作秘密密钥化的完整性位，并在权重字节间建立链式依赖，使局部修改扰动多个完整性检查。一个轻量级流式检查器无需独立认证标签即可重算这些检查，并通过提交门控（commit gating）阻止未经验证的权重进入计算。
AI.result: 在安全PRF假设下，伪造概率随受影响检查数量呈指数下降，实测失配率与理论界紧密吻合。SILK在功能攻击套件中检测到所有修改流的实例。对INT8，它使各CNN的质量损失不超过0.76个百分点，八个LLM的困惑度损失不超过0.17；INT4和MXFP4通过检查稀疏性提供可配置的安全-质量权衡。在Xilinx ZCU102上，参考流水线实现以仅相当于Caliptra 2.x RoT面积成本的1.00%维持756 MB/s吞吐量；保守的单次伪造界2^-128配置仍以RoT成本的6.15%维持678 MB/s。
AI.conclusion: SILK通过在计算边界处进行流式内联完整性验证，以极低的面积开销和可忽略的质量损失有效消除了DNN推理中的TOCTOU完整性漏洞，提供了可配置的安全-质量权衡，适合作为传统RoT认证的互补层部署。

title: Closing the Loop on the Poppy Humanoid: Bipedal Locomotion with Linear-Quadratic Control and Learned Cost Functions
comment: Accepted by International Conference on the AI Revolution: Research, Ethics, and Society (AIR-RES 2026)
summary: The Poppy Humanoid is an open-source, low-cost robot suitable for research and education in artificial intelligence. However, we are unaware of any published methodology that achieves reliable, unassisted bipedal locomotion on the standard Poppy hardware. This paper contributes a functional closed-loop walking controller for Poppy, based on the linear-quadratic regulator (LQR) framework for trajectory tracking. Starting with data collected from open-loop playback of a nominal walking trajectory, our proposed method learns a quadratic cost function for an LQR controller that substantially improves the reliability of the motion. The closed-loop controller is validated empirically, demonstrating statistically significant improvements in walking performance compared to open-loop trajectory playback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于线性二次调节器（LQR）框架的闭环步行控制器，用于开源低成本机器人Poppy，通过从开环行走轨迹数据中学习二次代价函数，显著提升了双足行走的可靠性与性能。
AI.motivation: Poppy人形机器人是面向AI研究与教育的开源低成本平台，但标准硬件上缺乏可靠的双足行走方法。现有文献中尚无无需人工辅助的稳定行走控制方案，因此需要开发一种功能性的闭环步行控制器。
AI.method: 基于LQR框架设计闭环行走控制器用于轨迹跟踪。首先通过开环回放名义行走轨迹收集数据，然后从该数据中学习二次代价函数以调整LQR控制器的代价权重，从而提升运动可靠性。
AI.result: 通过实证验证，闭环控制器相比开环轨迹回放，在行走性能上取得统计学显著的改善。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为Poppy标准硬件提供了首个功能性的闭环双足行走控制方案，展示了通过数据驱动学习代价函数来改进LQR控制器的有效性，为低成本人形机器人的行走研究提供了可复现的开源方法。

title: The Artificial Experimentalist: Discovery and Control of Self-Organizing Phenomena with Autotelic Reinforcement Learning
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at ALIFE 2026. Companion website: https://developmentalsystems.org/carl/
summary: Existing methods for exploring cellular automata and other complex systems mostly operate in open loop: they set initial conditions, execute a full simulation, and observe the outcome, without intervening during execution. We introduce a closed-loop framework based on autotelic reinforcement learning, in which an agent autonomously samples diverse goals and learns a goal-conditioned policy to intervene in a complex system through minimal, local perturbations. We instantiate this framework on Lenia, a continuous cellular automaton known for life-like self-organizing patterns, in an agentic system we call CARL, and demonstrate three capabilities. First, CARL discovers stable solitons across a wide range of Lenia update rules at a higher rate than heuristic baselines. Second, it learns to steer the movement direction of existing solitons with few interventions, showing that CARL can control self-organizing patterns, not only create them. Third, humans can use trained agents to guide solitons through maze environments in real time by specifying high-level directional commands that the agent translates into low-level interventions. Trained across diverse goals, update rules, and random initial states, the agents acquire policies that generalize zero-shot to various out-of-distribution conditions. These results suggest a path toward artificial experimentalist agents that, autonomously or with human guidance, discover and control emergent phenomena in complex systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CARL，一种基于自生成强化学习（autotelic RL）的闭环框架，用于探索和控制Lenia等复杂系统中的涌现现象。CARL能够在多种Lenia更新规则下比启发式基线更高效地发现稳定孤子，学会用少量干预控制已有孤子的运动方向，并支持人类通过高层方向指令实时引导孤子穿越迷宫环境，且策略具备零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有探索元胞自动机等复杂系统的方法多为开环操作——设定初始条件、执行完整模拟、观察结果，无法在执行过程中进行干预。这种范式限制了对涌现现象的主动发现与控制能力，因此需要一种能够与环境持续交互、自主设定目标并学习干预策略的闭环框架。
AI.method: 基于自生成强化学习构建闭环框架：智能体自主采样多样化目标，学习目标条件化策略，通过最小化的局部扰动干预复杂系统。具体在Lenia（一种连续元胞自动机）上实例化为CARL系统，训练覆盖多样目标、更新规则和随机初始状态。
AI.result: 实验展示了三大能力：(1) CARL在多种Lenia更新规则下发现稳定孤子的效率高于启发式基线；(2) 学会用少量干预控制已有孤子的移动方向，表明不仅能创造模式还能控制模式；(3) 人类可通过高层方向指令实时引导训练好的智能体操控孤子穿越迷宫。策略在多种分布外条件下实现了零样本泛化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，基于自生成强化学习的闭合回路智能体能够主动发现并控制复杂系统中的涌现现象，为构建可实现自主或人机协同探索的人工实验者智能体开辟了路径。

title: Which India Survives Translation? Narrative Homogenisation Across Indian Oral Traditions in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are trained predominantly on English-language internet text that over-represents certain cultural narratives, raising concerns that models flatten the diversity of non-Western storytelling traditions into a single homogenized archetype. We present a pilot computational study examining this across three maximally distinct Indian regional oral and literary traditions: the Rajasthani Pabuji epic, classical Tamil Sangam poetry, and Bengali folk tales. We collected authentic reference corpora for each tradition (11, 21, and 10 passages respectively) and prompted two LLMs (Claude Sonnet and Gemini) with 54 generation requests spanning three prompt types per tradition - generic, culturally specific, and regional-language. Using Sentence-BERT embeddings and cosine similarity, we measure reference drift (how closely outputs track their own tradition's authentic texts relative to the other two) and cross-tradition convergence (how similar outputs are across traditions). We find that while outputs remain closer to their own tradition's reference than to others, cross-tradition similarity is high (0.52-0.66) relative to what the traditions' genuine distance would predict, indicating partial homogenisation. Unexpectedly, prompting in the regional language (Hindi, Tamil, or Bengali) consistently reduced fidelity to the authentic tradition relative to English prompting, by as much as 27 percentage points for Rajasthani and Bengali traditions. We discuss this against conflicting prior results on multilingual prompting and argue it reflects a difference between eliciting general cultural diversity and simulating one narrow, lesser-documented oral tradition. We position this pilot as a lightweight, scalable complement to recent large-scale human-annotation studies of Indian cultural misrepresentation in LLM-generated stories, as part of a broader doctoral research program.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对比三个印度地区口头/文学传统（拉贾斯坦Pabuji史诗、泰米尔桑加姆诗歌、孟加拉民间故事）的参考语料与两种LLM生成文本，利用Sentence-BERT嵌入和余弦相似度测量"参考漂移"和"跨传统趋同"，发现模型存在部分文化同质化现象，且区域语言提示反而比英语提示更降低对真实传统的保真度。
AI.motivation: LLM主要基于英语网络文本训练，过度代表特定文化叙事，可能将非西方叙事传统扁平化为同质原型。现有研究对印度文化在LLM生成故事中的误表征关注不足，需要轻量级计算方法来量化这一问题。
AI.method: 选取三个差异最大的印度地区口头传统（Pabuji史诗11篇、桑加姆诗歌21篇、孟加拉民间故事10篇），用Claude Sonnet和Gemini两个模型，基于3种提示类型（通用、文化特定、区域语言）共发起54次生成请求。使用Sentence-BERT嵌入和余弦相似度计算参考漂移（输出与自身传统参考文本的接近程度相对其他传统）和跨传统趋同（不同传统输出间的相似度）。
AI.result: 输出文本更接近自身传统的参考文本而非其他传统，但跨传统相似度高达0.52-0.66，相对真实传统间距离偏高，表明存在部分同质化。出乎意料的是，使用区域语言（印地语、泰米尔语、孟加拉语）提示反而使对传统文本的忠实度比英语提示降低最多27个百分点（拉贾斯坦和孟加拉传统）。
AI.conclusion: LLM确实部分同质化了印度地域叙事传统；区域语言提示的效果与先前多语言提示研究结果存在冲突，作者将其归因于"激发一般文化多样性"与"模拟狭窄、记录较少的口头传统"之间的差异。该研究定位为大规模人类标注研究的轻量级、可扩展补充。

title: VIPER: An Expert-Curated Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Veterinary Pathology
summary: Pathology vision-language models are advancing rapidly, yet existing benchmarks remain focused on human tissue, particularly oncology, leaving non-human pathology largely unaddressed. This gap is especially important in toxicologic pathology, where microscopic tissue examination of laboratory animals is a core component of preclinical drug safety assessment. To address it, we introduce VIPER, the first expert-curated benchmark for vision-language model evaluation in toxicologic pathology. VIPER contains 1,251 questions associated with 419 H&E-stained rat histology images across seven organ systems, covering multiple-choice, KPrim, and free-text formats. All questions were curated and validated by board-certified veterinary pathologists. In total, we benchmarked 16 models, including two newly introduced veterinary-pathology models, seven human pathology-specialized models, and seven general-purpose frontier models. The results identify a substantial domain gap between veterinary and human pathology, expose the risk of over-diagnosis of normal tissue in frontier models, and show that domain-specific training remains critical for visually grounded predictions. VIPER data and evaluation code are available at https://github.com/mahmoodlab/viper.

AI.tldr: VIPER是首个由兽医病理学专家策划的毒理病理学视觉语言模型基准，包含419张H&E染色大鼠组织图像上的1251个问题（覆盖七个器官系统），并系统评测了16个模型（含2个新提出的兽医病理模型、7个人类病理专用模型和7个通用前沿模型），揭示了兽医病理与人类病理之间存在显著的领域差距，前沿模型存在正常组织过度诊断的风险，且领域特定训练对视觉基础预测至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有病理视觉语言模型基准几乎全部聚焦于人类组织（尤其是肿瘤学），忽略了非人类病理学领域。毒理病理学作为临床前药物安全评估的核心环节，需要显微镜下检查实验动物组织，但目前缺乏专门用于评估视觉语言模型在该领域性能的基准。
AI.method: 构建VIPER基准：包含与419张H&E染色大鼠组织病理图像关联的1251个问题，覆盖七个器官系统，问题格式涵盖多项选择、KPrim（关键点推理）和自由文本。所有问题由获得资质认证的兽医病理学家策划和验证。对16个模型进行基准测试，包括2个新引入的兽医病理专用模型、7个人类病理专用模型和7个通用前沿模型。
AI.result: 评测结果发现：兽医病理与人类病理之间存在显著的领域差距；前沿模型存在对正常组织过度诊断的风险；领域特定的训练对于实现视觉基础（视觉依据）的正确预测仍然至关重要。
AI.conclusion: VIPER填补了毒理病理学领域视觉语言模型评估基准的空白，为兽医及毒理病理学方向的模型发展提供了标准化评测框架。数据和代码已开源。

title: Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading
summary: Modern machine learning models rely on large amounts of labeled data. However, manual annotation of large-scale datasets is expensive and time-consuming. Label spreading is a semi-supervised learning technique that addresses this challenge by propagating information from a few labeled examples to a larger pool of unlabeled data. Despite its effectiveness, its application to large-scale, high-dimensional datasets is limited by computational costs and memory constraints. To address these limitations, we propose Algebraic Multigrid Acceleration for Efficient Label Spreading (AMELS), an efficient label spreading framework that improves scalability by fast construction of neighborhood graphs and the incorporation of algebraic multigrid solvers. The latter is an iterative solver that replaces the ordinary random walk iteration typically performed in label spreading. Due to the multilevel nature of algebraic multigrid solvers, AMELS spreads given label information across a graph of any size in a single multigrid cycle. We demonstrate that AMELS achieves significant runtime reductions compared to existing implementations while also being more robust to hyperparameter choices in terms of both runtime and classification accuracy. Our framework therefore enables efficient label spreading on large-scale image datasets and produces accurate labels even when only a few labeled samples are available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AMELS框架，通过快速邻接图构建和代数多重网格求解器加速标签传播，实现在大规模高维数据集上的高效半监督学习。
AI.motivation: 大规模数据集的标注成本高昂，标签传播作为半监督学习技术虽然有效，但在大规模高维数据集上受限于计算成本和内存约束，难以实际应用。
AI.method: AMELS框架包含两个核心改进：(1) 快速构建邻居图以提升扩展性；(2) 引入代数多重网格(AMG)迭代求解器替代传统的随机游走迭代，利用多层级特性在单个多重网格周期内完成任意规模图的标签传播，同时增强了对超参数的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验表明AMELS相比现有实现在运行时间上显著减少，在运行时和分类精度方面对超参数选择更鲁棒，能够在大规模图像数据集上高效生成准确标签，即使在标记样本极少的情况下也表现良好。
AI.conclusion: AMELS使标签传播能够大规模可扩展地应用于图像数据集，在少量标注样本条件下仍能产生准确标签，为半监督学习在大规模场景下的应用提供了高效解决方案。

title: Agent Mesh: Reliability Primitives for Non-Idempotent Agent Delegation - Identity Adequacy and Evidence Adequacy
summary: Autonomous agents increasingly perform bounded software tasks under an orchestrator that retries, resumes, and budgets them. The machinery such orchestrators reach for is the service mesh's: retry, timeout, and error-rate circuit breaking. We report a failure study of a production agentic software-delivery platform over 147 numbered incidents spanning 81 runs, each with a measured cost and, in most cases, a mutation proof reproducing the failure. All three assumptions those primitives rest on are violated in practice, and we quantify the consequences: a loop of fifty-four consecutive successful tool calls no error-rate breaker could see; a progress signal constant by construction, guaranteeing a false trip on the third repair round and driving one run from six of six components to three; twenty-one events accumulated across six invocations of one delegation, making a correct, idempotent component unwinnable; a misrouted failure that woke five components for a two-component fault, leaving three bystanders regressing working code; and twelve incidents in which the enforcement layer blocked correct work, the most expensive costing 107 agent turns and zero accepted writes. We find one cross-cutting cause and its dual. Identity adequacy: in five separate subsystems an identity that failed to discriminate produced a confident wrong answer, and two of them derived the corrective rule independently. Evidence adequacy: a reliability decision may be taken only on evidence capable of moving, attributable to what it measures, and deterministic under identical conditions. From the findings we derive seven reliability primitives whose enforcement unit is the delegation rather than the message, and specify the controlled evaluation the study motivates but does not constitute.

AI.tldr: 对生产环境代理式软件交付平台的147个编号事故（81次运行）进行失败研究，发现服务网格三大可靠性原语（重试、超时、错误率熔断）所依赖的假设在实践中全部失效，并量化了后果；识别出两个横切根因（身份充分性与证据充分性），据此提出七个以委派（delegation）为执行单元的可靠性原语。
AI.motivation: 自主代理在有编排器管理（重试、恢复、预算）的受限软件任务中日益普遍，而编排器所依赖的机制（重试、超时、错误率熔断）源自服务网格。但这些机制所基于的假设在代理环境中是否成立缺乏实证验证，本研究通过生产平台的事故数据来检验这些假设。
AI.method: 对生产环境代理式软件交付平台进行失败研究，收集147个编号事故（分布于81次运行），每次运行都记录测量成本，多数事故附有可复现失败的变异证明（mutation proof）。通过系统性分类和量化分析，检验服务网格三大可靠性原语所依赖的假设在代理环境中的有效性，并归纳横切根因。
AI.result: 发现三大假设（重试、超时、错误率熔断）在代理环境中全部被违反：54次连续成功的工具调用循环使错误率熔断无法察觉；进度信号因构造而为常数，导致第三次修复轮次必然误触发熔断（使一次运行从6/6组件降为3）；单次委派累积21个事件使正确且幂等的组件无法获胜；错误路由导致5个组件被唤醒而实际仅2个组件故障，3个旁观者回归破坏工作代码；12起事故中执行层阻止了正确工作，最贵的一次消耗107个代理turn且零写入被接受。识别出两个横切根因：身份充分性（5个子系统中身份辨别失败导致自信的错误答案）和证据充分性（可靠性决策必须基于可移动、可归因、确定性的证据）。据此提出7个以委派而非消息为执行单元的可靠性原语。
AI.conclusion: 服务网格的可靠性原语不能直接移植到代理编排场景，因为它们基于的假设（错误可被连续成功稀释、进度可测、故障可归因于消息）在代理环境中系统性失效。未来需要以委派为执行单元的可靠性原语，并对设计进行受控评估（该研究本身不构成该评估，但指明了方向）。

title: GRAS: Guided Reduced-Variance Proposals and Adaptive Selection for Training-Free Reward Alignment in Discrete Diffusion
summary: Discrete diffusion models have become a strong, widely adopted class of generators for sequence data, and steering them toward a downstream reward at inference time, without any retraining, is increasingly important. Such training-free steering is done by gradient guidance, by search, or by combining the two. We study the combined regime and identify two weaknesses in how it is usually run: the guided proposal estimates its gradient from a single noisy sample, and the search then resamples particles at a fixed temperature that ignores how rewards spread across each denoising step. We address both with a small set of changes that add no denoiser cost. For the proposal, we lower the estimator variance with a Rao-Blackwellized reveal for differentiable rewards and a leave-one-out baseline for non-differentiable ones; for the search, we standardize the per-step values into a group-relative advantage and prove it collapses to a single active ingredient, an adaptive resampling temperature. We call the resulting method Guided Reduced-variance proposals and Adaptive Selection (GRAS). GRAS is simple yet effective: across regulatory DNA and protein design it attains the best training-free reward, outperforming prior training-free methods and matching or surpassing a reward-fine-tuned model, and it remains effective even for non-differentiable rewards.

AI.tldr: 提出一种称为GRAS的训练免费离散扩散模型推理期引导方法，通过Rao-Blackwell化降低梯度估计方差，并引入组相对优势与自适应重采样温度来改进搜索机制，在调控DNA和蛋白质设计任务上优于现有训练免费方法，甚至匹敌或超越奖励微调模型。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型已成为序列数据的强生成器，推理期无需重训练即可引导其向特定下游奖励靠拢的需求日益重要。现有训练免费引导方法通常结合梯度引导与搜索两种方式，但存在两个关键弱点：引导提议仅从单个噪声样本估计梯度导致高方差，且搜索以固定温度重采样粒子而忽视了奖励在去噪各步中的分布特性。
AI.method: 针对上述两个弱点提出少量修改且不增加去噪器成本。对提议部分，利用Rao-Blackwell化揭示（针对可微奖励）降低估计器方差，对不可微奖励则采用留一（leave-one-out）基线；对搜索部分，将每步值标准化为组相对优势（group-relative advantage），并证明其最终塌缩为单一有效成分——自适应重采样温度。
AI.result: 在调控DNA和蛋白质设计任务中，GRAS取得了最佳的训练免费奖励，优于既有训练免费方法，并可与奖励微调模型匹敌甚至超越；在非可微奖励场景下依然保持有效。
AI.conclusion: GRAS是一种简单而有效的方案，通过降低梯度估计方差与引入自适应重采样温度，同时改善了训练免费引导中梯度与搜索两个环节的缺陷，在多个序列设计任务上验证了其优越性和普适性。

title: IoMT-SecAlarmBench: A Counterfactual Benchmark for Integrity Attacks in IoMT
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Big Data (BigData) 2026. Benchmark, generator, evaluation harness, and datasheet: https://github.com/techosystem/IoMT_SecAlarmBench
summary: The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT) combines clinical physiological data with cyber-system information, creating challenges in determining whether an abnormal reading reflects a genuine physiological event, a device fault, or a cyber-attack within the expected physiological range. Answering this requires counterfactual ground truth, which no existing dataset provides. We present IoMT-SecAlarmBench, a semi-synthetic benchmark that injects controlled integrity attacks into genuine coupled ECG+PPG recordings using a structured experimental design combining four attack morphologies, four severity levels, two physiological plausibility conditions, and replay attacks. Each injected window retains its cause, attack subtype, and the clean signal that would have been observed without the attack. We evaluate six detectors from five method families using threshold-independent measures and a matched false-alarm budget. Results show no method consistently detects the most difficult cases: replay attacks and low-amplitude transient spikes remain close to chance-level performance across detectors. Results also reveal a trade-off between detecting attacks and distinguishing them from sensor faults: the best-performing detector on hard cases flags fault/artifact windows at 5.3 times its false-alarm rate on normal data. Three-way classification performs poorly for genuine physiological events, and a leakage audit of a dual-modality network dataset indicates previously reported IoMT intrusion-detection performance is partly driven by identifying information. Benchmark, generation code, preprocessing, evaluation tools, and datasheet are released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IoMT-SecAlarmBench，一个半合成基准数据集，通过将受控完整性攻击注入真实的ECG+PPG配对信号，评估医疗物联网(IoMT)安全告警系统在区分真实生理事件、设备故障和网络攻击方面的能力。实验发现现有检测器在最困难的攻击类型（重放攻击和低幅瞬态尖峰）上接近随机水平，且存在检测攻击与区分传感器故障之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: IoMT中异常读数可能来自真实生理事件、设备故障或网络攻击，但现有数据集缺乏反事实真值（即如果没有攻击本应观察到的干净信号），导致无法严格评估检测器的鲁棒性和区分能力。
AI.method: 采用结构化实验设计，将四种攻击形态、四种严重级别、两种生理合理性条件和重放攻击注入到真实的ECG+PPG配对记录中，生成半合成基准数据集。每个注入窗口保留其成因、攻击子类型和对应的干净信号作为反事实真值。使用阈值无关的评估指标和匹配的误报预算来评估五个方法家族的六种检测器。
AI.result: 没有检测器能够持续检测最困难的情况：重放攻击和低幅瞬态尖峰在所有检测器上接近随机水平。检测攻击与区分传感器故障之间存在权衡：在困难案例上表现最好的检测器，其故障/伪影窗口的标记率是正常数据误报率的5.3倍。三分类对真实生理事件的识别表现不佳。泄漏审计表明先前报道的IoMT入侵检测性能部分由识别信息驱动。
AI.conclusion: 当前IoMT安全检测方法在最困难的实际攻击场景下仍不可靠，需要更好的基准和算法。该基准、生成代码、预处理、评估工具和数据表均已开源，为后续研究提供了标准化评估平台。

title: Memory Anchors for Continual Robot Learning
summary: Robot policies deployed in the wild should have the capability to continually learn new tasks without forgetting existing behaviors. A common approach to combat such catastrophic forgetting is to train on new task data with a replay buffer of previously learned task data. Although this buffer is commonly sampled randomly from all prior experiences, we show that a small set of these experiences contributes greatly in anchoring past performance. We call these experiences Memory Anchors. We identify Memory Anchors in regions where representations of new-task observations collapse onto those of old-task observations even though the tasks require conflicting actions, like when a familiar object must be manipulated in a new way. Rehearsing old data in this region plays a key role in preventing destructive overwriting of past task knowledge, serving as this critical Memory Anchor role. Excluding only 10% Memory Anchors before sampling the buffer leads to more than a 4.5x increase in catastrophic forgetting on the LIBERO benchmark suites. Conversely, enriching the replay buffer with Memory Anchors can decrease high-conflict task forgetting by 63% and enables successful continual learning of two task sequences on a real robot. Videos and additional visualizations can be found at https://robot-adaptation.github.io/MemoryAnchors

AI.tldr: 本文提出"记忆锚点"（Memory Anchors）概念——即新任务表征与旧任务表征在表征空间中发生坍缩重叠、但二者需要冲突动作的关键经验样本。研究发现，仅需少量这类样本即可在重放缓冲区中起到锚定旧任务性能的作用，剔除10%的记忆锚点会导致灾难性遗忘增加4.5倍以上，而富集记忆锚点可将高冲突任务遗忘降低63%。
AI.motivation: 机器人策略在真实场景部署时需要持续学习新任务而不遗忘已有行为。常见的缓解灾难性遗忘的方法是从既往经验中随机采样重放缓冲区，但作者发现并非所有旧经验对保持旧性能同等重要——只有少量关键经验在防止旧知识被破坏性覆盖中起决定性作用，因此需要识别并利用这些关键经验。
AI.method: 作者通过分析新任务观测表征与旧任务观测表征在特征空间的坍缩重叠区域来识别记忆锚点（Memory Anchors）。这些区域的特点是：新旧任务观测在表征上高度相似（坍缩到一起），但所需动作冲突。识别出这些锚点后，将其从重放缓冲采样中排除或富集，以验证其对灾难性遗忘的关键作用，并在LIBERO基准和真实机器人上进行了实验验证。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准套件上，仅排除10%的记忆锚点后再采样缓冲区，灾难性遗忘增加超过4.5倍；相反，在重放缓冲区中富集记忆锚点可将高冲突任务的遗忘降低63%，并成功实现了真实机器人上两个任务序列的持续学习。
AI.conclusion: 记忆锚点是重放缓冲区中极小但关键的样本子集，位于新旧任务表征坍缩且动作冲突的区域，对防止灾难性遗忘具有不成比例的重要作用。随机采样重放缓冲区并非最优策略，应针对性保留或富集记忆锚点以提升持续学习效果。

title: The Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox Quantifying Net Energy Loss in on-Device Energy Forecasting
comment: The 5th International Conference on Mobile, Military, Maritime IT Convergence (ICMIC 2026)
summary: Energy forecasting aims to maximize accuracy to ensure energy efficiency by reducing energy waste, an objective that applies equally to on-device forecasting for mission-critical edge environments, including military systems. However, this paper identifies the Accuracy-Efficiency Paradox: high-precision energy forecasting models can ironically trigger a net energy deficit. This stems from both edge AI's inference energy consumption and battery aging. We propose a Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) framework for energy forecasting, designed to minimize net energy loss. This framework treats not only inference energy consumption but also battery aging as a unified form of energy loss, as degradation represents a physical dissipation of the system's future energy-carrying capacity. We demonstrate that in thermally sensitive edge environments, energy saved by the superior precision of complex architectures is often outweighed by the total energy lost through their high operational intensity.

AI.tldr: 本文指出能源预测领域存在"精度-效率悖论"：高精度的能源预测模型可能由于边缘AI推理能耗和电池老化而反而导致净能源赤字。为此提出总拥有成本（TCO）框架，将推理能耗与电池老化统一视为能量损失，以最小化净能量损失为目标，并证明在热敏感边缘环境中，复杂架构带来的精度优势往往被其高运行强度造成的总能量损失所抵消。
AI.motivation: 能源预测的核心目标是最大化精度以减少能源浪费，该目标同样适用于军事系统等关键边缘环境中的端上预测。然而作者发现一个悖论：高精度预测模型虽然节省了预测误差带来的能源浪费，但模型本身在边缘设备上推理所消耗的能量以及因高负载导致的电池加速老化（物理上消耗了系统未来承载能量的能力），可能使得净能源收益为负。因此需要重新审视精度与能耗之间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 提出一个总拥有成本（Total Cost of Ownership, TCO）框架用于能源预测，该框架的核心创新在于将两类能源损失统一建模：一是边缘AI模型推理本身的能耗，二是电池老化带来的未来能量承载能力损耗（退化被视为系统未来能量的物理耗散）。通过统一的能量损失度量，对预测精度与运行成本进行综合权衡优化。
AI.result: 在热敏感边缘环境中的实验表明，复杂架构模型凭借更高精度所节省的能量，往往无法抵消其高运行强度所导致的推理能耗与电池老化带来的总能量损失，从而验证了精度-效率悖论的存在以及TCO框架的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 能源预测不应仅以预测精度为唯一优化目标，而应从总拥有成本的角度综合考虑模型推理能耗与电池老化损耗，在热敏感边缘环境中尤其需要警惕复杂模型带来的净能量赤字。

title: Natural-Language Policies to Executable Decisions: An Interpretable Large Language Model Framework
summary: Pricing automation in large-scale tourism is challenging because travel orders are highly unstructured, while pricing policies are complex, rapidly evolving, and inherently open-ended. Traditional rule engines are brittle and costly to maintain, whereas unconstrained LLM agents lack the reliability and auditability required for financial decisions. We present a production-grade LLM-powered pricing system with a strict decision boundary: LLMs perform structured extraction and bounded policy/path selection, while all numeric pricing, including total-price computation, is executed deterministically. Policies are compiled into interpretable condition trees, enabling open-ended support for new clauses and evolving rules without code changes, while exposing auditable artifacts for human-in-the-loop control. Periodic fine-tuning on logged traces further improves tree induction and path matching. Deployed at a municipal state-owned tourism enterprise across 7 scenic sites and 12 business categories with 1,500+ operators and 1,000+ active policies, the system processed 3,960 orders in six months, reduced the order management team from 15-20 to 3, and cut per-order handling time from 10 minutes to <2 minutes.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个生产级LLM驱动的定价系统，采用严格的决策边界：LLM负责结构化提取和有界策略/路径选择，所有数值定价计算由确定性程序执行。该系统在市级国有旅游企业部署，覆盖7个景区、12个业务类别、1500+运营者和1000+活跃策略，6个月内处理3960个订单，将订单管理团队从15-20人缩减至3人，单订单处理时间从10分钟降至2分钟以内。
AI.motivation: 大规模旅游定价自动化面临挑战：旅行订单高度非结构化，定价策略复杂、快速演变且天然开放。传统规则引擎脆弱且维护成本高，而无约束的LLM代理在财务决策中缺乏可靠性和可审计性，因此需要一种兼具灵活性、可靠性和可审计性的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出严格的决策边界架构：LLM仅负责结构化提取和有界的策略/路径选择，所有数值定价（包括总价计算）由确定性引擎执行。策略编译为可解释的条件树，支持新条款和规则演化而无需代码变更，同时生成可审计的工件支持人工介入控制。此外，通过定期在日志轨迹上进行微调来改进树归纳和路径匹配。
AI.result: 系统在市级国有旅游企业部署，覆盖7个景区和12个业务类别，支持1500+运营者和1000+活跃策略。6个月内处理3960个订单，订单管理团队从15-20人缩减至3人，单订单处理时间从10分钟降至不足2分钟。
AI.conclusion: 将LLM的能力限定在结构化提取和有界决策选择范围内，同时将数值定价交给确定性执行，可以在保持开放性和灵活性的前提下实现生产级财务决策所需的可靠性、可审计性和可维护性，显著提升运营效率。

title: Mapping Woody Vegetation from Multi-Source Imagery and Prediction Fusion for Enhanced Data Efficiency and Accuracy
comment: Published in IEEE Journal of Selected Topics in Applied Earth Observations and Remote Sensing
summary: Tree cover maps are a fundamental remote sensing product, used to derive ecological insights about the landscape and are essential to change detection, vegetation mapping and fire monitoring programs. However, comprehensive tree cover mapping requires reliable and high-quality imagery, free of cloud and weather defects to ensure accurate model outputs. Deep learning approaches can generate high quality maps with minimal human intervention but require large amounts of human annotated data to be successful. In this work we propose a framework consisting of methods that aim to improve the data efficiency and robustness of deep learning models using data fusion techniques to segment woody vegetation defined as vegetation over the height of 2m across the state of New South Wales, Australia. To improve robustness against varying image quality, we propose an image composition method that normalizes the imagery and removes defects, whilst also minimizing the reliance on individual image quality by proposing a prediction fusion method. The two methods resulted in an error reduction of 38.2% and 53.6% respectively compared to single-source imagery. To address deep learning approaches' limitation of requiring large amounts of data, we apply label transfer to multiple sources of imagery as a form of data augmentation to improve data efficiency. Learning from multiple image sources was shown to be the biggest improvement in performance, resulting in an error reduction between 28.1% to 76.2% across the different validation experiments, whilst reducing the standard deviation of performance across image dates by a factor of 13.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个数据融合框架，通过图像归一化/缺陷去除的合成方法、预测融合方法以及基于标签迁移的多源数据增强策略，提升深度学习模型在澳大利亚新南威尔士州木本植被（高度>2m）分割中的数据效率与鲁棒性，分别实现38.2%、53.6%和28.1%-76.2%的误差降低。
AI.motivation: 树冠覆盖图是遥感领域的基础产品，但其生成依赖无云无缺陷的高质量影像。深度学习方法虽能生成高质量地图，但需要大量人工标注数据。现有方法在图像质量鲁棒性和数据效率方面存在不足，亟需一种既能应对影像质量变化又能减少标注依赖的框架。
AI.method: 提出一个三部分组成的框架：(1) 图像合成方法，对影像进行归一化并移除云和天气缺陷；(2) 预测融合方法，降低对单幅图像质量的依赖；(3) 标签迁移技术，将标注转移到多源影像上作为数据增强手段，提升多源学习的效率与泛化能力。
AI.result: 图像合成和预测融合方法分别比单源影像降低了38.2%和53.6%的误差；多源学习是最大的性能提升来源，在不同验证实验中将误差降低了28.1%至76.2%，并将不同成像日期间性能的标准差降低了13倍。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过数据融合和标签迁移有效提升了深度学习模型在木本植被分割任务中的数据效率和鲁棒性，多源学习是性能提升贡献最大的因素，显著增强了模型在不同影像质量和日期条件下的稳定性。

title: Privacy Without Regret: Differentially Private Inference-Time Alignment
summary: Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is the simplest and most widely deployed inference-time alignment strategy, but it suffers from two distinct problems: reward hacking, in which the selected response exploits errors in the proxy reward model, and the absence of any privacy protection for the sensitive human preference data used to train that reward model. We show that a single intervention-adding calibrated noise to reward scores before selection-resolves both. Our first result, Private Best-of-N (PrivBoN), establishes that Gumbel noise at an appropriate scale simultaneously provides $ε$-differential privacy and implements KL-regularized alignment. Whenever the privacy budget exceeds a critical threshold $ε^*$, the privacy-mandated noise is the regret-optimal regularization, and privacy imposes zero additional alignment cost-matching the information-theoretic skyline of Huang et al. (2025). Because $ε^*$ depends on an unknown coverage coefficient, we introduce Private Inference-Time Pessimism (PrivITP), which combines $χ^2$-regularized rejection sampling with a two-phase Gaussian mechanism. PrivITP achieves ex-post $(ε,δ)$-DP with a privacy cost independent of the number of responses $n$, cleanly decouples the regularization parameter from the privacy parameter, and attains the skyline up to a noise-inflation term. Experiments across several language models, datasets, and reward models confirm our results: PrivBoN and PrivITP are scaling-monotonic (unlike BoN, which degrades past a critical $n$), and PrivITP matches or outperforms PrivBoN at equivalent privacy levels, with the largest gains in the strong-privacy regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种带隐私保护的推理时对齐采样方法：PrivBoN和PrivITP，通过在奖励分数中添加校准的Gumbel噪声或结合χ²正则化拒绝采样与两阶段高斯机制，同时解决Best-of-N采样中的奖励黑客和隐私泄露两大问题，在ε-差分隐私和KL/χ²正则化对齐之间建立了理论等价性。
AI.motivation: Best-of-N (BoN)采样是最广泛使用的推理时对齐策略，但存在两个独立问题：奖励黑客（代理奖励模型误差被利用）和敏感人类偏好数据的隐私泄露。此前研究分别处理这两个问题，但本文证明单一干预（添加校准噪声）可以同时解决两者，且当隐私预算超过临界阈值时，隐私强制噪声本身就是最优正则化，隐私不产生额外对齐代价。
AI.method: 1) PrivBoN：在奖励分数选择前添加Gumbel噪声，同时实现ε-差分隐私和KL正则化对齐，证明隐私预算超过临界阈值ε*时达到信息论最优；2) PrivITP：结合χ²正则化拒绝采样和两阶段高斯机制，实现事后(ε,δ)-DP，隐私成本独立于响应数量n，将正则化参数与隐私参数解耦。
AI.result: 实验验证了PrivBoN和PrivITP具有尺度单调性（而BoN在超过临界n后性能退化），且在等价隐私水平下PrivITP匹配或优于PrivBoN，在强隐私区域增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 校准噪声的统一干预能同时解决BoN采样的奖励黑客和隐私保护两大问题，且强隐私下PrivITP是最优选择。

title: Distributed Training using an Intelligent Network
summary: Distributed training across a wide area network (WAN) is challenging, as continuous parameter exchange by islands of compute is constrained by limited bandwidth, high latency, and uneven topology. We propose making the network an active participant in training. On the systems side, such networks should leverage (i) multicast technology to replicate outbound traffic and (ii) in-line FPGAs to aggregate inbound traffic, to ease egress and ingress bottlenecks. These technologies are used for training across workers within a data center, but this paper extends them to the WAN. On the algorithms side, we develop an optimization framework that produces rich synchronization schedules (namely, rotating cliques of islands) around the underlying network topology and these technologies, to maximize information exchange. Finally, we illustrate this on a nine-city topology modeled on the DoubleZero network, a live programmable WAN equipped with both technologies, and show how the optimal schedules shift with the network's capabilities. Together, these can narrow the gap to the gold standard of colocated training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用WAN中的组播技术和FPGA内联聚合能力，使网络成为分布式训练中的活跃参与者，并结合优化框架生成围绕网络拓扑的富同步调度（旋转worker岛团），以缓解广域网带宽受限、高延迟和拓扑不均带来的训练瓶颈，缩小与同地训练的性能差距。
AI.motivation: 广域网（WAN）分布式训练面临带宽受限、高延迟和拓扑不均等挑战，传统的连续参数交换方式受到严重制约，亟需从系统和算法两个层面突破这些瓶颈，使跨地域训练更加高效。
AI.method: 在系统层面，利用组播（multicast）技术复制出站流量以缓解出口瓶颈，利用内联FPGA聚合入站流量以缓解入口瓶颈，并将这些原本用于数据中心内部的技术扩展至WAN。在算法层面，开发了一个优化框架，生成丰富的同步调度方案（即围绕底层网络拓扑旋转的worker岛团），以最大化信息交换效率。在基于DoubleZero网络的九城市拓扑上进行验证。
AI.result: 在参照DoubleZero网络建模的九城市拓扑上进行了验证实验，结果表明最优调度方案会随网络能力的变化而发生相应调整，这些技术组合能够显著缩小跨WAN分布式训练与同地训练这一黄金标准之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 通过将网络（组播与FPGA）作为训练过程的主动参与者，并配合拓扑感知的优化调度，可以显著缓解WAN分布式训练的通信瓶颈，使其性能接近同地训练的理想水平。

title: Vision-centric generative AI models: A software-hardware perspective
summary: Vision generative artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as one of the most rapidly advancing areas of deep learning. The explosion of multimodal models has made them widely associated with text-to-image applications running on large datacentres. However, vision generative models are equally needed in applications that operate under strict hardware constraints at the edge, including autonomous vehicles, agricultural sensors, and mobile devices.
