In this Perspective, we argue that progress in vision generative AI has been driven by output quality, with hardware evolving reactively to accommodate growing model demands. We quantify the parameter cost and energy efficiency of these models across a range of accelerator platforms, and map four generative model families against seven real-world application domains. Finally, we advocate a software-hardware co-design approach, where deployment constraints are considered from the start of the design process, ensuring that the "right model" runs on the "right hardware" to serve the "right application", making generative AI deployment sustainable and accessible across a much broader range of platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇Perspective（观点性文章），指出视觉生成式AI的进展主要由输出质量驱动，硬件被动适配模型需求；作者呼吁采用软硬件协同设计的方法，让"正确的模型跑在正确的硬件上服务于正确的应用"，从而实现生成式AI在边缘平台（如自动驾驶车辆、农业传感器、移动设备）上的可持续和可及部署。
AI.motivation: 视觉生成式AI在边缘受限硬件场景（如自动驾驶、农业传感器、移动设备）中同样不可或缺，但当前进展几乎由输出质量驱动，硬件只能被动适应不断增长的模型需求，缺乏对部署约束的主动考虑，导致边缘侧生成式AI部署不可持续、不可及。
AI.method: 量化了多种加速器平台上视觉生成模型的参数成本和能效；将四类生成模型家族与七个真实应用领域进行映射匹配；在此基础上提出软硬件协同设计（software-hardware co-design）的框架，主张在模型设计之初即考虑部署约束。
AI.result: 通过参数成本与能效的量化分析以及模型家族与应用领域的映射，揭示了当前生成式AI"以质量为中心"的发展模式与边缘部署需求之间的错配，并论证了软硬件协同设计的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 生成式AI的可持续与广泛部署需要从设计源头纳入硬件约束，通过软硬件协同设计实现模型、硬件与应用的最优匹配，使生成式AI惠及更广泛的平台和场景。

title: Unsaid, Unsafe? Implicit Security Obligations in LLM-Based RTL Code Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) generate register-transfer-level (RTL) code with rapidly improving functional correctness. Security of LLM-generated code, however, has been studied mainly for software, where flaws can still be patched after deployment. Insecure RTL offers no such remedy once taped out into silicon. We construct SECRTL-GEN, a multi-language resource-access security benchmark grounded in real SoC IP: 392 tasks over five CWE families and four HDLs (Verilog, SystemVerilog, VHDL, and Python), each with black-box functional and security testbenches. Functional specifications intentionally omit security obligations, matching how obligations are often kept out of functional docs in practice. An empirical study of five frontier LLMs shows a sharp gap: under vanilla prompts they pass functional tests in about 73-79% of cases but security tests in only 14-35%, and stronger functional models are not safer. Adding CWE knowledge raises security, while unaided self-thinking helps less and both security-oriented prompts cut functional pass rates, showing that the bottleneck is missing weakness awareness in the specification, not an inability to write defensive RTL. We present RTL-Obliger, a neuro-symbolic framework that infers these implicit obligations. An LLM extracts a functional-semantic graph from the specification; a symbolic engine then matches it against a CWE pattern ontology to surface mitigation-evidence gaps and signal-level obligations; the LLM finally revises RTL under those obligations in a functionality-preserving two-stage generation. Across five models and four languages, RTL-Obliger raises mean all-pass from 49.6-51.4% (SecV/RESCUE) to 61.6%, with higher security and functional rates than these secure-generation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了SECRTL-GEN多语言资源访问安全基准（392个任务、5个CWE家族、4种HDL），揭示了前沿LLM生成RTL代码时功能正确性与安全性之间的巨大差距（功能通过率73-79%，安全通过率仅14-35%），并提出RTL-Obliger神经符号框架通过推断隐式安全义务来提升代码安全性，将平均全通过率从49.6-51.4%提升至61.6%。
AI.motivation: LLM生成RTL代码的功能正确性快速提升，但安全性研究主要集中在软件领域。软件漏洞可在部署后修补，而RTL一旦流片（tape out）到硅片则无法补救。现有工作忽略了RTL代码的安全问题，缺乏专门针对硬件描述语言的安全基准和生成方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建SECRTL-GEN基准：基于真实SoC IP，包含392个任务、5个CWE家族、4种HDL（Verilog、SystemVerilog、VHDL、Python），配备黑盒功能与安全测试台；功能规格有意省略安全义务以模拟实际开发场景。2) 对5个前沿LLM进行经验研究，对比vanilla提示、CWE知识注入和自推理等策略。3) 提出RTL-Obliger神经符号框架：LLM提取功能语义图，符号引擎与CWE模式本体匹配以识别缓解证据缺口和信号级义务，LLM在这些义务指导下进行保持功能的两阶段生成。
AI.result: 经验研究显示：vanilla提示下功能测试通过率73-79%，但安全测试仅14-35%；更强的功能模型并不更安全。加入CWE知识可提升安全性，但无辅助的自推理效果较差，且安全导向提示会降低功能通过率。RTL-Obliger在5个模型和4种语言上将平均全通过率从基线（SecV/RESCUE）的49.6-51.4%提升至61.6%，安全率和功能率均优于基线。
AI.conclusion: RTL安全瓶颈在于规格中缺少弱点（weakness）意识，而非模型编写防御性RTL的能力不足。RTL-Obliger通过神经符号推理推断隐式安全义务，在不牺牲功能性的前提下有效提升RTL代码安全性，为LLM生成安全硬件代码提供了可行范式。

title: TrapVLA: Trapping Vision-Language-Action Models in Configured Failure Modes
summary: This work introduces Configured Failure Trapping, a novel backdoor attack task against Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, which aims to activate attacks through stealthy textual triggers and induce configured failure modes. Unlike prior backdoor attacks that treat any task failure as a successful attack, Configured Failure Trapping requires the attacker to control how the robot fails (e.g., causing the robot to grasp with a specified positional offset), making it substantially more challenging and hard to detect. To support the new task, we propose an effective data engine for synthesizing high-quality target trajectories and an automated suite for measuring configured-failure fidelity. Then, based on this foundation, we construct two new benchmarks, namely Trap-LIBERO and Trap-RoboTwin, that instantiate Configured Failure Trapping across four representative failure modes. To address this task, we identify sparse action deviation as a critical challenge and accordingly propose a novel method named TrapVLA, which explicitly learns trigger-induced action residuals to steer the policy toward the configured failure behavior. Extensive experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic settings show that TrapVLA effectively injects configured failure modes into VLA models while largely preserving performance on clean data. Project page: https://john-liua.github.io/TrapVLA/

AI.tldr: 本文提出"配置化失败陷阱"(Configured Failure Trapping)这一新型后门攻击任务，针对视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型，通过隐蔽文本触发器激活攻击并诱导指定配置的失败模式（如机器人以特定位置偏移抓取），而非仅仅造成任意失败。作者构建了数据引擎、自动化评估套件，并推出Trap-LIBERO和Trap-RoboTwin两个基准，覆盖四种代表性失败模式；同时提出TrapVLA方法，通过显式学习触发器诱导的动作残差来引导策略产生配置化失败行为。实验表明TrapVLA在仿真与现实机器人场景中均可有效注入配置化失败模式，同时基本保持干净数据的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有针对VLA模型的后门攻击仅将"任意任务失败"视为攻击成功，无法满足攻击者对失败行为进行精细控制的需求。作者认为攻击者应能控制机器人如何以特定方式失败，这一更具挑战性的任务在现有研究中尚属空白，需要新的任务定义、基准和方法。
AI.method: 首先，提出Configured Failure Trapping任务定义，要求通过文本触发器激活攻击并诱导指定配置的失败模式。其次，开发数据引擎以合成高质量目标轨迹，并设计自动化评估套件来衡量配置失败保真度。基于此构建Trap-LIBERO和Trap-RoboTwin两个基准，覆盖四种代表性失败模式。最后，针对"稀疏动作偏差"(sparse action deviation)这一关键挑战，提出TrapVLA方法，显式学习触发器诱导的动作残差，将策略行为引导至配置化失败模式。
AI.result: 在仿真基准和真实机器人场景中的大量实验表明，TrapVLA能够有效将配置化失败模式注入VLA模型，同时在很大程度上保持其在干净数据上的性能，验证了该方法在隐蔽性与攻击可控性方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 配置化失败陷阱揭示了一种更隐蔽、更可控的新型后门攻击范式，对VLA模型的安全性和鲁棒性提出了新的挑战。TrapVLA的成功说明现有VLA模型在面对精细控制的文本触发器后门攻击时存在脆弱性，这一工作为后续防御研究提供了重要基准和启发。

title: LLMs for Academic Workflows: An Evaluation of Literature Reviews Generated with Short and Long Context Windows of LLMs
summary: Our research focuses on evaluating literature reviews generated in short and long context settings of large language models (LLMs) to investigate the impact of context window on the quality of AI-generated literature reviews and the role of AI in supporting literature review writing. Twenty AI-generated literature reviews based on research sources from Semantic Scholar and Arxiv were evaluated by two researchers across 15 dimensions. Our findings reveal that AI-generated literature reviews require human oversight to meet academic publishing standards. As context windows increase, LLMs can incorporate broader information and maintain coherence across longer inputs, but they also exacerbate issues such as content repetition, omission of critical work, and a tendency towards descriptiveness over synthesis. Our work shows that AI-generated reviews can provide foundational overviews, but their output must be critically evaluated and refined by domain experts. Future research should consider integrating other LLMs and fine-tuned models in different domains with hybrid approaches that combine human expertise with AI capabilities to address the limitations identified in this study.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了大型语言模型（LLMs）在短上下文和长上下文设置下生成的文献综述质量，发现AI生成的综述需要人类监督才能达到学术出版标准，长上下文虽然能纳入更广泛信息，但也会加剧内容重复、遗漏关键工作和重描述轻综合等问题。
AI.motivation: 探究上下文窗口大小对AI生成文献综述质量的影响，以及AI在文献综述写作中的实际作用，以评估AI生成综述是否可用于学术领域。
AI.method: 基于Semantic Scholar和Arxiv的研究来源生成20篇AI文献综述，由两名研究者从15个维度进行评估。
AI.result: 发现AI生成的文献综述需要人工监督才能满足学术出版标准；上下文窗口增大可纳入更广泛信息并保持长输入的一致性，但同时会加剧内容重复、错过关键工作和重描述轻综合的问题。
AI.conclusion: AI生成的综述虽能提供基础性概览，但需领域专家进行批判性评估和精炼；未来研究应考虑在不同领域整合其他LLM和微调模型，采用人类专家与AI能力相结合的混合方法来解决本研究发现的局限性。

title: Training-Time Explainability for Multilingual Hate Speech Detection: Aligning Model Reasoning with Human Rationales
summary: Online hate against Muslim communities often appears in culturally coded, multilingual forms that evade conventional AI moderation. Such systems, though accurate, remain opaque and risk bias, over-censorship, or under-moderation, particularly when detached from sociocultural context. We propose a \emph{training-time} explainability framework that aligns model reasoning with human-annotated rationales, improving both classification performance and interpretability. Our approach is evaluated on HateXplain (English) and BullySent (Hinglish), reflecting the prevalence of anti-Muslim hate across both languages. Using LIME, Integrated Gradients, Grad X Input, and attention, we assess accuracy, explanation quality, and cross-method agreement. Results show that gradient- and attention-based regularization improve F-scores, enhance plausibility and faithfulness, and capture culturally specific cues for detecting implicit anti-Muslim hate, offering a path toward multilingual, culturally aware content moderation.

AI.tldr: 提出一种训练时（training-time）可解释性框架，通过将模型推理与人类标注的理由（rationales）对齐，在提升分类性能的同时增强可解释性，用于检测多语言环境中隐晦的、文化编码的反穆斯林仇恨言论。在HateXplain（英语）和BullySent（印地英语）上验证，梯度与注意力正则化方法在准确率、可信度与忠实度上均优于传统方法。
AI.motivation: 针对穆斯林社群的网络仇恨常以多语言、文化编码的隐晦形式出现，传统AI审核系统虽准确但缺乏透明度，且因脱离社会文化语境而存在偏见、过度审查或审核不足等风险，亟需一种兼顾性能与可解释性的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出训练时（training-time）可解释性框架，将模型推理过程与人类标注的理由对齐。评估中使用LIME、Integrated Gradients、Grad X Input和注意力机制四种解释方法，从准确率、解释质量和跨方法一致性三个维度进行综合评估。
AI.result: 梯度与注意力正则化方法能够提升F值、增强解释的合理性与忠实度，并能捕捉检测隐晦反穆斯林仇恨所需的特定文化线索；跨方法一致性也得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为多语言、文化敏感的内容审核提供了一条可行路径，展现了训练时对齐人类语义对提升机器学习系统可解释性与检测能力并重的价值。

title: Zero-Shot Video Restoration and Enhancement with Text-to-Image Latent Diffusion Models and Multi-Modal References
summary: Zero-shot image restoration methods with text-to-image latent diffusion models have achieved great success in universal image restoration tasks without training. However, applying them to video restoration will result in severe temporal flickering. In this paper, we propose a novel framework for zero-shot video restoration and enhancement which uses a text-to-image latent diffusion model and multi-modal references. Through the proposed dual prompt tuning inversion and sampling, the inference time can be reduced to nearly 1/3 of the original. The performance and temporal consistency can be also significantly stregthened. By using the proposed texture-aware video token merging, the temporal correlation between frames can be further utilized to improve the temporal consistency. We futher propose the referenced self-attention and referenced token merging to support image reference. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the proposed method in restoring and enhancing temporally consistent videos.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型的零样本视频恢复与增强框架，通过双提示调优反转与采样、纹理感知视频标记合并及参考自注意力等技术，将推理时间缩短至原来的约1/3，同时显著提升时间一致性和恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的零样本图像恢复方法（基于文本到图像潜在扩散模型）在单图恢复上表现出色，但直接应用于视频恢复会产生严重的时间闪烁问题，缺乏针对视频时间一致性的处理机制。
AI.method: 1) 提出双提示调优反转与采样（dual prompt tuning inversion and sampling），将推理时间降至原有的约1/3；2) 提出纹理感知视频标记合并（texture-aware video token merging），利用帧间时间相关性增强时间一致性；3) 提出参考自注意力（referenced self-attention）和参考标记合并（referenced token merging）以支持图像参考。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法在视频恢复和增强任务中具有优越性，能够显著提升视频的时间一致性并达到更好的恢复与增强效果。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合多模态参考、双提示调优及专用时间一致性技术，该方法有效解决了零样本视频恢复中的时间闪烁问题，同时兼顾了推理效率和恢复质量。

title: Beyond Capability Benchmarks: Learning Operational Fingerprints of LLM Cloud Services from Production Incident Metadata
summary: Managed LLM services are now part of real production systems, but model selection and service planning still rely heavily on capability benchmarks that reveal little about operational behavior after deployment. We present Operational Embedding (OpEmbed), a framework for learning compact operational fingerprints of LLM cloud services from structured, privacy-preserving support-case metadata, without using case text. OpEmbed aggregates model--time windows into an eight-channel operational signature and learns a low-dimensional representation via temporal contrastive learning, cross-view reconstruction, and generational-ordinality regularization. Evaluated on more than 33,000 production support cases spanning seven LLM families over 26 months at Google Cloud, OpEmbed recovers interpretable family- and version-level structure, improves leave-one-model-out operational forecasting over non-learned baselines, remains useful under limited early-window data, and supports cross-model fault-type transfer. We report the practical lessons learned from building and evaluating this tool for model onboarding, support readiness assessment, and operational monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpEmbed框架，利用结构化的隐私保护支持工单元数据（不含案例文本），学习LLM云服务的紧凑操作指纹。在Google Cloud 26个月内超过33,000个生产支持案例（覆盖7个LLM家族）上验证，OpEmbed能恢复可解释的家族与版本级结构，提升留一模型操作预测性能，在早期数据有限时仍有效，并支持跨模型故障类型迁移。
AI.motivation: 托管LLM服务已进入真实生产系统，但模型选择与服务规划仍主要依赖能力基准测试，这些基准几乎无法揭示部署后的操作行为。现有方法缺乏对LLM云服务运营特性的系统化建模手段，需要一种能从不含敏感案例文本的结构化元数据中学习操作特征的方法。
AI.method: OpEmbed将模型-时间窗口聚合为八通道操作签名，并通过时间对比学习（temporal contrastive learning）、跨视图重建（cross-view reconstruction）和世代序数正则化（generational-ordinality regularization）学习低维表示。该方法仅使用结构化的、隐私保护的支持案例元数据，不依赖案例文本内容。
AI.result: 在Google Cloud超过33,000个生产支持案例、7个LLM家族、26个月的时间跨度上，OpEmbed恢复了可解释的家族级和版本级结构；在留一模型（leave-one-model-out）操作预测中优于非学习基线；在早期窗口数据有限时仍保持有效；并支持跨模型的故障类型迁移。
AI.conclusion: OpEmbed为LLM云服务的模型上架（onboarding）、支持就绪度评估和操作监控提供了实用工具，并总结了一套构建与评估该工具的实际经验教训，证明无需读取敏感案例文本也能有效刻画和预测生产LLM服务的运营行为。

title: Performance Foundations of Parallel & Distributed Reasoning Language Models
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and other RL-style post-training paradigms have been used for aligning large language models (LLMs) with reasoning standards. The resulting recent Reasoning Language Models (RLMs) such as DeepSeek-R1, o3, and Kimi k1.5 show that such RL-style post-training ("RL-for-LLMs") can substantially improve chain-of-thought reasoning, long-horizon planning, and self-correction. However, the computational footprint of these systems is massive: state-of-the-art RLM training requires millions of GPU-hours and tightly coupled multi-model pipelines that stress modern hardware far beyond classical supervised LLM training. This makes RLM training as much a parallel and distributed systems problem as an algorithmic one. In this work, to facilitate developing RLMs that are simultaneously high-performance, scalable, and cost-effective, we first systematize the RL-for-LLM paradigm and provide a compute-centric analysis of prominent post-training algorithmic frameworks: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), as well as their variants. Second, we develop a taxonomy of intra- and inter-model parallelism strategies for RL-for-LLMs, covering both traditional techniques (data, tensor, pipeline, sequence, context, and expert parallelism) as well as novel forms of parallelism and optimization techniques for multi-model RLM training, for example disaggregated placement, stage fusion, hybrid parallelism, and asynchronous execution. We harness the work-depth model of parallel computing to make our taxonomy and its insights rigorous and portable. Finally, we analyze existing RLM frameworks and we distill practical guidelines and outline open research directions for building scalable, fast, and cost-effective RLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）等RL式后训练范式在大型语言模型（LLM）推理对齐中的应用，从计算角度分析了RL-for-LLM的系统开销，提出了包含传统与新颖并行策略（如解聚放置、阶段融合、混合并行、异步执行）的并行性分类体系，并基于work-depth并行计算模型给出了严格理论框架，最终总结出可扩展、高效且低成本的推理语言模型（RLM）训练的实践指南与开放研究方向。
AI.motivation: RLM（如DeepSeek-R1、o3、Kimi k1.5）的RL式后训练能显著提升推理、规划与自我纠错能力，但其训练需要数百万GPU小时及紧密耦合的多模型流水线，计算开销远超传统监督式LLM训练。这使得RLM训练不仅是算法问题，更是并行和分布式系统问题。作者旨在系统化该范式并提供计算中心的分析框架，以促进开发高性能、可扩展且成本有效的RLM。
AI.method: 首先系统化RL-for-LLM范式，对主流后训练算法框架（PPO、GRPO及其变体）进行以计算为中心的剖析；其次构建RL-for-LLM的模型内与模型间并行性分类体系，涵盖传统技术（数据、张量、流水线、序列、上下文、专家并行）及新颖并行与优化技术（解聚放置、阶段融合、混合并行、异步执行）；利用并行计算中的work-depth模型使分类体系及其洞察严谨且可移植；最后分析现有RLM框架，提炼实践指南并指出开放研究方向。
AI.result: 本文提出了一套系统化的RLM训练并行性分类体系，将传统并行策略与面向多模型训练的新颖并行优化技术统一在work-depth模型的严格框架下；通过分析现有RLM框架，提炼出构建可扩展、快速且成本有效的RLM的实用指南，并揭示了该领域中的关键系统瓶颈与开放研究挑战。
AI.conclusion: RLM的训练本质上是并行与分布式系统问题，需要从算法与系统两个维度协同优化。通过work-depth模型建立的并行性分类体系为理解RL-for-LLM的计算特征提供了严谨且可移植的理论工具，而实践指南和开放研究方向为未来构建大规模、高效、低成本的RLM训练系统指明了道路。

title: Beyond Vector Hiding: Breaking and Mitigating Shared-Direction Weight Obfuscation in TEE-Offloaded Large Language Models
summary: Trusted Execution Environment (TEE)-shielded partitioning of Large Language Models (LLMs) accelerates on-device inference by offloading obfuscated linear layers to an untrusted accelerator while retaining only a small correction inside the TEE. However, earlier lightweight obfuscation schemes preserved weight-vector directions and were broken by ArrowMatch. To defend against this attack, ArrowCloak injects scalar multiples of the same hidden direction into all weight vectors, enabling lightweight trusted correction. We show that this reuse leaves a rank-one relation across the complete accelerator-visible matrix. For the released real-valued scheme, we propose SpectralLeak, which estimates and removes the shared component. Across 12 task settings, its surrogates achieve $87.98\%$ mean accuracy versus $89.85\%$ for the victims. In our defense-favorable mod-$Q$ realization of ArrowCloak's published modular security formulation, mod-$Q$ arithmetic suppresses this spectral signal but retains the algebraic rank-one relation modulo $Q$. We therefore propose LatticeLeak, which exploits the resulting hidden lattice. In our BERT-Base and GPT2-Base experiments, it reconstructs every protected fixed-point parameter exactly; across all evaluated architectures, the reconstructed models retain victim-level task accuracy without victim queries, labels, or fine-tuning. These findings identify shared rank-one reuse as the root cause of the leakage exploited by our attacks. Guided by this insight, we design ButterflyCloak, a keyed maximal-rank butterfly mask that replaces the reused direction with distinct mask rows while retaining fast trusted correction...

AI.tldr: 本文针对TEE保护的LLM分区推理方案ArrowCloak提出两种攻击（SpectralLeak和LatticeLeak），揭示其秩一复用结构导致的安全漏洞，并提出防御方案ButterflyCloak。
AI.motivation: TEE-LLM分区推理通过将混淆线性层卸载到不可信加速器来加速端上推理，但先前轻量混淆方案（ArrowMatch攻击证明其失效）。ArrowCloak通过向所有权重向量注入同一隐藏方向的标量倍数来防御，但本文质疑该方案的安全性，旨在发现并利用其共享方向复用导致的结构性漏洞。
AI.method: (1) 提出SpectralLeak：利用ArrowCloak中跨全部权重矩阵的秩一关系，通过谱分析估计并移除共享分量，用于真实值方案的代理模型攻击。(2) 提出LatticeLeak：针对mod-Q版本，利用模Q代数下的秩一关系形成的隐藏格结构，精确重建受保护的定点参数。(3) 基于根因分析设计ButterflyCloak：用密钥化的最大秩蝴蝶掩码替代复用方向，保留快速可信校正。
AI.result: SpectralLeak在12个任务设置中代理模型平均准确率87.98%（受害者89.85%）；LatticeLeak在BERT-Base和GPT2-Base上精确重建所有受保护定点参数，重建模型在不查询受害者、无标签、无需微调的情况下保持与受害者相同的任务准确率。
AI.conclusion: 共享秩一复用是ArrowCloak泄漏的根源；上述两种攻击证明该方案在真实值及mod-Q两类实现下均不安全。ButterflyCloak通过消除秩一复用并提供最大秩蝴蝶掩码，在保持轻量可信校正的同时封堵该攻击向量。

title: SOLO: Stable Omni-terrain Long-Horizon Perceptive Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Humans traverse complex terrain over long distances without losing balance, whereas perceptive humanoid policies become fragile as perception and control errors accumulate. We present SOLO, a unified framework addressing two compounding causes of this long-horizon fragility: dense terrain reconstruction smooths action-critical details, and pointwise imitation lacks temporal credit assignment. Its Query Reconstructor (QR) uses Fourier-encoded cell queries to retrieve spatially specific evidence from depth-proprioception tokens, preserving sharp terrain boundaries. Trajectory-Aware MSE (TA-MSE) Distillation adds next-state teacher-student disagreement to the PPO reward, enabling Generalized Advantage Estimation to propagate future disagreement penalties to preceding actions. In simulation, QR reduces height-map L1 error by factors of 3.3-4.0, while TA-MSE surpasses PPO and MSE+PPO in curriculum progression. On stress-test terrains, SOLO achieves 97.5% mean traversal success and 96% stepping-stone success, versus 75.0-75.6% and 0-3% for dense-reconstructor variants. Deployed zero-shot with only a chest-mounted depth camera and proprioception, SOLO completes a continuous 1.5-km outdoor route and an indoor mixed-terrain course. Project page: https://sunpihai-up.github.io/solo/

AI.tldr: SOLO是一个统一框架，针对感知人形机器人在长时程复杂地形穿越中因感知与控制误差累积而导致的脆弱性问题，提出查询重建器（QR）与轨迹感知MSE蒸馏（TA-MSE）两种方法，分别解决稠密地形重建平滑化行动关键细节和逐点模仿缺乏时序信用分配两大问题，在仿真与真实环境中均取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 人类能够在复杂地形上长距离行走而不失平衡，但感知人形策略在感知与控制误差累积下变得脆弱。作者识别出两个相互叠加的脆弱性成因：稠密地形重建会平滑掉对动作至关重要的细节信息，以及逐点模仿缺乏时间维度上的信用分配。这两者共同导致长时程任务的失败。
AI.method: SOLO包含两个核心组件：1) 查询重建器（Query Reconstructor, QR），使用傅里叶编码的单元查询从深度-本体感知token中检索空间特异性的证据，保留锐利的地形边界；2) 轨迹感知MSE蒸馏（Trajectory-Aware MSE Distillation, TA-MSE），将下一步教师-学生不一致性加入PPO奖励中，使广义优势估计（GAE）能够将未来的不一致惩罚传播到之前的动作上，实现时序信用分配。
AI.result: 在仿真中，QR将高度图L1误差降低3.3-4.0倍；TA-MSE在课程推进进度上优于PPO和MSE+PPO。在压力测试地形上，SOLO达到97.5%的平均穿越成功率和96%的踏脚石成功率，而稠密重建变体的成功率仅为75.0-75.6%和0-3%。零样本部署中，仅使用胸部深度相机和本体感知，SOLO完成了连续1.5公里的户外路线和室内混合地形路线。
AI.conclusion: SOLO通过保留地形锐利边界和引入时序信用分配机制，有效解决了感知人形机器人的长时程脆弱性问题，显著提升了复杂地形穿越的鲁棒性，并展现出从仿真到真实环境的零样本迁移能力。

title: Methodological and Conceptual Framework for 5D Multi-Table Analysis: A Unified Approach for Complex Data Reuse
summary: Multi-table learning remains a major challenge in machine learning for healthcare and other complex information systems. Relational data combine several sources of complexity, including large data volume, high-dimensional variables, high-cardinality categorical features, complex inter-table dependencies, and repeated temporal observations. We introduce the Relational Hypergraph Transformer (RHT), a unified architecture that represents relational databases as hypergraphs, learns pentadimensional embeddings (PentE), and performs sparse relational attention with complexity proportional to the average relational degree rather than the square of the number of entities. We formally define the architecture, derive the complexity of its attention mechanism, and provide an open-source reference implementation. We evaluate RHT on the public Synthea synthetic electronic health record dataset using multi-label prediction of SNOMED CT condition codes per encounter, a task characterized by high categorical cardinality and long-tailed label distributions. Comparisons with tabular, relational, and temporal graph baselines show that RHT produces more semantically coherent embeddings while remaining computationally scalable. In this benchmark, the highest rare-code recall is achieved by XGBoost, whereas RHT attains the strongest embedding semantic coherence. We also report ablation studies quantifying the contribution of each architectural component. Clinical validation on MIMIC-IV is planned following PhysioNet credentialing. Source code and experimental protocols are provided in the accompanying repository.

AI.tldr: 本文提出关系超图Transformer（RHT），一种统一架构，将关系数据库表示为超图，学习五维嵌入（PentE）并执行稀疏关系注意力，其复杂度与平均关系度成比例而非实体数量的平方。在Synthea合成电子健康记录数据集上的多标签预测任务中，RHT相比表格、关系和时序图基线产生更语义连贯的嵌入且计算可扩展，但最高稀有代码召回率由XGBoost取得。
AI.motivation: 多表学习在医疗等复杂信息系统中的机器学习中仍是重大挑战。关系数据结合了多种复杂性来源：大数据量、高维变量、高基数分类特征、复杂的表间依赖以及重复的时间观测。现有方法难以同时应对这些挑战。
AI.method: RHT通过以下方式解决上述问题：(1) 将关系数据库表示为超图，统一建模实体和关系；(2) 学习五维嵌入(PentE)以更丰富地表达实体语义；(3) 采用稀疏关系注意力机制，其计算复杂度与平均关系度成比例而非实体数量的平方，保证可扩展性；(4) 提供开源参考实现。
AI.result: 在Synthea合成EHR数据集上进行SNOMED CT编码多标签预测任务中，RHT在嵌入语义一致性上超越表格、关系和时序图基线，同时保持计算可扩展性。最高稀有代码召回率由XGBoost取得，RHT在嵌入语义一致性上最强。消融实验量化了各架构组件的贡献。
AI.conclusion: RHT是一种计算可扩展的关系数据库统一架构，在嵌入语义质量上表现突出，但稀有代码预测方面仍不及传统树模型。临床验证将基于MIMIC-IV进行，代码和实验协议已公开。

title: TelecomGPT-R1: A Unified Open-Source Reasoner for the Telecom Stack
summary: Telecommunications is a high-leverage domain for large language model (LLM)-based reasoning because routine engineering workflows require joint grounding in normative specifications, operational telemetry, vendor-specific fault evidence, and exact RF/network calculations. However, current LLM integration in telecom remains bottlenecked by a two-sided capability gap: generic reasoners often lack telecom-specific grounding, while domain-specific telecom LLMs remain limited in structured, multi-step reasoning. To bridge this gap, we release TelecomGPT-R1-9B, a unified open-source telecom reasoner that ranks top-performing on the GSMA open telco leaderboard. Specifically, we curate a 67,427-example supervised fine-tuning (SFT) corpus organized around four complementary reasoning axes: protocol, knowledge, modeling, and fault. The corpus is built from axis-matched public web sources and enhanced through axis-specific chain-of-thought (CoT) generation and prefix-continuation self-validation. Starting from Qwen3.5-9B, we further develop a two-stage post-training recipe. First, multi-teacher low-rank adaptation (LoRA)-based SFT injects telecom knowledge and induces axis-specific reasoning formats. Second, group relative policy optimization (GRPO), stabilized by decoupled clip and dynamic sampling policy optimization (DAPO), optimizes the policy using four axis-aligned binary verifier rewards. Across seven public telecom benchmarks, TelecomGPT-R1-9B ranks first among open-source telecom LLMs and achieves a seven-axis mean comparable to state-of-the-art closed-source frontier reasoners.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了TelecomGPT-R1-9B，一个统一的开源电信领域推理模型，通过构建67,427个样本的四轴SFT语料库（协议、知识、建模、故障），并采用多教师LoRA-SFT与GRPO/DAPO强化学习的两阶段后训练策略，在GSMA开源电信排行榜及七个公开电信基准上位居开源模型首位，平均性能媲美闭源前沿推理模型。
AI.motivation: 电信领域是LLM推理的高杠杆应用场景，但当前存在两方面的能力鸿沟：通用推理模型缺乏电信领域特定知识落地，而领域特定的电信LLM在结构化多步推理方面能力有限。现有方法无法同时兼顾领域接地性与复杂推理能力，亟需一个统一模型来弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 方法包含三大核心组件：(1) 构建67,427个样本的SFT语料库，围绕协议、知识、建模、故障四个互补推理轴组织，基于轴匹配的公开网络资源，并通过轴特定思维链生成与前缀延续自验证增强；(2) 以Qwen3.5-9B为基座，采用两阶段后训练：第一阶段为多教师LoRA-SFT，注入电信知识并诱导轴特定推理格式；第二阶段为GRPO强化学习，通过解耦裁剪和动态采样策略优化（DAPO）稳定训练，使用四个轴向对齐的二元验证器奖励。
AI.result: 在七个公开电信基准上，TelecomGPT-R1-9B在开源电信LLM中排名第一，七轴平均值与最先进的闭源前沿推理模型相当，并在GSMA开源电信排行榜上名列前茅。
AI.conclusion: TelecomGPT-R1-9B证明，通过精心设计的多轴语料库和两阶段后训练管线，一个9B参数的开源模型可以在电信领域同时实现领域接地性与复杂推理能力，达到甚至媲美闭源前沿模型的水平，为电信行业LLM应用提供了可复现的开源方案。

title: Learning Woody Clearing With Loss Alignment for Zero-Shot Regrowth and Woody Segmentation
comment: Published in IEEE Transactions on Geoscience and Remote Sensing
summary: Detecting woody clearing is vital for managing biodiversity. Deep learning models can detect change in woody vegetation from bitemporal remote sensing imagery, however generated products may not meet end-user specifications due to unaligned loss definitions. Further limitations of deep learning models are the reliance on large datasets which can be difficult to attain for spatially rare and ambiguous events such as regrowth detection. In this work we train a model to detect woody change using bitemporal Sentinel-2 imagery consisting of 7 years' worth of annual imagery across the state of New South Wales, Australia. To align the objective of the model with end-user metrics, we introduce the loss scaling coefficient $α$ which transforms the objective to optimize for specific $F_β$ scores. Introducing $α$ was found to increase precision by 1.85x or recall by 1.12x. We propose input imagery augmentation and generation techniques that allow the woody change detection model to zero-shot transfer to regrowth and woody segmentation tasks. For woody segmentation, image generation techniques using activation maximization with low $α$ values for stability and image generation techniques derived from handcrafted features utilizing a mosaic of clearing patches and artificial trees for contextual grounding were found to outperform prior woody segmentation works of the study area, reducing the overall error by up to 18.2%. For zero-shot woody regrowth, creating pseudo-post and prior images resulted in the model achieving an F1 score of 0.845, creating a foundation for future regrowth detection work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于双时相Sentinel-2影像的森林覆被变化检测深度学习模型，通过引入损失缩放系数α来对齐模型目标与最终用户指标（Fβ分数），并使用图像增强和生成技术实现模型对再生检测和木材分割任务的零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 木材覆被清除检测对生物多样性管理至关重要，但现有深度学习模型生成的产物可能因损失函数定义不一致而无法满足终端用户规格要求；此外，深度学习模型依赖大规模标注数据集，而空间上罕见且模糊的事件（如再生检测）难以获取足够训练数据。
AI.method: 1) 使用澳大利亚新南威尔士州7年年度双时相Sentinel-2影像训练木材变化检测模型；2) 引入损失缩放系数α，将优化目标转换为针对特定Fβ分数优化；3) 提出输入影像增强和生成技术（包括激活最大化、基于手工特征的影像生成、清除斑块马赛克与人工树木的组合），实现零样本迁移到再生检测和木材分割任务。
AI.result: 引入α后，精确率提升1.85倍或召回率提升1.12倍；木材分割任务中，利用低α值的激活最大化及手工特征影像生成技术，相比先前研究将总体误差降低高达18.2%；零样本木材再生检测中，通过生成伪后像和先验影像，模型达到0.845的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: 损失缩放系数α能有效对齐模型目标与终端用户指标，影像生成技术可实现模型对不同木本植被任务的零样本泛化，为未来再生检测工作奠定基础。

title: CG4AI: A Column Generation Framework for Training AI Models Under Constraints
summary: Standard machine-learning training minimizes a loss function over a dataset, but does not guarantee that the resulting model will satisfy predefined rules or constraints on its outputs. In many real-world applications, ranging from autonomous systems to network routing, such guarantees are essential. We propose CG4AI, a framework that builds a convex combination of AI models while enforcing linear constraints on the combined output. A master linear program (LP) determines the optimal mixture weights, while a pricing subproblem generates new models guided by LP dual variables, focusing attention on the most violated constraints. A cutting-plane procedure extends feasibility guarantees beyond the training set. We apply CG4AI to two problems: (i) digit classification on MNIST, where we demonstrate four distinct uses of constraints, learning from constraints alone, improving adversarial robustness, correcting misclassified examples, and enforcing output relabeling; and (ii) the multi-commodity flow problem, where link capacity constraints are enforced on neural-network routing predictors. Experiments on MNIST and standard SNDLIB benchmark networks show that CG4AI reliably produces feasible predictors while achieving better accuracy than single-model baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出了CG4AI框架，通过凸组合多个AI模型并强制执行线性输出约束，利用主线性规划求解最优混合权重、定价子问题生成新模型、切割平面方法扩展可行性保证，在MNIST和SNDLIB基准上验证了可行性预测与更高精度。
AI.motivation: 标准机器学习训练只最小化损失函数，无法保证模型输出满足预定义规则或约束。在自动驾驶、网络路由等实际应用中，这种可行性保证至关重要。
AI.method: CG4AI框架包含三个关键组件：(1) 主线性规划(LP)确定各模型的最优凸组合权重；(2) 定价子问题利用LP对偶变量生成新模型，聚焦于最受违例的约束；(3) 切割平面过程将可行性保证扩展到训练集之外。整个框架通过列生成(column generation)与切割平面相结合的方式迭代求解。
AI.result: 在MNIST上展示了约束的四种用途：仅从约束学习、提升对抗鲁棒性、纠正错误分类示例以及强制执行输出重标记。在多商品流问题中，对神经网络路由预测器施加链路容量约束。在MNIST和SNDLIB基准网络上的实验表明，CG4AI能可靠地产生可行预测器，且准确率优于单模型基线。
AI.conclusion: CG4AI通过凸组合与线性规划主从优化结构的结合，成功弥合了机器学习训练与约束满足之间的鸿沟，为实现可保证合规的AI预测器提供了有效且通用的框架。

title: KubeCap: A Framework for Capability Minimization in Kubernetes via Static Analysis and LLM-Assisted Rule Inference
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, accepted to the 37th IEEE International Symposium on Software Reliability Engineering (ISSRE 2026)
summary:
As the most widely used container orchestration platform, Kubernetes provides flexible privilege configuration by allowing developers to manage Linux capabilities via manifest files. However, developers rely on default settings or coarse-grained security contexts in practice, violating the principle of least privilege and enlarging the attack surface of containerized workloads. Existing studies either detect vulnerable patterns in Kubernetes manifests or infer required capabilities for standalone Linux programs, but they do not directly address capability minimization in Kubernetes.
  To bridge this gap, we first conduct an empirical study on three open-source datasets, revealing that 74.67% of projects lack capability configurations. Motivated by our observations, we propose KubeCap, a framework for Kubernetes capability minimization. KubeCap translates deployment specifications into deterministic manifests, locates container entrypoints, performs reachability-guided system call analysis, and leverages LLM-assisted rule specification to derive syscall--parameter--capability relations from Linux kernel code. Based on these results, KubeCap infers the minimal capability set required by each workload and automatically generates repaired manifests. Evaluation on 10 representative Go-based Kubernetes projects shows an average capability reduction rate of 54.97%, outperforming rapid type analysis and class hierarchy analysis baselines while maintaining practical analysis cost. These results demonstrate KubeCap's effectiveness in enforcing least privilege in Kubernetes.

AI.tldr: 提出KubeCap框架，通过可达性引导的系统调用分析和LLM辅助规则推导，自动最小化Kubernetes容器能力的设置，在10个Go项目中实现平均54.97%的能力缩减率。
AI.motivation: Kubernetes作为最广泛使用的容器编排平台允许通过清单文件灵活配置Linux能力，但开发者在实践中依赖默认设置或粗粒度安全上下文，违反了最小权限原则并扩大了容器化工作负载的攻击面。现有研究要么检测Kubernetes清单中的脆弱模式，要么为独立Linux程序推断所需能力，但都没有直接解决Kubernetes中的能力最小化问题。
AI.method: 首先对三个开源数据集进行实证研究，发现74.67%的项目缺乏能力配置。然后提出KubeCap框架：(1)将部署规格翻译为确定性清单；(2)定位容器入口点；(3)执行可达性引导的系统调用分析；(4)利用LLM辅助规则规范从Linux内核代码推导系统调用-参数-能力关系；(5)基于这些结果推断每个工作负载所需的最小能力集并自动生成修复后的清单。
AI.result: 在10个具有代表性的Go-based Kubernetes项目上评估，平均能力缩减率达到54.97%，优于快速类型分析和类层次分析基线，同时保持实用的分析成本。
AI.conclusion: KubeCap在Kubernetes中有效实施最小权限原则，证明了其自动化的能力最小化方案的有效性。

title: Relaxation-Aware Multimodal Sensing of Soft Gripper Driven by Structure-Perception-Learning
comment: 11 pages, 9 figures. Published in Robotics: Science and Systems (RSS 2026)
summary: Achieving stable, sustained grasping with soft robotic hands remains a fundamental challenge. Compliance enables safe and adaptive contact, yet the intrinsic viscoelasticity of soft polymers leads to stress relaxation and a continuous decay of grasping force during holding. Inspired by human grasping, which combines phase-dependent stiffness regulation with continuous sensing and feedback, this paper presents an integrated structure--perception--learning framework. We develop a variable-stiffness soft gripper that uses onboard vision and infrared thermography to track deformation and the temperature field in real time, preserving continuous tracking of the interaction state. To mitigate relaxation-induced force decay, we propose a temperature-coupled viscoelastic force representation, together with a physics-informed learning model, to reconstruct the force trend and provide explicit compensation during holding. Experiments show that, in a 280s force-controlled grasp-and-hold task, the proposed method maintains the desired force with a mean absolute error of 0.066N, outperforming fixed-aperture and instantaneous-only baselines by 80% and 95%, respectively. Overall, the results support a mechanism--AI co-design view: mechanisms shape feasible interactions, while learning compensates remaining uncertainty in viscoelastic dynamics, together enabling stable, sustained grasping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种集成结构-感知-学习框架的变刚度软体抓手，利用机载视觉与红外热成像实时跟踪变形和温度场，结合温度耦合的粘弹性力表示和物理信息学习模型，对抓取力衰减进行补偿。在280秒持握任务中平均绝对误差仅0.066N，比固定孔径和瞬时基准分别提升80%和95%，实现了稳定持续的软体抓取。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人手的稳定持续抓取是根本性挑战：软聚合物固有的粘弹性导致应力松弛和抓取力持续衰减，现有方法难以在长时间持握过程中维持期望力。
AI.method: 提出三部分集成框架：(1) 变刚度软体抓手，利用机载视觉和红外热成像实时跟踪变形与温度场；(2) 温度耦合的粘弹性力表示模型；(3) 物理信息学习模型，用于重建力趋势并显式补偿持握期间的点位力衰减。
AI.result: 在280秒力控抓取-持握任务中，所提方法以0.066N的平均绝对误差维持期望力，相比固定孔径和仅瞬时补偿基线分别提升80%和95%的性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"机制-AI联合设计"观点：机制决定了可行的交互行为，而学习算法补偿粘弹性动力学中的残余不确定性，二者结合可共同实现稳定、持续的抓取。

title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Systematic Literature Review of Disease Spread Models
comment: To be published in the Winter Simulation Conference 2026
summary: Recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs) have created new opportunities to streamline and potentially automate many research processes, including systematic literature reviews (SLRs). This study reports an LLM pipeline development for extracting model-relevant information from 536 peer-reviewed agent-based modeling papers. We compare the results with those of a human-conducted SLR. Our results show paper-level accuracies of approximately 77.95% for GPT-4.1 and 81.67% for GPT-5.0. Field-level accuracy ranges from 32.40% to 100.00%, with more complex or subjective fields performing less reliably. Importantly, we find that agreement between LLMs is a potential indicator of output quality: low agreement may signal hallucinations, whereas high agreement combined with low accuracy may point to noise or errors in the human dataset. Overall, our study provides practical insights into prompt development and highlights both the potential and limitations of using LLMs for full-scale SLRs in the modeling and simulation domain.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一条LLM流水线，用于从536篇基于代理建模论文中提取模型相关信息，并与人工系统文献综述结果进行对比。GPT-4.1和GPT-5.0的论文级准确率分别约为77.95%和81.67%，字段级准确率在32.40%至100.00%之间。研究发现LLM间的一致性可作为输出质量的潜在指标：低一致性可能预示幻觉，高一致性结合低准确率则可能指向人工数据中的噪声或错误。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的进步为自动化研究流程（尤其是系统文献综述）创造了新机遇，但LLM在这一领域的可靠性尚未得到充分验证。作者希望通过与人工SLR的系统对比，评估LLM在自动化文献综述中的实际表现及其局限性。
AI.method: 开发了一条LLM流水线，从536篇经同行评审的基于代理建模论文中提取模型相关信息；使用GPT-4.1和GPT-5.0两个版本的模型进行提取；将结果与人工进行的系统文献综述结果进行逐篇、逐字段的对比分析。
AI.result: GPT-4.1和GPT-5.0的论文级准确率分别约为77.95%和81.67%；字段级准确率范围为32.40%到100.00%，复杂或主观字段表现较差；LLM间一致性可作为输出质量指标，低一致性提示幻觉，高一致性但低准确率提示人工数据存在问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究为提示词开发提供了实用见解，展示了LLM在建模与仿真领域全规模系统文献综述中的潜力与限制。LLM一致性可作为一种质量审查信号，但复杂和主观字段仍需谨慎处理。

title: FIRSTPASS: A Multi-Domain, Multi-Round Peer Review Dataset Grounded in Real Editorial Outcomes
comment: Accepted at the AI for Science Workshop at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026), 3 pages, 1 figure, 1 table
summary: Scientific peer review datasets have trained AI systems exclusively on Computer Science and Machine Learning venues, producing models that critique ablation studies yet have never seen a biology reviewer demand contamination controls or a chemist question Nuclear Magnetic Resonance (NMR) spectral assignments. We introduce FIRSTPASS, the first large-scale peer review dataset built on complete multi-round editorial dialogues from a multidisciplinary high-impact journal. Curated from Nature Communications mandatory transparent peer review (instituted November 2022), FIRSTPASS comprises 3,668 records spanning five scientific domains (biology, chemistry, neuroscience, physics, and earth science), capturing the full iterative structure of scientific validation: initial referee reports, author point-by-point responses, and updated reviewer assessments. Each record carries an outcome label derived directly from editorial decisions (STANDARD for two-round review; EXTENDED for three or more rounds), providing ground truth absent in all prior corpora. An automated audit confirms 100% content integrity. Expert reviews average 2,155 words, substantially denser than conference venue reviews. All data, parsing pipelines, and evaluation scripts are released to enable reproducible benchmarking of AI scientific judgment across disciplines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FIRSTPASS，首个基于多学科高影响力期刊完整多轮编辑对话的大规模同行评审数据集，涵盖生物学、化学、神经科学、物理学和地球科学五个领域共3,668条记录，包含初始审稿报告、作者逐点回复和更新后的评审意见，并带有来自编辑决策的结果标签（STANDARD或EXTENDED），为跨学科AI科学判断的可复现基准测试提供了全部数据、解析流程和评估脚本。
AI.motivation: 现有科学同行评审数据集仅来源于计算机科学和机器学习领域的会议，导致基于这些数据训练的AI系统缺乏跨学科评审的专业知识——例如AI能批评消融实验，却从未见过生物学审稿人要求污染控制或化学家质疑NMR谱归属。这一严重的数据偏差限制了AI在真实多学科科学评审场景中的应用能力。
AI.method: 基于Nature Communications自2022年11月起实施的强制性透明同行评审机制，收集完整的编辑对话记录，构建包含3,668条记录的数据集，覆盖五个科学领域。每条记录保留完整的迭代审稿结构（初始审稿报告、作者逐点回复、更新后的审稿评估），并根据编辑决策（两轮为STANDARD，三轮及以上为EXTENDED）生成结果标签，同时通过自动化审计确保100%内容完整性。
AI.result: FIRSTPASS包含3,668条多领域审稿记录，自动化审计确认100%内容完整性，专家评审平均字数达2,155字，显著高于会议审稿的字数密度。所有数据、解析流程和评估脚本均已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: FIRSTPASS填补了同行评审数据集在学科多样性和审稿迭代结构方面的空白，为跨学科AI科学判断的评估提供了包含真实结果标签的基准资源，有望推动AI在学术评审和科学评估领域的发展。

title: Video-FLAIR: Not Whether to Reason, But How
summary: Multimodal queries can require different types of reasoning. Some can be answered via perceptual reasoning, extracting information directly from the visual signal, while others require compositional reasoning that combines observations or deliberative reasoning that evaluates competing hypotheses. However, many existing methods apply a uniform reasoning strategy across queries, leading to unnecessary computation on simple tasks and insufficient reasoning on complex ones. We introduce Video-FLAIR, a training framework that learns to select the appropriate reasoning mode for each query using reinforcement learning. During training, the model generates responses under all three modes for the same prompt, enabling direct comparison. A composite reward compares these responses to favor the most effective one based on correctness, grounding, and cost, while discouraging unsupported or misaligned deliberation. This yields a supervision signal for learning adaptive reasoning without per-query annotations. Video-FLAIR improves accuracy over the Qwen2.5-VL base model by +5.4 on MathVista, +4.8 on Video-Holmes, and +4.8 on Video-MMMU, while reducing average token usage to 95 compared to 417 for always-thinking baselines.

AI.tldr: Video-FLAIR是一个视频问答训练框架，通过强化学习让模型自适应地为每个查询选择合适的推理模式（感知推理、组合推理、审慎推理），在提升准确率的同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 多模态查询需要不同类型的推理，但现有方法对所有查询采用统一推理策略，导致简单任务上计算冗余、复杂任务上推理不足，缺乏自适应推理能力。
AI.method: 训练时对同一提示在三种推理模式下分别生成回答，基于正确性、grounding和成本设计复合奖励比较各回答，选出最有效的模式，生成弱监督信号用于优化推理模式选择，无需逐查询标注。
AI.result: 相比Qwen2.5-VL基座模型，在MathVista上提升+5.4，Video-Holmes上提升+4.8，Video-MMMU上提升+4.8；平均token消耗从always-thinking基线的417降至95，显著降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: Video-FLAIR通过强化学习实现自适应推理模式选择，在提升视频问答准确率的同时大幅减少计算成本，验证了按查询复杂度动态调整推理策略的有效性。

title: The Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy: A Framework for Constructing Classifiers and Diagnosing Their Decisions, Applied to Prompt Injection Detection
summary: This paper proposes a framework for constructing a classifier as a safeguard layer, and for developing a complementary diagnostic that identifies which of the classifier's confident decisions can be trusted. This framework, the Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy, consists of (i) constructing a dimensionality-optimized classifier, in which the embedding dimensionality is empirically selected via cross-validated performance rather than fixed a priori, (ii) locating a relatively small set of latent support vectors (~ 29% of total training examples) representing influential prompts for identifying tokens that alter the classifier's predicted labels, and (iii) utilizing such tokens and their associated attack magnitudes for constructing a diagnostic taxonomy. This diagnostic taxonomy provides an end-to-end guideline for flagging prompts that require different treatments: rely Safely on the classifier's decision; flag Heuristic Bias and Heuristic Override cases; route Insufficient Context cases for further human/safety review. Applying the framework to a classifier trained on a public prompt injection dataset, we find that a substantial fraction of its confident decisions (~ 77%) are not robust to removing a single token, and that this brittleness separates into two distinct failure patterns: a confidence calibration failure and a genuinely exploitable shortcut. For each zone of the taxonomy, we also recommend strategies for remediating diagnosed prompts. We illustrate the framework as a series of steps, demonstrating how each step operates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"潜在诊断分类体系"(Latent Diagnostic Taxonomy)框架，通过优化维度分类器、提取约29%潜在支持向量、利用改变预测标签的令牌及其攻击强度构建诊断分类，为提示词提供端到端的处理指南：安全依赖、启发式偏见/覆盖标记、或转人工审查。在提示注入数据集上应用发现约77%的高置信决策对删除单个令牌不鲁棒，并区分为置信度校准失败和可被利用的捷径两类失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有分类器缺乏可信任度评估机制，许多高置信度决策实际上脆弱且不可靠。需要一个系统化的框架来区分可信决策与不可信决策，并识别失败模式以便针对性修复。
AI.method: 框架由三步构成：(i) 通过交叉验证优化嵌入维度而非预先固定；(ii) 识别约29%的潜在支持向量作为有影响力的提示代表，用于定位改变预测标签的令牌；(iii) 利用这些令牌及其攻击幅度构建诊断分类体系，将提示划分为安全依赖、启发式偏置/覆盖、及上下文不足需人工审查等类别。
AI.result: 在公开提示注入数据集上，约77%的高置信决策在删除单个令牌后不再鲁棒。这些脆弱性可归为两类不同失败模式：置信度校准失败和真正可被利用的捷径。框架为每个分类区域提供了补救策略。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为分类器输出提供了可操作的信任评估机制，能够识别可安全依赖的决策与需要干预的情况，并为不同失败模式定制修复策略，形成一个端到端的安全保障流程。

title: Daydreaming: Stealing Hidden Agent Skills through Black-Box Task Interaction
summary: Agent skills bundle instructions, reference data, and executable helpers that let a general agent perform specialized tasks. Hosted providers can keep these files secret while selling access to task results, making the skill itself a valuable target. Existing disclosure defenses can block requests that ask for the skill or reproduce its text, but they cannot block customers from submitting the ordinary tasks the service is built to complete. We present Daydreaming, an execution-only attack that steals a multi-file skill through black-box task interactions. The victim is never asked to reveal the skill or grade a reconstruction. Instead, Daydreaming adaptively creates crafted tasks whose results distinguish possible hidden behaviors. It tests individual behaviors, uses attacker-controlled shadow agents to choose a design, and completes each file using stored victim results and local execution checks. We formalize three nested threat levels of access as Differential, Trace, and Output, and focus on Output, where the attacker sees only the final response and returned files. Across 7 skills and 4 victim models, Daydreaming recovers 86.8% of the original skill's capability at Output, outperforming SigLeak by almost 4x. It produces installable skills using a median of 32 victim calls per skill even with disclosure defenses enabled. These results show that hiding skill files and filtering direct disclosure do not, by themselves, prevent functional reconstruction through normal use.

AI.tldr: Daydreaming是一种仅通过黑盒任务交互即可窃取多文件AI Agent技能（skill）的执行型攻击方法。它通过自适应构造任务来探测隐藏行为，在仅能看到最终输出（Output级别）的情况下，跨7个技能和4个受害者模型恢复了原始技能86.8%的能力，比SigLeak高近4倍，且每次技能窃取仅需中位数32次受害者调用。
AI.motivation: 托管服务提供商可以将Agent技能文件保密，仅向用户出售任务结果访问权限，这使得技能本身成为高价值攻击目标。现有的披露防御机制虽然可以阻止直接请求技能内容或复制文本的恶意查询，但无法阻止用户提交服务原本就设计来完成的普通任务，从而留下了一个安全盲区——如何通过正常任务交互窃取整个技能。
AI.method: Daydreaming是一种执行型（execution-only）攻击，其核心流程包括三层威胁模型形式化（Differential、Trace、Output）并聚焦最严格的Output级别。攻击方法为：1）自适应创建精心设计的任务，其输出结果能够区分可能的隐藏行为；2）逐个测试技能中的每个独立行为；3）使用攻击者控制的影子agent（shadow agents）来辅助选择最优设计方案；4）利用存储的受害者结果结合本地执行检查逐步完成每个文件的还原。
AI.result: 在7个技能和4个受害者模型上，Daydreaming在Output攻击级别下恢复了原始技能86.8%的能力，性能比SigLeak高出近4倍。即使在启用披露防御的情况下，每次技能窃取仅需中位数32次受害者调用即可生成可安装的完整技能。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，仅隐藏技能文件和过滤直接披露请求并不能有效阻止通过正常使用进行的功能重建。Daydreaming证明了即使攻击者只能看到最终响应，也可以通过精心构造的黑盒任务交互来完整重构多文件技能，这意味着需要开发更强大的防御机制来应对基于行为的技能窃取攻击。

title: FLARE: A Failure-Aware Framework for Autonomous Correction and Recovery in Visual-Language Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action Models~(VLAs) have demonstrated significant promise in generalizing to complex, long-horizon robotic manipulation tasks. However, their performance remains brittle, as they are typically trained on trajectory-monotonic, failure-free demonstrations. This reliance on ``perfect" data leaves them unable to recover from common execution errors, such as a missed grasp, a dropped object, or an unexpected collision. In this paper, we propose FLARE, a novel framework that endows VLAs with robust error recovery capabilities through a ``Retry" and ``Reset" paradigm. First, we introduce a ``Retry" mechanism by injecting perturbation and bridging segments that decouple robot pose from environment state into demonstrations, enabling the policy to autonomously handle execution deviations. Second, to address critical, state-breaking (OOD) failures, we introduce a ``Reset" pipeline. We leverage an MLLM for offline failure analysis to automatically identify OOD states from execution videos. This analysis enables the efficient, targeted collection of a small library of object-centric ``Reset" skills, which are trained to restore the environment to a task-valid state. Our full framework integrates these learned policies. At inference, an online MLLM monitor arbitrates between task execution and ``Reset" skills. Experiments on challenging, contact-rich manipulation tasks show our approach significantly improves task success and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FLARE框架，通过"Retry"（重试）和"Reset"（重置）两种机制赋予视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）错误恢复能力。Retry机制通过在演示中注入扰动和桥接片段，使策略能够自主处理执行偏差；Reset机制利用MLLM进行离线故障分析，识别OOD状态并训练目标中心的重置技能以恢复环境到有效状态。推理阶段由在线MLLM监控器在任务执行与重置技能之间进行仲裁。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通常在无失败的演示数据上训练，导致其在真实环境中遇到常见执行错误（如抓取失败、物体掉落、意外碰撞）时无法恢复，性能十分脆弱。这些模型缺乏从错误中恢复的鲁棒性能力。
AI.method: FLARE框架包含两个核心机制：(1) "Retry"机制：在演示数据中注入扰动和桥接片段，将机器人位姿与环境状态解耦，使策略能够自主处理执行偏差；(2) "Reset"机制：利用MLLM对执行视频进行离线失败分析，自动识别OOD（分布外）状态，据此高效收集少量目标中心的"Reset"技能数据进行训练。训练完成后，推理阶段由在线MLLM监控器在正常任务执行与Reset技能之间进行实时仲裁。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的接触丰富型操作任务上进行了实验，结果表明FLARE框架显著提升了任务成功率和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: FLARE通过显式的错误恢复机制（Retry和Reset）有效弥补了VLA模型在非理想数据下的脆弱性，为长时程机器人操作任务的鲁棒执行提供了一种实用的解决方案。

title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunications: A Framework for CRM Integration
summary: Subscriber attrition is a costly, persistent challenge for telecommunications providers, with monthly churn of roughly 1.9% in mature markets eroding billions in revenue annually. Predictive models can flag at-risk customers accurately, yet they are routinely excluded from frontline CRM workflows because high-performing ensemble and non-linear architectures are opaque: a retention specialist cannot design a personalised intervention from a probability score alone, without knowing why a subscriber is at risk. This paper addresses that gap. We benchmark four classifiers--Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM--on the IBM Telco Customer Churn benchmark (7,043 records; 19 features; 26.5% churn, balanced to 50% via SMOTE on the training partition only). Logistic Regression attains the strongest AUC-ROC (0.8411) and LightGBM the highest accuracy (78.42%); all four fall within a 0.011 AUC band (0.831--0.841), and 5-fold cross-validation confirms the leading models are effectively tied. Explanations are delivered at two granularities: a global SHAP ranking identifying tenure, total charges, and month-to-month contract as the dominant churn signals, and instance-level SHAP and LIME decompositions that expose the drivers behind each prediction. Building on these outputs, we introduce a four-layer CRM integration architecture that converts risk scores and attribution vectors into tiered segmentation, maps top features to structured retention-action templates, and routes campaign outcomes into a retraining feedback loop. Targeting the highest-risk quintile is projected to cut overall churn by 3.3--5.3 percentage points, preserving an estimated $199K--$319K per campaign cycle.

AI.tldr: 本文针对电信客户流失预测中"模型准确但不可解释"的问题，在IBM Telco基准数据集上基准测试了四种分类器（Logistic Regression、Random Forest、XGBoost、LightGBM），所有模型AUC落在0.831-0.841的窄区间内（Logistic Regression最优0.8411），并通过全局SHAP与实例级SHAP/LIME提供双重粒度的可解释性，最后提出四层CRM集成架构将风险分数与归因向量转化为分层细分、留存动作模板和重训练反馈闭环，预计可将流失率降低3.3-5.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 电信行业客户流失每年侵蚀数十亿美元收入，预测模型虽能准确识别高风险客户，但高性能的集成与非线性架构缺乏可解释性，导致留存专员无法根据单一概率分数设计个性化干预方案，模型因此被排除在CRM工作流之外。
AI.method: 在IBM Telco Churn基准（7,043条记录、19个特征、26.5%流失率，仅训练集用SMOTE平衡至50%）上基准测试四种分类器；Logistic Regression达到最优AUC-ROC（0.8411），LightGBM准确率最高（78.42%），所有模型AUC差异在0.011以内；使用5折交叉验证确认模型表现相当；可解释性采用全局SHAP排名（识别tenure、total charges、month-to-month contract为主要流失信号）和实例级SHAP/LIME分解；提出四层CRM集成架构，将风险分数与归因向量转化为分层细分、特征到留存动作模板的映射，并将活动结果路由至再训练反馈回路。
AI.result: 四种分类器在AUC上几乎持平（0.831-0.841），其中Logistic Regression表现最佳（0.8411 AUC），LightGBM准确率最高（78.42%）。全局SHAP识别出合同期限、总费用和月付合约为主导流失信号。针对最高风险五分位客户进行精准营销，预计可将整体流失率降低3.3-5.3个百分点，每个活动周期可保留约19.9万-31.9万美元的价值。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性并非预测性能的代价——简单模型与复杂模型性能相当，且通过SHAP/LIME提供的可解释输出能够弥合预测模型与一线CRM工作流之间的鸿沟，使留存团队能够基于归因驱动设计个性化干预。四层集成架构为电信运营商的流失管理提供了从预测到行动的完整闭环方案。

title: Agents Don't Paginate: First-Chunk Selection for LLM Tool Responses
summary:
Coding agents built on large language models (LLMs), such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot, and Aider, receive tool responses that routinely exceed the agent's per-turn token budget. The standard remedy, pagination, is available in every protocol that produced these responses; yet across the corpus of session logs from a public Model Context Protocol middleware we observed no agent-initiated requests for a second chunk. The first chunk is what the agent reads, so we ask how often the gold item (the one the agent needs) is placed first in it: the precision-at-1 rate $p_1$.
  In a controlled offline benchmark we treat first-chunk selection as a 0/1 knapsack and compare six value functions on 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks, then test whether $p_1$ matters with a single-turn file-localisation probe on five language models (4,800 LLM calls; not an end-to-end resolve-rate test). Two pre-registered hypotheses did not hold and are our main findings. The central one is negative: raising $p_1$ does not systematically raise downstream accuracy. Per-model deltas stay under three percentage points (p.p.), are not consistently signed, and no model is significant; the agent recovers the gold from anywhere in the chunk, so what reaches its answer is first-chunk inclusion, not the gold's rank within it. The second: adding four file-metadata signals to a keyword scorer hurts $p_1$ by 4.8 p.p. (paired significance test, $p = 0.001$).
  A parameter-free keyword scorer does raise $p_1$, from a 24.2% baseline to 35.0% (+10.8 p.p., far beyond chance; $p = 3.9 \times 10^{-8}$), and to 35.8% with a fallback to the tool's native ordering when no keyword matches. But by our central finding this is a rank-1 gain, and rank-1 is the part that does not reach the agent's answer: downstream accuracy does not move.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于 LLM 的编码代理中工具响应分页截断对下游准确率的影响。核心发现是两项预先注册的假设均未成立：(1) 提高首块内金标项的精度 p₁ 并不会系统性地提升下游准确率（各模型差异均低于 3 个百分点且不显著）；(2) 向关键词打分器添加文件元数据信号反而使 p₁ 下降 4.8 个百分点。虽然参数无关的关键词打分器可将 p₁ 从 24.2% 提升至 35.0%，但根据主发现，这种 rank-1 增益并不会转化为下游准确率的提升。
AI.motivation: 编码代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor、OpenAI Codex 等）在以 LLM 为核心时，工具响应经常超出每轮 token 预算。虽然分页机制在所有协议中均可用，但对公共 Model Context Protocol 中间件的会话日志分析发现，代理从未请求过第二块内容。因此第一块内容决定了代理实际读取的文本，研究者希望探究金标项被放在第一块首位的频率（即 precision-at-1, p₁）及其对下游任务的影响。
AI.method: 在受控离线基准中，将首块选择建模为 0/1 背包问题，在 500 个 SWE-bench Verified 任务上比较六种价值函数；随后通过单轮文件定位探针在五个语言模型上（共 4,800 次 LLM 调用）测试 p₁ 是否影响下游准确率。该方法明确旨在检验而非端到端 resolve-rate 测试。
AI.result: 两项预先注册的假设均未成立：(1) 负向主发现——提高 p₁ 并不系统性提高下游准确率，各模型差异均低于 3 个百分点、符号不一致且无显著性；(2) 向关键词打分器添加四种文件元数据信号使 p₁ 下降 4.8 个百分点（配对显著性检验，p=0.001）。参数无关的关键词打分器将 p₁ 从 24.2% 提升到 35.0%（+10.8 p.p., p=3.9×10⁻⁸），无关键词匹配时回退到工具原生排序可进一步提升至 35.8%。
AI.conclusion: 关键结论是矛盾性的：关键词打分器确实提升了 p₁，但这只是排位第 1 的增益，而排位第 1 恰恰是到达代理答案的那部分中不重要的环节——下游准确率并未移动。代理能从第一块中任意位置恢复金标项，因此真正影响答案的是金标项是否被包含在第一块中，而非其在块内的排序。这提示研究者应关注提升"首块包含率"而非"首块内排名"。

title: Systematic Literature Review of Machine Learning Models and Applications for Text Recognition
comment: Published in IEEE Access, 2025. 24 pages, 16 figures, 5 tables
summary: Optical Character Recognition (OCR) for text recognition using machine vision has significantly improved, particularly when handling heterogeneous textual data. Traditional OCR models struggle with script variations, writing styles, and degraded documents. Advancements in technology are leading to new AI models with improved architecture for handling multiple languages and complex data formats. Despite this progress, a comprehensive evaluation of OCR advancements remains limited. Based on the established preferred reporting items for systematic reviews and meta-analysis (PRISMA) guidelines, this literature review presents an extensive assessment of OCR research to trace the evolution of AI models over the past decade. It explores the transition in AI models, application domains, data types, linguistic coverage, and challenges. Through a detailed analysis of 97 selected studies published during January 2015 - January 2025, key OCR models are identified, and their performance, strengths, and limitations are analyzed. The findings highlight how OCR technologies have evolved to address structured and unstructured text, scene text recognition, and multilingual processing. Unresolved challenges include limited resources for underrepresented languages, high variability in handwritten text, visual similarity among characters, and constraints in real-time OCR applications. To address these issues, several promising approaches are proposed. Key suggestions include self-supervised learning, multimodal AI, automated machine learning (AutoML), AI-assisted postprocessing, tiny machine learning (TinyML), and the creation of joint corpora for script matching. The future recommendations aim to enhance OCR accuracy and tackle the challenges identified for real-time industrial applications. This study will guide future research and establish a foundation for OCR field.

AI.tldr: 本文基于PRISMA指南对2015年1月至2025年1月的97项OCR研究进行系统性文献综述，梳理了AI模型在OCR领域的演进历程，涵盖模型架构、应用领域、数据类型、语言覆盖及挑战，并提出自监督学习、多模态AI、AutoML等未来方向。
AI.motivation: 尽管OCR技术在过去十年取得了显著进步（尤其在处理异构文本、多语言和复杂数据格式方面），但缺乏对其进展的全面评估。传统OCR模型在脚本变体、书写风格和退化文档处理上存在不足，而现有文献综述未能系统性地追踪AI模型在这十年间的演化脉络。
AI.method: 采用PRISMA（系统综述和元分析优选报告项目）指南作为方法论框架，对2015年1月至2025年1月间发表的97项研究进行详细的文献筛选与综合分析，涵盖模型架构演进、应用领域、数据类型、语言覆盖范围及挑战等多个维度。
AI.result: 识别出关键OCR模型并分析了其性能、优势与局限；揭示了OCR技术如何演进来处理结构化与非结构化文本、场景文本识别及多语言处理；指出了未解决的挑战包括低资源语言语料匮乏、手写文本高变异性、字符视觉相似性以及实时OCR应用限制。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一系列有前景的解决方向，包括自监督学习、多模态AI、自动化机器学习（AutoML）、AI辅助后处理、微型机器学习（TinyML）以及联合语料库构建，旨在提升OCR准确率并解决实时工业应用的挑战，为未来研究提供指导并奠定OCR领域基础。

title: FedCMAPSS: A Benchmark for Federated Learning in Remaining Useful Life Estimation
comment: Accepted at the 21st IEEE Conference on Industrial Electronics and Applications (ICIEA 2026)
summary: Data-driven prognostics and health management has emerged as a key enabler for Industry 4.0, yet the development of robust remaining useful life (RUL) estimation models is often limited by the scarcity of run-to-failure data. While federated learning offers a promising paradigm to collaboratively train predictive models without sharing sensor data, research efforts have operated so far in the absence of a common evaluation framework. To address this gap, this paper introduces FedCMAPSS, a benchmark for federated RUL estimation based on the commonly-used NASA C-MAPSS dataset. We define a set of five standardized tasks designed to simulate real-world industrial challenges, ranging from ideal IID settings to extreme statistical heterogeneity, and conduct a systematic evaluation of state-of-the-art federated optimization algorithms across multiple neural architectures. By establishing reproducible baselines and making the source code and data splits publicly available, this work aims to provide a standard foundation for developing and comparing federated predictive maintenance solutions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedCMAPSS，一个基于NASA C-MAPSS数据集的联邦剩余使用寿命（RUL）估计基准，定义了五个标准化任务以模拟从理想IID到极端统计异构的真实工业场景，并系统评估了多种联邦优化算法和神经网络架构，公开代码与数据划分以促进可复现的联邦预测性维护研究。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动的预测性健康管理是工业4.0的关键使能技术，但run-to-failure数据稀缺限制了RUL估计模型的鲁棒性。虽然联邦学习可在不共享传感器数据的情况下协作训练预测模型，但现有研究缺乏统一的评估框架，导致不同方法之间难以公平比较。
AI.method: 基于NASA C-MAPSS数据集构建FedCMAPSS基准；定义五个标准化联邦学习任务，涵盖从理想IID到极端统计异构（non-IID）的现实工业场景；系统评估多个最先进的联邦优化算法（如FedAvg等）在不同神经网络架构上的性能；公开源代码和数据划分以建立可复现基线。
AI.result: 提供了一个标准化的联邦RUL估计评估基准，建立了可复现的基线结果，系统比较了不同联邦优化算法与网络架构在各类异构任务下的表现，并公开了基准代码与数据划分。
AI.conclusion: FedCMAPSS填补了联邦RUL估计领域缺乏统一评估框架的空白，为开发和比较联邦预测性维护解决方案提供了标准基础，有助于推动该领域的可复现性和良性竞争。

title: A Hybrid Post-Quantum Encryption Architecture with Self-Hosted Key Management for SME Cloud Data Protection
summary: Harvesting ciphertext from cloud storage needs no quantum computer; decrypting it later does. That gap is the harvest-now-decrypt-later exposure: anything protected by RSA or ECDH today that must stay secret for decades is already compromised. Small and medium-sized enterprises are least able to respond: they neither run the infrastructure on which their data sits on nor employ a cryptographer. Bespoke migration suits firms with security budgets; a managed key service relocates trust rather than removing it. The obstacle is architectural, not cryptographic. We present Quantum Cloud Guard (QCG), a software-only three-layer architecture. No prior SME-oriented system combines its three elements: client-side hybrid post-quantum encryption, self-hosted key custody with client-verifiable ML-DSA-87 signatures on served keys, and an integrated application-layer abuse-prevention gateway. Files never leave the client: each is sealed under AES-256-GCM, its key wrapped to an ML-KEM-1024 public key from the enterprise's key service. The enterprise alone administers it; it signs every key with ML-DSA-87, so a client that pinned it detects substitution. Separating key custody from data custody is the point: a provider holding both can read the data. On a 24 MHz STM32F407, ML-KEM-1024 key generation takes 40.8 ms and decapsulation 44.0 ms; on the server every post-quantum operation stays sub-millisecond, signing adding 0.24 ms per request. The service runs on a 4.49 EUR/month virtual server. Under sustained flooding, the in-process gateway Sentinel Gate rejected 98.8% of attack traffic while a legitimate client's median latency moved from 621 to 625 ms. Being single-source, this shows filtering effectiveness, not DDoS resilience.

AI.tldr: 提出Quantum Cloud Guard（QCG），一种面向中小企业的软件型三层后量子云存储安全架构，结合客户端混合后量子加密、自托管密钥托管（带ML-DSA-87客户端可验证签名）和应用层滥用防护网关，在低成本虚拟服务器上实现亚毫秒级后量子操作，并有效过滤98.8%的洪水攻击流量。
AI.motivation: harvest-now-decrypt-later攻击使当前基于RSA或ECDH加密的数据面临被未来量子计算机解密的风险。中小企业既无法自建基础设施也无密码学专家，现有方案要么昂贵（定制迁移）要么仅转移信任（托管密钥服务），根本障碍是架构性的而非密码学性的，亟需一个适合SME的后量子云安全架构。
AI.method: QCG采用三层架构：1）客户端侧混合后量子加密——文件在客户端用AES-256-GCM密封，密钥用ML-KEM-1024公钥封装；2）自托管密钥托管——企业独占管理密钥服务，用ML-DSA-87对每个密钥签名，客户端通过固定密钥指纹检测替换；3）应用层滥用防护网关（Sentinel Gate）——集成应用层进行洪水攻击过滤。密钥托管与数据托管分离是关键设计。
AI.result: 在24 MHz STM32F407上，ML-KEM-1024密钥生成耗时40.8 ms、解封装44.0 ms；服务器端所有后量子操作均低于1毫秒，每次请求签名仅增加0.24 ms。服务运行于4.49欧元/月虚拟服务器。在持续洪水攻击下，Sentinel Gate拒绝98.8%攻击流量，合法客户端中位延迟从621 ms仅微增至625 ms。
AI.conclusion: QCG证明了面向中小企业的软件型后量子云存储安全方案在架构上可行且成本低，但需注意98.8%过滤率仅反映单一数据源下的过滤有效性，而非全面DDoS抗性。

title: Beyond the Proving Ground: Independent Public-Road Testing of Assisted Lane Change Systems using LiDAR
summary: Testing of commercial Advanced Driver Assistance Systems is essential to ensure safety and compliance during type approval and in service operation. However, proving ground scenarios may not reflect real world driving complexity, while geo fencing can require manufacturer collaboration and limit assessment independence. This work presents a methodology for independently testing Assisted Lane Change systems on public roads. A campaign on the A31 French motorway used a test vehicle equipped with a LiDAR based vehicle detection and tracking system. Tests covered combinations of inter vehicle distance and speed between the test vehicle and the take over vehicle. Real time kinematic global navigation satellite system receivers assessed detection and tracking performance. Recorded lane change trajectories were compared with the lane change suppression requirements of UNECE Regulation Number 79. Of 27 predefined lane change manoeuvres, 18 were completed and 9 suppressed. In 6 cases, the system allowed manoeuvres that did not meet regulatory minimum distance requirements. In 3 cases, the deviation remained statistically significant after accounting for measurement uncertainty. To the authors knowledge, this is the first public road campaign designed to assess Assisted Lane Change compliance with Regulation Number 79 safety distance requirements. The results demonstrate the suitability of LiDAR based sensing for this purpose. The methodology can support market surveillance and future regulatory revisions by revealing real world behaviours not covered by approval procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在公共道路上独立测试辅助车道变更（Assisted Lane Change）系统合规性的方法，并在法国A31高速公路上进行了实际测试。通过LiDAR探测和RTK-GNSS定位，将记录的车道变更轨迹与UNECE第79号法规的安全距离要求进行比较，发现部分系统允许了不满足法规最低距离要求的操作。
AI.motivation: 商业高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）的类型批准和服役安全测试至关重要，但试验场场景无法完全反映真实驾驶的复杂性，而地理围栏测试需要制造商协作且限制评估独立性，因此需要一种独立、真实道路上的测试方法。
AI.method: 基于LiDAR的车辆检测与跟踪系统装备测试车辆，在法国A31高速公路上开展测试活动。测试覆盖测试车辆与接管车辆之间不同车距和速度的组合；使用实时动态全球导航卫星系统（RTK-GNSS）接收机评估检测与跟踪性能；将记录的车道变更轨迹与UNECE第79号法规的车道变更抑制要求进行对比分析。
AI.result: 在27个预定义车道变更操作中，18个被完成，9个被抑制。6个案例中系统允许了不满足法规最低距离要求的操作；在考虑测量不确定性后，3个案例的偏差在统计上显著。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个针对辅助车道变更系统符合第79号法规安全距离要求的公共道路测试活动。结果表明LiDAR感知方案适用于此类测试，该方法论可支持市场监管和未来法规修订，揭示审批程序未覆盖的真实世界行为。

title: EEG-to-Report: An Annotation and Feature-Text Framework for Training Language Models on Clinical EEG
summary: Clinical electroencephalography (EEG) reporting remains largely manual and time-consuming, and current EEG software ecosystems do not produce the structured EEG-text supervision needed for training modern language models. Most toolboxes focus on visualization or preprocessing, providing limited support for workflows that generate high-quality datasets for AI. We introduce EEG-to-Report, a browser-based annotation and feature-text framework that links routine EEG review with the construction of AI-ready datasets. The framework integrates multi-format EEG ingestion, channel standardization, and an interactive viewer with a multimodal annotation layer that combines typed text and transcribed voice notes. For each annotated segment, a feature extraction engine computes a standardized set of spectral, temporal, entropy, Hjorth, connectivity, and spike-related descriptors, stored alongside clinical descriptions in a portable JSON schema. This yields aligned feature-text pairs designed to supervise multimodal EEG-language models. The framework also includes an auto-report module that couples an ensemble of convolutional networks with a large language model to draft clinical narratives for neurologist review. Using pilot annotations, we describe how EEG-to-Report streamlines annotation workflows and produces editable draft reports, providing a reusable foundation for automated EEG reporting systems.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍EEG-to-Report，一个基于浏览器的脑电图（EEG）标注与特征-文本框架，将常规EEG审查与AI就绪数据集的构建相连接。该框架整合多格式EEG数据导入、通道标准化、交互式可视化、多模态标注层（文本+语音转录）、特征提取引擎（频谱、时域、熵、Hjorth、连通性、尖峰描述符）、便携JSON模式存储，以及结合卷积网络集成与大型语言模型的自动报告模块。
AI.motivation: 临床EEG报告仍然主要依赖人工且耗时，现有EEG软件生态系统无法生成训练现代语言模型所需的结构化EEG-文本监督数据。大部分工具集中于可视化或预处理，缺乏支持生成高质量AI训练数据集的工作流程。
AI.method: 开发一个集成的浏览器端框架，包含：(1) 多格式EEG数据导入与通道标准化；(2) 交互式查看器与多模态标注层（支持打字文本和语音转录）；(3) 特征提取引擎，为每个标注片段计算标准化的频谱、时域、熵、Hjorth、连通性和尖峰相关描述符；(4) 以便携JSON schema存储对齐的特征-文本对；(5) 自动报告模块，通过卷积网络集成+大语言模型生成可编辑的临床报告草稿供神经科医生审阅。
AI.result: 利用试点标注，展示了EEG-to-Report如何简化标注工作流并生成可编辑的草稿报告，验证了该框架作为自动化EEG报告系统可复用基础的有效性。
AI.conclusion: EEG-to-Report填补了临床EEG工具与AI模型训练之间的空白，提供了一套从数据标注到报告生成的一体化流程，为未来自动化EEG报告系统奠定了可复用的基础。

title: Evaluating Language Models in Realistic Conversational Contexts
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed to serve open-ended, multi-turn interactions, evaluating conversational quality at human scale has become a central challenge. Existing evaluation frameworks built for summarization, translation, or short-form QA tasks fall short of adequately measuring the consistency of human-scale dialogue, especially when derivation and validation of these metrics themselves often rely on synthetic rather than human sources. We fill the gap by introducing UPHELD (UPwork Human-Scale Evaluated Long Dialogues), a large, reference-full benchmark for evaluating human-scale conversational ability beyond factual correctness. UPHELD consists of hundreds of complete human-to-human dialogues authored by professional script writers, with realistic turn densities and 36,000+ per-turn human annotations across 30,000+ expert-generated dialogue turns. Using UPHELD, we systematically evaluate classical automatic metrics and reference-free LLM-as-a-judge approaches, and find them unreliable when correlated with expert human judgment. Building off this analysis, we use UPHELD to develop a Mixture-of-Judges framework that combines multiple evaluative signals and improves correlation with human assessments by approximately 30%. Overall, UPHELD provides a robust, human-grounded foundation for evaluating human-scale conversational intelligence that fills a crucial gap in the pre-existing LLM dataset landscape.

AI.tldr: UPHELD是一个由专业编剧撰写的人类对话基准数据集，包含数百段完整对话和36,000+条逐轮人类标注，用于评估大语言模型在人类尺度多轮对话中的会话质量；研究发现现有自动评估指标和LLM-as-a-judge方法与专家人类判断相关性差，据此提出了Mixture-of-Judges框架，将相关性提升约30%。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架（如摘要、翻译、短问答任务）无法充分衡量人类规模对话的一致性，且这类指标的推导和验证往往依赖合成数据而非人类来源，缺乏可靠的人类尺度对话评估基准。
AI.method: 构建UPHELD基准（数百段专业编剧撰写的人对人对话，含30,000+专家生成的对话轮次和36,000+逐轮人类标注），系统评估经典自动评估指标和免参考的LLM-as-a-judge方法，并基于分析开发Mixture-of-Judges框架以组合多种评估信号。
AI.result: 经典自动评估指标和免参考LLM-as-a-judge方法与专家人类判断相关性差、不可靠；Mixture-of-Judges框架通过组合多种评估信号，将与人类评估的相关性提升约30%。
AI.conclusion: UPHELD提供了稳健的、以人类为基础的基准，填补了现有LLM数据集格局中关于人类尺度对话智能评估的关键空白，为评估超越事实正确性的对话能力奠定了基础。

title: NeuDonatello: Uncertainty-Aware Framework for Accurate Neural SDF Learning
summary: Neural surface reconstruction has emerged as a powerful paradigm for recovering high-quality 3D surfaces from multi-view images. However, recovering accurate geometry solely from RGB images remains challenging due to uncertainties arising from textureless regions, occlusions, and inherent scene ambiguities. Existing methods often overlook such uncertainties, leading to inaccurate estimates of the signed distance function (SDF). We introduce NeuDonatello, a novel framework that models and leverages SDF uncertainty to improve surface reconstruction. Central to our approach is to model spatially varying uncertainty using a Monte Carlo sampling strategy. Using this uncertainty, we develop an adaptive regularization that selectively strengthens geometric constraints where RGB supervision is unreliable, avoiding incorrect surface reconstruction. We further introduce an uncertainty-aware scale parameter for the SDF-to-density conversion. Conditioned on uncertainty, this design enables more accurate modeling of spatially varying densities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuDonatello achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction accuracy, with robust performance across diverse scenes using only posed RGB images.

AI.tldr: NeuDonatello是一个基于神经隐式曲面重建的框架，通过蒙特卡洛采样显式建模SDF的不确定性，并利用该不确定性设计自适应正则化和不确定性感知的SDF-to-density转换参数，从而在纹理缺失、遮挡等挑战性场景下提升三维曲面重建精度。
AI.motivation: 仅基于RGB图像恢复精确几何结构仍具挑战性，因为纹理缺失区域、遮挡和场景固有模糊性会引入不确定性。现有方法往往忽略这种不确定性，导致符号距离函数(SDF)估计不准确。
AI.method: 1) 使用蒙特卡洛采样策略建模空间变化的不确定性；2) 基于不确定性设计自适应正则化，在RGB监督不可靠处加强几何约束；3) 引入不确定性感知的尺度参数用于SDF-to-density转换，实现空间变化密度的更精确建模。
AI.result: 在多种场景的实验评估中，NeuDonatello达到了最先进的曲面重建精度，仅使用带位姿的RGB图像即可在各类场景下稳健工作。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并利用SDF不确定性，可以显著改善神经曲面重建在困难场景中的几何精度，为不确定性感知的三维重建提供了新方向。

title: NeoTriFuse: Reliability-Aware Multimodal Fusion under Missingness Heterogeneity for Neonatal Mortality Risk Prediction
summary: Neonatal mortality risk prediction from bedside monitoring data remains challenging due to extreme class imbalance, heterogeneous clinical risk factors, multi-scale temporal dynamics, and substantial missingness. We propose NeoTriFuse, a reliability-aware multimodal fusion framework for missingness-heterogeneous neonatal monitoring data. Unlike conventional multimodal approaches that treat missingness primarily as a preprocessing issue, NeoTriFuse models missingness as an explicit reliability signal that dynamically modulates modality contributions during fusion. The framework integrates static perinatal variables, local-global temporal encoders, and patient-level statistical summaries through reliability-guided gating mechanisms, while jointly optimizing mortality prediction and an auxiliary length-of-stay objective. NeoTriFuse achieves competitive performance, with an F1 score of 0.6736 +/- 0.0216 and an AUROC of 0.9454 +/- 0.0056. Ablation studies indicate that the local-global temporal architecture and patient-level summary branch contribute most substantially to predictive performance, while reliability-aware gating provides additional improvements on threshold-dependent metrics under heterogeneous observation completeness. Sensitivity analyses further suggest stable performance across nearby hyperparameter settings. Overall, the findings support reliability-aware multimodal fusion as a practical approach for neonatal mortality prediction under realistic clinical missingness conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NeoTriFuse，一种面向新生儿监护数据的可靠性感知多模态融合框架，将缺失率建模为显式的可靠性信号以动态调节模态贡献，在新生儿死亡风险预测中取得F1=0.6736、AUROC=0.9454的竞争力表现。
AI.motivation: 新生儿死亡率预测面临极端类别不平衡、临床风险因素异质性、多尺度时间动态以及大量数据缺失等挑战。传统多模态方法将缺失视为预处理问题，未充分挖掘缺失信息本身所蕴含的临床价值，亟需一种将缺失建模为可靠性信号并在融合过程中动态调控模态贡献的方法。
AI.method: NeoTriFuse框架包括三部分：(1) 静态围产期变量；(2) 局部-全局时间编码器（捕捉多尺度时间动态）；(3) 患者层面统计摘要。通过可靠性引导的门控机制，将数据缺失率作为显式的可靠性信号，动态调节各模态在融合中的贡献权重。同时联合优化死亡预测主任务和一个辅助的住院时长（length-of-stay）目标。
AI.result: NeoTriFuse取得F1=0.6736±0.0216、AUROC=0.9454±0.0056。消融研究表明局部-全局时间编码架构和患者层面统计摘要分支贡献最大；可靠性感知门控在异质性观测完整性下进一步改善了基于阈值的指标；敏感性分析表明模型在相近超参数下性能稳定。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性感知的多模态融合在真实临床缺失条件下是一种实用的新生儿死亡风险预测方法，为处理缺失数据提供了新的范式，即从"预处理问题"转向"显式信号建模"。

title: Thresholding Post-Quantum Signatures
summary: Threshold signature schemes distribute the signing process among $T$ parties out of $N$. They enable a variety of applications and their research is also motivated by a recent NIST call. However, applications are dominated by pre-quantum signatures, which are more efficient but not secure in the post-quantum setting. This paper investigates existing post-quantum signatures, based on a variety of paradigms: lattice problems, one-way (hash) functions, cryptographic group actions, isogenies and multivariate systems. We propose a classification (divided by paradigm) of existing tools that are used to build $T$-out-of-$N$ schemes from digital signatures. We also include general approaches based on FHE, MPC or ZKP.

AI.tldr: 本文调研了基于多种后量子密码学范式的门限签名方案，并按不同范式（格问题、单向哈希函数、密码学群作用、同源、多变量系统）以及通用方法（FHE、MPC、ZKP）对现有工具进行分类，以构建T-out-of-N门限签名方案。
AI.motivation: 后量子时代的到来使得现有门限签名方案（多基于预量子签名）在量子攻击下不再安全，而NIST对后量子门限签名的征集进一步推动了该领域的研究需求。需要对现有后量子签名在门限化方面的可扩展性进行系统梳理。
AI.method: 本文对不同后量子签名范式进行分类分析，涵盖格问题、单向哈希函数、密码学群作用、同源和多变量系统等范式，并梳理了用于构建T-out-of-N方案的工具，同时讨论基于FHE、MPC和ZKP的通用构造方法。
AI.result: 提出了一种按密码学范式分类的门限后量子签名构建工具分类体系，覆盖了不同后量子签名基础下的门限化技术路线。
AI.conclusion: 系统性地整理了后量子门限签名领域的研究现状，为后续在该方向的研究提供了分类学框架和参考。

title: PredVLA: A Sub-Million-Parameter Predictive-Coding Policy for Robot Manipulation
summary: Large pretrained vision-language-action models dominate modern robot-manipulation benchmarks, but it remains unclear how much model scale is necessary for strong language-conditioned control, or whether fundamentally different control architectures can remain competitive at much smaller parameter budgets. We present PredVLA, a language-conditioned predictive-coding policy with only 0.68 million trainable network parameters and no robot-data pretraining, whose hierarchical generative recurrent dynamics predict visual features and proprioception while observations influence latent state only through online inference from the resulting sensory prediction errors. On LIBERO, PredVLA achieves an 86.9% mean success rate across the three short-horizon suites and 75.4% when the long-horizon suite is included. Under a controlled comparison using the same frozen front end, demonstrations, action decoder, and evaluation protocol, PredVLA achieves 3.7x and 7.4x mean success rates of parameter-matched Transformer and LSTM policies, respectively. The predictive-coding formulation also makes the contribution of observation-driven correction directly measurable: because observations influence the recurrent state only through prediction-error-based latent inference, disabling this inference yields an exact open-loop control condition. Together, these results show that a sub-million-parameter recurrent generative policy can achieve strong performance on modern language-conditioned manipulation benchmarks while providing an explicit mechanism for prediction-error-driven online state correction.

AI.tldr: PredVLA是一种仅含68万可训练参数、无需机器人数据预训练的语言条件预测编码策略，采用分层生成式循环动力学预测视觉特征和本体感知，通过感官预测误差驱动潜在状态推断。在LIBERO基准上达到86.9%的短时域平均成功率，并显著超越参数匹配的Transformer和LSTM策略，同时提供了可精确量化的开环/闭环对照机制。
AI.motivation: 大型预训练视觉-语言-动作模型主导了现代机器人操作基准，但模型规模对语言条件控制性能的必要性尚不明确。本文旨在探究小型、架构不同的控制器是否能在极小参数预算下保持竞争力，从而挑战"规模越大越好"的主流假设。
AI.method: PredVLA采用预测编码范式：分层生成式循环网络预测视觉特征与本体感知，观测仅通过计算感官预测误差的在线推断来影响潜在状态。该架构仅含0.68M可训练参数，且无需机器人数据预训练。通过消融其预测误差驱动的潜在推断，可实现精确的开环控制对照。
AI.result: 在LIBERO基准上，PredVLA在三个短时域套件上平均成功率达86.9%，加入长时域套件后为75.4%。在冻结前端、示范数据、动作解码器和评估协议一致的受控对比下，其平均成功率分别是参数匹配的Transformer和LSTM策略的3.7倍和7.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，亚百万参数级别的循环生成策略在现代语言条件操控基准上能取得强性能，这一结论挑战了大规模预训练模型的必要性，同时预测误差驱动的在线状态校正机制提供了显式且可测量的闭环修正途径。

title: Selection Bias Correction in Retail Intelligence
comment: Accepted to the 15th International Conference on Data Science, Technology and Applications (DATA 2026)
summary: Retail intelligence often relies on monitoring popular, high-velocity products, potentially biasing economic indicators by ignoring the "long tail" of niche items. This simulation study investigates selection bias in inflation estimation and compares correction methods across diverse data-generating processes. Through 400 Monte Carlo replications spanning four scenarios--aligned step functions, smooth gradients, misaligned breaks, and polynomial relationships--we test the robustness of Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) with five specifications against stratification with varying strata counts. Our findings reveal fundamental limits of weighting methods in retail long-tail contexts: stratification achieves superior performance in three of four scenarios, maintaining sub-0.04pp median error even when boundaries deliberately misalign with population breaks (116x advantage over IPW). However, IPW with spline propensity models wins under smooth polynomial relationships (median error 0.007pp vs. 0.013pp), demonstrating context-dependency. Critically, even an oracle IPW specification with perfect structural knowledge achieves 6.06pp error compared to stratification's 0.008pp in step-function scenarios. This reflects violation of the Positivity Assumption--a fundamental causal inference requirement--rather than IPW methodological inferiority. When selection probabilities differ dramatically (90% vs. 1%), weighting methods operate outside their theoretical design envelope. These results demonstrate that stratification provides a safer engineering choice in retail long-tail distributions with severe positivity violations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过400次蒙特卡洛模拟，在四种数据生成场景下比较了IPW加权法与分层法在零售长尾商品通货膨胀估计中的选择偏差校正效果。研究发现分层法在三种场景中表现更优（误差低至0.04pp以下），而IPW仅在平滑多项式关系下胜出；即使在完美设定的"oracle"IPW下，违背Positivity Assumption会导致6.06pp的巨大误差，表明分层法是零售长尾情境下更稳健的工程选择。
AI.motivation: 零售情报通常聚焦于高销量热门商品，忽略"长尾"小众商品的监测，可能导致经济指标（如通货膨胀率）的系统性选择偏差。作者旨在系统评估不同偏差校正方法在零售长尾语境下的可靠性，填补该领域关于方法鲁棒性的实证空白。
AI.method: 采用400次蒙特卡洛模拟实验，构建四种数据生成场景（对齐阶跃函数、平滑梯度、错位断点、多项式关系），系统比较五种设定的IPW加权法与不同分层数下的分层校正法，并引入具有完美结构知识的oracle IPW作为理论基准。
AI.result: 分层法在四场景中三种表现优（中位误差<0.04pp，错位断点场景优势达116倍）；IPW仅在多项式场景胜出（0.007pp vs 0.013pp）；oracle IPW在阶跃场景误差高达6.06pp，远劣于分层法的0.008pp，原因在于选择概率差异悬殊（90% vs 1%）时违背Positivity Assumption。
AI.conclusion: 在零售长尾分布且存在严重Positivity违反的场景中，分层法比IPW加权法提供更安全的工程选择；IPW的失效源于因果推断的基本前提假设被破坏，而非方法本身的缺陷。方法选择应依赖数据生成特性，具有明确的场景依赖性。

title: Agent Seer: Synthesizing Scenarios from Specification Understanding
summary:
Evaluating AI agents that use external tools requires realistic test scenarios that capture how practitioners compose tools and iterate across conversation turns. Constructing such scenarios by hand demands deep domain expertise, does not scale across tool ecosystems, and produces static benchmarks that cannot track evolving APIs. We observe that tool specifications -- function names, natural-language descriptions, and typed parameter schemas -- already encode sufficient semantic information to synthesize realistic evaluation scenarios without manual curation or live tool execution. Agent Seer builds off this latent information: from a single Model Context Protocol (MCP) specification, with no examples, no live tool access, and no domain-specific tuning. This pipeline enriches raw schemas, generates graded scenarios with synthetic tool outputs, and expands them into mock-data-grounded multi-turn dialogues that exhibit strong tool-calling correctness and conversational coherence.
  Evaluation quality is measured by applying this pipeline on seven MCP specifications spanning diverse domains and tool-suite sizes and measuring the tool-calling correctness and conversational coherence. The pipeline achieves strong quality across all domains, with complete tool coverage on small and medium specifications.
