Two findings emerge within this analysis: parameter schema complexity is the strongest correlate of quality variation -- tool-suite size plays a smaller, orthogonal role -- and argument value accuracy is the dominant failure mode among imperfect scenarios, a sub-dimension invisible to coarse-grained name-match metrics.

AI.tldr: Agent Seer是一种利用MCP工具规格说明中的语义信息来自动合成AI代理评估场景的流水线，无需人工策展、实时工具访问或领域特定调优，即可生成具有高工具调用正确性和对话连贯性的多轮对话基准。
AI.motivation: 手工构建AI代理使用外部工具的评估场景需要深厚的领域专业知识、难以跨工具生态系统扩展，且产生的静态基准无法跟踪不断演化的API。作者观察到工具规格（函数名、自然语言描述、参数类型模式）已编码足够的语义信息，可用于自动合成逼真的评估场景。
AI.method: Agent Seer从单个MCP（Model Context Protocol）规格出发，无需示例、实时工具访问或领域专用调优。流水线包括三个步骤：丰富原始模式（enrich raw schemas）、生成带分级评分的情景及合成工具输出、扩展为基于模拟数据的多轮对话。
AI.result: 在七个覆盖不同领域和工具套件规模的MCP规格上评估，流水线在小型和中等规格上实现完整工具覆盖，并跨所有域达到高质量。两个关键发现：参数模式复杂度是质量变异的最强关联因素（工具套件规模作用较小且正交）；参数值准确性是不完美场景中的主要失败模式，这是粗粒度名称匹配指标无法捕捉的子维度。
AI.conclusion: 工具规格中的潜在语义信息足以支撑自动化合成高质量评估场景，为持续追踪动态API的代理评估提供了可扩展的解决方案，同时揭示了现有评估指标在参数级精度上的不足。

title: HUG-VIS: A Multimodal Benchmark for Human-centered Understanding and Generation in Visual Intelligence
summary: Visual intelligence seeks to perceive, interpret, and synthesize the visual world and is central to modern computer vision. Human-centered visual intelligence is especially demanding because it studies people as expressive, socially situated subjects whose meaning is rarely conveyed by appearance alone. It couples vision with audio and language across four representative tasks: human emotion recognition, human video generation, human voice cloning, and human video matting. Yet existing resources remain task-specific, providing modalities and annotations for individual problems rather than a shared foundation coordinating understanding and generation. This limits multimodal signal use and broader research. We address this gap with HUG-VIS, a unified benchmark for Human-centered Understanding and Generation in Visual Intelligence. It contains 8,400 seated half-body videos of 30 professional actors, each performing the same 280 emotion-action-prompt assignments under a controlled Mandarin studio protocol, with synchronized video, audio, text, and alpha mattes. We evaluate diverse open- and closed-source models across the four tasks under a unified zero-shot protocol using automatic metrics, criterion-specific mean opinion scores, and multiple cross-task analyses. Results show that (i) linguistic content dominates current emotion recognition, while purely visual affect recognition is weakest; (ii) in video generation and voice cloning, automatic metrics and human judgment agree overall but differ in their top rankings, requiring joint reporting; (iii) boundary fidelity under motion is the main remaining obstacle for human matting; and (iv) task difficulty varies across emotions, models, and metrics, with notable cross-task correlations. The dataset and results are available at https://github.com/GML-MMGroup/HUG-VIS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HUG-VIS，一个面向以人为中心视觉智能的统一基准，包含8,400段由30位专业演员在受控曼德琳语方案下拍摄的半身视频，同步提供视频、音频、文本和alpha蒙版，覆盖情绪识别、视频生成、语音克隆和视频抠像四项任务，并在统一零样本协议下对多种开源和闭源模型进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉智能资源是任务特异的，只为单个问题提供模态和标注，缺乏在理解和生成任务之间协调的统一基础，限制了多模态信号的使用和更广泛的研究。特别是以人为中心的视觉智能需要跨模态（视觉+音频+语言）支持，目前缺少这样的共享基准。
AI.method: 构建HUG-VIS基准：包含8,400段受控采集的半身视频，由30位专业演员各自完成280个相同的情感-动作-提示词任务，同步录制视频、音频、文本和alpha蒙版。在四类任务（人类情绪识别、人类视频生成、人类语音克隆、人类视频抠像）上，以统一的零样本协议、自动指标、基于准则的平均意见评分（MOS）以及多项跨任务分析来评估多种开源和闭源模型。
AI.result: 四项关键发现：（i）当前情绪识别由语言内容主导，纯视觉情感识别最弱；（ii）视频生成和语音克隆中，自动指标与人类判断总体一致但排名上存在差异，需联合报告；（iii）运动下的边界保真度仍是人类抠像的主要障碍；（iv）任务难度随情感、模型和指标而异，且存在显著的跨任务相关性。
AI.conclusion: HUG-VIS填补了以人为中心视觉智能在统一跨模态基准上的空白，为理解和生成任务的联合评测提供了基础，揭示了当前模型在各任务中的关键瓶颈，并公开了数据集与结果以促进后续研究。

title: Subgraph Filtering for Fair Graph Neural Networks
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) can exhibit unfair behavior even when sensitive attributes are excluded from node features, because graph topology and message passing propagate group-correlated signals under sensitive homophily. Existing fairness-aware GNN methods mainly constrain representations or prediction distributions at a global level, without explicitly controlling the local structural pathways through which biased information propagates during aggregation. We propose Subgraph Filtering for Fair Graph Neural Networks (SF-GNN), a lightweight and architecture-agnostic framework that mitigates structural bias at its source. SF-GNN identifies bias-prone edges by combining sensitive homophily with structural propagation amplifiers, including hub participation and triadic closure. It then incorporates stochastic edge filtering into each message-passing step to selectively downweight or remove these edges while preserving the remaining graph structure. Training further incorporates a statistical-parity regularizer with a warm-up schedule to stabilize optimization. Experiments on five benchmark datasets show that SF-GNN achieves consistent fairness improvements while maintaining competitive predictive performance, leading to a better fairness--accuracy trade-off than recent fairness-aware GNN baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SF-GNN，一个轻量级且与架构无关的框架，通过在消息传递过程中过滤偏置边缘（由敏感同质性和结构传播放大器识别）来在源头缓解图神经网络的结构性偏差，同时结合统计奇偶性正则化器，在五个基准数据集上实现了更好的公平-准确率权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有的公平感知GNN方法主要在全局层面约束表示或预测分布，未能显式控制偏置信息在图聚合过程中传播的局部结构路径，导致在敏感同质性条件下不公平行为依然存在。
AI.method: SF-GNN首先结合敏感同质性与结构传播放大器（hub参与度和三元闭包）识别易偏置边缘；然后在每次消息传递步骤中引入随机边缘过滤，选择性降权或移除这些边缘，同时保留其余图结构；训练中还结合了带热身调度的统计奇偶性正则化器以稳定优化。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，SF-GNN在保持具有竞争力的预测性能的同时实现了一致的公平性提升，相比近期公平感知GNN基线获得了更好的公平-准确率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接在消息传递层面拦截偏置传播路径，SF-GNN提供了一种轻量且通用的结构性偏差缓解方案，展示了在源头上干预图结构传播以实现公平学习的有效性。

title: When Relationships Break: Interpreting Network Traffic Anomalies via Dependency Violations
summary: Current research on security monitoring is increasingly focusing on machine-learning-based approaches, but caveats remain. In addition to huge computational overhead, one concern is the lack of insights into "why" alerts are raised. Existing interpretability approaches rely on feature attribution methods that ignore dependencies among features or on causal modeling that requires extensive domain knowledge or computational resources. This work proposes XION, a method for modeling relationships among network-flow features based on benign traffic only. During detection, anomalies are identified through violations of expected feature dependencies. Further, XION supports post-alert analysis by identifying which feature relationships break, when they break along the attack timeline, and how dependency violations evolve relatively to other identified violations. XION is evaluated on standard IDS datasets and compared against an Isolation Forest (IF) baseline across multiple attack scenarios, including both volumetric and stealthier attacks. Results show that XION matches or exceeds IF recall in all evaluated scenarios, while requiring up to 7x less inference time. At the post-alert stage, the dependency-violation analysis reveals temporal and structural patterns consistent with known attack behaviors, which IF alone could not contribute to. Together, these findings confirm that attacks indeed disrupt feature dependencies learned from benign traffic, and that these disruptions provide additional information for understanding an alert.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XION，一种基于良性流量建模网络流特征间依赖关系的方法，通过检测特征依赖关系的违反来识别异常，并支持警报后分析以揭示哪些特征关系被破坏、何时被破坏及其演化模式。在标准IDS数据集上，XION达到或超过Isolation Forest的召回率，同时推理时间最多减少7倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于机器学习的入侵检测方法存在计算开销大、缺乏可解释性的问题。特征归因方法忽略特征间依赖关系，因果建模方法需要大量领域知识或计算资源，亟需一种兼顾效率和可解释性的异常检测方案。
AI.method: XION仅基于良性流量学习网络流特征之间的关系，在检测阶段通过特征依赖关系的违反来识别异常。同时支持警报后分析，识别破坏的特征关系、攻击时间线上破坏发生的时机，以及依赖违反相对于其他违反的演化过程。
AI.result: 在标准IDS数据集上，XION在所有攻击场景（包括容量型攻击和隐蔽性攻击）中匹配或超过Isolation Forest的召回率，推理时间最多减少7倍。警报后分析揭示的时间与结构模式与已知攻击行为一致，这是IF无法提供的。
AI.conclusion: 攻击确实会破坏从良性流量中学到的特征依赖关系，且这些破坏为理解警报提供了额外信息。XION在效率和可解释性上均有优势，是一种有效的入侵检测方法。

title: Residual Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Computed Torque Control for a Cable-Driven Lower-Limb Rehabilitation Robot under Disturbances and Parametric Uncertainties
summary: Accurate trajectory tracking in cable-driven lower-limb rehabilitation robots is challenging because model uncertainty, external disturbances, joint constraints, and pull-only cable actuation can degrade nominal control performance. Conventional model-based controllers provide an interpretable control structure but remain sensitive to model mismatch, whereas fully learning-based control can reduce transparency and complicate constraint-aware operation. This study proposes a residual deep reinforcement learning-enhanced computed torque control framework in which computed torque control generates the nominal command and a bounded Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient policy supplies only an additional compensating torque. The approach is evaluated in simulation under nominal, uncertain, disturbed, combined, and generalization conditions, together with trajectory-tracking, joint-limit, cable-demand, workspace-feasibility, and cable-Jacobian diagnostics. Across the evaluated conditions, the residual controller improves tracking and disturbance rejection relative to computed torque control while preserving the interpretable model-based command structure and satisfying the reported feasibility checks in the representative evaluation. Broader tests indicate that tracking improvements can persist beyond the representative case while also exposing trajectory-dependent constraint limitations. These results support bounded residual learning as a practical robustness-enhancement strategy for simulation-based rehabilitation robot control and motivate further constraint-aware and experimental validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种残差深度强化学习增强的计算力矩控制（CTC）框架，用于线驱下肢康复机器人的精确轨迹跟踪。CTC产生标称指令，有界DDPG策略仅提供额外补偿力矩，在仿真中验证了该方法在模型不确定、外部扰动、关节约束及纯拉线驱动等条件下的鲁棒性提升，同时保留模型基控制的可解释性。
AI.motivation: 线驱下肢康复机器人面临模型不确定性、外部扰动、关节约束及纯拉力驱动等挑战，导致精确轨迹跟踪困难。传统模型基控制器对模型失配敏感，而全学习控制降低透明性并难以处理约束。作者希望兼顾模型基控制的可解释结构与学习方法的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出残差深度强化学习增强的CTC框架：CTC生成标称控制指令，一个有界的DDPG策略仅输出附加补偿力矩，两者叠加构成最终控制信号。在仿真中设置了标称、不确定、扰动、组合及泛化共五类条件，并辅以轨迹跟踪、关节限位、缆绳需求、工作空间可行性及缆绳雅可比矩阵等诊断指标进行评估。
AI.result: 在所有评估条件下，残差控制器相比纯CTC提升了轨迹跟踪精度和扰动抑制能力，同时保持了模型基命令结构的可解释性并通过代表性评估中的可行性检验。更广泛的测试表明跟踪改进可超出代表性场景持续存在，但也暴露了与轨迹相关的约束局限性。
AI.conclusion: 有界残差学习可作为仿真基康复机器人控制的实用鲁棒性增强策略，但需进一步进行约束感知设计及实验验证。

title: GROUND: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-Based Enterprise Analytics Through Governed Semantic Definitions
summary:
Natural-language analytics over enterprise data warehouses is increasingly important, but production use is limited by hallucinated metrics, invalid joins, wrong grain, unsafe data access, and unsupported explanations. Existing text-to-SQL systems often ground generation in database schemas or retrieved documentation, while enterprise reporting also requires governed business semantics: approved metrics, dimensions, join paths, filters, and row-level security. This paper introduces GROUND, Governed Retrieval Over Unified Normalized Definitions, a framework that constrains LLM-generated analytics to a governed semantic layer. GROUND supplies approved definitions, binds user intent to governed metrics and dimensions, and validates generated SQL against schema, metric, join, grain, filter, security, and cost rules before execution. On violations, it retries or abstains.
  In a 100-question synthetic enterprise-reporting benchmark, GROUND is compared with direct schema-only text-to-SQL, schema-RAG, and semantic-only grounding under one shared model. GROUND is the only system free of measured hallucinations across all six evaluated categories, while ungoverned systems violate row-level security on many questions. A semantic-only condition with exact metric definitions but no access policy still leaks data, showing that governance cannot be replaced by metric fidelity alone. The findings are replicated on real U.S. NHTSA vehicle-safety data with independent hand-authored gold and tested on an adversarial set across four models from three providers. GROUND's enforced guarantees, especially filters and row-level security, hold with zero violations on every model, while judgment-dependent behaviors such as refusing undefined metrics remain fallible.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍GROUND框架，通过将LLM生成的文本到SQL分析约束在一个受治理的语义层中（包含已批准的指标、维度、连接路径、过滤器和行级安全），并使用多维度SQL验证与重试/弃权机制，在100题企业报表基准和真实NHTSA数据上实现零幻觉和零安全违规。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到SQL系统通常基于数据库模式或检索文档进行生成，但企业数据仓库分析还要求受治理的业务语义（已批准的指标、维度、连接路径、过滤器和行级安全）。生产环境中的自然语言分析受到幻觉指标、无效连接、错误粒度、不安全数据访问和不支持解释的限制，亟需一个约束生成过程的治理框架。
AI.method: GROUND（Governed Retrieval Over Unified Normalized Definitions）框架包含三个核心部分：1) 提供已批准定义的受治理语义层；2) 将用户意图绑定到受治理指标和维度的检索与绑定机制；3) 在执行前对生成的SQL进行模式、指标、连接、粒度、过滤、安全和成本规则的验证，违规时重试或弃权。
AI.result: 在100题合成企业报表基准上，GROUND是唯一在六类评测类别中均无测量幻觉的系统；无治理系统在多道题上违反行级安全。仅含精确指标定义但无访问策略的语义专用条件仍会泄漏数据。在真实NHTSA车辆安全数据和对抗性测试集（4个模型、3家提供商）上，GROUND的强制保证（特别是过滤器和行级安全）在所有模型上零违规，而依赖判断的行为（如拒绝未定义指标）仍然可能出错。
AI.conclusion: 治理不能仅靠指标保真度来替代——必须强制执行访问策略等安全规则。GROUND通过强制保证在安全性上取得零违规，且优于仅模式、模式+检索和仅语义接地等方法，验证了以受治理语义层约束LLM生成的企业分析是可行且必要的。

title: Data Science Approaches to Evaluating Honours Candidates
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures, corrects typographical errors from published version and includes full-colour figures
summary: We present a modular data-science pipeline for estimating public sentiment towards individuals from fragmented, unstructured open-source intelligence (OSINT). The method chains web search, text extraction, relevance filtering, tokenisation, co-reference resolution, and sentiment analysis to convert heterogeneous web material into auditable person-level sentiment distributions. We compare AFINN and VADER with MINOS, a domain-informed sentiment algorithm designed to detect language associated with reputational risk, misconduct, and positive public contribution. Applied to public figures with known reputational outcomes, MINOS gives the clearest separation between positive, ambiguous, and negative cases. The results show that chained NLP and OSINT methods can support transparent, reproducible, human-in-the-loop sentiment assessment for high-stakes decision support. We demonstrate the approach on the UK Honours system, where individuals are required to display high standards of public conduct to maintain an Honour.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一个模块化的数据科学流水线，用于从碎片化、非结构化的开源情报（OSINT）中估计公众对个体的情绪倾向，通过链式NLP方法实现透明、可复现且可人工介入的情绪评估。
AI.motivation: 传统情绪分析在面对碎片化、非结构的OSINT数据时缺乏系统性处理流程，且通用情感词典在公职人员声誉评估等高风险场景中区分度不足。需要一个可审计、模块化、可复现的流水线来支持人类决策。
AI.method: 构建一个数据科学流水线，依次链式执行网络搜索、文本抽取、相关度过滤、分词、共指消解和情感分析。对比三种情感算法：AFINN、VADER以及领域信息驱动的MINOS算法（专门检测声誉风险、不当行为和积极公共贡献相关语言），应用于英国荣誉制度下的公众人物案例。
AI.result: 在具有已知声誉结果的公众人物数据集上，MINOS算法在正、模糊、负三类案例中表现出最清晰的区分度，优于AFINN和VADER。链式NLP与OSINT方法能够支持透明、可复现、带人工介入的高风险情绪评估。
AI.conclusion: 模块化NLP流水线结合OSINT可以为高风险决策支持（如荣誉制度审查）提供可靠的情绪评估手段，其中领域定制的MINOS算法比通用情感词典更能捕捉声誉相关内容信号。

title: FAN-LoRA: A Fourier-Adaptive Nonlinear Low-Rank Adaptor for Medical Foundation Model Domain Adaptation
summary: The advent of vision foundation models, notably the Segment Anything Model (SAM), has catalyzed significant advancements in natural image segmentation. However, their direct transfer to medical imaging remains severely bottlenecked by profound domain gaps, such as cross-modality and cross-center shifts. Existing Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods facilitate the adaptation of SAM to medical domains; nevertheless, they frequently suffer from performance degradation under severe distribution shifts. This vulnerability primarily stems from the implicit entanglement of heterogeneous frequency components within a shared low-rank subspace, which directly exacerbates sub-optimal structural alignment and localized boundary blurring. To overcome this representational bottleneck, we propose the Fourier-Adaptive Nonlinear Low-Rank Adaptor (FAN-LoRA), a novel frequency-decoupled fine-tuning architecture. FAN-LoRA explicitly separates the optimization space by employing a B-spline-driven low-pass branch for global structural alignment, synergistically coupled with a discrete Fourier high-pass branch for local textural compensation. Extensive experiments across three challenging cross-modality and cross-center benchmarks demonstrate that FAN-LoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art PEFT baselines. Compared to the strongest competitors, our method achieves consistent improvements in average Dice scores and notable reductions in boundary errors, while maintaining a compact module size without compromising computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FAN-LoRA，一种频域解耦的参数高效微调架构，用于将SAM适配到医学图像分割领域，通过B样条低通分支和离散傅里叶高通分支分别处理全局结构对齐与局部纹理补偿，在跨模态和跨中心基准上超越现有PEFT方法。
AI.motivation: SAM等视觉基础模型在自然图像分割上表现优异，但直接迁移到医学影像面临严重的领域差距（跨模态、跨中心分布偏移）。现有PEFT方法在严重分布偏移下性能退化，其根本原因在于共享低秩子空间中异质频率成分的隐式纠缠，导致结构对齐欠优和边界模糊。
AI.method: 提出Fourier-Adaptive Nonlinear Low-Rank Adaptor (FAN-LoRA)，采用频域解耦的微调架构：1) B样条驱动的低通分支负责全局结构对齐；2) 离散傅里叶高通分支负责局部纹理补偿；两者协同优化，显式分离优化空间，避免异质频率成分在低秩子空间中的纠缠。
AI.result: 在三个跨模态和跨中心基准上，FAN-LoRA一致优于最先进的PEFT基线，在平均Dice分数上持续提升，边界误差显著降低，同时保持紧凑的模块尺寸和计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 频域解耦的低秩适配策略能有效缓解SAM在医学领域适配中的分布偏移问题，为医学图像分割的PEFT提供了一种兼顾精度与效率的新范式。

title: Toward Equitable Low-Carbon Mobility: Fairness-Aware Demand Prediction for Expanding Bike-Sharing Systems
summary: Bike-sharing systems are an important component of low-carbon urban mobility, but continued expansion creates challenges in both cold-start prediction and equitable resource allocation. Newly deployed stations lack historical ridership records, causing a mismatch between training and inference for graph-based models on evolving networks. Historical demand may also encode structural inequalities, as lower ridership in low-income neighborhoods can reflect limited infrastructure access rather than weak latent demand. Models trained directly on such data may therefore reinforce existing mobility disparities. We propose FairGIN, a fairness-aware graph neural network for demand prediction in expanding bike-sharing systems. FairGIN integrates three components. Expansion-Simulated Increment Training stochastically simulates network expansion during training to reduce the cold-start distribution gap. Attention-Based Knowledge Transfer combines station-adaptive temperature scaling with orthogonal embedding alignment to transfer representations from data-rich existing stations to data-sparse new stations. Fairness-Aware Optimization introduces income-stratified regularization and an equity-calibrated deployment score to support more inclusive station placement. Experiments on NYC and Seattle demonstrate that FairGIN achieves state-of-the-art predictive accuracy across diverse expansion scenarios while substantially reducing income-based disparities without compromising overall system efficiency.

AI.tldr: FairGIN是一个面向扩展中共享单车系统的公平感知图神经网络，用于需求预测。它通过扩展模拟增量训练、基于注意力的知识迁移和公平感知优化三个组件，同时解决冷启动预测和收入不平等问题，在纽约和西雅图数据集上实现了最先进的预测精度并显著降低了收入差距。
AI.motivation: 共享单车系统持续扩张带来两个核心挑战：新部署站点缺乏历史数据导致的冷启动问题使图模型的训练与推理分布不匹配；历史需求数据可能编码结构性不平等（低收入社区较低骑行量反映基础设施不足而非真实需求疲软），直接训练会加剧现有出行不公平。
AI.method: FairGIN包含三个组件：1) Expansion-Simulated Increment Training：训练时随机模拟网络扩张以缩小冷启动分布差距；2) Attention-Based Knowledge Transfer：结合站点自适应温度缩放和正交嵌入对齐，将数据丰富的现有站点表示迁移到数据稀疏的新站点；3) Fairness-Aware Optimization：引入收入分层正则化和公平校准部署评分以支持更具包容性的站点布局。
AI.result: 在纽约和西雅图数据集上的实验表明，FairGIN在多种扩张场景下达到了最先进的预测精度，同时在不大幅牺牲整体系统效率的前提下显著降低了基于收入的差异。
AI.conclusion: FairGIN证明了预测性能与公平性可以兼顾：通过模拟扩张训练缩小冷启动分布差距、跨站点知识迁移提升新站预测能力、以及公平感知优化减少收入分层差异，为共享单车系统的可持续发展提供了可落地的技术方案。

title: Are We Shooting Flies with Cannons? Trade-off Analysis for AI-based 5G Intrusion Detection
comment: This paper was accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Measurement in Networking and Communications and will appear in the conference proceedings soon
summary: The increasing adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in network intrusion detection raises the question of whether complex and computationally expensive models are justified for this task. In this work, we investigate the trade-off between detection performance and computational cost for intrusion detection in 5G network telemetry. We compare traditional machine learning (ML) models, including XGBoost as a representative of tree ensemble, and TabNet for tabular deep neural network (DNN), with a large language model (LLM) used as a general-purpose intrusion detector. The LLM is evaluated under both zero-shot and few-shot prompting configurations. We evaluate the models in terms of detection performance, inference time, and CPU time as a proxy for energy efficiency. Using a relatively large available 5G dataset, we show that traditional ML models consistently achieve near-perfect detection performance with negligible inference time, while LLM-based approaches perform significantly worse and incur orders-of-magnitude higher CPU usage. Few-shot prompting improves recall, but at the cost of lower accuracy and further increased CPU time, without closing the performance gap. These findings indicate that, for tabular intrusion detection in 5G networks, XGBoost offers a substantially better performance-cost trade-off than DNNs and LLMs, highlighting the importance of selecting models based on task suitability rather than increasing complexity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了5G网络遥测中入侵检测的性能与计算成本之间的权衡，对比了XGBoost、TabNet和LLM（零样本/少样本）三类模型，发现传统ML模型（尤其是XGBoost）在检测性能和计算效率上均显著优于DNN和LLM。
AI.motivation: 随着AI在网络入侵检测中的广泛应用，一个核心疑问浮现：复杂且计算昂贵的模型（如LLM）是否真的优于传统机器学习模型？本文旨在系统评估不同复杂度模型在5G网络入侵检测任务中的性能-成本权衡，以指导模型选择。
AI.method: 在5G数据集上对比三类模型：XGBoost（树集成代表）、TabNet（表格DNN代表）以及作为通用入侵检测器的LLM（在零样本和少样本提示配置下评估）。评估指标包括检测性能、推理时间和CPU时间（作为能效代理）。
AI.result: 传统ML模型（XGBoost）在检测性能上接近完美，推理时间可忽略不计；LLM方法性能显著较差，且CPU使用量高出数个数量级。少样本提示虽提升了召回率，但以降低准确率和进一步增加CPU时间为代价，且未弥合性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 对于5G网络中的表格型入侵检测任务，XGBoost提供了显著优于DNN和LLM的性能-成本权衡，凸显了根据任务适配性而非模型复杂度来选择模型的重要性。

title: MeshPriorDiT: Hierarchical Modeling for Action-Conditioned Cloth Dynamics
summary: Action-conditioned cloth dynamics prediction requires both locally plausible deformation and long-range coordination. Existing approaches largely follow two paradigms. Mesh-based GNNs capture local physical responses through material connectivity. However, their finite message-passing range limits coordination between topologically distant regions, while autoregressive rollouts tend to accumulate prediction errors. Transformer-based dynamics models capture long-range interactions through global attention, but often operate without explicit material connectivity and must learn local topological responses directly from data. We propose MeshPriorDiT, a hierarchical dynamics model that decomposes future cloth motion into a structured mesh prior and a generative residual. An action-conditioned mesh GNN first predicts multi-step vertex displacements, yielding a reference trajectory that respects material topology and grasp constraints. Conditioned on historical states, planned actions, and the mesh prior, a Residual DiT then uses conditional flow matching to jointly generate the residual motion not captured by the prior. The generated residual is further rescaled and decoded using material adjacency to coordinate corrections across neighboring vertices. We evaluate MeshPriorDiT on 15-step autoregressive rollouts across three cloth manipulation tasks. Averaged over the three tasks, MeshPriorDiT reduces average Global MSE by 43.42% relative to the GNN-Only baseline and by 75.03% relative to the DiT-DDPM baseline, while maintaining a favorable Edge-strain MSE comparable to that of GNN-Only.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MeshPriorDiT，一种将结构化网格先验与生成式残差结合的分层布料动力学预测模型，通过动作条件的网格GNN生成参考轨迹，再以条件流匹配的Residual DiT生成残差运动，在三个布料操作任务的15步自回归推演中显著降低全局MSE。
AI.motivation: 现有布料动力学预测方法存在两种范式缺陷：网格GNN能捕捉局部物理响应但受限于消息传递范围，难以协调拓扑远距离区域，且自回归推演易累积误差；基于Transformer的动力学模型虽能捕获长程交互，但缺乏显式材质连通性，需从数据中学习局部拓扑响应。两者均未同时兼顾局部形变合理性与长程协调。
AI.method: MeshPriorDiT采用分层架构：首先由动作条件的网格GNN预测多步顶点位移，生成遵循材质拓扑和抓取约束的参考轨迹（mesh prior）；然后基于历史状态、规划动作和网格先验，用Residual DiT通过条件流匹配联合生成先验未捕捉的残差运动；最后利用材质邻接关系对生成的残差进行重缩放和解码，协调相邻顶点的修正。
AI.result: 在三个布料操作任务的15步自回归推演中，MeshPriorDiT相比GNN-Only基线平均降低全局MSE 43.42%，相比DiT-DDPM基线降低75.03%，同时保持了与GNN-Only相当的边缘应变MSE。
AI.conclusion: MeshPriorDiT有效融合了网格先验的局部物理合理性与生成式Transformer残差的全局协调能力，验证了"结构化先验+生成式残差"的分层策略在布料动力学预测中的优越性，为长程、多步布料操作预测提供了新思路。

title: SAREF-based Ontology for Distributed AI Workflows across the Edge-Fog-Cloud Continuum
summary: Nowadays semantic models provide limited support for representing distributed AI workflows and their execution across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. Therefore, AI processes and resources are often described using incompatible semantic representations, affecting the interoperability, orchestration, and reuse. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a SAREF-compliant ontology for representing distributed AI workflows across the edge-fog-cloud continuum. We extend the SAREF4SYST ontology with concepts for modeling AI pipelines, executable AI jobs, computational resources, deployment constraints, and communication relationships, providing a unified semantic model of both AI workflows and heterogeneous computing infrastructures. The ontology enables semantic interoperability, automated reasoning, and resource-aware orchestration of distributed AI applications while remaining fully aligned with the ETSI SAREF ecosystem. The ontology is evaluated using proof-of-concept smart grid energy services orchestration scenarios and validated using competency questions showing its ability to support AI workflow deployment, execution reasoning, and workload adaptation across heterogeneous edge, fog, and cloud environments. All competency questions were successfully validated using SPARQL querying and semantic reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate deployment success rates of 90-100% with average orchestration decision times below 80 ms across heterogeneous edge-fog-cloud environments, highlighting its effectiveness on ensuring semantic interoperability for distributed AI orchestration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种符合SAREF标准的本体（ontology），用于表示跨边缘-雾-云计算连续体的分布式AI工作流。通过扩展SAREF4SYST本体，引入AI管道、可执行AI作业、计算资源、部署约束和通信关系等概念，实现对AI工作流与异构计算基础设施的统一语义建模，支持语义互操作性、自动推理和资源感知的AI应用编排。
AI.motivation: 现有语义模型对分布式AI工作流及其跨异构边缘、雾和云环境的执行支持有限，导致AI过程和资源常以不兼容的语义表示，影响互操作性、编排和复用。
AI.method: 扩展SAREF4SYST本体，新增AI管道（AI pipelines）、可执行AI作业（executable AI jobs）、计算资源（computational resources）、部署约束（deployment constraints）和通信关系（communication relationships）等核心概念，构建与ETSI SAREF生态系统完全对齐的统一语义模型。
AI.result: 通过智能电网能源服务编排的概念验证场景和基于能力问题（competency questions）的验证，所有能力问题均通过SPARQL查询和语义推理成功验证。实验结果显示部署成功率达90-100%，平均编排决策时间低于80毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 该本体有效支持分布式AI工作流的部署、执行推理和跨异构边缘-雾-云环境的工作负载自适应，验证了其在确保分布式AI编排语义互操作性方面的有效性。

title: Reward-Informed Sparse Autoencoders and the Solution-Completeness Confound
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose language-model activations into sparse, interpretable features, and an appealing way to aim them at reasoning is to curate their data with a signal reinforcement learning already produces: the reward. We build such a reward-informed SAE (RI-SAE): we split GRPO trajectories into high-reward ("good") and low-reward ("bad") reasoning continuations, train a standard JumpReLU SAE on their activations, and then ask what the resulting good/bad separation actually measures. On Llama-3.1-8B a sparse subset of the 16,384 features does separate the classes (silhouette 0.79 on the selected features versus 0.005 for the full code), but a control battery shows the separation is largely solution completeness rather than reasoning quality: a TF-IDF text classifier already splits the classes (AUC 0.75--0.83), and three structural cues alone (length, a closed reasoning block, and a boxed answer) reach AUC 0.70 (99% of good versus 69% of bad completions are boxed). A generic SAE that never saw the reward does not separate the classes at all (silhouette 0.01, no discriminative features), so the 0.79 is in-sample fitting of this curated signal rather than structure that a reward-blind dictionary recovers. We therefore present the recipe and its control battery together: reward filtering is a cheap, label-free way to reuse RL signals for interpretability, but most of what it surfaces is completion form. Two discriminative features are still readable (symbolic mathematics; procedural and evaluative language), which we take as illustrative rather than as isolated reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了"奖励感知稀疏自编码器"(RI-SAE)，利用GRPO轨迹中的奖励信号将推理轨迹分为高低奖励两类并训练JumpReLU SAE，以探索SAE能否通过奖励信号分离出推理质量特征。在Llama-3.1-8B上，稀疏子集确实能分离两类(silhouette 0.79)，但对照实验表明这种分离主要反映的是"答案完整性"而非"推理质量"——TF-IDF文本分类器同样能分类(AUC 0.75-0.83)，三个结构线索(长度、封闭推理块、框选答案)可达AUC 0.70。未接触奖励的通用SAE完全无法分离(0.01 silhouette)，说明0.79只是对受控信号的样本内拟合。最终结论：奖励过滤是廉价的、无需标注的复用RL信号做可解释性的途径，但大多数表面特征只是完形形式，仅两个判别特征(符号数学、程序性与评价性语言)可读。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器(SAE)能将语言模型激活分解为稀疏可解释特征，但如何让SAE聚焦于推理能力是一大挑战。作者提出一个诱人思路：用强化学习(RL)已经产生的奖励信号来对SAE的训练数据进行筛选，从而引导SAE"瞄准"推理相关的特征。这种方法无需额外标注，成本低廉，值得验证其有效性。
AI.method: 作者构建了奖励感知SAE(RI-SAE)：(1) 将GRPO轨迹按奖励分为高奖励和低奖励推理延续；(2) 在它们激活上训练标准JumpReLU SAE；(3) 用silhouette指数评估所选特征对好/坏类别的分离能力；(4) 设计对照实验组(control battery)，包括TF-IDF文本分类器(AUC)、三类结构线索(长度、封闭推理块、框选答案)分类，以及与从未接触奖励的通用SAE对比。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B上，16,384个特征中的稀疏子集能分离好/坏类别(silhouette 0.79，而全编码仅0.005)。但对照显示分离主要是"解答完整性"而非推理质量：TF-IDF分类器AUC达0.75-0.83；仅三个结构线索就能达到AUC 0.70(99%的好完成带框选答案vs 69%的坏完成)。未见过奖励的通用SAE完全无法分离(silhouette 0.01，无判别特征)。仅两个判别特征可读：符号数学、程序性/评价性语言。
AI.conclusion: 论文认为：奖励过滤是廉价、无标注地复用RL信号进行可解释性研究的可行配方，但需配合对照实验组来检验。当前结果中大部分"分离"实际上捕捉的是输出形式(长解答、有框、封闭推理块)而非深层推理质量。作者将方法配方与对照实验一并呈现，作为后续研究的参考框架。

title: Visual Information-Guided Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Diffusion multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) have recently emerged as a new decoding paradigm for multimodal generation. Starting from a fully masked sequence, dMLLMs progressively decode the sequence by unmasking a subset of the remaining masked positions at each step. Since the selected tokens serve as the prediction context for subsequent steps, deciding which tokens to decode is crucial to the quality of the final output. The most common strategy prioritizes tokens based on a certainty measure that tends to favor tokens frequently observed in the training data. Recent approaches instead order tokens according to their influence on subsequent predictions, but do not explicitly account for the input image. We propose the Visual Information-Guided Sampler (VIG-Sampler), which prioritizes tokens based on their attention to image tokens. We further impose a constraint that penalizes candidate tokens whose image-attention distributions are similar to those of previously selected tokens, thereby increasing the information gain of the decoded subset. Extensive experiments on 7 captioning and VQA benchmarks with 3 open-source dMLLMs demonstrate the effectiveness of VIG-Sampler, which outperforms the Info-Gain Sampler by an average of 19.3 CIDEr points across the captioning benchmarks and surpasses it on COCO Caption while using only half as many decoding steps.

AI.tldr: 提出VIG-Sampler，一种基于视觉信息引导的解码排序采样器，通过优先选择对图像token注意力高的token并惩罚与已选token图像注意力分布相似的候选token，提升dMLLM生成质量，在7个基准上平均比Info-Gain Sampler高19.3 CIDEr点。
AI.motivation: 扩散多模态大语言模型（dMLLM）逐步解掩码解码时，已选token作为后续预测的上下文，因此解码token的顺序对最终生成质量至关重要。现有策略要么基于确定性度量偏向训练数据中的高频token，要么按对后续预测的影响力排序但未显式考虑输入图像，缺乏视觉信息引导。
AI.method: 提出Visual Information-Guided Sampler（VIG-Sampler）：1) 根据候选token对图像token的注意力对token进行优先级排序；2) 增加约束，惩罚那些与已选token图像注意力分布相似的候选token，以提高解码子集的信息增益。
AI.result: 在7个图像描述（captioning）和视觉问答（VQA）基准上，使用3个开源dMLLM验证了VIG-Sampler的有效性。在captioning基准上平均比Info-Gain Sampler高19.3 CIDEr点，在COCO Caption上仅用一半解码步数即超过该基线。
AI.conclusion: VIG-Sampler通过显式引入图像注意力信息作为token排序的引导信号，并结合信息增益多样性约束，有效提升dMLLM的生成质量，且具备更高的解码效率。

title: Information Flow Control in Off-Chain Components
summary: This paper develops a model of a smart-contract language for a blockchain architecture with off-chain components. Off-chain components are pieces of smart contracts that execute at designated locations outside of the network of blockchain nodes, but remain synchronised with the on-chain contract state. They react to changes to the on-chain state, but may also notify the on-chain component about events in the world, e.g. stock prices, weather data etc., or even act as a bridge between different blockchains. This affords greater flexibility for the developer, but may also enable new vulnerabilities. As a concrete example, we use the model to study the problem of ensuring integrity and secrecy of data between the on-chain and off-chain components, using static information flow control techniques. This fails, even in the absence of a loop construct, because off-chain components act as separate threads and can encode a blocking construct e.g. through recursive method calls. We end the paper with a discussion of possible ways to remedy this situation.

AI.tldr: 本文为区块链架构中的链下组件（off-chain components）开发了一个智能合约语言模型。链下组件在网络外执行但仍与链上状态同步，可响应链上变化并传递外部世界事件。模型用于研究链上与链下组件之间的数据完整性和保密性问题，发现即使没有循环结构，静态信息流控制技术仍会失败，因为链下组件作为独立线程可通过递归方法调用编码阻塞结构。文章最后讨论了可能的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 区块链智能合约通常局限于链上执行，缺乏与外部世界交互的能力。链下组件提供了更大的灵活性（如访问外部数据、跨链桥接），但同时也可能引入新的安全漏洞。作者希望通过形式化建模来研究链上-链下组件间的数据完整性和保密性保障问题。
AI.method: 作者形式化构建了一个包含链上与链下组件的智能合约语言模型，并应用静态信息流控制（Static Information Flow Control）技术来验证数据完整性与保密性属性。模型将链下组件视为独立线程，分析了它们在无循环构造情况下如何通过递归方法调用实现阻塞编码。
AI.result: 研究发现，即使在缺少循环构造的语言中，静态信息流控制也无法保证链上与链下组件间的数据完整性和保密性。根本原因是链下组件作为独立线程执行，可以通过递归方法调用来编码阻塞结构，从而绕过信息流控制的静态分析约束。
AI.conclusion: 现有静态信息流控制技术不足以应对链上-链下混合架构的安全需求。文章建议需要新的方法来解决这一问题，并讨论了若干可能的补救途径，为后续在区块链混合架构中设计安全智能合约语言提供了研究方向。

title: Online Joint Calibration of Steering Offset and Planar LiDAR Extrinsics for Wheeled Mobile Robots
summary: Accurate steering sensing and LiDAR-to-vehicle extrinsics are crucial for reliable path tracking in warehouse mobile robots (WMRs); miscalibration often leads to snaking, weaving, and elevated cross-track error (CTE). In practice, steering ``zero'' is commonly set manually (e.g., eyeballing straightness via a PS4 joystick), while LiDAR extrinsics are assumed from CAD and may drift after maintenance. Such static, manual procedures frequently cause miscalibration in safety-critical environments. This paper presents an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF)--based method for online estimation of steering offset and planar LiDAR extrinsics within a bicycle-kinematics model, providing a principled alternative to manual calibration. Experiments on real datasets show that correcting steering offset reduces CTE substantially, validating the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）的在线估计方法，在自行车运动学模型框架下同时估计仓库移动机器人的转向偏移和平面LiDAR外参数，替代传统手动标定方法，实验证明可显著降低横向误差（CTE）。
AI.motivation: 仓库移动机器人（WMR）的路径跟踪依赖精确的转向传感和LiDAR-车辆外参标定，但传统的静态手动标定（如通过手柄目测直线度、从CAD假设外参）容易产生失准，导致蛇形行驶、摆动和横向误差增大，在安全关键环境中存在隐患。
AI.method: 基于扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF），在自行车运动学模型内对转向偏移角和平面LiDAR外参数进行联合在线估计，提供一种替代手动标定的原理性方案。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，校正转向偏移能够大幅降低横向误差（CTE），验证了所提方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该EKF在线标定方法可有效替代手动标定流程，提升仓库移动机器人在安全关键环境中的路径跟踪性能和可靠性。

title: A Safety-Gated Multimodal AI Backend for Mental-Health Support: Hierarchical State Representation, Conservative Risk Fusion, and Controlled Generation in Anian
summary: Safety-critical mental-health support systems must distinguish when supportive conversation is appropriate from when free-form generation should be blocked. This paper presents Anian, a safety-gated multimodal AI backend for perinatal mental-health support and mindfulness-intervention routing. Anian is not intended to diagnose psychiatric conditions or replace clinical care or crisis intervention. Its modular pipeline places generative AI downstream of structured state representation, conservative risk fusion, and response gating. User text or voice-derived ASR transcripts are mapped into four linked layers: L1 emotion states, L2 psychosocial constructs, L3 safety risk, and L4 intervention routes. Local text- and rule-based safety evidence is fused with external voice-derived evidence using a highest-risk-priority rule, S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external). At moderate or high fused risk, ordinary AI-generated responses and text-to-speech delivery are blocked and replaced by fixed safety content and prompts for human support. An internal prototype evaluation used approximately 858,295 normalized records from public emotion, dialogue, mental-health-related, and Chinese dialogue corpora within a weak-label and rule-derived framework. Micro-F1 scores were 0.9604 for L1 emotion classification, 0.9144 for L2 psychosocial constructs, and 0.9742 for L4 routing. In a controlled safety stress test of 233 samples, the L3 rule engine achieved high-risk recall of 1.0000 within predefined scenarios. These findings support the internal feasibility of the label framework and gating logic but do not establish clinical validity, diagnostic accuracy, real-world safety, or effectiveness. We report the architecture, ontology, safety-fusion mechanism, prototype evaluation, error-analysis plan, and roadmap for expert-reviewed and real-world validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Anian，一个安全门控的多模态AI后端系统，用于围产期心理健康支持和正念干预路由。系统通过结构化状态表示、保守风险融合和响应门控的模块化流水线，将生成式AI置于安全管控之下。在内部原型评估中，各层分类F1分数达0.91-0.97，高风险召回率达1.0，但作者明确声明该结果仅支持内部可行性，不构成临床有效性证据。
AI.motivation: 安全关键的心理健康支持系统必须能够区分何时适合进行支持性对话、何时应阻止自由文本生成，以避免对用户造成潜在伤害。现有系统缺乏将生成式AI置于安全门控之后的系统性设计。
AI.method: Anian采用模块化流水线：将用户文本或ASR转录映射为四层结构（L1情绪状态、L2心理社会构念、L3安全风险、L4干预路由）；融合本地文本/规则证据与外部语音证据，采用最高风险优先规则S_fusion = max(S_local, S_external)；中高风险时阻止常规AI生成和TTS输出，替换为固定安全内容和人工支持提示。
AI.result: 基于约858,295条来自公共情绪、对话、心理健康及中文对话语料的规范化记录进行弱标签和规则驱动评估，L1情绪分类Micro-F1为0.9604，L2心理社会构念为0.9144，L4路由为0.9742；233个样本的安全压力测试中L3规则引擎场景内高风险召回率为1.0000。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明标签框架和门控逻辑在内部具备可行性，但尚不能确立临床有效性、诊断准确性、真实世界安全性或效果。后续需进行专家评审和真实世界验证。

title: Interpretable, Fairly Evaluated Automated L2 Speaking Assessment that Beats the Single-Human Ceiling and Why Pause Encoding Does Not Change LLM Fluency Scores
summary: Second-language (L2) English learners can rarely rehearse speaking with a partner. Speaking is also the most anxiety-laden skill. These gaps drive a fast-growing market for automated speaking practice and scoring. But an automated score is trustworthy only if it is accurate, interpretable, fair, and benchmarked against the right human bar. We build an interpretable feature-plus-LLM hybrid for spontaneous L2 dialogue. We evaluate it without ever fitting to the human labels, against the ICNALE Global Rating Archive: 140 speeches rated by ~80 trained raters on 10 analytic criteria. We score the 130 L2 speeches with usable audio. A deterministic De-Jong speech-timing composite reaches rho=0.764. Blended with a single text-LLM fluency judgment, it reaches Spearman rho=0.818 against the consensus gold. This agrees with the consensus better than 81% of the 80 individual trained raters: above the median rater (rho=0.73) and near the best, and at ~83% of the reliability-corrected maximum (kappa_max=0.99). The blend improves on the composite alone by +0.054 (paired-bootstrap 95% CI [0.017, 0.108], excludes 0); the LLM adds a coarse fluency ranking that the continuous composite refines. We also report a controlled null on pause encoding, bounded to effects below about +/-0.1 rho at this sample size. Holding the LLM and learner words fixed and varying only how pauses are written into the prompt, inline pause locations do not beat aggregate pause statistics (-0.069, CI [-0.15, +0.08]), and a grounded mid-clause criterion gives no reliable gain. The fluency signal comes from the measured speech-timing features, not from how pauses are written for the LLM. We back every claim with two agreeing learner-isolation methods, paired-bootstrap CIs, a monologue negative control, per-feature reproduction of classical measurements, and a per-L1 fairness audit.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个可解释的特征+LLM混合系统，用于自动评估二语学习者的自发性口语对话。系统在ICNALE Global Rating Archive基准上（140段语音，约80名训练评分者，10项分析标准）无需拟合人工标签即达到Spearman rho=0.818的得分，优于81%的个体评分者，接近最优评分者水平，约为信度修正最大值的83%。
AI.motivation: 二语英语学习者难以获得与真人伴侣练习口语的机会，且口语是最易引发焦虑的技能。这推动了自动化口语练习与评分市场的快速增长，但自动化评分只有在准确、可解释、公平且对标正确人类基准时才值得信赖。现有系统缺乏在不拟合人工标签的情况下进行严格评估的实证。
AI.method: 构建可解释的特征加LLM混合模型：采用确定性的De-Jong语音时序复合特征（speech-timing composite），并将其与单个文本LLM流畅度判断进行融合。评估策略包括：不拟合人工标签的零样本评估、两种一致的学习者隔离方法、配对bootstrap置信区间、独白负对照、逐特征复现经典测量、逐L1母语公平性审计，以及对停顿编码方式的受控消融实验（比较内联停顿位置与聚合停顿统计在prompt中的呈现效果）。
AI.result: 确定性De-Jong语音时序复合特征达到rho=0.764；与单个文本LLM流畅度判断融合后达到rho=0.818，优于81%的80名个体训练评分者（中位评分者rho=0.73），接近最优评分者。融合相对复合特征单独提升+0.054（95% CI [0.017, 0.108]）。对停顿编码的受控消融显示：内联停顿位置不优于聚合停顿统计（-0.069，CI [-0.15, +0.08]），流畅度信号来自实测的语音时序特征而非停顿在prompt中的书写方式。
AI.conclusion: 可解释的特征+LLM混合方法在零拟合条件下即可达到接近最优人类评分者的水准，验证了该范式的可行性；同时表明流畅度信号主要来源于可测量的语音时序特征，LLM提供粗粒度的流畅度排序而连续语音特征负责精化，且需严格的多维度验证（公平性审计、负对照、置信区间）来支撑评估可信度。

title: DPA-I2P: Depth-Guided Projective Alignment for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration in Autonomous Driving
summary: Image-to-Point Cloud Registration aims to estimate the camera pose of a given image within a 3D scene point cloud, which is a fundamental task in autonomous driving and large-scale outdoor localization. Recent implicit correspondence learning methods have improved registration performance by learning cross-modal alignment in an end-to-end framework, leading to more accurate camera pose estimation. However, due to the inherent modality discrepancy between images and sparse LiDAR point clouds, reliable cross-modal correspondence learning remains challenging. To address this issue, we propose Depth-Guided Projective Alignment for Image-to-Point-Cloud Registration (DPA-I2P). Unlike naive depth or feature concatenation, Ray-Conditioned Metric Depth Encoding (RMDE) and Projection-Consistent Vision Lifting (PVL) exploit depth and visual cues in a structured, geometry-aware manner. In addition, Cross-Modal Query Pruning (CQP) suppresses unreliable queries during early refinement to improve matching stability. Experiments on KITTI and nuScenes demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method. On KITTI, DPA-I2P reduces RTE and RRE by 45.0% and 55.6% over the strongest implicit baseline, respectively. On nuScenes, DPA-I2P also improves registration accuracy over the evaluated baselines, suggesting better transferability to different driving scenes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DPA-I2P，一种利用深度引导的投影对齐方法来解决图像与点云跨模态配准问题，通过射线条件度量深度编码（RMDE）、投影一致视觉抬升（PVL）和跨模态查询剪枝（CQP）三个模块增强跨模态对应关系学习，在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上显著提升了相机位姿估计精度。
AI.motivation: 图像到点云配准是自动驾驶和户外定位中的基础任务。尽管隐式对应学习方法通过端到端框架提升了配准性能，但图像与稀疏LiDAR点云之间的固有模态差异使得可靠的跨模态对应学习仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出DPA-I2P框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 射线条件度量深度编码（RMDE）以结构化和几何感知的方式编码深度信息；2) 投影一致视觉抬升（PVL）利用视觉线索进行几何感知的跨模态对齐；3) 跨模态查询剪枝（CQP）在早期细化阶段抑制不可靠查询以提升匹配稳定性。这些模块区别于简单的深度或特征拼接方式。
AI.result: 在KITTI数据集上，DPA-I2P相比最强隐式基线将RTE（旋转平移误差）降低45.0%，RRE（旋转旋转误差）降低55.6%；在nuScenes数据集上也优于所评估的基线方法，展现出对不同驾驶场景的良好泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: DPA-I2P通过结构化和几何感知的深度与视觉线索利用方式，有效解决了图像与点云之间的模态差异问题，在多个自动驾驶数据集上取得了显著优于现有隐式基线的配准精度，并表现出较好的跨场景迁移性。

title: Diff Mining: Logit Differences Reveal Finetuning Objectives
comment: 37 pages, 7 figures. ICLR 2026 Workshop: Principled Design for Trustworthy AI. Code available at https://github.com/science-of-finetuning/diffing-toolkit
summary: Finetuning has become the gold standard for refining existing behaviors and inducing new ones in language models, yet it often remains unclear exactly which behaviors emerge during this process. As models grow ever more capable, understanding finetuning better becomes increasingly important, particularly since unwanted behaviors may arise during finetuning. In this paper, we introduce Diff Mining, a simple yet effective framework for identifying what a finetuned model has learned by comparing its logits to those of its base model. Diff Mining effectively surfaces salient tokens that are amplified in the finetuned model, serving as a fingerprint of its training -- even on text unrelated to the finetuning domain. Unlike many existing model diffing methods which require model internals, Diff Mining only needs access to output logits and scales to large models. The framework consists of two modular stages: (i) extracting per-context logit differences between the finetuned and base models on a reference corpus, and (ii) aggregating the resulting signals to construct an interpretable token set representing the finetune. For aggregation, we explore both a simple Top-K frequency method and a Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF)-based approach for disentangling multiple finetuning objectives into distinct token clusters. Empirically, Diff Mining succeeds across diverse settings: on finetune domain detection, it significantly outperforms state-of-the-art model diffing methods both in identifying relevant tokens and in downstream performance when an interpretability agent is given access to the extracted token set; on models with injected biases, it identifies more than one third of the biases without targeted probing. Overall, our framework shows promise in developing auditing tools to detect finetuning objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diff Mining框架，通过比较微调模型与基础模型的输出logits来识别微调过程中模型学到的新行为。该方法仅需访问输出logits，可扩展到大规模模型，在微调领域检测、偏见识别等多个场景中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 微调是修改语言模型行为的标准方法，但微调后模型究竟学到了什么行为仍然不清楚。随着模型能力增强，理解微调过程变得日益重要，特别是微调过程中可能出现不良行为。现有模型差异比较方法大多需要访问模型内部结构，限制了其适用性和可扩展性。
AI.method: Diff Mining包含两个模块化阶段：（1）在参考语料上提取微调模型与基础模型之间的逐上下文logit差异；（2）聚合这些信号构建可解释的token集合来表征微调内容。聚合阶段探索了两种方法：简单的Top-K频率法，以及基于非负矩阵分解（NMF）的方法，用于将多个微调目标分离为不同的token聚类。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Diff Mining在微调领域检测任务上显著优于现有最先进的模型差异比较方法，无论是识别相关token还是在下游表现上均更优；在注入偏见的模型中，无需针对性探测即可识别出超过三分之一的偏见。
AI.conclusion: Diff Mining证明了一个简单有效的框架——仅通过比较输出logits就能识别微调模型的训练指纹，在开发用于检测微调目标的审计工具方面展现出良好前景，并且无需访问模型内部结构即可扩展到大规模模型。

title: SysComb: Fine-Grained Transparent System Call Filtering for Attack Surface Reduction
summary: Restricting the system calls available to applications shrinks the kernel's attack surface and greatly mitigates the impact of compromised programs. Recent approaches showcase techniques to generate system call filters, however, all existing solutions require either kernel or application modifications to activate them at runtime. This is intrusive, error-prone, and often impractical, especially when the code is maintained by external parties. This paper presents SysComb, a novel eBPF-based solution to enforce temporally-specialized system call filters based on the application state, without requiring any modification to the application or the kernel code, and thus addressing the above limitations. Moreover, SysComb lets the developer choose between two distinct enforcement strategies: seccomp-like, ensuring no new privileges are gained after a state transition is performed, and least-privilege, which applies to each state the most restrictive filter. We evaluated SysComb using widely used software, showcasing accurate state-aware system call filtering and an overhead comparable to built-in kernel solutions, demonstrating the practicality of our approach.

AI.tldr: SysComb是一个基于eBPF的新型系统调用过滤方案，能够在无需修改应用程序或内核代码的情况下，根据应用程序状态实施时间特化的系统调用过滤器，提供seccomp-like和least-privilege两种强制策略。
AI.motivation: 限制系统调用可以缩小内核攻击面并缓解程序被攻破的影响，但现有系统调用过滤器生成技术都需要修改内核或应用程序代码才能在运行时激活，这种侵入式方法容易出错且在实际中（尤其是涉及外部维护代码时）往往不可行。
AI.method: SysComb利用eBPF实现基于应用状态的时间特化系统调用过滤。它无需修改应用或内核代码即可在运行时强制实施，并提供两种策略：seccomp-like策略确保状态转换后不获取新权限；least-privilege策略对每个状态应用最严格的过滤器。
AI.result: 在广泛使用的软件上评估显示，SysComb能够实现准确的状态感知系统调用过滤，性能开销与内核内置解决方案相当，证明了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: SysComb通过eBPF实现了非侵入式的、状态感知的系统调用过滤机制，克服了现有方案的局限性，为系统调用过滤提供了一种实用且高效的替代方案。

title: Rapid On-Robot Learning for Dynamic Manipulation Skills: Robot Juggling
summary: We present an online learning framework that enables a bimanual robot to acquire diverse juggling patterns directly on physical hardware within minutes, even with a significant sim2real gap. One of the most important lessons from this work is that a model, even when far from reality, can be extremely useful for learning. This motivates a central philosophy of our approach: learning should build upon the robot's current knowledge rather than replace it. Our regularized memory-based learning puts this principle into practice by learning a local model from accumulated experience while retaining the global prior model to extrapolate where experience is sparse. This enables efficient and stable online learning from each new experience without resorting to uninformed exploration over a vast space of possible behaviors. Equally important to continual on-robot learning is safety, allowing the robot to repeatedly practice and improve in the real world. We construct a mutually reachable set that allows safe transitions between successive throws and catches, without driving either arm into a state from which its next action would require violating the robot's joint or actuator limits. Together, these ideas enable a bimanual robot with multi-fingered hands and onboard vision to safely learn and compose five canonical three-ball juggling patterns, including cascade, tennis, half-shower, shower, and box, within less than 5 minutes of real-world interaction. More broadly, this work points toward robots that build upon imperfect prior knowledge and continually refine their behavior through their own real-world experience.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个在线学习框架，使双臂机器人能在不到5分钟的真实世界交互中直接习得多样的三球杂耍模式。核心思想是：即使模型与真实差距显著，它仍可极有价值地服务于学习——学习应建立在机器人当前知识之上而非替代它。通过正则化记忆学习保留全局先验模型用于外推、同时从积累经验中学习局部模型，并辅以互可达集合保证安全性，实现了高效、稳定的在线学习和安全实践。
AI.motivation: 如何在存在显著sim2real差距的情况下，让机器人直接在物理硬件上快速学习复杂运动技能（如双臂杂耍），同时保证学习过程中的安全性，避免无效探索并实现持续改进。
AI.method: 1) 正则化记忆学习（Regularized Memory-based Learning）：从积累经验中学习局部模型，同时保留全局先验模型用于经验稀疏区域的外推；2) 互可达集合（Mutually Reachable Set）：构建保证连续投掷-接球之间安全状态转换的集合，避免任一手臂状态违反关节或执行器限制；3) 在线学习框架结合局部模型与全局先验，实现每次新经验的高效稳定学习，无需在庞大行为空间中无指导地探索。
AI.result: 双臂多指手机器人配合机载视觉，在不到5分钟的真实世界交互内，安全地学习并组合了五种经典三球杂耍模式：cascade（叠抛）、tennis（网球）、half-shower（半淋浴）、shower（淋浴）和box（盒子），且全程安全无事故发生。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作证明了即使先验模型与真实环境存在显著差距，它依然可以极大地促进学习效率。核心哲学是学习应不断精炼而非取代机器人的现有知识，通过局部经验学习与全局先验外推的结合，机器人能够在真实世界中安全、高效地持续改进行为。这为机器人基于不完美先验知识、通过自身真实世界经验持续精炼行为提供了有力示范。

title: A Task-Centric Ontology and Deterministic Domain Rules as a Verifiable Core for AI-Assisted Chemistry Problem Solving
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Proof-of-concept evaluation of a task-centric chemistry ontology and deterministic rule engine on 300 human-authored and manually validated school-level problems. The proposed LLM translation layer and token-efficiency hypothesis are not evaluated in the current study
summary: Large language models can interpret natural-language chemistry questions, but their internal reasoning is difficult to inspect, constrain, and validate. This paper presents ChemOntoRule, a proof-of-concept symbolic core for AI-assisted school-level chemistry problem solving. The central design choice is task-centric ontology engineering: the ontology is constructed around the concepts, properties, relations, and executable procedures required by a defined collection of chemistry problems, rather than as a universal representation of chemistry. The implemented artifact combines a lightweight ontology serialized in JSON and RDF/Turtle with deterministic Python rules for electronic structure, periodic trends, oxidation states, oxide and hydride behavior, and related school-level reasoning patterns. A separate expert-coded fallback handles problem families not yet represented by general rules. The system was examined on 300 human-authored and manually validated chemistry problems. The complete system matched 296 of 300 reference answers (98.67%). The ontology-driven rule subset covered 269 problems and matched 266 references (98.88%); 31 problems were handled by task-specific expert-coded fallbacks, with 30 matches. Because the same collection informed ontology construction and evaluation, these results measure implemented coverage and internal consistency, not independent generalization. We analyze the four mismatches, distinguish structural validation from chemical correctness, and define a future architecture in which a language model acts primarily as a translator from user language into a normalized ontological task frame. Token efficiency is presented as a testable hypothesis for future controlled studies, not as a result of the current work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChemOntoRule，一个面向中学化学问题求解的符号化核心系统。采用任务中心的本体工程方法，结合轻量级本体（JSON/RDF-Turtle）和确定性的Python规则，在300道人工题目上达到98.67%的匹配率（296/300）。但作者明确指出，由于构建与评估使用同一题目集合，结果衡量的是覆盖率与内部一致性而非独立泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽能解释自然语言化学问题，但其内部推理过程难以检查、约束和验证。现有的端到端深度学习方案缺乏可解释性和可控性，因此需要一种符号化的、可审计的推理机制来支撑AI辅助的化学解题。
AI.method: 核心设计选择是任务中心的本体工程——本体不是构建通用化学表示，而是围绕特定化学问题集合所需的概念、属性、关系和可执行过程来构建。实现包括两部分：(1) 轻量级本体序列化为JSON和RDF/Turtle格式；(2) 用于电子结构、周期趋势、氧化态、氧化物和氢化物行为等学校级推理模式的确定性Python规则。另设专家编码的fallback模块处理尚未被通用规则覆盖的问题族。未来架构设想中，语言模型仅充当用户语言到规范化本体任务框架的翻译器。
AI.result: 在300个人工编写并验证的化学问题上，完整系统匹配296个参考答案（98.67%）。本体驱动规则子集覆盖269个问题，匹配266个（98.88%）；31个问题由任务特定的专家编码fallback处理，其中30个匹配。作者分析4个不匹配案例，区分了结构验证与化学正确性，并指出token效率仅为未来对照研究的可测试假设，而非当前工作结论。
AI.conclusion: ChemOntoRule作为概念验证展示了符号核心在中学化学问题求解中的可行性，但其评估结果受限于"同一题目集合既用于构建又用于评估"的自我参照性，只能衡量实现覆盖率与内部一致性。未来工作方向是让语言模型担任翻译角色，将用户语言转化为规范化本体任务框架，以实现更可控、可验证的化学推理管线。

title: Cross-Platform Generalisation Failure in Mental Health Natural Language Processing: A Five-Axis Fairness Audit of Transformer Models on Social Media
comment: 15 pages, 24 figures, 10 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary: We introduce the Cross-Platform Fairness Evaluation (CPFE) framework -- a five-axis audit protocol covering discriminative performance, calibration, statistical significance, prediction equity, and attribution stability -- and apply it to four transformer models (BERT, RoBERTa, Emotion-DistilRoBERTa, GoEmotions-RoBERTa) trained on a Kaggle mental health corpus (n=35,556) and evaluated on Reddit (n=6,257) and Twitter (n=2,883) test sets with emotion labels mapped to clinical proxies. All three independently evaluated models exhibit consistent and substantial cross-platform AUC degradation (30.3-35.4% on Reddit, 37.9-39.5% on Twitter) relative to within-platform performance (AUC 0.983-0.987), confirmed across five independent training seeds. Calibration failure is concurrent and severe: ECE rises from 0.056-0.060 in-domain to 0.196-0.229 on Reddit and 0.499-0.542 on Twitter. Platform-specific temperature scaling reduces mean ECE by 88.0% without altering discriminative performance (mean |delta AUC|<0.01), confirming separable failure modes. Prediction equity analysis reveals large cross-platform disparities (raw DI < 0.17; prior-shift-adjusted DI: 0.11-0.29 on Reddit), with equalized odds differences of 0.753-0.830 for mental health proxy classes on Reddit and 0.755-0.831 for anxiety on Twitter. Attribution stability analysis shows near-complete vocabulary divergence across platforms (Jaccard J=0 in 14/16 model-class pairs at K=10). These findings support treating cross-platform validation across all five CPFE axes as a standard requirement for mental health NLP systems in heterogeneous environments. In a single-seed fine-tuning experiment, mean AUC improved by 0.216, suggesting target-platform labels provide greater benefit as training signal than as calibration signal.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出跨平台公平性评估（CPFE）框架，涵盖五个审计维度（判别性能、校准、统计显著性、预测公平性、归因稳定性），对四个Transformer模型在心理健康语料上进行训练，并在Reddit和Twitter上进行跨平台评估。结果显示跨平台AUC大幅下降（30-39%）、校准严重失败（ECE上升至0.5+）、预测公平性存在巨大差异，且词汇归因几乎完全不相交，表明跨平台验证应成为心理健康NLP系统的标准要求。
AI.motivation: 心理健康NLP模型通常在单一平台数据上训练和评估，但实际部署会面临高度异构的多平台环境。已有研究未能系统性地从多维度量化跨平台性能退化问题，缺乏统一的审计框架来评估模型在不同平台间的公平性、可靠性及可解释性退化，因此需要建立一个多轴评估协议来全面揭示跨平台泛化风险。
AI.method: 提出CPFE五轴审计协议：(1)判别性能（AUC）；(2)校准（ECE）；(3)统计显著性（多随机种子验证）；(4)预测公平性（DI、prior-shift调整DI、equalized odds）；(5)归因稳定性（Jaccard词汇重叠）。在Kaggle心理健康语料（n=35,556）上训练BERT、RoBERTa、Emotion-DistilRoBERTa、GoEmotions-RoBERTa四个模型，在Reddit（6,257条）和Twitter（2,883条）测试集上评估，并引入平台特定的温度缩放进行校准修复。
AI.result: 跨平台AUC下降30.3-39.5%（域内AUC 0.983-0.987）；ECE从0.056-0.060升至Reddit 0.196-0.229和Twitter 0.499-0.542；平台特定温度缩放将ECE降低88.0%且不损害判别性能（|delta AUC|<0.01）；预测公平性方面，raw DI<0.17，equalized odds差异达0.753-0.831；归因分析中Jaccard J=0出现在14/16模型-类对。此外，单种子微调实验显示AUC提升0.216，表明目标平台标签作为训练信号比校准信号更有价值。
AI.conclusion: 跨平台部署导致心理健康NLP模型在判别性能、校准、公平性和可解释性四个维度均发生严重且一致的退化，且这些失败模式是可分离的（校准可通过温度缩放独立修复）。研究建议将五轴跨平台验证纳入心理健康NLP系统的标准评估要求，并指出获取目标平台标注数据用于微调比仅用于校准更有效。

title: FU-Mamba: A Frequency-Enhanced Dynamic Scanning Framework for Oralscan Image Segmentation
summary: Oralscan image segmentation is essential for computer-aided diagnosis and treatment planning in digital dentistry. However, existing visual state space models (SSMs) often rely on manually designed scanning orders to flatten image patches into sequences, which disrupts the semantic spatial continuity and hinders coherent feature extraction from key foreground regions. Moreover, elements such as inconsistent lighting, reflective surfaces, and noise during data acquisition disrupt the frequency distribution by diminishing high-frequency details while enhancing low-frequency components, consequently hindering the accurate localization of boundaries. In response to these challenges, we introduce FU-Mamba, an innovative framework that incorporates dynamic scanning and frequency domain enhancement within the SSM architecture. Specifically, the Dynamic Mamba Block (DMB) adaptively learns sampling offsets via a trainable offset prediction network and performs flexible bilinear interpolation, enabling content-aware scanning that preserves spatial coherence. Furthermore, a frequency domain enhancement block balances spectral components through wavelet-guided decomposition and spectrum pooling, improving robustness under adverse imaging conditions. Experimental findings indicate that FU-Mamba attains a notable enhancement in segmentation accuracy, evidenced by a 1.1% increase in the mean intersection over union (mIoU) metric when evaluated on the dental segmentation dataset. Project page: https://byte2bite.github.io/FU-Mamba/

AI.tldr: 本文提出FU-Mamba框架，针对口内扫描图像分割中视觉状态空间模型（SSM）依赖人工设计扫描顺序破坏语义空间连续性，以及成像条件（光照不均、反光、噪声）导致频率分布失衡的问题，通过动态扫描（Dynamic Mamba Block）和频域增强（频率域增强模块）提升分割精度，在牙科分割数据集上mIoU提升1.1%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉状态空间模型（SSM）在口内扫描图像分割中存在两大痛点：一是手动设计的扫描顺序将图像块展平为序列时破坏了前景关键区域的语义空间连续性，阻碍了连贯特征提取；二是数据采集过程中光照不均、反光表面和噪声等不利因素扰乱了频率分布（削弱高频细节、增强低频成分），导致边界定位不准确。
AI.method: 提出FU-Mamba框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) Dynamic Mamba Block (DMB)，通过可训练的偏移预测网络自适应学习采样偏移，并结合灵活的双线性插值实现内容感知的动态扫描，保持空间连贯性；(2) 频率域增强模块，通过小波引导分解和频谱池化平衡光谱成分，在不利成像条件下增强鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在牙科分割数据集上，FU-Mamba相较于基线取得了1.1%的平均交并比（mIoU）提升，验证了动态扫描与频域增强机制在口内扫描图像分割中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: FU-Mamba通过动态扫描替代人工设计的固定扫描顺序，并结合频域增强策略，有效解决了SSM在口内扫描图像分割中面临的语义空间连续性破坏和频率分布失衡问题，为数字牙科计算机辅助诊断与治疗规划提供了更为精准的分割能力。

title: Active Curriculum Refinement for Reinforcement Learning
summary: In many reinforcement learning (RL) domains, environments are connected by prerequisite relations, such as difficulty-increasing edits or parameter increments, which induce a directed acyclic curriculum graph (DAG). Although this structure is often exploited only implicitly, explicitly modeling it can improve training. We introduce PATH, a curriculum-learning framework that performs active learning over the curriculum graph. PATH first expands coverage by sampling diverse curriculum paths and then reallocates training toward regions that remain unmastered. Experiments across diverse environments show that PATH explicitly leverages the graph structure to achieve strong robustness and generalization.

AI.tldr: PATH是一个基于课程图的主动学习框架，它通过显式建模环境中前提关系构成的有向无环课程图（DAG），先采样多样课程路径以扩大覆盖，再对未掌握区域重新分配训练资源，在多种环境中显著提升了鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 许多强化学习环境中，任务通过先决关系（如难度递增的编辑或参数增量）相互关联，形成有向无环课程图。这种结构通常只被隐式利用，显式建模有望改善训练效果。
AI.method: PATH框架由两个阶段构成：首先通过采样多样化的课程路径来扩大覆盖范围，然后针对尚未掌握的区域重新分配训练资源，实现对课程图的主动学习。
AI.result: 在多种多样环境中的实验表明，PATH通过显式利用图结构获得了较强的鲁棒性和泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模环境中的课程图结构并采用主动学习策略，可以有效提升强化学习训练的鲁棒性与泛化能力。

title: PLCBench: Can Autonomous LLM Agents Turn PLC Access into Sustained Physical Impact?
summary:
Industrial control systems (ICSs) rely on programmable logic controllers (PLCs) to connect networked computation with physical control. Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents represent an emerging attack threat: can an autonomous agent convert a network-reachable PLC into sustained adverse physical impact? However, existing evaluations focus on digital tasks or individual stages of PLC testing. In ICSs, evaluations that stop at software exploitation, an accepted write, or tool access may therefore mischaracterize physical risk.
  We present PLCBENCH, to our knowledge, the first real-PLC hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) framework for characterizing this cyber-to-physical capability and its boundaries. It combines vendor-native interaction, commercial PLC execution, closed-loop reduced-order process simulation, and independent outcome verification. A deterministic evaluator applies fixed rules to runner, communication, PLC-object, and process records to assign six hidden diagnostic flags, distinguishing usable PLC interaction, process-linked manipulation, and sustained physical impact. We instantiate PLCBENCH on four commercial PLCs crossed with four closed-loop workloads. Across five LLM families and 240 real-PLC episodes, 75 episodes (31.3%) sustain their respective physical objectives. Stagewise results show that 98 episodes stop before a valid native read, whereas 62 reach a process-linked write but do not sustain the final objective. Notably, richer process observation is associated with an increase in conditional objective attainment after a process-linked write from 44.2% to 64.0%. These measurements localize failure in configured PLC-process deployments and identify intervention points for future defense evaluation. To support reproducibility, we release the safely disclosable PLCBENCH code and a software-only reproduction pipeline through the accompanying artifact.

AI.tldr: PLCBENCH 是首个面向真实PLC的硬件在环（HIL）评估框架，用于量化工具型LLM代理从网络可达PLC到持续物理破坏的"网络到物理"攻击能力。在4种商用PLC、4种闭环工作负载、5个LLM家族共240次真实PLC攻击会话中，75次（31.3%）实现了持续的物理目标；评测通过六个隐藏诊断标志区分PLC交互、过程相关写入和持续物理影响，并定位了攻击失败阶段及未来防御干预点。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理攻击评估集中于数字任务或PLC测试的单一阶段（如软件利用、写入成功或工具访问），无法准确刻画工业控制系统中从网络攻击到物理影响的完整风险链条。研究者需要一个能够端到端评估"网络可达PLC是否可被自主代理转化为持续物理影响"的真实硬件在环框架。
AI.method: PLCBENCH结合厂商原生协议交互、真实商用PLC执行、闭环降阶过程仿真和独立结果验证。确定性评估器根据固定的规则对运行记录、通信记录、PLC对象记录和过程记录分配六个隐藏诊断标志，以区分可用PLC交互、过程关联操纵和持续物理影响。框架在4种商用PLC×4种闭环工作负载上实例化，涉及5个LLM家族共240个真实PLC攻击会话。
AI.result: 240次真实PLC会话中75次（31.3%）实现了持续物理目标。阶段性结果表明：98次会话在有效的原生读取之前即停止，62次达到过程关联写入但未维持最终目标。更丰富的过程观测将过程关联写入后的条件目标达成率从44.2%提升至64.0%。
AI.conclusion: PLCBENCH通过细粒度阶段性诊断定位了LLM代理在配置好的PLC-过程部署中的失败节点，识别了未来防御评估的干预点。同时发布了可安全披露的代码和纯软件复现流水线以支持可复现性。

title: CLIPPER: Replayable Shortlisted Optimization for Repeated Spatial Coverage Planning
comment: Accepted at ACM SIGSPATIAL 2026. 6 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables
summary: Operational requirements developed with the City of Braunschweig frame municipal micromobility planning under geofenced exclusions, mandatory retained sites, spacing rules, and area-level caps. Each policy edit requires a new feasible plan; full-set greedy takes tens of seconds per alternative at city scale. We present CLIPPER (Constraint-exact Low-latency Iterative Planning with Pooled Evaluation and Replay). It forms bounded candidate pools but recomputes exact current gains and checks every active constraint before selection. Coverage from each candidate alone sets the initial order. Offline full-set scans measure gains omitted by the pool; online, a conservative bound triggers expansion or audit. CLIPPER-F gives each proposal group the same number of candidate slots. Across Braunschweig, Munich, and Berlin, its mean coverage over complete chains stays within 0.245 percentage points of full-set greedy under the same policy, with 13.6--28.9 times lower mean rollout time. CLIPPER-A instead distributes one shared candidate budget across the groups. Under its coverage-prioritized policy, it uses 9--15% of full-set greedy's rollout time under the same policy, with mean gaps of 1.82 percentage points in Braunschweig, 0.12 in Munich, and 0.27 in Berlin. Together, CLIPPER enables rapid, replayable comparison of recorded city-scale planning states while enforcing every encoded model constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLIPPER框架，用于在布拉格……（实际为布伦瑞克、慕尼黑、柏林）等城市规模的共享微出行规划中，通过候选池限定、精确增益重算及保守边界扩池/审计机制，在保持与全量贪心算法几乎相同覆盖率（差距≤0.245个百分点）的同时，将滚动时间降低13.6–28.9倍。
AI.motivation: 城市微出行规划中每一项策略修改都需要重新生成可行方案，而城市规模下全量贪心算法每次需要数十秒才能完成一次替代方案计算，难以支持快速、可回放的多策略对比与规划迭代。
AI.method: CLIPPER采用候选池限定方式生成有界候选集，但在每次选择前重新计算精确的当前增益并逐一校验所有活动约束。初始顺序由各候选单独产生的覆盖率决定；通过离线全量扫描测量池外遗漏增益，在线通过保守边界触发候选池扩展或审计。CLIPPER-F为每个提议组分配等量候选槽位；CLIPPER-A则在组间共享一个候选预算。
AI.result: 在布伦瑞克、慕尼黑和柏林三座城市上，CLIPPER-F在完整链条上的平均覆盖率与同策略下的全量贪心算法差距保持在0.245个百分点以内，而平均滚动时间降低了13.6–28.9倍；CLIPPER-A在覆盖率优先策略下仅使用全量贪心算法9–15%的滚动时间，平均覆盖率差距分别为布伦瑞克1.82、慕尼黑0.12、柏林0.27个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CLIPPER能够在全面执行所有编码模型约束的前提下，实现快速、可回放的城市规模规划状态对比，显著降低计算开销同时保持接近最优的覆盖率质量，为城市微出行的策略迭代与规划决策提供了高效的工程化解决方案。

title: Refusal Is Not Robustness: Auditing Confident Fabrication in Large Language Models on a Provably Uninformative Clinical Pain Speech Transcript
summary: Hallucination and abstention benchmarks rarely establish that a model could not have known the correct answer, making it difficult to distinguish appropriate abstention from an unsupported prediction. Seven large language models were evaluated on the TAME Pain speech corpus. Participants read phonetically balanced Harvard Sentences while one hand was immersed in cold or warm water and reported pain only during periodic pain statements. This protocol generated 5,750 no signal Harvard Sentence utterances whose transcripts contained no lexical pain information and 1,294 signal pain statement utterances in which the pain rating was explicitly spoken. In the no signal arm, pain was recoverable from acoustic features (AUC 0.622, 95% CI 0.553 to 0.662), whereas transcript based prediction was near chance (AUC 0.489, 95% CI 0.418 to 0.504). Because automatic speech recognition removes the acoustic pain cues, any pain score inferred solely from the transcript is unsupported by the available evidence. Under cooperative prompting, six models abstained on nearly all no signal transcripts, correctly extracted spoken pain ratings in the positive control task with accuracies ranging from 0.939 to 1.00, and maintained an expected calibration error of at most 0.100. Under authority framed prompts, abstention became prompt dependent, with the same model ranging from 0.18 to 1.00 across equivalent prompt phrasings. Most models produced low confidence estimates when forced to answer, whereas Gemini 2.5 Flash and Llama 3.1 8B consistently generated confident pain scores with confident fabrication rates of 0.53 and 0.76, compared with at most 0.15 for all other models. No significant demographic effects were observed in forced responses, with all $p$ values greater than or equal to 0.20.

AI.tldr: 该研究在TAME Pain语音语料库上评估了七种大型语言模型（LLMs）的幻觉与弃权行为。通过对比无疼痛信息的声学特征（AUC 0.622）与转录文本（AUC 0.489）的疼痛可检测性，证明仅凭转录文本推断疼痛分数缺乏证据支持。研究发现，在合作性提示下，多数模型能正确弃权并高精度提取口语疼痛评分；而权威框架提示会导致弃权行为依赖提示措辞。Gemini 2.5 Flash和Llama 3.1 8B在被迫作答时产生高置信度幻觉（置信幻觉率分别为0.53和0.76）。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉和弃权基准测试未验证模型是否可能已知正确信息，因此难以区分合理的弃权与无证据支持的预测。本研究旨在设计一个能明确区分"模型确实不知道"与"模型有依据但出错"的评测协议，以更严谨地评估LLM在缺乏证据时的弃权行为和幻觉倾向。
AI.method: 使用TAME Pain语音语料库：受试者在冷/温水浸泡中朗读语音平衡的Harvard句子，并在周期性疼痛陈述中口头报告疼痛。构建了5,750条无疼痛信号转录（无词法疼痛信息）和1,294条有疼痛信号陈述。通过对比声学特征与转录文本的疼痛可预测性，确立"从转录推断疼痛为无证据预测"的评估基础。对七种LLM采用两种提示框架（合作性提示和权威框架提示）评估弃权率、疼痛提取准确率、预期校准误差及被迫作答时的置信度与幻觉率。
AI.result: 声学特征可区分疼痛（AUC 0.622）而转录文本接近随机（AUC 0.489），确认转录预测无证据支撑。合作性提示下，六种模型几乎对所有无信号转录弃权（弃权率近1.00），正向对照任务中正确提取口语疼痛评分的准确率达0.939-1.00，预期校准误差≤0.100。权威框架提示下，同一模型弃权率在0.18至1.00之间剧烈波动。Gemini 2.5 Flash和Llama 3.1 8B被迫作答时产生高置信幻觉（率分别为0.53和0.76），其他模型≤0.15。未发现显著的人口统计学效应（所有p≥0.20）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过精心设计的实验协议证明了：LLM在缺乏证据时倾向于合理弃权（在合作性提示下），但提示措辞的权威框架会显著破坏这种可靠性，导致弃权行为不稳定。部分模型（Gemini 2.5 Flash、Llama 3.1 8B）在被迫作答时表现出严重的高置信幻觉倾向，构成临床应用风险。研究强调评估LLM幻觉时应验证任务的可判定性（即模型是否可能从可用证据中获知正确答案），并警示提示设计对模型可靠性的关键影响。

title: Syntax vs. Semantics: How Transformers Learn Deep Dependencies
summary: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable syntactic fluency, yet the optimization dynamics governing their acquisition of deep semantic dependencies remain poorly understood. We propose a mechanistic framework that models this learning process as a competition between Surface Statistics and Deep Semantics. Our theoretical analysis identifies a ``Gradient Starvation" phenomenon where the error signals for sparse semantic dependencies are actively suppressed during early optimization. This suppression impedes the learning of structural reasoning and causes its emergence to manifest as a sudden phase transition. Furthermore, this framework offers a mechanistic basis for the effectiveness of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) strategies. By externalizing intermediate reasoning steps into concrete tokens, CoT effectively bypasses the suppression regime inherent to implicit reasoning. We validate these findings across scales ranging from toy transformers to production models (Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B). Finally, guided by this theory, we propose a topology-aligned contrastive objective that explicitly rectifies the gradient geometry. Experiments on variable binding tasks demonstrate that our method achieves an improvement that is over 2x larger than that obtained via standard cross-entropy fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个机理框架，将大语言模型学习深层语义依赖的过程建模为表面统计与深层语义之间的竞争。理论分析揭示"梯度饥饿"现象——稀疏语义依赖的错误信号在早期优化中被主动抑制，导致结构推理的学习以突变的相变形式涌现。该框架为CoT策略的有效性提供了机理基础，并提出拓扑对齐的对比目标来修正梯度几何，在变量绑定任务上比标准交叉熵微调提升超2倍。
AI.motivation: 虽然LLM展现出显著的句法流畅性，但其深层语义依赖获取背后的优化动力学仍缺乏理解。作者旨在从优化视角解释为什么深层语义推理能力的学习呈现突发涌现，并为CoT策略的有效性和改进训练方法提供理论依据。
AI.method: 1) 提出"梯度饥饿"理论框架，将学习建模为表面统计与深层语义间的竞争，从理论上识别早期优化中稀疏语义依赖信号被抑制的机制。2) 以该框架解释CoT通过外部化中间推理步骤绕过抑制区域的有效性。3) 提出拓扑对齐的对比学习目标，显式修正梯度几何。4) 在玩具Transformer到生产级模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B）上进行验证。
AI.result: 实验覆盖从玩具Transformer到生产级模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-Coder-7B）多个尺度，验证了梯度饥饿理论的正确性；在变量绑定任务上，所提出的拓扑对齐对比方法相比标准交叉熵微调的改进超过2倍。
AI.conclusion: 深层语义推导能力的涌现源于梯度饥饿导致的信号抑制，CoT通过token外部化绕过这一抑制机制而有效；拓扑对齐的对比目标可显式改善梯度几何，显著提升变量绑定任务的训练效果，为LLM深层语义学习提供了理论指导与实用方法。

title: Text-to-seed generation: Training-free open-vocabulary seeded semantic segmentation via re-purposing diffusion as text-guided seed generator
comment: Preprint version of the work accepted for publication in Knowledge-Based Systems
summary: Open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) aims to segment image regions corresponding to arbitrary text queries. Although the Segment Anything Model (SAM) is a powerful foundation model for segmentation, its standalone performance on OVSS remains limited. Existing methods therefore often use SAM to refine coarse masks predicted by other models, but this strategy is unreliable when the initial masks are inaccurate. In this work, we argue that more reliable segmentation can be achieved by exploiting SAM as a region expansion module guided by accurate object points (i.e., seeds) rather than inaccurate coarse masks. Inspired by classical seeded segmentation, we reformulate OVSS as text-guided seed localization followed by seed-based region expansion. To realize this idea, we propose Text-to-Seed (T2S), a training-free framework that leverages the text-to-region correspondence of Stable Diffusion to generate attention-based seed points for target categories described by text. These sparse seeds are then used as point prompts for SAM to produce full object masks. Without task-specific training or additional annotations, T2S achieves strong performance on standard OVSS benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining semantic grounding with seed-driven spatial segmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Text-to-Seed (T2S)，一个无需训练的开放词汇语义分割框架。该方法利用Stable Diffusion的文本-区域对应关系生成注意力种子点，再将这些稀疏种子点作为点提示输入SAM进行区域扩展，从而获得完整的物体掩码，在标准基准上取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 现有开放词汇语义分割方法常依赖SAM来细化其他模型生成的粗糙掩码，但当初始掩码不准确时，这种策略不可靠。作者提出应利用SAM作为基于精确物体种子点的区域扩展模块，而非基于不精确的粗糙掩码。
AI.method: 将开放词汇语义分割重新表述为"文本引导的种子定位+基于种子的区域扩展"两个阶段。第一阶段利用Stable Diffusion的文本到区域对应能力生成基于注意力的种子点；第二阶段将这些稀疏种子点作为点提示输入SAM，生成完整的物体掩码。整个框架无需任务特定训练或额外标注。
AI.result: 在标准开放词汇语义分割基准上取得了强性能，验证了将语义锚定（semantic grounding）与种子驱动的空间分割相结合的框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将SAM重新定位为种子驱动的区域扩展模块，并借助Stable Diffusion的语义锚定能力，T2S提供了一种无需训练即可实现可靠开放词汇语义分割的替代路径，优于依赖粗糙掩码细化的传统策略。

title: Shared Actors Need Not Share Critics: Effects of Value Mismatch in Parallel Reinforcement Learning
summary: When a single policy is trained in parallel across multiple environments of the same task, such as procedurally generated levels, randomized dynamics, or curricula, implementations commonly use one critic across all sampled environments. Yet different environments can assign different expected returns to the same input visible to the critic. A critic without environment information must then reconcile distinct value targets, systematically shifting the sampled advantages within individual environments. Using illustrative bandit models with multiple environments and a common optimal arm, we characterize how this value mismatch redistributes sampled policy updates, reinforcing unhelpful actions while attenuating or even reversing useful ones. The oracle processes using no baseline, the shared value, or the value specific to the sampled environment have the same mean logit update at a fixed policy and converge to the same optimal policy, yet their realized learning paths can differ sharply. The analysis motivates a minimal intervention: give only a logged environment index to the critic so that it can separate the value targets. Controlled CartPole and MuJoCo experiments expose the predicted shifted values, advantages, and performance gaps. In the more complex BipedalWalker and Procgen settings, the same intervention yields more stable learning and higher returns. Across all $16$ Procgen games, the multihead conditional critic improves aggregate normalized return on $600$ unseen levels per game by $40.8\%$. In conclusion, the theory identifies value mismatch as a direct mechanism through which critic sharing can degrade stochastic learning dynamics, not captured by scalar estimator variance alone, and the experiments show that conditioning on an index is broadly effective in parallel reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了并行强化学习中，单一critic跨多个环境（如程序生成的关卡、随机化动力学或课程）共享时，由于不同环境对相同输入赋予不同期望回报而导致的"值不匹配"问题。理论分析结合实验证明，仅向critic提供环境索引作为条件输入，即可有效缓解该问题，在Procgen全部16个游戏上提升40.8%的归一化回报。
AI.motivation: 并行强化学习中常见做法是用一个共享critic评估所有采样的环境，但不同环境可能对critic可见的相同输入赋予不同的期望回报。这种值不匹配会系统性地偏移各环境内的采样优势，扭曲策略更新——强化无用动作、削弱甚至逆转有用动作，从而损害学习动态。现有标量估计器方差分析无法捕捉这一机制。
AI.method: 理论部分使用多环境、共享最优臂的bandit模型，刻画值不匹配如何重新分配策略更新。对比三种baseline机制（无baseline、共享值、环境特定值），证明它们在固定策略下具有相同的平均logit更新并收敛到同一最优策略，但学习路径存在显著差异。实验部分提出最小干预方案：仅将已记录的环境索引提供给critic（多head条件critic），使其分离不同环境的值目标。在CartPole、MuJoCo、BipedalWalker和Procgen上验证。
AI.result: 控制实验（CartPole、MuJoCo）验证了理论预测的偏移值、偏移优势及性能差距。在更复杂的BipedalWalker和Procgen中，多head条件critic带来更稳定的学习和更高的回报。在所有16个Procgen游戏中，条件critic在每游戏600个未见关卡上的平均归一化回报提升40.8%。
AI.conclusion: 理论识别了critic共享通过值不匹配直接退化随机学习动态的机制（这是标量估计器方差无法捕捉的），并证明以环境索引为条件是最小且广泛有效的干预手段，适用于并行强化学习场景。

title: A Catalog of User Authentication Patterns
comment: This is the peer-reviewed, accepted version of a paper. It will appear in the proceedings of the 33rd Conference on Pattern Languages of Programs, People, and Practices (PLoP 2026). The final published version will be available from the Association for Computing Machinery (ACM) via the ACM Digital Library. 25 pages, 1 table, 14 patterns
summary: Security patterns are intended to support the design and development of secure software systems. However, although established catalogs of security patterns exist, their practical application remains limited. In particular, despite these catalogs, concrete patterns for common security controls such as user authentication (authentication for short) are lacking. This paper aims to make an initial contribution toward closing this gap, as exemplified by authentication. It presents a novel authentication pattern catalog, comprising 14 user authentication patterns. To support the catalog's practical application, it classifies patterns by the well-known concept of authentication factors and by the usual role each pattern fulfills in practice. By cataloging common authentication techniques through authentication patterns, we aim to make an important contribution to supporting software engineers and architects in designing and developing secure software systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个包含14种用户认证模式的新型认证模式目录，按认证因素和实际角色进行分类，旨在填补安全模式目录中缺乏具体认证控制模式的空白，支持软件工程师和架构师设计开发安全软件系统。
AI.motivation: 安全模式旨在支持安全软件系统的设计与开发，但现有的安全模式目录在实际应用中有限，尤其是缺乏针对常见安全控制（如用户认证）的具体模式，存在明显的知识缺口。
AI.method: 提出一个新颖的认证模式目录，包含14种用户认证模式；通过公认的认证因素概念和每种模式在实践中通常扮演的角色进行分类，以支持目录的实际应用。
AI.result: 成功构建了一个包含14种用户认证模式的认证模式目录，并利用认证因素和角色进行系统分类，为常见认证技术提供了结构化的模式描述。
AI.conclusion: 该认证模式目录是对现有安全模式体系的重要补充，有助于缩小模式目录与实际安全控制应用之间的差距，为软件工程师和架构师在设计开发安全软件系统时提供实用支持。

title: TemporalFlow-VLA: Learning Physically Grounded Execution History for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models leverage pretrained vision-language representations for robot control, yet simply adding historical frames does not reliably capture recent physical change. This is especially problematic in multi-stage manipulation, where visually similar states may require different actions depending on prior execution. To address this challenge, we present TemporalFlow-VLA, which learns compact execution history through physically grounded temporal supervision. Using recorded robot states, robot geometry, and calibrated cameras, we construct robot-surface temporal flow as a training-only target and supervise two execution-aligned temporal queries that provide structured history to the action expert. The geometric supervision path is not evaluated at deployment. TemporalFlow-VLA achieves 97.63 +/- 0.26% average success on LIBERO, including 96.60 +/- 0.87% on LIBERO Long, and 85.5%/84.2% Clean/Randomized success across 12 RoboTwin tasks. It shows its clearest advantage over prior methods on longer-horizon, multi-stage manipulation. Controlled history interventions show that action prediction depends on both historical content and temporal order. With asynchronous feature caching, temporal conditioning maintains single-frame-level server-side sampling latency without additional historical-encoding overhead. Overall, TemporalFlow-VLA provides a compact, physically grounded interface for exploiting ordered execution history without explicit motion estimation or geometric processing at deployment.

AI.tldr: TemporalFlow-VLA通过物理接地的时间监督学习紧凑的执行历史，利用机器人状态、几何与标定相机构建机器人-表面时间流作为训练目标，监督两个执行对齐的时间查询，在不增加部署延迟的情况下显著提升长时序多阶段操作任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型利用预训练的视觉-语言表示进行机器人控制，但简单添加历史帧无法可靠捕捉近期物理变化。在多阶段操作中，视觉相似的状态可能因先前执行历史不同而需要不同动作，因此需要有效的执行历史建模。
AI.method: 构建机器人-表面时间流（robot-surface temporal flow）作为训练专用目标，该目标由记录机器人状态、机器人几何和标定相机生成；设计两个执行对齐的时间查询（execution-aligned temporal queries），为动作专家提供结构化历史信息；几何监督路径仅在训练中使用，不支持部署期评估；同时采用异步特征缓存以保持单帧级服务端采样延迟。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上达到97.63±0.26%的平均成功率（其中LIBERO Long为96.60±0.87%），在12个RoboTwin任务上分别达到85.5%（Clean）和84.2%（Randomized）的成功率。在长时序、多阶段任务上优势最为明显。受控历史干预实验表明动作预测同时依赖历史内容和时间顺序。
AI.conclusion: TemporalFlow-VLA提供了一种紧凑且物理接地的手段来利用有序执行历史，无需在部署时进行显式运动估计或几何处理，同时通过异步特征缓存保持部署效率。

title: Knowledge Cards: Structured Knowledge for AI Systems
summary: AI systems whose outputs inform real decisions, and increasingly consequential ones, require something that current documentation practice does not provide: a structured, inspectable representation of the knowledge they need to ground, contextualize, and reason about those decisions, ideally reviewed and signed off by a domain expert. Established documentation artefacts already capture important aspects of an AI system. Model cards describe how a system behaves, data cards describe what it was trained on, and system cards describe the risks of a deployed system. None of them addresses the layer between inputs and outputs, more precisely, the concepts a system holds, the relationships it models, and the patterns of reasoning it applies. For pattern-recognition tasks this gap is tolerable. For agentic AI, where systems act on their conclusions, it is the step that most often separates a promising proof of concept from an operational solution an organisation can rely on. This paper introduces the Knowledge Card, a structured artefact that captures validated knowledge about a single bounded concept in a form that experts can review, organisations can audit, and AI systems can reason over.
