To support joint world-action learning, we construct synchronized gameplay and GUI trajectories. To handle heterogeneous native control, GameWAM predicts a gameplay/GUI mode at each action step and generates actions with mode-specific prediction distributions and continuous-action normalization. For long-horizon interaction, block-cycle control predicts beyond the committed horizon, executes only a short action prefix, and replans from new observations, while fine-grained within-cycle context and hierarchical cross-cycle history preserve temporal continuity. Experiments demonstrate competitive task success with fewer executed native actions than the compared agents. We further uncover Low-Frequency Action Source Imprinting (LASI), in which low-frequency components of the sampled action source systematically steer coarse generated camera motion under fixed conditioning, revealing a source-sensitivity failure mode in generative control. Project page is available at https://yunncheng.github.io/GameWAM/.

AI.tldr: GameWAM是首个面向原生闭环游戏玩法与GUI控制的World-Action Model（WAM），通过并行视觉与动作生成过程（采用块因果条件与流匹配）联合预测未来视觉观察和可执行的键盘鼠标轨迹，实验表明在更少原生动作下达到具有竞争力的任务成功率，并揭示了低频频谱行动源印记（LASI）这一生成式控制中的源敏感失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现有游戏智能体直接将视觉与任务上下文映射为动作，缺少显式世界动态建模；而交互式游戏世界模型虽能根据动作预测视觉未来，却不能作为任务策略。将两者统一为World-Action Models（WAMs）在视频游戏的动态性与开放式交互背景下尚未被充分探索，因此需要首个面向游戏原生闭环控制的WAM。
AI.method: GameWAM通过并行视觉与动作生成过程联合预测未来视觉观察和可执行的键盘-鼠标轨迹，采用块因果条件（block-causal conditioning）与流匹配（flow matching）。构建同步游戏玩法与GUI轨迹以支撑联合世界-动作学习；通过在每个动作步骤预测gameplay/GUI模式，并采用模式特定的预测分布与连续动作归一化来处理异构原生控制；针对长程交互，采用块循环控制（block-cycle control），仅执行短动作前缀后基于新观察重新规划，并通过细粒度周期内上下文与层次化跨周期历史保持时序连续性。
AI.result: 实验表明GameWAM在任务成功率上与对比智能体相当，但执行的原生动作数量更少。此外，发现低频动作源印记（LASI）现象：在固定条件下，采样动作源的低频分量会系统性地偏向生成的粗粒度相机运动，揭示了生成式控制的一个源敏感失效模式。
AI.conclusion: GameWAM证明了WAM在原生游戏闭环控制中的可行性，实现了世界建模与策略的统一，同时揭示了生成式控制中动作源低频分量影响相机运动的潜在失效模式，为后续研究指出了方向。

title: Mutual Debiasing via Dual-Seed Comparison for Probabilistic Sampling in Large Language Models
summary: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable capabilities in reasoning and decision-making, high-fidelity probabilistic sampling remains a persistent challenge. When generating random variables, LLMs consistently exhibit systematic biases that warp the target probability distributions. Current approaches often rely on a single, self-generated seed, which inherits model-specific biases. To overcome this vulnerability, we introduce Dual-Seed Comparison (DSC), a transparent, tool-free protocol that utilizes two independent LLM-generated seeds to neutralize bias. DSC compares the character-level ordinal values of the two seeds to construct a bit sequence, converts and normalizes this sequence into a pseudo-uniform variate, and then maps the variate to the target distribution through the inverse cumulative distribution function (CDF). Empirical results show that DSC substantially outperforms existing methods across 96\% of evaluated settings. Beyond direct sampling, task-adapted variants based on the DSC comparison operator improve distributional control in MCQ generation and attribute-constrained text-to-image prompting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双种子比较（DSC）协议，利用两个独立LLM生成的种子通过字符级序数值比较构建比特序列，经归一化得到伪均匀变量，再通过逆CDF映射到目标分布，从而消除LLM在概率采样中的系统性偏差。实验表明DSC在96%的评测设置下优于现有方法，并适用于MCQ生成和文本到图像提示等任务。
AI.motivation: LLM在生成随机变量时存在系统性偏差，扭曲目标概率分布；现有方法依赖单一自生成种子，继承模型特有的偏差，缺乏透明且无需外部工具的纠偏手段。
AI.method: DSC协议包含三个步骤：(1) 生成两个独立的LLM种子，并比较它们的字符级序数值，得到比特序列；(2) 将该序列转换并归一化为伪均匀变量；(3) 通过逆累积分布函数（逆CDF）将该变量映射到目标分布。此外，还提出了基于DSC比较操作符的任务自适应变体。
AI.result: 在96%的评测设置下，DSC显著优于现有方法。任务自适应变体在MCQ生成和属性约束的文本到图像提示中改善了分布控制能力。
AI.conclusion: 双种子比较机制通过差分方式相互抵消单种子偏差，提供了一个透明、无需外部工具的LLM概率采样方案，具备良好的泛化性和实用性。

title: Beyond Atomic Layouts: Compositional Design Understanding with Vision-Language Models
summary: Layout understanding, or the interpretation of element organization, is essential for document analysis, user interface (UI) creation, and graphic design. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) excel at interpreting atomic layouts composed of independent elements, they struggle with compositional layouts that require reasoning over visually entangled elements within hierarchical multi-layer structures. In this paper, we introduce a new task, compositional layout understanding, and present CoDeLayout, a VQA dataset of ~20K real-world multi-layer layouts annotated with compositional element pairs and design intent. Through empirical analysis on CoDeLayout, we identify two key challenges for existing VLMs: semantic drift between textual metadata and visual content, and structural ambiguity in hierarchical inter-element relationships. To address these challenges, we propose MASON, a post-training paradigm that integrates multimodal alignment (MA) and structural perception (SP). MA enhances element interpretation by grounding metadata-defined elements to their visual counterparts, mitigating semantic drift, while SP models layer-aware inter-element spatial relationships to improve hierarchical understanding and reduce structural ambiguity. Experiments reveal substantial gaps in existing VLMs: even the strongest baseline, GPT-o3, achieves only 79.68% accuracy, whereas Qwen2.5-VL 7B with MASON reaches 91.66%. Notably, MASON surpasses full-data Direct Finetune using only 30% of the training data and scales better with additional data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出组合式布局理解新任务和CoDeLayout数据集（约2万张真实多层布局图），并设计MASON后训练范式，通过多模态对齐（MA）和结构感知（SP）分别缓解语义漂移与层级结构歧义，使Qwen2.5-VL 7B在MASON下达到91.66%准确率，超越最强基线GPT-o3的79.68%。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言模型（VLMs）在处理由独立元素组成的原子布局时表现良好，但在需要推理层级多层结构中视觉纠缠元素的组合式布局时表现不足。作者识别的两个核心挑战：文本元数据与视觉内容之间的语义漂移，以及层级元素间关系的结构歧义。
AI.method: 提出CoDeLayout数据集（~20K真实多层布局，标注组合元素对和设计意图），以及MASON后训练范式，包含两个模块：多模态对齐（MA）将元数据定义的元素锚定到视觉对应物以缓解语义漂移；结构感知（SP）建模层感知的元素间空间关系以改善层级理解并降低结构歧义。
AI.result: 最强基线GPT-o3仅达79.68%准确率，而Qwen2.5-VL 7B配合MASON达到91.66%；MASON仅用30%训练数据即超越全量数据的直接微调，且随数据量增加展现出更好的扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 现有VLM在组合式布局理解上存在显著能力缺口，MASON通过多模态对齐与结构感知的联合后训练有效弥补了这一不足，证明了高效、可扩展的布局理解训练方案的可行性。

title: Technical Comparative Benchmarking Study: Advanced AI Hybrid Methods for Renewable Energy Farm Optimization and Forecasting
summary: This study provides a comprehensive benchmarking of conventional machine learning (ML), ensemble learning, deep neural networks, recurrent architectures, Transformers, graph based models, and hybrid ensemble deep learning approaches under complementary renewable energy scenarios. Three datasets are considered: a large scale WEC dataset, a 16 WEC dataset, and operational 10 min SCADA measurements at the Penmanshiel wind farm. For structured WEC layout data, tree ensembles exhibited a clear advantage over conventional ML and neural predictors because randomized partitioning and boosting efficiently captured nonlinear layout power interactions without requiring explicit feature representation learning. The Extra Trees was the strongest model, achieving considerable results. Relative to the MLP baseline, this corresponds to an approximately 63.7% reduction in MAE, demonstrating the suitability of randomized tree ensembles for high dimensional structured WEC data. Also, STGCN reduced the MAE to approximately 167.0 kW and achieved R = 0.93 by explicitly learning spatial and temporal turbine interactions. The best overall forecasting accuracy was obtained by the RF BiLSTM hybrid, with an MAE=150.5 kW. Compared with standalone LSTM, this represents an approximately 75% reduction in MAE, while improving on STGCN by approximately 10.0%. Finally, the experiments reveal that no single AI architecture is universally optimal: randomized and boosted ensembles are particularly effective for structured WEC surrogate modeling, graph networks become advantageous when explicit spatial interactions dominate, and ensemble recurrent hybrids provide the strongest balance when nonlinear tabular relationships and temporal dynamics coexist.

AI.tldr: 本文对传统机器学习、集成学习、深度神经网络、循环架构、Transformer、图模型及混合集成深度学习方法在互补可再生能源场景下进行了全面基准测试，涵盖大规模WEC数据集、16 WEC数据集和Penmanshiel风电场10分钟SCADA运行数据。研究表明：Extra Trees在结构化WEC布局数据上表现最佳（较MLP基线MAE降低约63.7%）；STGCN通过显式学习时空交互将MAE降低至约167.0 kW（R=0.93）；RF BiLSTM混合模型整体预测精度最优（MAE=150.5 kW，较LSTM降低约75%，较STGCN提升约10%）。实验揭示没有单一AI架构普遍最优，需根据数据特性选择合适模型。
AI.motivation: 针对可再生能源（波浪能转换器WEC和风能）预测中，不同AI架构（传统ML、集成学习、深度网络、Transformer、图模型和混合方法）的适用边界不明确，缺乏系统性的跨架构基准对比研究。作者旨在全面评估各类AI方法在互补可再生能源场景下的预测性能，为模型选择提供指导性结论。
AI.method: 采用系统性基准测试框架，在三个数据集上对比八类AI方法：传统ML、集成学习、深度神经网络（DNN/MLP）、循环架构（RNN/LSTM）、Transformer、图模型（STGCN）及混合集成深度学习方法（RF BiLSTM等）。数据集包括大规模WEC结构化布局数据、16 WEC小规模数据集和Penmanshiel风电场10分钟SCADA运行数据。以MAE和相关系数R作为核心评价指标，以MLP和LSTM为基准基线进行相对性能比较。
AI.result: 1) 在结构化WEC数据上，树集成模型（尤其Extra Trees）显著优于传统ML和神经预测器，较MLP基线MAE降低约63.7%，因随机分区和提升机制能有效捕获非线性布局功率交互；2) STGCN通过显式学习空间和时间涡轮交互，将MAE降至约167.0 kW并达到R=0.93；3) RF BiLSTM混合模型综合表现最优，MAE=150.5 kW，较独立LSTM降低约75%，较STGCN再提升约10%；4) 各架构优势场景各异：随机/提升集成适合结构化WEC替代建模，图网络适合显式空间交互主导的场景，集成循环混合模型适合非线性表格关系与时间动态并存的情况。
AI.conclusion: 不存在普适最优的AI架构。模型选择应基于数据特性和任务需求：结构化WEC替代建模首选随机化树集成；空间交互主导的预测任务应使用图神经网络；兼具非线性表格特征与时间依赖的场景则推荐集成循环混合模型（如RF BiLSTM）。该研究为可再生能源预测中的AI架构选型提供了全面的实证依据。

title: Low-ASR Backdoors: Exploiting Attack Success Rate Reduction and Attacker-Defender Asymmetry
summary: Backdoor attacks are among the most effective and stealthy attacks in deep learning. Existing attacks and defenses are largely designed and evaluated under the assumption that successful backdoors exhibit high Attack Success Rates (ASRs). In this paper, we show that this assumption creates a fundamental weakness in existing defense paradigms. ASR is not an intrinsic property of a backdoor; rather, it is an attacker-controlled variable that can be deliberately reduced without eliminating the underlying backdoor behavior. We introduce a reverse-training framework that weakens the trigger-target association, producing low-ASR backdoor models while preserving clean-input performance. Through extensive evaluation across multiple datasets, diverse attack families, and multiple architectures, we show that state-of-the-art defenses fail consistently under low-ASR conditions, exposing a fundamental attacker-defender asymmetry.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了现有后门攻击防御体系的一个根本性缺陷：攻击成功率（ASR）并非后门的固有属性，而是攻击者可控的变量。作者提出一种反向训练框架，通过削弱触发器与目标标签之间的关联，生成低ASR但保持干净输入性能的后门模型。实验表明，在低ASR条件下，现有最先进的防御方法普遍失效，暴露了攻击者与防御者之间的根本性不对称。
AI.motivation: 现有后门攻击的攻防研究大多基于一个隐含假设：成功的后门攻击必然具有高攻击成功率（ASR）。作者认为这一假设是现有防御范式的根本弱点，因为ASR可以被攻击者刻意降低而不消除底层后门行为，从而使防御机制失效。
AI.method: 提出一种反向训练（reverse-training）框架，其核心思想是削弱触发器和目标标签之间的关联强度，从而在保持干净输入性能的同时，生成具有低ASR的后门模型。该方法不依赖特定攻击类型，可适配多种攻击族和网络架构。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、多种攻击类型和多种网络架构下进行广泛评估，结果显示现有最先进的防御方法在低ASR条件下持续失败，无法有效检测或防御这类低ASR后门模型。
AI.conclusion: 低ASR后门攻击揭示了攻击者与防御者之间存在根本性的不对称：ASR高低并不反映后门行为是否存在，仅仅依赖高ASR检测后门的防御范式在本质上存在可被利用的漏洞。

title: STEP: State-Aware Task Estimation and Planning with Multi-Modal LLMs for Human-Robot Collaboration
comment: Published in IEEE International Conference on Robot and Human Interactive Communication (RO-MAN), 2026, 8 pages, 4 figuers, 5 tables
summary: Effective human-robot collaboration in industrial settings requires robots to understand human intentions and assist with task planning, reducing workload. Recent works have explored the use of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MM-LLMs) for task planning in such data-scarce scenarios, leveraging in-context learning to interpret user actions and generate long-horizon action plans in natural language. However, MM-LLMs inherently lack an understanding of system states and do not track state transitions, often leading to hallucinated actions that deviate from the intended goal. Additionally, generating action plans in natural language tends to limit the generated plans to a high level, introducing ambiguity in action execution. To address these limitations, we propose the State-aware Task Estimator and Planner (STEP), which prompts a MM-LLM to explicitly estimate the state of the system and predict the state transitions resulting from executed actions. By forecasting future states alongside actions, STEP ensures task-convergent planning while also providing additional assistance parameters necessary for executing the predicted actions. We evaluate STEP in a simulated environment using a robot assembly task. Our approach outperforms the state-of-the-art by 32.8% in action executability and 14.8% in final-state error.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STEP（State-aware Task Estimator and Planner）框架，通过让多模态大语言模型显式估计系统状态并预测状态转换，解决其在人机协作任务规划中的幻觉问题，在模拟装配任务中将动作可执行性提升32.8%、最终状态误差降低14.8%。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在数据稀缺场景下被用于人机协作任务规划，但存在两个关键缺陷：一是MM-LLM缺乏对系统状态的理解且不追踪状态转换，导致产生偏离目标的幻觉动作；二是用自然语言生成动作计划往往停留在抽象层面，引入动作执行歧义。这两个问题都严重阻碍了有效的人机协作。
AI.method: STEP框架通过提示（prompt）MM-LLM显式估计系统当前状态并预测执行动作后的状态转换。在规划过程中，模型不仅预测即将执行的动作，还同时预测未来的状态，从而保证规划收敛到目标状态；同时额外输出执行预测动作所需的辅助参数（如关节位置、抓手姿态等），以消除自然语言计划带来的歧义。
AI.result: 在模拟环境中的机器人装配任务上进行评估，STEP相比现有最先进方法在动作可执行性上提升32.8%，在最终状态误差上降低14.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过在任务规划中引入显式的系统状态估计与状态转换预测，STEP有效缓解了MM-LLM的幻觉问题并提升了动作的可执行性，为多模态大模型在人机协作任务规划中的可靠应用提供了有效方案。

title: Same Model, Different Harness: Different Coding-Agent Results
comment: 24 pages, 9 figures. Software and study artifacts: https://github.com/sydches/yuj
summary:
A coding agent combines a model with a harness, which decides what the model sees, which tools it can use, and how the work continues. We ask whether changing the harness changes the result when the model and task stay fixed. We compare two configurations of the same harness on three coding benchmarks. The control supplies the full conversation in time order, while the treatment keeps the same record but mechanically shortens older tool results as the context fills and responds to repeated or stalled work.
  Under tight context, the treatment raises mean per-task fail-to-pass fraction (F2PF) in all three pressure comparisons and increases complete solutions on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro. The tight-window Verified comparison uses 169 tasks, a 20,480-token window, and a fixed 480-second attempt endpoint; on this cohort, treatment raises mean per-task F2PF from 28 percent to 49 percent and complete solutions from 43 to 72. Without model-specific retuning, the same frozen treatment also raises both endpoints on the same cohort for three additional models with different designs. In the wide-window Qwen3.6 comparisons, observed arm outcomes are close on Verified and Pro, while FeatureBench retains a higher mean per-task F2PF under treatment. On the wide-window Verified cohort, treatment also serves fewer prompt tokens per turn. Because changing the harness changed what unchanged model weights could accomplish, coding-agent evaluations should treat the model and harness together as the tested solver.

AI.tldr: 本文研究编码智能体中"模型+harness（调度框架）"的整体性。在固定模型和任务的前提下，改变harness的上下文管理策略（压缩旧工具结果、响应重复卡顿）即可显著提升性能：在紧密上下文窗口下，均值每任务fail-to-pass分数（F2PF）从28%升至49%，完整解决方案从43升至72，且该效果在多个不同架构的模型上均成立。结论是编码智能体评估应将模型与harness视为一个整体求解器。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体研究往往聚焦于模型本身的能力，而忽略了harness（决定模型看到什么、用哪些工具、如何继续工作的外围框架）对结果的影响。作者希望探究：当模型和任务完全固定时，仅改变harness配置是否会导致不同的任务结果，从而为编码智能体评估方法提供更严谨的视角。
AI.method: 在同一harness的两个配置上比较三种编码基准的表现。对照组按时间顺序提供完整对话历史；处理组在上下文填满时机械缩短较早的工具结果，并对重复或停滞的工作做出响应。在紧密上下文窗口下进行压力对比，并在同一队列上对四个不同设计的多模型进行零参数重调的冻结处理验证，同时在宽窗口设置下进行了Qwen3.6对比实验。
AI.result: 在紧密上下文的三组压力对比中，处理组均提高了均值每任务F2PF；在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro上完整解决方案增加。紧密窗口Verified基准（169任务、20480 token窗口、480秒端点）下，处理组F2PF从28%提高到49%，完整解从43提高到72。该冻结处理对另外三种不同架构的模型也有效。宽窗口下Qwen3.6在Verified和Pro上两臂结果接近，FeatureBench处理组F2PF更高，且处理组每轮提示token更少。
AI.conclusion: 改变harness确实能改变未变模型权重的任务表现，因此编码智能体的评估应将模型与harness作为一个整体求解器来对待，而非仅评价模型本身。

title: From Sound to Symptom: Real-Time Respiratory Signal Understanding for Conversational Healthcare Agents
summary: Cough events during live spoken conversations carry clinically valuable respiratory signals, yet existing dialogue systems treat them as acoustic noise to be discarded. We present HealthCUES (Clinical Understanding from Embodied Sounds), a streaming pipeline for paralinguistic respiratory monitoring in real-time conversational agents, a capability that, to the best of our knowledge, is absent from all prior systems. HealthCUES processes audio through a rolling buffer aligned with dialogue turn boundaries, enabling sub-second event detection without interrupting conversational flow. Beyond binary cough detection, the system provides fine-grained analytics: (i) differentiation between coughing and throat clearing, (ii) cough subtype classification (dry, wet, barking, whooping) with confidence scores, and (iii) temporal duration estimation with start-end boundaries. To prevent alert fatigue, HealthCUES introduces dialogue-aware gating mechanisms that modulate triggering based on conversational context. The system leverages Qwen3Omni, a multimodal large language model (MLLM), with constrained structured outputs, decomposing cough analysis into parallel prediction tasks for independent prompt optimization. Evaluation on 847 in-house conversational audio segments demonstrates 93\% F1 for cough detection, 0.75 weighted-F1 for wet/dry subtype classification, and average end-to-end latency of 340ms; external validation on the AMI meeting corpus confirms robust cough, throat-clearing, and speech separation in the presence of speech (0.91 macro-F1). A user study with licensed healthcare professionals confirms the clinical relevance of subtype information and the system's utility in telehealth workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HealthCUES，一个面向实时对话代理的流式副语言呼吸监测系统，能够在不打断对话流的情况下检测咳嗽事件并提供细粒度分析（咳嗽与清嗓区分、咳型分类、时长估计），利用Qwen3Omni多模态大语言模型和对话感知门控机制实现，在847个内部对话片段和AMI会议语料上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有对话系统将咳嗽等副语言声音视为需要丢弃的声学噪声，但实际上咳嗽事件在口语对话中承载着具有临床价值的呼吸信号。目前没有任何系统能够在实时对话代理中实现副语言呼吸监测能力，这一能力缺口是本文的核心动机。
AI.method: HealthCUES采用流式管线，通过滚动缓冲区与对话轮次边界对齐实现亚秒级事件检测，不打断对话流。系统提供超越二元咳嗽检测的细粒度分析功能：咳嗽与清嗓区分、咳型分类（干咳、湿咳、吠咳、百日咳）含置信度、带起止边界的时间长度估计。引入对话感知门控机制根据对话上下文调节触发行为以防止警报疲劳。基于Qwen3Omni多模态大语言模型，采用约束结构化输出，将咳嗽分析分解为并行预测任务以独立优化提示。
AI.result: 在847个内部对话音频片段上，咳嗽检测达93% F1，湿/干咳型分类加权F1为0.75，端到端平均延迟340ms。在AMI会议语料上的外部验证表明，在存在语音干扰时咳嗽、清嗓及语音分离性能稳健（macro-F1为0.91）。与持证医疗专业人员开展的用户研究确认了咳型信息的临床相关性和系统在远程医疗工作流中的实用性。
AI.conclusion: HealthCUES填补了实时对话系统中副语言呼吸监测能力的空白，证明了在大语言模型驱动的对话代理中实现临床级咳嗽分析的可行性，并通过内部数据集、外部语料验证和医疗专业人员用户研究三重维度验证了系统的有效性与临床实用性，为远程医疗和持续健康监测开辟了新路径。

title: Parameter Efficient Continual Learning for Sparse Event-Based Transformers
summary: Robotic and edge intelligence systems operate in dynamic environments where data arrives continuously, requiring models to adapt while preserving previously learned knowledge under strict memory and energy constraints. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning has shown promise for continual learning with vision transformers, conventional architectures rely on dense computation and remain costly for real-world deployment. Sparse event-based vision transformers provide energy-efficient event-driven computation, yet their continual learning capabilities remain largely unexplored. We here introduce sLoTh, a parameter-efficient continual learning framework for pretrained sparse event-based (spiking) vision transformers. sLoTh freezes the backbone and restricts plasticity to scalable-efficient low-rank attention updates (seLoRA) and shared neuronal threshold modulation, enabling adaptation without replay buffers by updating less than 1% of model parameters. Experiments across CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet-100, and ImageNet-R with up to 100 tasks demonstrate competitive rehearsal-free performance in class-incremental learning and online continual learning, while enabling approximately 6.5x lower energy consumption than conventional dense vision transformers.

AI.tldr: sLoTh是一个针对预训练稀疏事件驱动（脉冲）视觉Transformer的参数高效持续学习框架，通过冻结主干网络、仅更新低秩注意力模块（seLoRA）和共享神经元阈值来适应新任务，无需重放缓冲区，仅更新不到1%的参数，在多个基准数据集上取得竞争力的无重放性能，且能耗比传统密集视觉Transformer低约6.5倍。
AI.motivation: 机器人及边缘智能系统在动态环境中持续接收数据，模型需要在严格的内存和能耗约束下适应新数据同时保留已学知识。虽然参数高效微调在视觉Transformer的持续学习中已有进展，但传统架构依赖密集计算，部署成本高；稀疏事件驱动视觉Transformer能提供节能计算，但其持续学习能力尚未被探索。
AI.method: sLoTh框架采用冻结主干网络、仅更新可扩展高效低秩注意力模块（seLoRA）和共享神经元阈值调制的策略，在不使用重放缓冲区的情况下实现参数高效适应，仅更新不到1%的模型参数。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-100、Tiny-ImageNet、ImageNet-100和ImageNet-R四个基准数据集上，最多100个任务设置下，sLoTh在类增量学习（class-incremental learning）和在线持续学习（online continual learning）中取得了具有竞争力的无重放性能，同时能耗比传统密集视觉Transformer降低约6.5倍。
AI.conclusion: sLoTh首次探索了稀疏事件驱动视觉Transformer的持续学习能力，证明了通过参数高效的低秩注意力更新和阈值调制，可以在严格的资源约束下实现高效的无重放持续学习，为边缘智能系统的节能持续学习提供了可行方案。

title: Robust Neural Stimulation Response Modeling Through Meta-Learning and Pretraining
comment: Open source code available: github.com/mmattb/py-tbfm/tree/multisession. 15 pages, 10 figures
summary: Objective: Model-based closed-loop neural stimulation holds promise for therapeutic applications ranging from Parkinson's disease to sensory restoration, but deployment has been limited by two obstacles: 1) forecasting models for predicting the consequences of stimulation fail catastrophically on a meaningful fraction of sessions, and 2) per-session calibration requirements are often incompatible with clinical constraints. We address both by demonstrating, for the first time, that meta-learning and pretraining can be applied to neural stimulation response modeling. Methods: Temporal basis function models (TBFMs) forecast state-dependent neural responses to stimulation. We extend TBFMs with cross-session pretraining using a novel architecture and algorithm based on model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML), evaluating them on 40 sessions of optogenetic stimulation in primary sensorimotor cortex of two non-human primates. Results: Meta-learning substantially reduces catastrophic forecast failure: for a 1k calibration set size, sessions with test R-squared < 0.05 drop from 16 of 40 (single-session training) to 1 (MAML-pretrained), and prediction intervals become significantly narrower (p < 0.05). Calibration requirements are reduced by 50-90% at matched accuracy, enabling experiments otherwise infeasible within clinical session-time constraints. Conclusion: Our results demonstrate that cross-session structure in stimulation responses is consistent enough to support pretraining, providing the first empirical evidence that meta-learning approaches are viable for neural stimulation. Significance: The robustness and sample efficiency gains directly address known obstacles to deploying model-based stimulation controllers. Our results motivate community efforts to assemble standardized multi-site stimulation datasets and to further explore meta-learning for robust closed-loop stimulation.

AI.tldr: 本文首次证明元学习（meta-learning）和预训练可应用于神经刺激响应建模，通过基于MAML的跨会话预训练扩展时间基函数模型（TBFM），在40个视觉刺激会话中将灾难性预测失败率从16/40降至1/40，并将校准需求减少50-90%，为模型驱动的闭环神经刺激部署扫清了两大障碍。
AI.motivation: 模型驱动的闭环神经刺激在帕金森病治疗到感觉恢复等应用中前景广阔，但部署受两大障碍制约：1）预测刺激后果的预测模型在相当比例的会话中灾难性失败；2）逐会话校准要求常与临床约束不兼容。作者旨在通过元学习和预训练同时解决这两个问题。
AI.method: 使用时间基函数模型（TBFM）预测状态依赖的神经刺激响应，并创新性地将其扩展为跨会话预训练架构，基于模型无关元学习（MAML）算法。在两只非人灵长类动物初级感觉运动皮层的40个光遗传刺激会话上进行评估。
AI.result: 元学习显著降低灾难性预测失败：在1k校准集规模下，测试R²<0.05的会话从16/40（单会话训练）降至1/40（MAML预训练），且预测区间显著变窄（p<0.05）。在匹配精度下，校准需求减少50-90%，使此前在临床会话时间内不可行的实验成为可能。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明跨会话的刺激响应结构具有足够的一致性以支持预训练，提供了元学习方法对神经刺激可行的首个经验证据，其鲁棒性和样本效率的提升直接应对了模型驱动刺激控制器的部署障碍。

title: When Context Gets Root: Privilege Escalation in LLM Harnesses
summary: Instruction hierarchy is a model-side defense that assigns instructions different levels of privilege according to their sources. These levels constrain which content may direct model behavior. During agent execution, however, agent harnesses construct context for each model invocation. This construction can elevate low-level content to a higher instruction level and grant it greater model-facing privilege. We introduce instruction privilege escalation. In this attack, an attacker induces an agent to elevate low-level malicious content to a higher instruction level. The elevated content then causes the agent to execute instructions it would not follow at their original level. We evaluate this threat by using multi-agent mechanisms to achieve 13 attack objectives across six coding-agent harnesses. These objectives span confidentiality, integrity, availability, and remote code execution. With unrestricted action execution, the attacks achieve all 13 objectives on all six harnesses. Under automatic permission review, the attacks achieve all 13 objectives on all three harnesses that provide this mode. We further reproduce the vulnerability using harness-provided persistent goals and scheduled tasks. These results demonstrate the generality of instruction privilege escalation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"指令特权提升"（instruction privilege escalation）攻击，利用智能体框架（agent harness）在构造模型上下文时对指令来源的分级处理漏洞，将低级别恶意内容提升至更高级别指令，从而绕过指令层级防御，在六个编码智能体框架上实现了全部13个攻击目标（涵盖机密性、完整性、可用性和远程代码执行），证明了该漏洞的普遍性。
AI.motivation: 指令层级（instruction hierarchy）是一种模型侧防御机制，根据指令来源分配不同特权级别。然而，智能体框架在每次模型调用时构建上下文的过程可能将低级别内容提升到更高级别，从而使恶意内容获得更大模型特权。作者旨在揭示这一被忽视的攻击面。
AI.method: 作者提出"指令特权提升"攻击框架：通过多智能体机制诱导智能体将低级别恶意内容提升至更高指令级别。评估覆盖六个编码智能体框架，设计13个跨越机密性、完整性、可用性及远程代码执行类别的攻击目标，并在无限制动作执行和自动权限审查两种模式下分别测试，同时利用框架提供的持久目标和定时任务功能复现漏洞。
AI.result: 在无限制动作执行模式下，攻击在全部六个框架上达成所有13个目标；在自动权限审查模式下，攻击在提供该模式的三个框架上同样实现全部13个目标；通过框架提供的持久目标和定时任务也成功复现了该漏洞。
AI.conclusion: 指令特权提升攻击具有高度普遍性，指令层级作为模型侧防御无法独立保障智能体系统安全，需要在智能体框架层面补强上下文构造过程中的指令权限管理。

title: Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026. Project page: https://bit-pie.github.io/ESRP/ Code: https://github.com/BIT-PIE/ESRP Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/serendipity800/ESRP-PD
summary: This paper introduces Embodied Scene Rearrangement Planning (ESRP), a novel task requiring embodied agents to rearrange furniture in 3D scenes to match a target configuration using only egocentric observations and a top-down target layout. Unlike prior rearrangement tasks, ESRP precludes global state access and introduces mutual object occlusions, reflecting the practical constraints of real-world robotic deployment. These factors make aligning partial egocentric observations with the global target layout particularly challenging for long-horizon planning. To facilitate research, we present ESRP-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built on OmniGibson featuring over 5,400 scene pairs and 8,200 objects. We define three multi-level metrics to evaluate rearrangement quality and provide four baselines: a hierarchical task-and-motion planning method, a vision-language-model-based method, and two learning-based approaches (IL and RL). Experimental results demonstrate that current methods struggle to complete the task efficiently, highlighting ESRP as a challenging frontier for embodied agents in scene understanding and long-horizon task planning. This work serves as a stepping stone toward deploying intelligent agents in real-world scenarios. Project page: https://pie-lab.cn/ESRP/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的具身场景重排规划任务（ESRP），要求具身智能体仅通过以自我为中心的观察和俯视目标布局来重排3D场景中的家具。作者构建了包含5400+场景对和8200+物体的ESRP-Bench基准，定义了多层级评估指标，并提供四种基线方法进行对比。实验表明现有方法难以高效完成该任务，揭示了ESRP作为具身智能体在场景理解与长时程任务规划中的挑战性前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有重排任务通常假设智能体可以访问全局状态，这与真实机器人部署场景不符。ESRP首次引入仅凭自我中心观察和俯视目标布局进行家具重排的设置，排除全局状态访问并引入物体相互遮挡，更贴近实际机器人部署的物理约束，旨在弥合仿真与真实世界之间的差距。
AI.method: 基于OmniGibson构建了包含超过5400个场景对和8200个物体的ESRP-Bench基准；定义了三个多层级评估指标以评价重排质量；提供了四种基线方法：层次化任务与运动规划方法、基于视觉语言模型的方法，以及两种基于学习的方法（模仿学习和强化学习）。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，当前四种基线方法在完成该任务的高效性方面均表现不佳，难以高效完成任务，说明ESRP对现有具身智能体而言具有显著挑战性。
AI.conclusion: ESRP是一个具有挑战性的具身智能前沿任务，在场景理解与长时程任务规划方面对智能体提出了更高要求。该工作为在真实世界场景中部署智能体提供了铺垫和基础。

title: Using Poly-Encoders for Computationally Efficient Automated Creativity Assessment
comment: Accepted at AIED 2026. The final authenticated version is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-29755-6_32
summary: Automated creativity assessment has been a long standing challenge, with traditional methods often being resource intensive or lacking practical accuracy. We introduce a novel approach by using Poly-Encoder for computationally efficient and accurate automated creativity assessment. We fine-tuned a Poly-Encoder on a public dataset from the Scientific Creative Thinking Test, comprised of approximately 18,000 human-rated question responses. Our method leverages small pre-trained BERT encoders, achieving performance comparable to fine-tuned Large Language Models while significantly reducing computational demands. Experiments with the BERT-family models and poly-code counts achieved Pearson correlations of up to r = 0.74, 95% CI [0.73, 0.75] with human raters, matching the performance of resource intensive LLMs. This study bridges the gap between high performance and computational efficiency, potentially enabling widespread implementation of automated creativity assessment on accessible consumer-grade hardware. With some limitations, our findings suggest that Poly-Encoders are a promising alternative to LLMs for practical, scalable creativity assessment in various contexts, especially educational.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用Poly-Encoder进行自动化创造力评估，在科学创造性思维测试的约18000条人类评分数据上微调，取得与大型语言模型相当的评分性能（Pearson相关高达r=0.74），同时显著降低计算需求，使创造力评估可在消费级硬件上大规模部署。
AI.motivation: 传统的自动化创造力评估方法要么资源消耗大，要么准确度不足，长期缺乏兼顾性能与效率的解决方案。现有LLM方法虽然准确但计算成本高昂，难以普及推广。
AI.method: 采用Poly-Encoder架构，利用小型预训练BERT编码器，在公开的Scientific Creative Thinking Test数据集（约18,000条人类评分的问题回答）上进行微调，并探索不同BERT系列模型与poly-code数量对性能的影响。
AI.result: 与人类评分者的Pearson相关系数最高达到0.74（95% CI [0.73, 0.75]），性能与微调的大语言模型相当，但计算开销大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: Poly-Encoder是LLM在实用化、可扩展创造力评估中的一个有前景的替代方案，特别是在教育等场景中，能够在高准确性和计算效率之间取得平衡，但存在一定局限性。

title: UniGeo: A Multi-modal Large Language Model for Text-Guided Cross-View Geo-Localization
summary: Text-guided drone geo-localization aims to identify a target region in a large-scale image gallery from a natural-language description. Existing methods mainly formulate this task as direct matching between an open-ended text query and candidate images. However, incomplete queries and highly similar candidates often make global cross-modal matching insufficient for reliable fine-grained localization. We propose UniGeo, a unified multimodal large language model (MLLM) for text-guided drone geo-localization. Built on a shared vision-language framework, UniGeo jointly supports geo-semantic understanding, cross-view semantic generation, and candidate-level verification. Specifically, it establishes stable correspondences among local scene elements, spatial relations, and language descriptions through geo-semantic learning, and further models semantic mappings between drone and satellite views through cross-view generation. Based on these capabilities, a plug-and-play verification module performs fine-grained discrimination among highly confusable candidates. We further introduce a multi-stage training strategy that progressively learns geo-semantic understanding, cross-view generation, and candidate verification, improving adaptation to text-guided geo-localization. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements across multiple retrieval backbones. On GeoText-1652, UniGeo improves R@10 and mAP by 13.59 and 2.83 percentage points, respectively, validating its effectiveness for fine-grained text-guided drone geo-localization.

AI.tldr: UniGeo是一个统一的多模态大语言模型，用于文本引导的无人机地理定位任务。它通过联合支持地理语义理解、跨视角语义生成和候选级验证三大能力，并采用多阶段训练策略，在GeoText-1652基准上将R@10和mAP分别提升了13.59和2.83个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有文本引导的无人机地理定位方法主要将任务建模为开放文本查询与候选图像之间的直接全局跨模态匹配。然而，不完整的查询描述和高度相似的候选图像使得全局匹配难以实现可靠的细粒度定位，亟需更强大的建模方法。
AI.method: UniGeo构建在共享的视觉-语言框架之上，包含三个核心能力模块：(1) 地理语义学习，建立局部场景元素、空间关系与语言描述之间的稳定对应；(2) 跨视角生成，建模无人机视角与卫星视角之间的语义映射；(3) 即插即用的候选验证模块，对高混淆度候选进行细粒度判别。此外提出多阶段训练策略，渐进式学习三种能力以提升对文本引导地理定位任务的适应性。
AI.result: 在GeoText-1652基准上，UniGeo将R@10提升了13.59个百分点，mAP提升了2.83个百分点，并在多个检索骨干网络上展现一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 实验验证了UniGeo在细粒度文本引导无人机地理定位任务上的有效性，表明通过同时建模地理语义理解、跨视角生成和候选级验证，可以有效克服全局跨模态匹配在面对不完整查询和高相似候选时的不足。

title: When Privacy Hurts Mergeability: Geometry-Aware Model Merging under Differential Privacy
summary: Model merging promises to construct a single multi-task model from independently fine-tuned task models without accessing the original task data. This makes it attractive when task data cannot be centralized, but released task models may still leak private fine-tuning data. Differential privacy (DP) provides a principled mechanism for limiting such leakage, yet its effect on model merging remains poorly understood. In this paper, we study the geometry of differentially private model merging and identify two geometric obstacles that make private task models difficult to merge: \emph{local sharpness}, which makes task losses sensitive to the parameter displacement induced by merging, and \emph{reference drift}, which measures the displacement of private task models from the shared pretrained initialization and amplifies cross-task interference. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{DP-Merging}, a geometry-aware framework that improves the mergeability of differentially private task models. DP-Merging uses a DP-compatible sharpness-aware objective to guide each private task model toward flatter loss regions, and a reference-based alignment regularizer to keep task models close to the shared pretrained initialization. We derive a merge-gap upper bound showing that reducing local curvature and reference drift tightens the bound on the loss increase induced by merging. Experiments on vision and language tasks across multiple privacy budgets show that DP-Merging consistently improves private merged-model performance while preserving the privacy guarantees of the underlying DP fine-tuning procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DP-Merging，一个基于几何感知的框架，用于改善差分隐私（DP）微调模型的合并能力。通过识别并解决两个几何障碍——局部尖锐性（local sharpness）和参考漂移（reference drift），DP-Merging在保持DP隐私保证的同时，显著提升了私有任务模型合并后的多任务性能。
AI.motivation: 模型合并技术可以从独立微调的任务模型中构建多任务模型，无需访问原始任务数据，这在数据无法集中时很有吸引力。但发布的模型可能泄露私有微调数据，DP提供了限制这种泄露的原则性机制，然而DP对模型合并的影响此前缺乏深入研究。本文旨在理解并克服DP任务模型难以合并的几何障碍。
AI.method: DP-Merging框架包含两个核心组件：(1) DP兼容的锐度感知（sharpness-aware）目标函数，引导每个私有任务模型走向更平坦的损失区域，降低局部尖锐性；(2) 基于参考的对齐正则化器，使任务模型保持靠近共享的预训练初始化，从而减小参考漂移。此外，本文推导了合并差距（merge-gap）的上界，证明降低局部曲率和参考漂移可以收紧合并导致的损失增加的上界。
AI.result: 在多种隐私预算下，对视觉和语言任务的实验表明，DP-Merging一致性地提升了私有合并模型的性能，同时保持了底层DP微调过程的隐私保证。
AI.conclusion: DP-Merging通过几何感知的框架有效解决了差分隐私任务模型难以合并的问题，为隐私保护场景下的多任务模型构建提供了可行的方案，兼顾了隐私安全与合并性能。

title: Beyond F1: Evaluating Coverage and Failure Recovery in AI Model Security Scanners
summary: Static scanners are increasingly used to identify executable or otherwise unsafe content in machine- learning artifacts, yet conventional evaluation metrics characterize only cases where a scanner yields a usable security judgment. We evaluate ModelScan, ModelAudit, and Fickling using a controlled, artifact-backed benchmark on a synthetic corpus of 170 Pickle and PyTorch focused artifacts across 145 specimen families, 135 of which have binary security ground truth and 10 of which are intentionally malformed without labels. We explicitly distinguish non-N/A coverage, analysis completion, definitive security decisions, non-security findings, and unsupported outcomes. On labeled families, ModelAudit produced definitive security decisions for all 135 families (100%), Fickling for 110 (81.5%), and ModelScan for 67 (49.6%). Conditional on making a definitive judgment, ModelScan achieved 100% precision, recall, and F1. Fickling identified no unique true- positive families beyond those found by the combination of ModelAudit and ModelScan. Furthermore, for the 48 malicious families where ModelScan failed to complete its analysis, both ModelAudit and Fickling generated detections consistent with ground truth. These findings underscore the need to separate judgment accuracy from judgment availability, as well as incremental detection coverage from tool-level redundancy.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个包含170个人工合成工件（145个标本族）的基准测试，对比了ModelScan、ModelAudit和Fickling三种机器学习工件静态扫描器的实际安全判定能力。研究发现ModelAudit在所有135个带标签家族上均做出了明确安全判定（100%），Fickling为81.5%，ModelScan仅为49.6%；但ModelScan在做出判定时达到了100%的精确率、召回率和F1分数。此外，ModelScan未能完成分析的48个恶意家族中，ModelAudit和Fickling均产生了与基准真相一致的检测结果，表明需要将判定准确性与判定可得性、增量检测覆盖率与工具级冗余性分开评估。
AI.motivation: 现有静态扫描器评估指标仅关注扫描器能给出可用安全判定时的表现，忽略了扫描器无法完成分析或无法给出明确判定的情况。对于机器学习工件（如Pickle和PyTorch模型）中的恶意内容检测，这种评估偏差会高估工具的实际安全性，需要更细粒度的评估框架来区分覆盖率、分析完成度、确定性判定等不同维度。
AI.method: 构建了一个受控的、基于真实工件的合成基准测试数据集，包含170个Pickle和PyTorch聚焦工件，覆盖145个标本族（其中135个具有二元安全基准真相标签，10个是故意损坏但无标签的）。在评估中明确区分了非N/A覆盖率、分析完成度、确定性安全判定、非安全发现和不受支持的结果五种结果类型，并分别评估了ModelScan、ModelAudit和Fickling三种扫描器。
AI.result: 在有标签的135个家族上：ModelAudit对全部135个家族（100%）做出了确定性安全判定；Fickling为110个（81.5%）；ModelScan仅为67个（49.6%）。ModelScan在做出确定性判定的条件下达到了100%的精确率、召回率和F1。Fickling没有发现任何超越ModelAudit和ModelScan组合所能发现的独特真阳性家族。此外，在ModelScan未能完成分析的48个恶意家族中，ModelAudit和Fickling的检测结果均与基准真相一致。
AI.conclusion: 评估静态扫描器时必须将判定准确性与判定可得性分开衡量——ModelScan虽然准确性最高，但大量分析失败导致其可用性受限；同时需要区分增量检测覆盖与工具间冗余，Fickling在ModelAudit和ModelScan组合之外未能提供额外价值。这提示安全评估实践中应组合使用互补工具，而非依赖单一扫描器。

title: FlashVLA: Streaming Action Decoding for Fast and Asynchronous VLA Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are increasingly promising for robotic manipulation, yet their real-world deployment remains bottlenecked by high inference latency and unstable asynchronous execution. This challenge is particularly pronounced in flow-matching-based VLA models, where action decoding requires multiple iterative steps conditioned on the VLM context. While efficient inference methods improve control frequency and asynchronous methods reduce execution idle time, existing approaches often fail to jointly achieve low-latency inference and accurate, temporally consistent asynchronous execution. We introduce \textbf{FlashVLA}, a streaming action decoding framework that addresses both challenges in a unified formulation. FlashVLA maintains a streaming action buffer with multiple chunks at different noise levels and decodes them using chunk-wise causal attention. This design allows FlashVLA to produce one executable action chunk per inference step. Moreover, its chunk-wise autoregressive formulation implicitly preserves action continuity, enabling smooth asynchronous execution without extra future-state conditioning. Across extensive simulated and real-world experiments, FlashVLA substantially improves inference speed while maintaining strong task performance. It can achieve $\geq$30\,Hz control frequency on a single GPU with smooth asynchronous inference in real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: FlashVLA是一个流式动作解码框架，通过维护多噪声级别的流式动作缓冲区并结合分块因果注意力，在统一框架中同时解决了流匹配VLA模型的高推理延迟和异步执行不稳定的问题，实现了单GPU上≥30Hz的控制频率和流畅的异步推理。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作中日益重要，但实际部署受限于高推理延迟和不稳定的异步执行。特别是流匹配（flow-matching）类VLA模型，动作解码需要多轮迭代且依赖VLM上下文，导致控制频率低。现有高效推理方法和异步方法往往只解决单一问题，无法同时实现低延迟推理与准确、时间一致的异步执行。
AI.method: FlashVLA提出统一的流式动作解码框架：(1) 维护一个包含多个不同噪声级别动作块的流式动作缓冲区；(2) 利用分块因果注意力（chunk-wise causal attention）进行解码；(3) 每个推理步骤产生一个可执行的动作块；(4) 通过分块自回归公式隐式保持动作连续性，无需额外的未来状态条件，从而支持平滑的异步执行。
AI.result: 在大量仿真和真实世界实验中，FlashVLA显著提升了推理速度同时保持强任务性能，在单GPU上可实现≥30Hz的控制频率，并在真实部署中实现平滑的异步推理。
AI.conclusion: FlashVLA通过统一的流式动作解码框架，在保持任务性能的前提下大幅提升推理速度并实现平滑异步执行，有效解决了流匹配VLA模型在实际部署中的延迟和执行一致性问题。

title: LLM Agents for Time-Series: A Survey
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly being developed for time-series problems, but their design choices vary substantially across task settings. This survey adopts a problem-driven taxonomy that organizes these systems by the time-series problems they address rather than by isolated technical components. We group existing systems into four categories: forecasting and reasoning, augmentation and synthesis, anomaly detection and diagnosis, and decision support. Within each category, we examine how task requirements shape agent architecture, tool use, and memory design. We further summarize representative datasets and environments, and compare reported model performance under shared or closely related settings. Overall, this survey offers a task-oriented guide to designing LLM-based agents for time-series problems and identifies open gaps for future work.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述采用问题驱动的分类体系，将基于LLM的智能体在时间序列问题上的系统按其所解决的任务分为四类：预测与推理、增强与合成、异常检测与诊断、决策支持，并系统分析了各类别中任务需求如何塑造智能体的架构、工具使用和记忆设计。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在时间序列问题中的开发日益增多，但不同任务场景下的设计选择差异很大，缺乏系统地按问题类型组织的研究，需要为从业者提供任务导向的设计指南。
AI.method: 采用问题驱动的分类学（problem-driven taxonomy），将现有系统按时间序列问题分为四类：预测与推理、增强与合成、异常检测与诊断、决策支持；对每个类别考察任务需求如何影响智能体架构、工具使用和记忆设计；总结代表性数据集与环境，并在共享或相近设置下比较报告中的模型性能。
AI.result: 提供了四个类别中LLM智能体设计的系统化分析，总结并比较了代表性数据集、环境以及模型性能，揭示了任务需求与智能体设计之间的映射关系。
AI.conclusion: 该综述提供了一份面向任务的LLM智能体设计指南，并指出了未来研究的开放空白点。

title: Hallucinations in LLMs: A Lifecycle-Based Survey of Causes, Detection, Mitigation, and Prevention
summary: The lifecycle of hallucination in LLMs is a concept that enables building solid frameworks on the control and reliability of LLMs in high-stakes environments, including health, legal, and scientific research. Although previous surveys have primarily focused on detection or mitigation, this survey provides a lifecycle-based overview of the hallucinations in the LLMs, their cause, detection, mitigation, and prevention.We propose a three-fold categorization of hallucinations across the LLM lifecycle: data-related, training-related, and inference-related, which is consistent with the lifecycle of the development of the LLM. Each of these stages is discussed regarding the cause of hallucinations, their detection, and the ways they can be addressed under specific mitigation or prevention interventions. In addition, we discuss the available benchmark data using a number of parameters so as to establish their suitability in identifying, restricting and managing hallucinations. The survey provides researchers and practitioners with a standardized framework to understand, diagnose, and cure hallucinations in a systematic system to present actionable data to build safer and more reliable LLMs.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文从生命周期视角系统性地回顾了大型语言模型（LLM）中幻觉现象的成因、检测、缓解与预防，提出了数据相关、训练相关和推理相关三类幻觉的划分框架，并评估了现有基准数据的适用性。
AI.motivation: 在高风险场景（如医疗、法律、科学研究）中，LLM的幻觉问题对可靠性和安全性构成严重威胁。现有综述大多仅聚焦于幻觉的检测或缓解单一环节，缺乏从LLM整个生命周期角度出发的系统性梳理。因此，需要一种统一的生命周期框架来全面理解幻觉的成因及全流程管控策略。
AI.method: 本文提出一个基于LLM生命周期的三重分类框架：数据相关幻觉、训练相关幻觉和推理相关幻觉。每一类分别从幻觉成因、检测方法以及对应的缓解或预防干预手段三个维度进行讨论。此外，还从多个参数维度分析了现有基准数据集在识别、限制和管理幻觉方面的适用性。
AI.result: 提供了一个标准化的生命周期框架，帮助研究人员和实践者系统地理解、诊断和处理LLM幻觉，并给出了基准数据评估结果，为构建更安全可靠的LLM提供可操作的指导方案。
AI.conclusion: 该综述通过生命周期视角整合了幻觉的成因、检测、缓解与预防，为高可靠性LLM系统的开发提供了系统化方法论，弥补了以往仅关注单一环节的研究空白。

title: GeoMAD: Geometry-Aware Multi-View Anomaly Detection via Deformable Fusion and Distributional Alignment
summary: Multi-view anomaly detection (MvAD) detects defects by exploiting complementary observations from multiple camera viewpoints. The central challenge is to fuse views with sufficient geometric awareness while remaining scalable to multi-class industrial settings. Existing methods typically fall into two extremes: voxel-based fusion provides explicit geometric alignment but requires costly 3D construction and class-specific assumptions, whereas lightweight patch-based fusion is efficient but relies on discrete candidate matching and lacks continuous cross-view correspondence. In this paper, we propose GeoMAD, a unified multi-view, multi-class AD framework that addresses both geometric correspondence deficiency and distributional inconsistency. Our \textit{Cross-view Deformable Fusion Module} (CDFM) learns content-adaptive, view-pair-specific sampling offsets directly on 2D feature maps and arranges them across a multi-scale window pyramid with image-global reference sampling, enabling hierarchical cross-view correspondence without camera calibration, voxel construction, or class-specific 3D supervision. We further introduce \textit{Distributional View Alignment} (DVA), a self-supervised cross-view regularization loss that aligns each view's bottleneck distribution against a per-instance view-centric target, enforcing global consistency without pixel-level correspondence. Together, CDFM and DVA bridge local geometric correspondence and global distributional consistency, providing geometry-aware and distribution-consistent fusion while preserving the efficiency of 2D feature-space learning. Extensive experiments on Real-IAD and MANTA-Tiny show that GeoMAD achieves strong detection and localization performance in unified MvAD.

AI.tldr: GeoMAD是一个统一的多视角、多类别异常检测框架，通过跨视角可变形融合模块（CDFM）实现几何感知的层次化跨视角对应，并引入分布视角对齐（DVA）正则化损失保证各视角瓶颈分布的全局一致性，在保持2D特征空间学习效率的同时，在Real-IAD和MANTA-Tiny数据集上取得了优异的检测与定位性能。
AI.motivation: 现有MvAD方法存在两个极端：基于体素的融合虽提供显式几何对齐，但需要昂贵的3D构建和类别特定假设；轻量级基于补丁的融合虽高效，但依赖离散候选匹配，缺乏连续的跨视角对应。此外，多视角之间存在分布不一致性问题。
AI.method: 提出GeoMAD框架，包含两个核心模块：(1) 跨视角可变形融合模块（CDFM）——在2D特征图上直接学习内容自适应、视角对特定的采样偏移，并通过多尺度窗口金字塔和图像全局参考采样实现层次化跨视角对应，无需相机标定、体素构建或类别特定的3D监督；(2) 分布视角对齐（DVA）——自监督跨视角正则化损失，将每个视角的瓶颈分布对齐到每实例的视角中心目标，在不依赖像素级对应的情况下实现全局一致性。
AI.result: 在Real-IAD和MANTA-Tiny数据集上的大量实验表明，GeoMAD在统一MvAD设定下取得了强大的检测和定位性能，同时保持了2D特征空间学习的高效性。
AI.conclusion: CDFM和DVA共同桥接了局部几何对应与全局分布一致性，提供了几何感知、分布一致的融合方案，在保持2D特征空间学习效率的同时，有效解决了多视角异常检测中的几何对应不足和分布不一致问题。

title: Simple Actors and Deep Critics for Scalable Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent progress in offline reinforcement learning (RL) has been driven by expressive generative actors such as diffusion and flow-matching policies, which capture multimodal behavior in offline datasets. However, these actors require multiple denoising or integration steps per action and thus incur substantial overhead at every decision in deployment. In this work, we revisit where capacity should be invested in an offline actor--critic method. Since the critic is used only during training and is discarded at deployment while the actor runs at every decision step, allocating capacity to the critic rather than the actor is more favorable for inference-time efficiency. However, scaling MLP critics in offline RL is known to introduce several distinct instabilities that have, in practice, kept critics shallow. We identify three distinct failure modes that arise when critics are deepened in offline RL---optimization, bootstrap-noise amplification, and value-range drift---and address each with a corresponding ingredient: a residual MLP backbone, n-step bootstrap targets, and a categorical cross-entropy loss. Combining these ingredients with a lightweight deterministic actor, we propose LAC (Light Actor, deep Critic). On OGBench, LAC matches the strongest diffusion- and flow-matching baselines while achieving up to 4x lower inference latency, comparable to one-step distilled policies without distillation. Its critic recipe also transfers across actor parametrizations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LAC（轻量Actor、深度Critic）方法，重新审视离线强化学习中actor-critic架构的能力分配问题，将计算容量更多投入critic而非actor，在保持与扩散/流匹配策略相当性能的同时，实现最高4倍推理延迟降低。
AI.motivation: 离线强化学习中，生成式actor（如扩散、流匹配策略）虽能捕捉多模态行为，但每次决策需要多次去噪/积分步骤，导致部署时显著推理开销。由于critic仅在训练时使用、部署时被丢弃，而actor每步决策都要运行，将容量分配给critic而非actor更有利于推理效率。然而，扩展MLP critic在离线RL中已知会引入多种不稳定性，实践中critic通常保持较浅。
AI.method: 识别出离线RL中加深critic时的三种失败模式：优化问题、自举噪声放大和值域漂移，并分别用三个组件解决：(1) 残差MLP骨干网络解决优化问题；(2) n步自举目标缓解自举噪声放大；(3) 分类交叉熵损失处理值域漂移。将上述组件与轻量确定性actor结合，提出LAC方法。
AI.result: 在OGBench基准上，LAC与最强的扩散和流匹配基线性能相当，同时实现最高4倍推理延迟降低，推理速度与一步蒸馏策略相当且无需蒸馏过程。其critic配方还可跨actor参数化迁移。
AI.conclusion: 通过将容量从actor重新分配到critic，LAC证明了在离线RL中可以用轻量actor配合深度critic在保持高性能的同时大幅提升部署推理效率，为离线RL中的架构设计提供了新方向。

title: RedEvoAgent: Automatic Red-Teaming Agent with Experience-Driven Skill Evolution
summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in product-level execution harnesses, where jailbreaks can trigger harmful tool use and persistent state changes, creating greater risks than unsafe text generation alone. Existing automatic red-teaming methods often rely on fixed attacks, while recent agentic attackers coordinate multiple jailbreak tools and show stronger potential through trajectory-based retrieval. However, such retrieval can reuse misleading experiences due to retrieval bias and unclear tool credit, and full trajectories add context overhead while reducing interpretability. We propose RedEvoAgent, a black-box red-teaming agent that distills cross-case attack trajectories into a concise, human-readable attack skill. The attack skill adaptively evolves through tool-effectiveness profiling and Deciding-Tool Attribution for skill updates, and a validation ratchet that retains only updates improving validation performance. Experiments on multiple benchmarks, target models, and target execution harnesses show that RedEvoAgent outperforms fixed and agentic baselines, improves tool efficiency, and transfers across attacker models and target execution harnesses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RedEvoAgent，一种黑盒红队代理，将跨案例攻击轨迹蒸馏为简洁可读的攻击技能，通过工具有效性分析和决策工具归因自适应演化技能，并采用验证棘轮仅保留能提升验证性能的更新。实验表明其在多个基准、目标模型和执行平台上优于固定攻击和代理基线，提升了工具效率并具有良好的跨模型和跨平台迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体被部署在产品级执行环境中，越狱攻击可能触发有害工具调用和持久状态改变，风险远超单纯的文本生成。现有自动红队方法依赖固定攻击，而最近的智能体攻击者虽然协调多种越狱工具并通过轨迹检索展现更强潜力，但轨迹检索存在检索偏差、工具归因不清晰问题，且完整轨迹带来上下文开销并降低可解释性。
AI.method: RedEvoAgent通过三个核心机制实现：1) 将跨案例的攻击轨迹蒸馏为简洁、人类可读的攻击技能（attack skill）；2) 基于工具有效性分析（tool-effectiveness profiling）和决策工具归因（Deciding-Tool Attribution）进行技能的自适应演化更新；3) 引入验证棘轮（validation ratchet），仅保留那些能提升验证性能的技能更新，防止退化。
AI.result: 在多个基准、目标模型和目标执行平台上，RedEvoAgent优于固定攻击基线和智能体攻击基线，显著提升工具效率（工具调用更少），并展现出跨攻击者模型和跨目标执行平台的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: RedEvoAgent通过将攻击经验蒸馏为可解释的攻击技能而非原始完整轨迹，有效解决了检索偏差和工具归因不清的问题，在降低上下文开销的同时提升越狱攻击效率和可迁移性，为产品级LLM智能体执行环境的红队测试提供了更高效、更可靠的方案。

title: CLAP: Cross-Embodiment Video World Models are Zero-Shot Physical Simulators
summary: State-of-the-art action-conditioned video models are typically restricted to a single robot embodiment, preventing them from leveraging the vast corpus of heterogeneous video data that contains rich signals for learning generalizable physics. To bridge this gap, we introduce CLAP, a framework for cross-embodiment action-conditioned video generation capable of being trained on diverse, internet-scale videos across human and robotic agents. CLAP is grounded in the insight that universal physical laws govern spatiotemporal dynamics regardless of the actor. However, cross-embodiment learning is non-trivial because action representations vary sharply across robot platforms and are typically absent in human videos. CLAP addresses this fundamental challenge through the following core contributions. First, CLAP reconciles disparate action spaces using end-effector poses, language instructions, and latent actions. Second, to resolve their individual limitations, CLAP introduces a curriculum-based cross-embodiment learning recipe that first learns foundational physical priors across unlabeled video data using latent actions and subsequently grounds them in end-effector action spaces for zero-shot deployment to real-world tasks. Crucially, CLAP approaches or surpasses state-of-the-art single-embodiment video models in challenging environments like DROID. These performance advantages compound via few-shot adaptation to establish a novel paradigm for training single-embodiment video world models. Ultimately, CLAP delivers the most comprehensive suite of action-conditioned video world models to date - spanning diverse action-conditioning spaces (end-effector, language, and latent) and robot morphologies (including cross-embodiment, DROID, Bridge, bimanual YAM robots, and G1 humanoids). We open-source all code and models. Project Website at https://omni-clap.github.io .

AI.tldr: CLAP是一个跨具身动作条件视频生成框架，利用潜在动作在无标签异构视频数据上学习通用物理先验，再通过课程式跨具身学习策略将其绑定到末端执行器动作空间，实现零样本部署及超越单具身视频模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件视频模型通常局限于单一机器人具身，无法利用丰富的异构视频数据（包含人类和各类机器人动作）来学习通用物理规律。不同机器人平台的动作表示差异巨大，且人类视频中通常缺失动作标签，这使得跨具身学习难以实现。
AI.method: CLAP通过三个核心贡献实现：1) 使用末端执行器位姿、语言指令和潜在动作来调和不同动作空间；2) 提出课程式跨具身学习范式，先在无标签视频上用潜在动作学习基础物理先验，再将其绑定到末端执行器动作空间实现零样本真实世界部署；3) 开放全部代码和模型。
AI.result: CLAP在DROID等挑战性环境中达到或超越最先进的单具身视频模型，且通过少量样本适应可进一步放大性能优势，形成训练单具身视频世界模型的新范式。CLAP提供了涵盖广泛动作条件空间和机器人形态的最全面动作条件视频世界模型套件。
AI.conclusion: CLAP验证了跨具身视频世界模型的有效性，证明了利用潜在动作学习通用物理先验再迁移到具体动作空间的课程式训练策略是可行的，为视频世界模型训练树立了新范式。

title: The Reasoning Tax: Token Economics of LLM Reasoning Across Task Types and Deployment Contexts
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures and tables, accepted at the 2026 TPCTC Conference and will be published at Performance Evaluation and Benchmarking (Springer)
summary: Accuracy-only benchmarking of reasoning-capable large language models misses a central deployment question: when do extended thinking tokens earn their cost? We introduce the Token Economy Score (TES), a marginal benchmarking metric that measures the accuracy gain of a reasoning model over a non-reasoning baseline, normalized by the generated-token multiplier. We define paired and approximated TES variants for model families with reasoning toggles and frontier models without direct non-reasoning counterparts. We then conduct an empirical benchmarking analysis across 151 model-benchmark evaluation runs on seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, science reasoning, instruction following, expert knowledge, knowledge recall, and research-level physics. The analysis examines three deployment-facing dimensions: which task structures yield positive marginal reasoning efficiency, how increasing reasoning effort changes TES within model families, and how deployment context changes economic viability. Results show that task structure predicts reasoning efficiency better than nominal difficulty: sequential inferencechain tasks such as AIME 2025 and LiveCodeBench show high TES, while knowledge-recall tasks such as MMLU-Pro show low TES despite their difficulty. We also find systematic diminishing returns at higher reasoning effort levels, including cases where additional thinking reduces accuracy. Finally, Reasoning Cost Share (RCS) shows that inference spend is often dominated by internal thinking, while Deployment Cost Multiplier (DCM) shows how on-premises deployment can change the economics of otherwise costly reasoning workloads. These findings support a benchmarking-driven model-selection rule: enable reasoning selectively by task type, effort level, and deployment context rather than treating it as a universally beneficial mode.

AI.tldr: 提出Token经济得分（TES）这一边际基准指标，衡量推理模型相对于非推理基线的准确率增益与生成token倍率的比值，并通过151个模型-基准评估运行的分析，揭示了任务结构而非名义难度是推理效率的更好预测因子，同时发现高推理努力水平下存在系统性边际收益递减，支持按任务类型、努力水平和部署场景选择性启用推理的策略。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖准确性来评估推理能力型大语言模型，忽略了推理token在部署中的真实成本效益问题——即扩展思考何时值得其付出的推理成本。现有的基准方法无法回答推理模式在何种任务和场景下具有经济合理性。
AI.method: 提出Token经济得分（TES）作为边际基准指标，定义为推理模型相对非推理基线的准确率增益除以生成token倍率。定义配对版本（适用于有推理开关的模型族）和近似版本（适用于无直接非推理对照的前沿模型）。在7个基准（数学、代码生成、科学推理、指令跟随、专家知识、知识回忆、研究级物理）上进行151个模型-基准评估运行的实证分析，同时引入推理成本占比（RCS）和部署成本乘数（DCM）指标，从三个部署维度（任务结构、推理努力程度、部署场景）进行评估。
AI.result: 任务结构比名义难度更能预测推理效率：顺序推理链任务（如AIME 2025和LiveCodeBench）呈现高TES，而知识回忆任务（如MMLU-Pro）即使难度较高也呈现低TES。在高推理努力水平下存在系统性边际收益递减，甚至出现额外思考反而降低准确率的案例。RCS表明推理开销常被内部思考主导，DCM则显示本地部署可以改变高成本推理任务的经济性。
AI.conclusion: 应基于基准驱动的模型选择规则：按任务类型、努力水平和部署情境选择性地启用推理，而非将其视为普适有益的默认模式。TES及相关指标为部署决策提供了量化工具，支持在推理成本与准确性收益之间做出更经济合理的权衡。

title: Lost in Compression: A Controlled Cross-Lingual Audit of Extractive Prompt Compressors
summary: Extractive prompt compression promises to cut LLM inference costs by removing low-information tokens, and learned compressors such as LLMLingua-2 report strong results on English benchmarks. Most other languages already pay a token premium: the same content costs 1.3-1.8x more tokens than in English. We ask whether compression closes or widens this gap. Using fully parallel data in ten languages spanning five scripts, with controls budget-matched in the target model's tokenizer, we audit four learned compressors against four deterministic baselines, on eleven target models from ten vendors (over 250,000 evaluation calls). Three of the compressors are trained with English supervision (LLMLingua-2 XLM-R/mBERT; Kompress-v2 from the production Headroom stack); the fourth, XProvence, is trained multilingually. First, the transfer gap is real, replicates across target models and compressor backbones, and is strongly rate-dependent: at a 0.33 keep-rate English retains 57-62% of normalized context utilization while Lithuanian retains 10-24% and Chinese essentially none, despite Chinese having the smallest token premium. Second, the gap tracks compression supervision data, not architecture. All three English-trained compressors show it, deterministic methods show no comparable gap, and the multilingually trained XProvence v1 shows none. Its v2 release, retrained on translated data, empties 92% of Chinese contexts at its aggressive threshold without any warning. Third, in a harder long-context setting, aggressive learned compression drives compressed contexts to or below no-context utility in three of five non-English languages. A translate-then-compress pipeline matches or beats native compression at roughly half the token cost in three of five tested languages. We release all code, compressions, and model outputs. Safe compression budgets are much smaller outside English.

AI.tldr: 本文系统审计了抽取式提示压缩器在英语以外的语言上的表现。基于十种语言、五种文字、超过25万次评估调用，发现压缩的跨语言迁移差距真实存在且强烈依赖保留率：英语压缩器在0.33保留率下保留57-62%的归一化上下文利用率，而中文几乎为零。差距由压缩训练数据的语言监督决定而非架构，多语言训练的XProvence v1无此差距，但其v2版本在激进阈值下会清空92%的中文上下文。在长上下文场景中，激进的学者压缩在五种非英语语言中的三种将压缩上下文压缩到低于无上下文效用水平。
AI.motivation: 英语以外的大多数语言在token使用上本就比英语贵1.3-1.8倍，而现有学习型压缩器（如LLMLingua-2）主要在英语基准上报告结果。作者想知道压缩是缩小还是扩大了不同语言之间的token成本差距，并检验压缩器的跨语言泛化能力。
AI.method: 使用十种语言（覆盖五种文字系统）的完全平行数据，控制目标模型分词器的预算匹配，审计四种学习型压缩器（LLMLingua-2的XLM-R/mBERT两个版本、Kompress-v2、多语言训练的XProvence）与四种确定性基线，在来自十个供应商的十一个目标模型上进行超过25万次评估调用。压缩器分为三类：三个用英语监督训练，一个多语言训练。
AI.result: 发现三点：(1)跨语言转移差距真实存在、在目标模型和压缩器骨干上可复现、且强烈依赖保留率——在0.33保留率下英语保留57-62%归一化上下文利用率，立陶宛语仅10-24%，中文几乎为零；(2)差距源于压缩监督数据而非架构——三个英语训练的压缩器都表现差距，确定性方法无此差距，多语言训练的XProvence v1无差距，但其v2被翻译数据重训后在激进阈值下清空92%的中文上下文且无警告；(3)长上下文场景中，激进学者压缩使五种非英语语言中的三种压缩到低于无上下文效用。翻译后再压缩的流程在五种语言中的三种中匹配或超过原生压缩，且token成本约减半。
AI.conclusion: 英语之外的"安全压缩预算"远小于英语。当前生产级学者压缩器在其他语言上存在系统性能力退化，压缩在非英语语言上可能反而"扩大"token差距而非缩小。建议采用翻译后压缩管线，并警示多语言重训练并不自动保证安全（XProvence v2的退步案例）。

title: Generative Semantic Scene Completion
comment: 18 pages, 12 figures, 4 tables. Supplementary material (29 pages) is included as an ancillary file. Project page: https://shichen.world/GSSC-project-page/ - Code, models and the PS$^3$ dataset: https://github.com/BillyChern/GSSC-S2D2
summary: Outdoor LiDAR semantic scene completion (SSC) recovers a dense semantic voxel grid from a scan observing 1% of the target volume, under class imbalance beyond 7,000x. We recast SSC as generative semantic scene completion (GSSC): a single discrete-diffusion formulation in three roles. First, paired sparse-dense scene synthesis (PS$^3$) generates matched sparse LiDAR observations with their dense semantic completions, addressing the long tail at its source and yielding the PS$^3$-SemanticKITTI corpus we train on alongside SemanticKITTI. Second, semantic-guided generative scene completion (SGSC) generates the scene from noise with multinomial discrete diffusion, conditioned on the sparse scan through a bird's-eye-view semantic map and a sparse 3D feature stream. Third, the same framework instead refines an existing completion in one flow-matching step: structured source discrete diffusion (S$^2$D$^2$). S$^2$D$^2$ improves the mIoU of SGSC's own output and every external SSC base tested, without base retraining or test-time adaptation. On the strongest base, one step without test-time augmentation reaches 38.8% mIoU on the SemanticKITTI hidden test. To our knowledge that is the best causal, single-sweep, single-sample result on that leaderboard, +2.1 pp over the previous best published score under the same restriction. Four correction steps with eight-view test-time augmentation reach 39.2%, outside that restriction.

AI.tldr: 本文将户外LiDAR语义场景补全（SSC）重铸为生成式语义场景补全（GSSC），提出一个统一的离散扩散框架，同时实现配对稀疏-稠密场景合成（PS³）、语义引导生成场景补全（SGSC）和结构化源离散扩散（S²D²）三种角色。该方法在SemanticKITTI隐藏测试集上单步推理达到38.8% mIoU，是该榜单上因果、单扫描、单样本的最佳结果，较此前最优成绩提升2.1个百分点。
AI.motivation: 户外LiDAR语义场景补全面临两大挑战：扫描仅覆盖目标体积的1%，且类别不平衡超过7000倍。现有的SSC方法受限于数据稀缺和长尾分布，难以有效处理稀疏观测下的稠密语义推断问题。
AI.method: 论文提出统一的多项式离散扩散框架GSSC，包含三种角色：(1) PS³：生成配对稀疏LiDAR观测与其稠密语义补全数据，缓解长尾问题；(2) SGSC：以鸟瞰语义图和稀疏3D特征流为条件，从噪声生成场景的语义补全；(3) S²D²：通过单步流匹配对已有补全结果进行精炼，无需对基础模型重新训练或测试时自适应。
AI.result: S²D²精炼提升了SGSC自身输出及所有外部SSC基线的mIoU。在最强基线上，无测试时增强的单步推理在SemanticKITTI隐藏测试集达到38.8% mIoU，为该榜单上因果、单扫描、单样本条件下的最佳结果，较此前最优高2.1个百分点；四次校正加八视角测试时增强可达39.2% mIoU。
AI.conclusion: 生成式框架GSSC将数据合成、场景生成和精炼统一在同一离散扩散框架中，有效解决了SSC中数据稀缺与长尾分布的核心问题，并通过一种无需重训练的精炼机制显著提升了各类SSC基线的性能。

title: Neural Regression with Embeddings for Numerical Attribute Prediction in Knowledge Graphs
summary: In recent years, transductive knowledge graph embedding models have been applied to tasks such as link prediction and query answering. Although knowledge graphs often contain rich numerical attributes, most embedding models neglect them, limiting their ability to represent real-world knowledge graphs with diverse information. In this work, we propose a neural regression model (LitEm) that enables transductive knowledge graph embedding models to predict numerical attributes within knowledge graphs. Experimental results demonstrate that LitEm achieves the best or second-best results on most attributes across FB15K-237, YAGO15K, DB15K, and Mutagenesis. Furthermore, we propose a co-training framework that jointly trains state-of-the-art transductive knowledge graph embedding models with LitEm, which improves link prediction performance mainly for bilinear models and simultaneously enables them to predict numerical attributes. In addition, the literal-awareness evaluation demonstrates that co-training helps models to encode and exploit attribute information in a "literal-aware'' manner, suggesting that the observed gains are not merely due to additional parameters. We publicly release our implementation at https://github.com/dice-group/dice-embeddings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LitEm，一种神经回归模型，使直推式知识图谱嵌入模型能够预测知识图谱中的数值属性。实验表明LitEm在多个数据集上达到最优或次优结果；进一步提出协同训练框架，联合训练SOTA直推式知识图谱嵌入模型与LitEm，可提升链路预测性能（尤其对双线性模型），并赋予模型数值属性预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有直推式知识图谱嵌入模型虽广泛应用于链接预测和查询问答等任务，但大多忽略了知识图谱中丰富的数值属性信息，限制了其对包含多样信息真实世界知识图谱的表示能力。
AI.method: 提出LitEm（神经回归模型）来预测知识图谱中的数值属性；并构建一个协同训练框架，将LitEm与SOTA直推式知识图谱嵌入模型联合训练，使其既保留原有链路预测能力，同时获得数值属性预测能力。
AI.result: 在FB15K-237、YAGO15K、DB15K和Mutagenesis数据集上，LitEm在大多数属性上取得最优或次优结果；协同训练主要提升了双线性模型的链路预测性能，并使其具备数值属性预测能力。字面量感知评估表明性能提升并非仅源于额外参数。
AI.conclusion: 协同训练框架能够有效增强知识图谱嵌入模型的结构预测性能和数值属性预测能力，且模型以"字面量感知"方式编码和利用属性信息，验证了该方法的实际有效性。实现已开源。

title: 6.5% of the Neuro-Symbolic Literature Can Be Reproduced from Its Published Artifacts, a Six-Stage Audit Framework and First Instantiation
summary: We present a six-stage framework for auditing the reproducibility of scientific claims across a research literature within the computer science domain, and instantiate our framework for the neuro-symbolic AI (NSAI) subdomain. Instantiating the framework on the NSAI subdomain produced a multi-year audit. Stage one retrieved 5,497 records and removed 3,018 duplicates. Stage two screened the 2,479 unique records at title and abstract, identifying 1,365 self-identified NSAI records, then removed a further 61 at full text for off-topic, non-research, no-quantitative-evaluation, or inaccessible-full-text reasons. Stage three sought a verifiable public code artifact for each of the 1,304 eligible records and found none for 849, leaving 455 to enter the artifact inventory and bounded rerun of stages four and five. We fully or partially reproduced 85 studies, 6.52% of the eligible corpus and 18.68% of attempted reruns. We found that 321 attempted reruns were blocked by missing non- code artifacts and 42 by missing or unusable code repositories. These figures quantify a persistent reproducibility deficit that survives even nominal "code available" declarations, and signal the need for enforced, versioned, and permanently archived artifact bundles in future NSAI publications. We argue that empirical NSAI papers should be required at submission time to provide complete, versioned, and permanently archived artifact bundles.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并实例化了一个六阶段的可重复性审计框架，应用于神经符号AI（NSAI）子领域。在1,304篇符合条件的论文中，仅85篇（6.52%）被完全或部分复现，揭示了即使声明"代码可用"仍存在持续的可复现性赤字，并主张未来NSAI论文应在投稿时强制提供完整、带版本且永久存档的工件包。
AI.motivation: 科学研究的可重复性是学术可信度的基石，但现有文献缺乏对跨研究文献可重复性的系统性审计方法。作者旨在通过六阶段框架量化计算机科学领域中NSAI子领域的可重复性状况，并据此提出改进出版实践的呼吁。
AI.method: 提出六阶段审计框架：（1）检索——检索5,497条记录并去重3,018条；（2）标题/摘要筛选——从2,479条唯一记录中识别出1,365条NSAI自标识记录，全文后移除61条；（3）寻找公开代码工件——849条记录无可用代码，455条进入工件清单；（4-5）对工件进行有界重跑（bound rerun）；（6）综合分析与建议。最终对455项进行复现尝试。
AI.result: 完全或部分复现85项研究（占合格语料6.52%，占复现尝试的18.68%）。321次尝试因缺少非代码工件被阻断，42次因缺失或不可用的代码仓库被阻断。
AI.conclusion: 即使论文声明"代码可用"，可重复性赤字依然显著存在。应在投稿时强制要求提供完整、版本化且永久存档的工件包，以提升NSAI领域乃至更广泛计算机科学研究的可重复性。

title: A Multi-Framework Comparison of Outline Stages in Long-Form Generation with LLMs
summary: Long-form generation exposes fundamental limitations of large language models. Even 70B-parameter models exhibit length collapse at 16k-token outputs, and multi-chapter stories frequently trigger the attribute drift characteristic of the ``lost-in-the-middle'' effect. The ``outline-first, write-later'' paradigm has gained wide adoption, yet existing research evaluates the final writing rather than the outline itself, conflating two evaluation objects that should be decoupled. We construct a unified head-to-head benchmark covering 7 representative long-form generation frameworks across 3 generation granularities -- single-chapter, multi-chapter, and whole-book -- and propose an anchor-based LLM-as-a-judge protocol that directly assesses outlines against the source text on a 5-point anchored scale. Across 21 framework-granularity cells, no single framework dominates; performance depends on the match between a framework's intrinsic output form and the target granularity. SuperWriter ranks first in the length-constrained single-chapter mode, but this advantage degrades in whole-book mode. The outline-side ranking correlates only moderately with the writing-side ranking, supporting the outline--writing decoupling principle. Compute constraints limit the writing-side evaluation to a subset of cases; follow-up experiments will expand the sample size and add cross-model evaluators to enable stronger statistical inference.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个覆盖7种长文生成框架、3种生成粒度（单章/多章/整本书）的统一基准，并提出基于锚点的LLM-as-a-judge协议来直接评估大纲质量，发现不存在单一主流框架，框架内在输出形式与目标粒度的匹配决定性能，且大纲侧排名与写作侧排名仅中等相关，支持大纲与写作解耦原则。
AI.motivation: 长文生成揭示了LLM的根本局限，即使是70B参数模型在16k token输出时也会出现长度坍缩，多章故事常触发"lost-in-the-middle"效应的属性漂移。"大纲先行、后写作"范式虽被广泛采用，但现有研究评估的是最终写作而非大纲本身，将本应解耦的两个评估对象混为一谈。
AI.method: 构建统一head-to-head基准，覆盖7个代表性长文生成框架和3种生成粒度（单章、多章、整本书）；提出基于锚点的LLM-as-a-judge协议，在5点锚定评分量表上直接评估大纲与源文本的一致性；对21个框架-粒度组合进行全面评估。
AI.result: 在21个框架-粒度组合中没有任何单一框架占优，性能取决于框架内在输出形式与目标粒度的匹配程度。SuperWriter在长度受限的单章模式下排名第一，但在整本书模式下优势退化。大纲侧排名与写作侧排名仅中等相关，支持大纲-写作解耦原则。
AI.conclusion: 计算资源限制使写作侧评估仅覆盖部分案例；后续实验将扩大样本量并增加跨模型评估器以支持更强的统计推断。

title: G2D: Generative-to-Discriminative Collaborative Inference for Zero-Shot Image Classification
comment: Accepted at ACM MM 2026. 10 pages, 5 figures
summary: Zero-shot classification needs efficient label retrieval and fine-grained visual reasoning, yet discriminative and generative vision-language models fail in complementary ways.When CLIP's top-1 prediction is wrong, the correct label often remains in its top-$K$ shortlist, making disambiguation rather than recall the key challenge.Standalone generative models, however, are hindered by large label spaces and unconstrained outputs.This complementarity motivates separating broad candidate retrieval from fine-grained, image-grounded verification.We propose G2D, a training-free framework that uses a generative VLM to verify CLIP-retrieved candidates against the image.Candidate names and CLIP probabilities provide a structured prior for resolving visually similar classes.Fixed confidence routing, entropy-adaptive candidate sizing, and trie-constrained decoding focus generative reasoning on uncertain samples and ensure one valid output for each input at test time.Across eight benchmarks, G2D achieves 68.85% average accuracy, versus 59.35% for CLIP and 63.11% for the standalone VLM.Across seven generator configurations, candidate-set verification improves average accuracy by 1.08--27.42 percentage points.G2D also transfers to DCLIP, WaffleCLIP, and CuPL, supporting a practical interface between discriminative proposal and generative visual reasoning. Code: https://github.com/Harzva/G2D

AI.tldr: G2D是一个无需训练的训练框架，将判别式模型（CLIP）的候选标签检索与生成式视觉语言模型的细粒度验证相结合，通过结构化先验、熵自适应候选大小和trie约束解码，在八个基准上实现68.85%的平均准确率，显著优于单独的CLIP（59.35%）和独立VLM（63.11%）。
AI.motivation: 零样本分类需要高效的标签检索和细粒度的视觉推理，但判别式模型（如CLIP）和生成式模型在互补的方式上存在不足：当CLIP的top-1预测错误时，正确标签往往仍在其top-K候选列表中，因此关键在于消除歧义而非召回；而独立的生成式模型受限于大规模标签空间和无约束输出。
AI.method: G2D采用训练无关的两阶段框架：(1) 使用CLIP进行广泛的候选检索；(2) 使用生成式VLM对检索到的候选进行基于图像的细粒度验证。候选名称和CLIP概率构成结构化先验，用于分辨视觉相似的类别。技术细节包括固定置信度路由、熵自适应候选大小调整以及trie约束解码，将生成式推理聚焦于不确定样本并确保每个输入在测试时只有一个有效输出。
AI.result: 在八个基准上，G2D达到68.85%的平均准确率，对比CLIP的59.35%和独立VLM的63.11%。跨七种生成器配置，candidate-set验证将平均准确率提升了1.08至27.42个百分点。G2D还能迁移到DCLIP、WaffleCLIP和CuPL等模型上。
AI.conclusion: G2D验证了判别式候选检索与生成式视觉推理之间的互补性可以形成实用的接口：通过将广泛召回的任务交给CLIP，将细粒度消歧交给生成式VLM，并利用结构化先验和约束解码来聚焦生成式推理于不确定样本，可以显著提升零样本分类性能，且无需额外训练。

title: Rethinking Message Passing as Retrieval for Text-Attributed Graph Learning
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are typically conceptualized as message-passing neural networks, yet it remains unclear why neighborhood aggregation reliably outperforms node-wise multilayer perceptrons (MLPs). Despite its empirical success, this paradigm can be computationally expensive and sensitive to imperfect graph structures. In this work, we present a retrieval-augmented view of GNNs: each layer makes predictions by applying an MLP to a node representation together with a permutation-invariant summary of retrieved graph context. Motivated by this perspective, we propose RTA, a simple MLP-based framework that replaces structural message passing with label-aware retrieval and propagation. We provide theoretical insights that (i) connect retrieval-based aggregation to softmax-attention message passing, and (ii) establish the robustness of retrieved-context supervision to mis-retrieved outliers. Experiments on multiple text-attributed graph benchmarks show that RTA matches or even outperforms strong GNN and graph LLM baselines while improving efficiency and robustness across diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RTA框架，从检索增强的视角重新解读GNN，用基于标签的检索与传播替代结构化消息传递，在多个文本属性图基准上匹配甚至超越强GNN和图LLM基线，同时提升效率与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 尽管GNN通常被概念化为消息传递神经网络，但其邻域聚合为何优于节点级MLP仍不清楚，且该范式计算开销大、对不完美图结构敏感。作者希望从检索增强的角度重新解释GNN的成功，并提出更高效、更鲁棒的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出RTA（Retrieval-augmented Text-attributed framework）框架：将GNN每一层视为对节点表示加上检索到的图上下文的置换不变摘要应用MLP。RTA用标签感知的检索与传播替代结构化的消息传递，并提供了理论分析：(i) 将基于检索的聚合与softmax-注意力消息传递建立联系；(ii) 证明检索上下文的监督对错误检索的离群点具有鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个文本属性图基准上的实验表明，RTA匹配甚至超越了强GNN和图LLM基线，同时在不同场景下提升了效率与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RTA验证了检索增强视角下MLP框架能够以更高效、更鲁棒的方式实现甚至超越传统GNN的性能，为图学习提供了一种新的范式。

title: SKILL.state: Scalable Long-Horizon Agent Skills
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as autonomous agents executing complex, long-running procedural skills. Existing agent runtimes maintain execution by continually appending observations, actions, and intermediate reasoning traces to an ever-growing conversation history, causing latency degradation and context-poisoning failures over long horizons. We present SKILL.state, a runtime architecture that replaces append-only conversational history with an explicit, mutable execution state. At each execution step, the model receives only the immutable skill specification, the current structured execution state, and the latest observation. Intermediate reasoning is discarded immediately after producing a validated state update, preventing prompt growth with execution history. Across diverse datasets, models, and execution environments, SKILL.state improves task accuracy while substantially reducing cumulative token consumption. Our results demonstrate that explicit execution state is an effective and architecture-agnostic abstraction for scalable long-horizon agent skills.

AI.tldr: SKILL.state提出了一种替代传统追加式对话历史的新型代理运行时架构，通过显式的、可变的执行状态来替代不断增长的对话历史，每步仅向模型提供不可变的技能规范、当前结构化执行状态和最新观测，中间推理在产生有效状态更新后立即丢弃，从而防止提示随执行历史增长。实验表明该方法在多个数据集、模型和执行环境中显著提升任务准确率并大幅降低累计token消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理运行时通过不断向对话历史追加观测、动作和中间推理来维持执行，这导致随着任务执行时间增长，上下文变得冗长，引发延迟劣化和上下文污染失败，尤其在长时程复杂程序性技能任务中问题尤为突出。
AI.method: SKILL.state提出运行时架构，以显式的、可变的执行状态替代追加式对话历史。每步执行时，模型仅接收三部分：不可变的技能规范、当前结构化执行状态和最新观测。中间推理迹在产生有效的状态更新后立即被丢弃，从根本上防止提示随执行历史无限增长。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、模型和执行环境中，SKILL.state相比基线方法在任务准确率上获得提升，同时大幅降低累计token消耗，证明了显式执行状态是一种高效且架构无关的抽象。
AI.conclusion: 显式执行状态是面向可扩展长时程代理技能的有效且架构无关的抽象，为LLM代理运行时的设计提供了新的方向，能在保证准确率的同时显著降低计算开销。

title: PACEShop: Evaluating Personalized, Actionable, Compositional, and Evidence-grounded Shopping Assistants
summary: Shopping assistants are shifting from ranked product lists toward structured decision support, where systems must synthesize shopper context, product evidence, and next-step guidance into a coherent recommendation experience. This changes the unit of evaluation: a fluent response can still fail by ignoring shopper context, contradicting itself across components, or leaving defects too vague to localize. Existing personalization, grounding, and LLM-as-a-judge benchmarks cover pieces of this problem, but they do not define a joint evaluation target for structured shopping-assistant responses. We formulate this missing evaluation target as PACE: Personalized, Actionable, Compositional, and Evidence-grounded evaluation. We instantiate PACE with two artifacts: PACEShop, a benchmark dataset that makes the target measurable through 22,625 controlled records with structured personas, auditable evidence pools, GOOD/BAD labels, and gold defect family and location annotations; and PACEJudge, a training-free judging protocol that makes the target reportable through a structured output contract. Our experiments show that generic judges can recognize broad quality but fail to recover the diagnostic fields required for PACE; PACEShop makes these failures verifiable, and PACEJudge improves persona-source, cross-component, grounding, and family/location closure without retraining, showing that realistic shopping-assistant evaluation requires a task-matched output contract rather than only a stronger backbone or scalar prompt.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE评估框架，用于结构化购物助手响应的联合评估，包含PACEShop基准数据集（22,625条受控记录）和PACEJudge无训练评判协议，弥补现有基准无法联合评估个性化、可操作性、组合性与证据依据的空白。
AI.motivation: 购物助手从排序商品列表转向结构化决策支持，评估单元随之改变：流畅的响应可能因忽略购物者上下文、组件间自相矛盾或缺陷描述过于模糊而失败。现有基准只覆盖个性化、基础依据或LLM评判的碎片，缺乏联合评估目标。
AI.method: 提出PACE（个性化、可操作、组合、证据依据）评估目标。通过PACEShop数据集实现可测量性：22,625条受控记录，含结构化人设、可审计证据池、GOOD/BAD标签以及金标缺陷家族和位置的标注；通过PACEJudge协议实现可报告性：采用无训练的结构化输出契约评判协议。
AI.result: 实验表明通用评判器能识别整体质量但无法恢复PACE所需的诊断字段；PACEShop使这些失败可验证；PACEJudge在无需重训练的情况下提升了人设来源、跨组件、基础依据以及家族/位置闭合性，表明现实购物助手评估需要任务匹配的输出契约，而非仅依赖更强的主干模型或标量提示。
AI.conclusion: 购物助手评估的关键在于设计任务匹配的结构化输出契约而非仅提升模型能力；PACE框架为结构化购物响应提供了首个联合评估目标，具有可测量性和可报告性。

title: Glass Surface Detection Grounded in 3D Visual Geometry
comment: 9 pages, 10 figures. Accepted by ACM Multimedia 2026
summary: Glass surface detection (GSD) is critical for scene understanding and reconstruction, and yet remains challenging due to the transparency and reflectivity of glass surfaces. Existing GSD methods typically rely on 2D appearance cues, which may fail in geometrically ambiguous scenes. In this paper, we propose a paradigm shift: grounding GSD in 3D visual geometry to explicitly model the physical existence of glass surfaces. Our method first distills rich 3D priors from the visual geometry grounded transformer (VGGT) and generates glass-aware 3D representations. It then exploits multi-tasking learning with a novel glass detection head, consisting of two core modules: a Frequency Self-Attention Module (FSAM) that identifies glass-specific spectral features for glass surface localization, and a Geometry Grounding Block (GeGB) that selectively grounds 2D features in 3D geometry for glass surface segmentation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven standard GSD benchmarks, generalizes well to video/multi-modal data, and substantially improves reconstruction in glass scenes. Code is available in https://github.com/YT3DVision/VGGT_GLASS.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于3D视觉几何的玻璃表面检测（GSD）新范式，从VGGT中蒸馏3D先验并生成玻璃感知的3D表征，通过包含FSAM和GeGB的玻璃检测头实现玻璃表面的定位与分割，在七个标准benchmark上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有GSD方法依赖2D外观线索，在几何模糊场景中容易失效；玻璃表面的透明性和反射性使得仅靠2D信息难以准确建模其物理存在。因此需要将检测任务从2D外观提升到3D几何层面，以显式建模玻璃表面的物理存在。
AI.method: 首先从视觉几何grounded transformer（VGGT）中蒸馏丰富的3D先验，生成玻璃感知的3D表征；随后利用多任务学习，引入新型玻璃检测头，该检测头包含两个核心模块：FSAM用于识别玻璃特有的频谱特征以进行表面定位，GeGB用于将2D特征有选择地ground到3D几何中进行玻璃表面分割。
AI.result: 在七个标准GSD基准上取得SOTA性能，能很好地泛化到视频和多模态数据，并显著提升玻璃场景中的重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 将玻璃表面检测从2D外观线索转向3D视觉几何是有效的范式转变，通过3D几何grounding能够更好地显式建模玻璃表面的物理存在，从而在检测精度、泛化能力以及下游重建任务上均取得显著提升。

title: Self-Augmented Diffusion Guidance for Physics-Informed Generation
summary: Diffusion models can be used to generate spatiotemporal signals of physical phenomena, such as time-series images of fluid dynamics. However, a major limitation of standard diffusion models is that they do not incorporate constraints derived from the underlying physical laws. Consequently, generated samples may appear visually plausible while deviating substantially from the true dynamics. In this study, we propose a simple yet effective physics-informed approach based on diffusion guidance with self-generated data augmentation. The proposed method learns the data distribution conditioned on the degree of deviation from the physically correct dynamics and generates samples by explicitly setting the deviation condition to be zero. The method decouples the evaluation of the governing equations from the diffusion model training and sampling processes, avoiding the need to solve the governing equations at every iteration of the denoising process. This design makes the method applicable to problems requiring computationally expensive numerical simulations and enables faster sample generation. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model not only significantly reduces the deviations compared with standard diffusion models but also achieves further reductions when combined with existing physics-constrained diffusion methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散引导的物理信息方法，通过自生成数据增强，以零物理偏差为条件生成符合物理定律的时空信号（如流体动力学图像序列），在无需每步求解控制方程的情况下显著降低与真实动力学的偏差。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散模型生成物理现象时空信号时不包含物理定律约束，生成的样本虽然视觉上合理但可能与真实动力学严重偏离。
AI.method: 提出物理信息扩散引导方法：学习以物理正确性偏差程度为条件的数据分布，生成样本时显式设置偏差条件为零。该方法将控制方程的评估与扩散模型的训练和采样过程解耦，无需在每步去噪过程中求解控制方程。
AI.result: 实验表明，相比标准扩散模型，该方法显著减少了物理偏差；与现有物理约束扩散方法结合时，可实现进一步的偏差降低，同时支持计算开销大的数值模拟场景并加快样本生成。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的物理信息扩散引导方法在保持快速生成的同時有效约束样本符合物理定律，且可与现有方法互补增强，适用于需要昂贵数值模拟的物理信号生成问题。

title: Investigating the Influence of Prompt and Response Languages on LLM Content Generation
summary: This study examines how prompt and response language influence the behavior of large language models. Using five models, we evaluated answers to 68 non translation questions across four language conditions: English to English, English to Norwegian, Norwegian to Norwegian, and Norwegian to English. After removing refused items, the dataset contains 1348 responses. We measure length differences with Cohen d, semantic fidelity with LabSE cosine similarity, and cross lingual keyword overlap with both raw and soft Jaccard. Prompt language has a strong effect on response length. With English output, Norwegian prompts shorten responses by about thirty seven percent. With Norwegian output, English prompts shorten responses by about forty one percent. The largest cross lingual contrast shows a reduction in word count but a smaller reduction in tokens, reflecting tokenizer differences. Despite variation in length, semantic similarity remains high, and soft Jaccard reveals substantial conceptual overlap that raw Jaccard does not capture. Effect sizes vary across models, indicating heterogeneity. Prompt language is not neutral and systematically shapes output length and lexical realization, with implications for multilingual prompt design.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨提示词语言与响应语言对大语言模型行为的影响，使用五个模型在四种语言条件下评估了68个非翻译问题的回答。发现提示词语言对响应长度有强烈影响：英文输出时挪威语提示可使响应缩短约37%，挪威语输出时英文提示可使响应缩短约41%。尽管长度有显著差异，语义相似度保持较高水平，软Jaccard指标揭示了原始Jaccard无法捕捉的大量概念重叠。不同模型间效应大小存在异质性，提示词语言并非中立，会系统性塑造输出长度和词汇实现。
AI.motivation: 探究提示词语言和响应语言对大语言模型行为的影响，以揭示提示词语言并非中立因素，并为多语言提示设计提供实证依据。现有研究对提示词语言效应的系统性量化尚不充分，特别是跨语言条件下对输出长度、语义保真度和词汇重叠度的综合评估较少。
AI.method: 使用五个大语言模型，对68个非翻译问题在四种语言条件下进行评估（英-英、英-挪、挪-挪、挪-英），剔除拒答样本后共获得1348条响应。采用三种量化指标：Cohen d衡量长度差异、LabSE余弦相似度衡量语义保真度、原始Jaccard与软Jaccard衡量跨语言关键词重叠度。
