AI.result: 提示词语言对响应长度有显著影响：英文输出下挪威语提示使响应缩短约37%，挪威语输出下英文提示使响应缩短约41%。最大的跨语言对比显示词数减少但token数减少幅度较小，反映分词器差异。尽管长度波动，语义相似度保持较高，软Jaccard揭示大量原始Jaccard无法捕捉的概念重叠。不同模型间的效应大小存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 提示词语言并非中立因素，它系统性影响输出长度和词汇实现模式。该发现对多语言提示设计具有实际意义，提示词语言的选择应在提示工程中作为关键变量加以考量。

title: Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation from a Vision Foundation Model to a Lightweight Visual State Space Model for Tea Leaf Disease Classification
summary: Automated tea leaf disease classification supports precision agriculture, yet deploying accurate models on edge devices remains challenging under tight compute budgets. Self-supervised vision foundation models such as DINOv2 provide strong features but are too large for field deployment, while lightweight models trained from scratch on small agricultural datasets often underfit. We study cross-architecture knowledge distillation (KD) from a fine-tuned DINOv2 teacher (Vision Transformer) to a compact bidirectional Visual State Space Model (LVSSM) student, an underexplored direction because the architectures use fundamentally different token-mixing mechanisms. We identify and fix two training-stability problems that prevent the from-scratch SSM student from learning on limited data: a single large patch-embedding convolution and a fusion layer that severs the residual path. With a progressive convolutional stem and gated bidirectional selective-scan block, the 4.45M-parameter student trains stably. Across three seeds, temperature-scaled logit distillation raises test accuracy from 92.32+/-2.14% to 95.41+/-1.17% (best single run: 96.20%; macro-F1: 94.45%), a +3.09 percentage-point mean gain. The student uses 5.0 times fewer parameters than the 22M-parameter teacher while retaining 98.3% of its accuracy. Ablations show that intermediate feature-alignment losses reduce accuracy, making simple logit-level KD the strongest configuration. A fair from-scratch comparison shows the gain is specific to students that start below the teacher. We report per-class metrics, confusion matrices, bootstrap confidence intervals, and FLOPs/latency measurements, and discuss limitations including the single-dataset scope and simplified non-official SSM implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究从DINOv2（Vision Transformer教师）到紧凑型双向视觉状态空间模型（LVSSM学生）的跨架构知识蒸馏，用于茶叶叶片病害分类。通过修复两个训练稳定性问题（单一大的patch-embedding卷积和切断残差路径的融合层），采用渐进式卷积stem和门控双向选择性扫描块，4.45M参数的学生模型在三个种子上将测试准确率从92.32±2.14%提升至95.41±1.17%，比教师少5倍参数却保留98.3%的准确率。
AI.motivation: 自动化茶叶病害分类支持精准农业，但边缘设备上部署高精度模型面临计算预算紧张的挑战。自监督视觉基础模型（如DINOv2）特征强大但参数量过大不适合现场部署，而轻量级模型在小型农业数据集上从头训练容易欠拟合。因此需要研究如何将大模型的知识高效蒸馏到紧凑模型中。
AI.method: 采用跨架构知识蒸馏：以微调后的DINOv2（Vision Transformer）为教师，训练紧凑的双向视觉状态空间模型（LVSSM）为学生的。识别并修复两个阻止SSM学生从头学习的训练稳定性问题：（1）单一大型patch-embedding卷积导致训练不稳定；（2）融合层切断了残差路径。解决方案包括采用渐进式卷积stem和门控双向选择性扫描块。蒸馏策略采用温度缩放的对数级别蒸馏（logit-level KD），并系统消融了中间层特征对齐损失。
AI.result: 在三个随机种子上，温度缩放对数蒸馏将测试准确率从92.32±2.14%提升至95.41±1.17%（最佳单次运行96.20%，宏F1为94.45%），平均提升+3.09个百分点。学生模型参数量为4.45M，比22M参数的教师少5倍，同时保留教师98.3%的准确率。消融实验表明中间层特征对齐损失反而降低准确率，简单的对数级别KD是最强配置。公平的从头比较显示性能增益仅对起点低于教师的学生有效。
AI.conclusion: 跨架构知识蒸馏从Transformer教师到状态空间模型学生是可行且有效的，即使两者使用根本不同的token-mixing机制。修复训练稳定性问题后，轻量SSM学生模型能在有限农业数据上稳定训练并接近教师性能。但研究存在局限性：仅限单一数据集验证，且SSM实现为简化的非官方版本，需要更多场景验证其泛化性。

title: Safety by Design: Realized-Cost Constraints for Contextual Bandits with Continuous Actions
summary: Contextual bandits are a standard framework for sequential decision-making under uncertainty, with applications in clinical trials, dosage selection, recommendation systems, and autonomous systems. Safety is central in many of these applications, since a single unsafe decision in settings such as dosage selection or autonomous driving can have catastrophic consequences. A common way to model safety in bandit problems is to associate each action with both a reward signal and a cost signal, and to optimize reward subject to constraints on cost. Most existing safety-constrained bandit models enforce safety by requiring the expected cost of each action to remain below a prescribed threshold. However, this may be insufficient in heteroscedastic settings, where the chosen action affects not only the expected reward and cost, but also the variability of the observed outcomes. We study contextual bandits with one-dimensional continuous actions and stage-wise high-probability constraints on the realized cost. We propose High-Probability Constrained UCB, an optimistic-pessimistic algorithm that explores for reward while conservatively estimating the safe action set. For linear reward and cost models, we prove a tight $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(d\sqrt{T})$ regret bound, and we extend the analysis to general function classes using the eluder dimension. Experiments show that enforcing realized-cost safety substantially reduces violations compared with expected-cost constrained baselines.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究异方差环境下的安全上下文赌博机问题，提出乐观-悲观算法 High-Probability Constrained UCB，在阶段级高概率约束下对实现成本施加安全限制，获得了d√T量级的后悔界，并实验证明了该方法相比期望成本约束基线大幅减少安全违规。
AI.motivation: 现有安全约束赌博机模型仅约束动作的期望成本低于预置阈值，但这在异方差环境下可能不足够，因为动作不仅影响期望回报和成本，还影响观测结果的变异性。在剂量选择或自动驾驶等场景中，单次不安全决策就可能带来灾难性后果，因此需要更严格的阶段级高概率成本约束。
AI.method: 提出 High-Probability Constrained UCB (HPC-UCB) 算法，采用乐观-悲观策略：对奖励进行乐观估计以促进探索，同时对安全动作集进行保守估计以确保高概率阶段的成本约束。算法针对一维连续动作空间，在每阶段线性奖励/成本模型下通过置信界构建可行安全集，并利用 eluder 维度将分析扩展到一般函数类。
AI.result: 对线性奖励和成本模型证明了紧致的 Õ(d√T) 后悔界；通过 eluder 维度将分析推广到一般函数类。实验表明，相比期望成本约束的基线方法，施加实现成本的安全约束能显著减少违规次数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明在异方差设置下，阶段级高概率成本约束是比期望成本约束更强且更实际的安全保证方式，所提出的乐观-悲观算法能够在保证安全性的同时维持最优的遗憾性能。

title: Five Primitives for Governing Autonomous AI Agents at Runtime
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Describes an implemented system in private pilot deployment; four of five primitives implemented
summary: Enterprise deployments of autonomous AI agents inherit a control model built for human users and long-lived services, and the fit fails in three specific ways: agent principals are ephemeral, appearing and vanishing faster than provisioning; their actions are selected by a model rather than programmed, so the set of things they may attempt is not known in advance; and the population is discovered rather than provisioned, because anyone who can call an API can create one. We argue that governing such agents is a runtime problem -- not a model-alignment problem and not a build-time problem -- and we derive five primitives from the questions that must be answered before an action takes effect and after it has: discovery, identity, governance, attestation, and supply chain. For each we state what fails if it is absent and why the others cannot structurally supply it. We describe an implementation in which an agent's action is mediated against policy before it takes effect, authorised against a per-tenant action vocabulary, and recorded in a hash-linked signed ledger a third party can verify with the vendor out of the loop. We report what the architecture costs: the enforcement point sits on the request's critical path, identity requires a sidecar per workload, and fail-closed mediation converts availability incidents into denial. We are explicit about implementation status: four primitives are built and running in private pilots, and the fifth is built as separate tooling and not yet integrated into the request path. We keep it in the set deliberately: a five-part decomposition that exactly matches what its authors happened to build is not a taxonomy but a description of a codebase.

AI.tldr: 本文指出自治AI代理的企业部署沿用了为人类用户设计的控制模型，并在三个层面失效：代理主体生命周期短暂、行为由模型而非程序决定、群体通过发现而非预置产生。作者提出应将代理治理视为运行时问题，并推导出五个原语（发现、身份、治理、证明、供应链），描述了各原语缺失时的后果及实现架构（策略前置调解、按租户动作词表授权、哈希链接签名账本），同时坦承实现现状及部署成本。
AI.motivation: 企业部署自治AI代理时延用面向人类用户和长期服务的控制模型，存在三个结构性不匹配：代理主体是短暂易逝的（出现和消失比预置更快）、代理行为由模型选择而非编程确定（可能尝试的行为集合事先未知）、代理群体是被发现而非被预置的（任何能调用API的人都能创建代理）。作者认为这需要全新的治理框架。
AI.method: 作者主张将代理治理定位为运行时问题而非模型对齐或构建期问题，从动作生效前和生效后必须回答的问题中推导出五个治理原语：发现、身份、治理、证明和供应链。并描述了一个具体实现，其中代理动作在生效前经过策略调解，按租户动作词表授权，并记录在第三方可验证的哈希链接签名账本中（供应商无需参与验证）。
AI.result: 该架构的代价包括：强制点位于请求的关键路径上、每个工作负载需要身份sidecar、fail-closed调解会将可用性事件转化为拒绝。实现现状为：四个原语已构建并在私人试点中运行，第五个（供应链）作为独立工具构建但尚未集成到请求路径中，且有意保留这五部分分解以避免成为代码库而非分类法的描述。
AI.conclusion: 治理自治代理的关键在于运行时强制而非模型对齐或构建时约束。五原语框架为代理治理提供了结构化方案，且作者强调五部分分解应与实际构建相匹配，而非生造一个理论分类学。当前部署成本（关键路径延迟、身份开销、fail-closed风险）是必须正视的工程取舍。

title: Decoupling Planning and Control for Instructable Agents
comment: Published as a conference paper at COLM 2026. Project page: https://zinengtang.github.io/instruct-to-act/
summary: Recent work shows that pre-trained, instruction-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) perform well at mapping from instructions and observations to high-level plans, but struggle to realize such plans as reliable low-latency action sequences in unfamiliar environments. At the same time, world-model controllers excel at fast observation-to-action control, but lack open-ended task guidance. In this work, we combine these strengths into a single system, Instruct-to-Act, where we train a world-model controller to act autonomously at high frequency when conditioned on sparse, higher-latency, and high-level text instructions generated by a VLM planner. To train controllers to be language-instructable, we relabel segments of controller policy rollouts with synthetic instructions and jointly optimize a behavior-cloning objective along with existing reward-maximizing and world-modeling objectives. We evaluate our proposed approach across seven embodied environments, including three multi-agent environments where VLM planners coordinate through language while trained controllers serve as their actuators. Under matched observation and action spaces, our decoupled approach consistently outperforms controller-only and direct VLM action-generation variants, preserves fast control, and lets us swap in different pretrained VLM planners without fine-tuning, while remaining competitive with strong vision-language-action and multi-agent RL baselines on six of seven tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Instruct-to-Act系统，将VLM规划器的高层语言指令能力与世界模型控制器的低延迟动作执行能力相结合，通过在控制器策略滚动段上合成语言指令并联合优化行为克隆与奖励最大化/世界建模目标，实现高频率、语言可指令的自主控制，在七个具身环境中表现优于多种基线。
AI.motivation: 预训练的指令微调视觉语言模型（VLM）擅长将指令和观察映射为高层计划，但在陌生环境中难以实现可靠的低延迟动作序列；而世界模型控制器擅长快速观察到动作的控制，但缺乏开放式任务引导。二者优劣互补，现有方法未能有效结合。
AI.method: 构建Instruct-to-Act系统：训练世界模型控制器在接收到VLM规划器生成的高层文本指令后，以高频率自主执行动作。具体方法包括：(1) 用合成指令对控制器策略滚动段进行重标注；(2) 联合优化行为克隆目标与已有的奖励最大化及世界建模目标，使控制器具备语言可指令性。系统支持在匹配观察和动作空间下解耦VLM规划器与控制器，允许无需微调地替换不同的预训练VLM规划器。
AI.result: 在七个具身环境中评估，包括三个多智能体环境（VLM规划器通过语言协调，训练控制器充当执行器）。在匹配的观察和动作空间下，该解耦方法一致优于仅控制器的变体和直接VLM动作生成变体，保持快速控制能力，且可在六个任务上与强视觉-语言-动作模型及多智能体强化学习基线竞争。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM规划与基于世界模型的控制器解耦结合是一种有效方案，能够在保留VLM开放任务指导能力的同时维持控制器的低延迟执行性能，为具身智能体中规划与控制的分离设计提供了有力证据。

title: Approved Too Late: Verdict Staleness in LLM-Guarded Self-Adaptive Systems
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Autonomic Computing and Self-Organizing Systems (ACSOS 2026)
summary: A large language model (LLM) guardrail for a self-adaptive system (SAS) may issue an approval that is correct at check time but stale by actuation. This creates an Execute-stage time-of-check to time-of-use (TOCTOU) hazard. We study verdict freshness: whether a guardrail verdict remains valid when used. We distinguish three quantities that answer different questions: all-candidate verdict change under fixed-action replay, oracle-labeled approval expiry on recorded closed-loop trajectories, and judge-conditioned use-time invalidity. Across five reproducible SAS environments, all-candidate verdict-change rates span 5.3-48.4% at a common replay shift of eight simulator steps. We introduce the Freshness-Bounded Shield (FBS), which estimates each approval's validity horizon from its safe-side margin and recent feature volatility, without an explicit plant-dynamics model. Using fixed settings documented in the artifact, FBS reduces oracle-labeled approval-expiry rates from 3.4-24.7% to 0-1.8% at the same shift. A separate audit of four LLM judges finds nonzero judge-conditioned use-time invalidity in every approval stream. We formulate a freshness contract: every approval must be correct at check time and remain valid at use time.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自适应性系统中的大语言模型防护栏（guardrail）在"批准时正确但执行时过期"的TOCTOU（检查时间到使用时间）风险。论文提出了三个不同的"裁决新鲜度"量化指标，并设计了Freshness-Bounded Shield（FBS）方法，通过审批的安全侧边际和特征波动性来估计每个审批的有效期，无需显式植物动力学模型。在五个可复现的SAS环境中，FBS将oracle标注的批准过期率从3.4-24.7%降至0-1.8%。
AI.motivation: LLM防护栏在为自适应性系统做出安全审批时，审批在检查时刻是正确的，但可能到执行时刻已经失效（即TOCTOU危险）。现有研究缺乏对裁决新鲜度的系统化定义和量化，也无法提供缓解手段。
AI.method: 论文区分了三个不同的新鲜度度量：(1) 固定动作重放下全候选裁决变化率；(2) 记录闭环轨迹上oracle标注的批准过期率；(3) 法官条件下的使用时无效性。在此基础上，提出Freshness-Bounded Shield（FBS）算法，利用每个审批的安全侧边际和近期特征波动性估计审批的有效期范围，无需显式动力学模型。
AI.result: 在五个可复现的SAS环境中，在常见的8步模拟器移位下，全候选裁决变化率在5.3%-48.4%之间。FBS将oracle标注的批准过期率从3.4-24.7%降低至0-1.8%。对四个LLM法官的审计发现，每个审批流都存在非零的法官条件下使用时无效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文明确提出"新鲜度契约"：每个审批必须在检查时刻正确，并且在执行（使用）时刻仍然有效。这一契约可作为未来SAS中LLM防护栏设计的正式规范。

title: When the Canonical Completion Is Wrong: Formalizing and Measuring the Jump in Large Language Models
summary: Whether large language models (LLMs) can perform the abductive leap from evidence to a new system of axioms, commonly referred to as a jump, has recently attracted considerable debate. A prominent position holds that LLMs are structurally incapable of such jumps, while recent studies challenge both its mechanism and its evidence. However, the debate remains difficult to settle, since the field still lacks a formal definition of the jump and a measure to test either side. In this paper, we develop a formal account of the jump in four steps and measure the second. The steps ask what the default completion of partial data is, when abandoning it is forced, when the abandonment is correct, and how successive jumps compound. Specifically, we define a jump instance as a finite extension problem with a machine-checked certificate that a correct completion exists, is unique up to renaming, and differs from the canonical completion of the data. The canonical completion is given by the left and right Kan extensions and is also what models produce without constraints, so it serves as the default. We prove that jump instances are well-posed and establish a family theorem that certifies instances of unbounded difficulty without enumeration. We further formalize when a jump is correct and how successive jumps compound. Finally, we run the measurement on nine certified instances and four frontier models. The Kan-default rate is zero in all 248 constrained trials, so the models do jump at this step and abandon the excluded default every time. Failures at higher difficulty stem from exhausted reasoning budgets or constraint errors, never from reverting to the default. These results indicate that the second step is not the bottleneck. If the disputed incapacity is real, it lies in generating the constraints or inventing the framework. Code can be found at: https://github.com/EEthanShi/kan-jump-test.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"跳跃"（jump）的形式化定义，并通过Kan扩展作为规范完成方式来测量LLM从证据跳转到新公理系统的能力。在248个受约束试验中，四个前沿模型的Kan默认率为零，说明模型在该步骤始终能放弃默认完成方式，失败源于推理预算耗尽或约束错误而非回到默认。
AI.motivation: 关于LLM能否执行从证据到新公理系统的溯因性跳跃（jump）存在重大争论。一方认为LLM在结构上无法做到，另一方质疑其机制和证据。但该领域缺乏跳跃的形式化定义和测试度量，导致争论难以解决。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 本文从四个步骤形式化跳跃概念：(1) 部分数据的默认完成是什么；(2) 何时被迫放弃默认；(3) 放弃何时是正确的；(4) 连续跳跃如何复合。将跳跃实例定义为带机器可验证证书的有限扩展问题，要求正确完成存在、在重命名意义下唯一、且不同于数据的规范完成（由左右Kan扩展给出）。证明了跳跃实例的适定性，建立了保证无限难度实例可认证的族定理，并形式化正确跳跃的定义及复合方式。
AI.result: 在9个认证实例和4个前沿模型上进行了测量，248个受约束试验中Kan默认率为零，即模型在所有试验中都放弃被排除的默认完成方式。在更高难度上的失败源于推理预算耗尽或约束错误，从未出现回归默认的情况。
AI.conclusion: 第二个步骤（放弃默认）并非LLM跳跃能力的瓶颈。如果所谓的能力缺失确实存在，那么它位于生成约束或发明框架的环节，而非放弃默认完成的环节。

title: Ring Forcing: Towards Precise Long-Term Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Scaling video generation to long durations reveals a critical bottleneck: current models lack robust long-term memory. This deficiency can be studied along two critical aspects: object permanence, the ability to precisely reproduce the appearance of objects upon re-entry; and memory capacity, the ability to process ultra-long context and use information from distant history. Robust long-term memory requires both: object permanence without sufficient context handling limits the temporal scope, while long context length without permanence fails to maintain identity. To address this, we present Ring Forcing, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed to robustly construct and precisely utilize long-term memory. Our ring-structured training strategy enforces retrieval from distant history, effectively reconciling the trade-off between strict historical adherence and generative diversity. To expand memory capacity, we introduce a compression and timestep composition strategy. Under fixed sequence length constraints, this method extends the effective historical span to minutes-long durations and achieves a comprehensive receptive field over the entire history. Furthermore, we present a sparse RoPE mechanism to enable flexible, scalable memory adaptation while fully exploiting pre-trained priors. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Ring Forcing achieves superior minutes-long coherence and object permanence, significantly outperforming state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Ring Forcing，一种自回归视频扩散框架，通过环形结构训练策略、压缩与时间步组合策略以及稀疏RoPE机制，解决长时视频生成中缺乏长期记忆的关键瓶颈，显著提升分钟级视频的连贯性和物体恒存性。
AI.motivation: 长时视频生成面临关键瓶颈：现有模型缺乏稳健的长期记忆能力。该问题体现在两个层面：物体恒存性（物体重新出现时能否精确复现其外观）和记忆容量（能否处理超长上下文并利用远距离历史信息）。两者缺一不可——仅有物体恒存性但上下文处理能力不足会限制时间范围，仅有长上下文但缺乏恒存性则无法保持身份一致性。
AI.method: 提出Ring Forcing框架，包含三大核心组件：(1)环形结构训练策略，强制模型从远距离历史中检索信息，平衡严格历史遵循与生成多样性之间的权衡；(2)压缩与时间步组合策略，在固定序列长度约束下将有效历史跨度扩展到分钟级时长，实现对全部历史的全面感受野；(3)稀疏RoPE机制，实现灵活可扩展的记忆适配，同时充分利用预训练先验。
AI.result: 大量实验表明Ring Forcing在分钟级视频连贯性和物体恒存性方面取得了优异表现，显著优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: Ring Forcing通过系统性地解决长期记忆构建与利用问题，为长时视频生成提供了一种可扩展且有效的方案，在播放时长和身份保持两个维度上同时取得突破。

title: Beyond Client Averaging: A Client-Independent Second-Order Stationary-Bias Component in Stochastic SCAFFOLD
summary:
Existing constant-step analysis of stochastic \Scaf{} identifies a leading $O(γ/N)$ stationary mean bias and shows that higher-order bias can persist as the client count increases, but does not identify the first client-independent contribution at coefficient level. For full-participation stochastic \Scaf{} with one-dimensional homogeneous clients, fixed local-step count $H$, and bounded additive gradient noise, we prove, uniformly over $N\ge2$,
  $$ \begin{aligned} \mathbb{E}_{π_{γ,N,H}}[x]-x^\star ={}& -\frac{f'''(x^\star)σ^2}{4f''(x^\star)^2}\fracγ{N}\\ &- \frac{f'''(x^\star)σ^2}{12f''(x^\star)} \frac{(H-1)(5H-1)}{H}γ^2 +O_H\!\left(\frac{γ^2}{N}+γ^3\right). \end{aligned} $$
  Hence client averaging suppresses the leading $O(γ/N)$ bias but does not remove the client-independent $O(γ^2)$ component when its coefficient is nonzero.
  The mechanism is indirect: although the direct control contribution cancels pathwise in the linear global average, the controls still alter within-round local trajectories and their second moments. Fresh gradient noise and persistent control fluctuations therefore generate local second-moment corrections that nonquadratic curvature converts into stationary mean bias. The coefficient vanishes for quadratic objectives. Numerical experiments are consistent with the predicted coefficient, its persistence as client count increases, and the stated joint remainder. The result is restricted to the one-dimensional homogeneous fixed-$H$ setting.

AI.tldr: 本文针对全参与随机SCAFFOLD算法，在单维同构客户端、固定局部步数H和有界加性梯度噪声的设定下，精确推导出稳态平均偏差的一阶系数，证明其包含O(γ/N)的主导项和与客户端数无关的O(γ²)项，并通过理论分析和数值实验验证了该偏差的持久性。
AI.motivation: 现有对随机SCAFFOLD的常数步长分析虽已识别出O(γ/N)的稳态均值偏差，并指出随着客户端数量增加存在高阶偏差，但未在系数层面识别出第一个与客户端数量无关的贡献项。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 对全参与随机SCAFFOLD，在单维同构客户端、固定局部步数H和有界加性梯度噪声条件下，利用均匀对N≥2的严格数学推导，将稳态均值偏差精确展开为γ/N和γ²的系数表达式，并通过识别直接控制贡献与局部二阶矩修正之间的交互机制完成证明。
AI.result: 证明稳态均值偏差满足:E[x]-x* = -f'''(x*)σ²/(4f''(x*)²)·γ/N - f'''(x*)σ²/(12f''(x*))·(H-1)(5H-1)/H·γ² + O_H(γ²/N+γ³)。客户端平均抑制了O(γ/N)主导偏差，但无法消除系数非零时与客户端数无关的O(γ²)分量。数值实验与预测系数及其随客户端数增长的持久性一致。
AI.conclusion: 随机SCAFFOLD的偏差消除机制是间接的：直接控制贡献在全局线性平均中路经意义下抵消，但控制仍改变轮内局部轨迹及其二阶矩，新鲜梯度噪声和持续控制波动产生的局部二阶矩修正，经非二次曲率转化为稳态均值偏差。该系数在二次目标下为零，结果限于单维同构固定H设定。

title: FIDA: Feature Instability-Driven Attack on Self-Supervised Facial Representation
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) models are vulnerable to backdoor attacks. However, the systemic risks they pose in face representation have received little attention. The entanglement of identity features in self-supervised face learning presents unique challenges for attack stealthiness. To address this gap, we propose FIDA (Feature Instability-Driven Attack), a novel backdoor attack framework. FIDA uses subtle semantic triggers for injection, but its key innovation is a novel objective called Feature Instability Loss. It trains the encoder to increase the sensitivity of triggered features along perturbation directions sampled during attack optimization . By preventing the backdoor from exhibiting the rigid feature patterns typical of previous attacks, FIDA effectively evades the evaluated perturbation-based defenses. Experiments show that FIDA achieves a high attack success rate and generally preserves benign utility across the evaluated settings , posing a significant threat to real-world multimedia applications relying on facial analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FIDA（基于特征不稳定的攻击），一种针对自监督人脸表示学习的后门攻击框架，通过新颖的特征不稳定损失增强触发特征的敏感性，使后门特征更具动态性以逃避基于扰动的防御，同时保持高攻击成功率和良性效用。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习（SSL）模型易受后门攻击，但在人脸表示领域中的系统性风险尚未得到充分关注。自监督人脸学习中身份特征的纠缠性为攻击隐蔽性带来独特挑战，现有攻击缺乏针对该场景的有效方案。
AI.method: FIDA框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 使用细微的语义触发进行注入；(2) 提出特征不稳定损失（Feature Instability Loss），该损失训练编码器沿攻击优化过程中采样的扰动方向增加触发特征对扰动的敏感性，从而避免后门表现出以往攻击所具有的刚性特征模式，以规避基于扰动的防御。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，FIDA在评估场景中实现了较高的攻击成功率，同时普遍保持了良性效用，对所评估的基于扰动的防御具有有效的规避能力。
AI.conclusion: FIDA对依赖人脸分析的真实多媒体应用构成了显著威胁，揭示了自监督人脸表示学习中的新型安全漏洞。

title: CGS-SLAM: Collaborative Gaussian Splatting based SLAM for Multi-Agent Reconstruction
summary: Recent advances in SLAM have leveraged 3DGS for photorealistic reconstruction and novel view synthesis. However, most methods rely on RGB-D input, which is unavailable on consumer-grade smartphones, and few integrate 3DGS within a collaborative framework. Therefore, we present CGS-SLAM, a hybrid decentralized/centralized system enabling multi-agent 3DGS SLAM using only RGB and inertial data. Each agent performs local tracking with inertial data as a motion prior and reconstructs a scaled map using a metric monocular depth estimator (Depth Pro). Keyframe encodings are shared among agents, enabling dynamic keyframing in regions of spatial overlaps with other agents, enhancing submap alignment. Afterwards, a central server aligns submaps using VGGT as a view alignment model. This bidirectional communication keeps communication cost low during mapping and global reconstruction in difficult GNSS-denied environments. Experiments on multiple datasets demonstrate competitive tracking performance, improved rendering quality over state-of-the-art methods, and accurate submap alignment.

AI.tldr: CGS-SLAM是一种仅依赖RGB和惯性数据的混合去中心化/中心化多智能体3DGS SLAM系统，每个智能体利用惯性数据作为运动先验进行局部跟踪，并通过单目深度估计器重建尺度化地图，中央服务器使用VGGT对齐子地图，在多种数据集上展现出有竞争力的跟踪性能和更优的渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3DGS的SLAM方法大多依赖RGB-D输入，这在消费级智能手机上不可用；此外很少在协作框架中集成3DGS。作者旨在填补这一空白，提出一种仅使用RGB和惯性数据的多智能体3DGS SLAM系统。
AI.method: 采用混合去中心化/中心化架构：(1) 每个智能体使用惯性数据作为运动先验进行局部跟踪，并通过度量单目深度估计器（Depth Pro）重建尺度化地图；(2) 智能体间共享关键帧编码，在空间重叠区域实现动态关键帧选取以增强子地图对齐；(3) 中央服务器使用VGGT作为视图对齐模型来对齐各子地图；通过双向通信在GNSS拒绝环境中保持低通信成本。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明：跟踪性能具有竞争力，渲染质量优于现有最先进方法，且子地图对齐精度较高。
AI.conclusion: CGS-SLAM成功验证了在仅使用RGB和惯性数据的情况下实现协作式多智能体3DGS SLAM的可行性，兼顾了低通信成本和高质量重建，适用于GNSS受限环境。

title: FaithSieve: Fine-Grained Evaluation of Math Proofs with Faithful Formal Evidence
comment: 32 pages, 3 figures; preprint with appendix and supplementary experimental details
summary: Large language models can now generate complex, multi-step mathematical proofs, but reliably determining their correctness and localizing early logical errors remains a critical challenge. Existing evaluation approaches largely depend on model-based natural-language judgments, which often overlook local reasoning gaps. While formal theorem provers like Lean offer a path to rigorous verification, using them to evaluate informal text requires solving locality and semantic mismatches: a prover might bypass a local flaw by proving an overly broad target, or validate an auto-formalized statement that drifts from the original mathematical intent. To address this, we introduce FaithSieve, a Lean-assisted framework for fine-grained evaluation of natural-language mathematical proofs. FaithSieve decomposes coarse proof steps into local reasoning units, extracts typed proof obligations, and verifies them through a formal evaluation agent. Formal validation is gated by semantic alignment scoring, so Lean evidence is incorporated only when the formal statement faithfully preserves the context, objects, and logical form of the original claim. We construct two expert-verified datasets, ProofLoc-Olympiad and ProofLoc-University, to benchmark first-error localization. On the 350-problem Olympiad dataset, FaithSieve using a GPT-5.4 backbone achieves 81.43% exact first-error accuracy, outperforming the direct-judging baseline of 72.29%. Furthermore, on the 200-problem ProofLoc-University benchmark spanning six advanced domains, FaithSieve reaches 84.5% exact accuracy, compared to 75.0% for the direct judge. Our work demonstrates that decomposing proofs into fine-grained units and grounding them with faithful formal evidence significantly improves reliable evaluation of natural-language reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FaithSieve，一个基于Lean的框架，用于细粒度评估自然语言数学证明的正确性并定位首个逻辑错误。通过将粗粒度证明步骤分解为局部推理单元、提取类型化证明义务，并通过语义对齐评分门控形式验证，FaithSieve在Olympiad和University两个基准上分别达到81.43%和84.5%的首错定位准确率，显著优于直接判断基线。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可以生成复杂的多步数学证明，但可靠地判断其正确性并定位早期逻辑错误仍是关键挑战。现有评估方法大多依赖基于模型的自然语言判断，容易忽略局部推理缺陷。虽然形式化定理证明器（如Lean）提供了严格验证的途径，但将其用于评估非正式文本面临局部性和语义不匹配问题：证明器可能通过证明过于宽泛的目标来绕过局部缺陷，或验证了偏离原始数学意图的自动形式化陈述。
AI.method: FaithSieve框架包含三个核心环节：(1) 将粗粒度的证明步骤分解为局部推理单元；(2) 提取类型化证明义务（typed proof obligations）；(3) 通过形式化评估代理进行验证。形式化验证由语义对齐评分门控，只有当形式化陈述忠实保留原始声明的上下文、对象和逻辑形式时，才纳入Lean证据。
AI.result: 构建了两个专家验证的数据集：ProofLoc-Olympiad（350题）和ProofLoc-University（200题，涵盖六个高级领域）。基于GPT-5.4骨干，FaithSieve在Olympiad数据集上达到81.43%的精确首错定位准确率，优于直接判断基线的72.29%；在University基准上达到84.5%的精确准确率，优于直接判断的75.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将证明分解为细粒度单元并用忠实的形式化证据进行接地，能显著提升自然语言推理评估的可靠性，为数学证明验证提供了一条将非正式文本与形式化证明器有效结合的可行路径。

title: Comparing Chunking and Embedding Strategies for Turkish RAG Systems
comment: Accepted to INTCEC 2026. This is the author's pre-print version. The final authenticated version will be available through the conference proceedings
summary: How documents are segmented into retrievable chunks and how those chunks are embedded strongly affect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) quality, yet neither has been systematically studied for morphologically rich languages such as Turkish. We compare Turkish document question answering across three chunking strategies (fixed-length, semantic, and layout-aware Docling), five embedding models, and two generator LLMs, over three documents with contrasting layouts. The fully crossed design yields 9,000 graded question-answer evaluations, each scored by an independent judge model, and component comparisons are tested by paired McNemar tests under Holm correction. Four findings follow. The chunking strategy determines how much the embedding choice matters: layout-aware chunking compresses the spread between the modern embedding models to about a point. The three leading embedding models are statistically indistinguishable, so language specialization yields no measurable retrieval advantage. The faster generator is not the more accurate one. And the preferred configuration depends on content type, since layout-aware chunking helps documents containing tables far more than prose. The best individual components therefore do not compose into the best complete configuration, which reaches 87.0%.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了土耳其语等形态丰富语言中RAG的文档分块策略与嵌入模型对问答质量的影响，通过全因子实验设计（3种分块策略×5种嵌入模型×2种生成模型×3种文档）产生9,000个评分，发现分块策略决定嵌入模型的重要性、语言专用嵌入无优势、更快生成器并非更准确，且最佳配置取决于内容类型（表格文档更受益于布局感知分块），最佳组件组合并不等同于最佳整体配置（87.0%）。
AI.motivation: 文档如何被切分为可检索块以及这些块如何被嵌入，对RAG质量有强烈影响，但此前在土耳其语等形态丰富语言中这两者均未被系统研究过，缺乏实证指导。
AI.method: 采用全交叉实验设计：3种分块策略（固定长度、语义、布局感知Docling）×5种嵌入模型×2种生成LLM，在3个布局对比鲜明的文档上执行土耳其语文档问答，生成9,000个带评分的问答对，每个由独立的评判模型打分；组件间比较采用Holm校正下的配对McNemar检验。
AI.result: 四项主要发现：（1）分块策略决定嵌入选择的重要性，布局感知分块将现代嵌入模型间的差距压缩至约1分；（2）排名前三的嵌入模型在统计上无显著差异，语言专用化未带来检索优势；（3）更快的生成器并非更准确的生成器；（4）首选配置取决于内容类型，布局感知分块对含表格的文档增益远大于纯文本。最佳整体配置达到87.0%，但由各单项最优组件组合并不构成最佳配置。
AI.conclusion: 在形态丰富语言（以土耳其语为代表）的RAG系统中，最佳组件的简单组合并不能保证整体最优，分块策略与内容类型的交互作用至关重要，配置选择必须根据目标文档的内容结构（如是否含表格）进行定制。

title: Multi-Image Visual Token Pruning in Large Visual Language Models
summary: With the growing demand for processing multiple image sequences in real-world applications, various visual token pruning methods have emerged to mitigate the computational and context length constraints faced by Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs). However, most existing pruning approaches rely on static strategies that struggle to adapt across different architectural LVLMs and multi-image scenarios, and are additionally constrained by their dependence on attention computations that are incompatible with efficient techniques like FlashAttention. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free, Adaptive Visual Token Pruning (AVTP) framework, applicable to diverse LVLM architectures. We strategically determine pruning layers based on empirical analysis of visual attention distributions across various LVLMs, and implement adaptive pruning ratios in multi-image contexts where images of higher importance retain proportionally more tokens. We conduct extensive experiments across different LVLMs to demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of AVTP. Specifically, Qwen3VL-8B achieves 2 times inference speedup while maintaining 96.1\% of its original accuracy on multiple multi-image benchmarks, InternVL3.5-8B retains 94.1\% accuracy, and LLaVA-OV-7B even exceeds its original baseline performance. Our code is available at \href{https://github.com/zry13/AVTP}{this link}.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的、自适应的视觉token剪枝框架AVTP，适用于多种LVLM架构，在多种多图像基准上实现了最高2倍的推理加速，同时保持了超过94%的原始准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法多依赖静态策略，难以适应不同架构的LVLM和多图像场景，且依赖于注意力计算，与FlashAttention等高效技术不兼容，限制了其应用范围。
AI.method: 提出AVTP（自适应视觉token剪枝）框架：1）基于对不同LVLM中视觉注意力分布的经验分析来策略性地确定剪枝层；2）在多图像场景中实现自适应剪枝比率，对重要性更高的图像保留成比例的更多token；3）该方法无需训练，且不依赖注意力计算，可与FlashAttention兼容。
AI.result: 在多个多图像基准上验证了AVTP的有效性和鲁棒性：Qwen3VL-8B实现2倍推理加速并保持96.1%的原始准确率，InternVL3.5-8B保持94.1%的准确率，LLaVA-OV-7B甚至超过原始基线性能。
AI.conclusion: AVTP作为一种训练免费、架构无关的自适应视觉token剪枝框架，有效解决了静态剪枝策略的局限性和注意力计算依赖问题，在显著加速推理的同时保持了高精度，为多图像场景下的LVLM高效推理提供了可行方案。

title: On the Indistinguishability of Human v/s AI Generated Text
summary: The rapid improvement of LLMs has made distinguishing AI-generated text from human writing a pressing problem. This challenge is further amplified by paraphrasing tools designed to make machine-generated text appear more "human". We study how access to human writing samples can be used to strategically paraphrase machine-generated responses toward the human distribution. Under a multi-sample setting with human and machine responses to the same prompts, we show that repeated paraphrasing moves the machine distribution toward the empirical human distribution under simple mixing and stability conditions. Our results derive an explicit convergence rate, extend the analysis to a finite-sample setting, and characterize how the required number of human samples and paraphrasing rounds scale with the desired error.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何利用人类写作样本，通过策略性改写的多轮迭代，将机器生成文本的分布逐步推向人类文本分布，并给出了收敛速率、有限样本下的分析以及所需样本量和改写轮数的标度关系。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM能力的快速提升，区分AI生成文本与人类写作成为紧迫问题，而改写工具进一步加剧了这一挑战。本文旨在从理论层面理解：在获得人类写作样本的情况下，如何通过策略性改写使机器文本更接近人类分布，从而为检测问题提供理论依据。
AI.method: 在多样本设置下（同一提示对应人类和机器响应），作者提出重复改写策略，在简单的混合与稳定性条件下证明机器分布会收敛到经验人类分布。推导了显式的收敛速率，并将分析扩展到有限样本场景，同时刻画所需人类样本数量与改写轮数如何随期望误差标度变化。
AI.result: 得到了机器分布向人类经验分布收敛的显式收敛速率；在有限样本环境下扩展了理论分析；阐明了所需的训练样本数量和改写迭代轮数与目标误差之间的定量关系。
AI.conclusion: 该研究从理论上证明了通过重复改写可以系统地将机器文本分布迁移至人类文本分布，提供了收敛保证和资源标度关系，对AI文本检测和生成内容的真实性研究具有重要理论意义。

title: LAAF: A Layered Accountability Architecture Framework for LLM Applications
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) operate in hospitals, courtrooms, banks, and public service desks, where fluent, confident outputs are treated as authoritative even when ungrounded or incorrect. When such an output contributes to harm, who is answerable, and through what mechanisms can responsibility be traced, explained, and acted upon? Following PRISMA guidance, five databases were searched from January 2022 to March 2026 against four review questions; of 4,512 records identified, 122 primary studies were included, together with 12 regulatory and standards documents analysed as primary sources. The review consolidates a sociotechnical account of accountability as an actor-forum relation resolved into five dimensions, and synthesises mechanisms across four families: technical controls, human oversight, organisational governance, and documentation and traceability, each with a maturity assessment. The corpus is read through a four-layer classification device spanning provenance, application logic, human oversight, and governance and redress, cross-cut by traceability, role clarity, and continuous monitoring. Both are mapped onto the EU AI Act, whose high-risk obligations have applied since 2 August 2026, the NIST AI RMF with its Generative AI Profile, ISO/IEC 42001, and sectoral guidance in healthcare, consumer finance, education, and the public sector. Four persistent gaps emerge: under-specification of human oversight, absence of shared accountability metrics, disciplinary disconnection, and limited empirical evaluation, alongside five structural tensions that no surveyed instrument resolves. The review closes by consolidating the classification device into an integrated accountability architecture, LAAF, with cybersecurity aligned to the OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025); it is a synthesis of the surveyed evidence rather than a validated artefact.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述（PRISMA方法），分析了2022年至2026年3月间关于大语言模型（LLM）责任机制的研究与监管文件，构建了一个包含五维度责任理论和四类机制家族的社会技术问责框架，并映射到EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001等法规标准，最终提出名为LAAF的综合责任架构，识别出四个持续存在的缺口和五个结构性张力。
AI.motivation: LLM在医疗、司法、金融等高风险领域产生流畅但可能无依据或错误的输出，当这些输出导致伤害时，缺乏明确的责任归属和可操作的追溯、解释与追责机制，亟需系统性的问责框架。
AI.method: 遵循PRISMA指南，检索五个数据库（2022年1月至2026年3月），共识别4,512条记录，最终纳入122项主要研究及12份监管与标准文件作为主要来源；采用四层分类装置（来源、应用逻辑、人类监督、治理与救济），并通过可追溯性、角色清晰度和持续监控作为横向维度，将分析结果映射到EU AI Act、NIST AI RMF、ISO/IEC 42001等法规框架。
AI.result: 将问责制综合为行为者-论坛关系的五维度社会技术理论；归纳了四类机制家族（技术控制、人类监督、组织治理、文档与可追溯性）并附有成熟度评估；识别出四个持续缺口（人类监督规定不足、缺乏共享问责指标、学科割裂、实证评估有限）和五个结构性张力，并最终整合为LAAF问责架构。
AI.conclusion: LLM责任问题不能仅靠单一工具或法规解决，需要综合的技术、组织、治理与文档机制协同作用；LAAF作为对现有证据的综合产物而非验证过的构件，为未来实践与实证评估提供了基础性的整合框架。

title: SpatialCrafter: Single Image World Modeling with Generative 3D Proxies
summary: Explorable image-to-scene generation is essential for applications in gaming, robotics, and virtual reality. Existing methods based on video diffusion model (VDM) commonly rely on incomplete conditioning signals such as sparse point clouds or 2D panoramas, leading to stochastic hallucinations, long-term drifts and suboptimal 3D consistency. We present SpatialCrafter, a novel two-stage framework that addresses these issues by introducing a global 3D proxy for high-fidelity image-to-scene generation. Specifically, we decompose the generation process into global proxy generation and appearance refinement. For proxy generation, we propose a Point-anchored Sparse Structure~(PaSS) Flow module that predicts a spatially aligned and geometrically consistent 3D proxy. For appearance refinement, we re-frame the VDM as a Generative Deferred Refiner which synthesizes high-frequency photorealistic details upon proxy-defined scene geometry. To better integrate the proxy with the pre-trained VDM, we introduce Parallel Geometry Injection and Proxy-Aware Corruption training strategies, which improve robustness to proxy artifacts without disrupting the pretrained generative manifold. Furthermore, as no suitable dataset exists for this explorable scene generation task, we construct a new large-scale dataset of 115K scenes. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first hybrid dataset for image-to-scene generation. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that SpatialCrafter outperforms state-of-the-art methods, mitigates long-term drift, and remains robust and consistent under rapid camera motion and extreme viewpoint changes. Code, models, and the newly constructed dataset will be publicly released. See more at https://fangchuan.github.io/SpatialCrafter/.

AI.tldr: SpatialCrafter 是一个两阶段图像到场景生成框架，通过引入全局3D代理（proxy）解决视频扩散模型（VDM）在可探索场景生成中的随机幻觉、长期漂移和3D不一致问题。它包含Point-anchored Sparse Structure (PaSS) Flow模块用于生成几何一致的3D代理，以及将VDM重构为Generative Deferred Refiner用于外观细化，并引入Parallel Geometry Injection和Proxy-Aware Corruption训练策略。同时构建了115K场景的大规模混合数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视频扩散模型（VDM）的图像到场景生成方法依赖不完整条件信号（如稀疏点云或2D全景图），导致随机幻觉（stochastic hallucinations）、长期漂移（long-term drifts）和次优的3D一致性。这些问题限制了在游戏、机器人和虚拟现实等应用中的可探索场景生成质量。
AI.method: 提出了两阶段框架SpatialCrafter：(1) 全局代理生成阶段，设计了Point-anchored Sparse Structure (PaSS) Flow模块，预测空间对齐且几何一致的3D代理；(2) 外观细化阶段，将VDM重新定义为Generative Deferred Refiner，在代理定义场景几何上合成高频逼真细节。为更好整合代理与预训练VDM，提出Parallel Geometry Injection和Proxy-Aware Corruption两种训练策略，增强对代理伪影的鲁棒性同时不破坏预训练生成流形。此外构建了115K场景的大规模混合数据集。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，SpatialCrafter优于最先进方法，缓解了长期漂移问题，在快速相机运动和极端视角变化下保持鲁棒性和一致性。代码、模型和新构建的数据集将公开发布。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入全局3D代理作为中间表示，SpatialCrafter有效解决了可探索图像到场景生成中的3D一致性和长期漂移难题，为该领域提供了新的技术方案和大规模数据集资源。

title: ProofEvolve: Neuro-Symbolic Evolution for Formal Automated Theorem Proving
summary: Automated theorem proving offers a natural foundation for recursive self-improvement in scientific discovery. However, existing neural provers do not fully preserve this recursive structure, where the learning process should be self-improving over time. Existing methods either embed proof experience into model parameters through expensive weight updates, or keep verified intermediate deductions only within the current problem. In addition, these methods also heavily rely on sparse whole-proof feedback, even when unsuccessful partial attempts contain useful discoveries. To close the gap, we propose ProofEvolve, a neuro-symbolic framework that evolves explicit, formally verified symbolic proof structures with neural models to decisively expand the knowledge boundary. In this framework, the neural model proposes variation operators, including decompositions, repairs, and schema recombinations. The symbolic Lean kernel verifies every proof transition. Over the evolution loops, ProofEvolve computes verified closure over the resulting proof directed acyclic graphs (DAGs). Within each problem, ProofEvolve evolves partial AND-OR proof DAGs in a behaviorally indexed archive. Across problems, kernel-checked schema extraction adds newly proved sub-DAGs to a persistent schema library. Proof DAGs inherit the solved results through typed schema recombination, with every residual premise exposed as a new subgoal. This evolutionary process preserves verified results from incomplete attempts and makes them available for later proofs without weakening formal soundness. Across three competition-level Lean benchmarks, ProofEvolve achieves the highest average solve rate among the evaluated proof systems.

AI.tldr: ProofEvolve是一个神经符号框架，通过进化验证过的符号证明结构（DAGs）与神经模型结合，在三个竞赛级Lean基准上取得了最高的平均求解率。
AI.motivation: 现有神经证明器存在三个关键缺陷：1）将证明经验嵌入模型参数需要昂贵的权重更新，破坏递归自改进结构；2）只保留当前问题内的中间演绎，跨问题经验无法积累；3）严重依赖稀疏的全证明反馈，忽略了不成功部分尝试中有价值的发现。
AI.method: ProofEvolve是神经符号框架：神经模型提出变异算子（分解、修复、模式重组），符号Lean内核验证每个证明转换。问题内通过行为索引档案进化部分AND-OR证明DAGs；问题间通过内核检查的模式提取将已验证的子DAGs存入持久模式库。证明DAGs通过类型化模式重组继承已解结果，残差前提作为新子目标暴露。
AI.result: 在三个竞赛级Lean基准上，ProofEvolve在所有被评估的证明系统中取得了最高的平均求解率。
AI.conclusion: 这种进化过程在不削弱形式化可靠性的前提下，保留了不完整尝试中的验证结果，并使其可用于后续证明，切实扩展了知识边界。

title: A Reranker for Orchestrating Heterogeneous Speech and Text Retrievers
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems have attracted significant interest for their ability to mitigate hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs). Although knowledge databases for RAG are increasingly diversifying to include various modalities such as speech and text, research on handling such multi-modal database scenarios remains limited. In this paper, we propose STeReO (Speech and Text Reranking Orchestrator), a reranker based on speech and text retrievers that aggregates disparate modality databases. To address the lack of specialized training data, we first curate a dataset comprising queries, mixed-modality evidence, and their corresponding relevance ranks. We then train the reranker and evaluate its effectiveness in both single-modality and mixed-modality scenarios. Our results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm excels at selecting the most relevant evidence, thereby significantly improving downstream question-answering performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STeReO（Speech and Text Reranking Orchestrator），一种基于语音和文本检索器的重排序器，用于聚合异构模态数据库，解决RAG系统在多模态数据库场景下的证据重排序问题，并通过自构建数据集训练，显著提升下游问答性能。
AI.motivation: RAG系统虽能缓解大语言模型的幻觉问题，但现有知识数据库日益多样化（包含语音、文本等多模态），而针对这类多模态数据库场景的研究仍然有限。同时，缺乏专门用于多模态重排序的训练数据，构成主要挑战。
AI.method: 首先构建了一个包含查询、混合模态证据及其相关性排名的数据集；随后在此基础上训练一个基于语音和文本检索器的重排序器STeReO，用于聚合不同模态的数据库。
AI.result: STeReO在单模态和混合模态场景下均表现出色，能够有效选择最相关的证据，从而显著提升下游问答任务的性能。
AI.conclusion: STeReO证明了在多模态RAG场景下通过重排序器聚合异构模态证据的可行性，为多模态知识库的检索增强生成提供了有效方案。

title: Thinking on Shots: Consistent Multi-Shot Video Editing with Agentic Reasoning
comment: Project Page: https://wucy0519.github.io/MMLVE/ and see source codes at https://github.com/Wucy0519/MMLVE
summary: While generative AI has significantly advanced video editing, existing methods primarily focus on single-shot or short video clips. Editing long videos with multiple instructions remains a formidable challenge. Naive chunking strategies, e.g., fixed-duration segmentation, often lead to entity fragmentation, severe editing hallucinations, and disrupted temporal continuity. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Multi-Instruction Multi-Shot Long-Video Editing (MMLVE) task, which is structured around three core objectives: Cross-Shot Editing Consistency (CSEC), Multi-Instruction Decoupling (MID), and Zero-Destruction on Spatiotemporal Structure (ZDSS). To tackle these three unique challenges, we introduce an agentic editing framework that leverages the synergy of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to achieve shot-level video decoupling and precise instruction parsing. Furthermore, to comprehensively evaluate this task, we construct MMLVE-Bench, which is an MMLVE-focused dataset characterized by complex real-world spatiotemporal dynamics, high-density heterogeneous instructions, and sparse, random entity distributions. Three MMLVE-focused evaluation metrics are further exploited to assess the quality of the editing results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our MMLVE-Agent outperforms existing closed-source SOTA approaches (e.g., Seedance 2.0), successfully eliminating editing hallucinations, preserving cross-shot editing consistency, and attaining seamless spatiotemporal transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多指令多镜头长视频编辑（MMLVE）任务及对应的agentic编辑框架MMLVE-Agent，通过大语言模型（LLMs）与视觉语言模型（VLMs）协同实现镜头级视频解耦和精确指令解析，并构建了MMLVE-Bench数据集与三项专用评估指标。实验表明该方法在消除编辑幻觉、保持跨镜头一致性及时空连贯性方面优于Seedance 2.0等现有闭源SOTA方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式AI视频编辑方法主要聚焦于单镜头或短视频片段，面对长视频多指令编辑时，朴素的固定时长分块策略会导致实体碎片化、严重的编辑幻觉和时序连续性中断，因此亟需一种能够处理多指令、多镜头长视频编辑的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出MMLVE任务，围绕三个核心目标（跨镜头编辑一致性CSEC、多指令解耦MID、时空结构零破坏ZDSS）设计；构建agentic编辑框架，利用LLM与VLM的协同实现镜头级视频解耦与精确指令解析；构建MMLVE-Bench数据集（含复杂真实时空动态、高密度异构指令、稀疏随机实体分布），并设计三项MMLVE专用评估指标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明MMLVE-Agent优于Seedance 2.0等现有闭源SOTA方法，成功消除编辑幻觉，保持跨镜头编辑一致性，并实现无缝的时空转换。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的MMLVE任务定义、agentic编辑框架及基准数据集有效填补了长视频多指令编辑领域的空白，验证了LLM+VLM协同范式在该任务上的优越性，为该方向提供了可复现的评估基准。

title: SAGE: Variate-Wise Semantic Augmentation for Vision-Language Time Series Forecasting
summary: Time series forecasting models operate on raw numerical sequences, lacking the semantic knowledge that domain experts implicitly leverage, such as the physical meaning of each variable, its statistical behavior, and its temporal dynamics. Recent efforts to bridge this gap fall into two camps. Some rely on large language models at inference time, which is computationally expensive. Others apply uniform textual prompts at the dataset level, ignoring the heterogeneous semantics across individual variates. We propose SAGE (Seeing and Augmenting with Grounded Encoding), an end-to-end CLIP-based framework that jointly models temporal, cross-variable, textual, and visual information. The CLIP text encoder processes frequency-enhanced patches and variable tokens, while gated residual paths inject variable-specific descriptions and statistical descriptors. In parallel, the frozen CLIP vision encoder aligns rendered series with temporal representations through a training-only contrastive objective. This dual use of CLIP adds complementary semantic and visual supervision without placing an LLM in the forecasting loop. Across eight long-term benchmarks and M4, SAGE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy. Ablations confirm complementary gains from multimodal alignment and variable-level knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE框架，一个基于CLIP的端到端多模态时间序列预测模型，联合建模时间、跨变量、文本和视觉信息，在八个长期基准和M4上达到最先进精度。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列预测模型仅处理原始数值序列，缺乏领域专家利用的语义知识（变量物理含义、统计行为、时间动态）。已有的尝试要么在推理时依赖大语言模型导致计算昂贵，要么在数据集层面使用统一文本提示而忽略单个变量的异构语义。
AI.method: 提出SAGE（Seeing and Augmenting with Grounded Encoding）框架，基于CLIP的端到端架构：1) CLIP文本编码器处理频率增强的patch和变量token，通过门控残差路径注入变量特定描述和统计描述符；2) 冻结的CLIP视觉编码器通过仅训练时的对比目标将渲染序列与时间表示对齐。无需在预测循环中放置LLM，实现双重CLIP利用以提供互补的语义和视觉监督。
AI.result: 在八个长期预测基准和M4数据集上，SAGE达到最先进的预测精度。消融实验确认多模态对齐和变量级知识带来互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时利用CLIP的文本和视觉编码器，并注入变量级语义知识，可以在不引入LLM推理开销的情况下显著提升时间序列预测性能，多模态信息提供了互补的监督信号。

title: TADP: Task-Aware Deformable Prediction for Single-Stage 3D Object Detection
comment: Accepted to the 2023 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV 2023)
summary: Most single-stage 3D object detectors complete different tasks with the same extracted features. Nevertheless, it is impossible to project features into a common space that is adaptive for all the tasks. We present a novel task-aware deformable prediction (TADP) method for single-stage 3D object detection to solve this problem. Firstly, a triple feature refinement aggregation module is designed to extract three-level features adaptively. Additionally, we design the multi-scale feature aggregation block to fuse multi-scale features in a scale-aware manner. Finally, the prediction of each task is deformed with the designed plug-and-play task-aware deformation head. It can percept the emphasis and interaction of each task. We also designed three different deformation modules. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed deformation head shows good results on other detection methods. The experimental results on the KITTI dataset demonstrate that the car mAP is 80.91%, surpassing many state-of-the-art methods on the KITTI benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向单阶段3D目标检测的任务感知可变形预测（TADP）方法，通过三重特征细化聚合模块、多尺度特征聚合块以及即插即用的任务感知变形头来解决不同任务无法共享同一特征空间的问题，在KITTI数据集上取得了80.91%的车辆mAP。
AI.motivation: 大多数单阶段3D目标检测器使用相同的提取特征来完成不同任务（如分类、定位等），但将特征投影到一个对所有任务都自适应的公共空间是不可能的，这限制了检测性能。
AI.method: 1) 设计三重特征细化聚合模块提取三级自适应特征；2) 设计多尺度特征聚合块以尺度感知方式融合多尺度特征；3) 设计即插即用的任务感知变形头，能够感知每个任务的重点和交互关系，并设计了三种不同的变形模块。
AI.result: 在KITTI数据集上，车辆mAP达到80.91%，超越了许多在KITTI基准上的先进方法；同时任务感知变形头在其他检测方法上也表现出良好的泛化效果。
AI.conclusion: 任务感知的可变形预测机制能够有效解决单阶段3D检测中多任务特征空间不兼容的问题，所提出的变形头具有良好的即插即用性和迁移能力。

title: Fine-Tuning of Transformer models with Frames
summary: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) strategies such as Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) are effective solutions for fine-tuning large-scale pre-trained models; however, their memory requirements scale with the size of the model, $\mathcal{O}(dr)$, where $d$ is the model's hidden dimension and $r$ is the rank. Our proposal, FrameFT, models the parameter update $ΔW$ with a sparse coefficient matrix in a Fusion Frame basis. Fusion Frames can be generated algorithmically and shared across model layers, enabling very efficient updates. Only the sparse coefficients of the basis expansion are stored/optimized, reducing the memory footprint. The sparse structure of the coefficient matrix in FrameFT and the sparsity in the Fusion Frames give large compute benefits, and our analysis provides formal convergence results. We evaluate the idea across a suite of supervised fine-tuning benchmarks, focusing on language tasks, but also report application to vision models. Our experiments show that FrameFT achieves performance on par with/exceeding state-of-the-art PEFT techniques, but needs far fewer trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出FrameFT，一种基于Fusion Frame基的稀疏参数高效微调方法，通过稀疏系数矩阵和可跨层共享的Fusion Frame基来建模参数更新ΔW，大幅降低内存和计算开销，同时保持甚至超越现有PEFT技术的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有PEFT方法（如LoRA）虽然有效，但其内存需求随模型维度d和秩r线性增长（O(dr)），在大规模模型上仍然开销较高，需要更高效的参数更新表示方式。
AI.method: 1) 利用Fusion Frame（融合框架）基来建模参数更新ΔW，将ΔW表示为稀疏系数矩阵在Fusion Frame基下的展开。2) Fusion Frame可通过算法生成且跨层共享，只需存储和优化基展开的稀疏系数。3) 系数矩阵的稀疏结构加上Fusion Frame本身的稀疏性带来显著计算收益，并提供形式化的收敛性分析。
AI.result: 在多种监督微调基准（以语言任务为主，也覆盖视觉模型）上，FrameFT在性能上与现有最先进PEFT方法相当或更优，但所需可训练参数显著更少。
AI.conclusion: FrameFT通过Fusion Frame基的稀疏表示实现了更为参数高效、内存友好且计算高效的微调方案，为大规模预训练模型的PEFT提供了一种新范式。

title: On Scope Classification and Current Knowledge-Editing Benchmarks: A Negative Result, with INLAY as a Gradient-Free Case Study
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/Aditya-PS-05/INLAY
summary: Every memory-based knowledge editor in the SERAC lineage depends on a scope decision: given a query, does a stored edit apply? We report that current knowledge-editing benchmarks cannot measure this decision at all. Using INLAY, a gradient-free editor we built to obtain exact per-query ground truth (the model is frozen, edits live in an external addressable memory, and applying an edit is a bias added along one token's unembedding direction at decode time), we execute every candidate router action on 1,689 queries spanning three datasets and three input conditions. An oracle router choosing the best action every time ties a one-line static policy to four decimal places in all nine dataset-by-condition cells: the maximum attainable gain of any per-query routing method is 0.00 points. Abstention is the sole winning action zero times out of 1,689. The cause is structural: these are counterfactual benchmarks whose evaluation question asks for the post-edit answer, so answering from parametric knowledge is wrong by construction, and a benchmark without negatives cannot reward a classifier's ability to reject. This generalizes beyond our system to the whole scope-classifier family the benchmarks are used to evaluate. We confirm the mechanism directly: constructing the missing condition ourselves, by withholding a query's own edit from the index for half the sample, moves pooled headroom from exactly +0.0000 to +0.0420 and gives abstention its first wins. We also report where INLAY itself does not win (WISE beats it on Qwen2.5-7B CounterFact, and retrieval-augmented generation beats every method we tested, INLAY included, on rigorously matched RippleEdits), and disclose two bugs found during a self-audit of our own routing machinery, neither of which changed a published headline number outside noise.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示基于SERAC血统的记忆型知识编辑器中，范围决策（scope decision）这一核心机制在现有benchmark中完全无法被度量。作者构建了INLAY——一种无梯度的记忆编辑器，可获得精确的逐查询真实标签——并系统评估了1,689个查询上的路由器行为，发现最优路由器与一行静态策略在全部九个数据集-条件组合中精确打平（提升为0.00），弃权（abstention）从未获胜。原因是结构性缺陷：反事实benchmark的评估问题本身就要求后编辑答案，分类器无从"拒绝"。作者通过构造含缺失编辑的条件，将池化提升从+0.0000提升至+0.0420，验证了机制。同时披露INLAY自身在部分场景的失败及两个自身路由机制的bug。
AI.motivation: 现有知识编辑benchmark无法度量范围决策（scope decision）这一记忆编辑器的核心能力，导致整个SERAC血统的范围分类器（scope classifier）族群的评价失真。作者旨在证明这一结构性缺陷，并呼吁社区重新审视benchmark设计。
AI.method: 构建INLAY（无梯度、冻结模型、编辑存储于外部可寻址内存、解码时沿词嵌入反方向加偏置），从而获得精确的逐查询真实标签；对1,689个查询、三个数据集、三种输入条件执行所有候选路由器动作；与oracle路由器、静态策略、弃权策略对比；并通过人为构造缺失编辑条件（从索引中扣留一半样本自身编辑）来验证机制假设。
AI.result: oracle路由器与一行静态策略在九个数据集-条件组合中精确一致到四位小数（最大可达增益为0.00点）；1,689次查询中弃权从未获胜。构造缺失条件后，池化headroom从+0.0000跃升至+0.0420，弃权首次获得胜利。此外，WISE在Qwen2.5-7B CounterFact上超越INLAY；在严格配对的RippleEdits上，RAG击败所有测试方法（含INLAY）。
AI.conclusion: 反事实知识编辑benchmark因缺少"负例"（无需编辑的查询）在结构上无法奖励范围分类器的拒绝能力，这使SERAC族系的范围决策评价全面失真；需要设计含缺失编辑条件的benchmark才能真实度量范围分类器。作者同时以自我审查态度披露了INLAY的局限与自身路由机制的两个bug。

title: Hyperspectral Diffusion Equivariant Imaging (HyDiff-EI): A Self-supervised Framework for Hyperspectral Image Inpainting
summary: A novel Hyperspectral diffusion Equivariant Imaging (HyDiff-EI) framework for solving the hyperspectral image (HSI) inpainting problem has been presented here. Unlike conventional diffusion-based methods that rely on large-scale pretraining, HyDiff-EI is a test-time optimization framework that learns directly from a single corrupted HSI acquisition. This makes it flexible for different sensor configurations and particularly well-suited for practical remote sensing scenarios where large annotated hyperspectral datasets are limited. To address the ill-posed nature of unsupervised inpainting, we embed equivariant consistency constraints within the diffusion process. By leveraging the inherent geometric symmetries and intrinsic characteristics of HSIs, HyDiff-EI bridges the gap between generative diffusion modeling and self-consistent physical priors. We empirically show that coupling diffusion modeling with equivariant priors substantially enhances noise robustness and generalizability. Extensive experiments on real-world datasets including Chikusei, Botswana, and EMIT demonstrate that HyDiff-EI offers remarkable inpainting quality over existing self-supervised and diffusion-based algorithms in both noiseless and noisy cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为HyDiff-EI的新型高光谱图像修补框架，它不同于传统依赖大规模预训练的扩散方法，而是一种测试时优化框架，直接从单次损坏的高光谱采集数据中学习。通过在扩散过程中嵌入等变一致性约束来利用高光谱图像的几何对称性和固有特征，从而解决无监督修补的不适定性问题，并在真实数据集上展现出优于现有自监督和扩散算法的修补质量。
AI.motivation: 高光谱图像修补面临两个核心挑战：（1）传统扩散方法依赖大规模预训练，但在实际遥感场景中标注的高光谱数据集十分有限，限制了其适用性；（2）无监督修补问题本身具有不适定性。因此需要一种不依赖大规模数据、且能有效利用高光谱图像内在物理先验的方法。
AI.method: HyDiff-EI采用测试时优化框架，直接从单个损坏的高光谱图像中学习，无需大规模预训练。方法的关键在于在扩散过程中嵌入等变一致性约束，利用高光谱图像固有的几何对称性和内在特征，将生成式扩散建模与自洽的物理先验相结合，从而解决无监督修补的不适定问题。
AI.result: 在Chikusei、Botswana和EMIT等真实数据集上的大量实验表明，HyDiff-EI在无噪声和有噪声两种情况下，相较于现有自监督和扩散类算法均展现出显著的修补质量提升。实验还证实，将扩散建模与等变先验相结合能显著增强噪声鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: HyDiff-EI通过将扩散模型与等变一致性约束相结合，成功弥合了生成式扩散建模与自洽物理先验之间的鸿沟，为遥感场景下数据有限的高光谱图像修补提供了一种灵活且鲁棒的解决方案，在不同传感器配置下具有良好的适应性和实用性。

title: Reinforcement Learning-Based Control of CAV Platoon Joining Maneuvers in Mixed Traffic
summary: Connected and automated vehicle (CAV) platooning offers a promising approach to improving road safety and traffic capacity. However, platoon control in real-world traffic is challenging due to uncertainty and heterogeneous driving behaviors. Reinforcement learning (RL) has strong potential for addressing such control problems, but its practical deployment raises challenges related to safety and learning efficiency. This paper proposes a generic modeling and simulation framework for investigating CAV platoon joining maneuvers and comparing deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based control algorithms. The problem is particularly challenging in mixed-traffic environments, where CAVs coexist with human-driven vehicles exhibiting heterogeneous longitudinal and lateral behaviors. The objective is to achieve safe and efficient joining maneuvers by either incorporating penalties for risky behaviors into the learning process or using an external safety controller to constrain the learned policy. An agent-based modeling framework coupled with the Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) simulator is used to evaluate Deep Q-Network (DQN), Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN), and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Results show that PPO outperforms DQN and DDQN, achieving a joining success rate of approximately 98 % and a collision rate below 1 %, largely due to risk-related penalties incorporated into the reward function. However, this improved performance requires more decision steps to complete the maneuver, revealing a trade-off between safety, joining effectiveness, and decision efficiency. An external safety controller effectively prevents collisions, although its interventions may reduce joining efficiency. The results highlight the importance of jointly considering safety and efficiency when designing RL-based controllers for CAV platoon joining in mixed traffic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个通用建模与仿真框架，用于研究网联自动驾驶车辆（CAV）车队加入 maneuvers 并比较不同深度强化学习（DRL）控制算法。在混合交通环境中，通过在奖励函数中加入风险惩罚或使用外部安全控制器来约束所学策略，实现安全高效的加入操作。结果表明PPO优于DQN和DDQN，加入成功率达约98%，碰撞率低于1%。
AI.motivation: CAV车队在真实交通环境中面临不确定性和异构驾驶行为的挑战，而强化学习虽然适合处理此类控制问题，但其实际部署面临安全性和学习效率方面的挑战。因此需要一个通用的仿真框架来系统性地研究并评估不同DRL算法在车队加入场景中的表现。
AI.method: 采用基于智能体的建模框架，耦合SUMO交通仿真器，评估了三种DRL算法（DQN、DDQN和PPO）。通过两种安全机制实现目标：一是在学习过程中将风险行为的惩罚纳入奖励函数，二是使用外部安全控制器约束已学习的策略。
AI.result: PPO在加入成功率和安全性方面优于DQN和DDQN，实现了约98%的加入成功率和低于1%的碰撞率，这主要归功于奖励函数中的风险惩罚。但PPO需要更多的决策步骤来完成操作，揭示了安全、加入有效性和决策效率之间的权衡。外部安全控制器能有效防止碰撞，但可能降低加入效率。
AI.conclusion: 在设计用于混合交通中CAV车队加入的基于强化学习的控制器时，必须综合考虑安全性和效率，二者之间存在内在权衡。该研究为CAV车队加入控制算法的设计与评估提供了可靠的仿真基础。

title: Don't Overthink, Don't Underthink: Toward Adaptive Reasoning in Agentic AI
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown that increased inference-time reasoning can improve performance on complex tasks. However, many existing approaches rely on fixed or preallocated reasoning controls, such as fixed token budgets, pre-execution difficulty estimates, or activation-space interventions, and are often evaluated on standalone reasoning benchmarks rather than full agentic workflows. These assumptions may not hold in agentic AI systems, where reasoning requirements evolve dynamically through planning, tool use, memory retrieval, and agent-to-agent interactions. Consequently, reasoning can become either excessive or insufficient, resulting in unnecessary computation, increased latency, planning drift, excessive tool use, or incomplete solutions. We argue that a major challenge for next-generation agentic AI is not merely how much reasoning a language model should perform, but how it should allocate reasoning according to evolving task demands. We characterize over-reasoning and under-reasoning as recurring failure modes of misallocated reasoning and evaluate them on MATH-500 and the GAIA public validation benchmark. Using tool-decision latency, token consumption, token-limit exhaustion, and answer correctness, our results suggest that cases classified as over-reasoning are associated with higher computational cost without proportional accuracy gains, whereas cases classified as under-reasoning are consistently associated with incorrect or incomplete solutions. These findings motivate future research on adaptive reasoning mechanisms for agentic AI.

AI.tldr: 本文指出智能体AI系统中推理分配不当会导致过度推理和推理不足两种失败模式，并通过MATH-500和GAIA基准实验证明这两种模式分别带来不必要的计算开销和错误/不完整的解决方案，呼吁研究自适应推理分配机制。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理方法多依赖固定或预分配的推理控制（如固定token预算、预执行难度估计、激活空间干预），且主要在独立推理基准上评估，而智能体场景中推理需求随规划、工具使用、记忆检索等动态变化，导致推理过量或不足，造成计算浪费或方案不完整。作者认为下一代智能体AI的核心挑战不只是"推理多少"，而是"如何根据任务需求动态分配推理"。
AI.method: 作者在MATH-500和GAIA公开验证基准上对推理分配问题进行系统评估。使用工具决策延迟、token消耗、token限制耗尽和答案正确性作为指标，对过度推理和推理不足两类失败模式进行定量表征和分类分析。
AI.result: 实验结果发现：过度推理案例与更高的计算成本相关但无成比例的准确率提升；推理不足案例与错误或不完整的解决方案一致相关。两类失败模式在智能体工作流中均显著存在。
AI.conclusion: 推理分配而非推理总量是智能体AI实现高效可靠推理的关键，研究结果为未来自适应推理机制的设计提供了实证基础和方向。

title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models
summary: Tool-augmented LLMs must arbitrate between two fallible sources when a tool return conflicts with their parametric memory, yet existing evaluations measure source preference without establishing source correctness. We introduce MemToC, a controlled benchmark for post-tool-return arbitration with executable tools. MemToC comprises 6,504 evaluation episodes constructed from 542 quality-controlled factual questions, independently elicited model-specific closed-book answers, and controlled tool returns of known correctness. These components instantiate four source-correctness cases; tool-error and no-tool conditions are separate controls. Across five open-weight 7-9B models, tool returns strongly dominate elicited closed-book answers. The four instruction-tuned models retain a verified-correct answer against an incorrect tool in only 6.5-17.1% of eligible cases, follow a correct tool in 86.0-93.1%, and repeat the tool return in 78.4-86.0% of cases where both sources are wrong. No cross-model ordering remains stable across three instruction-wording variants with the question and episode content held fixed. We compare prompting with SFT and DPO using chain-level cross-fitting over ToolHop, so questions sharing an underlying fact never straddle training and evaluation. We apply an asymmetric success criterion: correct-answer retention must improve without a detected reduction in correct-tool following. SFT and DPO meet this criterion on the same two of four instruction-tuned backbones. Improvements rarely come cleanly: 19 of 20 tested method-model combinations reduce abstention after tool errors or on unanswerable inputs. Transfer beyond MemToC is positive but partial and depends on the model and presentation frame. Correctness-conditioned arbitration can be improved through fine-tuning, but gains must be evaluated jointly with correct tool use, abstention, and robustness to formulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MemToC基准，用于评估工具增强LLM在后工具返回阶段在工具输出与参数记忆冲突时的仲裁能力。基于542个质量受控的事实问题和6,504个评估片段，研究发现工具返回强烈主导闭卷答案，四个指令微调模型在面对错误工具时仅有6.5-17.1%保留正确答案。通过SFT和DPO微调可改善仲裁，但收益需与正确工具跟随率、弃答率和表述鲁棒性联合评估。
AI.motivation: 现有工具增强LLM的评估仅衡量来源偏好（工具vs记忆），而不建立来源正确性，无法真正衡量模型能否在工具返回与参数记忆冲突时做出正确仲裁。作者希望构建一个同时控制工具返回正确性与模型闭卷答案正确性的基准，以严格评估仲裁能力。
AI.method: 构建MemToC基准：从542个质量控管的事实问题中生成6,504个评估片段，独立诱发模型特定闭卷答案，并控制工具返回的正确性，构成四种来源正确性情形（工具正/记忆正、工具错/记忆正等），另设工具错误和无语境对照。通过与ToolHop的链级交叉拟合，将SFT和DPO与提示词方法对比，使用非对称成功准则评估。
AI.result: 五个7-9B开放权重模型中，工具返回强烈主导闭卷答案。四个指令微调模型保留正确记忆对抗错误工具的比例仅6.5-17.1%；正确工具跟随率为86.0-93.1%；双错时重复工具返回率78.4-86.0%。三种指令措辞下无跨模型稳定排序。SFT和DPO仅在四个后端中的两个满足非对称成功准则；19/20的方法-模型组合降低了工具错误或不可作答输入时的弃答率。向MemToC外迁移的部分正向且依赖模型和呈现框架。
AI.conclusion: 基于正确性的条件仲裁可通过微调得到改善，但收益必须与正确工具使用、弃答行为以及对表述变化的鲁棒性联合评估。仅关注正确性提升而不考虑工具跟随和弃答下降会掩盖真实的仲裁能力缺陷。

title: LLaVAFlow: Preserving Latent Alignment Flow for Parameter-Efficient Multimodal Fine-Tuning
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) exhibit strong generalization, visual instruction tuning for downstream tasks inevitably causes catastrophic forgetting, impairing overall generalization. While existing methods regulate weight updates to reduce forgetting, they overlook the fundamental cross-modal alignment in MLLMs. Based on prior work and our observations, we argue that cross-modal alignment is implicitly captured in the information-compression trajectory. To preserve the alignment flow embedded in the trajectory, we propose LLaVAFlow, an information-theoretic distillation framework. First, we compress the mutual information between the extracted relations and MLLM embeddings, encouraging a learnable module to produce a refined alignment flow that benefits downstream tasks. Second, we maximize the mutual information between the extracted alignment flows of the pretrained and fine-tuned MLLMs, enabling the transfer of compact alignment information. Extensive experiments show that LLaVAFlow is an effective plug-and-play framework that preserves alignment flow and enhances both downstream performance and generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出LLaVAFlow，一种基于信息论的蒸馏框架，通过压缩互信息保持多模态大语言模型在视觉指令微调过程中的跨模态对齐流，从而缓解灾难性遗忘并提升泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视觉指令微调时存在灾难性遗忘问题，损害整体泛化能力。现有方法仅通过约束权重更新来缓解遗忘，但忽略了MLLMs中根本的跨模态对齐问题。
AI.method: 基于跨模态对齐隐含在信息压缩轨迹中的观察，提出LLaVAFlow框架：1）压缩提取关系与MLLM嵌入之间的互信息，促使可学习模块生成有利于下游任务的精炼对齐流；2）最大化预训练与微调MLLMs提取的对齐流之间的互信息，实现紧凑对齐信息的迁移。
AI.result: 大量实验表明LLaVAFlow是有效的即插即用框架，能够保留对齐流，同时提升下游任务性能与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态对齐的保持是缓解MLLMs灾难性遗忘的关键，LLaVAFlow通过信息论蒸馏方法有效实现了这一点，且具有即插即用的灵活性。

title: When Is the Sharp Covariance Envelope Tight? Feature-Only Geometry for Volume-Sampled Least Squares
summary: Prior analyses by Derezinski and Warmuth established all-size sampling identities, selected-OLS unbiasedness, and inverse moments for ordinary volume sampling, while their exact arbitrary-fixed-response loss and prediction-covariance formulas are at the rank-size endpoint s=d. We establish a Loewner envelope for centered coefficient covariance for every full-rank fixed pool, response, and legal budget d <= s <= m under ordinary indexed fixed-size volume sampling followed by selected unweighted least squares; its coefficient is globally sharp over the full-rank class. Global sharpness does not determine attainability on the pool in hand. Under positive loss, strict-interior budgets, and no coloops, a feature-only margin nu_A gives the exact fixed-design spectral phase: nu_A > 0 if and only if the normalized spectral envelope is strict for every compatible residual, whereas nu_A = 0 if and only if some compatible residual is spectrally tight; the same zero-margin residual is tight at every strict-interior budget. A residual-augmented change of measure supplies the response-aware mechanism and a one-sided quantitative slack bound, while support saturation proves the attainment direction. Critical equal-leverage geometry interprets the boundary, and sound lower certificates yield conservative same-primitive cardinality decisions. Frozen-feature examples show that the certificate is nonvacuous and measure the fixed-pool cost of its authorized reduction. The claims concern conditional centered, full-Gram-whitened coefficient covariance, not population generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文在普通索引固定规模体积抽样后接所选未加权最小二乘的框架下，建立了中心化系数协方差的Loewner包络，覆盖所有满秩固定池、响应及合法预算d≤s≤m，并通过特征边际、残差增广测度变换与支撑饱和机制给出谱相变的精确刻画。
AI.motivation: Derezinski与Warmuth先前仅在所有规模抽样恒等式、所选OLS无偏性与逆矩、以及秩满时端点s=d处的精确损失与预测协方差公式上取得结果。对任意固定响应与中间预算（满秩s介于d与m之间）的精确/最优性刻画仍缺失，需要系统性地建立中心化系数协方差的包络及其严格/紧致条件的可判定准则。
AI.method: 在普通索引固定规模体积抽样（ordinary indexed fixed-size volume sampling）后接所选未加权最小二乘的框架下：1）利用Loewner序建立中心化系数协方差的包络，并证明其在满秩类上全局尖锐；2）引入特征边际nu_A刻画固定设计谱相变，给出nu_A>0（谱包络对所有兼容残差严格）与nu_A=0（存在兼容残差谱紧致）的充要条件；3）采用残差增广测度变换提供响应感知机制与单边定量松弛界；4）通过支撑饱和证明可达方向；5）利用临界等杠杆几何解释边界，并以零边际残差在所有严格内部预算下的紧致性作支撑。
AI.result: 建立了满秩类上全局尖锐的Loewner包络；证明了nu_A>0当且仅当对所有兼容残差谱包络严格，nu_A=0当且仅当存在谱紧致的兼容残差，且同一零边际残差在所有严格内部预算下紧致；提供了残差增广测度变换下的定量松弛界与保守的相同原基基数判定下界证书；冻结特征示例验证证书非平凡并量化授权缩减的固定池代价。
AI.conclusion: 系统补全了体积抽样后所选OLS在中间预算下的中心化系数协方差精确刻画，明确全局尖锐性不等同于在具体池上的可达性，并严格限定研究范围为条件中心化的、全Gram白化的系数协方差，不涉及总体泛化。

title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agent runs generate experience that can improve both the current run and future work. Most self-improvement methods process this experience only after execution ends, so they cannot redirect the active run or immediately apply and validate lessons learned from it. We argue that self-improvement should instead be live, using emerging experience both to redirect the active run and to update the persistent harness. Existing agent architectures do not fully support this goal. Single-agent self-correction combines task execution and trajectory assessment within one context, while subagent delegation separates execution but typically cannot redirect an active subagent. We present PILOT, a supervisor-worker harness for live self-improvement through two coupled mechanisms: (1) live steering lets a separate supervisor redirect or abort the active worker during execution; and (2) live self-evolution distils procedures and failure modes revealed during execution into reusable skills and memory. Across two frozen backbones and three benchmarks, PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, PILOT outperforms counterpart harnesses by up to 9.8 percentage points. In the self-improvement setting, PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6. Mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%, while successful evaluations per million output tokens rise by 110.3% and 134.0%, respectively.

AI.tldr: PILOT是一种监督者-工作者架构，通过实时转向和实时自我进化两种耦合机制实现智能体的实时自我改进，在多个基准上优于现有方法，同时显著降低输出token并提升单位token的成功率。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体运行产生的经验可以改进当前运行和未来工作，但大多数自我改进方法仅在执行结束后处理经验，无法重定向正在进行的运行，也无法立即应用和验证从中学到的教训。作者认为自我改进应当是实时的（live），即利用涌现的经验既重定向当前运行，又更新持久化的工具库。
AI.method: PILOT采用监督者-工作者（supervisor-worker）架构，包含两个耦合机制：(1) 实时转向（live steering）：独立的监督者可以在执行过程中重定向或中止活跃的工作者；(2) 实时自我进化（live self-evolution）：在执行过程中将暴露的程序和失败模式提炼为可复用的技能和记忆。
AI.result: 在两个冻结骨干模型和三个基准上，PILOT在六个配置中的五个排名第一。在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，PILOT比对照架构最高高出9.8个百分点。在自我改进设置中，PILOT在GLM-5.1上提升14.6点，在Kimi-K2.6上提升12.4点。平均输出token分别下降42.9%和47.4%，而每百万输出token的成功评估次数分别提升110.3%和134.0%。
AI.conclusion: 实时自我改进比事后处理经验更有效，PILOT通过将任务执行与轨迹评估解耦（分配到不同上下文），同时保持监督者能够实时介入工作者，能够同时提升当前运行和未来工作的性能，并且显著提高token效率。

title: When Is Noise Response Universal? Tokenization as the Hidden Variable in Language Models
summary: The performance of textual neural models often degrades when their inputs are corrupted by noise such as typos, OCR errors, or dropped words. We study the degradation rate across neural models, both sentence embeddings and decoder-only LLMs, and find that how consistent it is depends on the scale of the noise: under word-level noise, models with very different architectures decline along nearly the same curve, while under character-level noise they separate. We further identify the determining factor to be the training objective, not the architecture: eight encoders spanning six pretraining paradigms are scattered initially, and collapse onto a common curve after a short contrastive training recipe. We trace the word/character split to tokenization: a single character edit forces the tokenizer to re-segment the surrounding word, disturbing the token sequence far more than dropping a whole word does. This finding and its underlying mechanism provide a practical means to predict a model's robustness to noise without any noisy evaluation, and to install robustness at a chosen noise scale through noise-augmented training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了文本神经模型在输入噪声（如错别字、OCR错误、单词缺失）下的性能退化规律，发现退化一致性取决于噪声规模：词级噪声下不同架构模型沿几乎相同的退化曲线，而字符级噪声下则分化明显。决定因素是训练目标而非架构，对比训练能使不同编码器收敛到共同退化曲线。根本机制在于分词器：单个字符编辑会迫使分词器重新切分词元序列，扰动远大于删除整个单词。
AI.motivation: 文本神经模型在真实场景中常遭遇输入噪声，但不同模型对噪声的鲁棒性差异及其背后的机理尚未被系统理解。理解退化规律有助于预测模型鲁棒性并针对性提升，无需大量带噪声的评测数据。
AI.method: 在多种神经模型（句子嵌入和仅解码器LLM）上，分别施加词级噪声和字符级噪声，测量性能退化曲线；对比六种预训练范式的八个编码器在对比训练前后的退化行为；通过分析分词器的重切分行为来解释词级与字符级噪声的退化差异。
AI.result: 词级噪声下不同架构模型退化曲线几乎一致；字符级噪声下模型退化行为分化。训练目标是决定因素而非架构，短时对比训练可使模型退化曲线收敛。字符级噪声导致分词器重新切分词元，造成更严重的词元序列扰动，这一机制可解释词/字符级噪声的退化差异。
AI.conclusion: 该发现提供了一种无需噪声评测即可预测模型鲁棒性的实用手段，并可通过噪声增强训练在指定噪声规模下为模型安装鲁棒性。

title: Evaluator-Dependent Patient-Adaptive ECG Lead-Channel Allocation
summary: Patient-conditioned acquisition policies for ECG lead-channel selection can outperform population-wide fixed protocols by tailoring the channel budget to each patient's observed cardiac state. However, the value of acquiring any given channel is defined relative to a downstream diagnostic evaluator, so marginal utilities learned under one evaluator need not transfer when the evaluator is replaced. We study this evaluator dependence empirically on PTB-XL by freezing two policies (ECG-on-Demand and MGA) trained with a controlled arbitrary-mask logistic evaluator, then scoring their unchanged acquisition trajectories with a more predictive masked raw-waveform ResNet1D. Exhaustive search provides metric-matched population-wide fixed comparators separately for each evaluator, enabling a clean interaction contrast. At budget $k=4$ on a held-out evaluation fold, ECG-on-Demand shifts from $D_\mathrm{C}=-0.011$ (favoring adaptive under the controlled evaluator) to $D_\mathrm{S}=+0.029$ (favoring fixed under the strong evaluator), yielding an NLL interaction of $+0.041$ (95% CI $[+0.030, +0.050]$). Across two policies, five budgets, and three probabilistic metrics, all 30 interaction estimates are positive with paired confidence intervals excluding zero. Three post-hoc sensitivity analyses -- common-reference scoring, training the strong evaluator on a mixture of policy-generated and random masks, and evaluator-aligned Strong-MGA policy training -- each preserve a positive interaction interval, making reference-choice and mask-distribution artifacts less plausible explanations. Evaluator-aligned training reduces but does not eliminate the gap. These results indicate that adaptive ECG channel allocation should be developed and validated jointly with its intended diagnostic backbone, and that jointly optimized sensing-diagnosis systems remain an open problem.

AI.tldr: 本研究在PTB-XL数据集上实证检验了ECG导联选择策略对其下游诊断评估器的依赖程度。通过将两种自适应策略（ECG-on-Demand和MGA）在受控逻辑评估器下训练的采集轨迹，用更强的掩码原始波形ResNet1D评估器重新打分，发现所有30个交互效应估计均为正且置信区间排除零，表明自适应通道分配的优势依赖于评估器，并建议ECG通道分配策略应与目标诊断骨干网络联合开发与验证。
AI.motivation: 自适应ECG导联选择策略的效用是相对于特定下游诊断评估器定义的，因此在一个评估器下学习到的边际效用可能无法在评估器更换后迁移。现有研究缺乏对评估器依赖性的系统实证分析，而这直接影响此类策略在真实临床部署中的稳健性和普适性。
AI.method: 在PTB-XL上冻结两个用受控任意掩码逻辑评估器训练的策略（ECG-on-Demand和MGA），用更强的掩码原始波形ResNet1D对未改变的采集轨迹重新打分。通过穷举搜索为每个评估器分别提供度量匹配的群体固定比较基线，计算NLL交互效应。跨2种策略×5个预算×3个概率指标共30个交互估计，并进行三个事后敏感性分析：公共参考评分、混合掩码训练强评估器、评估器对齐的Strong-MGA策略训练。
AI.result: 预算k=4时，ECG-on-Demand从受控评估器下的D_C=-0.011（自适应占优）翻转为强评估器下的D_S=+0.029（固定占优），NLL交互效应为+0.041（95% CI [+0.030, +0.050]）。全部30个交互估计均为正且配对置信区间排除零。三个敏感性分析均保留正交互区间，排除参考选择和掩码分布伪影解释；评估器对齐训练可缩小但未消除差距。
AI.conclusion: 自适应ECG通道分配策略的效用高度依赖于其下游诊断评估器，此类策略应与目标诊断骨干网络联合开发和验证。联合优化的感知-诊断系统仍是一个未解决的问题。

title: Mitigating Strong-Modality Collapse in Multimodal Learning via Inverted Asymmetric Fusion
summary: Fusing multiple modalities is expected to improve model performance. However, on the MultiHuSE dataset, early, late, and symmetric attention fusion often fail to outperform the best unimodal baseline (text). Pathway isolation of a symmetric attention fusion model reveals that the text-pathway accuracy drops from 74.9% to 56.4% after fusion in one such setting, indicating that the dominant modality can be degraded during integration. We term this strong-modality collapse and argue that it helps explain why some multimodal models fail to surpass unimodal baselines. We propose Inverted Asymmetric Fusion (IAF), which avoids forcing mutual attention across modalities. The dominant modality is preserved by passing through fusion unchanged, while weaker modalities attend to it as a contextual anchor. Before fusion, weaker modalities are strengthened using Modality-Aware Knowledge Distillation. We evaluate IAF on three benchmarks with different modality hierarchies: text-dominant datasets (MultiHuSE, UR-FUNNY) and an audio-visual-dominant dataset (MUStARD). Pathway isolation shows that IAF preserves the dominant modality's internal accuracy at its unimodal ceiling across all tested configurations, whereas symmetric fusion degrades it by up to 18.5% on MultiHuSE. IAF improves over the strongest unimodal baseline by up to 8.25%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出强模态坍缩（strong-modality collapse）概念，用于解释多模态融合模型为何常未能超越最优单模态基线。作者提出倒置非对称融合（IAF）方法，保留主模态信息不变，让弱模态以知识蒸馏增强后向其对齐，在三个多模态数据集上有效提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有早期融合、晚期融合和对称注意力融合在MultiHuSE数据集上均无法超越最优单模态基线（文本）。通过通路隔离分析发现，融合过程中主模态的内部精度会从74.9%下降到56.4%，说明优势模态在集成过程中被降级，这解释了为何多模态模型有时不如单模态基线。作者将这一现象命名为强模态坍缩，并致力于解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出Inverted Asymmetric Fusion (IAF)方法：1) 主模态通道在融合时保持不变、直接旁路，避免被弱模态干扰；2) 弱模态将主模态作为上下文锚点进行注意力对齐，而非强制模态间互注意力；3) 融合前使用Modality-Aware Knowledge Distillation对弱模态进行增强。
AI.result: 在三个不同模态层级的数据集（文本主导的MultiHuSE、UR-FUNNY和视听主导的MUStARD）上评估IAF。通路隔离显示，IAF在所有测试配置中均将主模态内部精度保持在单模态上限水平，而对称融合在MultiHuSE上使主模态精度降低高达18.5%。IAF相比最强单模态基线最高提升8.25%。
AI.conclusion: 强模态坍缩是导致多模态融合失败的关键原因，IAF通过非对称架构设计避免了这一退化问题，能够有效保留主模态能力并利用辅助模态信息带来增益，为多模态融合模型设计提供了新的思路。

title: Multi2AV-Safety: Benchmarking Safety in Multimodal-to-Audio-Video Generation
summary: Audio-video generation is rapidly moving from prompt-driven synthesis toward multimodal conditioning, where text, images, audio, and video can jointly shape the generated output. This shift changes the nature of safety evaluation: harmful intent may no longer reside in any single input, but instead emerge from how otherwise benign or weakly harmful conditions interact across modalities and time. Existing safety benchmarks, however, remain largely prompt-centric or tied to fixed conditioning interfaces, leaving such compositional risks difficult to study systematically. To bridge this gap, we introduce Multi2AV-Safety, the first safety benchmark, to the best of our knowledge, to cover all 11 non-singleton T/I/A/V conditioning configurations for audio-video generation, comprising 11,024 attack instances. Evaluation on Multi2AV-Safety reveals systematic weaknesses in representative multimodal safety guards across attack mechanisms and harm-evidence structures. Our evaluation reveals two complementary failure modes: harmful semantics can emerge from the combination of individually benign inputs, while explicit harmful cues can become harder to detect when mixed with benign multimodal context. Together, these results identify \emph{compositional risk perception} as a central capability gap in safeguarding multimodal-conditioned audio-video generation: current safety guards fail to reliably integrate safety evidence across modalities and time, even when all conditioning inputs are observable. The dataset will be publicly released in October 2026.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Multi2AV-Safety，这是首个覆盖音频-视频生成中所有11种非单模态文本/图像/音频/视频条件组合的安全基准测试集，包含11,024个攻击实例。评估发现当前多模态安全防护器存在两个互补的失败模式：良性输入组合可能涌现有害语义，而显式有害线索混入良性多模态上下文后更难被检测，揭示"组合风险感知"是当前多模态条件音频-视频生成安全防护的核心能力缺口。
AI.motivation: 音频-视频生成正从提示驱动合成转向多模态条件生成，文本、图像、音频和视频可联合塑造输出。这种转变改变了安全评估的性质：有害意图可能不再存在于任何单一输入中，而是从各模态间跨时间交互中涌现出来。然而现有安全基准仍以提示为中心或绑定固定条件接口，难以系统性地研究这类组合风险，因此需要新的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 作者构建了Multi2AV-Safety基准，覆盖音频-视频生成中所有11种非单例的T/I/A/V（文本/图像/音频/视频）条件配置，包含11,024个攻击实例。通过在这些多模态条件配置下评估代表性多模态安全防护器，系统性地考察攻击机制和有害证据结构对安全检测的影响。
AI.result: 评估揭示了两个互补的失败模式：(1) 原本各自良性的输入组合可以涌现出有害语义；(2) 显式有害线索在与良性多模态上下文混合时变得更难检测。这些结果共同表明当前安全防护器即使所有条件输入都可观测，仍无法可靠地跨模态和跨时间整合安全证据。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出"组合风险感知"（compositional risk perception）是保障多模态条件音频-视频生成安全的核心能力缺口。当前安全防护器在跨模态和跨时间整合安全证据方面存在系统性不足，即使所有条件输入都可见。该数据集将于2026年10月公开发布。

title: How Unlikely Is "Unlikely"? Assessing Verbal Probability Perception Across Large Language Models
summary: Large language models increasingly produce and interpret verbal probability expressions, yet whether these expressions carry consistent meaning across models (or match human perceptions of uncertainty) remains unknown. We present a systematic cross-model evaluation using a word-to-number mapping task grounded in established human benchmarks. Eleven uncertainty expressions were presented to 19 models under two conditions, forced single-number response and explanation elicitation, alongside a novel bidirectional roundtrip test of internal consistency. LLMs track the human benchmark with surprising fidelity: word ordering is preserved, three anchor points are recovered, and ``possible'' shows the highest variance and cross-model disagreement of any expression tested, consistent with its documented bimodal interpretation in humans. However, models show a systematic upward bias for negative expressions such as ``unlikely'' and ``improbable.'' Explanation elicitation reduces within-model variance while increasing between-model divergence, stabilizing individual models at the cost of inter-model consensus, and the roundtrip experiment reveals clear stratification, with frontier models maintaining coherent bidirectional representations. LLMs thus reproduce the structure of human verbal probability cognition, including its biases, while diverging systematically at the negative end---with implications for any setting where humans and models exchange probabilistic language.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了大型语言模型对自然语言概率表达（如"可能""不太可能"）的理解是否与人类一致。通过对19个模型、11个不确定性表达进行跨模型评估，发现LLM在很大程度上复现了人类口头概率认知的结构（包括词语排序、锚点恢复和"possible"的双峰歧义），但对负面表达（如"unlikely""improbable"）存在系统性向上偏差，且解释引导虽降低模型内方差却加剧模型间分歧。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地产生和解读自然语言中的概率表达，但这些表达在不同模型间是否有一致含义、是否匹配人类对不确定性的感知，仍是未知数。这一问题的答案直接影响人机概率语言交互的可靠性。
