AI.method: 采用词到数字映射任务（word-to-number mapping），基于已建立的人类基准数据集。对19个模型、11个不确定性表达在两种条件下进行测试：(1) 强制单数字回答；(2) 解释引导（explanation elicitation）。同时设计了新颖的双向往返测试（bidirectional roundtrip test）来检验模型的内部一致性。
AI.result: 研究发现：(1) LLM词序与人类基准高度一致，恢复出三个锚点；(2) "possible"在所有表达中方差和跨模型分歧最高，与人类双峰解释一致；(3) 对"unlikely""improbable"等负面表达存在系统性向上偏差；(4) 解释引导降低了模型内方差但增加了模型间分歧；(5) 往返测试显示前沿模型保持连贯的双向表征，模型间存在明显分层。
AI.conclusion: LLM复现了人类口头概率认知的结构及其偏差，但在负面端（low probability方向）存在系统性分歧。这一发现对任何人类与模型交换概率性语言的场景（如人机协作决策、AI辅助风险评估）都有重要影响。

title: Rethinking Image Processing for the Age of AI: A Problem-First Framework for Scientific Progress
summary: Modern AI has greatly expanded the capabilities of image processing. However, the ready availability of powerful models, public datasets, and benchmark leaderboards has also en- couraged a model-first research pattern: researchers increasingly begin with an available architecture and optimize it on a public benchmark, rather than beginning with the underlying real-world imaging problem. This can produce impressive benchmark results without necessarily improving our understanding or solution of the real problem. This paper argues for a problem-first approach that distinguishes the physical imaging problem, solution principle, statistical estimator, and computational implementation, while clarifying what modern AI can achieve and which fundamental problems remain unsolved. Through case studies of super- resolution and low-light enhancement, we show how benchmark datasets may define tasks that differ substantially from the real-world problems they are intended to represent, and why performance improvements must be interpreted within the conditions under which they are obtained. We propose a six-stage workflow that places problem formulation, image acquisition, information-loss analysis, assumptions, ambiguity, and evaluation before model and dataset selection. The paper also proposes clearer standards for evidence, reproducibility, uncertainty, and claims of state-of-the-art performance. More fundamentally, it calls for a change in research culture and education so that future researchers learn to understand imaging problems deeply and use modern AI to achieve genuine scientific and technical advancement.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了当前AI图像处理研究中以模型为中心的"模型优先"模式，主张转向"问题优先"的研究范式，通过区分物理成像问题、解决方案原则、统计估计器和计算实现，提出六阶段工作流程，并倡导重建研究文化与教育，使研究者先深入理解成像问题本身，再借助现代AI实现真正的科学与技术进展。
AI.motivation: 现代AI使图像处理能力大幅提升，但强大的现成模型、公开数据集和排行榜促使研究者形成"模型优先"的研究模式——先选架构再在公开基准上优化，而非从真实成像问题出发。这导致出色的基准分数未必改善对真实问题的理解或解决，亟需一种从问题出发的研究框架。
AI.method: 论文提出一个概念框架，区分物理成像问题、解决方案原则、统计估计器和计算实现四个层次；通过超分辨率和低光增强两个案例研究，揭示基准数据集定义的任务与真实问题之间的偏差；提出六阶段工作流程（问题定义、图像采集、信息损失分析、假设、模糊性、评估）置于模型和数据集选择之前；并建议建立更清晰的证据、可复现性、不确定性和SOTA声明标准。
AI.result: 通过案例研究表明，基准数据集可能定义与真实世界问题显著不同的任务，性能提升必须在其获取条件下进行解释；提出的六阶段流程和标准为研究实践提供了具体指导框架。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁研究文化和教育的根本性变革，使未来的研究者能够深入理解成像问题，并利用现代AI实现真正的科学与技术突破，而不仅仅是基准分数的提升。

title: A Layer Importance Metric for Quantization Accounting for the Speed-Quality Trade-off in Autoregressive Models
summary: Small language models (sLLMs) are nowadays hosted on devices with limited memory and computational budget. In an autoregressive setup, inference is memory-bandwidth bound: uniform quantization is often detrimental to such models, since their architecture has limited redundancies and only a few layers are not very sensitive to lower precision. We propose a composite metric that combines two orthogonal criteria: information retention (measured in terms of a normalized SQNR-based coefficient) and throughput gains (modeled using a roofline-based latency analysis). By profiling Gemma 3 1B, we find that Feed-Forward Network blocks and the embedding matrix are the most promising targets for acceleration. For each candidate, we estimate a normalized quality score based on simulated quantization and a normalized speed score based on roofline modeling with no actual execution needed. We combine the two scores in a composite priority coefficient, allowing us to tune the trade-off between speed and quality as needed. Our metric is general and can be used to prioritize individual blocks, their projection sublayers, or transformer layers as a whole. We evaluate our approach on several model architectures, showing that our estimates have at around 4% prediction error for the accelerated speedup. We find that our method generally allocates more resources to the most expressive layers compared to evolutionary search, specialized accelerators, or Shapley-value-based approaches that require expensive approximate inference. Our analytical approach makes sLLM quantization a predictable engineering task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种复合指标，用于在小语言模型(sLLM)中优先选择量化目标，兼顾信息保留和吞吐量提升，无需实际执行即可预测加速效果。
AI.motivation: 小语言模型常部署在内存和算力受限的设备上，自回归推理受内存带宽限制。均匀量化对sLLM有害，因为其架构冗余有限，仅少数层对低精度不敏感。需要一个可预测的指标来指导量化决策，平衡速度与质量。
AI.method: 提出复合指标，结合两个正交准则：(1) 信息保留——基于归一化SQNR系数；(2) 吞吐量增益——基于roofline模型的延迟分析。通过对Gemma 3 1B进行剖析，确定FFN块和嵌入矩阵为最有前景的加速目标。对每个候选目标估计归一化质量分数（基于模拟量化）和归一化速度分数（基于roofline建模），组合为复合优先级系数以调整速度与质量的权衡。
AI.result: 在多个模型架构上评估，加速速度预测误差约4%。该方法相比进化搜索、专用加速器或基于Shapley值的方法，能将更多资源分配给最有表现力的层。
AI.conclusion: 该分析性方法使sLLM量化成为可预测的工程任务，指标通用，可用于优先处理单个块、投影子层或整个Transformer层。

title: DuMateBench: Evaluating Autonomous Agents in Complex Real-World Workflows
summary: Autonomous agents are increasingly adopted to complete complex, multi-tool workflows in real-world settings. However, existing benchmarks typically separate tasks by application or capability and evaluate agents in environments that are cleaner and more stable than those encountered in practice. We introduce DuMateBench, a real-session benchmark reconstructed from anonymized and privacy-screened user sessions collected from a large-scale production agent platform. Each task preserves the relevant pre-solution interaction history, persistent configurations, and workspace state, and is then validated through human verification. The resulting benchmark comprises 200 tasks spanning 8 broad scenarios and 17 fine-grained capability categories, with most tasks requiring multiple capability coordination. We execute these tasks in isolated Docker containers injected with three forms of real-world environmental complexity: Insufficient, Unstable, and Noisy, and assess performance using a hybrid deterministic and LLM-as-Judge evaluation protocol. Experiments across five representative autonomous-agent frameworks paired with four state-of-the-art LLMs reveal substantial gaps in strict task completion. Complementary robustness, efficiency, and diagnostic analyses further show that performance under environmental perturbations is jointly shaped by the capabilities of the LLM and the surrounding agent framework. The code and data are publicly available at https://dumatebench.com/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DuMateBench，一个基于大规模生产级智能体平台真实用户会话重建的基准测试，包含200个任务、8大场景和17个细粒度能力类别，在Docker容器中注入三种真实环境复杂度（资源不足、不稳定、噪声），通过混合式评估协议对5种智能体框架和4种先进LLM进行全面评测，发现严格任务完成率存在显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准通常按应用或能力分离任务，在比实际更干净稳定的环境中评估智能体，无法反映真实世界中多工具工作流的复杂性和不确定性。作者希望构建一个更贴近真实生产环境的基准，弥合实验室评估与实际部署之间的差距。
AI.method: 从大规模生产智能体平台收集匿名化且通过隐私筛选的真实用户会话，重建任务并保留交互历史、持久配置和工作区状态，经人工验证形成200个覆盖8大场景和17个细粒度能力类别的任务集。任务在隔离的Docker容器中执行，注入三种环境复杂度（资源不足Insufficient、不稳定Unstable、噪声Noisy），采用确定性评估与LLM-as-Judge相结合的混合评估协议，对5种代表性智能体框架和4种SOTA LLM进行系统评测。
AI.result: 实验表明，不同框架与LLM组合在严格任务完成率上存在显著差距；鲁棒性、效率和诊断分析进一步揭示环境扰动下的性能由LLM能力和智能体框架协同决定。
AI.conclusion: DuMateBench为真实场景下的多工具智能体评估提供了更可靠的基准，填补了现有基准在环境复杂性和任务真实性方面的空白，代码和数据已公开。

title: Neuro-symbolic PRM: Enhancing Scientific Reasoning via Structured Traces and Symbolic Verification
summary: While tool-augmented Large Language Models have significantly improved multi-step reasoning in quantitative STEM tasks, a critical residual failure mode remains: intermediate reasoning steps that are syntactically well-formed, mathematically executable, and unit-consistent, yet contextually ungrounded. Current approaches either rely on formal verifiers that cannot assess semantic intent, or burden Process Reward Models (PRMs) with the dual task of checking both arithmetic and logic. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic framework that cleanly decouples reasoning into two formal dimensions: Symbolic Validity ($V$) and Semantic Groundedness ($G$). We guarantee $V$ by construction using a deterministic symbolic verifier acting as a hard filter. To assess $G$, we train a PRM conditionally on the verifier-accepted manifold. To train this PRM efficiently, we introduce Counterfactual Symbolic Perturbation (CSP), a novel data synthesis strategy that algorithmically generates constraint-preserving hard negatives (steps that perfectly pass the verifier but are logically flawed). At inference, we deploy a verifier-first constrained search that guarantees execution consistency for verifier-covered operations while relying on the PRM solely to rank semantic grounding. By targeting the exact residual error class of strong tool-using LLMs, our method significantly improves reasoning reliability without the sprawling heuristics of prior frameworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个神经符号框架，将工具增强型大语言模型在多步推理中的推理过程解耦为两个正交维度：符号有效性（V）和语义扎根性（G）。通过确定性符号验证器硬编码保证V，并通过条件化PRM和Counterfactual Symbolic Perturbation（CSP）数据合成策略来评估G，从而精准解决"语法正确、可执行、量纲一致但语义脱节"的中间推理步骤失效问题。
AI.motivation: 工具增强型LLM在定量STEM任务中虽已显著提升多步推理能力，但仍存在关键残余错误：中间推理步骤在语法上良构、数学上可执行、单位一致，却在语义上缺乏根基。现有方法要么依赖无法评估语义意图的形式验证器，要么让过程奖励模型（PRM）同时承担算术和逻辑双重检查的负担。这需要一种将形式正确性与语义合理性解耦的框架。
AI.method: 提出神经符号框架，将推理解耦为两个维度：符号有效性（V）和语义扎根性（G）。V通过确定性符号验证器作为硬过滤器在构造上保证；G通过条件在验证器接受流形上训练的PRM来评估。为高效训练该PRM，提出Counterfactual Symbolic Perturbation（CSP）数据合成策略，算法化生成约束保持的困难负样本（能完全通过验证器但逻辑有缺陷的步骤）。推理时采用验证器优先的受限搜索，对验证器覆盖的操作保证执行一致性，而PRM仅用于语义扎根性排序。
AI.result: 该方法精准针对强工具使用LLM的确切残余错误类别，在不依赖先前框架中繁复启发式规则的情况下显著提升了推理可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将推理的符号正确性与语义合理性解耦，并采用CSP生成高质量困难负样本，该框架以简洁和可扩展的方式解决了工具增强LLM的语义脱节问题，为多步定量推理的可靠性提升提供了新路径。

title: MedFG-VQA: Low-Frequency Memory and Graph Attention for Lightweight Medical VQA
summary: Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA) holds significant promise for clinical decision support, yet faces challenges due to limited annotated data and the high computational demands of existing large vision-language models. We propose MedFG-VQA, a lightweight framework that leverages a memory bank to augment DCT-based low-frequency features and employs graph-enhanced cross-attention for effective visual-textual alignment. Specifically, our approach features two key components: Frequency-Memory Fusion (FMF), which enhances low-frequency features by retrieving from a learnable memory bank built on DCT decomposition, and Graph-Aware Cross-Attention (GACA), which aligns visual-textual features via cross-attention and refines them through graph-convolutional aggregation. To address data scarcity, we construct SynMed-VQA, a large-scale synthetic dataset comprising over 2 million question-answer pairs across 9 imaging modalities and 10 major organs, generated with GPT-4o. Extensive experiments on SynMed-VQA and three other standard biomedical VQA benchmarks demonstrate that MedFG-VQA achieves competitive or superior performance compared to much larger models while maintaining significantly lower computational costs, highlighting its efficiency and potential for clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出MedFG-VQA，一种轻量级医学视觉问答框架，利用记忆库增强基于DCT的低频特征，并通过图增强交叉注意力实现视觉-文本对齐。为缓解数据稀缺，构建了包含200万+问答对的合成数据集SynMed-VQA，在多个基准上以极低计算成本达到或超越大规模模型的性能。
AI.motivation: Med-VQA在临床决策支持中具有重要潜力，但面临两个核心挑战：一是医学领域标注数据稀缺，二是现有大规模视觉语言模型计算开销过高，难以满足临床部署需求。因此需要一种既能应对数据稀缺又能降低计算成本的轻量级解决方案。
AI.method: 框架包含两个关键组件：(1) 频率-记忆融合模块（FMF），基于DCT分解构建可学习记忆库，通过检索增强低频视觉特征；(2) 图感知交叉注意力模块（GACA），利用交叉注意力对齐视觉-文本特征，并通过图卷积聚合进行特征精炼。此外，使用GPT-4o构建大规模合成数据集SynMed-VQA（覆盖9种影像模态、10个主要器官，200万+问答对）以应对数据稀缺问题。
AI.result: 在SynMed-VQA及其他三个标准生物医学VQA基准上的大量实验表明，MedFG-VQA相比更大规模的模型取得了具有竞争力或更优的性能，同时计算成本显著更低，验证了其高效性和临床部署潜力。
AI.conclusion: MedFG-VQA通过频率域特征增强和轻量级对齐机制，在显著降低计算开销的同时保持或超越大模型的性能，结合大规模合成数据扩充，为Med-VQA在实际临床应用中的高效部署提供了一条可行路径。

title: Scaling Model-Generated Distillation Data Can Make Latent Teacher Traits More Recoverable
summary: Scaling model-generated data is usually viewed as improving distillation: more examples should increase coverage, reduce noise, and produce stronger students. We show a second effect: larger datasets can make subtle teacher-specific signals easier to detect in the trained student, even when examples are off-task and never mention the trait. In a controlled setup inspired by subliminal learning, a teacher induced to express a target trait generates restricted off-task data, such as number-only completions. Students trained on different amounts of independent off-task data are evaluated in a separate domain, with matched no-trait controls isolating target-specific transfer. Our main finding is that larger independent datasets make the teacher's induced trait stand out more clearly in the student's later behavior. Other plausible traits may also strengthen with scale, but the target usually grows more. When the small-scale student already favors the target, scaling mainly amplifies that behavior; when it favors a related or salient alternative, more data can shift behavior toward the intended trait. Analyses of learned LoRA updates show a parallel trend. These effects appear across model families, trait types, multi-trait settings, and cross-model transfer. Our results suggest that scaling generated distillation data should be paired with trait-aware curation and evaluation, even when the data appears off-task or benign.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，扩大模型生成数据的规模不仅改善蒸馏质量，还会放大教师模型中被诱导表达的隐性特质信号——即使数据是离题的、不相关领域的。更大的独立数据集会使教师特质在学生模型中更加清晰地显现，且这种效应跨模型家族、特质类型和跨模型迁移都成立。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为，扩大模型生成数据的规模主要提升蒸馏效果（更多样本→更好覆盖→更强学生模型）。作者质疑这一简化认知，探索数据规模是否还有第二重效应：放大教师模型中微妙但可检测的特质信号。
AI.method: 采用受潜隐学习（subliminal learning）启发的受控实验设置：诱导教师表达特定目标特质，生成仅限于数字等离题内容的数据；在不同规模下训练学生模型，并在独立领域评估；用匹配的无特质对照组分离目标特异性的迁移效应；分析LoRA更新。
AI.result: 更大规模的独立数据集使教师诱导特质在学生后期行为中更突出。小规模时已倾向目标则规模放大该行为；若倾向相关或显著替代特质，更多数据可将行为拉向目标。LoRA更新分析显示平行趋势。效应跨模型家族、特质类型、多特质设置和跨模型迁移一致。
AI.conclusion: 扩展生成蒸馏数据时应配合特质感知的策展与评估（trait-aware curation and evaluation），即使数据看似离题或良性，也可能传递并放大教师特质信号。

title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling
comment: 31 Pages, 9 Figures, 31 Tables, Accepted as a main conference paper at EMNLP 2026
summary: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate agentic tool-calling systems, yet their reliability on structured, dependency-driven workflows remains largely unexamined. We present AgentJudgeBench, the first benchmark to systematically study LLM-as-a-judge reliability for agentic tool-calling over workflow DAGs, as distinct from the broader LLM-as-a-judge task of open-ended text or preference evaluation. The benchmark comprises 3,808 instances spanning six DAG topologies and three difficulty tiers, evaluated with five generators (3B-70B open-weight models and GPT-5.4) and six judges (20B to frontier scale) under paired with- and without-ground-truth conditions. Judge alignment degrades monotonically with task difficulty, 1.5x faster without ground truth, and on hard queries without ground truth all six judges converge to a narrow 77-82% band regardless of scale, revealing a structural ceiling driven primarily by task difficulty, though its height is partly prompt-dependent for weaker generators, that model capacity alone cannot overcome. Ground-truth exposure is not uniformly beneficial: it reduces alignment for GPT-5.4 (1.5 pp) and Gemini-2.5-Pro (3.9 pp), consistent with over-anchoring. Among mitigation strategies, chain-of-thought reasoning and judge temperature both have negligible effect, while structured evaluation rubrics improve alignment by up to 6.5 pp but do not generalize uniformly across judge-generator pairs. With ground truth, QwQ-32B best matches the programmatic reference, while a human validation study identifies GPT-OSS-120B as the most human-aligned judge; without it, frontier judges lead only marginally within the shared ceiling. These results expose fundamental limitations of current LLM judges and yield practical guidelines for reliable evaluation in agentic systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentJudgeBench——首个系统研究LLM作为裁判在智能体工具调用工作流DAG上可靠性的基准测试，包含3,808个实例、六种DAG拓扑和三个难度层级。研究发现裁判对齐度随任务难度单调下降，无真实答案时下降速度1.5倍；所有六个裁判在硬查询上收敛于77-82%的狭窄区间，显示存在结构性天花板；真实答案暴露并非总是有益，甚至对部分模型产生过锚定效应；链式推理和温度设置效果甚微，结构化评估量表可提升最多6.5个百分点但不具备泛化性。
AI.motivation: LLM裁判被广泛用于评估智能体工具调用系统，但其在结构化、依赖驱动的工作流上的可靠性尚未被系统性研究。现有LLM-as-a-judge研究主要聚焦于开放式文本或偏好评估，缺乏对工作流DAG场景下裁判可靠性的深入考察，因此需要构建专门的基准来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建AgentJudgeBench基准：包含3,808个实例，覆盖六种DAG拓扑（依赖驱动的工作流结构）和三个难度层级。使用五个生成器（3B-70B开源模型及GPT-5.4）生成候选输出，用六个裁判（20B至前沿规模）在有/无真实答案两种条件下进行评估，并通过与程序化参考对比和人工验证研究来衡量裁判对齐度。
AI.result: 裁判对齐度随任务难度单调下降，无真实答案时下降速度加快1.5倍；硬查询无真实答案时所有六个裁判收敛于77-82%的狭窄区间，揭示任务难度主导的结构性天花板。真实答案暴露对GPT-5.4（下降1.5个百分点）和Gemini-2.5-Pro（下降3.9个百分点）反而降低对齐度，符合过锚定现象。链式推理和温度设置对结果影响可忽略，结构化评估量表最多提升6.5个百分点但不具备跨模型泛化性。有真实答案时QwQ-32B最匹配程序化参考，人工验证发现GPT-OSS-120B最符合人类对齐。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM裁判在智能体工具调用评估中存在根本性局限，任务难度是驱动裁判性能的核心因素，模型规模无法弥补这一结构性天花板；真实答案的使用需谨慎（可能引发过锚定），现有缓解策略（如链式推理、温度调节）效果有限，而结构化评估量表虽有效但需针对性设计。研究为智能体系统的可靠评估提供了实用指导。

title: MoganColBERT-TR: A Late-Interaction Multi-Vector Retrieval Model for Turkish
summary: We previously reported a ModernBERT encoder trained from scratch for Turkish (MoganBERT-TR) and a single-vector embedding model built on top of it (MoganBERT-embed). This work introduces the third model in that lineage: MoganColBERT-TR, a multi-vector retrieval model that, instead of compressing a query or a document into a single vector, represents it at the token level through a 768->128 projection and scores it with MaxSim late interaction. The model is not trained from scratch: the embedding model's encoder is taken as the starting point and adapted to the ColBERT objective with a single-epoch distillation phase. Training data is produced from two sources - title-to-passage pairs carved out of our own pretraining corpus in the character domain and at sentence boundaries, and two Turkish question-based retrieval sets - and is distilled from the soft scores of a cross-encoder teacher (bge-reranker-v2-m3) over one positive and seven mined negatives. We show that in hard negative mining, rank-based skipping alone is insufficient and must be combined with a group mask and a cosine ceiling. Evaluation is carried out with the official pipeline of TurkColBERT, a benchmark built for Turkish late-interaction retrieval (PLAID index, exact MaxSim), on five Turkish BEIR datasets; none of them appears in our training pool, so all five results are clean zero-shot. With 148.9M parameters, MoganColBERT-TR reaches an overall score of 37.36 (35.53 nDCG@100, 31.81 nDCG@10) averaged over the five datasets and finishes second among the five models compared: it outperforms the twice-as-large ColmmBERT-base-TR on four of five datasets and by +3.05 overall, and the benchmark's largest model by +12.30. The gap to the leading model (mLateOn) is concentrated on ArguAna-TR, the dataset with by far the longest queries.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了MoganColBERT-TR，一个土耳其语多向量检索模型。该模型基于之前训练的MoganBERT-embed编码器，通过768->128投影在token级别表示查询和文档，并使用MaxSim后期交互评分。模型未从头训练，而是通过单轮蒸馏阶段适配ColBERT目标，教师模型为交叉编码器bge-reranker-v2-m3。在五个土耳其BEIR数据集（均为零样本）上达到37.36的平均分（35.53 nDCG@100, 31.81 nDCG@10），以148.9M参数在五个对比模型中排名第二，优于两倍大的ColmmBERT-base-TR和基准最大模型，但与领先模型mLateOn的差距集中在查询最长的ArguAna-TR数据集上。实验还发现硬负样本挖掘中仅靠rank-based skipping不足，需结合group mask和cosine ceiling。
AI.motivation: 在已有的单向量嵌入模型（MoganBERT-embed）基础上，探索土耳其语多向量检索模型，以token级表示和后期交互（MaxSim）提升细粒度匹配能力，弥补单向量模型在复杂检索场景中的局限性。
AI.method: 以MoganBERT-embed的编码器为起点，通过768->128投影实现token级多向量表示，采用MaxSim后期交互评分；使用单轮蒸馏阶段适配ColBERT目标，训练数据来自两个来源（预训练语料中提取的标题-段落对和两个土耳其语基于问题的检索集），由交叉编码器教师（bge-reranker-v2-m3）对1个正例和7个挖掘的负例生成软标签进行蒸馏；在硬负样本挖掘中结合rank-based skipping、group mask和cosine ceiling三种策略。
AI.result: 在TurkColBERT官方评估管线（PLAID索引，精确MaxSim）下，对五个土耳其BEIR数据集进行零样本评估，整体得分37.36（nDCG@100为35.53，nDCG@10为31.81），在五个对比模型中排名第二；在四个/五个数据集上优于两倍大的ColmmBERT-base-TR，整体高出+3.05，比基准最大模型高出+12.30；与领先模型mLateOn的差距主要来自查询最长的ArguAna-TR数据集。
AI.conclusion: MoganColBERT-TR证明在资源稀缺的土耳其语场景下，通过蒸馏和高效参数利用（148.9M参数）可以构建具有竞争力的多向量检索模型。硬负样本挖掘中group mask与cosine ceiling的引入对提升训练质量至关重要。未来工作可聚焦于长查询场景下（如ArguAna-TR）与领先模型的差距，可能需要更强的后期交互或查询表示策略。

title: From Reasoning to Pixels: Grounded Medical Multimodal LLMs for VQA and Segmentation
summary: Although Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in Medical Visual Question Answering (Med-VQA), their reliance on global image features often lacks precise pixel-level grounding, thereby limiting clinical trustworthiness. To bridge the semantic gap between high-level clinical reasoning and spatial localization, we propose \textsc{\textsc{MedREAL}} (\textbf{Med}ical \textbf{RE}asoning-driven \textbf{A}nswering and \textbf{L}ocalization), a unified framework that seamlessly aligns linguistic reasoning with spatial grounding. Specifically, \textsc{MedREAL} introduces \textbf{S}eg \textbf{A}nchored \textbf{R}easoning \textbf{P}ooling (SARP) to distill task-relevant semantic evidence directly from \texttt{[SEG]} tokens within the MLLM's hidden states. Furthermore, a \textbf{R}easoning-to-\textbf{V}isual (R2V) fusion mechanism is proposed to effectively inject these reasoning-aware features into a segmentation pipeline for accurate mask decoding. To facilitate this paradigm, we construct MedRAVS-13K, a comprehensive dataset comprising 13,824 expertly validated samples across four diverse imaging modalities. Extensive experiments demonstrate that \textsc{MedREAL} significantly outperforms state-of-the-arts, achieving 68.49\% gIoU and 70.47\% cIoU on benchmark evaluations. By generating evidence masks that are strictly consistent with textual diagnoses, \textsc{MedREAL} provides a robust, interpretable framework for reasoning-driven medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: MedREAL是一个统一的多模态大语言模型框架，通过分段锚定推理池化（SARP）从[SEG]标记中蒸馏语义证据，并利用推理到视觉（R2V）融合机制将推理感知特征注入分割管线，实现医学视觉问答中语言推理与空间定位的精确对齐。在自建MedRAVS-13K数据集（13,824个样本，四种影像模态）上，该框架在gIoU和cIoU上分别达到68.49%和70.47%，显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs在Med-VQA中依赖全局图像特征，缺乏像素级别的精确定位能力，导致临床可信度受限。为弥合高层临床推理与空间定位之间的语义鸿沟，作者提出MedREAL框架。
AI.method: MedREAL包含两个核心创新：1) 分段锚定推理池化（SARP），从MLLM隐藏状态中的[SEG]标记直接蒸馏任务相关的语义证据；2) 推理到视觉（R2V）融合机制，将推理感知特征有效注入分割管线以进行精确的掩码解码。同时构建了包含13,824个专家验证样本、覆盖四种影像模态的MedRAVS-13K数据集。
AI.result: 在基准评测中，MedREAL达到68.49%的gIoU和70.47%的cIoU，显著优于现有最先进方法，且生成的证据掩码与文本诊断严格一致。
AI.conclusion: MedREAL通过将推理驱动的证据掩码与文本诊断对齐，为推理驱动的医学图像分析提供了稳健且可解释的框架，增强了MLLMs在临床场景中的可信度。

title: Gromov-Monge Flow Matching for Equivariant Graph Generation
comment: Gromov-Wasserstein, Optimal Transport, Flow Matching, Graph Generation, Equivariant Networks
summary: Graphs are invariant under node permutations, motivating the use of permutation-equivariant architectures in generative models. In flow matching, however, symmetry may also enter the source--target coupling: once graph pairs are compared up to node relabeling, the natural Wasserstein geometry is that of the graph quotient space. The Euclidean quotient metric of this space coincides with the Gromov--Monge distance, obtained by optimally relabeling the nodes. We develop this perspective theoretically, showing that quotient couplings can be lifted to aligned representatives without additional cost and that symmetrization yields equivariant flow-matching minimizers, including for categorical endpoint prediction. In practice, exact Gromov--Monge alignment is intractable, so we construct minibatch couplings using efficient Gromov--Wasserstein-type relaxations and lower bounds for the inner node alignment, optionally combined with an outer assignment between graphs. The resulting procedure changes only the training coupling and is compatible with standard permutation-equivariant architectures. Across continuous graph and categorical molecular generation, these structure-aware couplings substantially improve sample quality at small integration budgets, while our scaled-up molecular models remain competitive under conventional many-step sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在流匹配（flow matching）框架中引入结构感知的耦合（structure-aware couplings），利用图商空间中的Gromov--Monge距离来对齐图对，从而在置换等变生成模型中获得更好的样本质量。
AI.motivation: 图对节点置换不变性意味着生成模型中不仅需要置换等变架构，源-目标耦合也应体现对称性。然而现有流匹配方法未充分利用图商空间中的Wasserstein几何，导致生成样本质量受限。
AI.method: 从理论上证明商空间耦合可无损提升为对齐表示，且对称化可得到等变流匹配最优解（包括分类端点预测）。实践中，由于精确Gromov--Monge对齐不可行，采用基于Gromov--Wasserstein类型的松弛与内层节点对齐下界构建小批量耦合，可选地结合图间外层分配。该方法仅改变训练耦合，兼容标准置换等变架构。
AI.result: 在连续图生成和分类分子生成任务中，结构感知耦合在较小积分步数下显著提升样本质量；规模化的分子模型在传统多步采样下仍保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 通过将对称性引入训练耦合而非仅依赖架构设计，可在流匹配生成模型的效率和样本质量之间取得更好的权衡。

title: SIGMA: Structured Noise-Effect-Aware Grouped Multi-Agent Aggregation
summary: Cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) faces significant challenges in maintaining robust coordination under noisy observations. Although observation disturbances are often introduced independently across agents, their downstream effects on cooperative decision-making can become structured through underlying cooperation structures. We characterize this phenomenon as structured noise effects, where noise-induced decision effects exhibit local correlation among agents with stronger task-related dependencies while remaining globally heterogeneous across different agents and local structures. Existing robust MARL methods, however, rarely explicitly characterize or exploit such structure-dependent noise effects. To address this limitation, we propose SIGMA, a hierarchical collaboration framework that exploits cooperation structures to learn robust representations under noisy observations. SIGMA first organizes agents into adaptive local structures through density-based grouping and performs intra-group consensus aggregation to preserve shared task-relevant information while smoothing agent-specific representation deviations. Inter-group attention then adaptively integrates information across different groups to preserve global coordination while accommodating their heterogeneous contributions. Experiments on noisy-observation tasks in StarCraft II empirically validate the structured noise effects and demonstrate that SIGMA consistently improves robustness under observation noise while maintaining competitive performance in noise-free environments.

AI.tldr: 提出SIGMA，一个利用协作结构学习鲁棒表示的层级多智能体强化学习框架，通过组内共识聚合和组间注意力机制来应对噪声观测下的结构化噪声效应，在星际争霸II任务中验证了其鲁棒性和性能。
AI.motivation: 多智能体强化学习在噪声观测下难以维持鲁棒协作。虽然噪声通常独立施加于各智能体，但其对决策的影响会通过底层协作结构变得结构化——任务关联强的智能体之间噪声效应局部相关，而全局上在不同智能体和局部结构中呈现异质性。现有鲁棒MARL方法很少显式刻画或利用这种结构依赖的噪声效应。
AI.method: SIGMA采用层级协作框架：首先通过基于密度的分组将智能体组织为自适应局部结构，并在组内进行共识聚合以保留共享任务相关信息同时平滑智能体特定表示偏差；然后通过组间注意力自适应地整合不同组的信息，在保持全局协调的同时容纳各组异质性贡献。
AI.result: 在星际争霸II噪声观测任务上的实验经验性地验证了结构化噪声效应的存在，并证明SIGMA在观测噪声下持续提升鲁棒性，同时在无噪声环境中保持有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: SIGMA通过显式利用协作结构来刻画和对抗结构化噪声效应，为鲁棒多智能体强化学习提供了有效方案，兼顾了噪声环境下的鲁棒性与干净环境下的性能。

title: Cross-lingual Representation Learning via Centroid Intervention Fusion
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit uneven multilingual performance, especially when dealing with low-resource languages. Inference-time intervention offers a lightweight way to improve cross-lingual transfer by modifying the hidden states produced by the LLMs during the forward pass, without updating model parameters. However, existing cross-lingual intervention methods typically learn separate projections from source to target languages, which limits scalability and prevents knowledge sharing across languages. We propose Centroid Intervention Fusion (CIF), a projection fusion framework that consolidates multiple multilingual intervention projections into a single language-shared operator. Across multilingual commonsense reasoning, natural language inference, factual editing, and machine translation benchmarks, CIF outperforms the strongest prior pairwise intervention baseline by up to +3.378 pp on average across four model backbones, while supporting performance gains for low resource languages. The code is available at https://github.com/VRCMF/CIF.git.

AI.tldr: 提出Centroid Intervention Fusion (CIF)框架，将多个跨语言干预投影融合为单一语言共享算子，在不更新模型参数的情况下改善低资源语言的多语言性能，在多项基准上超越最强基线平均达+3.378个百分点。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在低资源语言上表现不平衡，推理时干预可通过修改前向传播中的隐藏状态来改进跨语言迁移。然而现有跨语言干预方法通常为每对源-目标语言学习独立投影，可扩展性受限且阻碍语言间知识共享。
AI.method: 提出Centroid Intervention Fusion (CIF)，一个投影融合框架，将多个多语言干预投影整合为一个语言共享的单一算子。该框架通过质心融合的方式合并多个干预投影，使得不同语言之间的干预信息可以共享。
AI.result: 在跨语言常识推理、自然语言推理、事实编辑和机器翻译基准上，CIF在四个模型主干上平均超越最强成对干预基线最高达+3.378个百分点，并特别支持低资源语言的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: CIF通过将多个干预投影融合为单一语言共享算子，有效提升了跨语言迁移性能，尤其对低资源语言带来显著增益，同时解决了多投影方法的可扩展性和知识共享问题。

title: A Geometry-Driven, Framework-Agnostic Optimization for Object Pose Estimation
summary: Current object pose estimation research remains predominantly model-centric, focusing on architectural innovations and post-processing refinements. This paper introduces a data-centric optimization by proposing a novel, physically grounded rotation representation through principal axes alignment. Our method aligns the object's coordinate system with its inherent geometric axes, derived from inertial properties, yielding three key advantages: Inherent Stability-leveraging the energy-minimizing property of principal axes provides a robust representation that is less sensitive to noise and occlusions; Symmetry-Aware Canonicalization-explicitly resolving rotational ambiguities for symmetric objects at the data level, which fundamentally eliminates label confusion during network training; and Framework Agnosticism-the optimization is applied purely at the dataset level, ensuring plug-and-play compatibility with existing networks without any architectural modification. We validate the framework across diverse category-level and instance-level models. Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent and significant accuracy improvements, while preserving the integrity of the baseline network. This work establishes a new, geometry-driven direction for enhancing pose estimation, circumventing the need for complex network redesign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据层面的三维物体姿态估计优化方法，通过主轴对齐构建基于物体惯性特性的物理旋转表示，在不修改网络架构的前提下提升姿态估计精度，尤其对对称物体能从根本上消除标签混淆问题。
AI.motivation: 当前物体姿态估计研究主要集中于模型端（网络架构创新和后处理优化），忽视了数据端优化的潜力，且对称物体在训练时存在旋转标签歧义问题。
AI.method: 提出一种基于主轴对齐（principal axes alignment）的物理旋转表示方法：将物体坐标系与其由惯性特性推导出的几何主轴对齐，在数据集层面进行规范化（canonicalization），从而获得具有固有稳定性、对称性感知和框架无关性的旋转表示。
AI.result: 在多个类别级和实例级模型上进行了广泛验证，实验结果表明该方法在保持基线网络完整性的前提下，一致且显著地提升了姿态估计精度。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了几何驱动的数据层面优化新方向，无需复杂的网络重新设计即可增强姿态估计性能，对对称物体的规范化处理从根源上解决了训练中的标签混乱问题。

title: Packora: Systematic Design for Generative Molecular Crystal Structure Prediction
summary: Molecular crystal structure prediction (CSP) is important in pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, and organic electronics, where subtle differences in molecular conformation and packing can strongly affect material properties. We present Packora, a flow-based generative model for molecular CSP that jointly predicts atomic coordinates and the lattice from molecular graphs. Packora supports multi-component and organometallic crystals and can condition on any subset of molecular conformers, stereochemical labels, and space-group information within a single model. Inspired by the CCDC CSP blind test, we evaluate generation and ranking separately, using generation to isolate generator quality and ranking to measure end-to-end performance under a common relaxation and ranking pipeline. We also systematically study architecture, training, conditioning, inference, and scaling, identifying an effective design based on cacheable pairwise reasoning, training objective and numerical solver choices, conditioning dropout, and balanced scaling of pairwise and single representations. Packora outperforms the baselines on both structure generation and ranking benchmarks, achieving the best matched-budget coverage across all six generation benchmarks, as well as higher experimental-form recovery, lower experimental-form ranks, and faster convergence in ranking.

AI.tldr: Packora是一种基于流的生成模型，用于分子晶体结构预测（CSP），能够从分子图联合预测原子坐标和晶格，支持多组分和有机金属晶体，并在生成与排序基准上均优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 分子晶体结构预测在制药、农用化学品和有机电子领域至关重要，分子构象和堆积的细微差异会显著影响材料性质，因此需要更有效的CSP方法。
AI.method: 提出Packora，一个流式生成模型，从分子图联合预测原子坐标与晶格。支持多组分和有机金属晶体，可在单模型中条件化任意子集的分子构象、立体化学标签和空间群信息。受CCDC CSP盲测启发，将生成与排序分开评估。系统研究了架构、训练、条件化、推理和缩放，提出基于可缓存成对推理、训练目标与数值求解器选择、条件化dropout以及成对与单表示平衡缩放的有效设计。
AI.result: Packora在结构生成和排序基准上均优于基线：在所有六个生成基准上实现最佳匹配预算覆盖率，同时获得更高的实验形态恢复率、更低的实验形态排名和更快的收敛速度。
AI.conclusion: Packora通过统一的生成式框架和系统化的设计选择，在分子CSP的生成质量与端到端排序性能上都取得了显著提升，证明了生成与评估分离以及细致设计各组件的重要性。

title: Relational Over-Regularization: Graph-Based AI-Generated Text Detection via Sentence Transition Deviation
summary: Detecting AI-generated text (AIGT) remains challenging because existing approaches rely on token-level statistical signals or independent stylometric features, causing them to overfit to specific generators and fail under distribution shift. We identify a structural signal at the sentence-pair level: LLMs produce inter-sentence transition variance that deviates from human writing through inflated variance driven by recurring similarity bursts at paragraph boundaries and templated transitions. We formalize this as Relational Over-Regularization (ROR) and validate it across four benchmarks (p < 0.001). The central contribution is this relational problem formulation, not a novel GNN architecture; CSFG is one concrete instantiation for operationalizing ROR. To exploit this signal, we propose the Cross-Source Stylometric Fingerprint Graph (CSFG), a graph-based framework that encodes positional, sequential, semantic, and transition deviation signals as learnable GNN edge features. The per-edge signed deviation δ_ij operationalizes ROR without hand-crafted thresholds and acts as a false-positive calibrator. CSFG achieves 97.14% accuracy under binary detection, outperforming the strongest graph-based baseline by 11.14 pp, with a false-positive rate of 1.57% and robust generalization to unseen LLMs in the inflated-variance regime; detection degrades for generators whose transition variance falls at or below the human baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文发现了一种句对级别的结构信号——关系过度正则化（ROR），即LLM生成文本在句间转换方差上出现膨胀，并通过跨源风格指纹图（CSFG）框架将其编码为可学习的GNN边特征，实现97.14%的检测准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有AIGT检测方法依赖词元级统计信号或独立风格特征，容易对特定生成器过拟合且在分布偏移下失效，亟需更具泛化性的结构性信号。
AI.method: 提出ROR（Relational Over-Regularization）作为句对级别的结构信号，形式化定义为LLM句间转换方差的膨胀现象；构建CSFG（Cross-Source Stylometric Fingerprint Graph）框架，将位置、序列、语义及转换偏差信号编码为GNN的可学习边特征，其中逐边有符号偏差δ_ij无阈值地操作化ROR并充当假阳性校准器。
AI.result: 在四个基准上验证（p<0.001），CSFG在二元检测下达到97.14%准确率，超越最强图基线11.14个百分点，假阳性率仅1.57%，对未见LLM在方差膨胀区间内具有稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: ROR作为关系层面的结构信号是核心贡献，而非具体图架构；CSFG是其一种具体实现。检测性能在生成器转换方差接近或低于人类基线时退化，揭示了该方法的适用边界。

title: Knowledge-Verified Emergent Deception in LLM Agents Under Conflicting Incentives
comment: A benchmark for knowledge-verified emergent deception in LLM agents under conflicting incentives
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents serving users on behalf of companies, placing them in settings where user and deployer interests can conflict. When an agent knows that a user is owed something its deployer would prefer to deny, does it remain honest? Answering this is difficult because false statements can reflect either ignorance or hallucination rather than deception. To address this challenge, we introduce KnownLieBench , a knowledge-verified benchmark that first confirms through a neutral probe that an agent knows a user's entitlement, and then evaluates whether it makes false claims once an incentive to deny that entitlement is introduced. Specifically, KnownLieBench covers eight customer-service domains and 112 grounded cases, conducts multi-round dialogues with a trust-tracking customer agent, and separates deception emerging from incentive alone from deception produced under explicit instruction. Across eighteen proprietary and open-weight models, emergent deception varies substantially across model families and domains. We further use the benchmark for post-training, finding that honesty-directed fine-tuning reduces deception under incentive, while deception-graded fine-tuning increases lie success on honest-control dialogues without increasing lie frequency under incentive. By verifying entitlement knowledge before scoring deceptive behavior, KnownLieBench reduces the confound between lying and not knowing and enables more rigorous auditing and steering of agent honesty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KnownLieBench，一个知识验证的基准测试，用于区分大语言模型智能体在利益冲突场景下是说谎还是不知道。该基准先通过中性探针确认模型知道用户应得权益，再评估其在被引入否认动机后是否作出虚假陈述。覆盖8个客服领域和112个案例，实验发现不同模型家族和领域的欺骗行为差异显著，且诚实导向的微调可减少激励下的欺骗，而欺骗导向的微调虽不增加欺骗频率但提高谎言的"成功率"。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署为代理公司行事的自主智能体，处于用户与部署者利益可能冲突的场景中。当智能体知道用户应得某项权益但部署者倾向于拒绝时，它是否会保持诚实？此前的评估难以回答这一问题，因为虚假陈述可能源于无知或幻觉而非刻意欺骗，缺乏将"说谎"与"不知道"区分开来的能力。
AI.method: KnownLieBench首先通过一个中性探针确认智能体知道用户的应得权益，然后再引入否认激励来评估其是否作出虚假声明。基准覆盖8个客服领域、112个基于真实依据的案例，采用多轮对话设置并配有一个追踪信任度的客户智能体，将激励单独引发的欺骗与明确指令产生的欺骗分离开来。此外还利用该基准进行后训练实验，包括诚实导向和欺骗导向的微调。
AI.result: 在18个专有和开源模型中，欺骗行为在模型家族和领域之间表现出显著差异。诚实导向的微调减少了激励下的欺骗行为，而欺骗导向的微调在诚实对照组对话中提高了谎言成功率，但并未增加激励下的谎言频率。
AI.conclusion: 通过在评估欺骗行为前验证权益知识，KnownLieBench有效减少了"说谎"与"不知道"之间的混淆，为审计和引导智能体诚实性提供了更严谨的工具。

title: Adversarial Training Without Input Gradients via Low-Rank Householder Expansions
summary: This work concerns adversarial training against the small-norm adversarial examples that arise from the inherent input instability of a trained deep neural network. Examples in this class are small as measured in the relative $\ell^2$-norm, and therefore lie in the neighborhood of the input on which the model acts approximately linearly, the regime in which the perturbation remains imperceptible. We first show that such examples can be computed directly from the trained network parameters, without input gradient iterations, by means of a linearization called the low-rank Householder expansion (LRHE). The expansion describes the composed affine map rather than any individual layer, and the directions it identifies are read from the activation pattern already available in the forward pass. We then propose a simple adversarial training scheme built on this construction. No differentiation with respect to the input is performed at any point: training requires only additional forward evaluations, with weight parameters updated by the standard backward pass, and the inner maximization of the usual min-max formulation is eliminated entirely. That such a regularizer exists is our main finding: the methods that dispense with the inner search all obtain their local geometry by differentiating with respect to the input, and we show this is not necessary. The regularizer costs the equivalent of $2.8$ PGD steps per epoch, an $8.7\times$ reduction relative to 40-step adversarial training on MNIST and below the cost of 3-step training. The resulting models match three-step PGD adversarial training for relative $\ell^2$ budgets $\varepsilon \le 0.02$ and 40-step training for $\varepsilon \le 0.012$, falling away beyond, consistent with the locality of the expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需输入梯度迭代的对抗训练方法，利用低秩Householder展开（LRHE）对训练好的深度神经网络进行线性化，直接从网络参数和激活模式中计算小范数对抗样本，并由此构建一个仅需额外前向传播的正则化器，消除了min-max训练中的内层最大化过程。
AI.motivation: 小范数对抗样本源于训练深度神经网络的固有输入不稳定性，此类样本位于模型近似线性的输入邻域内且不可感知。已有的绕开内层搜索的方法都依赖于对输入进行求导来获取局部几何信息，作者希望证明这种做法并非必要，从而设计更高效的对抗训练方案。
AI.method: 首先提出LRHE（低秩Householder展开），对网络整体（而非单层）的复合仿射映射进行线性化，利用前向传播中已有的激活模式读取对抗方向，无需输入梯度迭代即可直接由网络参数计算小范数对抗样本。基于此构造对抗训练正则化器，训练过程中不进行任何对输入的求导，仅需额外的正向评估，权重参数仍由标准反向传播更新，完全消除了标准min-max公式中的内层最大化。
AI.result: 所提正则化器每轮epoch的成本相当于2.8个PGD步骤，相比MNIST上40步对抗训练降低了8.7倍，且低于3步训练的成本。在相对ℓ²预算ε≤0.02时匹配3步PGD对抗训练的性能，在ε≤0.012时匹配40步训练的性能；超出该范围的性能下降与展开的局部性一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明：存在一种规则化方法可以在完全不对输入求导、不进行内层搜索的情况下获得局部对抗几何信息，这挑战了以往认为必须通过对输入求导来获取局部几何的认知。LRHE展开的局部性决定了该方法在小范数对抗预算下有效，适用于追求高效且保持对抗鲁棒性的场景。

title: Survival-Guided Length Control for Efficient Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked sequences, but standard decoding either fixes the sequence length or relies on ad hoc stopping rules, often leading to unnecessary denoising steps. We recast length selection as a discrete-time survival problem over the end-of-sequence token and propose a plug-in, training-free length predictor that can be added to any existing DLM. Across reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, survival-guided length decoding speeds up inference by up to 7 times while preserving task accuracy. We further find that predicted lengths vary widely even within the same dataset, making model performance sensitive to the chosen length.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于离散时间生存分析的、无需训练的即插即用长度预测器，用于扩散语言模型的解码过程，在保留任务精度的同时最高可将推理速度提升7倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型通过迭代去噪掩码序列生成文本，但标准解码要么固定序列长度，要么依赖临时启发的停止规则，常导致不必要的去噪步骤，造成推理效率低下。
AI.method: 将长度选择重新建模为关于序列结束符的离散时间生存问题，提出一个即插即用、无需训练的生存引导长度预测器，可集成到任意现有扩散语言模型中。
AI.result: 在推理和代码生成基准上，生存引导的长度解码在保持任务精度的同时，将推理速度最高提升7倍。此外发现预测长度在同一数据集内差异很大，模型性能对所选长度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 生存引导长度预测是一种有效的训练免费方案，可显著提升扩散语言模型的推理效率，同时揭示长度选择对模型性能具有重要影响。

title: Order Matters: A Chinese Multi-Panel Meme Benchmark for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Many multimodal tasks depend on how visual elements are ordered and composed, not only on recognizing them in isolation. Internet memes are a compact case of this problem: their punchline often depends on a constrained reading order and cross-panel visual--textual cues. While large vision-language models (LVLMs) show strong performance on single-image understanding, it remains unclear whether they can perform sequence-aware reasoning over structured meme layouts, especially in Chinese social media. We introduce CMPM, a Chinese Multi-Panel Meme benchmark with 1,214 annotated samples covering five structural types, ordering dependency, panel-order constraints, and optional comment context. We formulate a two-layer evaluation: Task1 probes structure typing and order-sensitive panel sequencing (with a context ablation setting), and Task2 evaluates Chinese meme explanation generation with human ratings on five 1-3 Likert dimensions (visual, panel, humor, context, and faithfulness). We benchmark five representative LVLMs under a unified protocol. Results indicate that canonical-display accuracy is not by itself evidence of order understanding: the primary shuffled condition produces a sharp accuracy drop, revealing a persistent gap in order-sensitive multimodal reasoning. Task2 preferences place Gemini 3.1 Pro and GPT-5.5 above the open models, while comment context yields only a small and mixed Core4 gain. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CMPM，一个包含1,214个中文多面板表情包样本的基准，覆盖五种结构类型、顺序依赖和可选评论上下文，用于评估LVLM在结构化多面板布局上的顺序感知推理能力。实验表明，标准显示精度不能证明顺序理解能力，打乱顺序条件下模型表现显著下降，揭示了多模态推理中顺序敏感性的持续缺口。
AI.motivation: 许多多模态任务不仅依赖对视觉元素的单独识别，还取决于它们的排列顺序和组合方式。互联网表情包是这一问题的紧凑案例，其笑点往往依赖于受限的阅读顺序和跨面板的视觉-文本线索。然而，现有LVLM虽然在单图理解上表现强劲，但在结构化表情包布局上进行序列感知推理的能力尚不明确，尤其在中文本土社交媒体语境下缺乏相关基准。
AI.method: 作者构建了CMPM基准，包含1,214个标注样本，覆盖五种结构类型、顺序依赖、面板顺序约束及可选评论上下文。评估分为两层：Task1探测结构类型识别和顺序敏感的面板排序（含上下文消融设置）；Task2评估中文表情包解释生成，采用五个1-3李克特维度（视觉、面板、幽默、上下文、忠实度）进行人工评分。在统一协议下对五个代表性LVLM进行基准测试。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，常规显示下的准确率本身并不能证明顺序理解能力：主要打乱条件下准确率出现显著下降，揭示了顺序敏感的多模态推理存在持续差距。Task2的评分偏好显示Gemini 3.1 Pro和GPT-5.5优于开源模型，而评论上下文对Core4预测仅带来微小且不稳定的提升。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了现有LVLM在多面板顺序感知推理上的根本性不足，并提供了CMPM这一标准化评测工具，为后续改进顺序敏感的多模态推理能力提供了基准资源和研究方向。

title: Graph-Based Pseudo-multimodal Contrastive Learning for 12-Lead ECG Representations
comment: 7 pages, 7 figures. Presented at the 48th Annual International Conference of the IEEE Engineering in Medicine and Biology Society (EMBC 2026)
summary:
12-lead electrocardiogram (ECG) is a standard, non-invasive examination widely used for diagnosing coronary artery disease, where clinical interpretation relies on comparing waveform patterns across multiple leads. However, most existing ECG analysis methods focus on single-lead signals or treat each lead independently, and typically process ECG signals as one-dimensional time-series data using CNNs or RNNs. While effective in modeling local waveform changes, such approaches have difficulty capturing inter-lead dependency and global waveform patterns essential for clinical diagnosis.
  To address this limitation, we propose a graph-based pseudo-multimodal contrastive learning framework called Graph-CMMC. ECG waveforms are transformed into Gramian Angular Difference Field (GADF) images to construct complementary representations of the same cardiac activity, enabling a pseudo-multimodal learning setting. Using all 12 leads, Graph-CMMC aligns waveform and GADF representations in a self-supervised manner, while a graph-based relational module is employed to model inter-lead dependency and enforce structural consistency across leads during contrastive learning.
  Experimental results on a multi-label coronary artery occlusion classification task demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive performance compared to supervised learning methods. These results further suggest the effectiveness of using GADF as a complementary representation and incorporating explicit graph-based modeling of inter-lead dependency for learning robust 12-lead ECG representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Graph-CMMC，一种基于图的伪多模态对比学习框架，用于12导联心电图的冠状动脉疾病诊断。通过将ECG波形转换为GADF图像形成互补表征，并结合图关系模块建模导联间依赖关系，在自监督方式下对齐两种表征，在多标签冠状动脉闭塞分类任务上取得与监督学习方法相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有ECG分析方法大多将信号视为一维时间序列，使用CNN或RNN处理，仅能捕捉局部波形变化，难以建模导联间依赖关系和全局波形模式，而这对于12导联ECG的临床诊断至关重要。
AI.method: 提出Graph-CMMC框架：1) 将12导联ECG波形转换为GADF图像作为互补表征，构建伪多模态学习设定；2) 在自监督方式下对齐波形和GADF表征；3) 引入基于图的关系模块建模导联间依赖，并在对比学习过程中强制结构一致性。
AI.result: 在多标签冠状动脉闭塞分类任务上，Graph-CMMC取得了与监督学习方法具有竞争力的性能，验证了GADF作为互补表征的有效性以及显式图建模导联间依赖对学习鲁棒12导联ECG表征的促进作用。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了在12导联ECG分析中，结合GADF图像变换与图结构建模可以有效补充传统时序建模，提升表征学习的稳健性，为ECG自监督表示学习提供了新思路。

title: Accelerating Scientific Research with Gemini in the Real-World
summary: We present an extension and comprehensive real-world validation of Co-Scientist, a Gemini-based multi-agent system designed to accelerate end-to-end scientific research across hypothesis generation, experimentation, and manuscript generation. Moving beyond in silico hypothesis generation, this specialized configuration transitions Co-Scientist into an execution-grounded research partner advancing closed-loop scientific workflows across materials science, biology, and computer science. In materials science, Co-Scientist interfaced with a semi-automated chemical vapor deposition reactor to design a safe precursor route for MXenes; experimental execution produced a lamellar 2D material sharing key structural similarities with the Ti3C2Tx MXene lattice, although further experiments are needed to confirm the atomic structure. Leveraging Gemini 3 Deep Think for rapid, lab-in-the-loop execution, it also tailored growth recipes to laboratory constraints in minutes, enabling single-attempt growth of monolayer MoS2, MoSe2, and WS2 semiconductors. In biology, Co-Scientist predicted emergent swarming phenotypes of engineered E. coli across inducer (IPTG) gradients from sparse imaging data, quantitatively matching unpublished wet-lab morphological measurements. In computer science, Co-Scientist autonomously discovered an inference-time scaling architecture that outperformed six frontier models on HealthBench (Hard and Professional) while reducing potential clinical harm under blinded physician evaluation. Finally, a double-blind study of end-to-end generated papers with 30 domain experts across 450 reviews demonstrates that Co-Scientist's reliability modules reduce hallucination and plagiarism while improving research safety. Together, these results demonstrate progress toward closed-loop multi-agent scientific AI systems capable of accelerating real-world scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍并验证了Co-Scientist——一个基于Gemini的多智能体系统在端到端科学研究中的应用扩展，涵盖假设生成、实验执行和论文撰写。该系统在材料科学（MXene前驱体设计与单层半导体生长）、生物学（预测大肠杆菌群体行为）、计算机科学（推理时缩放架构）以及研究安全（双重盲审降低幻觉与抄袭）四个领域均取得进展，展示了闭环多智能体科学AI系统加速真实世界发现的潜力。
AI.motivation: 超越纯计算机内（in silico）的假设生成，将AI科学助手从"思想工具"转变为"执行落地"的研究伙伴，实现从假设到实验再到论文的闭环科学工作流。
AI.method: 将Co-Scientist升级为专业化配置，接口半自动CVD反应器进行材料实验；利用Gemini 3 Deep Think实现实验室在环（lab-in-the-loop）快速执行；在生物学中通过稀疏成像数据预测表型；在计算机科学中自主探索推理时缩放架构；并引入可靠性模块配合双盲评审。
AI.result: 材料科学中成功设计MXene前驱体路线并生长出与Ti3C2Tx MXene结构相似的双层2D材料；单次尝试生长出MoS2、MoSe2和WS2单层半导体；生物学中定量匹配未发表的湿实验室形态测量；计算机科学中发现的架构在HealthBench上超越六个前沿模型且降低临床危害；450次双盲评审显示可靠性模块有效降低幻觉和抄袭。
AI.conclusion: Co-Scientist展示了多智能体AI系统从假设生成到实际实验执行的闭环潜力，在多个学科领域加速真实科学发现方面取得了实质性进展。

title: Why RAGs Hallucinate: Penalty-Aware Evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems with Knowledge-Gap Canaries
comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 5 tables. Code, full per-request logs, and all judge votes: https://github.com/adorosario/why-rags-hallucinate
summary: Volume-based accuracy rewards retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems for guessing: a system that answers everything outscores one that declines when its knowledge base cannot support an answer. Building on the confidence-target analysis of Kalai et al. (2025), we present a penalty-aware evaluation framework for deployed RAG products, combining (i) asymmetric scoring (correct +1, wrong -4, abstain 0), (ii) knowledge-gap canaries, questions whose answers are verifiably absent from the knowledge base, so that any answer constitutes ungrounded generation from parametric memory, and (iii) a failure-attribution pipeline that separates retrieval, generation, and abstention-policy failures. Applying the framework to three commercial RAG systems and a no-retrieval baseline on SimpleQA-Verified (1,000 questions x 3 repeats, graded blind by a cross-family three-judge panel with 98.9% unanimity), we find that accuracy when answering is closely clustered across systems (97.0-98.0%), while canary violation rates differ roughly sixfold (16.7% vs. 98.1%). The systems are separated less by what they answer correctly than by whether they answer at all when they should not, and penalty-aware scoring reorders the volume-based ranking accordingly; the reordering is stable across penalty settings from k=1 to k=9. All code, configurations, transcripts, and judge votes are released for independent audit.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向部署场景的RAG系统罚分感知评估框架，结合不对称评分（答对+1、答错-4、弃答0）、知识缺口金丝雀问题以及故障归因流水线，对三个商业RAG系统进行评估后发现：各系统回答准确性高度接近（97-98%），但金丝雀违规率相差约六倍（16.7% vs 98.1%），说明系统之间的差异主要在于"不该回答时是否回答"而非"回答得是否正确"，基于罚分的评分能够稳定地重新排序基于回答量的排名。
AI.motivation: 现有基于回答量的准确率评估方式会使RAG系统倾向于"猜测式作答"——即使知识库无法支撑答案也强行回答，从而获得更高的分数。这种评估方式奖励了无根据生成（从参数记忆而非知识库中产生答案），与现实部署中不确定时应弃答的实际需求不符，因此需要一个能够惩罚错误回答并奖励弃答的评估框架。
AI.method: 该框架包含三个核心组件：(i)不对称评分方案，答对+1、答错-4、弃答0，以平衡"猜测"的激励；(ii)知识缺口金丝雀（canary）问题，即答案确定性地不存在于知识库中的问题，任何回答都构成从参数记忆产生的无根据生成；(iii)故障归因流水线，将失败来源分离为检索失败、生成失败和弃答策略失败。评估在SimpleQA-Verified上对三个商业RAG系统和无检索基线进行，共1000题×3次重复，由跨模型家族的三法官小组盲评，一致率达98.9%。
AI.result: 研究发现：各系统在回答时的准确性非常接近（97.0-98.0%），但金丝雀违规率差异显著（16.7%至98.1%，约六倍差距）。系统之间的区分度主要不在于"回答正确的能力"，而在于"不该回答时是否选择回答"。基于罚分的评分能够重新排序基于回答量的排名，且该重新排序在罚分参数k=1到k=9范围内保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 传统的基于回答量的评估会误导对RAG系统的判断，罚分感知评估框架能够更真实地反映部署场景中的系统质量。系统间的核心差异在于弃答策略的质量而非生成能力的差别，这提示RAG产品应更重视不确定性问题上的拒答机制。所有代码、配置、转录和法官投票均公开以供独立审计。

title: ClusterAttention: A training-free speedup of bidirectional attention
summary:
This paper introduces ClusterAttention, a general training-free speedup of bidirectional attention layers. Existing sparse attention methods either rely on structure in the input, such as order in language or spatial proximity in images, or use slow clustering processes amortized over several forward passes. ClusterAttention instead uses a fast recursive clustering method that adapts to the geometry of the keys and queries in each attention head to produce useful clusters. This method allows setting the size of the clusters arbitrarily. We utilize this by setting all clusters to be a fixed size that is a power of two, allowing the block-sparse attention to run at the same latency per query-key interaction as dense attention on GPUs. We also derive an expression for the output error in sparse attention, that explains the counterintuitive experimental finding that tight clusters can lead to larger errors than random clusters. We then derive the error when excluded clusters are compensated through their centroids, and show that this error shrinks with tighter clusters. We integrate this compensation into the method.
  On large-scale tabular data ClusterAttention speeds up TabPFN-3 arXiv:2605.13986 by two to six times, while retaining at least 99% of the dense accuracy. To our knowledge, it is the first training-free method that can be successfully applied in the setting of unstructured input and a single forward pass. For video generation with Wan 2.1-14B T2V arXiv:2503.20314 , ClusterAttention achieves output closer to dense attention and a larger speedup (1.8x versus 1.4x) compared to SVOO arXiv:2603.18636 , a leading method developed specifically for this domain, both run without offline calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClusterAttention，一种无需训练的通用双向注意力加速方法。通过快速递归聚类自适应生成固定大小的簇，搭配质心补偿机制，在TabPFN-3上实现2-6倍加速且保持99%以上精度，在Wan 2.1-14B视频生成上比SVOO获得更大加速比（1.8x vs 1.4x）且输出更接近密集注意力。
AI.motivation: 现有稀疏注意力方法要么依赖输入的结构先验（如语言顺序、图像空间邻近性），要么使用跨多次前向传播摊还的慢速聚类过程。在非结构化输入和单次前向传播场景下，缺乏有效的训练无关加速方案。
AI.method: ClusterAttention提出一种快速递归聚类方法，自适应于每个注意力头中键和查询的几何分布，产生大小可任意设定的簇。将簇大小固定为2的幂，使块稀疏注意力的每个查询-键交互延迟与密集注意力一致。同时推导了稀疏注意力的输出误差表达式，解释紧簇反而比随机簇误差更大的反直觉现象，并通过对被排除簇的质心补偿来消除这一误差，证明补偿后误差随簇更紧而减小。
AI.result: 在大规模表格数据上，ClusterAttention对TabPFN-3实现2-6倍加速，同时保留至少99%的密集注意力精度；在Wan 2.1-14B T2V视频生成任务上，相比专门为该领域开发的领先方法SVOO，ClusterAttention的加速比更大（1.8x vs 1.4x）且输出更接近密集注意力，两者均无需离线校准。
AI.conclusion: ClusterAttention是首个能在非结构化输入和单次前向传播条件下成功应用的无训练加速方法，通过质心补偿克服了紧簇导致的误差问题，在表格数据和视频生成两个异构任务上均验证了其通用性和有效性。

title: Style as a Confound: False Positives in AI Detection of Non-Native Academic Writing
summary: AI text detectors are increasingly employed in academic settings, but it remains unclear whether their outputs reflect AI authorship itself or broader linguistic features associated with polished academic English. Previous studies have reported high false-positive rates (FPRs) for non-native English writing, but population-level comparisons confound authorship with differences in topic, domain, and writing style. Professional editing provides a useful setting for examining this issue because it changes the linguistic form of manuscripts while preserving authorship and content. We examined 135,389 document pairs from a professional English editing service (2018-2025), comprising non-native manuscripts and their native-edited versions, to assess how editing affects detector responses controlling for content and authorship. For the 13 AI text detectors, FPRs for human-written texts varied widely, from 0.0% to 100.0%. Responses varied across detectors: the same edits increased AI scores in some detectors but decreased them in others. Notably, score changes correlated with the extent of editing. The findings identify professional editing style as a key confounding variable in AI detector outputs, rather than establishing a full separation of text origin from linguistic style, raising concerns about fairness and reliability in academic settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用135,389对专业英文编辑服务文档（非母语原稿及母语编辑后版本），控制内容与作者身份，考察了13种AI文本检测器对编辑前后文本的反应差异。结果显示检测器误报率差异极大（0%-100%），同一编辑操作在不同检测器中可能提升或降低AI分数，且分数变化与编辑程度相关，表明专业编辑风格是AI检测器输出的关键混淆变量。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对非母语英语写作的AI检测器高误报率进行了报告，但此前的人群层面比较将作者身份与主题、领域和写作风格差异混为一谈，无法厘清检测器输出反映的究竟是AI作者身份本身还是与润色学术英语相关的语言学特征。专业编辑场景提供了独特条件，可在保持作者身份和内容不变的前提下，仅改变文本的语言形式。
AI.method: 收集2018-2025年间来自专业英语编辑服务的135,389对文档（非母语作者原稿及经母语编辑修改的版本），在控制内容和作者身份的条件下，评估编辑操作如何影响13种AI文本检测器的输出。分析各检测器的误报率、编辑前后AI分数的变化方向及幅度，并考察分数变化与编辑程度之间的相关性。
AI.result: 13种检测器对人类书面文本的误报率差异极大，范围从0.0%到100.0%。不同检测器对相同编辑操作的反应方向不一致：同一编辑操作在某些检测器中使AI分数升高，在另一些检测器中则使分数降低。此外，分数变化的幅度与编辑程度显著相关。
AI.conclusion: 专业编辑风格是AI文本检测器输出的关键混淆变量，研究并未实现文本来源与语言风格的完全分离，这引发了对学术场景中AI检测器公平性和可靠性的担忧。

title: Co-Evolving Structured Knowledge and Reasoning in Language Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented methods improve factual accuracy by grounding language models in external knowledge, but retrieving over unstructured text often introduces irrelevant context and offers limited control over the retrieved information. Structured knowledge bases offer a more controllable alternative, yet they are expensive to construct and often brittle to reason over. To address these limitations, we propose KBevo: a co-evolving framework that jointly learns to construct a structured knowledge base and reason over it for knowledge-intensive question answering. By optimizing both components end-to-end with QA outcome rewards, our method enables reasoning success to directly improve the quality of the constructed knowledge base. This leads to larger, better-connected knowledge structures with higher answer reachability, while also improving compositional factual reasoning and controllability compared to standard retrieval baselines.

AI.tldr: KBevo提出一个共演化框架，联合学习构建结构化知识库并基于其进行推理，用于知识密集型问答任务。通过端到端优化QA结果奖励，推理成功直接反馈改进知识库质量，相比标准检索方法在组合事实推理和可控性上表现更优。
AI.motivation: 检索增强方法虽然能提升事实准确性，但非结构化文本检索常引入无关上下文且控制力有限；结构化知识库虽可控但构建昂贵且推理脆弱。现有方法难以兼顾可控性与可扩展性，需要一种能够联合优化知识库构建与推理的新框架。
AI.method: 提出KBevo共演化框架，同时学习知识库构建模块和推理模块。两个组件通过QA结果奖励进行端到端联合优化，使得推理成功能够直接反馈并提升已构建知识库的质量，形成知识库构建与推理的互惠演化。
AI.result: 该方法生成了更大、连接更紧密的知识结构，具有更高的答案可达性，并在组合事实推理能力和可控性方面优于标准的检索基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 端到端联合优化知识库构建与推理是一种有效的范式，能够打破传统方法在可控性与可扩展性之间的权衡，为知识密集型问答提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Self-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models without Teacher
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD), which leverages a pre-trained, specialized teacher model to provide dense supervisory signals, has achieved significant success in Large Language Models (LLMs) and has recently been adapted to flow matching models. However, this paradigm suffers from two major issues: First, training a separate, task-specific teacher for every new objective incurs high computational costs. Second, the discrepancy between teacher and student distributions often leads to compounding errors along the generation trajectory. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{Self-OPD}, a teacher-free OPD framework for flow matching models that turns the student's own self-exploration into step-wise supervision. At each timestep, Self-OPD branches the deterministic next-state prediction into $K$ stochastic SDE candidates, rolls them out with the ODE sampler, and compares their rewards against a deterministic self-reference baseline to obtain normalized advantages. The velocity field is optimized with an all-branch pull-push objective, where high-advantage branches attract the student and low-advantage branches repel it under direction-aware attenuation and SDE-variance normalization. For multi-objective alignment, Self-OPD fuses normalized scores at the reward level, avoiding direct gradient conflict. Experiments on single and mixed reward benchmarks show that Self-OPD outperforms prior RL and OPD methods without task-specific teachers.

AI.tldr: Self-OPD提出了一种无需教师模型的流匹配模型在线蒸馏（OPD）框架。它通过将学生模型自身的确定性下一步预测分支为K个随机SDE候选路径，与ODE采样器进行rollout，并与确定性自参考基线比较奖励来获得归一化优势。速度场通过全分支拉推目标优化（高优势分支吸引、低优势分支排斥），在奖励层面融合多目标分数以避免梯度冲突。实验表明在单目标和混合奖励基准上均优于现有RL和OPD方法。
AI.motivation: 现有在线蒸馏（OPD）范式存在两大问题：一是为每个新目标训练专门的任务特定教师模型计算成本高昂；二是教师与学生分布之间的差异会导致生成轨迹上的累积误差（compounding errors）。作者旨在消除对独立教师模型的依赖，同时缓解分布不匹配问题。
AI.method: Self-OPD在每一步时间步将确定性下一状态预测分支为K个随机SDE候选，用ODE采样器进行rollout，并通过与确定性自参考基线比较来计算归一化优势。速度场使用全分支拉推目标（pull-push objective）优化：高优势分支吸引学生模型，低优势分支排斥它，同时采用方向感知衰减和SDE方差归一化。对于多目标对齐，在奖励层面对归一化分数进行融合，避免直接梯度冲突。
AI.result: 在单目标和混合奖励基准上的实验表明，Self-OPD在无需任务特定教师的情况下优于先前的强化学习方法和OPD方法。
AI.conclusion: Self-OPD通过将教师信号替换为学生的自我探索和自参考基线，实现了无教师（teacher-free）的在线蒸馏，有效解决了传统OPD的高计算成本和教师-学生分布不匹配问题，为流匹配模型的对齐提供了一种高效的新范式。

title: TEMPLAR Wales: A georeferenced environmental and toponymic dataset of Welsh settlements
summary: Place names provide persistent records of how landscapes have been described and organised, but their quantitative reuse requires explicit separation between mapped places, lexical annotations and environmental measurements. TEMPLAR Wales is a georeferenced environmental-toponymy dataset comprising 3,757 settlement records across Wales. The resource links a reproducible settlement frame to deterministic lexical screening and settlement-level environmental attributes through stable identifiers. It contains 1,350 lexical detections across 1,294 settlements, generated from a frozen registry of 24 Welsh place-name elements, while retaining exact- and prefix-token matches and their provenance separately. Environmental attributes describe river and coastal proximity, elevation and local terrain context at multiple spatial scales, land cover and neighbourhood woody cover, with parallel terrain measurements derived from independent elevation products. The dataset is distributed as four relational tables accompanied by a field-level data dictionary, source-provenance register and licensing metadata. Technical validation confirms relational integrity, deterministic lexical reconstruction, documented environmental coverage, strong agreement between independent terrain sources and reproducible reconstruction of the frozen release. TEMPLAR Wales provides a reusable foundation for research in toponymy, linguistic geography, historical and environmental landscape studies, GIS and spatial data analysis without treating computational lexical detections as verified etymologies or contemporary environmental measurements as historical landscape reconstructions.

AI.tldr: TEMPLAR Wales是一个包含3,757条威尔士聚落记录的地理参考环境-地名数据集，通过稳定标识符将可复现的聚落框架、确定性词汇筛选和聚落级环境属性相链接，并提供技术验证支持。
AI.motivation: 地名提供景观描述与组织的持久记录，但其定量复用需要在测绘地点、词汇注释和环境测量之间进行明确分离；现有资源缺乏统一、可复现且可量化的地名与环境集成数据集。
AI.method: 采用可复现聚落框架，结合基于24个威尔士地名元素冻结注册表的确定性词汇筛选（保留精确和前缀词元匹配并分别记录来源），在多个空间尺度上计算河流/海岸距离、海拔、地形上下文、土地覆盖及邻域林木覆盖等环境属性，并使用独立海拔产品进行平行地形测量；以四个关系表配合字段级数据字典、来源注册表和许可元数据发布。
AI.result: 包含1,350个词汇检测（覆盖1,294个聚落），技术验证确认了关系完整性、确定性词汇重建、环境覆盖率、独立地形源间强一致性以及冻结版本的可复现重建。
AI.conclusion: TEMPLAR Wales为地名学、语言地理学、历史与环境景观研究、GIS及空间数据分析提供可复用基础，同时明确区分计算词汇检测与验证词源、当代环境测量与历史景观重建的边界。

title: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
summary: Large language models offer broad capabilities, but adapting them to evolving domains, tools, and requirements often entails repeated post-training. Autonomous systems automate parts of this process by proposing updates, training candidates, and using evaluation feedback to select subsequent proposals. As evidence accumulates, a central problem emerges: which past update evidence remains actionable after subsequent training has changed the parent model? An update's effect depends on its parent, data, and training stage. Treating past success as context-free permission can waste compute. If the resulting child is promoted, it can also degrade the subsequent training trajectory. We formulate this problem as conditional experience transfer and introduce Boundary-Calibrated Intervention Transfer (BCIT), a method that authorizes experience reuse before weight-changing training. BCIT binds an observed effect to its source context, checks applicability conditions, vetoes candidates with named hard conflicts, and obtains current-state evidence through a bounded training trial when needed. Fully trained candidates still face a shared adoption rule, and only observed events extend memory. On one 4B model adapted across finance reasoning, text-to-SQL, and function calling, candidate updates exhibit heterogeneous target and retention effects across the evaluated contexts. Under matched candidates, evidence, and compute, BCIT authorizes fewer harmful updates and attains higher equal-budget final-model quality than the evaluated alternatives. These results support treating experience authorization as a distinct problem in autonomous post-training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件经验迁移问题，并引入边界校准干预迁移（BCIT）方法，在自主后训练中基于更新效果的源上下文决定哪些历史经验可以被授权重用，防止有害更新影响后续训练轨迹，实验表明BCIT在4B模型上授权更少有害更新并获得更优的等预算最终模型质量。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在适应持续演化的领域、工具和需求时，常需反复后训练。自主系统通过提出更新、训练候选和评估反馈来自动化该过程，但随着证据累积，一个核心问题浮现：在父模型已被后续训练改变后，哪些过去的更新证据仍然有效？由于更新的效果依赖于其父模型、数据和训练阶段，将过去成功视为无上下文的许可能浪费计算，且若子模型被提升，还可能恶化后续训练轨迹。
AI.method: 本文将问题形式化为条件经验迁移，提出BCIT方法：在权重改变训练之前授权经验重用。BCIT将观察到的效果绑定到其来源上下文，检查适用性条件，否决具有命名硬冲突的候选者，并在需要时通过有界训练试验获取当前状态证据。完全训练的候选仍受共享采用规则约束，只有观察到的事件才扩展记忆。
AI.result: 在4B模型上跨金融推理、文本到SQL和函数调用进行实验，候选更新在不同评估上下文中表现出异质的保留和效果。在匹配的候选、证据和计算条件下，BCIT比评估的替代方法授权更少的有害更新，并在等预算条件下达到更高的最终模型质量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明应将在自主后训练中将经验授权视为一个独立问题，而非简单地将历史成功当作无条件的重用许可。

title: LowRankArena: A Standardized Evaluation Platform for SVD-Based LLM Compression
summary: SVD-based low-rank compression has become a fast-growing direction for reducing the memory and computational cost of large language models (LLMs). However, meaningful comparison across existing studies remains difficult as prior evaluations use varied benchmarks, inconsistent ratios, and diverse setups, often failing to isolate low-rank effects from auxiliary techniques. As a result, it remains unclear whether reported gains reflect method-level improvements or differences in evaluation protocol. This lack of comparability highlights the need for a unified, reproducible evaluation platform. To address this problem, we present LowRankArena, a standardized evaluation platform for SVD-based LLM compression. LowRankArena unifies task versions, uniform-precision compression budgets, comparison regimes, and inference measurements, and provides a reproducible pipeline with over 3 TiB released compressed checkpoints. Using LowRankArena, our aligned audit of five representative SVD methods reveals that prior findings are highly conditional under standardized protocols: clear leaders and performance tiers shift across backbones and keep ratios, multiple-choice accuracy can hide large perplexity degradation, and nominal low-rank savings yield workload-dependent and often limited end-to-end speedups. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Zishan-Shao/lowrankarena.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LowRankArena，一个用于SVD-based LLM低秩压缩的统一可复现评估平台，统一了任务版本、压缩预算、对比规程和推理测量；通过对五种代表性SVD方法的对齐审计，发现先前的研究结论在标准化协议下高度依赖于具体条件，性能排名会随主干网络和保留比例变化。
AI.motivation: 现有SVD低秩压缩研究各自使用不同的基准、不一致的比例和多样的设置，导致方法之间难以进行有意义的对比。研究者无法判断报告的性能提升究竟是方法本身的改进还是评估协议差异造成的，这种缺乏可比性的问题凸显了构建统一可复现评估平台的必要性。
AI.method: LowRankArena平台通过统一任务版本、统一精度的压缩预算、标准化对比规程和推理测量来构建可复现的评估流程，并发布了超过3 TiB的压缩检查点。基于该平台，对五种代表性SVD方法进行了对齐审计（aligned audit）。
AI.result: 审计发现：（1）在标准化协议下，先前的研究结论高度条件化——清晰的方法领先者和性能梯队会随主干网络（backbone）和保留比例（keep ratio）的变化而改变；（2）多项选择准确率可能掩盖严重的困惑度（perplexity）退化；（3）名义上的低秩节省在实际端到端加速中表现出工作量相关且通常有限的收益。
AI.conclusion: SVD低秩压缩方法的性能表现高度依赖评估条件，需要在统一标准下进行评估才能获得可靠的对比结论；LowRankArena为社区提供了一个标准化的评估基座，有助于区分真实的方法级改进与评估协议差异。

title: Tether the Subject, Release the Scene: Query-Aware Memory Routing for Long-Horizon Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Streaming autoregressive video models generate long videos chunk by chunk, using historical memory to maintain consistency. Existing methods typically expose subject and scene queries to history through similar policies. This stabilizes the subject, but can also lock backgrounds, viewpoints, and scene structure to previously generated states even when local motion continues. We call this failure memory-anchored scene under-progression; consistency and motion metrics alone can miss it. We introduce TetherMem, a training-free, query-aware spatiotemporal memory router for frozen video generators. TetherMem separates subject and scene queries and modulates historical access with region- and age-conditioned priors: subject queries retain identity-bearing history, while scene queries reduce reliance on subject history and stale backgrounds. Across 2,400 blinded pairwise judgments from 10 annotators, TetherMem achieves the highest estimated expected preference among eight streaming long-video baselines for overall quality (0.780) and scene progression (0.769). On complete 30-second videos, it sustains changes in background, viewpoint, and scene state while preserving subject recognizability and temporal continuity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TetherMem，一种无需训练、查询感知的时空记忆路由器，用于冻结的视频生成器。它通过分离主体（subject）和场景（scene）查询，并分别调节它们对历史记忆的访问，解决了流式自回归视频模型中"记忆锚定场景欠进展"（memory-anchored scene under-progression）问题——即背景、视角和场景结构被锁定在先前生成状态的问题。实验表明TetherMem在8个基线中取得最高的整体质量和场景进展偏好。
AI.motivation: 现有的流式自回归视频模型按块生成视频，通常对主体和场景查询采用相似的历史访问策略。这虽然稳定了主体，但也会将背景、视角和场景结构锁定在先前生成的状态，即使局部运动仍在继续。这种"记忆锚定场景欠进展"问题无法被一致性指标和运动指标单独捕捉，需要新的解决方案。
AI.method: TetherMem是一种训练无关、查询感知的时空记忆路由器，应用于冻结的视频生成器。核心做法是：1）将主体查询和场景查询分离；2）通过区域条件和年龄条件先验（region- and age-conditioned priors）调节历史访问：主体查询保留承载身份特征的历史信息，而场景查询减少对主体历史和陈旧背景的依赖。
AI.result: 在2400个盲选成对比较（10名标注者）中，TetherMem在8个流式长视频基线中获得了最高的估计期望偏好：整体质量0.780，场景进展0.769。在完整的30秒视频上，它持续保持背景、视角和场景状态的变化，同时保持主体可识别性和时间连续性。
AI.conclusion: TetherMem证明了通过查询感知、区域和年龄条件化的记忆路由策略，可以在不重新训练模型的情况下，解决流式视频生成中的场景欠进展问题，同时兼顾主体稳定性和场景动态变化性。

title: Terrain signatures in Welsh settlement names
summary: Landscapes are named, but whether names retain measurable environmental information beyond broad geographic structure is rarely tested. We analysed 3,757 Welsh settlements using a frozen, source-audited 24-element lexical framework, preregistered outcome-specific models and geographically structured validation. The central comparison contrasted 101 settlements carrying high-terrain elements (\textit{bryn} or \textit{mynydd}) with 139 carrying low-terrain elements (\textit{cwm} or \textit{pant}). High-terrain names occupied locations 24.4 m higher relative to their 2-km surroundings (95\% CI, 10.8--38.1 m; Holm-adjusted $p$ = 0.00137). The association remained positive across prespecified 1-, 2- and 5-km neighbourhood definitions and was reproduced using an independently produced elevation source (24.1 m; 95\% CI, 10.6--37.6 m). Adding terrain-name polarity to a non-lexical spatial and settlement baseline reduced geographically held-out mean squared error by 4.63\%, 6.22\% and 7.30\% under 10-, 25- and 50-km spatial blocking, respectively, although improvement varied among held-out regions. River-related names provided weaker, directionally consistent evidence, while the preregistered woodland model was non-estimable. Residual spatial structure, unresolved name language and the absence of independent external replication limit interpretation. Selected Welsh settlement-name categories therefore retain measurable information about present-day terrain within Wales, without establishing individual etymology, causal naming, historical environmental memory or transferability to other naming systems.

AI.tldr: 通过对3,757个威尔士定居点名称的分析，验证了地名是否保留可测量的环境信息。高地形名称（bryn/mynydd）相对周围2公里环境高出24.4米，且该关联在不同的邻域定义和独立高程数据源中得到验证。将地形名称极性加入预测模型可将空间交叉验证的均方误差降低4.63%-7.30%。
AI.motivation: 地名是否保留可测量的环境信息这一点很少被严格检验。现有研究往往假设地名能反映地形等环境特征，但缺乏系统的、预先注册的验证方法。本研究旨在通过严格的方法论框架，检验威尔士定居点名称是否在广义地理结构之外保留可测量的环境信息。
AI.method: 使用冻结的、经来源审计的24元素词汇框架，对3,757个威尔士定居点进行分析。采用预先注册的按结果特定的模型和地理结构化验证。核心比较聚焦于101个含高地形元素（bryn/mynydd）与139个含低地形元素（cwm/pant）的定居点。使用1公里、2公里和5公里的邻域定义，并采用独立产生的高程数据源进行验证，同时使用10公里、25公里和50公里空间分组进行空间交叉验证。
AI.result: 高地形名称定居点相对周围2公里环境高出24.4米（95% CI: 10.8-38.1米；校正p=0.00137）。该关联在预设的1、2、5公里邻域定义和独立高程数据源中均保持一致。地形名称极性加入基线模型后，在10、25、50公里空间分组下分别降低均方误差4.63%、6.22%和7.30%。河流相关名称证据较弱但方向一致，预注册的林地模型无法估计。
AI.conclusion: 威尔士选定定居点名称类别确实在广义地理结构之外保留了关于现今地形的可测量信息，但该发现不确立个体词源学、因果关系、历史环境记忆或对其他命名系统的可迁移性。残余空间结构、未解决的地名语言问题以及缺乏独立外部复制限制了结论的普适性。

title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds
summary: Enterprises fine-tune language models on proprietary data that may later require removal due to privacy, contractual, or compliance obligations. Selective unlearning removes requested knowledge while preserving model utility, offering a practical alternative to full retraining, but existing methods treat the explicitly identified forget examples as the complete deletion scope. This is insufficient when target knowledge remains recoverable through paraphrases, aliases, or neighboring training examples. We propose GRAPHSU, a graph-guided controller that expands the deletion scope beyond forget seeds by constructing a weighted support-route graph, propagating deletion pressure through it, and applying graded forgetting strengths to high-risk neighbors. On the Task of Fictitious Unlearning (TOFU), a synthetic author-profile question-answering benchmark, and PISTOL, a structural-unlearning benchmark built around interconnected factual samples, with GPT-2 Medium and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct, GRAPHSU achieves the lowest utility-feasible soft leakage across all deletion settings, reducing leakage by up to 49.5 percentage points over a matched seed-only baseline, demonstrating that effective enterprise unlearning requires controlling support routes, not just forget seeds.

AI.tldr: GRAPHSU是一种基于图引导的模型选择性遗忘方法，通过构建加权"支持-路由"图来扩展删除范围，不仅删除显式的遗忘种子，还通过传播删除压力并施加分级遗忘强度来处理高风险邻近样本，在TOFU和PISTOL基准上显著降低了软泄漏（最高降低49.5个百分点）。
AI.motivation: 企业微调的大语言模型可能因隐私、合同或合规要求需要删除特定知识。现有选择性遗忘方法仅处理显式标识的遗忘样本，但目标知识仍可通过释义、别名或邻近训练样本被恢复，导致删除不彻底。
AI.method: GRAPHSU构建一个加权支持-路由图（weighted support-route graph），将删除范围从遗忘种子扩展到其关联的邻近样本。通过在图结构上传播删除压力（propagating deletion pressure），并对高风险邻居施加分级遗忘强度（graded forgetting strengths），实现更全面的知识删除。
AI.result: 在TOFU基准和PISTOL结构遗忘基准上，使用GPT-2 Medium和Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct模型，GRAPHSU在所有删除设置下实现了最低的效用可行的软泄漏，相比匹配的仅种子基线最多降低49.5个百分点的泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 有效的企业级模型遗忘需要控制"支持路由"（support routes）而不仅仅是遗忘种子，即必须考虑目标知识通过其他路径被恢复的可能性，这为选择性遗忘提供了新的设计思路。

title: Case2Flow: Bridging Patient Cases and Guideline Flowcharts through Multimodal Retrieval
summary: Medical guidelines encode rich, evidence-based decision logic, yet the specific decision artifact a clinician needs is hard to locate within a guideline, let alone across guidelines covering plausible diseases and treatments. While guideline passages have supported end-to-end question answering, flowcharts remain largely underused in decision support despite their ability to encode actionable clinical pathways. We therefore introduce Case2Flow, a task designed to retrieve the most relevant guideline flowchart for a given patient case from a collection of guideline documents. To support it, we construct FlowAtlas, a curated corpus of 202 flowcharts extracted from 2,080 medical guidelines, together with a pipeline that synthesises 1,911 aligned case-flowchart pairs. Our evaluation of multimodal retrieval methods reveals systematic failure modes, including overreliance on keywords and spurious token-patch matches induced by uninformative background regions in flowcharts. Motivated by this, we propose CRISP, a training-free scoring method that sharpens late-interaction retrieval by suppressing uninformative patches, discounting ambiguous token matches, and incorporating bidirectional query-image alignment. CRISP improves Recall@1 by up to 18.71 percentage points, while a blinded physician assessment on published case narratives provides preliminary feasibility evidence beyond synthetic queries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Case2Flow任务，目标是从医学指南集合中为给定患者病例检索最相关的指南流程图。为此构建了FlowAtlas语料库（从2,080份医学指南中提取202个流程图，并合成1,911个病例-流程图配对），并提出CRISP——一种免训练的评分方法，通过抑制无关补丁、折扣模糊token匹配及双向查询-图像对齐来改进后期交互检索，在Recall@1上最高提升18.71个百分点。
AI.motivation: 医学指南编码了丰富的循证决策逻辑，但临床医生难以在单一指南乃至跨指南中快速定位所需的特定决策工件。虽然指南文本段落已支持端到端问答，但流程图作为编码可操作临床路径的关键工件，在决策支持中仍被大量闲置，缺乏针对病例的流程图检索研究。
AI.method: 1) 构建Case2Flow任务及FlowAtlas语料库（202个流程图+1,911个合成病例-流程图配对）；2) 系统评估多模态检索方法并分析失败模式（关键词过依赖、无信息背景导致的伪token-patch匹配）；3) 提出CRISP免训练评分方法：抑制无信息补丁、折扣模糊token匹配、引入双向查询-图像对齐，以锐化后期交互检索。
AI.result: CRISP在Recall@1上较基线最高提升18.71个百分点；此外，通过盲法医师评估已发表病例叙述，提供了超出合成查询的初步可行性证据。
AI.conclusion: CRISP能有效改善指南流程图检索性能，为将医学指南流程图的临床决策逻辑整合到病例级决策支持中提供了可行路径；但仍需更大规模的真实临床验证。

title: AraMS-28k: The Largest Publicly Released Line-Level Dataset of Historical Arabic Manuscripts with Margin and Insertion-Anchor Annotations
comment: Data and code available at this https URL and this https URL. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22095333 Code: https://github.com/ArchaText/AraMS-28k-Dataset
summary: We introduce AraMS-28k, the largest publicly released line-level dataset of genuine historical Arabic manuscripts, comprising 14 books, 3,043 pages, and 28,600 annotated text lines (27,971 main-text, 629 margin). Thirteen books are hand-copied manuscripts spanning three script traditions -- Naskh, Ruq'ah, and Maghrebi -- and one is a lithographed printed edition included to broaden format diversity. Each line is labelled as main-text or margin, and margin lines that have an unambiguous attachment point in the main text are further annotated with an insertion anchor, recovering the manuscript's true non-linear reading order at line-level granularity -- to our knowledge the first such annotation released for a historical Arabic manuscript corpus. Because reference transcriptions are fully vocalised while manuscript hands are typically undiacritised, we release both the raw diacritised transcription and a diacritic-normalised counterpart for every line. The dataset was constructed with RefLAM, a reference-grounded annotation pipeline that aligns multimodal-LLM OCR against independently sourced clean transcriptions and routes every line through human review, combining automatic verification with expert oversight. We describe the construction and quality-control process, present the annotation schema, report dataset statistics at both the corpus and per-book level, and provide baseline HTR results using Kraken and HATFormer, including a cross-script generalisation gradient from in-distribution pages to fully unseen books. AraMS-28k is released with page images, line-level annotations, and fixed train/val/test splits under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 to support reproducible research on Arabic manuscript recognition, layout analysis, and reading-order recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了AraMS-28k，目前最大的公开行级真实历史阿拉伯语手稿数据集，包含14本书、3043页和28600条标注文本行，覆盖Naskh、Ruq'ah和Maghrebi三种手写体传统及一种石印印刷版本。数据集对每行标注为主文本或边注，并为可明确关联的边注行标注插入锚点，首次以行级粒度恢复非线性的真实阅读顺序。每条文本行同时发布原始带音符转写和去音符版本。通过RefLAM管线（多模态大模型OCR与独立清洁转写对齐）构建，并经过人工审查。提供了Kraken和HATFormer的基线HTR结果及跨字体泛化分析。
AI.motivation: 历史阿拉伯语手稿的自动化识别、版面分析和阅读顺序恢复研究长期缺乏大规模、高质量的真实标注数据集。现有数据集规模有限、格式单一、缺乏行级阅读顺序标注，且手稿通常无音符而转写通常带音符，存在标注不一致问题，限制了该领域的研究进展和可复现性。
AI.method: 构建AraMS-28k数据集，包含14本书籍（13本手抄本涵盖三种字体传统，1本石印版）。采用RefLAM标注管线：将多模态大语言模型OCR输出与独立来源的清洁转写进行参考对齐，每条文本行均经过人工审查，实现自动验证与专家监督相结合。边注行若在主文本中有明确插入位置则标注插入锚点，以实现行级阅读顺序恢复。每个行级转写同时发布原始带标音版本和去标音版本。
AI.result: 发布了包含28600条标注行（27971条主文本、629条边注）的数据集，统计了语料库级和逐书级数据指标。提供了Kraken和HATFormer两种HTR模型的基线结果，并呈现了从分布内页面到完全未见书籍的跨字体泛化梯度分析。数据集以CC BY-NC-SA 4.0协议发布，包含页面图像、行级标注和固定的训练/验证/测试划分。
AI.conclusion: AraMS-28k作为目前最大规模的公开历史阿拉伯语手稿行级数据集，首次引入行级阅读顺序恢复标注，解决了手稿转写中标音不一致的问题，并通过RefLAM管线保证了标注质量。该数据集为阿拉伯语手稿识别、版面分析和阅读顺序恢复提供了标准化的可复现研究基准。

title: Decentralized Multitask Learning over Learned Task Graphs
summary: This paper investigates decentralized multitask learning over networks when the underlying task relationships are unknown. While existing graph-regularized multitask frameworks typically assume a known structure, practical settings often require learning inter-task dependencies directly from distributed data. We propose a decentralized two-phase strategy that first estimates a generalized graph Laplacian from noisy non-cooperative stochastic gradient iterates, and subsequently exploits the learned graph to enable cooperative multitask diffusion learning. This framework is motivated by a Gaussian Markov random field prior, which gives rise to a decentralized maximum likelihood estimator for the graph Laplacian. The analysis quantifies the Laplacian estimation error and its propagation to the steady-state performance of the multitask diffusion recursion, and introduces a topology sensitivity index to capture the effect of network heterogeneity. Simulation results corroborate the theoretical findings and demonstrate that cooperation enabled by the learned task graph significantly improves performance over non-cooperative learning, while approaching the true-graph baseline when the estimation stepsize is sufficiently small.

AI.tldr: 本文研究任务关系未知的分散式多任务学习问题，提出一种两阶段策略：先从非合作随机梯度迭代中估计广义图拉普拉斯，再利用学习到的图执行合作多任务扩散学习。理论分析量化了拉普拉斯估计误差向稳态性能的传播，并提出拓扑敏感度指标刻画网络异构性影响。
AI.motivation: 现有图正则化多任务学习框架通常假设任务间关系（即图结构）已知，但在实际应用场景中，任务间依赖关系往往未知，需要直接从分布式数据中学习。本文旨在填补这一空白，实现在网络环境下自动发现任务关系并利用其提升学习性能。
AI.method: 提出两阶段分散式框架：(1) 以高斯马尔可夫随机场为先验，从非合作随机梯度迭代中构建分散式极大似然估计器，估计广义图拉普拉斯；(2) 利用学习到的图结构进行合作式多任务扩散学习。分析包括拉普拉斯估计误差的量化、误差向多任务扩散递归稳态性能的传播，以及网络异构性的拓扑敏感度指标。
AI.result: 仿真实验验证了理论分析的正确性，表明由学习到的任务图驱动的合作学习较非合作学习有显著性能提升；当估计步长足够小时，性能接近真实图基线方案。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的两阶段分散式策略能够在任务关系未知时有效地从数据中学习图结构并利用其促进协作，为实际场景中拓扑未知的多任务分布式学习提供了理论保证和可行方案。

title: AgentFold: Closed-Loop Agentic Search for Protein Folding Model Design
