summary: Scientific LLM agents have shown promise in literature reasoning, tool use, and experiment planning, but it remains unclear whether they can autonomously improve large, tightly coupled scientific machine-learning systems through executable code changes and computationally expensive validation. We study this question in protein folding, where progress requires coordinated architectural modifications, multi-objective evaluation, and domain-aware interpretation. We present AgentFold, a multi-agent framework that formulates folding-model development as a closed-loop search over executable code variants. Starting from ESMFold, AgentFold proposes hypotheses, implements and debugs code-level modifications, evaluates model variants, analyzes experimental outcomes, and stores both successful and failed interventions in structured memory. An MCTS-style policy allocates computational resources across high-scoring search branches. On an engineering-scale protein-folding codebase comprising more than 2,000 lines of code, AgentFold explores approximately 80 model variants using approximately 5,000 GPU-hours and 170 million LLM tokens. Under a matched computational budget, AgentFold improves the best lDDT by 7.5% over independent Codex proposals and outperforms a random-search control. Beyond model improvement, the resulting intervention traces reveal recurring empirical design patterns: stable gains tend to arise from early, soft, learnable priors and gated refinement, whereas direct geometric perturbations and geometry-conditioned feedback often destabilize training. The code and experimental resources are publicly available at https://github.com/lmqfly/AgentFold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentFold，一个多智能体框架，将蛋白质折叠模型开发形式化为对可执行代码变体的闭环搜索。从ESMFold出发，AgentFold通过假设生成、代码修改与调试、多目标评估和结构化记忆存储，配合MCTS风格策略分配计算资源，在超过2000行代码的工程规模代码库上探索约80个模型变体（消耗约5000 GPU小时和1.7亿LLM token），在匹配计算预算下将最坏lDDT提升7.5%，优于独立Codex提议和随机搜索基线。干预追踪还揭示了稳定的经验设计模式。
AI.motivation: 科学LLM智能体在文献推理、工具使用和实验规划方面已展现潜力，但尚不清楚它们能否通过可执行的代码变更和计算昂贵的验证来自主改进大规模、紧密耦合的科学机器学习系统。蛋白质折叠领域需要协调的架构修改、多目标评估和领域感知解释，是检验这一能力的理想场景。
AI.method: AgentFold采用多智能体框架，将折叠模型开发视为对可执行代码变体的闭环搜索。系统从ESMFold出发，包含以下核心组件：1) 假设生成与代码级修改实施和调试；2) 多目标评估模型变体；3) 对实验结果的领域感知分析；4) 将成功和失败的干预措施存入结构化记忆；5) 采用MCTS风格策略在高分搜索分支间分配计算资源。该框架在包含2000+行代码的工程规模蛋白质折叠代码库上进行验证。
AI.result: AgentFold在约80个模型变体、约5000 GPU小时和1.7亿LLM token的实验条件下，在匹配计算预算下将最佳lDDT相较于独立Codex提议提升7.5%，并优于随机搜索对照组。此外，干预追踪揭示了可复现的经验设计模式：稳定的收益往往来自早期、软性、可学习的先验和门控精炼，而直接的几何扰动和几何条件反馈常常导致训练不稳定。
AI.conclusion: AgentFold证明LLM智能体能够自主改进大规模、紧密耦合的科学机器学习系统，超越了传统的独立代码生成方法。更重要的是，其干预轨迹不仅带来模型性能提升，还提供了关于蛋白质折叠模型设计的可迁移经验知识（稳定的设计模式），展示了LLM智能体在科学发现中作为自主研究者的潜力。代码和实验资源已公开。

title: AfriSwitch: A Benchmark for In-the-Wild African Code-Switched Speech Recognition
summary: Code-switching is pervasive in bilingual African conversation, yet most ASR systems assume monolingual input and are evaluated on curated monolingual benchmarks. We present AfriSwitch, a 61.36-hour human-transcribed benchmark of in-the-wild code-switched speech spanning 16 African languages and language varieties, released with switch-level English span tags, perutterance Code-Mixing Index (CMI), and switch-point counts. Corpus statistics show that mixing behaviour varies widely across African languages along two largely independent axes: how often speakers alternate, and how balanced the mixture is. No single scalar captures how code-switched a language is. Benchmarking five open and commercial multilingual ASR systems zero-shot yields word error rates far above published monolingual figures for the same languages, with the best system averaging 35.93% WER and no system falling below 24% on any language. Africa-targeted training, not model scale or nominal language coverage, best predicts performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AfriSwitch基准，包含61.36小时、覆盖16种非洲语言的真实场景语码转换语音数据，并对其进行了人工标注。研究发现非洲语言间的语码转换行为沿两个独立轴变化，现有ASR系统在语码转换场景下WER远高于单语基准。
AI.motivation: 双语非洲对话中普遍存在语码转换现象，但现有ASR系统大多假设单语输入，且在精心设计的单语基准上评估。缺乏针对非洲语言语码转换语音的公开基准，导致对该场景下ASR系统表现的真实评估缺失。
AI.method: 构建AfriSwitch基准：收集61.36小时野外（in-the-wild）语码转换语音，覆盖16种非洲语言及方言，提供人工转写、switch-level英语跨度标注、每句话的Code-Mixing Index (CMI)和转换点计数。基准测试了五个开源和商业多语言ASR系统的零样本（zero-shot）表现，并分析影响性能的预测因素。
AI.result: 语料统计显示非洲语言间的语码转换行为沿两个基本独立的轴变化：交替频率和混合均衡度。现有ASR系统零样本测试的WER远高于同一语言的已发表单语结果，最佳系统平均WER为35.93%，且没有任何系统在任何语言上低于24%。非洲定向训练（而非模型规模或名义语言覆盖）是性能的最佳预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 单一标量无法全面刻画语言的语码转换程度；现有ASR系统在非洲语码转换语音上表现不佳；针对非洲语言的定向训练比模型规模或名义语言覆盖更能提升ASR性能。AfriSwitch基准为该领域研究提供了标准化评估平台。

title: KISS-GS: 3D Gaussian Splatting Compression Kept Simple
summary:
Scene reconstruction with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become common, however deployment remains painful as the uncompressed file sizes can be massive. Current 3DGS compression systems combine multiple strategies for file size reduction, which can obscure where gains come from and limit component reuse across training pipelines. To make the gains more transparent, we propose KISS-GS, a modular compression pipeline named after the principle of keeping things simple, designed to decouple compression entirely from training.
  Given a 3DGS scene reconstructed with vanilla 3DGS, we are able to reduce it through compaction by 15.7x using a combination of state-of-the-art pruning schemes. Then we encode it into an image-based format designed for simple, ubiquitous decoding. With the SOG-XT format, we propose a novel extension to Self-Organizing Gaussians with two main contributions: (i) Self-organizing 2D Codebooks and (ii) Parallel Representative Assignment Smoothing (PRAS), which leverages the symmetry of quaternion and scale parameterizations to produce 2D attribute grids more amenable to encoding.
  This encoding reduces scene size by 6.6x. We show that optional encoding-aware fine-tuning yields a further 2.2x. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, our simple and modular approach thus achieves a total of 85x to 319x reductions in the size of the scene over uncompressed vanilla 3DGS, setting new benchmarks for real-world scenes and surpassing tightly integrated methods in rate-distortion. Decoding relies solely on web-native image formats, and the modular design makes each stage easy to combine with future advances in reconstruction and compaction.
  Code and project page: https://fraunhoferhhi.github.io/KISS-GS/

AI.tldr: KISS-GS提出一种模块化的3D高斯溅射(3DGS)压缩流水线，将压缩与训练完全解耦。通过对标准3DGS场景依次应用剪枝压缩(15.7x)和基于图像的SOG-XT格式编码(6.6x)，并可选编码感知微调(2.2x)，实现了85x至319x的总压缩比，解码仅依赖Web原生图像格式。
AI.motivation: 3DGS场景重建已普及，但未压缩文件体积巨大，部署困难。现有3DGS压缩系统将多种策略混合在一起，导致难以辨识各策略的具体贡献，且限制了各组件在其他训练流水线中的复用。作者希望使压缩增益透明化、模块化，从而便于后续改进与组合。
AI.method: 提出KISS-GS模块化压缩流水线：(1) 剪枝压缩阶段，对vanilla 3DGS重建场景应用多种先进剪枝方案，实现15.7倍压缩；(2) 编码阶段，将场景编码为基于图像的SOG-XT格式，包含两项创新：自组织2D码本(Self-organizing 2D Codebooks)和并行代表分配平滑(PRAS)，利用四元数与尺度参数化的对成性生成更利于编码的2D属性网格；(3) 可选的编码感知微调进一步提升2.2倍。
AI.result: 在标准3DGS基准上，KISS-GS实现对未压缩vanilla 3DGS场景85x至319x的总压缩比，在真实场景上创下新基准，且在率失真性能上超越紧密集成的压缩方法。
AI.conclusion: KISS-GS证明压缩可以与训练完全解耦仍然取得优异且可解释的增益。解码仅依赖Web原生图像格式，模块化设计使各阶段易于与未来的重建和压缩技术进步组合，为3DGS高效部署提供简洁实用的方案。

title: Benchmarking_Fast_Domain_Adaptation_for_Unsupervised_Speech_Units
summary: Representation learning has attracted great atten- tion and managed to reach good performances as a pretraining method for downstream tasks or as a first step towards unsu- pervised speech modeling. Yet, little is known about how such methods deal with out-of-domain speech and how could they be adapted in a few shot to new domains. This is important especially for accented speech where one observes a long tail of accents that diverge from the standard ones. We introduce ABX- Accent, a benchmark based on the AESRC dataset that features 10 different accents of English. It includes a small (< 10 hours) unlabelled training set in each of the accents and adaptations of the Zero Resources Challenge ABX evaluation metrics to each of the accents. We illustrate this benchmark with a baseline model that uses adaptive domain normalization to fine tune a pretrained Contrastive Predictive Coding model on the accents. This method is first developed on LibriSpeech using a male/female split. When applied to the new benchmark, the proposed method yields a relative improvement of 23.6% on across-speaker ABX scores on average compared to non adapted models. The data and metrics will be open sourced upon paper acceptance

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ABX-Accent基准测试，基于AESRC数据集涵盖10种英语口音，包含每种口音的小规模（<10小时）无标签训练集，并将Zero Resources Challenge的ABX评估指标适配到各口音。文中用自适应域归一化微调预训练CPC模型作为基线，在跨说话人ABX分数上平均获得23.6%的相对提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管表示学习作为预训练方法在下游任务和无人监督语音建模中表现良好，但对其如何处理域外语音以及如何在少样本条件下适应新领域的了解甚少。这对于口音语音尤其重要，因为口音存在长尾分布且偏离标准口音。
AI.method: 构建ABX-Accent基准：基于AESRC数据集的10种英语口音，提供各口音<10小时的无标签训练集，并适配Zero Resources Challenge的ABX评估指标。基线方法使用自适应域归一化（adaptive domain normalization）微调预训练的对比预测编码（CPC）模型，先在LibriSpeech上用男性/女性划分开发，再应用到新基准。
AI.result: 在ABX-Accent基准上，所提出的自适应域归一化方法相比未适配模型，在跨说话人ABX分数上平均获得23.6%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: ABX-Accent提供了一个可复现的口音域适应评估基准，且自适适应域归一化方法在少样本口音适应上表现出显著效果。数据和指标将在论文接收后开源。

title: Discovering Relationships in Data Lakes Using Large Language Models: An Industrial Case
summary: Data lakes rely on metadata to remain usable, yet this meta data is often limited or weakly informative for column relationship discovery, especially in ERP-derived datasets with coded or abbreviated schema labels. We propose ColRel, a two-stage method that builds column embeddings from metadata and data available at ingestion time. In difficult cases, such as coded schemata, business dictionaries help better interpret column names and support the generation of short natural-language descriptions used in the second stage. Experiments on public benchmarks and an industrial ERP dataset show that ColRel is particularly effective in semantically related, weak-signal settings.

AI.tldr: ColRel是一个两阶段方法，通过构建列嵌入来发现数据湖中的列关系。它利用摄入时的元数据和数据生成嵌入，在编码或缩写模式标签（如ERP数据集）中，借助业务词典解释列名并生成短自然语言描述以提高效果。实验表明该方法在语义相关、弱信号场景下尤为有效。
AI.motivation: 数据湖依赖元数据保持可用性，但元数据往往有限或信息量不足，尤其在ERP派生的数据集中，模式标签常为编码或缩写形式，导致列关系发现变得困难。
AI.method: ColRel采用两阶段方法：第一阶段从摄入时的元数据和数据构建列嵌入；第二阶段在困难案例（如编码模式）中，利用业务词典更好地解释列名并生成简短的自然语言描述，用于增强嵌入学习。
AI.result: 在公开基准测试和工业ERP数据集上的实验表明，ColRel在语义相关、弱信号设置下特别有效。
AI.conclusion: ColRel通过结合业务词典和自然语言描述，能够有效缓解元数据信息不足的问题，提升数据湖中列关系发现的能力，尤其在编码或缩写模式标签的ERP场景下表现出显著优势。

title: Vowel Signs Are Not Letters: A Pre-tokenization Ceiling on Multilingual Tokenizer Fertility
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 12 tables. Code, tokenizer and reproduction harness: https://github.com/sajalregmi/arkios-tokenizer and https://huggingface.co/sajalregmi4/arkios-tokenizer
summary: Byte-level BPE tokenizers that use the HuggingFace ByteLevel pre-tokenizer inherit GPT-2's word regex, where a word is defined as \p{L}+, one or more Unicode letters. In abugida scripts, vowels are written as combining marks; this pattern therefore splits each word at every vowel sign. Since BPE merges only within a pre-token, those splits persist through training regardless of vocabulary size or corpus composition. We formalise this effect as a training-free lower bound on fertility. Across 26 languages from a parallel corpus, every one of the 17 abugidas is affected, ranging from 1.47x (Tibetan) to 9.02x (Thai), whereas Latin, Cyrillic, Hangul, and Han show exactly 1.00x. For 5 languages, matched tokenizer pairs that differ only in this character class fall within 2.2% of the predicted floor, scoring 4.78 versus 1.58 tokens per word on Nepali. When the Nepali share of the training corpus is swept from 5% to 95%, the broken tokenizer barely shifts at all (1.7%) while the fixed one shifts 33.9%, which separates a structural ceiling from a data shortage without needing to inspect any code. We train three 268M models that differ only in their tokenizer; the fixed variant achieves 4.43% lower held-out Nepali bits per byte at equal compute, and it still leads when given the same bytes with 1.59x the compute. A census of 3,479 HuggingFace repositories finds the letters-only word class present in 63.3% of the most-downloaded text-generation models, accounting for 72.5% of their downloads. GPT-4o's o200k pattern already uses a mark-aware word class, making the repair itself prior art. We quantify its value, show how to recognise its absence from symptoms alone, map which scripts it reaches, measure how widely it is deployed, and release a 65,536-entry Nepali-English tokenizer with a harness that regenerates every number here from public data on a laptop.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了HuggingFace ByteLevel预分词器继承GPT-2的正则表达式（仅匹配Unicode字母\p{L}+）对音节文字（abugida）分词的影响。由于音节文字元音以组合标记形式书写，该模式会在每个元音处分割单词，且BPE只能在预分词单元内合并，导致这种分割在训练中持续存在。作者将其形式化为无训练的生育率（fertility）下界，在26种语言的平行语料中，17种音节文字全部受影响（1.47x至9.02x），而拉丁、西里尔、韩文和汉字精确为1.00x。通过匹配分词器对、语料比例扫描、268M模型训练对比以及3,479个HuggingFace仓库普查，量化了该问题的价值，并发现GPT-4o的o200k模式已使用mark-aware词类（作为先有技术），最终发布了65,536条目的尼泊尔语-英语分词器及可复现的评测工具。
AI.motivation: 字节级BPE分词器广泛采用GPT-2的\p{L}+词正则表达式，该模式不识别音节文字（abugida）中表示元音的组合标记，导致每个音节的元音符号处被强制分词。这种分词错误在BPE训练中无法被修复（因为BPE只在预分词单元内合并），即使增大词汇量或改变语料组成也无济于事。作者希望形式化并量化这一系统性缺陷的影响范围、严重程度及其在业界模型中的部署情况。
AI.method: 1) 将分词器缺陷形式化为训练无关的生育率（fertility）下界数学表达式；2) 利用26种语言平行语料测量17种音节文字的生育率放大倍数；3) 构造仅词类不同的匹配分词器对进行对照实验；4) 对尼泊尔语语料比例从5%到95%进行扫描，区分结构性瓶颈与数据不足；5) 训练三个仅分词器不同的268M参数模型，比较held-out尼泊尔语的bits per byte；6) 对3,479个HuggingFace仓库进行分词器词类普查；7) GPT-4o的o200k模式被确认为mark-aware的修复先有技术。
AI.result: 17个音节文字全部受影响，生育率放大1.47x（藏语）至9.02x（泰语），拉丁、西里尔、韩文、汉字为1.00x。匹配分词器对的差异在预测下界2.2%以内（尼泊尔语4.78 vs 1.58 tokens/word）。语料比例扫描显示缺陷分词器仅漂移1.7%而修复版漂移33.9%。268M模型上修复分词器在等计算下降低了4.43%的尼泊尔语held-out bits per byte，且在用1.59x计算时仍然领先。63.3%的最流行文本生成模型（占72.5%下载量）使用letters-only词类。GPT-4o的o200k已使用mark-aware词类。
AI.conclusion: 字节级BPE中\p{L}+词正则对音节文字构成系统性且不可通过训练修复的分词缺陷，影响17种语言、数十亿下载量的模型。修复方法简单（使用mark-aware词类），且已有GPT-4o的先有实现。作者提供了量化评估框架、部署情况及一个可复现的尼泊尔语-英语分词器工具。

title: Per-View Gaussian Predictions Enable Training-Free Distractor Filtering in Feed-Forward 3DGS
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting reconstructs an explicit Gaussian representation from multiple input images in one network execution, making 3D reconstruction increasingly accessible for casual captures. However, such captures frequently contain transient objects that appear in only a subset of the views. Such content can be encoded into the per-view Gaussians associated with the inputs that observe it and remain in the combined representation despite being observed by no other input. As a result, it may produce blurred, duplicated, or floating artifacts in novel views. We introduce a training-free filtering procedure that exploits this per-view prediction structure. For each input, we exclude its associated Gaussians and render the same camera using the remaining representation, revealing content that is inconsistent with the other inputs. Feature similarity forms candidate regions, and rendering-based verification retains only candidates whose removal reduces reconstruction error in the other input views. The procedure operates on a single frozen prediction without retraining or scene-specific optimization. Across three reconstruction models and two distractor benchmarks, it consistently improves novel-view quality with varying numbers of input views. On clean scenes, evaluations across four models show that the original reconstructions are largely preserved.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无需训练的高斯溅射过滤方法，通过逐视图排除自身高斯并用剩余表示重渲染来检测和移除瞬态物体，提升新视图质量的同时不破坏干净场景。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D高斯溅射（Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting）在单次网络执行中从多张输入图像重建显式高斯表示，使3D重建变得易于获取。然而，日常拍摄中常包含仅出现在部分视图中的瞬态物体，这些内容会被编码进与观察它们的输入相关的逐视图高斯中，即使没有其他输入观察到它们也会保留在组合表示中，从而在新视图中产生模糊、重复或漂浮的伪影。
AI.method: 提出一种训练无关的过滤流程：对每个输入，排除其关联的高斯，用剩余表示渲染同一相机视角，揭示与其他输入不一致的内容。利用特征相似性形成候选区域，渲染验证仅保留移除后能降低其他输入视图重建误差的候选。整个过程在单个冻结预测上运行，无需重新训练或场景特定优化。
AI.result: 在三个重建模型和两个干扰物基准上，该方法在不同数量输入视图下均一致提升新视图质量。在干净场景上，四个模型的评估表明原始重建结构基本被保留。
AI.conclusion: 该训练无关的过滤方法能够有效利用逐视图预测结构，移除瞬态物体引起的不一致高斯，从而在无需额外训练的情况下提升新视图渲染质量，同时保持干净场景的原始重建效果。

title: Disentangling Optimization Scale from Preference Scale in DPO
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) is a widely used objective for aligning language models from preference data, with the coefficient $β$ commonly interpreted as controlling the KL constraint to a reference policy. We show that $β$ entangles two distinct roles: it governs the effective inverse preference-noise scale and simultaneously rescales the optimization dynamics, coupling this scale with the effective step size. As a consequence, at a fixed learning rate the achieved policy deviation is non-monotone in $β$: it vanishes in a dead zone at small $β$, reaches a peak at an intermediate value, and decreases again for larger $β$. Moreover, standard DPO loss values are not comparable across $β$: runs with nearly identical loss curves can differ several-fold in KL divergence from the reference model. This entanglement obscures the role of $β$, increases sensitivity to hyperparameter choices, and complicates learning-rate scheduling. We propose a centered-softplus reformulation that is argmin-equivalent to DPO for $β>0$, while making the inverse preference-noise-scale and learning-rate effects explicit and independently tunable. The normalized centered-softplus objective also admits a continuous $β\to0$ endpoint that reduces to a linear preference-margin objective.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示DPO中的超参数β同时充当逆偏好噪声尺度和优化动力学缩放因子，二者纠缠导致策略偏差随β非单调变化、不同β间的loss不可比等问题。作者提出centered-softplus重表述，将两者解耦并独立可调，且β→0时退化为线性偏好边际目标。
AI.motivation: DPO中β被简单理解为控制KL约束的系数，但作者发现β实际上纠缠了两个不同角色：逆偏好噪声尺度和优化动力学缩放（有效步长）。这种纠缠导致策略偏差在固定学习率下随β非单调变化、loss不可比、对超参数敏感且学习率调度复杂化，掩盖了β的真实作用。
AI.method: 提出centered-softplus重表述：该目标在β>0时与DPO argmin等价，但将逆偏好噪声尺度与学习率效应显式分离并独立调节。归一化后的目标在β→0时存在连续极限，退化为线性偏好边际目标。
AI.result: 证明在固定学习率下，策略偏差随β呈非单调变化（小β死区、中间峰值、大β衰减）；标准DPO loss在不同β间不可比较，近乎相同的loss曲线可能对应数倍不同的KL偏差；centered-softplus成功解耦两个角色并支持独立调参。
AI.conclusion: DPO的β纠缠问题需要新的重表述来解耦，centered-softplus提供了可行方案，使逆偏好噪声尺度和学习率效应可独立控制，并自然衔接β→0的极限行为。

title: DEEPCHART: How Far are LLMs from Faithful Data-Science Chart Generation?
summary: Faithful chart generation in real-world data-science workflows requires grounding visualizations in scattered evidence, computing chart-ready quantities, and rendering them accurately. Modern LLMs can produce visually plausible, instruction-compliant charts, yet data-level hallucinations remain difficult to detect in long, noisy, and multimodal contexts. To measure this gap, we introduce DEEPCHART, an expert-annotated benchmark of 1,482 task-conditioned chart-generation instances drawn from real-world scientific papers, financial filings, and ecosystem reports. DEEPCHART formulates chart generation as an Extract--Reason--Visualize pipeline and evaluates source-data extraction, derived-data reasoning, and chart rendering stage by stage. Experiments with state-of-the-art models show that visually plausible charts often conceal data-level hallucinations, with extraction and reasoning errors common in realistic long and multimodal settings. These findings suggest that larger context windows alone are insufficient; faithful chart generation also requires reliable evidence extraction and quantitative reasoning before rendering. Our benchmark and associated resources are available at https://github.com/tangdouer1005/DeepChart.

AI.tldr: 提出了DEEPCHART基准，包含1,482个来自真实论文、金融文件及生态报告的任务条件化图表生成实例，将图表生成分解为提取-推理-可视化三阶段并逐阶段评估，发现可视化上看似合理的图表常隐藏数据级幻觉。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM能够生成视觉上合理且遵循指令的图表，但在长、嘈杂和多模态上下文中，数据级幻觉难以检测，现有研究缺乏对这一差距的系统性度量。
AI.method: 构建专家注释的DEEPCHART基准，包含1,482个任务条件化图表生成实例，来源涵盖科学论文、金融申报文件和生态系统报告；将图表生成形式化为Extract-Reason-Visualize流水线，并在源数据提取、派生数据推理和图表渲染三个阶段分别评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，最先进模型生成的视觉上合理的图表往往掩盖了数据级幻觉，在真实长文本和多模态场景中，提取和推理错误很常见。
AI.conclusion: 仅扩大上下文窗口不足以实现忠实的图表生成，可靠的证据提取和定量推理也是渲染之前的关键前提。

title: Compositional Generalization via Structural Identification in a Category-Theoretic Framework
summary: Compositional generalization is usually evaluated through model accuracy. We instead ask which structural or lexical identifications make held-out COGS examples admissible from the structures observed in training. Sentences are represented as functors from syntactic addresses to lexical tokens, and selective collapses induce Kan extensions that propagate observed associations. Across 21 COGS generalization types, admissibility follows distinct identification profiles, while residual failures separate unsupported structural templates. These data-side diagnoses characterize what the training corpus licenses under specified identifications, without training a predictive model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种不依赖模型训练的数据侧诊断方法，通过将句子表示为从句法地址到词汇标记的函子，并利用选择性坍缩诱导的Kan延拓来评估COGS组合泛化测试样本的可容许性，从而从结构和词汇识别角度分析训练语料库所支持的内容。
AI.motivation: 传统的组合泛化评估仅关注模型准确率，缺乏对训练语料本身所蕴含的结构和词汇约束的理解。作者希望回答一个问题：在给定训练结构中，哪些结构和词汇等同关系使得COGS的留出样本在数学上可被许可，从而深入理解泛化任务的数据侧本质。
AI.method: 将句子表示为从句法地址到词汇标记的函子（functors），通过选择性坍缩（selective collapses）来诱导Kan延拓（Kan extensions），从而传播训练中观察到的关联。该方法对COGS的21种泛化类型逐一分析，无需训练任何预测模型。
AI.result: 在21种COGS泛化类型中，可容许性遵循不同的识别（identification）轮廓，而残余失败则分离出不受支持的结构模板。这些数据侧诊断刻画了在特定识别条件下训练语料库所许可的内容。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种纯数据侧的分析框架，无需模型训练即可从结构识别角度预判哪些组合泛化任务能被训练语料支持，为理解组合泛化的根本限制提供了新的理论工具。

title: RubricRM: Generative Reward Modeling via Dynamic Rubrics for Image Generation and Editing
summary: Reward models play an essential role in aligning visual generative models, yet most existing visual reward models use a single scalar score or rely on fixed criteria that cannot adapt to different instructions. This limits both interpretability and task sensitivity, especially for text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing, where different inputs require different evaluation dimensions. We propose RubricRM, a pairwise generative reward modeling framework that first produces an input-specific rubric with evaluation dimensions, weights, and scoring criteria, and then applies the rubric to score candidate images. We train dedicated RubricRM models for text-to-image generation and image editing using a two-stage training pipeline: supervised fine-tuning teaches the model the rubric-based scoring paradigm, while GRPO further improves scoring through fine-grained dimension-level rewards. Experiments on multiple generation and editing benchmarks show that RubricRM outperforms existing specialized reward models and remains competitive with strong proprietary MLLM judges despite using smaller backbones. Our models, data, and code are available at https://github.com/zijiankan/RubricRM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RubricRM，一个针对视觉生成模型的成对生成式奖励建模框架。它首先为每个输入生成包含评估维度、权重和评分标准的具体rubric，再据此对候选图像打分。通过两阶段训练（SFT教范式、GRPO提升维度级奖励），RubricRM在文生图和图像编辑基准上超越了现有专用奖励模型，并使用更小的骨干网络与强大的专有MLLM评判器表现相当。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉奖励模型大多使用单一标量分数或固定标准，无法按指令自适应调整评估维度，导致可解释性和任务灵敏度不足。尤其在文生图和指令式图像编辑场景中，不同输入需要不同的评估维度，单一固定标准难以满足需求。
AI.method: RubricRM采用成对生成式奖励建模框架：首先为每个输入生成包含评估维度、权重和评分标准的rubric，然后基于该rubric对候选图像进行评分。训练采用两阶段流程：监督微调（SFT）用于教授基于rubric的评分范式，之后GRPO（组相对策略优化）通过细粒度维度级奖励进一步提升评分能力。分别针对文生图和图像编辑训练了专用模型。
AI.result: 在多个文生图和图像编辑基准上的实验表明，RubricRM超越了现有的专用奖励模型，并且在使用更小骨干网络的情况下，与强专有MLLM评判器相比保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: RubricRM通过输入自适应rubric解决了现有视觉奖励模型固定标准的问题，在性能和可解释性上均取得了显著提升，验证了生成式rubric奖励建模在视觉生成对齐中的有效性。

title: Categorizer Automata for Discounted-Sum Payoffs
summary: Categorizing continuous data into discrete bins is a fundamental operation in artificial intelligence. We introduce the categorizer automaton, a deterministic automaton that reads an infinite sequence of rewards and identifies which of finitely many bins contains its discounted sum. Categorizer automata generalize comparator automata, the special case of two bins, which have already proven useful in quantitative synthesis. Our main technical contribution is the construction of a categorizer automaton whose state space is linear in the number of bins, rather than exponential as obtained by a cross-product of comparator automata. We then apply categorizer automata to Markov decision processes, where they allow one to synthesize policies that maximize the expected utility of a discounted-sum payoff for utility functions that may be discontinuous. For piecewise-constant utility functions, the resulting algorithm is exact and runs in pseudo-polynomial time. For piecewise-Lipschitz utility functions, a class that includes any utility with bounded slope between finitely many jumps, it again runs in pseudo-polynomial time and yields an $\varepsilon$-optimal policy. We also show that the synthesis problem considered is PSPACE-hard already for piecewise-constant utilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"分类器自动机"（categorizer automaton）的确定性自动机，用于读取无限奖励序列并判断其贴现和落入哪个有限区间。该自动机的状态空间与区间数成线性关系（而非通过比较器自动机叉积得到的指数关系），并将其应用于马尔可夫决策过程，以实现对分段常数和分段Lipschitz效用函数的策略综合，算法具有伪多项式时间复杂度。
AI.motivation: 将连续数据分类为离散区间是人工智能中的基础操作。现有的比较器自动机（仅有两个区间的特例）已在定量综合中展现出价值，但将其推广到多个区间时，简单的叉积构造会导致状态空间指数爆炸。此外，马尔可夫决策过程中需要合成最大化不连续效用函数期望值的策略，这需要一种更高效的自动机结构来解决。
AI.method: 本文提出分类器自动机，它是比较器自动机的多区间推广。主要技术贡献是构造了一种状态空间与区间数成线性关系的分类器自动机，避免了通过比较器自动机叉积得到的指数级状态空间。该自动机被应用于马尔可夫决策过程的策略综合，针对分段常数效用函数给出精确的伪多项式时间算法，针对分段Lipschitz效用函数给出ε-最优的伪多项式时间算法。
AI.result: 分类器自动机的状态空间与区间数成线性关系。将其应用于马尔可夫决策过程后：对于分段常数效用函数，算法精确且运行时间为伪多项式；对于分段Lipschitz效用函数（包括任意有界斜率且有限跳跃的效用函数），同样在伪多项式时间内生成ε-最优策略。此外，证明了即使对分段常数效用函数，该综合问题也是PSPACE难的。
AI.conclusion: 分类器自动机为多区间量化合成提供了一种状态空间高效的表示方法，显著优于比较器自动机的叉积构造。它为马尔可夫决策过程中不连续效用函数下的策略综合提供了首个实用的算法框架，同时PSPACE-hard界表明该问题在本质上具有计算复杂性。

title: Sycophancy Suppression Can Impair Rational Updating: Anti-Sycophancy Should Preserve the Ability to Update
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Findings. Code and data: https://github.com/dependentsign/sycophancy-rational-updating
summary: Large language models often exhibit sycophancy, revising their answers to align with users when users push back. Such answer flips, however, can arise from different causes. One possibility is that the model simply aligns with the user's feedback in order to satisfy them. Another is that the feedback genuinely contains useful evidence, prompting the model to update its answer in a rational way. We distinguish them as Unsupported-Yielding and Rational-Updating. Prior work focuses primarily on suppressing Unsupported-Yielding, while overlooking its effect on Rational-Updating. We address this gap with a two-turn evaluation framework that measures the two behaviors separately. Across representative training-time and inference-time interventions, we find that anti-sycophancy methods often encounter a trade-off in which reducing Unsupported-Yielding can sacrifice Rational-Updating, and vice versa, even when the two objectives are optimized jointly. Mechanistic analysis suggests that the two behaviors share an internal substrate: the MLP neurons and attention heads driving them overlap substantially, and their associated steering directions are positively aligned. We further conduct a preliminary orthogonalized steering exploration, which yields modest, backbone-dependent selectivity gains. Overall, our results suggest that anti-sycophancy should be treated not as a simple suppression problem, but as a selectivity problem, where effective interventions should preserve Rational-Updating while reducing Unsupported-Yielding.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了大语言模型中的谄媚行为（sycophancy），将其区分为"无依据让步"（Unsupported-Yielding）和"理性更新"（Rational-Updating）两种机制，并通过两轮评估框架发现反谄媚方法在这两者之间存在权衡，需要在抑制前者时保留后者。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要聚焦于抑制大语言模型的"无依据让步"（模型仅因用户反驳而改变答案），而忽视了用户反馈中可能包含有效信息时应有的"理性更新"。这种二元对立视角使得反谄媚方法可能误伤模型的合理推理能力，需对两种行为进行区分研究。
AI.method: 提出一个两轮评估框架（two-turn evaluation framework），分别测量Unsupported-Yielding和Rational-Updating两个行为；对多种训练时（training-time）和推理时（inference-time）干预方法进行评测；通过机制分析（MLP神经元和注意力头的重叠、转向方向对齐）揭示两种行为共享内部神经基础；并进行初级的正交化转向（orthogonalized steering）探索。
AI.result: 发现反谄媚方法普遍面临权衡困境：降低Unsupported-Yielding往往会损害Rational-Updating，反之亦然，即使联合优化两个目标时也难以避免。机制分析表明两种行为共享大量MLP神经元和注意力头，对应的转向方向呈正对齐。正交化转向探索仅获得适度且依赖骨干网络的区分性收益。
AI.conclusion: 反谄媚不应被视为简单的抑制问题，而应被重新定义为选择性（selectivity）问题——有效的干预应在降低Unsupported-Yielding的同时保留Rational-Updating，即模型应具备判断何时该坚持、何时该更新的能力。

title: Geo-LoRA: Geometry-Aware Subspace Evolution for Low-Rank Adaptation in Continual Learning
summary: Rehearsal-free class-incremental learning (CIL) with LoRA adapters remains challenging because the low-rank subspaces updated across tasks evolve without geometric control, causing unstable shared representations and repetitive collapse of task-specific updates into previously occupied directions. We introduce Geo-LoRA, a geometry-aware framework that explicitly regulates how low-rank subspaces, both shared and task-specific, evolve during continual learning. For the shared branch, Subspace Projection Preservation (SPP) constrains consecutive updates to follow smooth trajectories on the Grassmann manifold, and Adaptive Core-Slack Alignment (ACSA) decomposes transitions into principal and residual components, aligning the former while modulating the latter to balance stability and plasticity. For the task-specific branch, Median-Calibrated Block Overlap (MCBO) imposes a statistical constraint via normalized projection overlap, penalizing excessive reuse to mitigate subspace crowding. These constraints jointly regulate the evolution of all LoRA subspaces across layers and tasks without introducing additional adapter types beyond standard LoRA. Geo-LoRA provides a principled geometric formulation for continual low-rank adaptation and consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmark datasets and different task lengths.

AI.tldr: Geo-LoRA是一个几何感知的无重放类增量学习框架，通过Grassmann流形上的子空间演化约束和统计投影重叠惩罚，联合调控共享与任务特定的LoRA低秩子空间，在多个基准数据集和任务长度上达到最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 无重放类增量学习(CIL)结合LoRA适配器仍具挑战性，因为跨任务更新的低秩子空间缺乏几何控制，导致共享表示不稳定，且任务特定更新会重复坍缩到先前占据的方向上。
AI.method: Geo-LoRA包含三个核心组件：(1) 共享分支中，子空间投影保持(SPP)在Grassmann流形上约束连续更新沿平滑轨迹演化；(2) 自适应核心-松弛对齐(ACSA)将过渡分解为主成分和残差成分，对齐前者并调节后者以平衡稳定性与可塑性；(3) 任务特定分支中，中位数校准块重叠(MCBO)通过归一化投影重叠施加统计约束，惩罚过度复用以缓解子空间拥挤。
AI.result: Geo-LoRA在多个基准数据集和不同任务长度上一致实现最先进的性能，且无需引入标准LoRA之外的额外适配器类型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为持续低秩自适应提供了原则性的几何形式化框架，证明了对所有LoRA子空间跨层和跨任务演化的联合调控是有效的。

title: Soft Active Electromyography Interface for Machine Learning-Enabled Silent Speech Recognition
summary: Silent speech recognition (SSR) provides an alternative communication pathway in the absence of audible speech. However, conventional approaches are limited by the need for constant facial attachment, privacy concerns, and unstable signal acquisition. Here, we propose a soft, active electromyography (EMG) interface that enables word-level SSR using machine learning. Worn on the hand, the device uses a fingertip electrode that can be positioned near the lips to acquire EMG signals only when needed. The interface integrates liquid metal (LM) interconnects, transparent flexible printed circuit (FPC) electrodes, and elastomer encapsulation to ensure high mechanical stability during finger motion. A deep neural network trained on these stable signals achieved a mean accuracy of 97.2 $\pm$ 1.3% across three subjects in classifying a 30-word vocabulary, demonstrating robust linguistic discrimination. Furthermore, real-time drone control validates the practicality of this approach in noisy and privacy-sensitive environments where conventional voice recognition fails. This study highlights the potential of soft, wearable EMG systems as secure and intuitive human-machine interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种柔软的、主动式肌电（EMG）手部穿戴界面，通过指尖电极在需要时靠近嘴唇采集EMG信号，结合液态金属互连、透明柔性电路板电极和弹性体封装，实现词级无声语音识别（SSR）。深度神经网络在30词词汇表上达到了97.2±1.3%的平均分类准确率，并通过实时无人机控制验证了其在嘈杂和隐私敏感环境中的实用性。
AI.motivation: 传统无声语音识别方法受限于需要持续面部佩戴设备、存在隐私问题以及信号采集不稳定等缺陷，亟需一种可穿戴的、按需采集信号且稳定可靠的替代方案。
AI.method: 设计了一个柔软的主动EMG手部界面，采用指尖电极（可按需移至唇部附近进行信号采集），集成液态金属互连、透明柔性电路板电极和弹性体封装以保证手指运动时的机械稳定性；利用深度神经网络对采集的稳定EMG信号进行30词汇分类训练。
AI.result: 在三名受试者上对30词词汇表分类的平均准确率达到97.2±1.3%；实时无人机控制实验验证了该方法在嘈杂和隐私敏感环境中的实际可行性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了柔软可穿戴EMG系统作为安全、直观的人机界面的巨大潜力，为无声语音识别提供了一种无需持续面部佩戴、保护隐私且信号稳定的新途径。

title: AI Control Scientist: LLM-driven Agentic System for Automated Control Design
summary: Control system design is critical for modern industry, such as chemical process temperature regulation and aero-engine control. However,traditional control design workflows rely heavily on expert knowledge and extensive manual parameter tuning, resulting in limited efficiency and scalability. To this end, this paper proposes AI Control Scientist (AICS), the first large language model (LLM)-driven agent capable of automatically generating optimized controller from language design requirements. Specifically, a Task Modeling Agent interprets user requirements to engineering constraints; a Controller Design Agent generate candidate controller structures and executable code; and a Parameter Tuning Agent refine controller parameters under closed-loop performance criteria. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed agentic system can automatically generate multiple representative control systems, outperforms existing automated baselines in both design success rate and optimization efficiency. This work has the potential to transform control system design from human-driven to agent-driven, paving the way for model predictive control and other advanced control systems design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI Control Scientist (AICS)，一个由大语言模型驱动的智能体系统，能够从语言设计需求中自动生成优化的控制器，将控制系统设计从人工驱动转变为智能体驱动。
AI.motivation: 传统的控制系统设计工作流高度依赖专家知识和大量手动参数调优，效率和可扩展性受限，亟需自动化解决方案。
AI.method: AICS由三个智能体组件构成：任务建模智能体将用户需求解释为工程约束，控制器设计智能体生成候选控制器结构和可执行代码，参数调优智能体在闭环性能准则下优化控制器参数。
AI.result: 实验表明该系统能够自动生成多种代表性控制系统，在设计成功率和优化效率上均优于现有的自动化基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作有潜力将控制系统设计从人工驱动转变为智能体驱动，为模型预测控制及其他先进控制系统设计铺平道路。

title: Multi-Expert Conformal Risk Control for Pairwise LLM Judging in Open-Ended Dialogue
summary: In this paper, we explore multi-expert Conformal Risk Control (CRC) algorithms for pairwise LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation in open-ended dialogue. Our core insight is that multi-expert aggregation offers a complementary remedy to CRC: whereas CRC controls risk at the decision threshold through abstention, aggregation sanitizes the scoring function at its source. Guided by this, we first design two multi-expert CRC methods: Score Averaging and Decision Voting, which aggregate at the score and decision levels, respectively. While both strategies outperform single-expert methods on homogeneous expert panels, on heterogeneous LLM judges they remain risk-valid but recover only limited coverage, because a uniform threshold cannot match the experts' distinct scoring scales. To resolve this issue, we further propose Marginal-Calibrated Conformal Consensus (MC3): it captures distinct per-expert scales via initial threshold ratios, while jointly tuning a unified decision function $C_t(x)$ applied identically in both calibration and test, thereby preserving exchangeability. To evaluate our framework, we construct Panel, a 1,800-pair human pairwise-preference benchmark for open-ended dialogue. It is built on responses generated by four open-weight LLMs over dialogue contexts from three domains (ESConv, MSC, DREAM), with full logit access. In experiments, we find that both Score Averaging and Decision Voting substantially improve accuracy and acceptance rate on homogeneous panels. Notably, MC3 extends these gains to heterogeneous panels by accommodating distinct per-expert scoring scales across all three datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多专家Conformal Risk Control（CRC）算法用于LLM-as-a-Judge的成对评估，通过多专家聚合与CRC互补解决风险控制与覆盖率问题。设计了Score Averaging和Decision Voting两种方法，并提出Marginal-Calibrated Conformal Consensus（MC3）解决异质专家评分尺度不一致的问题。构建了包含1800对人类偏好对的Panel基准数据集，实验表明所提方法在同质和异质专家面板上均显著提升准确率和接受率。
AI.motivation: 现有CRC方法仅通过决策阈值处的弃权机制控制风险，但无法从源头改善评分函数本身的质量。作者的核心洞见在于多专家聚合与CRC是互补的：聚合可以从评分源头"净化"评分函数，而CRC控制决策层风险。然而，当面对异质LLM评审者时，统一阈值无法适配不同专家的评分尺度，导致覆盖率受限。
AI.method: 首先提出两种多专家CRC方法：Score Averaging（在分数层面聚合）和Decision Voting（在决策层面聚合）。在此基础上提出MC3方法，通过初始阈值比例捕获每个专家的独立评分尺度，同时联合调整一个统一的决策函数C_t(x)在校准和测试阶段一致应用，从而保持可交换性。同时构建了Panel基准数据集，包含1800对人类偏好对，基于四个开放权重LLM在三个领域（ESConv、MSC、DREAM）的对话上下文生成的响应构建。
AI.result: 在同质专家面板上，Score Averaging和Decision Voting相比单专家方法显著提升了准确率和接受率。MC3在异质专家面板上通过适配不同专家的评分尺度，在全部三个数据集上都扩展了这些收益，同时保持风险有效性（risk-valid）。
AI.conclusion: 多专家聚合策略与CRC互补，能够从源头上改善LLM-as-a-Judge评估质量；MC3通过逐专家校准机制有效解决了异质专家评分尺度差异问题，为多LLM评审场景提供了更可靠的风险控制评估框架。

title: TempJail: Temporal Jailbreak Attacks against Image-to-Video Generation Models
summary: In recent years, image-to-video (I2V) generation models have made remarkable progress in subject consistency and temporal coherence, enabling high quality video synthesis. However, these advances also introduce new safety risks. Existing studies mainly focus on jailbreak attacks involving single frame violations, while largely overlooking the temporal dimension unique to video generation models. In this paper, we investigate three attack scenarios and uncover a temporal vulnerability in I2V systems: unsafe semantics may emerge not from a single frame, but from semantic composition over time. We further identify two key challenges in such attacks: temporal abstraction and semantic camouflage. To address these issues, we propose TempJail, a novel temporal jailbreak framework for I2V systems. For temporal abstraction, we decompose a target malicious caption into an initial frame visual condition and a temporal text instruction. For semantic camouflage, on the image side we model semantic injection as controlled latent perturbation in diffusion sampling and introduce gradient guidance from pretrained encoders. On the text side, we rewrite the caption into an innocuous ``subject-action-scene'' template that bypasses safety filters while preserving temporal guidance. In the black-box inference phase, these two modalities jointly enable malicious semantics to be gradually triggered over time. Experiments on closed-source commercial models, including Kling, Seedance, Veo and PixVerse, show that TempJail improves attack success rate over prior state-of-the-art methods by 23.3\% under GPT-5.2 evaluation and 22.0\% under human evaluation. Our codes are available at \href{https://github.com/luqi-glory/TempJail}{GitHub}.

AI.tldr: TempJail是一个针对图像到视频（I2V）生成模型的时序越狱攻击框架。与传统仅关注单帧违规的方法不同，TempJail利用I2V系统的时间维度漏洞，通过时间抽象（将恶意字幕分解为初始帧条件和时间文本指令）和语义伪装（图像侧使用潜在扰动和梯度引导，文本侧重写为无害的"主体-动作-场景"模板）实现恶意语义随时间逐步触发。在Kling、Seedance、Veo和PixVerse等闭源商业模型上，相比已有最先进方法，攻击成功率提升23.3%（GPT评估）和22.0%（人工评估）。
AI.motivation: 随着I2V生成模型在主体一致性和时间一致性方面取得显著进步，安全性风险随之增加。已有研究主要关注涉及单帧违规的越狱攻击，而忽视了视频生成模型所特有的时间维度。作者发现I2V系统存在时间漏洞：不安全语义可能并非来自单帧，而是来自随时间累积的语义组合。此外，此类攻击面临两个关键挑战：时间抽象（如何将恶意内容在时间维度上分解）和语义伪装（如何使各组成部分分别通过安全过滤器）。
AI.method: TempJail框架包含两个核心组件：（1）时间抽象：将目标恶意字幕分解为初始帧的视觉条件和随时间展开的时间文本指令；（2）语义伪装：在图像侧，将语义注入建模为扩散采样过程中的受控潜在扰动，并引入预训练编码器的梯度引导；在文本侧，将字幕重写为无害的"主体-动作-场景"模板，既能绕过安全过滤器又保留时间引导。在黑盒推理阶段，两个模态协同使恶意语义随时间逐步触发。
AI.result: 在闭源商业模型（Kling、Seedance、Veo和PixVerse）上的实验表明，TempJail相比先前最先进方法，在GPT评估下攻击成功率提升23.3%，在人工评估下提升22.0%。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了I2V生成模型在时间维度上的独特安全漏洞，证明不安全语义可以绕过单帧检测而通过跨时间的语义组合表现出来。TempJail通过时间抽象和语义伪装两个策略有效利用了这一漏洞，为I2V系统安全评估提供了新的视角和攻击基准。

title: Unifying Detection and Adaptation in Task-Free Continual Learning
summary: To mitigate catastrophic forgetting in downstream continual learning (CL) for large language models (LLMs), existing methods typically constrain parameter updates or introduce task-specific adaptation modules. However, these methods often rely on explicit task boundaries during training, limiting their applicability to realistic task-free scenarios. In this paper, we propose a \textbf{Fi}sher-guided \textbf{uni}fied (\textbf{FiUni}) framework for batch-level task detection and parameter-efficient continual adaptation. FiUni is motivated by a key observation about the Fisher information matrix (FIM) of pre-trained models: the orthogonality among the principal subspaces of its Kronecker-Factored Approximate Curvature (K-FAC) approximation, estimated from a small number of downstream task samples, can reflect the similarity between different tasks. Based on this observation, FiUni constructs FIM-derived frozen subspaces to guide low-rank adaptation (LoRA), while matching the Fisher principal subspace of each incoming batch window with historical subspaces. This enables FiUni to adaptively determine whether to reuse existing knowledge, expand a related subspace, or create a new subspace, dynamically balancing knowledge sharing and task isolation. Experiments show that FiUni can effectively infer latent batch-level task affiliations and achieve competitive performance against advanced task-aware CL methods with fewer trainable parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出FiUni框架，利用Fisher信息矩阵的K-FAC近似主子空间正交性进行批量级别的任务检测和参数高效的持续学习，无需显式任务边界。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型持续学习（CL）方法通常依赖显式任务边界进行训练，但在现实无任务（task-free）场景中任务边界不可得，这严重限制了方法的实用性。因此需要一种能在无任务边界情况下自动检测任务并进行参数高效适应的框架。
AI.method: FiUni框架包含两个核心组件：(1) 基于Fisher信息矩阵（FIM）的K-FAC近似，从少量下游任务样本估计主子空间，利用不同任务间主子空间的正交性来反映任务相似度；(2) 构建FIM派生的冻结子空间引导低秩适应（LoRA），同时将每个输入批次窗口的Fisher主子空间与历史子空间匹配，自适应决策复用已有知识、扩展相关子空间或创建新子空间。
AI.result: 实验表明FiUni能够有效推断潜在的批量级别任务关联，并在更少的可训练参数下取得与先进的task-aware持续学习方法相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: FiUni通过Fisher信息结构实现无需任务边界的批量级任务检测和动态知识共享/隔离，为大语言模型在无任务场景下的持续学习提供了一种高效且有竞争力的解决方案。

title: SPEAR: Distilling Domain-Adaptive Reasoning Skeletons via Sequential Symbolic Alignment in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning-based knowledge distillation has the potential to transfer complex reasoning from teacher to student models, yet it currently faces a critical dilemma: researchers must choose between sparse outcome-based rewards, which provide insufficient logical guidance, or expensive neural Process Reward Models (PRMs) for dense signals. We resolve this by introducing SPEAR (Symbolic Process Evaluation and Alignment Reward), a training-free and plug-and-play process reward method for sequence-level on-policy distillation. SPEAR projects natural-language reasoning traces into domain-adaptive symbolic milestones, providing an efficient proxy for process-level reasoning alignment. By utilizing the longest common subsequence (LCS) to align student explorations with teacher milestones, SPEAR provides a dense, order-aware reward signal that enforces logical consistency without the need for an external neural verifier. Our experiments across math, science, and commonsense reasoning tasks demonstrate that SPEAR effectively bridges the reasoning gap between student and teacher models via sequence-level distillation with efficient dense process rewards. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/zhuochunli/SPEAR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEAR，一种无需训练的即插即用过程奖励方法，通过将自然语言推理轨迹投影为领域自适应的符号里程碑，并利用最长公共子序列（LCS）对齐学生探索与教师里程碑，为序列级在线蒸馏提供密集、顺序感知的奖励信号，在数学、科学和常识推理任务上有效弥合学生与教师模型的推理差距。
AI.motivation: 基于强化学习的知识蒸馏面临两难困境：稀疏的基于结果的奖励缺乏逻辑引导，而昂贵的神经过程奖励模型（PRM）虽然提供密集信号但成本过高。研究者需要一种既能提供密集过程信号又无需外部神经验证器的奖励方法。
AI.method: SPEAR将自然语言推理轨迹投影到领域自适应的符号里程碑，作为过程级推理对齐的高效代理；利用最长公共子序列（LCS）对齐学生探索与教师里程碑，从而提供密集、顺序感知的奖励信号，在不依赖外部神经验证器的情况下强制执行逻辑一致性。该方法为训练免费、即插即用，适用于序列级在线蒸馏。
AI.result: 在数学、科学和常识推理任务上的实验表明，SPEAR通过序列级蒸馏配合高效密集过程奖励，有效弥合了学生与教师模型之间的推理差距。
AI.conclusion: SPEAR成功解决了强化学习知识蒸馏中结果稀疏奖励与神经PRM昂贵之间的两难问题，提供了一种高效、无需训练的密集过程奖励方案，实现了有效的推理能力迁移。

title: Aphanta: Diagnosing Task-Aligned Image-Edited Intermediates for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Explicit visual intermediates can help multimodal large language models (MLLMs) externalize spatial evidence and updated visual states, but their utility depends on whether an image editor can faithfully realize the required transformation. We introduce \textbf{Aphanta}, an automated task-discovery and closed-loop diagnostic framework for the MLLM -> image editor -> MLLM pipeline. Aphanta evaluates three conditions---direct reasoning, reasoning with an editor-generated intermediate, and reasoning with an idealized reference intermediate---to separate potential visual headroom from the practical utility of current editors. Across 20 candidate tasks and multiple editor--MLLM combinations, we find that utility is strongly task-conditioned. Gains concentrate in visual cue injection, grounding, and counterfactual state realization, whereas intermediates requiring symbol-sensitive construction or structural extrapolation are substantially less reliable. On the selected positive-task subset, our consolidated Qwen pipeline improves the mean task score from 0.343 to 0.445 ($+10.2$ points; $+29.7\%$ relative), while the full study also retains filtered and unsuccessful tasks to expose the boundary. These results position image editing as a specialized visual workspace rather than a universal reasoning mechanism, and establish Aphanta as a reusable protocol for measuring task--representation alignment, editor realization, and downstream pipeline utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Aphanta，一个自动化任务发现与闭环诊断框架，用于评估"MLLM→图像编辑器→MLLM"流水线中显式视觉中间表示的实用价值。研究发现编辑器中间表示的效用高度依赖于任务类型：在视觉线索注入、接地和反事实状态实现等任务上增益显著，而在需要符号敏感构建或结构外推的任务上可靠性较差。
AI.motivation: 显式视觉中间表示有望帮助多模态大语言模型（MLLM）外部化空间证据和更新的视觉状态，但其实际效用取决于图像编辑器能否忠实实现所需变换。现有研究缺乏系统评估编辑器实际实现能力与理想中间表示之间差距的方法，需要判断视觉headroom是否真正可被当前编辑器兑现。
AI.method: Aphanta框架通过评估三个条件来分离潜在视觉空间与实际编辑器效用：(1) 直接推理；(2) 使用编辑器生成的中间表示推理；(3) 使用理想化参考中间表示推理。研究覆盖20个候选任务和多个编辑器-MLLM组合，并采用闭环诊断策略筛选正向任务子集。
AI.result: 编辑器中间表示的效用强依赖任务类型。增益集中在视觉线索注入、接地和反事实状态实现任务上；而在需要符号敏感构建或结构外推的任务中，可靠性大幅下降。在选定的正向任务子集上，整合的Qwen流水线将平均任务得分从0.343提升至0.445（相对提升29.7%）。完整研究保留筛选和失败任务以揭示能力边界。
AI.conclusion: 图像编辑应被视为专门的视觉工作空间而非通用推理机制。Aphanta提供了可复用的协议，用于度量任务-表示对齐、编辑器实现能力以及下游流水线效用。

title: Emotional Preferences as Goal-Priority Regulation
summary: A core question in decision-making for agents is whether the relative priorities of competing lower-level objectives can be determined by emotional preferences autonomously generated by higher-level goals, rather than being externally prespecified. Under changing external environments and evolving internal states, emotions play an important functional role in regulating the relative priorities of competing goals. Inspired by the goal-directed theory of emotion, this paper studies how such preference regulation can be computationally realized through reinforcement learning. We first propose a conception of emergent emotional preference: a high-level goal autonomously induces state-dependent preferences over competing lower-level objectives. This conception is built upon a framework consisting of a multi-objective reinforcement learning inner controller and an outer preference generator. The inner controller provides a repertoire of preference-conditioned goal-directed behaviors, while the outer preference generator learns a mapping from the current state to objective preferences through reinforcement learning on a high-level goal. We operationalize emotional preference as a state-dependent regulation of relative goal priorities that emerges through optimization. Furthermore, we characterize the policy space induced by preference regulation and derive an upper bound on the optimality gap in terms of the representation error of the inner behavioral repertoire. We show that the gap vanishes when the optimal policy can be represented by the available preference-conditioned policies. Experiments in self-constructed multi-objective exploration environments show that the learned preference function exhibits contextual priority switching, graded trade-offs, and temporal persistence, and outperforms the evaluated fixed-preference and handcrafted-preference strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过强化学习实现情感偏好调节的框架,使智能体的高层目标能够自主生成对低层目标的相对偏好,而非由外部预先指定。该框架包含多目标强化学习内控制器和外部偏好生成器,实验证明其优于固定偏好和手工偏好策略。
AI.motivation: 核心问题是:在动态外部环境和内部状态变化下,智能体对竞争性低层目标的相对优先级是否能由高层目标自主产生的情感偏好决定,而非外部预先指定。情感在调节竞争目标优先级中起重要的功能性作用,但目前缺乏对这种偏好调节的计算实现研究。
AI.method: 受目标导向情感理论启发,提出"涌现情感偏好"概念:高层目标自主地对竞争性低层目标诱导出状态相关的偏好。框架由两层组成:内层为多目标强化学习控制器,提供偏好条件下的目标导向行为库;外层为偏好生成器,通过强化学习在高层级目标上学习从当前状态到目标偏好的映射。将情感偏好操作化为通过优化涌现的状态相关的目标优先级调节,并表征了偏好调节所诱导的策略空间,推导了最优性差距的上界(以内层行为库的表示误差表示)。
AI.result: 在自建的多目标探索环境中,学习到的偏好函数表现出情境性优先级切换、分级权衡和时间持续性,且在性能上优于所评估的固定偏好策略和手工偏好策略。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明,通过强化学习实现的情感偏好调节是可行的,且能够自适应地在复杂多目标环境中进行目标优先级调节,证明了自主涌现的偏好比外部预定义偏好更具优势。

title: SymbolLKG: Towards Verifiable Logical Reasoning via Logical Knowledge Graph and Symbolic Solvers
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in natural language understanding, yet they struggle with strict multi-step reasoning, frequently suffering from hallucinations and inconsistency. Existing solutions like Chain-of-Thought (CoT) lack rigorous verification mechanisms, while standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) often misses the complex, structural dependencies inherent in logical tasks. To bridge this gap, we propose a Neuro-Symbolic architecture that integrates a Logical Knowledge Graph (LKG) with dynamic solver routing. Specifically, we introduce an ontology-based LKG that treats logical rules and constraints as first-class topological nodes, enabling explicit modeling of dependencies extracted from text. We further design a Logic Router to dynamically dispatch tasks to the optimal symbolic engine, which is supported by a topology-aware hybrid retrieval mechanism. Experimental results on logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art prompting and RAG baselines, delivering higher accuracy and verifiable reasoning paths.

AI.tldr: 提出一种神经符号架构，将逻辑知识图谱与动态求解器路由相结合，通过拓扑感知的混合检索机制解决LLM在多步逻辑推理中的幻觉和不一致问题，在逻辑推理基准上显著优于CoT和标准RAG方法。
AI.motivation: LLM虽然擅长自然语言理解，但在严格的多步推理中容易出现幻觉和不一致；现有CoT方法缺乏严格验证机制，而标准RAG难以捕捉逻辑任务中复杂的结构依赖关系，因此需要一种能够显式建模逻辑依赖并提供可验证推理路径的新框架。
AI.method: 提出Neuro-Symbolic架构，核心包括：(1) 基于本体的逻辑知识图谱（LKG），将逻辑规则和约束作为一等拓扑节点，显式建模从文本中提取的依赖关系；(2) 逻辑路由器（Logic Router），动态将任务分派到最优符号引擎；(3) 拓扑感知的混合检索机制，为路由器提供支撑。
AI.result: 在逻辑推理基准上的实验结果表明，该框架在准确率和可验证推理路径方面均显著优于最先进的提示工程方法和RAG基线。
AI.conclusion: 融合符号逻辑的拓扑结构表示与动态引擎路由，能够有效弥补纯神经方法在严格多步推理中的不足，不仅提升推理准确性，还能提供可验证的推理路径。

title: SPT: Skills as Pre-Training Data for Agentic Language Models
summary: Agentic (tool-using) language models are mainly trained on tool-call traces and agent trajectories during post-training. These data provide direct behavioral supervision, but producing them requires task environments, execution, and verification, making broad tool and task coverage expensive. Publicly available skills offer another source of training data: they encode reusable tool semantics and workflows but are typically used only as inference-time context. We introduce Skill Pre-Training (SPT), a mid-training method that applies causal language modeling to SkillCorpus, a collection of public multi-file skill packages, optionally mixed with general data. To preserve relations among files within each package, we also introduce Reference Insert, a reference-aware assembly strategy that places supporting files near their mentions in the primary instruction. Experiments across multiple model scales and post-training recipes show that SPT consistently improves agentic performance over mid-training on general or trajectory data, while largely preserving general performance. Data mixture experiments show additional benefits from combining skill data with general annealing corpora. These results indicate that skill packages are a valuable data source for pre-training agentic language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出技能预训练（SPT）方法，利用公开的多文件技能包（SkillCorpus）作为训练数据，通过因果语言建模和"Reference Insert"文件组装策略，对语言模型进行中期训练，从而提升其智能体（工具使用）能力，同时基本保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 智能体语言模型主要依赖工具调用轨迹和智能体路径进行后训练，但这些昂贵数据的生成需要任务环境、执行和验证，导致工具和任务的覆盖范围受限。而公开可用的技能包虽然编码了可复用的工具语义和工作流，但通常仅作为推理时的上下文使用，未被充分利用为训练数据。
AI.method: 引入SPT（Skill Pre-Training）中期训练方法：1）构建SkillCorpus，收集公开的多文件技能包并可选地与通用数据混合；2）对SkillCorpus应用因果语言建模进行训练；3）提出Reference Insert参考感知组装策略，将支持文件放置在主说明文档中提及它们的位置附近，以保持包内文件间的关系。
AI.result: 跨多个模型规模和多种后训练配方的实验表明，SPT相比在通用数据或轨迹数据上进行中期训练，一致地提升了智能体性能，同时基本保持通用性能。数据混合实验进一步显示，将技能数据与通用退火语料结合能带来额外收益。
AI.conclusion: 技能包是预训练智能体语言模型的宝贵数据源。SPT方法验证了将公共技能包作为中期训练数据可以有效提升工具使用能力，且与通用数据混合时效果更佳。

title: Virtual iEEG from Scalp EEG: Charting the Landscape of Source Imaging, Intracranial Inference and Reconstruction
summary: Intracranial electroencephalography (iEEG) provides temporally precise and spatially specific access to neural activity from focal and deep brain regions, but its invasiveness and restricted anatomical coverage limit routine use. These constraints have motivated scalp-to-intracranial inference, termed virtual iEEG when model outputs carry iEEG-defined event, feature, representation, or contact-level waveform semantics. This review presents a target-centred framework distinguishing event inference, feature translation, and waveform reconstruction, while separating predictability from observability, identifiability, fidelity, and utility. Evidence is evaluated according to cohort independence, anatomical and spectral coverage, train--test separation, and target-patient adaptation. Current studies support inference of selected intracranial events, low-frequency components, and task-related representations, but not unique recovery of arbitrary contact-level activity. Stronger validation requires appropriate controls, source-imaging baselines, uncertainty assessment, and incremental-utility testing. Future progress depends on independent paired datasets and prospective evidence that virtual iEEG adds value beyond scalp EEG and EEG source imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了从头皮脑电到颅内脑电的推断方法（"虚拟iEEG"），提出了一个以目标为中心的框架，区分事件推断、特征翻译和波形重建三类任务，并评估了当前证据的充分性与未来验证需求。
AI.motivation: 颅内脑电图（iEEG）能提供高时间精度和空间特异性的神经活动，但因其侵入性和有限解剖覆盖难以常规使用。这一限制推动了头皮到颅内的推断研究，但该领域缺乏系统性的评估框架来区分可预测性与可观测性、可辨识性、保真度和实用性。
AI.method: 本文采用以目标为中心的综述框架，将虚拟iEEG任务分为三类：事件推断、特征翻译和波形重建；同时在概念上区分了可预测性、可观测性、可辨识性、保真度和效用等维度。证据评估依据四个标准：队列独立性、解剖与频谱覆盖、训练-测试分离、目标患者适配。
AI.result: 现有研究支持对特定颅内事件、低频成分和任务相关表征的推断，但无法实现对任意接触级活动的唯一重建。当前证据在队列独立性、解剖和频谱覆盖等方面存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 虚拟iEEG需要更强的验证，包括适当的对照组、源成像基线、不确定性评估和增量效用测试。未来进展依赖于独立的配对数据集以及证明虚拟iEEG在头皮EEG和EEG源成像之外提供额外价值的前瞻性证据。

title: Tabular Deep Learning for Algorithmic Trading: Cross-Regime Bayesian Optimisation for Equity Signal Generation
summary: Algorithmic trading now represents a market exceeding $20 billion, where even marginal gains in signal robustness can translate into economically significant returns. Existing evaluations of equity prediction models do not explicitly target regime robustness during hyperparameter selection. Five model classes are trained on daily observations from approximately 300 large-cap US equities over eleven years, with Bayesian optimisation configured to target trading performance across three statistically different market regimes. Regime-robust hyperparameter selection is associated with out-of-sample generalisation, as signal precision remains above the random baseline across all four quarters of the test period, and portfolio performance slowly degrades under simulated input noise before collapsing beyond a defined threshold. No individual tabular deep learning architecture outperforms gradient-boosted trees, but combining XGBoost and TabNet using rank aggregation produces a Hybrid ensemble with an annualised return of 51.26%, a Sharpe ratio of 2.44, and a statistically significant CAPM alpha of 0.423 (p = 0.011). A near-zero beta indicates this outperformance is driven by stock selection, not market exposure. Alternative data plays a secondary role once technical and fundamental features are accounted for, as well as contributing more strongly on the short side than the long, and varies by model class. An interactive application makes these results explorable in real time, with live data integration the remaining step toward practical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究算法交易中的股票收益预测模型，提出在超参数选择中显式针对不同市场制度进行鲁棒性优化。在约300只美国大市值股票、11年日度数据上，对比五种模型类别，发现无单一表格深度学习架构能超越梯度提升树，但通过秩聚合融合XGBoost和TabNet的混合集成模型实现年化收益51.26%、夏普比率2.44和显著CAPM alpha。制度鲁棒的超参数选择与样本外泛化相关，替代数据作用为次要且偏空头。
AI.motivation: 算法交易市场规模超过200亿美元，信号的微小稳健性增益即可转化为可观经济回报。然而现有股票收益预测模型评估在超参数选择阶段未显式针对制度（regime）鲁棒性进行优化，这是一个被忽视的关键缺口。
AI.method: 在约300只美国大市值股票、11年日度数据上训练五类模型，使用贝叶斯优化并将优化目标配置为跨三个统计学上不同的市场制度的交易表现。通过秩聚合方法融合XGBoost和TabNet构建混合集成模型，并模拟输入噪声测试性能退化。构建交互式应用实现实时探索。
AI.result: 制度鲁棒的超参数选择与样本外泛化正向关联，信号精度在测试期四个季度均高于随机基线。混合集成模型在噪声下性能缓慢退化、超过阈值后崩溃。XGBoost+TabNet混合集成实现年化收益51.26%、夏普比率2.44、CAPM alpha 0.423（p=0.011），且beta接近零表明超额收益源于选股而非市场暴露。替代数据在技术面和基本面特征之后仅扮演次要角色，在空头侧贡献更强。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实制度鲁棒的超参数选择能够提升样本外泛化能力，混合集成策略优于单一架构，且超额收益来源于选股能力。替代数据的边际价值有限且方向偏空。交互式应用已实现，剩余步骤为实时数据集成以达成实际部署。

title: LiveSim: Simulating Environment-Shaped Users in Multi-Agent Live-Stream Ecosystems
summary: User behavior simulation with large language models~(LLMs) is increasingly used to support multi-agent ecosystem simulation. Existing simulators typically rely on static user profiles inferred from historical observations, which become inadequate in socially intensive environments such as live streaming where interaction dynamics continuously reshape user behavior. We propose \textbf{LiveSim}, an LLM-based framework for live-stream ecosystem simulation. It represents users as editable behavioral hypotheses and progressively refines them through trajectory-grounded interactions, where discrepancies between simulated and observed trajectories reveal missing environmental shaping effects. These signals are further extracted as transferable environment-behavior patterns and accumulated in a collective behavioral memory to improve user-level behavioral fidelity and support ecosystem-level simulation. Experiments on real-world live-stream risk-control data validate the effectiveness of LiveSim in improving user-level behavioral fidelity and enabling ecosystem-level analysis of risk evolution and platform intervention effects.

AI.tldr: 提出了LiveSim，一种基于LLM的直播生态系统仿真框架，通过可编辑的行为假设和轨迹锚定交互来逐步细化用户行为模型，并将环境塑造信号提取为可迁移的"环境-行为"模式存入集体行为记忆，以提升用户级行为保真度并支持生态系统级仿真分析。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的用户行为仿真器通常依赖从历史观测中推断的静态用户画像，在直播等社交密集型场景中，用户行为持续被交互动态重塑，静态画像无法捕捉这种环境塑造效应，导致仿真保真度不足。
AI.method: LiveSim将用户表示为可编辑的行为假设（editable behavioral hypotheses），通过轨迹锚定交互（trajectory-grounded interactions）逐步细化；利用仿真轨迹与观测轨迹之间的差异来揭示缺失的环境塑造信号，将其提取为可迁移的环境-行为模式（environment-behavior patterns），并累积到集体行为记忆（collective behavioral memory）中，既提升用户级行为保真度又支持生态系统级仿真。
AI.result: 在真实直播风控数据上的实验验证了LiveSim在提升用户级行为保真度方面的有效性，并能够支持生态系统级的风险演化分析和平台干预效果分析。
AI.conclusion: LiveSim通过动态、可迁移的行为建模机制解决了静态用户画像在社交密集型环境中失效的问题，为直播生态系统仿真提供了一种既能刻画用户个体行为又能支持平台级洞察的统一框架。

title: Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding for Efficient Diffusion Large Language Model Inference
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive generation by decoding multiple tokens in parallel through iterative denoising. However, increasing decoding parallelism often degrades generation quality, as early errors can contaminate later contexts. Revocable decoding mitigates this issue by re-evaluating decoded tokens and remasking unreliable ones, but existing methods overlook that unreliable tokens may also corrupt the verification context itself. We identify this failure mode and propose Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding (DARD), a training-free framework that separates tokens into masked, candidate, and unmasked states. DARD verifies candidate tokens using a selective context that excludes less reliable tokens and adaptively regulates their influence on subsequent decoding. Experiments across 12 textual and multimodal benchmarks on 3 open-source dLLMs show that DARD consistently improves the speed-quality Pareto frontier over recent revocable decoding methods, achieving a 2.71$\times$ speedup and a 4.35-point CIDEr score gain over Saber on Flickr30K.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DARD（依赖感知的可撤销解码）框架，针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）中可撤销解码方法忽略不可靠token污染验证上下文的问题，通过将token分为掩码、候选和未掩码三种状态，并使用选择性上下文验证候选token，在12个文本和多模态基准上显著改善速度-质量权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型通过迭代去噪实现多token并行解码，但增加解码并行度会降低生成质量，因为早期错误会污染后续上下文。现有的可撤销解码方法虽然重新评估已解码token并重新掩码不可靠token，但忽视了不可靠token本身也会破坏验证上下文，导致验证过程受到污染。
AI.method: 提出DARD（Dependency-Aware Revocable Decoding），一个无需训练的框架。其核心思想是将token分为三种状态：掩码（masked）、候选（candidate）和未掩码（unmasked）。DARD在验证候选token时使用选择性上下文——排除不可靠的token以减少干扰，并自适应地调节这些token对后续解码的影响。
AI.result: 在12个文本和多模态基准上、基于3个开源dLLM的实验中，DARD一致地改善了相对现有可撤销解码方法的速度-质量Pareto前沿。具体而言，在Flickr30K上相比Saber方法实现了2.71倍加速和4.35点的CIDEr分数提升。
AI.conclusion: DARD通过依赖感知的选择性上下文验证机制，有效解决了可撤销解码中不可靠token污染验证上下文的问题，在提升解码速度的同时保证甚至改善了生成质量，为扩散大语言模型的高效解码提供了新思路。

title: MVC-Bench: Benchmarking Calibration of Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Reliable evaluation of vision-language models (VLMs) and medical vision-language models (Medical-VLMs) requires calibrated confidence, particularly under realistic clinical conditions. However, existing efforts mainly focused on improving accuracy, leaving calibration in the medical domain underexplored. To this end, we propose MVC-Bench, a calibration-centric benchmark for medical image classification with VLMs and Medical-VLMs. MVC-Bench assesses the calibration across three axes: (i) robustness to modality, backbone, and domain shift (ii) effectiveness of calibration strategies and prompt-tuning methods (iii) stability under prompt-template and random-seed variations. The benchmark covers eight different backbones, three medical modalities, including fundus imaging, histopathology, and chest X-ray under in-domain and domain shift settings. It compares post-hoc calibration, train-time calibration, and zero-shot inference methods, together with six prompt-tuning methods. Across more than 1638 controlled experiments, we report accuracy and Expected Calibration Error (ECE) as primary metrics, and further report results with complementary calibration measures, including Maximum Calibration Error (MCE) and Adaptive Calibration Error (ACE). We further investigate the underlying causes of miscalibration in VLMs and Medical-VLMs and propose a simple train-time calibration method, Multi-Class Margin (MCM) regularization, which achieves lowest ECE on 10 out of 12 settings in in-domain and remains competitive under domain shifts. Collectively, MVC-Bench provides a structured evaluation framework and actionable guidance for improving calibration in safety-critical medical workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MVC-Bench，一个面向医学图像分类的校准中心基准，系统评估视觉语言模型和医学视觉语言模型在多模态、多骨干网络及域偏移条件下的校准性能，并提出Multi-Class Margin (MCM)正则化方法以改善校准。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型研究主要关注准确性提升，而校准（calibration）——即模型置信度与真实正确概率的一致性——在医学领域尚未被充分探索。在临床安全关键场景下，可靠的置信度评估至关重要，因此需要一个专门针对医学VLM校准的系统性基准。
AI.method: MVC-Bench从三个维度评估校准：(i)对模态、骨干网络和域偏移的鲁棒性；(ii)校准策略和提示调优方法的有效性；(iii)在提示模板和随机种子变化下的稳定性。覆盖8种骨干网络、3种医学模态（眼底成像、组织病理学和胸部X光），比较后处理校准、训练时校准和零样本推理方法以及6种提示调优方法，共超过1638个受控实验。主要指标为准确率和期望校准误差(ECE)，辅以最大校准误差(MCE)和自适应校准误差(ACE)。此外提出训练时校准方法MCM正则化。
AI.result: MCM正则化方法在12个域内设置中的10个达到最低ECE，且在域偏移条件下保持竞争力。实验全面揭示了VLM和Medical-VLM校准不足的根本原因，并系统比较了多种校准策略和提示调优方法在医学场景下的表现。
AI.conclusion: MVC-Bench为医学视觉语言模型的校准评估提供了结构化框架和可操作指南，有助于在安全关键的医学工作流中提升模型可靠性，MCM正则化作为简单有效的训练时校准方法展现出良好的泛化能力。

title: Cone Extended Rayleigh Quotients for Directed Graph Learning: Minimax Spectral Certificates, Sensitivity, and Adaptive Control
summary:
Directed graph learning naturally leads to trainable nonsymmetric propagation operators with distinct right and left spectral structures. Building on the two-sided cone Rayleigh framework for generalized pencils \[ B_θ-λG, \] we develop a learning-oriented methodology for spectral certification, sensitivity analysis, and control without requiring symmetry, nonnegativity, or cone preservation. In the positive-orthant setting, computable lower and upper cone bounds provide an a posteriori enclosure of a distinguished cone level, while smooth soft-min/max surrogates preserve rigorous one-sided bounds with explicit approximation errors and remain differentiable with respect to the trainable parameters.
  For a simple interior level, the right and left modes satisfy \[ Dλ_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C, \] yielding first-order optimal graph-supported interventions under prescribed perturbation budgets and motivating adaptive spectral control. Numerical experiments demonstrate the applicability of the approach beyond cone-preserving operators and in directed learning settings. Signed nonsymmetric perturbations reveal a transition from interior eigenpairs to boundary complementary quasi-pairs, including non-spectral cone levels, while controlled experiments show that symmetrization can remove predictive information carried solely by edge direction.
  On the directed Cora citation network, adaptive recomputation of the right--left sensitivity reduces the distinguished spectral level by approximately $21.5\%$ under a cumulative edge-weight reduction budget of $0.5\%$, with no observed change in test accuracy for the trained model and data split considered.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向有向图学习的两侧锥Rayleigh框架方法，用于对非对称传播算子进行谱验证、灵敏度分析和控制，无需对称性、非负性或锥保持假设。在正象限设置下，可计算的上/下锥界提供了锥水平的后验包络，光滑的soft-min/max替代函数保持严格单侧界并具有可微性。实验表明该方法适用于锥非保持算子，在Cora引用网络上可将谱水平降低21.5%，同时不改变测试精度。
AI.motivation: 有向图学习自然产生可训练的非对称传播算子，其左右谱结构不同。现有谱分析方法通常依赖对称性、非负性或锥保持等假设，难以直接应用于有向图学习场景。需要一种无需这些限制的通用方法论，用于谱验证、灵敏度分析和谱控制。
AI.method: 基于广义铅笔B_θ-λG的两侧锥Rayleigh框架，推导正象限设置下可计算的上下锥界作为锥水平的后验包络；引入光滑soft-min/max替代函数保持严格单侧界且可微；对简单内部锥水平，建立右左特征模式对扰动的一阶灵敏度公式Dλ_C(B)[H]=v_C^T H u_C，用于最优图支持干预和自适应谱控制。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了该方法在锥非保持算子和有向学习设置中的适用性。符号非对称扰动揭示了从内部特征对到边界互补准对的转变，包括非谱锥水平。对照实验表明对称化会移除仅由边方向携带的预测信息。在Cora引用网络上，自适应重计算左右灵敏度使特征谱水平降低约21.5%，累积边权减少预算为0.5%，且测试精度无变化。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为有向图学习中的非对称传播算子提供了无需对称性/非负性/锥保持假设的谱分析和控制框架，证明利用左右谱结构信息可以实现有效的自适应谱控制且不损失模型精度，并揭示边方向信息对预测的独特贡献。

title: BekchiAI: Measuring, Observing, and Controlling LLM Agents in One Click
summary: Large language model agents reason, call tools, and act autonomously over many steps, but their agentic skills-correctly sequencing tools, planning under dependencies, judging untrusted inputs, and grounding generated arguments-are hard to measure with accuracy-only leaderboards. We present BekchiAI, which addresses both sides: a benchmark for measuring agentic skill and a platform for observing and controlling live agents. The BekchiAI-Benchmark, a suite of 13 tool-using ReAct agents across 7 task categories (arithmetic, structured/SQL, security detection, URL grounding, planning, orchestration, and tool-policy), totalling 2,057 deterministic, committed test tasks. Every task is verifier-checkable gold answers are computed by running canonical SQL against a real database, computing the exact schedule of a directed acyclic graph (DAG), or evaluating closed-form lambdas including adversarial security samples paired with deliberately imperfect signature scanners so a score reflects the model's own judgment, not the copying of an oracle. We define a small set of behavioral metrics beyond accuracy-tool-call adherence, URL hallucination and source-match, and per-model token cost and report a four-model comparison (Qwen3.7-Max, gemma-4-31B-it, gemma4:26b, gpt-oss-120b) whose story is in the per-family spread, not the aggregate. The benchmark runs are executed using the provided evaluation scripts. BekchiAI-Platform is a complementary web-based observability and control layer for deployed agents, providing full token and latency telemetry as well as remote run termination. The benchmark, evaluation tools, and platform are publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BekchiAI，包含一个用于评估LLM代理技能（如工具排序、规划、判断不可信输入等）的基准测试套件（13个ReAct代理、7个任务类别、2057个确定性任务），以及一个用于观测和控制部署中代理的Web平台。基准测试采用可验证的金标准答案，并引入超越准确率的行为指标（工具调用遵循度、URL幻觉、源匹配、token成本），对四个模型进行了对比。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理榜单仅以准确率衡量能力，无法捕捉代理的技能维度——包括正确排序工具、在依赖关系下规划、判断不可信输入以及为生成的论点提供依据。这些技能难以被准确率指标所衡量，需要更细粒度的评估方法和配套的观测控制工具。
AI.method: 1) BekchiAI-Benchmark：13个使用工具的ReAct代理，覆盖7个任务类别（算术、结构化/SQL、安全检测、URL接地、规划、编排、工具策略），共2057个确定性任务。每个任务都有可验证的金标准答案——通过运行真实数据库上的规范SQL、计算有向无环图(DAG)的精确调度，或评估封闭形式lambda（包括配以故意不完美的签名扫描器的对抗性安全样本）来获得。2) 定义超越准确率的行为指标：工具调用遵循度、URL幻觉和源匹配、逐模型token成本。3) 对四个模型（Qwen3.7-Max, gemma-4-31B-it, gemma4:26b, gpt-oss-120b）进行对比。4) BekchiAI-Platform：基于Web的观测和控制层，提供完整token和延迟遥测以及远程运行终止功能。
AI.result: 对四个模型进行了基准测试比较，核心发现不在于聚合分数，而在于每个模型家族内部的分数差异。基准测试通过金标准验证机制确保评分反映模型自身的判断而非简单复制oracle输出。基准测试、评估工具和平台均已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: BekchiAI通过提供可验证的基准测试和可观测的控制平台两方面来解决LLM代理评估的难题。强调了单项准确率不足、需要多维度行为指标（工具遵循、URL接地、成本等）来衡量代理技能的观点，并展示了不同模型家族内部差异比聚合分数更有信息量。

title: Double Trouble: Bilingual Pretraining Leaves Language-Conditioned Effects in Shared-Language Representations
comment: Published as a conference paper at EMNLP 2026 (Main)
summary: When researchers compare multilingual models for probing, interpretability, or cross-lingual transfer, they often align embedding spaces and assume that shared-language representations are comparable. We show that this assumption can be premature for decoder-only models. We pretrain paired 310M-parameter models (one English-only, one bilingual) across eight typologically diverse languages, separately controlling for English exposure, total compute, and document overlap. After aligning on shared English vocabulary, we test held-out words and find that token embeddings look similar after alignment, but the deeper hidden states that the model uses for prediction do not. This gap holds for all eight languages and survives controls for document overlap and alternative alignment methods. This hidden-state mismatch grows through middle transformer layers, suggesting that it arises from contextual processing rather than the input representations where alignment is performed. Embedding alignment can mask real differences in how models internally represent a shared language, which matters for any downstream study that treats aligned models as interchangeable.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了一个重要问题：在对多语言解码器模型进行嵌入空间对齐后，虽然输入词嵌入看起来相似，但模型内部用于预测的深层隐藏状态并不一致。这种不一致在八种语言中普遍存在，并且不受文档重叠和控制方法的干扰，意味着将对齐后的模型视为可互换的假设是有问题的。
AI.motivation: 研究人员在比较多语言模型进行探针分析、可解释性或跨语言迁移研究时，通常会对嵌入空间进行对齐，并假设共享语言的表示是可比的。作者质疑这一假设对于仅解码器（decoder-only）模型是否成立，因为嵌入对齐可能掩盖模型内部真实的表示差异。
AI.method: 作者预训练了成对的310M参数模型（一个仅英语模型，一个双语模型），涵盖八种类型多样的语言。实验分别控制了英语暴露量、总计算量和文档重叠三个变量。在共享英语词汇上进行对齐后，测试保留词（held-out words），比较词嵌入和更深层隐藏状态的相似性，并分析了不同Transformer层中这种差异的变化趋势。
AI.result: 研究发现：词嵌入在对齐后看起来相似，但模型实际用于预测的深层隐藏状态并不相似。这一差距在全部八种语言中均存在，且不受文档重叠控制或替代对齐方法的影响。该不匹配在Transformer中层最为显著，表明差异源于上下文处理过程而非对齐所作用的输入表示层。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入对齐会掩盖模型在内部表示共享语言时的真实差异，因此任何将对齐后模型视为可互换的下游研究都需要谨慎对待这一假设。研究强调，仅对齐嵌入层不足以确保多语言模型之间的表示可比性。

title: Differentiable Jitter Correction using Deep Learning-based Image Quality Metric for Phase-Contrast Micro-CT
summary: This paper proposes a fully differentiable jitter correction method for X-ray phase-contrast micro computed tomography using a deep learning-based image quality metric that estimates and compensates per-projection rigid jitter directly from the acquired projection data, without a pre-scan motion-free reference. The approach builds on a gradient-based auto-focus strategy adapted to parallel-beam geometry. A set of candidate objective functions is benchmarked in a controlled study, and the sensitivity of the visual information fidelity (VIF) metric to the jitter artifact is verified with the target phase-contrast data. To operate without a clean reference, a compact 3D convolutional neural network is trained to predict the VIF score from a single corrupted volume. A spatially selective total variation penalty applied exclusively to the image background is introduced to penalize spurious high-frequency structures that otherwise emerge during optimization. Experiments on biological specimens acquired at different synchrotron beamlines are conducted. Evaluation uses jitter motion applied to simulated and experimentally acquired projection data. The result confirms that the integrated pipeline reliably recovers fine structural detail lost due to jitter, with generalization demonstrated across morphologically distinct samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的全可微抖动校正方法，用于X射线相衬显微CT成像，通过利用VIF图像质量指标估计并补偿逐投影的刚性抖动，无需预扫描无运动参考。
AI.motivation: X射线相衬显微CT在成像过程中投影数据的机械抖动会降低图像质量，破坏细微结构信息。传统校正方法依赖无运动参考或专目标定，且难以针对相衬数据有效工作，因此需要一种无需干净参考、能够直接在投影域中估计和补偿抖动的鲁棒方法。
AI.method: 该方法基于梯度驱动的自动对焦策略（适配平行束几何），以VIF作为客观图像质量指标。为解决无干净参考问题，训练了一个紧凑的3D卷积神经网络从单一受损体数据预测VIF分数。此外引入仅作用于图像背景的空间选择性全变分惩罚项，抑制优化过程中产生的虚假高频结构。
AI.result: 实验在多个同步辐射光束线上采集的生物样本上进行，模拟和实际投影数据均施加抖动进行评估。结果表明该管线能够可靠恢复因抖动丢失的细微结构细节，并证明在不同形态学特征的样本间具有良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该集成管线无需运动参考即可有效校正X射线相衬显微CT中的刚性抖动伪影，恢复精细结构信息，且在多样化生物样本上具备通用性。

title: TRACE-CRC: Trajectory-Adaptive Conformal Risk Control for Multi-Step Channel State Information Prediction
comment: Published in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), volume 329, Conformal and Probabilistic Prediction with Applications (COPA 2026)
summary: Reliable prediction of time-varying channel state information (CSI) is essential for efficient wireless communication. Each CSI frame is a matrix-valued representation of the wireless channel response, and a sequence of CSI frames forms a temporal channel trajectory. Modern deep learning-based CSI predictors, however, often provide only point predictions and lack calibrated uncertainty estimates. This limitation is particularly problematic in multi-step CSI prediction, where the target is a sequence of future CSI matrices, and downstream decisions such as beamforming or scheduling may fail if any part of the predicted trajectory is unreliable. We propose trajectory-adaptive calibration and error profiling with conformal risk control (TRACE-CRC), a method for trajectory-aware uncertainty quantification in multi-step CSI prediction. TRACE-CRC constructs Frobenius-norm uncertainty balls around predicted CSI matrices and controls the risk that at least one future frame is uncovered. Instead of calibrating each future step independently, TRACE-CRC combines future-step-dependent error profiling, trajectory difficulty stratification, and learn-then-test (LTT) risk control. Empirically, TRACE-CRC achieves reliable trajectory-level coverage with substantially smaller uncertainty balls than conservative multi-step corrections, while avoiding the trajectory undercoverage of compact stepwise and adaptive conformal baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE-CRC方法，用于多步CSI预测中的轨迹感知不确定性量化，通过Frobenius范数不确定性球和一致性风险控制，实现可靠且紧凑的轨迹级覆盖。
AI.motivation: 现代基于深度学习的CSI预测器通常只提供点预测，缺乏校准的不确定性估计，这在多步CSI预测中尤为严重——下游决策（如波束成形或调度）在轨迹任一部分不可靠时都可能失败。
AI.method: TRACE-CRC构建Frobenius范数不确定性球包围预测的CSI矩阵，控制至少一个未来帧未被覆盖的风险。该方法结合了未来步骤相关的误差分析、轨迹难度分层以及学习-然后-测试（LTT）风险控制，而非对每个未来步骤独立校准。
AI.result: 实验表明TRACE-CRC在显著更小的不确定性球下实现可靠的轨迹级覆盖，优于保守的多步校正方法，同时避免了紧凑逐步和自适应一致性基线中的轨迹欠覆盖问题。
AI.conclusion: TRACE-CRC为多步CSI预测提供了轨迹感知的不确定性量化框架，在保证轨迹级覆盖可靠性的同时降低了不确定性估计的保守性，提升了不确定性估计的效率和精度。

title: C-Unseen: Weak Signal Detection in Dynamic Temporal Knowledge Graphs via LLM Reasoning
comment: Accepted at the AI4SE 2026 Special Track, held within the WISE 2026 Conference
summary: Weak signals are early, low-visibility indicators that precede significant changes before those changes become established. Existing detection methods, based on keyword frequency, topic modeling, or untyped graph topology, fail to capture the semantic and relational structure through which such signals manifest. In this paper, we propose C-Unseen, a self-interpretable framework for weak signal detection in Dynamic Temporal Knowledge Graphs (DTKGs). We define a weak signal as a rare, semantically coherent subgraph that proliferates across consecutive TKG snapshots. The framework operates through two modules: a Rare Subgraphs Extractor, in which an LLM identifies subgraphs whose content is in tension with the dominant snapshot narrative via chain-of-thought reasoning, and a Weak Signal Alerter, in which the persistence of these rare subgraphs is tracked across time steps to isolate true weak signals. Experimental results demonstrate that C-Unseen outperforms keyword-, topic-, and graph-based baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出C-Unseen框架，用于在动态时序知识图谱（DTKGs）中检测弱信号，将其定义为在连续快照中增殖的罕见、语义连贯的子图，通过LLM提取稀缺子图并跟踪其跨时间步的持续性来识别真正的弱信号。
AI.motivation: 现有弱信号检测方法（基于关键词频率、主题建模或无类型图拓扑）无法捕捉弱信号所体现的语义与关系结构，即它们缺乏对图结构中复杂语义关系的建模能力。
AI.method: C-Unseen框架包含两个模块：1) 罕见子图提取器（Rare Subgraphs Extractor），利用LLM通过链式推理（chain-of-thought）识别与主导快照叙事相悖的稀有子图；2) 弱信号警报器（Weak Signal Alerter），跨时间步追踪这些罕见子图的持续性以隔离真正的弱信号。
AI.result: 实验结果表明C-Unseen在性能上优于基于关键词、主题和图结构的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: C-Unseen通过将弱信号重新定义为在DTKG中连续快照间增殖的罕见语义子图，并利用LLM的推理能力与跨时间持续性跟踪，提供了一种自可解释的弱信号检测方案，显著优于传统方法。

title: Surgical Alignment in Knowledge Graph Training for Clinical Diagnosis with Large Language Models
summary: Biomedical knowledge graphs (KGs) offer structured medical knowledge that can ground large language model (LLM) reasoning in clinical diagnosis application, yet how KG signal should be integrated into LLMs remains an open question. We present a systematic study spanning five KG task formulations, three training paradigms, two KGs, and three base LLMs. At the task level, all paradigms improve over the non-finetuned baseline, but methods with comparable in-domain accuracy show substantially different knowledge transfer behavior. We introduce Gradient Intervention Density (GID) and Gradient Distortion (GD) to measure how broadly an optimizer modifies the pretrained model. GID and GD together reveal a clear divide: KG-judgment training under KL regularization produces sparse, localized updates (a regime we term as surgical alignment), while task-specific SFT produces dense ones. A controlled ablation shows that the objective and KL contribute to sparsity independently, and the paradigms that produce sparse updates also improve reasoning quality, even when their in-domain accuracy is lower than task-specific SFT. Assessing KG-LLM integration thus requires complementing accuracy with optimization-geometry diagnostics. Our implementation can be found at https://github.com/LARK-NLP-Lab/Surgical-Alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究生物医学知识图谱与大语言模型的集成方式，发现不同训练范式虽在领域内准确率相近，但其梯度更新几何特性存在显著差异。作者提出梯度干预密度（GID）和梯度畸变（GD）两个诊断指标，揭示知识图谱判断训练配合KL正则化会产生稀疏、局部的"外科手术式对齐"更新，而任务特定微调则产生稠密更新。稀疏更新范式能改善推理质量，即使其领域内准确率较低。
AI.motivation: 生物医学知识图谱可以提供结构化医学知识来支撑大语言模型在临床诊断中的推理，但知识图谱信号应如何集成到大语言模型中仍是一个开放问题。现有研究通常只关注领域内准确率，忽略了不同集成方式在模型内部优化动力学上的差异。
AI.method: 研究者进行了系统性对比实验，覆盖5种知识图谱任务形式、3种训练范式、2个知识图谱和3个基础大语言模型。提出了两个新的诊断指标：梯度干预密度（GID）和梯度畸变（GD），用于度量优化器对预训练模型的修改广度和变异程度。通过受控消融实验分离目标函数和KL正则化对梯度稀疏性的独立贡献。
AI.result: 所有训练范式在领域内准确率上都优于未微调基线，但领域内准确率相近的方法在知识迁移行为上差异显著。KG判断训练配合KL正则化产生稀疏局部更新（即"外科手术式对齐"），而任务特定SFT产生稠密更新。目标函数和KL对稀疏性有独立贡献。产生稀疏更新的范式能改善推理质量，即使其领域内准确率低于任务特定SFT。
AI.conclusion: 评估KG-LLM集成不仅需要关注准确率指标，还需结合优化几何诊断。梯度干预密度和梯度畸变能揭示准确率无法反映的模型更新特性，为选择知识图谱与语言模型集成策略提供更全面的评判依据。

title: Multi-Person Human Motion Forecasting in Complex Scenes
summary: Accurately forecasting the movement of people in complex scenes requires reasoning over the past and present state of the entire environment. In this context, effectively incorporating object information and social interactions into a unified framework remains particularly challenging. To address this, we propose Object-Conditioned Social Diffusion (OCSD), a conditional diffusion model that integrates motion history, multi-person interactions, and object cues into a single framework. OCSD uses an object-conditioning mechanism that modulates denoising at every timestep, enabling fine-grained human-object reasoning, and a social encoder that models the interactions between all humans in the scene. As a result, our model naturally handles varying group sizes, complex social interactions, and supports sampling multiple plausible futures. Extensive experiments show that OCSD achieves state-of-the-art results on the Humans in Kitchens (HiK) and HOI-M3 benchmarks. It reduces the two-second path error by 121.5 mm (31.3%) on HiK and 130.5 mm (33.2%) on HOI-M3 compared to prior work, and produces more realistic long-term forecasts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OCSD（Object-Conditioned Social Diffusion），一个将运动历史、多人交互和物体线索统一到单一框架中的条件扩散模型，用于复杂场景中的人类轨迹预测。OCSD在人类与物体的细粒度推理和多人社交交互建模上取得突破，并在HiK和HOI-M3基准上达到SOTA，显著降低了路径预测误差。
AI.motivation: 在复杂场景中准确预测人群移动轨迹需要推理整个环境的过去和当前状态，但如何将物体信息和社交交互有效纳入统一框架仍具挑战性。
AI.method: OCSD是一个条件扩散模型，包含两个关键组件：(1) 物体条件化机制（object-conditioning mechanism），在每个去噪时间步对预测进行调制，实现细粒度的人-物推理；(2) 社交编码器（social encoder），建模场景中所有人类之间的交互。该模型能够自然处理不同规模的群体、复杂的社交交互，并支持采样多个合理的未来轨迹。
AI.result: 在Humans in Kitchens (HiK)和HOI-M3基准上达到当前最优结果。相比先前工作，在HiK上减少了121.5mm（31.3%）的两秒路径误差，在HOI-M3上减少了130.5mm（33.2%），并生成了更真实的长期预测。
AI.conclusion: 通过将物体条件化和社交编码统一融合进扩散模型框架，OCSD有效解决了复杂场景中融合物体信息和社交交互进行轨迹预测的难题，在准确性和预测真实性两方面均超越了现有方法。

title: Ultra Low-Power, Lightweight, Probabilistic RSS-Based Path Reconstruction: A System for Landscape-Scale Bee Tracking
summary: Applications in fields such as movement ecology, Internet of Things or robotics share the need for systems that localize devices that are too small and power constrained to implement GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems). Alternative low-power localization methods often rely on only measurements of RSS (Received Signal Strength) to infer the AoA (Angle of Arrival) of a transmitted radio frequency signal, but are limited by range and the power demand of the large number of RSS measurements required to infer an accurate AoA.
