In this paper we address these issues with a novel RSS-based method for tracking ultra lightweight and low-power moving receivers across a complex landscape, achieved by using a minimal number of RSS measurements from simple rotating high-gain transmitters with a range of 300m, and applying probabilistic modelling to infer their AoA. The receiver's movement path is then modelled using a Gaussian process and reconstructed using doubly stochastic variational inference, resulting in approximately 15m accuracy tracking of receivers weighing 38mg (including power source) over a scalable landscape range while consuming less than 180uW, increased to approximately 10m accuracy at less than 600uW by taking more RSS measurements. We anticipate that this method will support fields such as the behavioural study of flying insect species, which we demonstrate by applying the system to track Bombus terrestris nest return flights.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于RSS的轻量级低功耗移动接收器跟踪方法，利用旋转高增益发射器的少量RSS测量推断到达角（AoA），并通过高斯过程和双重随机变分推断重建运动轨迹，在300m范围内实现约15m（180µW）至10m（600µW）的跟踪精度，可用于如蜜蜂等飞虫的行为研究。
AI.motivation: 在运动生态学、物联网和机器人等领域，需要定位那些体积太小且功耗受限而无法实现GNSS的设备。现有基于RSS推断AoA的低功耗定位方法受限于测量范围和大量RSS测量带来的功耗负担。
AI.method: 采用旋转高增益发射器发射射频信号，以极少量RSS测量获取信息；通过概率建模推断AoA；使用高斯过程建模接收器运动路径，并通过双重随机变分推断进行路径重建。
AI.result: 该系统能够在300m范围内以约15m精度跟踪重量仅38mg（含电源）的接收器，功耗低于180µW；通过增加RSS测量可达到约10m精度但功耗升至600µW以下。系统已成功应用于跟踪Bombus terrestris回巢飞行。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为超轻量、低功耗设备提供了可扩展范围的精准跟踪方案，有望支持飞虫等小型物种的行为学研究以及其他类似领域的应用。

title: Evaluating human and LLM screening workflows in a conceptually complex scoping review: Recall--workload trade-offs and run-to-run consistency
summary:
Background. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for screening in evidence synthesis, where false negatives can remove relevant studies before full-text assessment. We compared human and LLM title-and-abstract screening workflows in a preregistered study embedded in a conceptually complex scoping review.
  Methods. After a conservative title-only screen, 1,131 records were screened by one review lead, four trained assistants screening non-overlapping subsets, and seven complete LLM runs using different models and processing configurations, including a nominally identical repeat run. We compared retained workload, operational recall against 316 verified eligible records, agreement, run-to-run consistency, and procedural burden. Because eligibility was verified only for records advanced and assessed in the parent review, recall estimates were operational.
  Results. No workflow recovered all verified eligible records. The human workflows and two GPT-5.4 file-batch runs retained 42.2-45.0% of records while achieving 82.3-82.9% recall. Gemini 3.1 file batches achieved the highest recall (83.9%) but retained 56.7% of records. All-at-once configurations recovered fewer eligible records than corresponding file-batch configurations. Two nominally identical GPT-5.4 file-batch runs agreed on 91.7% of records but differed on 94 records, including 29 verified eligible records retained by only one run.
  Discussion. LLM screening performance depended on the implemented workflow, not model identity alone. Processing configuration, workload, record-level variation, and human-LLM decision integration are therefore substantive properties of deployed systems. For high-recall tasks, LLMs are better suited to validated, auditable, human-supervised workflows than autonomous exclusion.

AI.tldr: 在一项概念复杂的范围综述中，比较了人类和LLM标题-摘要筛选工作流，发现LLM筛选性能取决于实施的工作流而非仅模型本身，且没有任何工作流能找回所有已验证的合格记录；对于高召回任务，LLM更适合作为人类监督下的可审计工作流而非自主排除工具。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于证据综合的筛选环节，但假阴性可能在不进行全文评估前就移除相关研究。现有研究缺乏在实际复杂综述场景中对人类和LLM筛选工作流的系统性比较，尤其是在概念复杂的范围综述中，LLM筛选性能是否可靠、可重复仍不明确。
AI.method: 在一项预注册的、嵌入概念复杂范围综述的研究中，对1,131条记录进行了比较：由一名综述负责人、四名经过训练的助理（分别筛选不重叠的子集）以及七种不同的LLM运行（使用不同模型和不同的处理配置，包括名义上相同的重复运行）进行标题-摘要筛选。比较指标包括保留工作量、操作召回率（相对于316条已验证合格记录）、一致性、运行间一致性以及程序负担。
AI.result: 没有任何工作流能找回所有已验证的合格记录。人类工作流和两个GPT-5.4文件批次运行保留了42.2-45.0%的记录，召回率达82.3-82.9%；Gemini 3.1文件批次达到最高召回率（83.9%）但保留了56.7%的记录；一次性处理配置比对应的文件批次配置找回的合格记录更少；两个名义上相同的GPT-5.4文件批次运行在91.7%的记录上一致，但在94条记录上存在差异，其中包括29条仅被其中一次运行保留的已验证合格记录。
AI.conclusion: LLM筛选性能取决于实施的工作流，而非仅模型身份。处理配置、工作量、记录级变异以及人机决策整合是部署系统的实质属性。对于高召回任务，LLM更适合作为经过验证、可审计、人类监督的工作流的一部分，而非自主排除工具。

title: Benchmarking Clinical Decision Pathway Adherence in Large Language Models
summary: Following clinical decision pathways (CDPs) defined by clinical practice guidelines is essential for safe and reliable medical decision-making. However, existing medical large language model (LLM) benchmarks mainly evaluate final-answer accuracy, providing limited evaluation of models' ability to adhere to guidelines. To address this gap, we introduce MEGA-CDP, a benchmark for evaluating whether medical LLMs can generate guideline-adherent CDPs using provided guidelines as references. MEGA-CDP is constructed from 2,274 English and Chinese clinical practice guidelines through a guideline-to-case pipeline, yielding 42,353 clinical cases with explicit reference CDPs. It supports both single-turn vignette and multi-turn interactive settings, and introduces a CDP-oriented evaluation framework for measuring pathway consistency. Experiments on 16 representative LLMs show that reliable clinical decision support remains challenging for current models, demonstrating the need for CDP-oriented evaluation and the value of MEGA-CDP for advancing guideline adherence in medical LLMs.

AI.tldr: MEGA-CDP是一个用于评估医学大语言模型能否依据临床实践指南生成循证临床决策路径（CDP）的基准，包含42,353个临床案例，支持单轮和多轮交互评估，实验表明当前模型在指南遵循方面仍面临挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有医学大语言模型基准主要评估最终答案的准确性，缺乏对模型遵循临床实践指南能力（即能否生成符合指南的临床决策路径）的系统性评估，而遵循指南对安全可靠的临床决策至关重要。
AI.method: 从2,274份中英文临床实践指南出发，通过"指南到案例"（guideline-to-case）流水线构建基准，生成42,353个带有明确参考CDP的临床案例；支持单轮临床情境和多轮交互两种设置；引入CDP导向的评估框架来衡量路径一致性；在16个代表性大语言模型上进行实验。
AI.result: 在16个代表性LLM上的实验表明，当前模型在生成指南遵循的临床决策路径方面仍不可靠，说明可靠临床决策支持对现有模型而言仍具挑战性。
AI.conclusion: MEGA-CDP填补了医学LLM指南遵循评估的空白，证明了CDP导向评估的必要性，并为推进医学LLM的指南遵循能力提供了有价值的基准工具。

title: Anatomy-Guided Foundation Model Adaptation with Within-Case Prototype Supervision for Standard Plane Detection in Fetal Ultrasound Blind Sweeps
summary: Detecting the fetal abdominal circumference standard plane in low-cost obstetric blind sweeps is a highly imbalanced frame-classification problem: positive frames account for under 3% of a sequence, form short contiguous segments, and are poorly handled by off-the-shelf ultrasound and vision foundation models. We propose AnatoProto, a lightweight sequence-level framework that adapts a frozen BiomedCLIP encoder to fetal blind sweeps through four components: (i) anatomy-weighted spatial pooling that uses nnU-Net abdominal-region probabilities as a spatial prior to reweight BiomedCLIP patch tokens, so frozen semantic features are aggregated onto anatomically meaningful regions; (ii) a within-case prototype loss that pulls each frame embedding toward the mean of positive frames of the same sweep, exploiting case-level structure unavailable at the frame level; (iii) a three-stage cascade refinement (frame->segment->case-level rejecter) that lifts the prediction unit from noisy frames to structurally-constrained segments; and (iv) a hybrid prediction head that jointly models per-frame stability and inter-frame boundary transitions to suppress boundary false positives. On the ACOUSLIC-AI benchmark, AnatoProto reaches a test F1 of 67.72, outperforming the strongest foundation-model baseline (FetalCLIP + PRS, F1 = 54.52) by +13.20 F1 and the strongest video temporal-action-detection baseline (TriDet + PRS) by +15.76 F1. A synergy study, backed by embedding geometry and paired-bootstrap confidence intervals, shows that the prototype loss and anatomy-weighted pooling are not additive: applied alone the prototype loss reduces recall by 12 points, but combined with anatomy-weighted pooling it increases recall by 6.5 points -- a sign-flip we trace to the accuracy of the within-case prototype.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnatoProto，一种轻量级序列级框架，用于在低成本产科盲扫超声中检测胎儿腹围标准平面。该框架通过解剖加权空间池化、样例内原型损失、三级级联细化和混合预测头四个组件，适配冻结的BiomedCLIP编码器，在ACOUSLIC-AI基准上达到67.72的测试F1，超过最强基础模型基线13.20 F1。有趣的是，研究发现原型损失与解剖加权池化存在非加性协同效应：单独使用时原型损失使召回率下降12个百分点，但两者结合时召回率反而提高6.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 在低成本产科盲扫超声中检测胎儿腹围标准平面是一个高度类别不平衡的帧分类问题：阳性帧在序列中占比不足3%，形成短连续片段，且现成的超声与视觉基础模型对该任务处理效果不佳。现有方法缺乏针对此类高度不平衡、具有序列级结构特点的检测方案，需要更有效的轻量级框架来提升检测性能。
AI.method: AnatoProto由四个核心组件构成：(i)解剖加权空间池化，利用nnU-Net腹围区域概率作为空间先验重新加权BiomedCLIP的patch token，将冻结语义特征聚合到解剖学意义区域；(ii)样例内原型损失，将每帧嵌入拉向同一扫描中阳性帧的均值，利用帧级不可用的样例级结构；(iii)三级级联细化（帧→段→样例级拒绝器），将预测单元从不稳定的帧提升到受结构约束的段；(iv)混合预测头，联合建模帧内稳定性与帧间边界转换，抑制边界假阳性。
AI.result: 在ACOUSLIC-AI基准上，AnatoProto达到测试F1值67.72，比最强基础模型基线（FetalCLIP + PRS，F1=54.52）高出13.20 F1，比最强视频时间动作检测基线（TriDet + PRS）高出15.76 F1。消融与协同研究发现原型损失和解剖加权池化并非简单加性：单独应用原型损失使召回率降低12个百分点，但结合解剖加权池化后反而使召回率提高6.5个百分点，这种符号翻转可归因于样例内原型的准确性。
AI.conclusion: AnatoProto通过轻量级序列级框架与冻结基础模型的结合，有效解决了高度不平衡的超声盲扫帧分类问题，大幅超越现有最强基线。更重要的是，协同研究揭示了组件之间非加性的交互效应，说明在高度不平衡的医学影像任务中，空间先验与样例级结构信息的正确组合比简单堆叠方法更为关键。

title: Inductive Correlation Clustering with Graph Neural Networks
summary:
Correlation Clustering (CC) is a natural formulation of clustering in combinatorial optimization, which uses a graph representation of the input and does not require a pre-specified number of clusters. Given $n$ objects and a pairwise similarity function, the goal is to cluster the objects so that similar objects are put in the same cluster and dissimilar objects are put in different clusters. Despite its versatility, existing CC algorithms suffer from significant scalability issues and are inherently transductive: i.e., the algorithm must be executed from scratch for any new problem instance.
  In this work, we bridge this gap by leveraging Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to solve Inductive Correlation Clustering, a novel generalization of the CC problem designed to handle unseen graph instances. By learning to exploit common structural patterns and node features during training, our framework generalizes to new graphs drawn from the same distribution with minimal computational overhead with respect to standard algorithms. We demonstrate the effectiveness and scalability of our approach through extensive experiments. Our framework not only excels in the inductive setting, e.g., lowering the inference time up to $5$ order of magnitude, while maintaining an approximation ratio within $~10\%$ of the best baseline solution, but also achieves competitive results on standard (transductive) CC benchmarks. Finally, we showcase a practical application of our framework as a learnable pooling mechanism for graph classification. Our results indicate that our method serves as an efficient pooling layer, enhancing the ability of GNNs to capture hierarchical structural information in networks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用图神经网络（GNNs）解决归纳式相关聚类（Inductive Correlation Clustering）问题，这是对传统相关聚类（CC）问题的泛化，能够处理未见过的图实例。该框架通过训练学习结构模式和节点特征，在保持近似比接近最优解约10%的前提下，推理时间可降低5个数量级，并在标准转导式CC基准上也取得竞争性结果。此外，该框架还可作为可学习的池化机制增强GNN捕获层级结构信息的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的相关聚类（CC）算法存在两个主要问题：一是可扩展性差，难以处理大规模数据；二是本质上是转导式的（transductive），即每次遇到新的问题实例都需要从头重新执行算法，无法利用已有经验。这严重限制了CC在实际场景中的广泛应用。
AI.method: 利用图神经网络（GNNs）学习相关聚类问题中的常见结构模式和节点特征，构建一个归纳式框架，使模型在训练后能够直接对来自同一分布的新图实例进行聚类，无需重新求解优化问题。该框架同时被扩展为图分类中的可学习池化机制。
AI.result: 在归纳式设置下，推理时间最多可降低5个数量级，同时保持接近最优基线解约10%以内的近似比；在标准转导式CC基准上也取得有竞争力的结果；作为池化层时能增强GNN捕获层级结构信息的能力。
AI.conclusion: GNN驱动的归纳式相关聚类框架有效解决了CC的扩展性和转导性瓶颈，既能高效处理大规模新图实例，又能作为通用池化机制提升图分类性能，展示了将组合优化问题与深度学习相结合的巨大潜力。

title: Learning-Augmented Online Allocation under Unreliable Advice: Robustness, Exposure Fairness, and Distribution Shift
summary: Learning-augmented algorithms improve online decisions using predictions, but unreliable advice may harm efficiency and fairness. We study an online allocation problem with finite candidate sets, irreversible decisions, and exposure constraints. We propose a robust and fair rule combining advice with a conservative fallback and fairness correction. Under bounded-error assumptions, we prove consistency and robustness with loss proportional to prediction error. Experiments show stability under adversarial advice and significant reductions in exposure disparity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线分配问题（有限候选集、不可逆决策、暴露约束），提出一种结合预测建议、保守回退和公平校正的鲁棒公平规则，在预测有界误差下证明了一致性和鲁棒性，损失与预测误差成正比，实验表明该方法在对抗性建议下保持稳定并显著减少暴露差异。
AI.motivation: 现有的学习增强算法依赖预测建议来改进在线决策，但不可靠的建议可能损害效率和公平性。在线分配问题中，决策涉及有限候选集、不可逆性和暴露约束，如何在建议不可靠时仍保证算法性能是一个关键挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种鲁棒且公平的分配规则，包含三个核心成分：利用预测建议指导决策、采用保守回退机制防止不良建议造成的损害、加入公平校正项以减小暴露差异。在预测有界误差假设下进行理论分析。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，算法具有一致性（预测准确时性能最优）和鲁棒性（预测错误时损失有界），且损失与预测误差成线性比例关系。实验验证了该方法在对抗性建议下仍能保持稳定性，并显著降低了暴露差异（公平性指标）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为学习增强的在线分配问题提供了一种兼顾效率与公平的鲁棒解决方案，通过保守回退与公平校正机制有效化解了不可靠预测带来的风险，为该类问题提供了理论与实践的双重支撑。

title: Not Just Reason, Not Just Scan: Reinforcement Learning for Proactive Scientific Error Verification over Academic Paper
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly capable scientific assistants, yet they remain far from fully autonomous research. This transition requires models to actively inspect academic papers, build global evidence views, and make traceable judgments without prespecified issues or evidence. However, existing work provides limited task paradigms or training studies for such issue- and evidence-absent verification. We study this challenge through scientific error detection, where models must determine whether errors exist and justify them with evidence-based reasoning. To fill this gap, we present VERA-RL, a reinforcement-learning formulation for scientific error detection over academic papers. Following a Reason--Verify--Scan progression, we construct VERA-13K, a 12,900-sample dataset organized into 4,300 matched chains, covering 6 scientific-error categories across the research workflow and broad natural-science domains. We further introduce fine-grained rewards for reasoning completeness, evidence alignment, and error precision. Training Qwen3-VL-8B with VERA-RL substantially improves verifiable reasoning, approaching flagship MLLMs such as Gemini 3 Pro and Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B on Scan.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERA-RL，一个用于学术论文科学错误检测的强化学习框架。通过Reason–Verify–Scan三段式流程构建了包含12,900个样本的VERA-13K数据集，并引入细粒度奖励函数（推理完整性、证据对齐、错误精确度）。用VERA-RL训练Qwen3-VL-8B后，在Scan任务上显著提升了可验证推理能力，逼近Gemini 3 Pro和Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B等旗舰模型。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）虽然已成为越来越强大的科学助手，但距完全自主研究仍相去甚远。实现这一转变要求模型能够主动检查学术论文、构建全局证据视图，并在没有预设问题或证据的情况下做出可追溯的判断。然而现有工作在"问题与证据皆缺"的验证场景下，缺乏相应的任务范式或训练研究。
AI.method: （1）提出VERA-RL，一种面向学术论文科学错误检测的强化学习框架；（2）按照Reason–Verify–Scan的递进流程构建VERA-13K数据集，包含12,900个样本、4,300条匹配链，覆盖6类科学错误类别，横跨研究全流程及广泛的自然科学领域；（3）引入三类细粒度奖励：推理完整性奖励、证据对齐奖励和错误精确度奖励。
AI.result: 使用VERA-RL训练Qwen3-VL-8B，显著提升了模型的可验证推理能力，在Scan基准上逼近Gemini 3 Pro和Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B等旗舰级多模态大语言模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: VERA-RL通过强化学习与细粒度奖励设计，有效填补了"问题与证据皆缺"场景下科学错误检测的任务与训练空白，证明了小规模模型（8B）经由针对性RL训练可在可验证科学推理上接近甚至达到旗舰模型的水平，为推进MLLMs向全自主科学研究助手迈进的路径提供了可行方案。

title: Video-OPSD: Exploiting Privileged Visual Evidence for On-Policy Self-Distillation in Video Large Language Models
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) has recently emerged as an effective post-training paradigm that improves policy optimization through dense token-level supervision from a privileged self-teacher. Despite its promise, OPSD remains largely underexplored for Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs). Existing methods typically construct privileged teachers by augmenting their context with additional information while keeping the primary input unchanged for both teacher and student. Video reasoning, however, offers a distinct source of privileged supervision within the primary input itself: long videos contain substantial temporal redundancy, and only a small subset of frames provides the evidence necessary to answer a question. Building on this observation, we present $\textbf{Video-OPSD}$, an OPSD framework that exploits privileged visual evidence for both self-teacher construction and knowledge transfer. First, our Evidence-Grounded Self-Teacher conditions the teacher exclusively on annotated evidence frames while the student continues to reason over the complete video. This focused visual input enables the teacher to provide more informative supervision. Second, our Evidence-Guided Token Optimization adaptively weights token-level distillation according to each reasoning token's reliance on privileged visual evidence, thereby emphasizing perceptually grounded reasoning. Experiments across video understanding and reasoning benchmarks show that $\textbf{Video-OPSD}$ consistently improves upon Standard OPSD across multiple backbones and achieves performance comparable to GRPO while requiring substantially less training time, establishing an effective and efficient post-training approach for Video-LLMs.

AI.tldr: Video-OPSD是一个针对视频大语言模型（Video-LLMs）的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）后训练框架。它利用长视频中的时间冗余特性，通过证据锚定的自教师（Evidence-Grounded Self-Teacher）和证据引导的令牌优化（Evidence-Guided Token Optimization）来提供更密集、更有效的监督信号，在多个基准上优于标准OPSD，且性能与GRPO相当但训练时间大幅减少。
AI.motivation: OPSD在文本和图像领域已展现出对策略优化的提升效果，但在Video-LLMs上尚未被充分探索。现有OPSD方法通常通过向上下文添加额外信息来构建特权教师，而视频推理本身提供了一个独特的机会：长视频中存在大量时间冗余，仅有少数关键帧包含回答问题的证据。作者希望利用这一现象，从视频的原始输入中提取特权视觉证据，用于构建更强大的自教师并指导知识迁移。
AI.method: Video-OPSD包含两个核心组件：(1) 证据锚定的自教师（Evidence-Grounded Self-Teacher）：教师模型仅基于标注的证据帧进行推理，而学生模型在全视频上推理，从而让教师提供更聚焦、更具信息量的监督信号；(2) 证据引导的令牌优化（Evidence-Guided Token Optimization）：根据每个推理令牌对特权视觉证据的依赖程度，自适应地加权令牌级别的蒸馏损失，强调感知层面的推理。
AI.result: 在视频理解与推理基准上的实验表明，Video-OPSD在多个骨干网络上均稳定优于标准OPSD，性能与GRPO相当，但训练时间显著减少。
AI.conclusion: Video-OPSD通过在主输入内部挖掘特权视觉证据来构建自教师和指导知识迁移，为Video-LLMs提供了一种既有效又高效的后训练方案，填补了OPSD在视频领域的研究空白。

title: Diffusion Policies for Short-Horizon Planning in Robot Crowd Navigation
summary: Robot crowd navigation requires safe and efficient decision-making under dense, dynamic, and multimodal human--robot interactions. Existing reinforcement-learning methods typically output a single reactive action at each timestep, which limits their ability to represent diverse short-term avoidance strategies. We propose Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization (PDPO), an offline-to-online reinforcement-learning framework that uses a diffusion policy to generate short-horizon action chunks for crowd navigation. PDPO is first pretrained on collision-avoidance demonstrations and then fine-tuned online with PPO by treating the denoising process as an internal decision process. During execution, the policy generates a five-step action chunk and applies it in a receding-horizon manner. Furthermore, we observe an evaluation artifact in common crowd-navigation benchmarks: without explicit boundary constraints, learned agents may leave the valid domain and bypass dense crowds. To address this, we introduce a setting in which boundary violations are treated as collisions. Experiments show that PDPO obtains an improved success rate over strong baselines, and ablations demonstrate that action chunks are especially important for the modified bounded benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PDPO（Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization），一个离线到在线的强化学习框架，利用扩散策略生成短时域动作块用于机器人人群导航。该框架先通过避碰演示进行预训练，再使用PPO进行在线微调，将去噪过程视为内部决策过程。实验表明PDPO相较强基线取得了更高的成功率，且消融实验证明在修改的有界基准中动作块尤为重要。
AI.motivation: 现有基于强化学习的人群导航方法在每个时间步仅输出单一反应性动作，这限制了智能体在密集、动态、多模态人机交互场景中表达多样化短期避障策略的能力。单一动作无法充分建模复杂交互下的多模态避让行为，需要新的决策框架来增强短期规划的表现力。
AI.method: 提出Planning Diffusion Policy Optimization (PDPO)框架：1）采用扩散策略生成短时域（五步）动作块，而非单步动作；2）先在碰撞避免演示数据上进行离线预训练；3）再通过PPO在线微调，将扩散模型中的去噪过程视为内部决策过程；4）执行时采用滚动时域（receding-horizon）方式，每次生成五步动作块并逐步应用；5）此外，识别出基准测试中的评估伪影——无显式边界约束时智能体会离开有效区域绕开密集人群，因此引入将边界违规视为碰撞的新设置。
AI.result: 实验在人群导航基准上验证了PDPO框架：相较强基线方法，PDPO在改进的有界基准中取得了更高的成功率；消融研究表明动作块在修正后的有界基准场景中尤为关键，证明了短时域规划对边界约束下人群导航的重要性。
AI.conclusion: PDPO通过将扩散策略与PPO强化学习相结合，利用动作块进行短时域规划，有效提升了人群导航智能体的避障成功率和决策质量。同时，论文揭示并修正了现有基准中边界约束缺失的评估伪影，为人群导航研究提供了更严格和公平的评测设置。

title: AI agents in Algorithmic Electricity Markets: On the Emergence of Tacit Collusion
summary: As electricity market participants increasingly adopt learning-based agents for their bidding strategies, electricity markets are becoming algorithmic. Evidence from algorithmic markets in other domains shows that tacit collusion can arise purely through independent learning. Moreover, electricity markets are typically oligopolistic and feature repeated interaction among a small number of participants, making them structurally susceptible to non-competitive behavior. In the face of these observations, this paper investigates the hypothesis that tacit collusion may emerge in electricity markets where participants' actions are controlled by autonomous learning-based algorithms. We model strategic bidding as a repeated game with imperfect public monitoring, and model the participants' emergent behavior using multi-agent reinforcement learning. We propose a multi-dimensional set of criteria (going beyond profit comparisons against Nash equilibria) to assess whether the resulting behavior constitutes tacit collusion. Our experimental results showcase that such a danger is realistic for electricity markets: there are cases where agents do learn to sustain supra-competitive outcomes that are supportive of tacit collusion indicators, even though the agents were never instructed to collude.

AI.tldr: 本文研究电力市场中基于学习算法的智能体是否可能通过独立学习自发形成默契合谋（隐性串谋）。作者将策略性投标建模为具有不完美公共监测的重复博弈，并使用多智能体强化学习模拟参与者行为，提出了超越利润比较的多维评估标准。实验表明，即使在智能体从未被指示合谋的情况下，它们也能学会维持超竞争的产出，表现出支持默契合谋指标的行为。
AI.motivation: 随着电力市场参与者越来越多地采用基于学习的智能体进行投标决策，市场正变得算法化。其他领域的算法市场证据表明，纯粹通过独立学习即可产生默契合谋。而电力市场通常是寡头垄断结构，参与者数量少且存在重复互动，在结构上容易受到非竞争行为的影响。这一观察促使作者研究默契合谋是否可能在由自主学习算法控制的市场中自发涌现。
AI.method: 将策略性投标建模为具有不完美公共监测的重复博弈；使用多智能体强化学习（MARL）对参与者的涌现行为进行建模；提出一套多维度的评估标准（超越与纳什均衡的利润比较），用于判定所产生行为是否构成默契合谋。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，在电力市场中确实存在默契合谋的现实危险：某些情况下，即使智能体从未被明确指示进行合谋，它们也能学会维持支持默契合谋指标的超竞争结果。
AI.conclusion: 学习型投标算法在电力市场中有可能自发产生默契合谋行为，这种风险是现实存在的。该发现对电力市场的监管与设计具有重要的政策启示，需要关注算法化市场中的竞争秩序维护问题。

title: Which Metrics Save the Most Human Annotation? Prediction-Powered Evaluation and Meta-Evaluation
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 (Main). Code available: https://github.com/CHATS-lab/ppi-eval
summary: Across various non-verifiable tasks, human evaluation is reliable but expensive, while automatic metrics are more scalable but often biased. Building on prediction-powered inference (PPI), we propose prediction-powered evaluation, a framework that combines limited human judgments with large-scale automatic scores to obtain data-efficient system comparisons that are provably unbiased. We develop parametric and non-parametric procedures, analyze the efficiency trade-off between paired and unpaired designs, and validate the framework on six WMT datasets. We further introduce the Prediction-Powered Saving Ratio (PPSR), a meta-metric that measures how much human annotation an automatic metric can save when used within prediction-powered evaluation. PPSR directly targets metric utility for prediction-powered evaluation and yields more discriminative and stable metric rankings than existing system-level meta-metrics. Overall, our new paradigm reframes automatic metrics as tools for reducing human annotation cost rather than replacing human judgment, and applies broadly to non-verifiable tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出预测驱动评估（PPE）框架，将少量人工判断与大规模自动评分结合，实现无偏且数据高效的系统比较；同时引入PPSR元指标衡量自动指标在PPE框架中节省人工标注的效率。
AI.motivation: 在非可验证任务中，人工评估可靠但成本高，自动指标虽可扩展但存在偏差。现有方法无法同时兼顾两者的优势，需要一种框架既能利用自动指标的可扩展性，又能保证评估的无偏性。
AI.method: 基于预测驱动推断（PPI）提出预测驱动评估（PPE）框架：开发参数化和非参数化两种程序，分析配对与非配对设计的效率权衡，在六个WMT数据集上进行验证；并引入PPSR元指标量化自动指标在PPE中能节省的人工标注量。
AI.result: 在六个WMT数据集上验证了PPE框架的有效性；PPSR相较于现有系统级元指标，能产生更具区分力和稳定性的指标排名。
AI.conclusion: 该范式重新定义了自动指标的角色——作为降低人工标注成本的工具而非替代人工判断，广泛适用于非可验证任务。

title: Beyond Classification: Task-Dependent Learnability under Privacy-Motivated Image Transformations
summary: Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) in computer vision often rely on noise or image perturbations to protect visual data while securely processing it, creating a trade-off between task performance and protection. This trade-off is commonly evaluated using image classification, which primarily captures semantic separability and remains robust despite significant geometric, spatial layout or local boundary alterations. As a result, it is too simplistic as a proxy for generic vision tasks. Exhaustive downstream-task evaluation, however, is computationally expensive because models must often be trained for each PET transformation and parameter setting. We therefore propose a compute-aware multi-task protocol for evaluating PETs in model training. It combines lightweight proxy tasks that target complementary aspects of visual structure while remaining simple and fast to compute. Across irreversible privacy transformations, key-based block primitives, and learnable image encryption schemes, we demonstrate that PETs with similar classification accuracy can differ substantially on other tasks. The outcomes highlight the need for PET evaluation protocols that move beyond classification-only reporting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种计算感知的多任务评估协议，用于在模型训练中评估隐私增强技术（PETs），通过轻量级代理任务捕捉视觉结构的不同互补方面，超越仅依赖图像分类的传统评估方式。
AI.motivation: 计算机视觉中的隐私增强技术（PETs）通常依赖噪声或图像扰动，在任务性能与保护效果之间产生权衡。传统的评估主要基于图像分类，但分类主要捕捉语义可分性，对几何、空间布局或局部边界变化不敏感，过于简单而无法作为通用视觉任务的代理。然而对每个PET变换和参数设置训练模型进行全面下游任务评估计算成本过高。
AI.method: 提出一个计算感知的多任务评估协议，结合轻量级代理任务，这些任务针对视觉结构的互补方面（如几何、空间布局、局部边界等），同时保持简单且计算快速，用于评估PETs在模型训练中的表现。
AI.result: 在不可逆隐私变换、基于密钥的块级基元以及可学习图像加密方案上，证明了具有相似分类准确率的PETs在其他任务上可能表现差异显著，表明仅依赖分类准确率报告会掩盖重要性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了PETs评估协议需要超越仅基于分类的报告方式，采用更全面的多任务评估方法，以更准确地反映PETs在通用视觉任务中的实际表现。

title: TraceBench: Controlled Evaluation of LLM Agents for Time-Series Root-Cause Attribution
summary: LLM agents are increasingly applied to anomaly detection and root-cause analysis in time-series observations collected from real-world systems; however, their performance on these tasks has not been systematically evaluated under controlled conditions. We introduce TraceBench, a simulation-based framework for generating controlled root-cause attribution tasks. In each generated task, an agent receives time-series observations produced by simulating a physical dynamical system and must determine whether a system parameter was altered during the simulation and, if so, which one. Using TraceBench, we generate tasks from three interpretable mechanical systems and systematically evaluate four LLM agents across controlled experimental conditions, yielding new insights into how these agents analyze time-series observations from dynamical systems. Our results show that agents benefit substantially from domain context and explore data primarily through numerical console output rather than visualizations. We also find that agents generally perform worse when required to produce a Python script that maps each time-series sample to a predicted root-cause label than when they submit predictions directly. We release our datasets, agent trajectories, experimental results, and a leaderboard on our website, tracebench.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TraceBench，一个基于仿真的框架，用于在受控条件下系统评估LLM智能体在时间序列异常检测和根因归因任务上的表现，并揭示了智能体依赖领域上下文、偏向数值输出而非可视化、以及直接提交预测优于生成Python脚本等关键发现。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体已被越来越多地应用于真实系统时间序列数据的异常检测和根因分析，但其在受控条件下的表现尚未被系统评估。现有评估缺乏控制变量，难以可靠衡量智能体的归因能力及其行为特性，因此需要一个可生成受控根因归因任务的基准框架。
AI.method: 提出TraceBench，一种仿真驱动的框架：通过模拟物理动力学系统生成时间序列观测数据，在每次生成的任务中，智能体需要判断系统参数是否在仿真过程中被改变以及具体是哪个参数。基于三个可解释的机械系统生成任务，在受控实验条件下系统评估四个LLM智能体。
AI.result: 研究发现：智能体显著受益于领域上下文的提供；智能体主要通过数值控制台输出（而非可视化）来探索数据；当要求智能体生成Python脚本将每个时间序列样本映射到预测的根因标签时，其表现普遍比直接提交预测更差。数据集、智能体轨迹、实验结果和排行榜已公开于tracebench.github.io。
AI.conclusion: TraceBench为LLM智能体的时间序列根因归因能力提供了首个受控的评估基准，揭示了智能体在此类任务上的行为特征和局限性，为未来改进智能体设计与评估提供了基准平台和数据资源。

title: Counterfactual Bias Testing for Application Tracking System
summary: Automated candidate-job matching systems are increasingly classified as high-risk AI under emerging regulation, yet auditing them for demographic bias is expensive: classical correspondence-audit studies require hand-crafted resumes and manual submission, which does not scale to fast pipeline retraining cycles. This paper presents a general, reusable methodology that (1) uses task-specialized LLM agents to synthesize identity-neutral base resumes and inject controlled demographic treatments across five protected-characteristic axes (sex/gender, age, residence, language, disability), producing a K x (1+N) correspondence-audit matrix; (2) qualitatively flags inferred protected characteristics per an EU AI Act-aligned prompt; (3) ranks candidates against a job description via a fine-tuned sentence-embedding model and cosine similarity; and (4) computes a nine-metric fairness suite spanning counterfactual (score delta, mean absolute rank change, flip rate), group-fairness (top-K retention, four-fifths/impact ratio), and merit-aware (Recall@K, nDCG@K, equal opportunity, equalized odds) families, each with bootstrap confidence intervals, significance tests, and Benjamini-Hochberg correction, culminating in an automated PASS/INVESTIGATE/FAIL report with a composite risk score. On an example corpus of 5 job orders, 100 base candidates, and 10 demographic treatments (90 metric x variant evaluations): score shifts, top-K retention, and merit-aware rate gaps stay within tolerance for every treatment, but a rank-stability metric (MARC) and nDCG@K each surface borderline findings - including one on the neutral baseline itself - that a score- or retention-only view would miss. The results argue for multi-metric, multi-family auditing over any single aggregate score, and for LLM-agent-generated audits as a practical, low-cost complement to human-curated audits for any candidate-job matching pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种通用的、基于LLM代理的自动化候选人-职位匹配系统偏见审计方法，通过合成简历、注入人口统计特征、计算九项公平性指标并生成PASS/INVESTIGATE/FAIL报告，在多指标评估中发现单一指标遗漏的边缘性偏见发现。
AI.motivation: 候选人-职位匹配系统在欧盟新法规下被列为高风险AI，但传统对应审计方法（人工编写简历、手动提交）成本高昂、无法扩展以适应快速模型迭代周期，亟需一种可规模化、低成本的自动化审计方法。
AI.method: (1) 使用任务专用LLM代理合成身份中立基线简历并沿五个受保护特征轴（性别/年龄/居住地/语言/残疾）注入受控人口统计处理，生成K×(1+N)对应审计矩阵；(2) 按欧盟AI法案对齐的提示词定性标记推断的受保护特征；(3) 通过微调句子嵌入模型和余弦相似度对职位描述进行候选人排序；(4) 计算覆盖反事实（分数差、平均绝对排名变化、翻转率）、群体公平（Top-K保留率、4/5影响比）和绩效感知（Recall@K、nDCG@K、均等机会、均等几率）三个家族的九项指标，并附带bootstrap置信区间、显著性检验和Benjamini-Hochberg校正，最终输出带综合风险评分的自动PASS/INVESTIGATE/FAIL报告。
AI.result: 在5个职位订单、100个基线候选人、10个人口统计处理的示例语料库（90个指标×变体评估）上，分数偏移、Top-K保留率和绩效感知差距对所有处理均在容差范围内，但排名稳定性指标（MARC）和nDCG@K均浮现边界性发现——包括中性基线本身上的一个发现——这些是仅看分数或保留率的单指标审计所会错过的。
AI.conclusion: 结果论证了多指标、多家族审计优于任何单一聚合分数，并且LLM代理生成的审计是任何候选人-职位匹配管道中人工策划审计的实用、低成本补充方案。

title: Information-Guided Frontier Decoding: Contextual Utility-Driven Commitment in dMLLMs
summary: Decoding quality in diffusion multimodal language models (dMLLMs) depends heavily on the order in which masked tokens are committed. Existing confidence-based strategies prioritize locally easy tokens, but confidence does not necessarily reflect contextual usefulness. As a result, structurally easy tokens such as punctuation may be committed before informative semantic anchors, weakening context propagation and increasing error accumulation. We propose Information-Guided Frontier Decoding (IGFD), a training-free decoding strategy that ranks candidates using token confidence, neighborhood uncertainty, and structural commitment risk. IGFD encourages early commitment of reliable semantic anchors while delaying fragile structural tokens, improving contextual support during decoding. A dynamic candidate frontier further constrains token selection to locally expandable regions under the same decoding budget. The method requires no additional training, auxiliary models, or extra forward passes. Experiments across multimodal understanding, reasoning, grounding, and hallucination benchmarks show that IGFD consistently outperforms existing decoding strategies across the majority of benchmarks and diffusion MLLM backbones under identical decoding budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出信息引导前沿解码（IGFD），一种免训练的解码策略，通过结合token置信度、邻域不确定性和结构承诺风险来排序候选token，优先提交语义锚点、延后脆弱的结构性token，从而提升扩散多模态大语言模型的解码质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）中掩码token的提交顺序对解码质量影响很大。现有基于置信度的策略优先处理局部"简单"token，但置信度并不一定反映上下文的实际有用性，导致标点等结构上容易的token可能先于有信息量的语义锚点被提交，削弱上下文传播并增加错误累积。
AI.method: 提出Information-Guided Frontier Decoding (IGFD)策略：(1) 使用token置信度、邻域不确定性和结构承诺风险三个指标对候选token进行排序；(2) 鼓励早期提交可靠的语义锚点，延后提交脆弱的结构性token；(3) 通过动态候选前沿约束token选择到局部可扩展的区域，在相同解码预算下进行选择；方法免训练、无需辅助模型或额外前向传播。
AI.result: 在多项多模态理解、推理、接地（grounding）和幻觉基准上，IGFD在相同解码预算下，在大多数基准和扩散MLLM骨干网络上一致优于现有解码策略。
AI.conclusion: IGFD通过信息引导的提交顺序优化，在不增加训练成本和前向计算开销的前提下，有效改善了扩散多模态大语言模型的解码质量，验证了显式考虑上下文有用性与结构风险的解码排序策略的有效性。

title: When Interference Graphs Evolve: Doubly Robust Estimation of Dynamic Peer Effects
summary: Peer effects are difficult to estimate when interaction graphs evolve because pre-assignment network history, dynamic peer exposure, and post-assignment network change have distinct causal roles. We introduce a controlled contrast framework that indexes potential outcomes by own treatment, temporally aggregated peer exposure, and a post-assignment evolution summary. Differences between the resulting means define own-treatment, peer-exposure, controlled network-evolution, and joint controlled contrasts rather than a mediation decomposition. We develop the Dynamic Network Doubly Robust estimator, DynaNet-DR, which combines a temporally factorized propensity with normalized augmentation. Under consistency, summary sufficiency, sequential exchangeability, positivity, nuisance convergence, and weak dependence, its canonical estimator is consistent when either the outcome regression or the propensity estimator is consistent. The reported implementation adds representative-score prediction, fixed clipping, and finite-sample stabilization. Semi-synthetic benchmarks on fixed real temporal graph sequences show favorable estimation accuracy among methods targeting the full profile. These benchmarks assess summary-indexed contrasts rather than counterfactual edge generation, and the MathOverflow study is an observational illustration under the stated assumptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个受控对比框架（controlled contrast framework），用于在交互图随时间演化的场景下估计同伴效应。该框架通过将潜在结果索引为自身处理、时间聚合的同伴暴露和分配后网络演化的汇总来区分不同因果作用。在此基础上开发了动态网络双重稳健估计器（DynaNet-DR），结合时间因子化倾向得分与归一化增广，在满足一系列假设下具有双重稳健性质。
AI.motivation: 当交互图演化时，同伴效应的估计面临困难，因为分配前的网络历史、动态同伴暴露和分配后的网络变化在因果上具有不同的作用。现有方法难以区分这些不同因果机制，需要一个新的框架来系统性地刻画和估计这些效应。
AI.method: 提出受控对比框架，将潜在结果按自身处理、时间聚合同伴暴露和分配后演化汇总三类指标进行索引，定义自身处理对比、同伴暴露对比、受控网络演化对比及联合受控对比而非中介分解。开发DynaNet-DR估计器，结合时间因子化倾向得分与归一化增广，并加入代表性分数预测、固定裁剪和有限样本稳定化。
AI.result: 在固定真实时间图序列的半合成基准测试中，该估计器在针对完整画像的方法中具有较好的估计精度；MathOverflow研究作为观测性说明性示例在所述假设下展示了方法的应用。
AI.conclusion: 在一致性、汇总充分性、序列可交换性、正性、干扰收敛性和弱依赖等条件下，典范估计器在结果回归或倾向估计任一者一致时即保持一致（双重稳健）。基准测试评估的是汇总索引对比而非反事实边生成。

title: A Table Is Worth 64 Tokens: Pixel-level Compression for Multi-Table Document Question Answering
summary: Answering questions over real-world documents requires processing long inputs that interleave text with tables. Optical context compression, which represents context as images, promises to reduce token cost, but its effect on table understanding remains unclear. We study pixel-level table compression for question answering over documents with multiple tables, evaluating five VLMs across two benchmarks and five visual-token budgets. Representing tables as images at native resolution matches text in both performance and efficiency, but downscaling them makes models compensate the loss in readability with longer, less effective reasoning traces that cancel the expected savings. Highly downscaled tables, however, preserve enough signal to identify whether they are relevant to a question. We exploit this asymmetry with a training-free, two-step method: the model first identifies the tables needed to answer a question from a pixel-compressed context, and then reasons over those at native resolution. On long documents, our method saves 41% of total tokens and gains 7 accuracy points over single-step QA with native resolution tables. It also uses 15% fewer tokens than the most efficient single-step compressed configuration, with no accuracy loss.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了光学上下文压缩（将表格表示为图片）对多表格文档问答的影响，发现高度压缩的表格虽无法用于推理，但足以判断相关性。据此提出无需训练的两步方法：先用像素压缩上下文识别所需表格，再以原生分辨率对这些表格进行推理。在长文档上节省41%的token并提升7个准确率点，且比最高效的单步压缩配置少用15%的token且无准确率损失。
AI.motivation: 现实文档问答需要处理文本与表格交错的超长输入，光学上下文压缩（将上下文表示为图像）有望降低token成本，但其对表格理解的影响尚不清楚，需要系统性研究。
AI.method: 系统评估了5种VLM在两个基准和5种视觉token预算下的像素级表格压缩表现，并基于"高度压缩的表格仍保留相关性判断信号"这一发现，提出无需训练的两步方法：先从像素压缩上下文中识别回答问题所需的表格，再对这些表格以原生分辨率进行推理。
AI.result: 原生分辨率下表格以图像表示在性能和效率上与文本相当；下采样会让模型用更长但低效的推理链来弥补可读性损失，抵消预期的token节省。所提两步方法在长文档上节省41%总token并提升7个准确率点，同时比最高效的单步压缩配置少用15%的token且无准确率损失。
AI.conclusion: 表格的下采样程度与其用途之间存在不对称性：高度压缩足以做相关性筛选，但原生分辨率才是推理所需的。利用这一不对称性设计的两步方法能同时实现token节省和准确率提升，为长文档表格问答中的光学上下文压缩提供了有效范式。

title: Meta-Learning Where to Allocate Experts: Task-Conditioned Layer-Wise Compression for MoEs
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a subset of expert networks, increasing capacity while keeping per-token computation sparse. In many deployed MoEs, the number of active experts is fixed across layers and tasks, although layer roles and expert redundancy vary with depth and demand varies with difficulty. Existing approaches address only part of this setting: layer-wise allocations are usually determined offline and reused for all tasks, while token-level methods vary expert activation using local routing signals without task-level context. We propose MetaNet, a support-set controller that predicts, for each layer, an expert-retention threshold and a bounded routing bias. The backbone, experts, and router remain frozen. On DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat, MetaNet provides a tunable accuracy-expert-activation trade-off. Relative to fixed k=6, a conservative setting activates 3.61 experts on average (40% fewer) and achieves comparable MMLU accuracy (0.489 vs. 0.474), whereas an aggressive setting activates 2.28 experts on average (62% fewer) with accuracy approximately 3.7 percentage points lower. The MMLU-trained controller also transfers to C-Eval without retraining, activating 2.90 experts on average (52% fewer than fixed k=6) at 0.386 accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出MetaNet，一个支持集控制器，为MoE模型逐层预测专家保留阈值和有界路由偏置，在不训练主干网络、专家和路由器的前提下，动态调整每层的活跃专家数量，实现准确率与专家激活数之间的可调权衡，显著降低推理计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE模型中活跃专家数量在层间和任务间固定不变，但不同层的作用、专家冗余度和任务难度各不相同。已有的层间分配方法离线确定且对所有任务复用，而token级方法仅依赖局部路由信号缺乏任务级上下文，两者都只解决了部分问题。
AI.method: 提出MetaNet，一个支持集控制器（support-set controller），为每一层预测一个专家保留阈值（expert-retention threshold）和有界路由偏置（bounded routing bias）。所有底层组件（主干网络、专家、路由器）保持冻结，仅通过控制器的预测动态调整每层的专家激活数量。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-MoE-16B-Chat上，相较固定k=6的设置：保守配置平均激活3.61个专家（减少40%），MMLU准确率相当（0.489 vs 0.474）；激进配置平均激活2.28个专家（减少62%），准确率下降约3.7个百分点。MMLU训练的控制器可直接迁移到C-Eval（无需重训），平均激活2.90个专家（减少52%），准确率达0.386。
AI.conclusion: MetaNet通过轻量级支持集控制器实现逐层动态专家激活，在保持模型组件冻结的情况下提供可调的准确率-计算权衡，并且训练好的控制器具有良好的跨任务迁移能力。

title: Automated 2D and 3D Segmentation of AMD and DME Lesions in OCT
summary: Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) and diabetic macular edema (DME) are leading causes of vision loss, and optical coherence tomography (OCT) is the standard modality for detecting and monitoring the subtle lesions that drive treatment decisions. Most deep-learning segmentation work for OCT is validated only in-domain, leaving generalization to clinical data collected under different acquisition protocols largely untested. This work develops and systematically ablates four lesion-segmentation pipelines -- 2D and 3D variants for AMD and DME -- reaching Dice scores of 0.76 to 0.82 with strong volumetric and surface calibration (r vol, r surf greater than or equal to 0.97 across all four pipelines) on an in-domain validation set. The ablation process establishes a full-volume, calibration-aware adoption standard that catches mechanisms an ordinary slice-level evaluation would keep, and identifies ensemble composition as the most consistent driver of improvement. To test generalization, the models are evaluated on OLIVES, an external clinical cohort with no lesion-level ground truth, using a proxy-metric framework built around biomarker AUROC, central subfield thickness (CST) correlation, and longitudinal concordance. Predictions track clinical biomarkers outside the training distribution, though less strongly than in-domain -- evidence for, not validation of, automated lesion-burden tracking as a clinical tool.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发并系统消融了四种OCT病变分割流水线（AMD和DME的2D/3D变体），在域内验证集上达到0.76-0.82的Dice分数，并通过域外临床队列OLIVES上的代理指标框架测试了其泛化能力，发现预测能跟踪域外临床生物标志物但效果弱于域内。
AI.motivation: 年龄相关性黄斑变性（AMD）和糖尿病性黄斑水肿（DME）是视力丧失的主要病因，OCT是检测和监测其细微病变的标准手段。然而，大多数深度学习分割工作仅在域内验证，缺乏对不同采集协议下临床数据泛化能力的系统测试，这限制了自动化病变负荷追踪作为临床工具的可靠性评估。
AI.method: 开发并系统消融四种病变分割流水线，包括AMD和DME的2D与3D变体。消融过程建立了全容积、校准感知的采纳标准，以捕捉普通切片级评估可能遗漏的机制。为测试泛化，在无病变级金标准的域外临床队列OLIVES上，使用基于生物标志物AUROC、中央子野厚度（CST）相关性和纵向一致性的代理指标框架进行评估。
AI.result: 四种流水线在域内验证集上达到0.76至0.82的Dice分数，且所有四种流水线的体积和表面校准（r_vol, r_surf ≥ 0.97）表现良好。消融研究确定集成组合是最一致的改进驱动因素。在域外队列OLIVES上，预测虽能追踪临床生物标志物，但相关性弱于域内表现。
AI.conclusion: 预测在训练分布之外仍能跟踪临床生物标志物，但效果不如域内，这为自动化病变负荷追踪作为临床工具提供了证据而非验证。研究强调了全容积、校准感知评估标准的重要性，以及域外泛化测试的必要性。

title: Common Geodesics Do Not Guarantee Fisher Consistency of the Structured SVM: Minimal Counterexamples and a Tree-Metric Classification
summary: A known necessary condition for Fisher consistency of the structured support vector machine requires the task loss to be a metric for which every output triple has a common geodesic point. We show that this condition is not sufficient for the canonical coordinate-wise argmax decoder. A four-output unit star admits an exactly optimal score vector whose maximizers are all strictly non-Bayes, and four outputs are minimal among metrics satisfying the condition. We then completely classify positively weighted tree metrics whose vertex set is the output space: argmax consistency holds if and only if the tree is a path. The failure on branching trees is confined to boundary distributions; every tree retains the argmax property at every full-support distribution. Among metrics satisfying the common-geodesic condition, five outputs are necessary and sufficient for a full-support counterexample; $K_{2,3}$ is the smallest member of an infinite $K_{m,n}$ family. We additionally give a full-support counterexample for the three-dimensional Hamming cube. All optimality claims have exact primal-dual certificates. The counterexamples expose a concrete decoder gap: in this polyhedral setting, an embedding can guarantee the existence of a calibrated link without validating a prescribed argmax link on every surrogate-risk minimizer.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，结构化支持向量机（structured SVM）Fisher一致性的已知必要条件（任务损失需满足公共测地线条件的度量）对于坐标式argmax解码器而言并非充分条件。作者完整分类了正加权树度量上的argmax一致性（仅路径树成立），并给出了最小反例，同时提供了精确的对偶证书。
AI.motivation: 结构化SVM的Fisher一致性依赖于任务损失的度量性质及公共测地线条件，但该条件是否足以保证argmax解码器的一致性尚不清楚。作者希望填补这一理论空白，精确刻画argmax一致性的充分必要条件，并揭示嵌入与解码器之间存在"gap"这一深层理论问题。
AI.method: 通过构造具体反例（四输出的单位星图、K_{2,3}图族、三维Hamming立方体）来证明常见条件不充分；利用凸优化的精确原始-对偶证书验证最优性；通过完整分类正加权树度量，将问题简化为"树是否为路径"的判断；区分边界分布与全支撑分布两类情形分别分析。
AI.result: （1）四输出单位星图即可给出最优评分向量，其最大化器全部严格非Bayes，且四个输出是满足公共测地线条件的最小反例规模；（2）正加权树度量上argmax一致性当且仅当树为路径；（3）分支树上的一致性失效仅发生在边界分布，全支撑分布下所有树仍保持argmax性质；（4）全支撑反例在满足公共测地线条件下需要五个输出，K_{2,3}是K_{m,n}族中最小的成员；（5）三维Hamming立方体也有全支撑反例。
AI.conclusion: 公共测地线条件不足以保证argmax解码器的一致性，说明在该多面体设定下，嵌入只能保证校准链接的存在性，无法保证预先指定的argmax链接在所有代理风险最小化器上都有效——即存在具体的解码器gap。

title: From Atomic to Agentic: Towards Interpretable Evaluation of LLMs' Agentic Mathematical Capabilities
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are evolving from performing end-to-end mathematical reasoning to integrating agentic intelligence. However, most existing math benchmarks evaluate only final answers. This outcome-oriented evaluation provides limited diagnostic value for identifying process-level failures or rigorous logic, failing to guide the transformation of LLMs into robust agents. To bridge this gap, we present a process-level benchmark designed to evaluate the inherent agentic mathematical reasoning abilities of LLMs. Our framework aligns problem-solving agentic behaviors with a structured taxonomy of reusable mathematical atomic capabilities. We design a comprehensive suite of planning, action, and feedback tasks across both textual and multimodal contexts, supported by an automated pipeline that synthesizes high-quality trajectories and produces fine-grained annotations via controlled LLM rewriting. Experiments reveal that models with similar end-to-end accuracy can exhibit markedly different agentic capability profiles. This demonstrates that process-level evaluation is crucial for interpreting the true potential of LLMs and guiding the development of next-generation mathematical agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个过程级（process-level）基准来评估大语言模型在数学推理中的智能体（agentic）能力，而非仅评测最终答案。该框架将问题求解的智能体行为映射到可复用的数学原子能力分类体系，涵盖文本与多模态场景下的规划、行动和反馈任务，并配备自动化流水线合成高质量轨迹和细粒度标注。实验表明，最终答案准确率相似的模型可能表现出截然不同的智能体能力画像。
AI.motivation: 现有数学基准大多只评估最终答案（结果导向），这种评估方式缺乏诊断价值，无法识别推理过程中的过程级错误或逻辑严谨性问题，也难以指导LLM向稳健智能体（agent）的转化升级。
AI.method: （1）构建过程级基准框架，将智能体问题求解行为与可复用数学原子能力的结构化分类体系对齐；（2）设计涵盖文本与多模态场景的规划（planning）、行动（action）、反馈（feedback）任务套件；（3）开发自动化流水线，通过受控的LLM重写来合成高质量推理轨迹并生成细粒度标注。
AI.result: 实验发现，端到端（最终答案）准确率相近的模型，其智能体能力画像可能存在显著差异，说明过程级评估对揭示模型真实潜力至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 过程级评估是解读LLM真实潜力、指导下一代数学智能体开发的关键环节，弥补了结果导向评估的诊断盲区。

title: Do LLMs Understand Personality? Rethinking Persona Fidelity Evaluation through Structured Behavioral Inference
summary: As large language models are increasingly deployed to simulate diverse human characters, ensuring persona fidelity, defined as the extent to which an agent's behavior consistently reflects the psychological and stylistic characteristics of a target persona, has become a critical requirement. However, existing evaluation paradigms primarily rely on either holistic LLM-based judges, which are prone to "holistic appraisal hallucination'', or static psychometric inventories, which fail to capture the context-dependent fidelity required in dynamic dialogue. To address these limitations, we propose PRISM (Persona Reasoning with Inverse SFL-based Modeling), a psycholinguistically grounded framework that reformulates persona fidelity evaluation as a structured inverse inference task. Inspired by Systemic Functional Linguistics (SFL), PRISM decomposes persona fidelity into three functional dimensions: Task Framing, Interpersonal Stance, and Linguistic Style. It estimates dimension-specific evidence over a persona-conditioned label space and aggregates these signals into an interpretable and auditable evaluation process. Experiments show that PRISM yields more accurate and stable judgements than traditional holistic judging, providing a more reliable framework for persona fidelity evaluation.

AI.tldr: PRISM是一个基于系统功能语言学的心理语言学框架，将人物一致性评估重构为结构化逆向推理任务，从任务框架、人际立场和语言风格三个维度分解评估，比传统整体式评判更准确、更稳定。
AI.motivation: 现有的人物一致性评估方法存在两大缺陷：基于LLM的整体式评判容易产生"整体评价幻觉"（holistic appraisal hallucination），而静态心理测量清单无法捕捉动态对话中依赖上下文的一致性。需要一种既能避免幻觉又能在动态场景中准确评估人物一致性的新方法。
AI.method: PRISM将人物一致性评估重构为结构化的逆向推理任务。受系统功能语言学（SFL）启发，它将人物一致性分解为三个功能维度：任务框架（Task Framing）、人际立场（Interpersonal Stance）和语言风格（Linguistic Style）。在每个维度上，通过人物条件化的标签空间估计维度特定的证据，再将各维度信号聚合为可解释、可审计的评估过程。
AI.result: 实验表明，PRISM在评估准确性和稳定性方面均优于传统的整体式评判方法，为人物一致性评估提供了更可靠的框架。
AI.conclusion: PRISM通过心理学与语言学结合的结构化方法论，为解决大语言模型人物一致性评估中的幻觉和上下文依赖问题提供了更可靠、更可解释的替代方案。

title: EditaLive! Unified Character Video Editing for Live Streaming
summary: Conventional video editing primarily focuses on scene-level content, whereas live streaming places greater emphasis on the human subject. However, directly applying existing video-editing methods to human-centric live streaming remains challenging, as they may introduce facial-expression inconsistencies and typically depend on multiple offline inference steps, making them unsuitable for real-time interaction. We propose EditaLive, a novel framework for real-time streaming character video editing. In detail, we start from a pretrained image animation model (Wan-Animate), which naturally decouples appearance from motion, and repurpose it as the base model for instruction-based human-centric video editing by reference frame editing and video reconstruction via the collected CharEdit-50K dataset. Besides, we adapt the model from offline bidirectional to causal streaming generation, and design an aligned self-rollout distillation strategy that compresses the model into a two-step sampler, where fixed RoPE and align forcing reduce training--inference discrepancies, and first-frame preserved sparse attention filters redundant historical information to mitigate appearance drift. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EditaLive delivers state-of-the-art editing performance with faithful preservation of facial expressions and low-latency real-time streaming inference.

AI.tldr: 提出EditaLive，一个面向实时直播场景的角色视频编辑框架。基于图像动画模型Wan-Animate，通过参考帧编辑和视频重建实现指令驱动的人像视频编辑，并将模型从离线双向生成适配为因果流式生成，通过对齐自rollout蒸馏压缩为两步采样器，实现保真面部表情和低延迟实时推理。
AI.motivation: 传统视频编辑主要关注场景级内容，而直播场景更强调人物主体。现有视频编辑方法直接应用于人像直播存在两个核心问题：一是可能产生面部表情不一致，二是依赖多步离线推理，无法满足实时交互需求。
AI.method: 1) 基于预训练图像动画模型Wan-Animate（天然解耦外观与运动）作为基础模型；2) 通过参考帧编辑和视频重建在CharEdit-50K数据集上进行微调；3) 将模型从离线双向生成适配为因果流式生成；4) 设计对齐自rollout蒸馏策略，压缩为两步采样器；5) 使用固定RoPE和对齐forcing减少训练与推理差异；6) 首帧保留稀疏注意力过滤冗余历史信息以缓解外观漂移。
AI.result: 大量实验表明EditaLive在编辑性能上达到最先进水平，同时能忠实地保持面部表情，并实现低延迟的实时流式推理。
AI.conclusion: EditaLive验证了通过因果流式适配、蒸馏压缩和注意力优化，可以将预训练图像动画模型有效转化为实时人像视频编辑框架，兼顾编辑质量、表情保真度和推理速度，为直播场景中的交互式角色编辑提供了可行方案。

title: Profit based evaluation of machine learning for nitrogen recommendations in winter wheat
summary: Nitrogen rates for winter wheat are set before the season, under unknown prices and weather. The standard UK advice does not respond to prices, yet recent price swings moved the most profitable rate by tens of kilograms per hectare. Machine learning is often proposed as the fix. However, it is usually judged on prediction accuracy, and accurate prediction does not by itself make the recommended rate more profitable. Our insight is to score nitrogen advice directly by the profit it forgoes on measured yield response curves. We build a test bench on 892 such curves from two long running UK experiments, and sweep the nitrogen to grain price ratio to cover all price scenarios. On this bench, machine learning fails as a predictor. No model recovers the best rate within farm tolerance, and the benchmark noise shows none can. At normal prices, every model also loses to the standard advice on profit. The gain sits elsewhere. A simple correction step applied after the model cuts profit losses by a quarter, while better models and extra features give no gain. The same frozen correction cuts losses by 43% at the second site without any retraining. A hybrid of standard advice plus a damped correction removes bias and trims rare large losses. The same price sweep also prices emission cuts, at a cost comparable to current carbon prices. Machine learning therefore pays as a profit scored correction to standard advice, not as its replacement.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以利润（而非预测精度）直接评分氮肥推荐策略，构建了基于892条产量响应曲线的测试平台，发现机器学习作为预测器是失败的，但若将其用作标准建议的“修正步骤”，可显著降低利润损失（第一站点降四分之一，第二站点无需重训降43%），并兼具削减排放和规避大额损失的优势。
AI.motivation: 冬小麦施氮量在季节前设定，需在未知价格和天气条件下决策。标准UK建议不响应价格变动，而近期价格波动使最优施氮量变化达每公顷数十公斤。机器学习常被当作解决方案，但其通常以预测精度评判，而高精度预测并不必然带来更高的推荐利润。因此需要直接以利润为导向来评估推荐策略。
AI.method: 以实测产量响应曲线上的“利润损失”（forgone profit）为评分标准，构建包含892条来自两个长期UK试验田的产量响应曲线的测试平台；将氮肥/谷物价格比扫掠以覆盖所有价格情景。在平台上对比标准建议、多种机器学习模型，以及“标准建议+阻尼修正”的混合策略。
AI.result: 机器学习作为独立预测器是失败的：没有任何模型能在农场可容忍误差内恢复最优施氮率，基准噪声表明这不可实现；在正常价格下所有模型利润均不如标准建议。但将该建议作为模型后的简单修正步骤，利润损失减少四分之一；在第二站点不经重训直接使用同一修正使损失减少43%。更好的模型和额外特征并无增益。混合“标准建议+阻尼修正”可去除偏差并削减罕见的大额损失。价格扫掠还显示减排成本与当前碳价相当。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习在氮肥推荐中的价值并不在于替代标准建议，而在于作为“利润评分的修正层”叠加于标准建议之上；这样既能提升利润、降低排放成本，又具备跨站点的泛化稳健性。

title: GraphMemix: Query-Aware Evidence Forests for Long-Term Multimodal Agent Memory
summary: Organizing long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging because existing methods either suffer from expensive question-agnostic offline summaries or naive embedding similarity matching that introduces incomplete and redundant context. To address these issues, we propose GraphMemix, a combinatorial-optimization graph memory framework that models memory organization as query-aware evidence-forest construction. Specifically, our method consists of three key components:(1) candidate graph construction, which expands multi-view seed memories through schema and semantic relations to acquire query-aware original context; (2) evidence utility and activation costs, which decouples direct memory support from anchor-conditioned relation verification to suppress redundant or conflicting information; and (3) forest optimization, which jointly selects a forest-format memory context under a maximum evidence budget and its reliable relational structure. By organizing memory into a query-relevant subgraph, the method avoids substantial lifecycle cost and recovers low-similarity complementary evidence. Experimental results across four long-term multimodal memory benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements with different foundation models and establish a new Pareto frontier between accuracy and lifecycle cost.

AI.tldr: 提出GraphMemix，一种基于组合优化的图记忆框架，将多模态智能体的长期记忆组织建模为查询感知的证据森林构建问题，通过候选图构建、证据效用与激活成本分离、以及森林优化三个组件，在四个基准上取得了准确率与生命周期成本之间的新帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆方法要么依赖昂贵的、与查询无关的离线摘要，要么依赖朴素的嵌入相似度匹配，导致上下文不完整且冗余。需要一种兼顾查询相关性、成本效率和上下文完整性的记忆组织方法。
AI.method: GraphMemix包含三个关键组件：(1) 候选图构建——通过模式和语义关系扩展多视角种子记忆，获取查询感知的原始上下文；(2) 证据效用与激活成本——解耦直接记忆支持与锚定条件的关系验证，抑制冗余或冲突信息；(3) 森林优化——在最大证据预算下联合选择森林格式的记忆上下文及其可靠的关系结构。
AI.result: 在四个长期多模态记忆基准上的实验表明，该方法在不同基础模型下均取得显著提升，并建立了准确率与生命周期成本之间的新帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 通过将记忆组织为查询相关的子图，GraphMemix避免了大规模生命周期成本，并能恢复低相似度的互补性证据，有效解决了现有方法的核心缺陷。

title: FOCUS & RePAIR: Mitigating Text Degeneration via Token-Level Guidance for Pruned Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 as a Spotlight
summary: Pruning is a practical approach to compress large language models (LLMs), but it can amplify text degeneration, especially repetition loops, even when perplexity and task accuracy remain largely unchanged. In this work, we present a token-level analysis of this failure mode by viewing decoding as a dynamical process that enters and persists in a small set of recurrent contexts. Our analysis decomposes degeneration into loop entry risk and loop persistence, and shows that persistence is controlled by the escape mass assigned to plausible alternatives within the token sampling set. Motivated by these findings, we propose two token-level guidance objectives for post-pruning fine-tuning. FOCUS reweights distillation toward high-confidence teacher regions to suppress leakage, while RePAIR uses onset-centered positive/negative continuation pairs with a margin loss to promote plausible alternatives and prevent early commitment to repetition loops. Experiments on open-ended continuation and instruction-based generation show that both methods consistently reduce repetition and improve generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FOCUS和RePAIR两种token级引导目标用于后剪枝微调，以解决LLM剪枝后文本退化（尤其是重复循环）的问题。
AI.motivation: 剪枝能有效压缩大型语言模型，但会导致文本退化（尤其是重复循环），即使困惑度和任务准确率几乎不变。现有方法未从token级动态过程层面解释和解决这一失效模式。
AI.method: 将解码视为动态过程，分解退化为循环进入风险和循环持久性两个维度，提出FOCUS（将蒸馏重新加权到高置信度教师区域以抑制泄漏）和RePAIR（使用起始为中心的正面/负面续写对配合边际损失，促进合理替代并防止过早陷入重复循环）两种token级引导目标用于后剪枝微调。
AI.result: 在开放式续写和指令生成实验中，两种方法均能一致地减少重复并提升生成质量。
AI.conclusion: token级分析与引导目标能有效缓解剪枝引起的文本退化问题，为模型压缩与生成质量之间的权衡提供了新的解决思路。

title: ReViCo: Unveiling the Limitations of VLMs in Visual Text Understanding via Error Correction
summary: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown great success in general visual tasks, yet they still struggle to deeply understand text within images. In this paper, we introduce ReViCo (Real Visual Correction), a benchmark designed to evaluate VLM text understanding through a novel task of visual text error correction. ReViCo challenges models to identify and fix text errors in real-world images, which requires a profound understanding of the interplay between visual text and its surrounding visual context. We benchmark various VLMs using two distinct paradigms: prompt-based strategy and targeted model training, both aimed at pushing the limits of current models. Our experiments reveal a striking performance gap between even the best VLMs and human, and further analysis also shows that most models struggle to accurately perceive the visual text, resulting in frequent correction errors. By highlighting these gaps, ReViCo provides a new benchmark foundation for developing more robust and text-aware VLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReViCo（真实视觉纠正）基准，通过视觉文本错误修正这一新任务评估视觉语言模型（VLM）对图像中文本的深层理解能力。实验表明，即使最先进的VLM与人类表现之间仍存在显著差距，大多数模型难以准确感知视觉文本，导致频繁的纠错错误。
AI.motivation: 尽管VLM在通用视觉任务中表现优异，但它们对图像内文本的理解仍然不足。现有基准缺乏对这一能力的系统评估，因此需要一个专门的基准来揭示和衡量VLM在视觉文本深度理解方面的局限性。
AI.method: 构建ReViCo基准，通过视觉文本错误修正任务评估VLM。采用两种评测范式：基于提示词（prompt-based）的策略和针对性的模型训练（targeted model training），以测试和推动当前模型的极限。
AI.result: 实验发现最优VLM与人类表现之间存在显著差距；进一步分析表明大多数模型无法准确感知视觉文本，导致频繁出现纠错错误。
AI.conclusion: ReViCo通过揭示当前VLM在视觉文本理解上的关键不足，为开发更鲁棒、更具文本感知能力的VLM提供了新的基准基础。

title: HALO: A Heterogeneity-Aware Language-Aligned IMU Foundation Model for Open-Set Human Activity Recognition
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) using inertial measurement units (IMUs) enables a wide range of applications, yet the field still lacks a unified model that can generalize across diverse subjects, devices, and activities. Training such a model is difficult due to two key challenges: sensing heterogeneity -- differences in sampling rates, channel configurations, and sensor placements -- and poor generalization to unseen activities and label vocabularies. We introduce HALO (Heterogeneity-Aware Language-aligned Open-set model), a domain-specific IMU foundation model that addresses both challenges through a two-stage training framework. Stage 1 pretrains the IMU encoder with heterogeneity-aware self-supervised learning, including adaptive-pooling tokenization, channel-independent feature extraction, and contextualized sensor conditioning that injects natural-language sensor descriptions into each channel embedding. Stage 2 aligns this IMU encoder with text embeddings via synonym-aware soft contrastive learning, enabling open-set recognition via cosine-similarity retrieval without per-dataset classifiers. Trained on 10 public HAR datasets and evaluated on 7 held-out datasets, HALO outperforms five state-of-the-art baselines on all 8 aggregate metrics, and still leads on 3 of 4 settings under baseline-matched inputs. Despite using only ~35M trainable parameters -- 10x fewer than the latest foundation model MOMENT (341.2M) -- HALO improves zero-shot open-set accuracy, measured over all 87 training labels, by 13.7 percentage points. On two further datasets with severe distribution shift, every model including HALO collapses zero-shot. A video demonstration of HALO's performance in real world is available at https://youtu.be/rooVKragtFU

AI.tldr: 本文提出HALO，一个针对惯性测量单元(IMU)的领域专用基础模型。它通过两阶段训练框架解决传感异质性（采样率、通道配置、传感器放置差异）和对未见活动/标签词汇泛化差的问题：第一阶段使用异质性感知自监督学习预训练IMU编码器，第二阶段通过同义词感知的软对比学习将IMU编码器与文本嵌入对齐，实现开放集识别。在10个公开数据集上训练、7个留出数据集上评估，HALO在全部8项聚合指标上超越5个SOTA基线，仅用约3500万参数（比MOMENT少10倍），零样本开放集准确率提升13.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 人类活动识别(HAR)领域缺乏一个能跨主体、设备和活动泛化的统一模型，主要受两大挑战制约：一是传感异质性（采样率、通道配置和传感器放置的差异），二是对未见活动和标签词汇的泛化能力差。现有方法多为数据集特定、无法泛化到新环境。
AI.method: HALO采用两阶段训练框架。阶段1通过异质性感知自监督学习预训练IMU编码器，包括自适应池化分词（adaptive-pooling tokenization）、通道独立特征提取（channel-independent feature extraction）和上下文相关的传感器条件注入（contextualized sensor conditioning），将自然语言传感器描述嵌入每个通道表示。阶段2通过同义词感知的软对比学习（synonym-aware soft contrastive learning）将IMU编码器与文本嵌入对齐，实现基于余弦相似度检索的开放集识别，无需逐数据集分类器。
AI.result: 在10个公开HAR数据集上训练并在7个留出数据集上评估，HALO在全部8项聚合指标上超越5个SOTA基线；在基线匹配输入条件下仍保持4项设置中3项的领先。仅使用约3500万可训练参数（比最新基础模型MOMENT的3.412亿参数少10倍），零样本开放集准确率（覆盖全部87个训练标签）提升13.7个百分点。但在两个分布偏移严重的数据集上，包括HALO在内的所有模型零样本性能均崩溃。
AI.conclusion: HALO证明了领域专用的、轻量级的基础模型可以在IMU-HAR领域实现跨数据集、跨设备的强泛化能力，通过语言对齐实现开放集识别。同时论文也揭示了当前方法在严重分布偏移场景下的局限性，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: DSA: Evidence-Aware LLM-Agent Orchestration for Multi-Market Stock Research
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Code available at https://github.com/ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
summary: Large language models can summarize financial information, but an operational stock-research system must first assemble heterogeneous evidence, expose unavailable data and model capabilities, and control how generated opinions affect a final report. We present DSA, an evidence-aware orchestration framework for multi-market stock research with large language model (LLM) agents. DSA organizes the workflow into evidence acquisition, structured context construction, model-routed analysis, optional role and Strategy Skill reasoning, and report generation with selected context and diagnostics. A default report profile and an optional agentic profile share evidence and model-routing services but use profile-specific output validation and risk safeguards. In the agentic profile, core role outputs are processed by role-specific parsers, whereas Strategy Skill opinions undergo an additional signal-eligibility partition before synthesis; disagreement is supplied explicitly to the decision agent, followed by a conservative risk override. The reference implementation includes six regional market paths, fifteen bundled Strategy Skills, hosted and local model routes, and multiple execution and delivery surfaces. At a frozen software snapshot, a selected manifest of 1,457 portable offline backend contract tests passed; 596 cases were retrospectively mapped to six contract families central to the reported LLM-agent architecture. This evidence establishes implementation conformance for the tested software contracts, not superior report quality, forecasting accuracy, or investment returns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DSA，一个面向多市场股票研究的、具备证据感知能力的大语言模型智能体编排框架。它将工作流组织为证据获取、结构化上下文构建、模型路由分析、可选角色与策略技能推理、以及报告生成五个环节。默认报告配置与可选的智能体配置共享证据和模型路由服务，但采用各自独立的输出验证与风险防护。智能体配置中，核心角色输出由角色特定解析器处理，策略技能意见需经信号资格分区后才进行综合，分歧显式提供给决策智能体，并附带保守风险覆盖。参考实现涵盖六个区域市场路径、十五个捆绑策略技能、托管与本地模型路由以及多种执行和交付界面。在冻结的软件快照上，1,457个可移植离线后端契约测试全部通过；其中596个案例被回溯映射到六个与LLM智能体架构相关的契约族。该证据确立了所测软件契约的实现一致性，而非优越的报告质量、预测准确性或投资回报。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽能摘要金融信息，但一个可运营的股票研究系统必须先组装异构证据、暴露不可用数据与模型能力边界，并控制生成意见对最终报告的影响。现有方法缺乏在此类系统层面组织证据感知工作流的完整框架。
AI.method: DSA采用证据感知编排框架，将流程划分为证据获取、结构化上下文构建、模型路由分析、可选角色与策略技能推理、报告生成五个环节。框架提供默认与智能体两种配置档案，共享底层服务但配置各自安全机制；智能体配置中引入角色解析器、信号资格分区和保守风险覆盖机制。
AI.result: 在冻结软件快照上，1,457个可移植离线后端契约测试全部通过，其中596个案例被回溯映射到六个契约族。研究明确指出该证据仅表明实现一致性，不证明报告质量、预测准确性或投资收益的优越性。
AI.conclusion: DSA通过契约测试确立了实现的架构一致性，但作者谨慎界定了结论边界：证据仅覆盖软件契约合规性，而非下游任务绩效（如报告质量、预测准确率和投资回报），体现了工程严谨性。

title: Beyond Reflection: Affirmation as a Promising Behavioral Marker Associated with Quality in Text-Based Counseling
summary: While AI-assisted text-based counseling is gaining attention, it remains empirically unclear which counselor behaviors are associated with higher dialogue quality. Existing research often focuses heavily on Reflection, borrowing frameworks from Motivational Interviewing. To address this gap, we conduct a multi-layered analysis using KokoroChat, a large-scale Japanese text counseling dataset conducted by professional counselors and trainees, newly annotated with counselor strategy tags and client distress levels. Our results show that, under the quality indicators used in this study, Affirmation is more consistently associated with session quality than Reflection among the analyzed strategies. Cross-dataset transfer experiments further suggest that this quality signal can be observed to some extent on ESConv, an English dataset with non-expert supporters. These findings provide empirical implications for counselor training and emotional support system design. We release the additional KokoroChat annotations and experimental source code at https://github.com/UEC-InabaLab/BeyondReflection.

AI.tldr: 该研究对大规模日文文本心理咨询数据集KokoroChat进行多层级分析，新标注了咨询师策略标签和来访者困扰程度。结果表明，在所采用的质量指标下，Affirmation（肯定）比Reflection（反映）与对话质量的关联更稳定。跨数据集迁移实验在英文数据集ESConv上部分验证了这一质量信号。
AI.motivation: 虽然AI辅助文本心理咨询正受到关注，但哪些咨询师行为与更高质量的对话相关仍缺乏实证依据。现有研究过度聚焦于Reflection策略，并大量借鉴动机性访谈框架，需要更全面的策略分析来填补这一实证空白。
AI.method: 使用专业咨询师和实习生对话的大规模日文文本咨询数据集KokoroChat，新增标注咨询师策略标签和来访者困扰程度，进行多层级分析；并通过跨数据集迁移实验在英文非专家支持数据集ESConv上验证质量信号的泛化性。
AI.result: 在所采用的质量指标下，Affirmation策略比Reflection策略与会话质量的一致性关联更强；该质量信号在ESConv英文数据集上可部分观察到。
AI.conclusion: 研究为咨询师培训和情感支持系统设计提供了实证启示，并公开了新增的KokoroChat标注数据和实验源代码。

title: Magpie: Real-Time World Renderer for Interactive Games
summary: Modern game development relies heavily on conventional graphics pipelines. High-quality visual content requires modeling, material authoring, animation, lighting, effects, and runtime optimization, making asset production expensive and extending the development cycle of game prototypes. Recently, video foundation models are beginning to change film and video production, but games differ from linear media, they require not only continuous and realistic imagery, but also stable and reproducible gameplay rules, object states, and interaction outcomes. We present Magpie, a real-time generative world-rendering system for interactive games. Magpie separates gameplay execution from visual generation. Designers define scenes and rules in a game engine. At runtime, the Game Engine resolves player actions and maintains world state, while an independent Render Server generates visual output from white-box frames produced by the engine. Magpie provides a system-level implementation path for applying generative models to real-time game rendering. It preserves gameplay designability and reproducibility, and reduces the dependence of early game prototypes on complete visual assets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Magpie，一个用于交互式游戏的实时生成式世界渲染系统。该系统将游戏逻辑执行与视觉生成分离，游戏引擎负责解析玩家动作并维护世界状态，独立的渲染服务器根据引擎产生的白盒帧生成视觉输出，从而将生成式模型应用于实时游戏渲染，保留游戏可设计性和可复现性，同时减少早期游戏原型对完整视觉资产的依赖。
AI.motivation: 传统游戏开发依赖常规图形管线，高质量视觉内容需要建模、材质编辑、动画、光照、特效和运行时优化，导致资产生产成本高昂且延长游戏原型开发周期。虽然视频基础模型正在改变影视生产，但游戏与线性媒体不同，不仅需要连续逼真的画面，还需要稳定可复现的游戏规则、对象状态和交互结果。
AI.method: Magpie将游戏玩法执行与视觉生成分离：设计者在游戏引擎中定义场景和规则；运行时，游戏引擎解析玩家动作并维护世界状态，独立的渲染服务器根据引擎产生的白盒帧生成视觉输出。这是一种系统级的实现路径，将生成式模型应用于实时游戏渲染。
AI.result: Magpie实现了生成式模型在实时游戏渲染中的系统级应用，既保留了游戏玩法的可设计性和可复现性，又减少了对完整视觉资产的依赖。
AI.conclusion: Magpie为生成式世界渲染在交互式游戏中的应用提供了系统级实现方案，通过游戏逻辑与视觉生成的解耦，解决了游戏区别于线性媒体所独有的可复现性与交互性需求。

title: Importance Scoring of Transformer Attention Heads in Learning Tabular Data
summary: Computationally demanding and opaque deep learning models can be better understood and optimized by analyzing how they transform data. While deep transformers have been widely studied in computer vision and natural language processing, their application in tabular data remains relatively underexplored. This paper presents one of the first applications of an importance-scoring metric to interpret multi-head transformer models in learning from tabular data. Experiments conducted on 40 diverse tabular datasets demonstrate robustness to head drops based on the proposed head importance score. In 72.5\% of experimental examples, the model remains most resilient to performance drops when heads with the lowest importance scores are gradually removed. In contrast, removing the most important attention head first results in the greatest reduction in classification performance. A closer look at individual head importance scores across six attention layers reveals that important heads are scattered across layers, with no consistent layer-specific trends. In contrast to the image and language domains, the importance of individual attention heads varies considerably across tabular datasets with different schemas and feature spaces. The proposed importance score can improve efficiency and redundancy within transformer architectures. We make the source code for measuring the importance of individual attention heads publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将注意力头重要性评分指标应用于表格数据上的多头Transformer模型解释，通过在40个多样化表格数据集上的实验，验证了该指标对注意力头剪枝的鲁棒性，并发现重要注意力头在不同层间分散分布、无固定层内趋势，且与图像和语言领域的发现不同，表格数据中注意力头的重要性因数据集模式不同而显著变化。
AI.motivation: 深度Transformer模型在计算机视觉和自然语言处理领域已被广泛研究，但其在表格数据上的应用相对未被充分探索。计算密集且不透明的深度学习模型可以通过分析其数据变换方式来更好地理解和优化，因此需要一种可解释性指标来理解多头Transformer在表格数据学习中的内部机制。
AI.method: 提出一种重要性评分指标来量化多头Transformer中每个注意力头的重要性。在40个多样的表格数据集上进行实验，通过逐步移除注意力头（分别按最低和最高重要性分数）观察分类性能的变化。同时，跨六个注意力层分析单个头的重要性分数分布，并比较不同表格数据集之间注意力头重要性的差异。
AI.result: 在72.5%的实验案例中，当按最低重要性分数逐步移除注意力头时，模型对性能下降的鲁棒性最强；而最先移除最高重要性注意力头会导致分类性能最大幅度的下降。重要注意力头分散在六个注意力层中，没有一致的层特定趋势。与图像和语言领域不同，表格数据中个体注意力头的重要性在不同数据集（具有不同模式和特征空间）之间存在显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 提出的重要性评分指标可以有效改善Transformer架构中的效率和冗余性，并为表格数据领域中的Transformer模型提供可解释性工具。源代码已公开，以促进该方法的复现和进一步研究。

title: ASIL: Replacing Screenshot-and-Click with Structured State and Semantic Actions
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 19 pages, 7 figures: 9-page main paper followed by limitations, ethics, acknowledgments, references, and appendices A-E. Project page: https://sharryxr.github.io/ASIL/
summary: Powerful code agents can execute scripts, call tools, and manage files, yet many important applications remain accessible primarily through graphical user interfaces. We argue that screenshot-and-click is an inefficient interface for software-operating agents: screenshots are state-incomplete, and GUI actions are brittle, semantically weak, and poorly matched to long-horizon planning. We introduce ASIL (Agent-Software Interaction Layer), an agent-native interface that exposes software through structured JSON observations and code-executable semantic actions, realized through the deepest feasible access path for each application. We instantiate ASIL across 15 applications and a benchmark of 300 single-application and 80 multi-application tasks. ASIL reaches above 80 with closed models while executing fewer than five actions per task. Under a repaired runtime and a 50-step screenshot budget, the same tasks yield 6.6 and 26.6 strict success under screenshot-and-click control, rising to 15.0 and 53.3 on an easier OSWorld-comparable band. Against application-native interfaces on matched tasks, ASIL exceeds LibreOffice's UNO API by 28-38 strict points but only matches draw.io's MCP content contract. The structured modality also suits training: small-scale SFT raises Qwen3.5-2B from 58.0 to 72.1 and Qwen3.5-9B from 66.6 to 80.4, and resource-limited on-policy RL further raises them to 74.4 and 82.2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASIL（Agent-Software Interaction Layer），一种面向软件操作智能体的agent原生接口，通过结构化JSON观测和代码可执行的语义操作替代截图与点击交互。在15个应用、300个单应用和80个多应用任务的基准上，ASIL在闭源模型上达到80%以上成功率且每任务少于5个动作，远超截图点击方式；小规模SFT和资源受限的在线RL训练也能显著提升开源小模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有代码智能体虽然能执行脚本、调用工具和管理文件，但许多重要应用仍主要通过图形用户界面（GUI）访问。截图加点击（screenshot-and-click）作为软件操作接口存在根本性缺陷：截图状态不完整、GUI动作脆弱、语义弱且不适用于长期规划任务。因此需要一种更高效的agent原生交互接口。
AI.method: 提出ASIL接口，通过结构化JSON观测和代码可执行的语义动作暴露软件功能，为每个应用选择最深可行的访问路径（如API、MCP、UNO等）来实例化该接口。在15个应用上构建了300个单应用任务和80个多应用任务的基准进行评测，并验证了SFT和有限资源的在线RL训练在小模型上的适用性。
AI.result: ASIL在闭源模型上达到80%以上的成功率且每任务平均执行少于5个动作；在修复运行时和50步截图预算下，同任务在截图点击控制下严格成功率仅为6.6和26.6，在更简单的OSWorld可比波段中也仅升至15.0和53.3。与libreOffice的UNO API相比，ASIL在严格成功率上超出28-38个百分点；在训练方面，SFT将Qwen3.5-2B从58.0提升至72.1，Qwen3.5-9B从66.6提升至80.4，在线RL进一步将其提升至74.4和82.2。
AI.conclusion: ASIL证明agent原生接口（结构化观测+语义动作）在效率和效果上显著优于截图点击范式，同时结构化模态也更能适配模型训练，为软件操作智能体提供了更优的交互设计方向。

title: Scaling phoneme-based TTS augmentation for ASR: A unified pipeline and controlled study
summary: Synthetic speech provides scalable supervision for automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefit depends on the selected texts, reference speech, and amount of synthesized data. We present a unified phoneme-based TTS-to-ASR augmentation pipeline built around a multilingual TTS model trained from scratch using the F5-TTS architecture with language-ID conditioning. The pipeline combines language-specific grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, reference-speech filtering, candidate-text selection, synthesis, and matched ASR continuation. We further propose phoneme-frequency-guided selection (PFGS), which ranks candidate sentences using phoneme frequencies estimated from real ASR training labels. Experiments with separate monolingual ASR systems for Arabic, French, Italian, and Portuguese span 13 test sets. Across the synthesis-scale sweep, random augmentation improves over matched real-only continuation on 11 test sets. Under a nominal 60% synthesis budget, PFGS improves over real-only training on 12 test sets and over random selection on 9. Its largest relative word error rate (WER) reduction against random selection is 19.3%. With target texts and synthesis counts fixed, reference-speech filtering reduces absolute WER by 0.29 and 0.59 points on Italian and French Common Voice, respectively. These results identify synthesis scale, candidate-text content, and reference quality as important control variables in TTS-based ASR augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一的基于音素的TTS-to-ASR数据增强流水线，结合多语言TTS模型（F5-TTS架构）和音素频率引导选择（PFGS）策略，在阿拉伯语、法语、意大利语和葡萄牙语的13个测试集上验证了合成语音对ASR训练的有效性，并揭示了合成规模、候选文本内容和参考语音质量是关键的调控变量。
AI.motivation: 合成语音可以为自动语音识别（ASR）提供可扩展的监督信号，但其增强效果高度依赖于所选的文本、参考语音和合成数据的数量。现有方法缺乏统一、可解释的增强流水线，尤其是对合成数据的质量控制和文本选择策略的研究不足。
AI.method: 提出了一个统一的基于音素的TTS-to-ASR数据增强流水线，核心包括：（1）使用F5-TTS架构从零训练多语言TTS模型，并加入语言ID条件；（2）流水线包含语言特定的字素到音素转换、参考语音过滤、候选文本选择、合成和匹配的ASR续训；（3）提出音素频率引导选择（PFGS），利用真实ASR训练标签中估计的音素频率对候选句子进行排序。
AI.result: 在四种语言的13个测试集上进行实验：在合成规模扫描中，随机增强在11个测试集上优于仅使用真实数据的匹配续训；在60%合成预算下，PFGS在12个测试集上优于仅真实数据训练，在9个测试集上优于随机选择，最大相对WER降低19.3%；参考语音过滤在意大利语和法语Common Voice上分别降低绝对WER 0.29和0.59个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果识别出合成规模、候选文本内容和参考语音质量是TTS-based ASR增强中最重要的三个控制变量。PFGS作为一种基于音素分布的文本选择策略能有效提升增强效果，同时参考语音过滤也能显著改善合成数据的质量。

title: Ancient-Bench: A Comprehensive Multi-millennial, Multi-medium, and Multi-script Benchmark for Ancient Chinese Artifact Text Recognition
summary: Ancient Chinese artifact text recognition is fundamental to heritage digitization, and benchmarks for ancient texts are essential for evaluating current model capabilities. However, existing benchmarks suffer from ''fragmentation'', manifested in limited temporal coverage, limited medium diversity, and incomplete script types. Therefore, we present Ancient-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark of 2,700 images for ancient Chinese artifact text recognition, featuring three dimensions: Multi-millennial (spanning 3,000 years of character evolution), Multi-medium (covering nine artifact categories), and Multi-script (encompassing seven historical script forms). To enable consistent and fair evaluation across heterogeneous media, we further define three annotation standards tailored to the medium-specific characteristics of ancient texts: symbol standardization, character standardization, and parsing standardization. Extensive experiments on Ancient-Bench covering general Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and OCR-specialist models reveal that ancient Chinese artifact text recognition remains fundamentally unsolved, with persistent challenges in variant characters, specialized symbols, and hallucination. The dataset is available at https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/Ancient_Bench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Ancient-Bench，一个包含2,700张古代中国器物文字图像的综合基准，涵盖三千年时间跨度、九类器物媒介和七种历史字体形式，并针对异构媒介定义了三种标注标准，用于评估VLM和OCR专业模型在古代器物文字识别任务上的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有古代文字识别基准存在"碎片化"问题，表现为时间覆盖有限、媒介多样性不足、字体类型不完整，无法全面评估当前模型在古代器物文字识别上的真实能力。
AI.method: 构建Ancient-Bench基准数据集，包含2,700张图像，从三个维度设计：多千年（覆盖3,000年文字演化）、多媒介（覆盖九类器物）、多字体（涵盖七种历史字体形式）；同时针对古代文本的媒介特异性定义三种标注标准：符号标准化、字符标准化和解析标准化，以实现跨异构媒介的一致且公平评估。
AI.result: 在Ancient-Bench上对通用视觉语言模型（VLMs）和OCR专业模型进行的大量实验表明，古代中国器物文字识别仍是一个尚未解决的根本性问题，在异体字、专业符号和幻觉等方面持续存在挑战。
AI.conclusion: 古代中国器物文字识别仍然是一个开放且具有挑战性的问题，现有模型在Ancient-Bench上的表现揭示了其能力不足，该基准为后续研究提供了评估平台和方向指引。

title: Circuit Condensation: Post-Training that Concentrates a Behavior's Causal Circuit
summary: One approach to mechanistic interpretability explains behavior through circuits: the components and connections that carry it. Frozen discovery often returns hundreds of edges, making them hard to inspect, compare, or verify exhaustively. We introduce Circuit Condensation, which post-trains models to concentrate behaviors into smaller causal graphs. Each round prunes low-attribution edges and trains a low-rank adapter to match the original through what remains, retaining the cut only if task performance and general capability survive. Across four behaviors and eight models, condensed circuits are smaller than the strongest frozen baseline in 30 of 32 settings, by $8.1\times$ on average and up to $316\times$. Repeating the search without weight updates produces larger circuits in 29 of 32 settings, showing that weight updates, rather than search alone, drive the reduction. Testing every subset of 19 circuits finds 11 that cannot be reduced and reveals removable edges in the rest. Pair ablations expose dependencies between edges, showing that their effects cannot be understood independently. On indirect object identification, condensation isolates 24 heads, 17 of them with documented roles, against 61 heads and 36 undocumented ones for the matched frozen circuit: a sufficient sub-circuit of the published mechanism rather than a reconstruction of it. The resulting circuit tracks the original model's next-token distribution and predicts its errors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Circuit Condensation方法，通过后训练（post-training）将模型行为浓缩到更小的因果子图中。每一轮剪除低归因边并训练低秩适配器通过剩余边匹配原始行为，保留剪枝仅当任务性能和通用能力不受损。在4种行为和8个模型上，浓缩电路在32个设置中有30个比最强冻结基线更小（平均8.1倍，最高316倍），且通过消融实验揭示了边之间的依赖关系及电路可约简性。
AI.motivation: 机械可解释性通过电路（组件及其连接）来解释模型行为，但冻结发现（frozen discovery）通常返回数百条边，导致电路难以检查、比较或穷尽验证。现有电路过大，阻碍了可解释性的深入分析。
AI.method: Circuit Condensation方法：迭代式剪枝-适配流程。每一轮：(1) 基于归因分数剪除低归因边；(2) 训练低秩适配器（low-rank adapter）以通过保留边匹配原始模型行为；(3) 仅当任务性能和通用能力保持时保留剪枝。同时在间接宾语识别任务上进行了电路验证（24个head中17个有已记录功能），并通过成对消融和子集测试揭示边间依赖关系。
AI.result: 在32个设置中30个优于最强冻结基线，平均缩小8.1倍，最高316倍。无权重更新的重复搜索在29个设置中产生更大电路，证明权重更新（而非搜索本身）驱动了缩减。19个电路的子集测试发现11个不可约简，其余含可移除边。成对消融揭示边间依赖关系。在间接宾语识别中，浓缩电路仅需24个head（其中17个有文献记录角色），而冻结电路需61个head（仅36个有记录）。
AI.conclusion: Circuit Condensation能够产生显著更小且可验证的电路，浓缩电路是已发表机制的充分子电路而非重建。所得电路能跟踪原始模型的next-token分布并预测其错误，说明浓缩电路保留了原始模型的因果行为关键特征。

title: A Multi-Modal AI Framework for Real-Time Queue Prediction, Management and Optimisation in Intelligent Border Control Systems
summary: In the present work an efficient border control management procedure is proposed. Compared to operational queue management systems, whose operations are based on mostly static data, the proposed work takes into account dynamic traffic conditions, thus enabling optimal performance, even in cases of uncertainty. To this end, we are proposing a multi-modal Artificial Intelligence (AI) framework, tailored to th needs of border control systems, which enables real-time queue prediction, management, and resource optimization. The novel proposed approach integrates heterogeneous data sources and presents them through a unified representation by employing Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for queue forecasting. Furthermore, it leverages Model Predictive Control (MPC) and scheduling optimization to derive actionable control policies, which in turn can be presented to border control officers. The proposed work has been evaluated using synthetic data simulating realistic traffic. The evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed method reduces queue prediction error by up to 35% and average waiting time by 30%. Accordingly, the average throughput increases by nearly 20%, compared to ARIMA and rule-based methods. The abovementioned results show the effectiveness and efficiency of combining AI architectures with optimization techniques for proactive and adaptive border traffic management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的边境管控管理流程，通过多模态人工智能框架实现实时队列预测、管理和资源优化。该框架利用LSTM网络进行队列预测，并结合模型预测控制（MPC）和调度优化生成控制策略。在合成交通数据上评估显示，队列预测误差降低35%，平均等待时间减少30%，吞吐量提升约20%，优于ARIMA和基于规则的基准方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的运营队列管理系统主要基于静态数据进行操作，无法应对动态交通条件和不确定性场景，导致边境管控在实时变化的环境下性能欠佳，亟需一种能够动态适应交通状况的高效管理方案。
AI.method: 提出一个多模态人工智能框架：1）整合异构数据源并通过统一表示呈现；2）采用LSTM网络进行队列预测；3）利用模型预测控制（MPC）与调度优化导出可执行的控制策略，并将策略呈现给边境管控人员。
AI.result: 在模拟真实交通的合成数据上评估：队列预测误差降低最多35%，平均等待时间减少30%，平均吞吐量提升约20%，对比基准为ARIMA和基于规则的方法。
AI.conclusion: 将AI架构与优化技术相结合，能够有效且高效地实现主动式和自适应性的边境交通管理，证明了该框架在动态和不确定环境下的优越性能。

title: PragAlign: Evidence-Sensitive Reply Assistance Across Chinese and Japanese Appropriateness Judgments
summary: Reply assistance in multilingual settings requires linguistic competence and culturally situated judgments of appropriateness. We present PragAlign, which separates context reading from selective clarification, and evaluate it alongside Direct and Rule. Nine native Chinese speakers judged Chinese materials, while three native Japanese speakers judged matched Japanese versions. In the Chinese evaluation, PragAlign received significantly better ranks than both baselines.
