In the Japanese evaluation, Direct had the lowest mean rank, PragAlign had the highest top-rank rate, and the omnibus difference was not significant. The groups selected the same top condition in 5 of 10 scenarios, including four shared PragAlign selections. The results identify shared and language-specific judgment patterns and inform reply assistance designed to support linguistic and cultural understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PragAlign系统，将上下文阅读与选择性澄清分离，用于多语言回复辅助中的得体性判断。通过中文（9名母语者）和日语（3名母语者）的对照评测发现：中文场景下PragAlign显著优于Direct和Rule两个基线；日语场景下Direct平均排名最低、PragAlign最高排名率最高，但整体差异不显著。两组在10个场景中有5个选择了相同的顶级条件，其中4个为PragAlign的共同选择，揭示出共享与语言特异的判断模式。
AI.motivation: 多语言回复辅助不仅需要语言能力，还需要对文化语境的得体性判断。现有方法未能有效分离语境理解与澄清策略，且缺少跨语言（中/日）的实证比较，因此需要一种能区分上下文阅读与选择性澄清的系统，并考察其在不同语言母语者中的表现差异。
AI.method: 提出PragAlign框架，将上下文阅读（context reading）与选择性澄清（selective clarification）两个环节解耦；设置Direct与Rule两个基线方法进行对照实验。采用定量排序评估：9名中文母语者对中文语料进行评判，3名日语母语者对匹配的日语版本进行评判，通过平均排名、最高排名率及omnibus显著性检验比较三者在两组中的表现。
AI.result: 中文评测中PragAlign的排名显著优于两个基线；日语评测中Direct平均排名最低、PragAlign最高排名率最高，但omnibus差异不显著。两组在10个场景中有一半选择了相同的顶级条件，其中4个共同的PragAlign选择，表明两种语言群体在部分判断上具有一致性。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了跨语言环境中共享与语言特异的得体性判断模式，表明PragAlign在中文环境下有显著优势，但日语环境下各方法差异不显著。结果强调回复辅助系统需兼顾语言与文化理解，PragAlign的架构为支持多语言得体判断提供了可行方向。

title: Temporal Sensitivity Analysis of Tessera Embeddings
summary: Many Earth Observation applications need land-use/land-cover maps that are both precise and frequently updated, yet the strongest Earth Observation foundation models build their embeddings from a full year of observations. We present a controlled study of the temporal sensitivity of Tessera, one of these leading foundation models, for land-use/land-cover mapping. Keeping the encoder frozen, we recompute its embeddings over varying observation windows, from a full year down to a single day. We use them as inputs to a linear probe and a UNet segmentation head, benchmarking both of them against from-scratch networks on LUCAS, DynamicEarthNet, and PASTIS-R datasets. We show that the value of the embeddings is task-dependent. Where classes are separated by phenology, as for the crop types of PASTIS-R, they reach a mean Intersection-over-Union of $58.3$, about $46\%$ above the best from-scratch model. Where classes are temporally stable (e.g., forests in DynamicEarthNet and LUCAS), embedding-based and from-scratch models match only under full supervision. On both datasets, Tessera embeddings remain markedly more label-efficient. Degradation under shorter temporal windows is gradual and class-dependent. Contracting the window from one year to one month costs $39\%$ of the segmentation accuracy on PASTIS-R but only $5\%$ on DynamicEarthNet. Single-day embeddings still classify land cover in LUCAS at $3.4$ times the chance level. Our study shows that temporal coverage is therefore a tunable cost rather than a fixed prerequisite, opening regimes such as near-real-time mapping and faster land-use/land-cover refresh cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究地球观测基础模型Tessera在土地利用/土地覆盖制图中对时间窗口长度（从全年到单日）的敏感性。通过冻结编码器、在不同观测窗口重算嵌入，并用线性探针和UNet分割头进行基准测试，发现嵌入价值因任务而异：物候区分的类别（如作物类型）优势显著，时间稳定类别（如森林）在完全监督下与从零训练模型相当，但嵌入始终更具标签效率。时间退化是渐进的、类别相关的，表明时间覆盖是可调成本而非固定前提，可开启近实时制图等新应用。
AI.motivation: 地球观测应用需要既精确又高频更新的土地利用/覆盖地图，但最强大的EO基础模型通常基于全年观测构建嵌入。目前缺乏对时间观测窗口长度如何影响下游制图性能的受控研究，作者希望回答：基础模型嵌入的时间敏感性如何？是否能以更短的时间窗口获得可用性能，从而支持近实时等应用场景？
AI.method: 采用受控实验设计：固定（冻结）Tessera编码器，在不同观测窗口（全年到单日）重算嵌入；使用线性探针和UNet分割头两种下游方式；在LUCAS、DynamicEarthNet、PASTIS-R三个数据集上与从零训练的模型对比；评估注入类别物候特征、时间稳定性等因素对性能的影响。
AI.result: 嵌入价值是任务依赖的：在PASTIS-R上，嵌入驱动的模型mIoU达58.3，比最佳从零训练模型高约46%；在时间稳定类别（DynamicEarthNet和LUCAS的森林等）上，嵌入与从零模型仅在完全监督下相当，但嵌入始终更标签高效。从一年压缩到一个月，PASTIS-R精度损失39%，DynamicEarthNet仅损失5%；单日嵌入在LUCAS上分类精度仍为机会水平的3.4倍。
AI.conclusion: 时间覆盖是可调成本而非固定前提。Tessera嵌入对较短观测窗口具有鲁棒性，退化是渐进且类别依赖的，为实现近实时制图和更快的土地利用/覆盖刷新周期打开了可能性。

title: Making Latent Evolution Explicit: Operator-Structured Transitions for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot policies by predicting how task-relevant scene states may evolve under interaction. Recent WAMs increasingly perform such prediction in latent representation spaces, avoiding full appearance-level generation while preserving control-relevant information. Yet latent transitions are commonly realized with Transformer-based predictors whose inductive structure is centered on token interaction rather than temporal evolution. We study transition realization as an architectural choice distinct from predictive representation and prediction-policy coupling. We introduce the Latent Evolution Operator Network (LEON), which models latent evolution in a learned observable space through context-modulated operator-based propagation and additive forcing. Grounded in the controlled Koopman generator view of evolution, LEON organizes context-dependent transition variation around a shared evolution-operator structure while retaining a complementary path for additive change. Controlled dynamical systems verify the resulting evolution-specific inductive bias and the complementary roles of operator propagation and forcing. Across two WAM formulations that integrate latent prediction into the policy differently, LEON improves closed-loop performance and robustness while remaining effective under full transition replacement. These results establish transition realization as a consequential architectural choice in latent WAMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜变量演化算子网络（LEON），将潜空间中的状态转移建模为受控Koopman生成器框架下的算子传播与加性强迫，证明转移实现方式（transition realization）是潜空间世界动作模型（WAM）中独立于预测表征和策略耦合的关键架构选择。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间WAMs虽避免全外观级生成，但其潜转移预测普遍采用基于Transformer的架构，其归纳结构侧重token交互而非时间演化，缺乏针对状态演化的专门归纳偏置。作者将转移实现（transition realization）视为与预测表征、预测-策略耦合相互独立的架构选择，并对其系统性研究。
AI.method: 提出LEON（Latent Evolution Operator Network），在学习的可观测空间中通过上下文调制的算子传播（context-modulated operator-based propagation）与加性强迫（additive forcing）来建模潜状态演化。方法以受控Koopman生成器（controlled Koopman generator）视角为理论基础，将上下文相关的转移变化围绕共享的演化算子结构组织，同时保留一条互补的加性变化路径。
AI.result: 受控动力系统实验验证了演化特定归纳偏置的有效性以及算子传播与强迫的互补作用。在两种不同的WAM公式化（潜预测以不同方式集成到策略中）下，LEON均提升了闭环性能与鲁棒性，且在完全替换转移模块的情况下依然有效。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了转移实现是潜空间WAMs中具有实质影响的架构选择，LEON通过算子的归纳偏置为潜在状态演化提供了优于Transformer式token交互建模的替代方案。

title: Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder
summary: Multimodal representation learning has been shifting from traditional two-tower architectures to large language model (LLM)-based embedders due to their strong instruction-following capabilities. Despite this progress, existing approaches primarily focus on language and image modalities, which also remain the dominant modalities for user-conditioned interactions in current embedders. In this paper, we propose the first Omni-Interactive Universal Embedder (OmniUE), which not only learns a unified embedding space across text, video, and audio by leveraging intermediate-layer representations from dedicated learnable tokens, but also supports omni-interactive querying, enabling users to provide inputs in the form of text, visual regions of interest, and audio spans. Within OmniUE, visual and audio segmenters process diverse user interactions and integrate them with an omni-LLM to produce user-conditioned any-to-any embeddings via context aggregation. To evaluate OmniUE's omni-interactive capabilities, we introduce OmniCHOIR, benchmarking models for omni-interactive compositional audio retrieval based on the given text, video, and audio as well as unimodal or multimodal interaction prompts. OmniUE consistently surpasses state-of-the-art baselines across diverse modalities, with average improvements of 10.5% on textual-interactive video benchmarks (MMEB-v2-video), 1.1% on audio tasks (MAEB), 83.7% on visual-interactive benchmarks (SCaR), and 24.1% on our omni-interactive OmniCHOIR benchmark. We believe that jointly advancing omni-modal representation learning and omni-interactive querying paves the way toward universal embedders.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个全模态交互通用嵌入器（OmniUE），统一文本、视频、音频的嵌入空间，并支持用户以文本、视觉区域和音频片段进行交互式查询。同时引入OmniCHOIR基准测试全模态交互组合音频检索，实验结果表明OmniUE在多个基准上超越现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态表示学习正从传统双塔架构转向基于LLM的嵌入器，但现有方法主要聚焦语言和图像模态，缺乏对视频和音频的统一嵌入建模，也未支持用户以多样化的交互形式（如视觉区域、音频片段）进行条件化查询。
AI.method: OmniUE利用专用可学习令牌的中间层表示，在文本、视频和音频之间学习统一嵌入空间。视觉和音频分割器处理多样用户交互输入，与全模态LLM（omni-LLM）集成，通过上下文聚合生成用户条件化的任意到任意嵌入。同时构建OmniCHOIR基准，用于评估全模态交互组合音频检索。
AI.result: OmniUE在文本交互视频基准（MMEB-v2-video）上平均提升10.5%，在音频任务（MAEB）上提升1.1%，在视觉交互基准（SCaR）上提升83.7%，在全模态交互基准OmniCHOIR上提升24.1%。
AI.conclusion: 联合推进全模态表示学习与全模态交互查询是通往通用嵌入器的有效路径，OmniUE验证了这一方向的可行性。

title: Towards Expert Financial QA via Self-Improving RAG
comment: 17 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the ICLR 2026 Workshop on Advances in Financial AI
summary: Expert-level financial question answering requires both grounded verification to catch numeric hallucinations and audit trails for regulatory compliance, attributes that standard single-pass RAG systems lack. We take a step toward this goal with Self-Improving RAG, a framework that decomposes document QA into three specialized agents (Retrieval, Reasoning, and Judge) coordinated by an orchestrator with feedback-driven self-correction. When the Judge Agent scores an answer below a dynamic threshold, the system triggers retry with escalated strategies: broader retrieval, more careful prompting, and relaxed acceptance criteria. We evaluate on FinanceBench (SEC filing QA), where Self-Improving RAG achieves 86% oracle-guided accuracy (measuring agreement with gold answers) with a 36.4% Lazarus Rate, recovering nearly 4 in 10 initially incorrect answers through targeted retry. A key finding is that a fixed retrieval pipeline with judge-driven retry achieves strong results without dynamic routing, providing full interpretability. Every decision is logged with confidence scores, enabling the audit trails required for regulated financial applications.

AI.tldr: 提出Self-Improving RAG框架，通过检索、推理、评审三个专用代理与反馈驱动的自我纠错机制，在金融文档问答中实现86%的oracle引导准确率，并以36.4%的Lazarus Rate恢复了近四成初始错误答案。
AI.motivation: 金融领域的专业级问答需要扎实的验证能力以捕捉数值幻觉，同时需要审计追踪以满足监管合规要求，而标准的单次RAG系统无法满足这两项需求。
AI.method: 将文档问答分解为三个专用代理（检索、推理、评审），由编排器协调并驱动反馈式自我纠错。当评审代理对答案的评分低于动态阈值时，系统触发重试并采取升级策略：更广泛的检索、更谨慎的提示、以及更宽松的接受标准。
AI.result: 在FinanceBench（SEC文件问答）上，Self-Improving RAG达到86%的oracle引导准确率（与金标准答案的一致性度量），Lazarus Rate为36.4%，即近四成初始错误答案通过定向重试被恢复。关键发现是固定检索管线配合评审驱动重试无需动态路由即可实现强劲结果，且具备完全可解释性。
AI.conclusion: 每个决策均以置信度分数记录日志，从而为受监管的金融应用提供所需的审计追踪能力。

title: Parameter-Efficient pretrained-CT-to-MRI Transfer for Rectal Cancer Segmentation: Performance-Calibration Trade-offs
comment: Accepted to the Medical Image AI in Radiation Therapy (MIART) Workshop at MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate rectal cancer segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for adaptive radiotherapy and tumor response assessment, but deployment also requires computational efficiency and informative, calibrated uncertainty estimates. We therefore introduce SWIFT, a SWin pretrained model wIth parameter-eFficient and Tumor-aware fine-tuning for rectal cancer segmentation. A Swin V2 encoder pretrained on 10,444 public 3D CT volumes using a DINOv2-style objective was adapted to T2-weighted MRI through four cumulative configurations: full fine-tuning (SWIFT), decoder compression (SWIFTe), low-rank adaptation (SWIFTe-LoRA), and a four-member LoRA-decoder ensemble (SWIFTe-LDE4). Geometric accuracy, tumor detection, radiomic agreement, and probability calibration were evaluated on a held-out 247-case test set from a single-institution cohort acquired using 1.5 or 3 Tesla GE scanners. Compared with SWIFT, SWIFTe reduced total parameters by 70.1% (from 72.8M to 21.8M) and increased tumor detection rate from 89.9% to 93.9%, while achieving a slightly lower median surface DSC (0.61 versus 0.62) and improved radiomic agreement. In a separate SWIFTe ablation, removing tumor-aware augmentation reduced detection from 93.9% to 89.9% but increased surface DSC from 0.61 to 0.64, demonstrating a detection-boundary-agreement trade-off. SWIFTe-LoRA used 14.6% of SWIFTe's trainable parameters while retaining similar segmentation performance. SWIFTe-LDE4 achieved the lowest calibration errors among the four configurations after temperature scaling (expected calibration error, 0.217; Brier score, 0.222), although the absolute expected calibration error indicates residual miscalibration. Similar efficiency-calibration patterns were observed using the public VoCo checkpoint, supporting robustness across pretrained initializations rather than external clinical generalizability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SWIFT框架，用于直肠癌MRI分割，通过Swin V2预训练编码器适配T2加权MRI，并探索四种配置（全微调、解码器压缩、低秩适配、LoRA解码器集成），在247例测试集上评估几何精度、肿瘤检测、放射组学一致性和概率校准，发现效率-校准之间的权衡关系。
AI.motivation: 直肠癌MRI分割对自适应放疗和肿瘤反应评估至关重要，但实际部署不仅需要几何精度，还需要计算效率和具有信息量的校准不确定性估计。现有方法在这三个方面往往难以兼顾，因此需要一种兼顾精度、效率和校准的分割方法。
AI.method: 提出SWIFT框架：采用在10,444个公开3D CT体数据上用DINOv2风格目标预训练的Swin V2编码器，适配T2加权MRI，通过四种累计配置进行微调：(1)全微调(SWIFT)；(2)解码器压缩(SWIFTe)，参数减少70.1%；(3)低秩适配(SWIFTe-LoRA)，仅用14.6%的可训练参数；(4)四成员LoRA解码器集成(SWIFTe-LDE4)以改善校准。在单机构247例测试集（1.5/3T GE扫描仪）上评估几何精度、肿瘤检测、放射组学一致性和概率校准。
AI.result: SWIFTe相比SWIFT参数减少70.1%（72.8M降至21.8M），肿瘤检测率从89.9%提升至93.9%，表面DSC略低（0.61 vs 0.62），放射组学一致性改善。肿瘤感知增强的消融实验显示检测与边界一致性存在权衡（去除后检测降至89.9%但DSC升至0.64）。SWIFTe-LoRA用14.6%参数保持相似性能。SWIFTe-LDE4在温度缩放后取得最低校准误差（ECE=0.217，Brier=0.222），但绝对ECE仍显示残余误校准。VoCo公共检查点验证了跨预训练初始化的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SWIFT框架展示了参数高效微调在直肠癌MRI分割中的有效性，揭示了检测率与边界一致性之间的权衡，以及效率与校准之间的模式关系。结果支持跨预训练初始化的鲁棒性，但残差校准误差表明仍需进一步改进校准方法，且结论仅限于内部有效性而非外部临床泛化性。

title: MM-Spectrum: Multimodal Multi-spectral Molecular Structural Elucidation with a Stable MoE Framework
summary: Inferring molecular structures from multimodal spectroscopic measurements requires integrating complementary yet highly heterogeneous signals. However, the common paradigm of directly concatenating multispectral sequences can exhibit anomalous performance degradation, primarily due to pronounced heterogeneity and the resulting multimodal imbalance across modalities. As a remedy, we propose MM-Spectrum, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts framework tailored for multimodal multispectral spectra-to-structure elucidation. To better match the information characteristics under multispectral imbalance, MM-Spectrum introduces an explicit modality-aware routing mechanism that exposes spectral identity to the router in addition to token content representations. Moreover, it incorporates shared and interaction experts, together with heterogeneous expert capacities, to extract multispectral modality-unique and cross-modal synergistic information while suppressing noise-induced interference. Across full-modality, bimodal, and missing-modality settings on molecular structural elucidation, MM-Spectrum achieves consistent and substantial improvements, supported by ablation studies and interpretability analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MM-Spectrum，一个面向多模态多光谱分子结构解析的稀疏专家混合框架。其核心创新在于显式的模态感知路由机制（将光谱身份信息暴露给路由器）以及共享/交互专家与异构专家容量的设计，以解决多光谱模态之间高度异质性和模态不平衡导致的性能退化问题。
AI.motivation: 从多模态光谱测量推断分子结构需要整合互补但高度异质的信号。然而，直接拼接多光谱序列的常见范式会因模态间显著的异质性以及由此产生的多模态不平衡而出现异常的性能退化。
AI.method: 提出MM-Spectrum稀疏专家混合框架：(1) 显式模态感知路由机制，将光谱身份信息暴露给路由器以匹配多光谱不平衡下的信息特征；(2) 引入共享专家和交互专家，配合异构专家容量，提取各模态独有信息与跨模态协同信息，同时抑制噪声干扰。
AI.result: 在全模态、双模态和缺失模态场景的分子结构解析任务中，MM-Spectrum均取得了一致且显著的改进，并获得了消融实验和可解释性分析的支持。
AI.conclusion: MM-Spectrum有效解决了多光谱模态异质性和不平衡带来的性能退化问题，为多模态光谱到分子结构解析提供了一种更优的建模方案。

title: A Contract-Centered Architecture for Scalable and Manageable Agentic Runtimes
summary:
Enterprise AI deployment is a coordination problem across business units, application and AI teams, testing, platform engineering, infrastructure, security, operations, and data governance. Use-case benchmarks show whether one agent completes one task, but not how changing capabilities, models, runtime mechanisms, capacity, and enterprise data should be owned, changed, admitted, or evidenced together.
  We present four responsibility objects as shared organizational contracts: Skill (reusable, versioned capability and workflow asset), Harness (runtime compiler and governor), Scaffold (execution/control boundary and NFR owner), and a stack-external data substrate under independent CIO-governed semantics and telemetry. The runtime core is A = <S, H, X>, with the data substrate outside that stack.
  The central contribution is one bounded, falsifiable hypothesis, P1 (cost-aware capability-capacity separability): within a declared operating region, changing activated capability preserves the capacity-response interaction within a preregistered equivalence margin, while changing compatible Scaffold capacity preserves capability semantics up to a non-inferiority margin, and the required controls stay within a declared enforcement budget. Six design conditions become measured obligations whose coverage, violations, uncertainty, cost, and exclusions determine whether P1 is decidable.
  We propose a cluster-period randomized crossover experiment (balanced order, reset/washout, repeated seeds and failure regimes, cluster-aware uncertainty) with a four-state verdict: supported, falsified, conditional-engineering, or inconclusive. This paper contributes a contract-bounded runtime architecture, a source-preserving data substrate, and a falsifiable measurement protocol. It reports no completed implementation, experiment, dataset, or measured result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出企业AI部署的系统性协调问题：传统基准仅评估单agent单任务，无法覆盖跨部门（业务、应用、AI、测试、平台、基础设施、安全、运维、数据治理）的协同决策。作者提出四个责任对象（Skill、Harness、Scaffold、数据基座）作为组织层契约，并给出核心可证伪假设P1（成本感知的能力-容量可分离性），配套六项设计条件与群簇随机交叉实验协议，形成四态判定（支持/证伪/条件工程/不确定）。论文仅提出架构与协议，未报告任何实现或实测结果。
AI.motivation: 现有use-case benchmarks仅能验证"单个agent能否完成单个任务"，无法回答企业AI部署中能力、模型、运行时机制、容量与企业数据如何被共同"拥有、变更、准入、取证"的治理与协调问题。部署本质上是跨业务单元、AI团队、平台工程、安全、运维等多方参与的协同问题，需要一个统一的责任契约框架来弥合这一鸿沟。
AI.method: 提出四个责任对象作为共享组织契约：(1) Skill——可复用、版本化的能力与工作流资产；(2) Harness——运行时编译器与治理器（governor）；(3) Scaffold——执行/控制边界与NFR所有者；(4) 栈外数据基座——在独立CIO治理语义与遥测下运行。运行时核心A=<S,H,X>，数据基座位于栈外。核心贡献是单一有界、可证伪假设P1（成本感知能力-容量可分离性）：在声明运行区域内，能力激活变化在预注册等价边际内保持容量-响应交互，兼容Scaffold容量变化在非劣效边际内保持能力语义，控制开销在声明的执行预算内。六个设计条件转化为可度量的义务（覆盖、违规、不确定性、成本、排除项）决定P1的可判定性。实验采用群簇-周期随机交叉设计（平衡顺序、重置/洗脱、重复种子与故障场景、群簇感知不确定性），输出四态判定。
AI.result: 论文明确声明未报告任何已完成的实现、实验、数据集或实测结果。其成果为三项架构性贡献：契约约束的运行时架构、源保留（source-preserving）数据基座、以及可证伪的测量协议框架。因此本文定位为"架构+协议"提案型论文，而非实证型论文。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出了一个将企业AI部署从"单任务基准验证"转向"组织级责任契约+可证伪假设"的理论框架。P1假设与四态判定协议为后续实证研究提供了清晰的操作路径。但当前阶段缺乏实现与数据支撑，其可行性需通过后续实验检验；同时如何将六个设计条件落地为可操作的度量指标仍是关键挑战。

title: Preserving General Capabilities during Domain Specialization with Uncertainty-Calibrated MOPD
summary: Specializing large language models to vertical domains improves domain-specific behavior but often degrades general capabilities such as reasoning, coding, instruction following, and creative writing. We study this domain--general trade-off in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD), where a specialized student is supervised on its own sampled trajectories by domain and general teachers. Standard MOPD faces two limitations: ordinary on-policy sampling rarely exposes tokens with large positive teacher--student advantages, while the advantage sign alone does not establish whether the resulting update direction is reliable. We propose uncertainty-calibrated MOPD to address these limitations. Dual-temperature sampling broadens the candidate trajectory pool, and positive-advantage-density filtering selects trajectories with stronger positive learning signals. Centered log-likelihood (CLL) filtering then computes an entropy-calibrated teacher-endorsement score and probabilistically retains token updates according to direction--endorsement consistency. Experiments on role-playing and medical-domain specialization show that our method improves the general-capability average over standard MOPD by $4.73\%$ and $10.84\%$, respectively, while maintaining vertical-domain performance. Ablations and diagnostic analyses further confirm that the gains do not merely result from a larger rollout budget and that the proposed trajectory- and token-level mechanisms address their intended failure modes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出不确定性校准的多教师在线蒸馏（uncertainty-calibrated MOPD）方法，通过双温度采样、正优势密度过滤和中心对数似然（CLL）过滤三个机制，解决标准MOPD在垂直域专精化时面临的两个局限（难采样到大正优势token、优势符号无法可靠指示更新方向），在角色扮演和医疗领域分别提升通用能力平均4.73%和10.84%，同时保持垂直域性能。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型专精化到垂直领域能改善领域行为，但往往会损害通用能力（如推理、编码、指令遵循和创意写作）。标准MOPD面临两个根本局限：一是在普通在线采样下，很少暴露具有大正教师-学生优势的token，导致学习信号覆盖不足；二是仅依赖优势符号无法判断更新方向是否可靠，可能引入噪声更新。因此需要一个能同时解决采样覆盖不足和更新方向校准问题的方法。
AI.method: 提出了不确定性校准的MOPD方法，包含三个关键机制：(1) 双温度采样（dual-temperature sampling）：通过调整采样温度拓宽候选轨迹池，使更多具有大优势的token有机会被暴露；(2) 正优势密度过滤（positive-advantage-density filtering）：筛选出具有更强正学习信号的轨迹；(3) 中心对数似然过滤（CLL filtering）：计算熵校准的教师背书分数，并根据方向-背书一致性概率性地保留token更新。该方法让领域教师在学生自采样轨迹上监督，同时由通用教师提供校准信号。
AI.result: 在角色扮演和医疗领域专精化实验中，该方法相对标准MOPD在通用能力平均上分别提升4.73%和10.84%，同时保持垂直领域性能不下降。消融实验和诊断分析进一步验证了提升并非仅来自更大的rollout预算，且所提出的轨迹级和token级机制分别有效解决了其目标失效模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入不确定性校准机制，MOPD能够在保持垂直领域专精化效果的同时显著减轻通用能力退化问题。双温度采样和正优势密度过滤解决了轨迹级采样覆盖不足的问题，CLL过滤则从token级别校准更新方向的可靠性，三个机制协同作用形成了更稳健的蒸馏框架。

title: SSMB: Self-Supervised Local Feature Detection under Motion Blur
summary: Keypoint detection under motion blur remains a significant challenge, as blur distorts local image structure and degrades the repeatability of feature localization. Existing approaches either rely on computationally expensive deblur-then-detect pipelines that may introduce restoration artifacts, or learn to regress the image positions of handcrafted keypoints extracted on sharp images, which reflects the assumptions of the handcrafted detector rather than what is truly repeatable under blur. We present SSMB, a deblur-free, self-supervised keypoint detector for motion-blurred images that requires neither handcrafted detectors nor external pseudo-labels. SSMB introduces the Local Discriminability Enhancement (LDE) module, which restores fine-grained local discriminability after global feature mixing. Training is performed in two stages. First, geometric pretraining on synthetic shapes bootstraps spatially discriminative keypoint detection without any external detector, just from the rendered geometry. Second, blur-aware training on real sharp-blur image pairs learns blur-invariant detection through a multi-component self-supervised objective that enforces cross-domain consistency, geometric alignment, and spatial coverage. Extensive evaluations on keypoint detection, image matching, relative pose estimation, and visual localization under motion blur demonstrate that SSMB establishes a new state-of-the-art among sparse keypoint detectors, consistently outperforming both supervised and self-supervised baselines across all tasks. Code, models, and datasets will be publicly available upon paper acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出SSMB，一种无需去模糊、无需人工标注的自我监督运动模糊关键点检测器，通过局部判别增强模块和两阶段训练（几何预训练+模糊感知训练），在关键点检测、图像匹配、相对位姿估计和视觉定位等任务上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 运动模糊会扭曲局部图像结构，降低关键点定位的可重复性。现有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的去模糊流程（可能引入修复伪影），要么在清晰图像上学习手工关键点位置（继承了手工检测器的假设，而非模糊下真正可重复的特征），缺乏既高效又能捕捉模糊下真实可重复性的学习方案。
AI.method: SSMB包括两个核心组件：(1) 局部判别增强（LDE）模块，在全局特征混合后恢复细粒度局部判别能力；(2) 两阶段训练策略——第一阶段在合成几何图形上进行几何预训练，无需外部检测器即可引导空间判别性关键点检测；第二阶段在真实清晰-模糊图像对上通过多组件自监督目标（跨域一致性、几何对齐、空间覆盖）进行模糊感知训练。
AI.result: 在运动模糊条件下的关键点检测、图像匹配、相对位姿估计和视觉定位等任务上，SSMB在稀疏关键点检测器中建立了新的最先进水平，一致性地优于有监督和自我监督的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SSMB证明无需去模糊或外部伪标签，通过设计良好的自监督学习目标和两阶段训练策略，即可在运动模糊下实现高可重复性的关键点检测，为模糊场景中的稀疏特征提取提供了更高效、更可靠的解决方案。

title: QuantumBoostNet: A Hybrid Classical-Quantum Architecture for Enhanced Accuracy in Cardiac Ultrasound View Identification
summary: Accurate identification of the correct view or angle in cardiac ultrasound (echocardiogram) is a critical component of cardiologic imaging. This step is essential for precise anatomical interpretation, reliable measurement, and the reduction of clinical errors. Although computer vision has advanced significantly, most state-of-the-art models perform well on standard benchmarks but often yield suboptimal results in specialized medical imaging tasks due to the high level of noise present in the data. QuantumBoostNet, a hybrid classical-quantum architecture, is introduced to address these challenges. This model integrates a classical backbone with two heads: one classical and one quantum, with the quantum head implemented as a parametrized 10-qubit quantum circuit. Training occurs in two stages, with an adaptive transition between heads governed by a mixing parameter that monitors loss dynamics. Extensive experiments indicate that, despite the limited number of qubits that can be simulated, QuantumBoostNet consistently outperforms state-of-the-art classical and hybrid classical-quantum models in cardiac ultrasound view identification, achieving a relative improvement over the best competitor. QuantumBoostNet also demonstrates superior performance on established image classification benchmarks and exhibits robustness to noise. These findings support the continued development of hybrid classical-quantum models for specialized medical imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出QuantumBoostNet，一种混合经典-量子架构用于超声心动图视图识别。该模型结合经典骨干网络与经典/量子双头结构，其中量子头为参数化10量子比特电路，通过两阶段训练和自适应混合参数进行头切换，在心脏超声视图识别任务上优于现有最先进的经典和混合模型，并展现出对噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图中的视图/角度准确识别对心脏成像至关重要，直接影响解剖解释的准确性、测量可靠性和临床错误率的降低。尽管计算机视觉取得了显著进展，但现有最先进模型在标准基准上表现良好，却因医学影像数据中高噪声水平而在专业医学成像任务上效果欠佳，因此需要一种能够应对这些挑战的新架构。
AI.method: QuantumBoostNet采用混合经典-量子架构，包含一个经典骨干网络和两个头部：一个经典头和一个量子头。量子头实现为参数化的10量子比特电路。训练分两阶段进行，通过一个监控损失动态的混合参数在经典头与量子头之间实现自适应过渡。
AI.result: 在广泛实验中，尽管可模拟的量子比特数量有限，QuantumBoostNet在心脏超声视图识别任务上持续优于最先进的经典模型和混合经典-量子模型，相对于最佳竞争模型取得了相对改进。该模型在既有图像分类基准上也展现出更优性能，并表现出对噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持继续发展面向专业医学影像应用的混合经典-量子模型，表明此类架构在噪声较大的医学数据上具有显著的性能优势和实际应用潜力。

title: pro-team at LLMs4OL 2026 Tasks Flagship and Reuse: Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Vocabulary-Constrained Filtering for Ontology Learning
summary: Ontology learning from text remains challenging despite significant progress in Large Language Models (LLMs), which can hallucinate domain terms, produce inconsistent formats, and favor hierarchical over associative relations. In the LLMs4OL 2026 Challenge, we address both the End-to-End Flagship Task (Task A) and Ontology Extension Reuse Task (Task B) using an offline retrieval-augmented few-shot prompting pipeline. Our system employs Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 for demonstration retrieval, selecting the top-5 examples for Task A and top-2 for Task B. A left-truncated context-windowing strategy preserves task instructions within long prompts. For Task B, generated triples undergo deterministic vocabulary-constrained filtering, retaining triples when at least one endpoint belongs to the sample's closed term/type vocabulary and removing duplicates of the initial ontology. The approach achieves Semantic Graph Similarity of 0.8692, Term-Typing F1 of 0.9200, and Taxonomy Discovery F1 of 0.8540 on Task B, while Task A achieves 0.7416 Semantic Graph Similarity. However, no non-taxonomic relations are extracted, highlighting limitations of closed, taxonomy-oriented relation vocabularies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于离线检索增强的少样本提示流水线，用于解决LLMs4OL 2026挑战中的本体学习任务（Task A端到端旗舰任务和Task B本体扩展复用任务）。系统采用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct模型配合all-MiniLM-L6-v2进行示例检索，通过左截断上下文窗口策略保持长提示中的任务指令，并在Task B中应用确定性词汇约束过滤。在Task B上取得Semantic Graph Similarity 0.8692、Term-Typing F1 0.9200和Taxonomy Discovery F1 0.8540的成绩，Task A上SGS为0.7416，但未能提取任何非分类关系。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型在自然语言处理领域取得显著进展，但从文本中自动学习本体仍然面临三大挑战：LLM可能产生领域术语幻觉、输出格式不一致、以及偏向提取层级关系而忽视关联关系。作者旨在通过一种不依赖微调的离线检索增强少样本方法来解决这些本体学习中的核心难题。
AI.method: 系统采用离线检索增强的少样本提示流水线。具体包括：(1) 使用Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct作为生成模型，all-MiniLM-L6-v2作为嵌入模型进行演示检索，Task A选取top-5示例，Task B选取top-2示例；(2) 设计左截断上下文窗口策略，确保长提示中任务指令得以保留；(3) 针对Task B，对生成的三元组执行确定性的词汇约束过滤，保留至少一个端点属于样本封闭术语/类型词汇表的三元组，并去除与初始本体重复的内容。
AI.result: 在Task B上取得Semantic Graph Similarity 0.8692、Term-Typing F1 0.9200、Taxonomy Discovery F1 0.8540；Task A上Semantic Graph Similarity为0.7416。但系统未能提取任何非分类（关联）关系，说明封闭且面向分类学的关系词汇表限制了非层级关系的发现。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强的少样本提示方法在不需要训练的情况下能够有效完成本体学习任务，尤其在Task B的本体扩展与复用场景下表现优异。然而，完全放弃非分类关系提取暴露了当前关系词汇表设计的局限，未来需要更开放的关系定义或更长的关系约束机制来弥补这一缺陷。

title: Letters hide the truth from our eyes: English homophones have meaningfully different phonetic realizations
summary: The distribution of spoken word duration of English homophones is known to co-vary with frequency of use. This study investigates whether other aspects of the phonetic realization of homophones also differ. A series of quantitative investigations of 14,000 homophone tokens in American television news broadcasts revealed that the tokens of homophone pairs such as \textit{weight} and \textit{wait} have different phonetic realizations, and that these can be predicted from their meanings in utterance context. These systematic differences remain even when taking duration-related variation into account. Time-normalized spectrograms emerged as an excellent tool for probing the fine details of phonetic realization, and obviate the need for phonetic transcriptions, which inevitably hide the phonetic truth from our eyes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析美国电视新闻广播中14,000个英语同音词（如weight/wait）的语音实现，发现同音词除了时长随使用频率变化外，其他语音特征也与其在语境中的意义系统性相关，且这种差异在控制时长因素后仍然存在。研究采用时间归一化声谱图作为探测工具，避免了音标转录对语音细节的遮蔽。
AI.motivation: 已知英语同音词的口语词长分布与使用频率共变，但同音词的其他语音实现方面是否也存在差异尚不明确。本文旨在探索同音词对的语音实现在频率差异之外是否还有其他系统性差异，以及这些差异是否可从句义语境预测。
AI.method: 对美国电视新闻广播中收集的约14,000个同音词样本进行一系列定量分析。使用时间归一化声谱图（time-normalized spectrograms）作为核心分析工具，对同音词对的语音实现细节进行探查。分析中控制时长相关变异，检验语音实现差异是否仍存在，并考察这些差异是否可从语境中的意义预测。
AI.result: 发现同音词对（如weight和wait）具有不同的语音实现，这些差异可从其在语境中的意义进行预测。即使考虑了时长相关变异后，这些系统性差异仍然存在，表明同音词的语音差异超出了单纯时长维度的频率效应。
AI.conclusion: 同音词的语音实现不仅仅是时长随频率变化，其他精细的语音特征也与其语义语境相关联。时间归一化声谱图是探测语音实现精细细节的有效工具，能够避免传统音标转录对真实语音信息的遮蔽，为语音学研究提供了新的方法论视角。

title: Unsupervised Adaptation of 3D CT Foundation Models for 3D CBCT Segmentation
comment: Accepted at the EMA4MICCAI workshop at MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Code, trained models, weights, and liver annotations are available at https://github.com/mirabll/FARR3D/
summary: Accurate 3D segmentation of cone-beam CT (CBCT) is critical for interventional and radiation therapy applications, yet it remains limited by two compounding challenges: the scarcity of annotated CBCT data and the large domain shift from diagnostic CT. Interventional CBCT exhibits fundamental modality differences from conventional CT, driven by acquisition and physics effects as well as contrast-specific vascular content, thereby limiting effective cross-modality model transfer. We propose a novel unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) framework based on redundancy-reducing feature alignment, enabling 3D CBCT segmentation with no target-domain annotations or inference-time adaptation. Our framework is architecture-agnostic, seamlessly adapting both CNN-based and ViT-based foundation models. We evaluate our method on two challenging CT-CBCT liver segmentation benchmarks: one for interventional vascular procedures and one for radiation therapy, demonstrating that even large-scale pretrained segmentation networks require explicit feature-space bridging to generalize across acquisition modalities, and that our approach consistently outperforms existing pretrained foundation model and UDA strategies. To support reproducibility and benchmarking, we release the liver segmentations for a public CBCT dataset, along with the code, trained models, and weights.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于冗余减少特征对齐的无监督域适应（UDA）框架，用于解决锥形束CT（CBCT）三维分割中标注数据稀缺和与诊断CT域差异大的双重挑战。该框架与架构无关，可无缝适配CNN和ViT基础模型，在两个CT-CBCT肝脏分割基准上验证了有效性，并开源了代码、模型和数据集标注。
AI.motivation: CBCT三维分割对介入治疗和放疗至关重要，但面临两大难题：标注CBCT数据稀缺，以及CBCT与诊断CT之间存在由采集方式、物理效应和血管对比度差异导致的巨大域偏移，限制了跨模态模型迁移的有效性。
AI.method: 提出一种基于冗余减少特征对齐的无监督域适应框架，无需任何目标域标注或推理时适应，且架构无关，可同时适配CNN和ViT基础分割模型。
AI.result: 在两个具有挑战性的CT-CBCT肝脏分割基准（介入血管手术和放射治疗）上的实验表明，即使是大规模预训练分割网络也需要显式的特征空间桥接才能跨采集模态泛化，该方法一致优于现有预训练基础模型和UDA策略。
AI.conclusion: 冗余减少特征对齐是弥合CT-CBCT域差异的有效手段，所提出的UDA框架具有架构无关性和实用性，并通过开源代码、模型和数据集标注支持可复现性和后续基准测试。

title: Beyond Parallel Blindness: Information Floors and Model Gaps in Block Drafting
summary: Block drafters propose several tokens in one forward pass, before earlier target tokens are realised. Their rejection mixes two losses: missing within-block path information and imperfect modelling of observable information. Accepted length cannot distinguish them. We separate the two with an information floor, the minimum expected rejection at a specified conditioning order; rejection above this floor is the model gap. Estimating both from target rollouts across four domains, four open-weight targets, and a frontier API target yields three findings. First, the all-parallel floor reaches $0.286$ at the final slot on Qwen3-4B, limiting even the best proposal to $71\%$ per-slot acceptance. Second, one realised token removes $86$--$100\%$ of this floor, a locality also recovered by an independent mutual-information analysis. Third, current drafters remain far above their floors: the final-slot model gap accounts for $43$--$64\%$ of DFlash rejection and $85$--$92\%$ of DSpark's oracle-conditioned rejection. These findings separate the value of short-range conditioning from proposal quality.

AI.tldr: 该论文将块草稿（block drafters）的拒绝率分解为信息下限（因缺乏块内路径信息导致的不可避免拒绝）与模型差距（因模型对可观测信息建模不完美导致的额外拒绝），并通过实验量化了二者，发现信息下限由短程条件作用主导，而现有草稿器在最终槽位上仍有43%-92%的模型差距。
AI.motivation: 现有块草稿（block drafters）在一次前向传播中并行提出多个token，但拒绝混合了两种不同来源的损失：缺失块内路径信息（within-block path information）和对可观测信息建模不完美。仅凭接受长度无法区分这两种损失，阻碍了对草稿器质量的准确评估和优化方向的判断。
AI.method: 提出"信息下限"（information floor）概念，即在指定条件顺序下最小期望拒绝率；拒绝率高于该下限的部分称为"模型差距"（model gap）。通过在四个域、四个开源目标模型和一个前沿API目标模型上进行目标回放（target rollouts）实验，量化这两个指标。
AI.result: 三个关键发现：(1) 全并行信息下限在Qwen3-4B最终槽位达到0.286，将最优提案限制在71%的每槽位接受率；(2) 一个已实现token可消除86%-100%的信息下限，独立互信息分析也验证了这种局部性；(3) 现有草稿器仍远高于其下限：最终槽位模型差距占DFlash拒绝的43%-64%，占DSpark oracle条件拒绝的85%-92%。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现将短程条件作用的价值与提案质量分开，表明提高草稿器性能的关键瓶颈在于模型差距（可观测信息的建模能力），而非信息下限（块内路径信息缺失），为优化块草稿策略提供了清晰的理论依据。

title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers
summary: Rerankers, reward models and multi-document QA scorers score candidate documents or responses in one LLM prompt, so each score depends on their order. Such scorers are selected on ranking quality, but their scores determine a decision: what a score threshold retains, a reader answers, or a preference model selects. However, equal ranking quality does not imply equal decisions: on passage reranking, five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 retain sets that overlap by only 0.66-0.84 when reordered. A published reranker takes the highest retained-set F1 in our comparison and still overlaps by only 0.667. No prompt-time change we test removes that order dependence: the only one that gains ranking quality leaves all three decisions unchanged. Order-consistency SFT (OC-SFT) attenuates it in the weights, training a candidate's score not to depend on the order. It holds ranking quality and leads every decision-stability measure among trained scorers on all three tasks: it flips the reader's answer on 0.125 of permutation pairs against 0.149-0.164 for three other objectives that target order. It is more stable than order-averaged distillation on 12 base models, and one OC-SFT permutation retains sets that overlap more than ten averaged off-the-shelf permutations. A comparison should therefore report what a threshold retains and a reader answers, not ranking quality alone. Code is available at https://github.com/thomsonreuters/presentation-dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LLM排序器/奖励模型/多文档QA评分器的一个关键问题：这些模型在单个提示中对候选文档或回复进行评分，导致分数依赖于输入顺序。研究发现，即使排名质量（如nDCG@10）几乎相同的模型，其决策结果（阈值保留集、读者答案、偏好选择）可能差异巨大。作者提出OC-SFT（Order-Consistency SFT）方法，在模型权重层面训练候选评分不依赖于输入顺序，在不牺牲排名质量的前提下显著提升决策稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的排序器、奖励模型和多文档QA评分器在单次LLM提示中对候选进行打分，其分数天然受输入顺序影响，导致相同排名质量下决策不稳定。作者指出，这些模型的核心用途是做出决策，而非仅仅排名，但现有评估只看排名质量（如nDCG），忽略了排序质量相等并不意味着决策相等这一关键问题。
AI.method: 1) 实证比较五个训练后的排序器在排名质量相近（nDCG@10差距0.010以内）时保留集的重叠度；2) 系统测试各种提示时间变换（prompt-time changes）以消除顺序依赖；3) 提出OC-SFT（Order-Consistency SFT），通过在权重中训练候选分数不依赖输入顺序来衰减顺序依赖性，并与顺序平均蒸馏等方法对比。
AI.result: 5个nDCG@10相差不超过0.010的排序器保留集重叠仅0.66-0.84；已发布的最佳排序器保留集F1最高但重叠仅0.667；所有prompt-time变换均无法消除顺序依赖。OC-SFT在三个任务上均保持排名质量并达到所有决策稳定性指标最佳：可使读者答案在0.125的排列对上翻转（对比其他三种顺序目标的0.149-0.164），在12个基座模型上比顺序平均蒸馏更稳定，单个OC-SFT排列的保留集重叠度超过10个平均离线排列。
AI.conclusion: 模型评估应报告阈值保留了什么、读者回答了什么，而非仅报告排名质量。OC-SFT是缓解顺序依赖的有效方法。

title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
summary: Evolution Strategies (ES) have recently emerged as a memory-efficient post-training paradigm for LLM reasoning. However, the optimization behavior of ES remains understudied, making it hard to define its advantage scope compared to mainstream post-training paradigms (e.g., Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)). By systematically investigating ES dynamics and mechanisms, this paper first identifies a performance advantage of ES over GRPO, theoretically and empirically showing that ES can lead to broader reasoning coverage, thereby better exploiting the reasoning capabilities of pretrained LLMs. Theoretically, we show that verifier-projected Jensen-Shannon diversity across the ES population is helpful to higher Pass@K performances. Empirically, unlike GRPO, which exhibits entropy collapse, ES improves Pass@1 while attaining higher Pass@K than GRPO. We further develop a sequential GRPO-ES training strategy that combines GRPO's strength in Pass@1 with ES's gains in Pass@K. Second, we find that despite substantial whole-model parameter drift, the task-performance gains of ES are only contributed to a sparse subset of larger-magnitude updates. This functional sparsity suggests that large parameter movement need not imply widespread functional change, and held-out evaluations further show that it does not necessarily lead to catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we study how hyperparameter design affects the effectiveness of ES, demonstrating that ES requires a smaller population size in a larger LLM. These findings position ES as a distinct reasoning post-training paradigm rather than a less effective, memory-efficient alternative to GRPO.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了Evolution Strategies (ES)作为LLM推理后训练范式的优化行为，从理论上和实验上证明ES相比GRPO能带来更广泛的推理覆盖（更高的Pass@K），同时发现ES的性能提升仅由稀疏的大幅更新子集贡献，且ES在更大LLM中需要更小的种群规模。
AI.motivation: ES虽已成为一种内存高效的LLM推理后训练范式，但其优化行为尚未被充分研究，难以明确其相比主流后训练范式（如GRPO）的优势范围。作者旨在通过系统研究ES的动力学和机制，明确其定位。
AI.method: 论文采用理论分析与实证研究相结合的方式：(1)理论证明验证器投影的Jensen-Shannon多样性对Pass@K表现有益；(2)系统性对比ES与GRPO的优化动态，实验分析熵坍缩现象与推理覆盖差异；(3)提出顺序GRPO-ES训练策略结合两者优势；(4)分析ES中参数漂移与功能稀疏性的关系；(5)研究超参数（种群规模）与模型规模之间的关系。
AI.result: (1)ES在理论上和实证上均优于GRPO的推理覆盖，ES在提升Pass@1的同时获得比GRPO更高的Pass@K，而GRPO存在熵坍缩问题；(2)顺序GRPO-ES策略能结合GRPO的Pass@1优势和ES的Pass@K增益；(3)尽管ES导致显著的整模型参数漂移，但性能增益仅由稀疏的大幅更新子集贡献，且不一定导致灾难性遗忘；(4)更大的LLM需要更小的ES种群规模。
AI.conclusion: ES应被视为一种独特的推理后训练范式，而非GRPO的低效内存友好替代品。本研究为理解ES在LLM后训练中的角色提供了系统性见解，并为其超参数设计提供了指导。

title: TransMeme: A Multi-Agent Framework for Cross-Cultural Meme Transcreation
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Accepted at the 34th ACM International Conference on Multimedia (ACM MM 2026)
summary: Internet memes are a pervasive form of multimodal online communication; however, such communication often involves users from diverse linguistic and cultural backgrounds. Therefore, adapting memes across cultures and languages is a central challenge for enabling mutual understanding in online communication. Unlike ordinary translation or standalone text rewriting, cross-cultural meme transcreation must jointly preserve communicative intent, adapt culture-dependent meaning for the target audience, and maintain coherence between text and image. In this work, we first provide an explicit task analysis of cross-cultural meme transcreation and identify three core challenges: culture-specific knowledge understanding, intent and tone preservation, and multimodal consistency. Based on this analysis, we propose a multi-agent framework with specialized agents that are coordinated to address these challenges through cultural adaptation, target text rewriting, revision, and conditional visual adjustment. The framework strengthens target text adaptation with coordinated feedback to handle difficult cases that require deeper cultural or visual intervention. We evaluate the framework on bidirectional Chinese-English meme transcreation using both human evaluation and LLM-as-a-Judge. Our method consistently outperforms all baselines across both evaluation settings. In human evaluation, it achieves the best performance on all four dimensions and delivers a 33.1% average improvement over the strongest baseline, while in LLM-as-a-Judge, it attains the highest Top-1 ranking rate (60% versus 26% for the second-best baseline). Further analysis indicates that each component contributes to the performance. Our error analysis suggests that the remaining bottlenecks lie in humor reconstruction and image-text alignment rather than simple cultural knowledge gaps, pointing to future work on humor transfer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个多智能体框架用于跨文化表情包转创（meme transcreation），通过文化适应、目标文本改写、修订和条件视觉调整四个专门智能体的协调配合，在双向中英表情包转创任务上超越了所有基线方法，人类评估中平均提升33.1%，LLM-as-a-Judge排名率高达60%。
AI.motivation: 互联网表情包是普遍的多模态在线交流形式，但用户来自不同语言文化背景。传统翻译或文本改写无法满足跨文化表情包转创的需求，因为这需要同时保留交际意图、适应目标受众的文化含义、并维持图文一致性，这三重挑战亟需专门的任务分析和解决方案。
AI.method: 首先对跨文化表情包转创进行明确的任务分析，识别三个核心挑战：文化特定知识理解、意图与语气保留、多模态一致性。基于此提出多智能体框架，包含文化适应、目标文本改写、修订和条件视觉调整四个专门智能体，通过协调反馈机制强化目标文本适应能力，处理需要更深层文化或视觉介入的困难案例。
AI.result: 在双向中英表情包转创任务上，使用人类评估和LLM-as-a-Judge两种方式评估。人类评估中在所有四个维度上均取得最佳表现，较最强基线平均提升33.1%；LLM-as-a-Judge中Top-1排名率达到60%（次优基线仅26%）。消融分析表明各组件均有贡献，错误分析显示剩余瓶颈在于幽默重建和图文对齐，而非简单的文化知识缺口。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体框架在跨文化表情包转创任务上显著优于现有方法，验证了任务分析和组件分工的有效性。未来研究方向聚焦于幽默迁移（humor transfer），以解决当前最关键的瓶颈问题。

title: Instruction Quality Matters: Refining Instructions for Effective Preference Learning
summary: Preference learning optimizes models using response pairs, yet the informativeness of these pairs is fundamentally shaped by the instructions from which they are generated. We identify instruction quality as a hidden bottleneck in preference learning: low-quality or ambiguous instructions restrict the response-quality distribution, limiting strong chosen responses and weakening preference signals. Through Best- and Worst-of-N analyses, we show that instruction quality constrains both the ceiling and floor of sampled response quality. Motivated by this observation, we introduce an instruction-refinement pipeline that selects weak instructions using reward signals and revises them with rubric-guided LLM feedback, improving preference data without discarding examples. Across offline and online preference learning settings, experiments on multiple models and benchmarks show broad alignment improvements over original data and alternative data-improvement strategies. Further analyses indicate that instruction refinement raises achievable response quality and complements response-centric preference data curation. Overall, instruction quality emerges as a key factor governing how informative preference signals are formed for LLM alignment. Code is available at: https://github.com/01choco/instruction-refinement/

AI.tldr: 本文发现指令质量是偏好学习中隐藏的瓶颈，低质量或模糊的指令会限制采样响应的质量分布，从而削弱偏好信号。作者提出一个指令精炼管线，利用奖励信号筛选弱指令，并通过基于评分标准的LLM反馈进行修订，无需丢弃样本即可改善偏好数据，在离线与在线偏好学习设置中均取得广泛的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 偏好学习依赖响应对的生成质量，而这些响应的质量上限和下限从根本上受到生成它们的指令质量约束。现有研究多聚焦于响应侧的数据筛选与优化，忽略了指令本身的不确定性对偏好信号信息量的限制，导致对齐效果存在隐藏瓶颈。
AI.method: 通过Best- and Worst-of-N分析揭示指令质量对响应质量天花板和地板的影响；据此设计指令精炼管线：先用奖励信号识别弱指令，再借助rubric引导的LLM反馈修订这些指令，从而在不丢弃任何训练样本的前提下提升偏好数据质量。
AI.result: 在多种模型和基准上，跨离线与在线偏好学习设置的实验表明，所提方法相较原始数据及替代性数据改进策略，在广泛的对齐指标上均取得一致提升。进一步分析显示指令精炼能提高可达的响应质量上限，并与响应侧偏好数据策展形成互补。
AI.conclusion: 指令质量是决定偏好信号信息量如何形成的关键因素，对指令进行精炼可作为大语言模型对齐中偏好数据改进的有效且正交的维度。

title: PACE: A Unified Condense-and-Extract Paradigm for Fast VLM Inference
comment: 22 pages, 9 figures, 13 tables. Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate exceptional visual reasoning capabilities, yet their inference costs escalate rapidly with the proliferation of visual tokens. Existing visual token pruning methods exhibit two fundamental limitations. First, most approaches operate exclusively post-vision encoder, leaving the substantial latency of the visual encoding phase unoptimized. Second, under strict token budgets, these methods often fail to jointly preserve holistic visual contexts and fine-grained details, leading to performance degradation. To address these bottlenecks, we propose PACE (Pixel-Adaptive Condense and Extract), a training-free inference framework that accelerates both the vision encoder and the Large Language Model (LLM) via a unified Condense-and-Extract paradigm. During the Condense stage, an Adaptive Pixel Compressor (APC) evaluates visual information density prior to encoding, adaptively downsampling redundant inputs, curtailing encoder computation while preserving global context and essential visual cues. In the Extract stage, a Dynamic Dual-Attention Extractor (DDAE) selectively retains visual tokens via a fusion of internal visual signals from the encoder and semantic signals from the LLM, safeguarding task-critical details. By integrating PACE into Qwen2.5-VL-7B, the model retains 93.8% of its original performance while utilizing only 10% of the visual tokens, yielding a 3.1x speedup in time to first token (TTFT). Our code is available at https://github.com/jjL357/PACE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACE（Pixel-Adaptive Condense and Extract），一个无需训练的推理加速框架，通过统一的"压缩-提取"范式同时加速视觉编码器和大型语言模型，在仅使用10%视觉token的情况下保留93.8%的原始性能，实现3.1倍的首token延迟（TTFT）加速。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法存在两个根本性局限：一是大多数方法仅在视觉编码器之后操作，未优化视觉编码阶段的大量延迟；二是在严格的token预算下，难以同时保留整体视觉上下文和细粒度细节，导致性能下降。这两个瓶颈制约了VLM推理效率的进一步提升。
AI.method: PACE包含两个核心阶段：（1）Condense阶段：自适应像素压缩器（APC）在编码之前评估视觉信息密度，自适应地对冗余输入进行下采样，在削减编码器计算量的同时保留全局上下文和关键视觉线索；（2）Extract阶段：动态双注意力提取器（DDAE）通过融合来自编码器的内部视觉信号和来自LLM的语义信号，选择性保留视觉token，以保障任务关键细节。整个框架无需训练，可直接集成到现有VLM中。
AI.result: 将PACE集成到Qwen2.5-VL-7B后，模型在仅使用10%视觉token的情况下保留了93.8%的原始性能，同时实现了3.1倍的首token延迟（TTFT）加速。
AI.conclusion: PACE通过统一的Condense-and-Extract范式有效解决了VLM推理中视觉编码阶段延迟未优化和严格token预算下全局与细节难以兼顾的问题，实现了无需训练的推理加速，代码已开源。

title: GRAIN: Bridging Name and Narrative Shifts in Real-World Graph Reasoning through Invariance-Rewarded Agentic RL
summary: Despite their potential in standardized graph tasks, Large Language Models (LLMs) remain brittle to real-world shifts in node identifiers and task formulation. While deterministic graph tools are invariant to such shifts, extracting topological structures from noisy text is highly fragile for LLMs, which often overfit to surface patterns. Moreover, mitigating these parsing failures via multi-agent systems incurs prohibitive latency. To address this, we propose GRAIN, a single-agent framework optimized via reinforcement learning. GRAIN models reasoning as a semantic parsing and tool-execution pipeline, guided by a Structure Invariance Reward. By validating extracted intermediate graphs against ground-truth topologies, this reward forces the LLM to learn robust text-to-structure mappings rather than memorizing linguistic artifacts. We also introduce GRIT, a benchmark evaluating sensitivity to such linguistic shifts. GRAIN outperforms multi-agent baselines by 16.45\% in accuracy with approximately 24\% lower latency. Furthermore, it demonstrates superior structural generalization, halving the out-of-distribution (OOD) gap of SFT models (from 15.77\% to 7.80\%) and maintaining robustness on large-scale graphs beyond the training distribution.

AI.tldr: 提出GRAIN，一个基于强化学习的单代理框架，通过结构不变性奖励引导LLM进行语义解析和工具执行，实现稳健的图结构提取；同时引入GRIT基准测试，在准确率上超过多代理基线16.45%，延迟降低约24%，并将OOD泛化差距从15.77%压缩至7.80%。
AI.motivation: LLM在标准化图任务中表现良好，但面对真实世界中的节点标识符变化和任务表述变化时非常脆弱。确定性图工具具有不变性，但LLM从嘈杂文本中提取拓扑结构时容易过拟合表面模式；多代理系统虽能缓解解析失败但延迟过高。因此需要一种既能保持结构不变性又能控制延迟的解决方案。
AI.method: GRAIN采用基于强化学习的单代理框架，将推理建模为语义解析和工具执行的流水线，并由结构不变性奖励（Structure Invariance Reward）引导。该奖励通过将提取的中间图与地面真值拓扑进行验证，迫使LLM学习稳健的文本到结构映射，而非记忆语言伪影。同时提出GRIT基准来评估对语言偏移的敏感性。
AI.result: GRAIN在准确率上比多代理基线提升16.45%，延迟降低约24%；在结构泛化方面表现优异，将SFT模型的OOD差距从15.77%减半至7.80%，且在超出训练分布的大规模图上保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: GRAIN通过结构不变性奖励驱动的强化学习，在单代理框架内同时解决了LLM在图任务上的脆弱性和多代理系统的高延迟问题，为图结构提取提供了一种高效且稳健的解决方案。

title: Behavior2Trip: Towards Personalized Travel Planning via User Behavior Trajectory
summary: Travel planning agents assist users in generating personalized travel plans by modeling their individual preferences. Existing agents either rely on explicit user instructions or engage in multi-turn clarification to elicit user preferences. However, both approaches overlook the rich behavioral signals latent in users' past behaviors, which implicitly encode their preferences. This over-reliance on active user input increases interaction burden and limits plan personalization. To bridge this gap, we introduce a new task, Behavior-Aware Travel Planning, which infers user preferences directly from past behaviors and generates personalized travel plans. To facilitate research on this task, we introduce Behavior2Trip, a benchmark constructed from one of the largest Chinese online travel platforms, comprising 11,400 instances. Each instance represents an average of 39.8 past user behaviors spanning 14 attributes across 5 preference dimensions. We further propose B2T-Agent, a reinforcement learning-based agent that leverages user behavior trajectories, interacts with external tools for preference-aligned retrieval, and maintains an internal memory module. Experiments on Behavior2Trip show that GPT-4.1 achieves a full-constraint pass rate of only 0.5\% on the hardest tasks, while B2T-Agent built upon Qwen3-8B outperforms all baselines, highlighting the substantial challenge of this task. Moreover, Qwen3-8B trained with B2T-Agent also outperforms GPT-4.1 on the TravelPlanner benchmark, demonstrating strong generalization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/BUAA-IRIP-LLM/Behavior2Trip

AI.tldr: 本文提出了行为感知旅行规划任务（Behavior-Aware Travel Planning），通过从用户历史行为中推断偏好来生成个性化旅行计划，并发布了包含11,400个实例的Behavior2Trip基准数据集和基于强化学习的B2T-Agent智能体。实验表明GPT-4.1在最难任务上全约束通过率仅0.5%，而基于Qwen3-8B的B2T-Agent超越所有基线，并在TravelPlanner基准上表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的旅行规划智能体依赖显式用户指令或多轮澄清来获取偏好，忽视了用户历史行为中隐含的丰富行为信号，增加了交互负担并限制了规划的个性化水平。
AI.method: 提出了行为感知旅行规划任务，构建了Behavior2Trip基准（基于中国大型在线旅行平台，11,400个实例，平均每个实例包含39.8个历史行为，涵盖5个偏好维度的14个属性），并设计了B2T-Agent——基于强化学习的智能体，利用用户行为轨迹、与外部工具交互进行偏好对齐检索，并维护内部记忆模块。
AI.result: 在Behavior2Trip上，GPT-4.1在最具挑战性任务上的全约束通过率仅为0.5%；基于Qwen3-8B构建的B2T-Agent在各项指标上优于所有基线。此外，经B2T-Agent训练的Qwen3-8B在TravelPlanner基准上也超越了GPT-4.1，证明了其泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 行为感知旅行规划是一个具有挑战性的新任务，基于强化学习并利用用户行为轨迹的B2T-Agent在该任务上展现出显著优势，同时具备跨基准的泛化能力，为个性化旅行规划提供了新的研究方向和实用方案。

title: CODE: Cross-Modal Calibration and Dynamic Suppression for Open World Object Detection
summary: Open World Object Detection (OWOD) built on multimodal foundation models often suffers from semantic ambiguity caused by unidirectional text-to-vision matching, while rigid outlier penalties may over-suppress unknown objects near known-class decision boundaries. We propose CODE (Cross-Modal Calibration and Dynamic Suppression), a unified inference-time framework with three complementary components. Cross-Modal Joint Confidence Calibration injects global visual prototypes to calibrate text-driven known-class predictions. Uncertainty-Guided Universal Objectness Enhancement measures classification hesitation from local visual responses to strengthen potential unknown objects. Dynamic Outlier Suppression via Confidence Margin replaces rigid suppression with a margin-aware adjustment that preserves ambiguous out-of-distribution instances. Experiments on the Real-World Detection benchmark demonstrate that, with the OWL-ViT L/14 backbone, CODE achieves 21.7 U-mAP and 40.8 K-mAP in Task 1, surpassing the previous state of the art by 2.6 and 2.3 points, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CODE框架，通过跨模态置信度校准、不确定性引导的通用对象性增强和动态异常抑制三个互补组件，在推理阶段解决开放世界目标检测中的语义歧义和异常过度抑制问题，在Real-World Detection基准上取得了新的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 基于多模态基础模型的开放世界目标检测（OWOD）存在两个核心问题：一是单向文本到视觉匹配导致语义歧义；二是刚性异常惩罚会过度抑制已知类决策边界附近的未知对象。
AI.method: CODE是一个统一的推理时框架，包含三个互补组件：（1）跨模态联合置信度校准：注入全局视觉原型来校准文本驱动的已知类预测；（2）不确定性引导的通用对象性增强：通过局部视觉响应的分类犹豫程度来增强潜在的未知对象；（3）基于置信度边界的动态异常抑制：用边界感知的自适应调整替代刚性抑制，保留模糊的分布外实例。
AI.result: 在Real-World Detection基准上，使用OWL-ViT L/14骨干网络，CODE在Task 1上达到21.7 U-mAP和40.8 K-mAP，分别超越之前SOTA 2.6和2.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CODE通过跨模态校准和动态抑制策略有效缓解了开放世界检测中的语义歧义和异常过度抑制问题，验证了推理时干预在提升多模态OWOD性能上的有效性。

title: Feature Transformation Enhanced Jacobi Polynomial Graph Filtering for Graph Anomaly Detection
summary: In recent years, graph anomaly detection (GAD) based on frequency-domain filtering have achieved promising results. However, existing approaches still face three major challenges: First, they use static basic function to constructed graph filter which cannot effectively adapt to the frequency-domain distribution of graph data. Second, they fail to adequately consider the importance information of each attribute in the node feature vector, leading to the loss of fine-grained information. Third, they insufficiently utilize node labels for GAD. To address these issues, this paper proposes a novel graph anomaly detection method called JPGFN (Feature Transformation Enhanced Jacobi Polynomial Graph Filtering Network). First, a Feature Separation Transformation Network (FSTNN) is developed to better learn fine-grained node features by feature separation and applying nonlinear transformations to node features across different dimensions. Second, an adaptive Jacobi polynomial graph filtering module is constructed based on Jacobi polynomials to adaptively capture complex frequency-domain features of graph signals. Finally, a node label constraint module is developed to facilitate the use of node labels and enhance the performance of GAD. Experimental results on multiple real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed method significantly outperforms mainstream approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为JPGFN的图异常检测方法，通过特征分离变换网络、自适应雅可比多项式图滤波模块和节点标签约束模块，解决了现有频域滤波GAD方法在自适应滤波、细粒度特征利用和标签信息挖掘三方面的不足，并在多个真实数据集上显著优于主流方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于频域滤波的图异常检测方法存在三大挑战：(1)使用静态基函数构建图滤波器，无法有效适应图数据的频域分布；(2)未充分考虑节点特征向量中各属性的重要性，导致细粒度信息丢失；(3)对节点标签信息利用不充分。
AI.method: 提出JPGFN方法，包含三个核心模块：一是特征分离变换网络（FSTNN），通过特征分离和对不同维度的节点特征进行非线性变换来学习细粒度特征；二是基于雅可比多项式构建的自适应图滤波模块，用于自适应捕获图信号的复杂频域特征；三是节点标签约束模块，促进节点标签的利用以增强GAD性能。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的JPGFN方法在性能上显著优于主流基线方法。
AI.conclusion: JPGFN通过引入特征分离变换、自适应雅可比多项式图滤波和标签约束机制，有效解决了现有频域滤波GAD方法的三大局限性，为图异常检测提供了更优的解决方案。

title: RuleWeaver: Benchmarking Rule-Centered Scenario Reasoning for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to specialized domains, where effective use of domain expertise often requires reasoning over complex rules in concrete scenarios. However, existing benchmarks only partially evaluate this capability, as they either focus on output-level instruction constraints or overlook the distinct roles that rules play in scenario reasoning. To address these gaps, this paper introduces RuleWeaver, a benchmark construction framework for evaluating rule-centered scenario reasoning. RuleWeaver starts from corpus-derived IF-THEN Meta Rules, progressively augments them into complex rules, and composes these rules into rule-centered scenario QA instances. Beyond final-answer correctness, RuleWeaver further supports process-level evaluation through rubric-based answer quality, rule recall, and rule precision. Experiments on 11 representative LLMs show that current models still struggle with complex rule-centered scenario reasoning, with even the best-performing model achieving only around 50% of the maximum rubric score. We make our code and dataset available here: https://github.com/SharkSpicy-NLP/RuleWeaver.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RuleWeaver，一个用于评估规则中心场景推理能力的基准构建框架。该框架从语料库中提取IF-THEN元规则，逐步增强为复杂规则，并组合成规则中心的场景问答实例。实验表明现有LLM在此类推理任务上表现不佳，最佳模型也仅达到约50%的rubric评分。
AI.motivation: 现有基准对LLM在专业领域中的规则推理能力评估不全面：要么只关注输出层面的指令约束，要么忽视了不同规则在场景推理中的角色差异。需要一个新的基准框架来系统评估规则中心的场景推理能力。
AI.method: RuleWeaver框架包含三个核心步骤：(1) 从语料库中提取IF-THEN元规则；(2) 逐步将元规则增强为更复杂的规则；(3) 将这些规则组合成规则中心的场景QA实例。除最终答案正确性外，还通过rubric-based答案质量、规则召回率和规则精确率支持过程级评估。
AI.result: 在11个代表性LLM上的实验表明，当前模型在复杂的规则中心场景推理任务上仍面临困难，表现最好的模型也只达到约50%的最大rubric分数。
AI.conclusion: 现有LLM在规则中心场景推理方面仍有显著不足，RuleWeaver提供了一个更全面的评估框架，有助于揭示和推动这一能力的改进。

title: DINOcular: Self-Supervised Visuospatial Representations
summary: We introduce a self-supervised framework for learning joint visuospatial representations from RGB-D observations. While modern vision foundation models are trained almost exclusively on RGB images, many embodied systems have access to explicit depth sensing, which provides geometric information that monocular inputs cannot recover. Our method integrates depth-derived geometric priors with a visual backbone through inter-patch and intra-patch fusion, enabling the model to encode both appearance and spatial structure efficiently. The resulting representation shows promising improvements on 3D awareness while preserving semantic transfer: it outperforms prior methods of comparable scale on multiple 3D geometry benchmarks, and remains competitive when probed for standard RGB-D semantic segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个自监督学习框架，从RGB-D观测中学习联合视觉-空间表征，通过将深度导出的几何先验与视觉骨干网络结合，实现外观与空间结构的高效编码。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉基础模型几乎完全在RGB图像上训练，但许多具身系统可以获取显式深度感知，深度提供了单目输入无法恢复的几何信息。现有方法未能充分利用这一额外模态来提升3D感知能力。
AI.method: 该框架通过片间（inter-patch）和片内（intra-patch）融合，将深度导出的几何先验与视觉骨干网络集成，使模型能够同时高效编码外观信息和空间结构。
AI.result: 在多个3D几何基准上优于同规模先前方法，同时在标准RGB-D语义分割探测任务上保持竞争力，表明其在增强3D感知的同时保留了语义迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功展示了在自监督框架下利用显式深度信息可以显著提升3D感知能力，同时不牺牲语义表示的迁移性能。

title: When Tool Outputs Become Commands: Separating Action Induction from Runtime Authorization in Tool-Augmented LLM Agents
summary: Tool-augmented LLM agents must rely on untrusted runtime Observations to complete open-ended tasks; however, when tool outputs no longer merely provide data but begin to specify concrete actions, they effectively become ``commands'' that can drive real-world side effects beyond user intent. We argue that this risk arises from conflating action induction with execution authorization. To address this distinction, we propose SARA, which treats action induction and execution authorization as distinct runtime roles and separates action provenance from execution authority. On the Observation side, a context-isolated Action Probe exposes action-inducing semantics and persistently records action-origin provenance across steps as a review signal; on the execution side, actual tool calls are authorized only against the user objective and audited evidence from authorized successful executions, while satisfying goal, execution-chain, and argument-level support. To preserve this separation across multi-step execution, SARA applies No-History-Promotion to prevent historical recurrence from laundering action origins into execution authority. Across AgentDojo and AgentDyn, SARA limits ASR to no more than \(0.63\%\) across four primary evaluation settings while maintaining competitive task utility, and consistently reduces ASR across additional Agent backbones.

AI.tldr: SARA提出将行动归纳与执行授权分离，在工具增强的LLM代理中通过上下文隔离的动作探针和基于用户目标与证据链的授权机制，将攻击成功率控制在0.63%以下，同时保持竞争性的任务效用。
AI.motivation: 工具增强的LLM代理必须依赖不可信的工具输出来完成开放任务，但当工具输出不再仅仅提供数据而是开始指定具体动作时，它们实际上成为了可以驱动超出用户意图的真实世界副作用的"命令"。现有方法将行动归纳与执行授权混为一谈，导致安全风险。
AI.method: SARA框架：(1) 将行动归纳与执行授权视为不同的运行时角色，分离动作来源与执行权限；(2) 在观测侧，使用上下文隔离的动作探针（Action Probe）暴露动作诱导语义，并跨步骤持久记录动作来源作为审查信号；(3) 在执行侧，仅根据用户目标及经过授权的成功执行的审计证据来授权实际工具调用，同时满足目标、执行链和参数级别的支持；(4) 采用No-History-Promotion机制防止历史循环将动作来源洗白为执行权限，以保持跨多步执行的分离。
AI.result: 在AgentDojo和AgentDyn基准测试中，SARA在四个主要评估设置中将ASR（攻击成功率）限制在不超过0.63%，同时保持竞争性的任务效用，并在额外的Agent骨干网络上持续降低ASR。
AI.conclusion: SARA通过将行动归纳与执行授权分离，有效解决了工具输出被当作命令执行的安全风险，在保持任务效用的同时显著降低了攻击成功率，为工具增强型LLM代理提供了更安全的设计范式。

title: Evaluating Confidence-Gated Retrieval with Matched Trajectory Replay
summary: Interactive language-model agents use confidence signals to decide whether to answer immediately, retrieve additional evidence (from memory or external knowledge), or defer. Yet confidence is usually evaluated in isolation, without measuring the trajectory-level consequences of the actions it triggers. We propose matched trajectory replay, a controlled protocol for comparing confidence-to-action mappings. The protocol holds candidate answer states, evidence points, budgets, and action costs fixed. We use it to compare raw verbalized confidence with post-hoc isotonic calibration in a multi-hop question-answering system using Mistral, GPT, and Qwen models on HotpotQA and MuSiQue datasets. At the same numerical commitment threshold, calibration changes which questions agents ultimately commit to answering. Across all six model-dataset pairs, it increases accuracy among committed answers by up to 41 percentage points. However, it can reduce coverage and increase retrieval use. Overall accuracy improves by up to 15 percentage points on HotpotQA but falls by up to 17 percentage points on MuSiQue. These effects reflect a shift to a more selective, lower-risk operating point, not improved answers or confidence ranking. A calibration map fitted before retrieval improves held-out calibration through retrieval depths one and two, but is worse than raw confidence at depth three for all three models. Additional evidence helps on average, but this aggregate effect does not establish whether confidence identifies which individual episodes will benefit from another retrieval. Taken together, these results show that calibration can make commitment risk interpretable, but it does not estimate the expected benefit of another retrieval. Retrieval therefore requires a separate value-of-information or utility estimate. Evaluations should report held-out calibration, risk-coverage, and retrieval cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"匹配轨迹重放"（matched trajectory replay）协议，用于在控制候选答案状态、证据点、预算和行动成本的前提下，比较不同置信度到行动映射的效果。在多跳问答系统（使用Mistral、GPT、Qwen模型，HotpotQA和MuSiQue数据集）上，作者发现后验等渗校准虽能显著提升已承诺答案的准确率（最多41个百分点），但会降低覆盖率并增加检索使用。整体准确率在HotpotQA上最多提升15个百分点，在MuSiQue上最多下降17个百分点。核心结论是：校准使承诺风险可解释，但不能估计额外检索的预期收益，检索需要单独的价值信息（value-of-information）或效用估计。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体依赖置信度信号来决定是立即回答、检索额外证据还是推迟决策，但置信度通常在孤立环境中评估，没有衡量其所触发的行动在轨迹层面上的后果。现有研究缺乏一个受控协议来比较不同置信度到行动的映射在实际决策轨迹中的表现。
AI.method: 提出匹配轨迹重放协议，固定候选答案状态、证据点、预算和行动成本，比较原始口头置信度与事后等渗校准在置信度到行动映射上的差异。在多跳问答系统中使用Mistral、GPT、Qwen三个模型在HotpotQA和MuSiQue两个数据集上进行系统性实验。
AI.result: 在相同数值承诺阈值下，校准改变了智能体最终承诺回答的问题集。所有六个模型-数据集组合中，校准使已承诺答案的准确率最多提升41个百分点，但可能降低覆盖率并增加检索使用。整体准确率在HotpotQA上最多提升15个百分点，但在MuSiQue上最多下降17个百分点。检索前拟合的校准映射在第1和第2层检索深度上改善held-out校准，但第3层时三个模型均差于原始置信度。
AI.conclusion: 校准的效果体现为向更选择性、更低风险的操作点的转变，而非改善答案质量或置信度排序。校准可以让承诺风险变得可解释，但它不能估计另一次检索的预期收益——检索需要独立的价值信息或效用估计。评估应同时报告held-out校准、风险-覆盖率曲线和检索成本。

title: UniFLM: United Segmentation and Measurement on Fetal Limb Ultrasonic Image
summary: Prenatal ultrasound examination is crucial for assessing fetal limb development and detecting congenital anomalies. However, existing artificial intelligence models often overlook fetal lethal skeletal dysplasias due to the lack of high-quality annotated data and a unified framework for multiple long bones. Moreover, generic segmentation models struggle with the inherent noise and semantic gaps in ultrasound images. To address these challenges, we construct the Fetal Limb Bones (FLB) dataset, comprising high-quality annotations for the humerus, femur, tibia-fibula, and radius-ulna. Furthermore, we propose UniFLM, a unified framework for automatic cross-plane segmentation and measurement. UniFLM incorporates a Semantic-Aware Skip Connection module to bridge the semantic gap between encoder and decoder features, and a Positive Sampling strategy to adaptively filter noise and extract essential semantic information. Finally, a Point Regression Mapping module is introduced to learn clinician annotation patterns for precise bone length measurement. Extensive experiments conducted on the FLB dataset demonstrate that the proposed UniFLM achieves superior accuracy and enhanced generalization capabilities in fetal long bone assessment compared to current state-of-the-art models.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了胎儿四肢长骨（FLB）数据集，并提出了UniFLM统一框架，用于产前超声图像中胎儿长骨的自动跨平面分割与长度测量，通过语义感知跳跃连接、正采样策略和点回归映射模块，在分割精度和泛化能力上超越现有最先进模型。
AI.motivation: 产前超声检查对评估胎儿肢体发育和检测先天异常至关重要，但现有AI模型因缺乏高质量标注数据和统一的多长骨框架而常忽视胎儿致死性骨骼发育不良；同时通用分割模型难以应对超声图像固有的噪声和语义差距问题。
AI.method: 提出UniFLM统一框架，包含三个关键模块：（1）语义感知跳跃连接（Semantic-Aware Skip Connection）模块，弥合编码器与解码器特征间的语义差距；（2）正采样（Positive Sampling）策略，自适应过滤噪声并提取关键语义信息；（3）点回归映射（Point Regression Mapping）模块，学习临床医生的标注模式以实现精确的骨长度测量。同时构建了覆盖肱骨、股骨、胫腓骨和桡尺骨的高质量标注FLB数据集。
AI.result: 在FLB数据集上的大量实验表明，UniFLM在胎儿长骨评估中相比当前最先进模型取得了更高的准确性，并展现出更强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: UniFLM通过统一框架有效解决了胎儿长骨分割与测量中的噪声和语义差距问题，为产前超声胎儿骨骼发育评估提供了更精确和可靠的AI工具。

title: Thomson: Continual Learning of Frontier Models for SovereignAI
summary: The development of frontier models is commonly perceived to be the exclusive remit of a small number of heavily funded players, creating an information, economic and power asymmetry between developers and the diverse user base of modern AI. Recent public discourse acknowledges this concern, calling for SovereignAI (an organisation's capability to independently build, deploy and govern AI use), but offers little concrete advice on how this can be achieved in the short term under a diversity of funding settings. We argue that frontier performance is achievable by a wide range of institutions through Continual Learning on readily available open-weight models. Unlike limited approaches such as small-scale fine-tuning, prompt engineering, or tool-augmentation of a frozen model, our approach exploits a modern mid- & post-training stack while introducing safeguards that preserve both plasticity and stability at each stage, making the minimal number of high-impact interventions on the parameters. This yields gains comparable to those typically seen across multiple successive model generations, at compute and personnel budgets substantially lower than commonly thought, making ownership of large parts of the SovereignAI stack (model, tool infrastructure, values & data privacy) viable for far more actors. We demonstrate this with Thomson, a general-purpose frontier model trained with an enhanced focus on high-stakes professional work. Thomson performs competitively with recent frontier models across agentic tasks, safety, legal, tax & multilingualism, and large-scale Deep Research. Evaluations show a distinctive $π$-shaped pattern: distinct improvements across a wide range of capabilities, including those not explicitly targeted, while almost completely eliminating the forgetting problem common to narrow domain adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文论证通过持续学习（Continual Learning）在开放权重模型基础上，广泛机构可以实现前沿模型性能，而非仅由少数资金雄厚的玩家垄断。作者提出保留可塑性与稳定性的中后期训练堆栈方法，以较低计算和人力预算取得跨越多代模型才有的性能提升。通过Thomson模型（专注于高风险专业工作）验证，其在智能体任务、安全、法律、税务、多语言及深度研究等方面与前沿模型竞争，呈现π形性能增强模式，同时几乎消除领域适配中的灾难性遗忘问题。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型开发被少数大型玩家垄断，造成开发者与AI用户之间的信息、经济和权力不对称。虽然公共话语呼吁"主权AI"（SovereignAI），但缺乏如何在多样化资金条件下短期内实现的具体指导。现有方法（小规模微调、提示工程、冻结模型的工具增强）不足以突破性能瓶颈，需要一种更系统的方案。
AI.method: 采用现代中/后期训练堆栈的持续学习方法，在可获得的开放权重模型基础上进行优化。该方法区别于有限的微调和提示工程，在每个阶段引入保护可塑性（plasticity）与稳定性（stability）的保障机制，对参数进行最少但高影响的干预。核心突破在于利用完整的现代训练堆栈而非冻结模型的浅层增强。
AI.result: 通过Thomson模型验证，其性能与近期前沿模型在智能体任务、安全、法律、税务、多语言和大型深度研究任务上具竞争力。评估显示独特的π形模式：广泛能力获得显著提升（包括未明确目标的领域），同时几乎完全消除窄域适配中常见的灾难性遗忘问题。性能增益相当于跨越多个连续模型世代的提升，而预算远低于通常预期。
AI.conclusion: 前沿性能并非大型科技公司专属，通过持续学习策略，更多机构能够拥有SovereignAI堆栈的大部分（模型、工具基础设施、价值观和数据隐私），实现AI开发的民主化。这为广泛机构在多样资金条件下实现自主AI能力提供了切实可行的路径。

title: Planting a Latent Variable in Natural-Looking Text: a More Realistic Test of Belief States in LLMs and Their Link to Concept Geometry
summary: LLMs are thought to track "belief states," i.e., running probability distributions over the latent variables that govern language (Shai et al., 2024; Sarfati et al., 2026), but so far this has only been comprehensively demonstrated on toy synthetic data and in a few isolated case studies. It has also never been empirically connected to the geometry of LLM features (the concepts interpretability finds in model activations). In this work, we plant a controllable latent variable inside natural-looking text. An LLM teacher writes ordinary text while we "subliminally" steer it along one of K = 8 unrelated sparse autoencoder directions at each token, with the active directions following a ring-shaped Markov chain. A small transformer model trained on this corpus does indeed track the Bayesian posterior belief about our planted latent variable. Moreover, it also arranges the 8 states themselves on a ring, in the exact order of the Markov chain, which is supporting evidence that a concept's geometry can be formed by the statistical dynamics of the latent variable behind it.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在校验文本中植入可控隐性变量（用稀疏自编码器方向对8种状态构成环形马尔可夫链），证明小Transformer模型能追踪该隐性变量的贝叶斯后验信念，同时模型激活特征将这些状态排列成与马尔可夫链一致的环形几何结构，首次将LLM的信念追踪能力与特征几何联系起来。
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明LLM会追踪"信念状态"（即对控制语言的隐性变量的概率分布），但之前的证据仅来自玩具合成数据和少数孤立案例，且从未与LLM特征几何（可解释性研究中发现的激活概念）建立经验联系。本文旨在弥合这一空白。
AI.method: 作者在自然文本中植入可控隐性变量：LLM教师模型生成普通文本时，在每个token处沿K=8个不相关的稀疏自编码器（SAE）方向之一"潜意识地"引导模型，激活方向遵循环形马尔可夫链。随后训练一个小型Transformer模型在该语料上学习，检验其是否追踪所植入隐性变量的贝叶斯后验信念。
AI.result: 小型Transformer确实追踪了关于植入隐性变量的贝叶斯后验信念；更重要的是，模型将这8个状态本身排列在环形上，顺序与马尔可夫链的转移顺序完全一致，为"概念的几何结构可由其背后隐性变量的统计动力学形成"提供了经验证据。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在自然语言场景中将LLM的信念追踪能力与特征几何联系起来，表明隐性变量的统计动力学可能是模型激活中概念几何结构形成的重要驱动力。

title: Sidecar: Training-Free Semantic Reuse for Character-Consistent Free-form Visual Storytelling
summary: Visual storytelling requires generating images that follow a narrative while preserving consistent character identities across frames. In free-form story generation, a character is fully described only when first introduced and is later referred to by a type-level mention or pronoun. Although this setting better reflects natural storytelling, later prompts may omit important identity-related semantics, making character consistency more difficult to maintain. We propose \textbf{Sidecar}, a plug-and-play semantic augmentation module that preserves entity-level information from the initial description and injects the missing semantics into later prompt embeddings. Sidecar requires no additional training and does not modify the architecture of the base diffusion model. Experiments on FreeStoryBench show that Sidecar consistently improves prompt-image alignment and character consistency across multiple SDXL- and FLUX-based baselines, with negligible computational overhead.

AI.tldr: Sidecar是一个即插即用的语义增强模块，通过保留初始描述中的实体级信息并注入后续提示嵌入，在无需额外训练和修改架构的情况下提升自由形式故事生成中的角色一致性。
AI.motivation: 在自由形式故事生成中，角色只在首次出现时被完整描述，后续仅通过类型级提及或代词引用，导致后续提示丢失重要的身份相关语义，使角色一致性难以维持。
AI.method: 提出Sidecar，一个即插即用的语义增强模块，从初始描述中保留实体级信息并将其注入后续提示的嵌入中，无需额外训练，也不修改基础扩散模型的架构。
AI.result: 在FreeStoryBench上的实验表明，Sidecar在多个SDXL和FLUX基线上持续提升了提示-图像对齐和角色一致性，且计算开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: Sidecar通过语义增强有效解决了自由故事生成中角色一致性难题，具备即插即用、零训练、低开销的优势，可广泛适用于多种扩散模型基线。

title: BPMN4CAI: A BPMN Extension for Modeling Dynamic Conversational AI
comment: Presented at the 20th International Conference on Wirtschaftsinformatik (WI 2025), September 2025, Münster, Germany
summary: Conversational AI systems, such as chatbots and virtual assistants, are becoming increasingly important to digital business processes. However, the established Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) standard faces challenges when representing dynamic, context-sensitive interactions. This paper addresses this methodological and practical research gap by developing a standard-compliant BPMN extension (BPMN4CAI). Using Design Science Research methodology, this paper develops an approach that systematically extends existing BPMN elements and incorporates specialized components. The applicability and relevance of the BPMN4CAI framework are demonstrated and evaluated through a case study. The results show that the BPMN4CAI extension facilitates adaptive decision-making processes, robust context management, and transparent interactions for Conversational AI within business processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BPMN4CAI，一种基于Design Science Research方法开发的、符合标准的BPMN扩展框架，用于在业务流程中建模会话式AI（如聊天机器人和虚拟助手）。通过案例研究验证，该框架能够支持自适应的决策过程、稳健的上下文管理和透明的交互。
AI.motivation: 会话式AI系统在数字业务流程中日益重要，但现有的BPMN标准在表示动态、上下文敏感的交互方面存在不足，存在方法论和实践上的研究空白。
AI.method: 采用Design Science Research（设计科学研究）方法论，系统性地扩展现有BPMN元素，并纳入专门的组件，开发出符合BPMN标准的扩展框架（BPMN4CAI）。
AI.result: 通过案例研究验证了BPMN4CAI框架的适用性和相关性，结果表明该扩展能够促进业务流程中会话式AI的自适应决策、稳健的上下文管理以及透明交互。
AI.conclusion: BPMN4CAI为业务流程中建模会话式AI提供了一种标准兼容的解决方案，填补了BPMN在此领域的方法论空白。

title: TabuLM: Morphology-Aware Tabular Pre-training for Low-Resource Languages
summary: We present TabuLM, the first language model pre-trained on Kinyarwanda tabular data. Kinyarwanda is a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda, yet lacks any dedicated tabular representation learning resource. TabuLM extends KinyaBERT-large, a two-tier morphological transformer, with additive row, column, and cell-type embeddings and a learned table-structure attention bias that sharpens same-row and same-column attention. Pre-training uses two new objectives: Masked Cell Recovery (MCR), which masks entire cells and forces reconstruction from row and column context, and Column Type Prediction (CTP), which predicts column semantic types from observed cell values. We pre-train on 172 Rwandan government tables (~35,000 cells) from NISR, RAB, REB, and MoH open-data portals, and introduce TabQA-kin, the first native Kinyarwanda table question-answering benchmark comprising 526 QA pairs across 31 tables and four question types. TabuLM achieves 62.0% exact match on TabQA-kin, outperforming KinyaBERT-large by 5.7 EM points and all multilingual baselines (mBERT 49.3%, XLM-R 50.0%) by 11.7-12.7 points. Analysis shows that structural table embeddings are most decisive for comparison and lookup questions, while morphological awareness provides complementary gains. Our code, data, and pre-trained checkpoint are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TabuLM，这是首个针对基尼亚卢旺达语（Kinyarwanda）表格数据预训练的语言模型。该模型在 KinyaBERT-large 的基础上引入行、列、单元格类型嵌入和表格结构注意力偏置，并通过掩码单元格恢复（MCR）和列类型预测（CTP）两个新预训练目标，在 TabQA-kin 基准上达到 62.0% 的精确匹配率，显著优于所有基线模型。
AI.motivation: 基尼亚卢旺达语是一种形态丰富的班图语，拥有超过1200万使用者，但缺乏任何专门的表格表示学习资源。现有表格语言模型和 QA 系统主要面向英语等主流语言，无法有效处理该语言的表格数据。
AI.method: TabuLM 扩展了 KinyaBERT-large（两层形态变换器），通过以下方式建模表格结构：(1) 增加行、列和单元格类型三类加性嵌入；(2) 引入可学习的表格结构注意力偏置以增强同行、同列注意力；(3) 提出两个预训练目标：掩码单元格恢复（MCR）从行列上下文重建隐藏单元格，列类型预测（CTP）根据单元格值预测列语义类型。模型在卢旺达政府数据门户（NISR、RAB、REB、MoH）的172张表格（约35,000个单元格）上预训练，并构建了首个原生基尼亚卢旺达语表格问答基准 TabQA-kin，含526对问答、31张表和四类问题。
AI.result: TabuLM 在 TabQA-kin 上达到 62.0% 的精确匹配（EM），比 KinyaBERT-large 高 5.7 个 EM 点，比多语言基线（mBERT 49.3%、XLM-R 50.0%）高 11.7-12.7 个点。消融分析表明表格结构嵌入对比较类和查找类问题最有效，而形态学感知提供了互补的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: TabuLM 证明了将表格结构建模与形态感知预训练相结合，可以有效提升低资源语言表格问答性能。代码、数据和预训练模型均已公开，为该语言及相关低资源语言的研究提供了基础资源。

title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures. Code, data, pre-registration and all cached model outputs: https://github.com/Pranav-1100/confidence-calibration-evaluation . Also archived at Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22043517
summary: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from the 37.6% produced by genuine market data. What unlocks confident action is not information but the authority of its packaging. The failure is narrow and locatable. Incapacity is not the answer: on matched answerable questions attached to the same panels, the same models answer essentially always, at near-perfect accuracy. Nor is it belief - stated probabilities barely move across the gradient that swings action by 48 points, and score worse than a climatological baseline. Missing judgment isn't it either: asked to classify a question's knowability before acting, models call it irreducible 90% of the time and then commit on just 0.4% of those. The act/don't-act gate is what fails, and the effect is concentrated in a few models rather than universal. Because the gate is separable, it can be trained. Supervised fine-tuning of a 3B model on 540 synthetic cases, predominantly dice, coins, jars and timers, drives commitment to 0.0% on the original cases and transfers to three unseen domains. It does not survive everything: the gate holds exactly when the response format leaves room to reason, and rigid formats that remove that room leave the model confident and wrong on questions it otherwise answers correctly. The gate is trainable and context-fragile, and deployment needs both halves of that sentence.

AI.tldr: 本论文研究LLM智能体在面对专业外观的市场面板时，即使问题在原则上不可预测，仍会做出方向性判断的概率显著上升。研究发现这种"自信行动"并非源于信息本身，而是源于信息的"包装权威性"——即使数据完全虚构，效果与真实数据几乎相同。失败环节定位在"行动/不行动门控"而非能力、信念或判断力，且可通过少量合成数据微调修复，但该门控对响应格式极为敏感。
AI.motivation: 探究为什么LLM会在本质上不可预测的问题上做出明确的方向性判断，以及这种"过度自信承诺"的成因机制。核心动机是定位失败的具体环节（能力不足、信念偏差、判断缺失还是行动门控失效），从而判断该问题是否可修复、如何修复。
AI.method: 设计了12个前沿模型的对照实验，比较"裸提问"与"附带专业外观市场面板"两种条件下的承诺率。通过虚构全部数据的面板作为对照，分离信息内容与包装形式的作用。进一步通过概率陈述测试、可判定性分类测试定位失败环节。最后在3B模型上使用540个合成案例（骰子、硬币、罐子、计时器等）进行监督微调来训练行动门控，并测试领域迁移和格式鲁棒性。
AI.result: 承诺率从裸提问的6.5%升至带面板的54.0%（跨12个模型）；虚构数据显示仍从24.5%升至36.8%，与真实数据的37.6%在统计上不可区分。模型在可回答的匹配问题上准确率近乎完美；陈述概率几乎不随证据梯度变化且不如气候学基线；模型90%时间正确判定问题不可知，但其中仅0.4%时拒绝行动。微调后3B模型在原案例上承诺率降至0.0%并迁移到三个未见领域。但严格格式导致门控失效，模型再次自信而错误。
AI.conclusion: 驱动LLM做出自信行动的不是信息而是包装的权威性。失败并非源于能力、信念或判断力，而是可分离的行动门控环节。该门控可训练但上下文脆弱：需要足够的推理空间才能生效，过于刻板的响应格式会绕过门控导致模型在原本能正确回答的问题上犯错。部署时需要同时考虑门控的可训练性与格式敏感性。

title: Mapping Written Words to Spoken Words in a Different Language Using Only Visual Grounding
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables, preprint, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Audio, Speech and Language Processing
summary: In many low-resource settings, even just eliciting speech for data collection is difficult. One promising approach has been to ask speakers to describe images. But how do we build models from such visually grounded speech data? Given a dataset of images with Hindi spoken captions, we consider how we can map a written English keyword to spoken realisations of that word in Hindi. Previous work trained end-to-end multimodal neural models. Instead, we explore a simpler alignment-based approach built on self-supervised speech representations. Written English tags are automatically obtained from images using off-the-shelf image captioning systems. Hindi utterances associated with the same keyword are then aligned (using self-supervised features), and alignment evidence is aggregated to identify recurring speech segments corresponding to the target word. Experiments evaluating keyword spotting and localization show that our alignment-based approach outperforms a previous attention-based neural model. We also show the benefit of incorporating negative examples during alignment. Our work demonstrates that cross-lingual word-to-speech mappings can be learned directly from visual grounding without transcriptions or explicit model training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于对齐的方法，利用自监督语音表征从视觉接地语音数据中学习跨语言词到语音的映射，无需转录或显式模型训练，在关键词检测和定位任务上优于先前基于注意力机制的神经模型。
AI.motivation: 在低资源场景下，语音数据采集困难，视觉接地语音（如图像配印地语口语描述）成为一种有前景的数据获取方式。已有工作使用端到端多模态神经模型来学习从书面英语关键词到印地语口语表达的映射，但这类方法训练复杂、资源需求高。研究者希望探索更简单、无需转录和显式模型训练的对齐方法。
AI.method: 该方法基于对齐框架：首先利用现成的图像字幕生成系统自动为图像获取书面英语标签；随后将与同一关键词关联的印地语话语使用自监督语音特征进行对齐；通过聚合对齐证据来识别与目标词对应的重复语音片段。此外，在训练过程中引入负例以提升对齐质量。
AI.result: 在关键词检测（keyword spotting）和定位（localization）实验中，所提出的基于对齐的方法优于先前基于注意力机制的神经模型；同时实验表明在训练中融入负例能进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明跨语言的词到语音映射可以直接从视觉接地中学习，无需转录标注或显式模型训练，为低资源场景下的语音关键词学习提供了一种简单且有效的替代方案。

title: Detection of Christmas tree plantations from high-resolution aerial imagery. A case study in the French Morvan
comment: 18 pages, 9 figures. Submitted to IEEE JSTARS; currently under revision
summary: Christmas tree plantations are economically relevant, yet a largely unexplored application domain in Remote Sensing (RS). Their delineation is challenging because of high planting density, short rotation cycles, visual confusion with surrounding vegetation, the availability of dense labels for one reference year only, and severe class imbalance at the landscape scale.
