Although Deep Learning (DL) methods have shown strong potential for vegetation mapping, existing approaches are typically designed for forests, generic plantation systems, or orchards, and do not explicitly address the structural specificity and hard-negative confusion that characterize Christmas tree plantations. In response to these challenges, this work makes three main contributions: (i) it frames Christmas tree plantation mapping as a distinct rare-target semantic segmentation problem; (ii) it introduces a Hard Negative Mining (HNM) strategy to improve discrimination against confusing background patterns; and (iii) it evaluates the proposed framework across complementary levels, including supervised testing, temporal transfer, and large-scale validation. On the 2020 test set held out, the best model, DeepLabV3 with a ResNet-34 encoder, achieves an IoU of 0.733 and an F1-score of 0.846. HNM substantially improves precision-recall behavior, increasing the area under the precision-recall curve from 0.204 to 0.913. Temporal inference further shows meaningful transferability, reaching IoU/F1 values of 0.751/0.858 on 2017/2018 and 0.691/0.817 on 2023. Large-scale validation further highlights the intrinsic difficulty of the task, as Christmas tree plantations occupied only a very small fraction of the extent of the common evaluation, corresponding to 1,498.4 ha (1.72\%) in 2017/2018 and 1,782.2 ha (2.04\%) in 2023 out of 87,309.4 ha in total.

AI.tldr: 本文首次将圣诞树种植园制图问题界定为一个罕见的目标准语义分割任务，提出硬负样本挖掘（HNM）策略以改善与周围植被的混淆，并在监督测试、时间迁移和大规模验证三个层面进行系统性评估。最佳模型DeepLabV3+ResNet-34在2020测试集上达到IoU 0.733和F1 0.846，HNM将PR曲线下面积从0.204大幅提升至0.913，且展现良好的时间迁移性。
AI.motivation: 圣诞树种植园具有重要的经济价值，但长期被遥感领域忽视。其测绘面临多重挑战：种植密度高、轮伐周期短、与周围植被视觉混淆严重、仅有一个参考年份的密集标签，以及景观尺度的严重类别不平衡。现有深度学习植被制图方法主要面向森林、一般种植园或果园设计，未能明确应对圣诞树种植园的结构特异性和硬负例混淆问题。
AI.method: 本文做出三项核心贡献：(i) 将圣诞树种植园制图界定为罕见的目标准语义分割问题；(ii) 提出硬负样本挖掘（HNM）策略，用于提高模型对混淆背景模式的判别能力；(iii) 在监督测试、时间迁移和大规模验证等多个互补层面评估所提出的框架，并与DeepLabV3+ResNet-34等模型结合验证。
AI.result: 在2020保留测试集上，最优模型DeepLabV3+ResNet-34达到IoU 0.733和F1 0.846。HNM显著改善了精确率-召回率行为，将PR曲线下面积从0.204提升至0.913。时间推断展现有意义的迁移能力，2017/2018年IoU/F1为0.751/0.858，2023年为0.691/0.817。大规模验证揭示任务的内在难度，圣诞树种植园总面积仅占87,309.4 ha评价范围的一小部分：2017/2018年为1,498.4 ha（1.72%），2023年为1,782.2 ha（2.04%）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，将圣诞树种植园制图作为罕见的目标准语义分割任务，并结合硬负样本挖掘策略，能够有效提升模型在严重类别不平衡下的判别性能。模型展现出良好的时间迁移性和大规模应用潜力，尽管任务的极端稀疏特征从根本上决定了其固有难度。

title: What Makes Good Agentic Data? An ACE Lens on Data Generation for LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on generated interaction data to learn how to interact with external environments. Agentic data generation must maintain consistency among environments, tasks, interactions, and success signals while producing experience that is useful rather than merely abundant. Existing work spans many agent domains, but domain-centered organization and heterogeneous evaluation often obscure common generation mechanisms and conflate candidate construction with verification and selection. This work develops a two-level framework for the field. First, we represent agentic data as a common factorized object $(E,q,τ,v)$, comprising an environment specification, task signal, interaction realization, and optional verifier. We organize generation paradigms by their primary anchor and dependency structure. Second, we formulate generation as constrained distribution design through the Accuracy-Complexity-divErsity (ACE) lens. Accuracy establishes the feasible support of grounded and internally consistent data. Within this support, Complexity places learning mass relative to the capability of a declared learner and execution configuration, while divErsity controls coverage and redundancy of data. Using this framework, we explore how prior work verifies generated experience, constructs and calibrates difficulty, and expands behavioral coverage. The literature reveals a shift toward execution-grounded accuracy, learner-relative complexity, and diversity beyond surface variation or dataset size. We further discuss broader directions and emerging trends in agentic data generation through the ACE lens, including their implications for scaling, data sources, training regimes and adaptive learning. Overall, the central challenge is not simply to generate more data, but to continually allocate valid, informative, and non-redundant experience as agents and environments evolve.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于智能体数据生成领域的两层框架：将智能体数据表示为因子化对象(E,q,τ,v)，并通过"准确性-复杂度-多样性"(ACE)视角将生成问题形式化为约束分布设计，揭示了现有工作从执行锚定的准确性、学习者相对复杂度以及超越表面变化的多样性方向的演进。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体越来越依赖生成的交互数据来学习与外部环境交互，但现有工作存在两个核心问题：一是按领域划分导致生成机制被割裂，难以揭示共通原理；二是异构评估混淆了候选构建与验证/选择的界限，使得"有用的经验"与"海量数据"被混为一谈。因此需要一个统一的、跨领域的分析框架来厘清该领域的核心机制。
AI.method: 本文提出两层分析框架：第一层，将智能体数据表示为因子化对象(E,q,τ,v)，即环境规格、任务信号、交互实现和可选验证器，并按照主锚点和依赖结构对生成范式进行分类；第二层，通过ACE透镜（准确性-复杂度-多样性）将生成建模为受约束的分布设计——准确性定义可行支撑集，复杂度在支撑集内根据学习者能力和执行配置分配学习质量，多样性控制覆盖度和冗余度。基于此框架审视现有工作在验证、难度校准和行为覆盖方面的做法。
AI.result: 文献分析揭示了三个趋势：从预定义准确性转向执行锚定的准确性（以真实环境交互为验证基础）；从固定难度转向学习者相对的复杂度校准；从表面变化或数据集规模转向更深层的行为多样性。本文还通过ACE视角讨论了扩展、数据来源、训练制度和自适应学习等方向。
AI.conclusion: 智能体数据生成的核心挑战不在于生成更多数据，而在于随着智能体和环境演化，持续分配有效、信息丰富且非冗余的经验——这需要以ACE为原则，将数据生成视为一个动态、约束化的分布设计过程。

title: KinyaEmbed: Contrastive Sentence Embeddings for Kinyarwanda via Multi-Stage Curriculum Training
summary: We present KinyaEmbed, the first dedicated sentence embedding model for Kinyarwanda, a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda. Existing multilingual embedding models such as LaBSE, mE5-large, and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large perform poorly on Kinyarwanda due to severe under-representation in their pre-training corpora. KinyaEmbed is built on KinyaBERT-large and trained via a four-stage curriculum using MultipleNegativesRankingLoss (MNRL): Stage 1 leverages ~18,000 paraphrase pairs from the Official Gazette of Rwanda with three temperature scales; Stage 2 fine-tunes on 715 NLLB-translated MNLI triplets for entailment structure; Stage 3 aligns representations using English-Kinyarwanda OPUS-100 translation pairs; Stage 4 refines with 2,936 high-quality pairs filtered from KinyaCOMET at quality threshold 0.8. We evaluate on SemRel2024-rw and introduce Wiki-RW-STS, a new contamination-free Kinyarwanda STS benchmark of 300 pairs derived from Kinyarwanda Wikipedia. A seven-checkpoint ensemble (all5+23A*2, with the final stage double-weighted) achieves Spearman \r{ho}=0.7298 on SemRel2024-rw, surpassing mE5-large by 20.9% and OpenAI text-embedding-3-large by 41.0%. KinyaEmbed also achieves the best document clustering silhouette score (0.2146) across all evaluated models. All checkpoints, the KinyaCOMET filtered pairs, and the Wiki-RW-STS benchmark are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KinyaEmbed，首个面向基尼亚卢旺达语（Kinyarwanda）的专用句子嵌入模型，通过四阶段课程训练策略（使用MultipleNegativesRankingLoss），在SemRel2024-rw基准上达到Spearman ρ=0.7298，超越mE5-large 20.9%、OpenAI text-embedding-3-large 41.0%，并引入无污染的新基准Wiki-RW-STS。
AI.motivation: 基尼亚卢旺达语是一种形态丰富的班图语，拥有超过1200万使用者，但现有多语言嵌入模型（如LaBSE、mE5-large、OpenAI text-embedding-3-large）因预训练语料中该语言严重欠表示而表现不佳，亟需专用模型来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 基于KinyaBERT-large构建，采用四阶段课程式训练，全部使用MultipleNegativesRankingLoss (MNRL)：阶段1利用卢旺达官方公报约18,000对释义对，并采用三个温度尺度；阶段2在715个NLLB翻译的MNLI三元组上微调以学习蕴含结构；阶段3使用英语-基尼亚卢旺达语OPUS-100翻译对进行表示对齐；阶段4使用经KinyaCOMET在0.8质量阈值下过滤的2,936个高质量句对精调。评估采用SemRel2024-rw及新构建的Wiki-RW-STS基准（从基尼亚卢旺达语维基百科导出的300对无污染STS数据）。最终采用七检查点集成策略（all5+23A*2，最后阶段双倍加权）。
AI.result: 在SemRel2024-rw上取得Spearman ρ=0.7298，分别超越mE5-large 20.9%和OpenAI text-embedding-3-large 41.0%；在文档聚类任务上取得最佳轮廓系数0.2146，优于所有被评估的模型。所有检查点、KinyaCOMET过滤句对和Wiki-RW-STS基准均已公开。
AI.conclusion: KinyaEmbed证明了针对低资源、形态丰富的语言训练专用嵌入模型可以显著超越通用多语言模型，四阶段课程训练和检查点集成策略在本场景下有效，同时公开数据与基准有助于推动该语言的NLP研究和社区发展。

title: R2M-Bench: Evaluating Revisit Memory via Relative Consistency in Interactive Video World Models
summary: High similarity between first-visit and return frames does not necessarily show that a video world model remembered the scene; the intervening rollout may simply have changed very little. This ambiguity makes absolute revisit scores sensitive to rendering stability, repetitive content, and failed motion. We introduce \emph{R2M-Bench} (\textbf{R}elative \textbf{R}evisit \textbf{M}emory Benchmark), a benchmark of observable revisit-selective consistency. For every detected return, R2M-Bench compares the revisit pair with two controls from the same rollout: a gap-matched non-revisit pair that measures generic temporal stability and a short-range pair that estimates short-horizon consistency. These comparisons produce \emph{MemoryGain} (MG), the revisit advantage over the temporal baseline, and the \emph{Normalized Memory Ratio} (NMR), which normalizes this advantage by the short-to-baseline dynamic range. R2M-Bench combines 100 reference scenes with three leave-and-return trajectories to form 300 instances and evaluates appearance fidelity, scene and object identity, local geometry, and persistent state. Across seven action-conditioned video world models, Overall NMR correlates with human consistency judgments at Spearman's $ρ=0.547$ (95\% CI $[0.45,0.63]$). Its within-model correlation magnitude with generated motion is $0.072$, compared with $0.207$ for raw revisit similarity, indicating that relative calibration substantially reduces the slow-motion shortcut. DreamX-World-Memo achieves the highest Overall NMR among the evaluated video models. Together, these results support same-rollout relative calibration as a practical way to distinguish revisit-specific consistency from generic temporal stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出R2M-Bench基准，通过同一条rollout内的相对校准（对比重访对与两种控制对），将重访记忆一致性从一般的时序稳定性中区分出来，并引入MemoryGain和Normalized Memory Ratio两个指标。实验表明该方法显著减少慢动作捷径，与人类一致性判断高度相关。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频世界模型重访记忆评估存在根本性缺陷：首次访问帧与返回帧的高相似度可能仅仅因为中间的rollout变化很少（渲染稳定性、重复内容或动作失败导致），而非模型真正记住了场景。这种歧义使绝对重访分数不可靠，需要一种能区分"重访特异性记忆"与"总体时序稳定性"的评估方法。
AI.method: R2M-Bench对每个检测到的重访对，从同一rollout中取出两个控制对进行对比：(1) 间隔匹配的非重访对，用于衡量一般时序稳定性；(2) 短距对，用于估计短时一致性。由此计算两个指标：MemoryGain（MG）为重访对相对于时序基线的优势，Normalized Memory Ratio（NMR）将该优势按短距到基线的动态范围进行归一化。基准包含100个参考场景×3条离开-返回轨迹=300个实例，评估外观保真度、场景与物体身份、局部几何和持久状态。
AI.result: 在七个动作条件视频世界模型上，Overall NMR与人类一致性判断的Spearman相关系数为ρ=0.547（95%CI [0.45,0.63]）。其与生成运动的模型内相关性为0.072，而原始重访相似度为0.207，表明相对校准大幅降低了慢动作捷径。DreamX-World-Memo在评测模型中取得最高Overall NMR。
AI.conclusion: 同一rollout内的相对校准是区分重访特异性一致性与一般时序稳定性的实用方法，能有效消除评估中的慢动作捷径偏差，为视频世界模型的记忆能力提供更可靠的评测。

title: Naive Prompt Optimization: Rethinking the Need for Complex Prompt Search
summary: Efficiently improving autonomous agents across diverse tasks is central to accelerating recursive self-improvement (RSI) in agentic AI, with prompt optimization emerging as a promising approach capable of delivering performance gains comparable to those achieved by fine-tuning model weights, while reducing computational costs in both optimization and serving. However, recent developments increasingly favor unnecessarily complex prompt optimizers. We introduce Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO), a lightweight single-lineage method that iteratively revises prompts using a teacher model with rollout feedback. NPO achieves comparable or better performance than GEPA with fewer rollouts, and its advantage increases with stronger teacher models, suggesting that stronger teacher reasoning can partially substitute for optimizer-side search complexity. In interactive games, NPO remains broadly competitive with GEPA, while GRPO performs better on some tasks less amenable to prompt optimization. We also show that NPO-optimized prompts elicit similar performance improvements when applied verbatim to other student models, especially across models within the same family. Overall, our preliminary results show that simple, linear prompt optimization can rival substantially more sophisticated and complex search procedures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Naive Prompt Optimization (NPO)，一种轻量级单谱系提示优化方法，仅通过教师模型与rollout反馈迭代修正提示即可达到或超越复杂的优化器（如GEPA）的性能，且更少的rollout、更强的教师模型推理可替代优化器端的搜索复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在agentic AI中，通过提示优化提升自主agent性能是加速递归自我改进（RSI）的关键途径，其效果可与微调模型权重相媲美且计算成本更低。然而近期研究倾向于采用不必要的复杂提示优化器，作者质疑这种复杂性是否必要，主张探索简单方法能否达到同等效果。
AI.method: NPO是一种轻量级单谱系（single-lineage）方法，使用教师模型在rollout反馈的指导下迭代修订提示，不引入复杂的搜索结构或多分支探索。实验对比包括GEPA以及GRPO等基线，涵盖交互式游戏等任务，并测试跨模型迁移能力。
AI.result: NPO在更少的rollout下达到或优于GEPA的性能；教师模型越强，NPO相对优势越明显，表明强教师推理可部分替代优化器端搜索复杂度。在交互式游戏中NPO与GEPA基本持平，而GRPO在部分不适合提示优化的任务上表现更好。NPO优化得到的提示可原样迁移到其他学生模型（尤其是同族模型）并获得类似性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 初步结果表明，简单线性的提示优化可以匹敌甚至超越远为复杂的搜索过程，提示优化器的设计不应盲目追求复杂度，简洁的单谱系方法在计算效率和泛化性上具有实际价值。

title: Squeezing More from Limited Data with Recursive Transformers
summary: Pre-training under limited data requires a different view of scaling than web-scale language modeling. With a fixed data budget but relatively abundant compute, increasing parameter count helps only up to an optimal scale; beyond that point, models overfit and generalization worsens. We study this behavior across 10M-100M word pre-training budgets, two corpora, and multiple downstream evaluations, and find that optimal size depends strongly on both the data budget and the downstream target. We argue that standard Transformers scale down poorly to this setting, because embeddings consume a large fraction of the parameter budget and per-token computation is tied to representational capacity. To address this coupling, we study recursive Transformers, reusing a shared block across depth to scale compute, together with factorized embeddings to reduce vocabulary-map parameters. We train three recursive models and find that they outperform standard Transformers at 10M and 100M words, while remaining competitive with BabyLM Challenge 2025 winners.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限数据预算下Transformer的规模扩展策略，发现标准Transformer在10M-100M词预算下因嵌入层参数占比过高和计算与表示能力耦合而难以有效缩放；通过递归Transformer共享跨深度模块并采用分解嵌入，在低数据预算下超越标准Transformer，并与BabyLM 2025冠军模型性能相当。
AI.motivation: 大规模网络级语言建模的扩展规律不适用于有限数据场景：在固定数据预算下，简单地增加参数量会导致过拟合。需要研究标准Transformer在低数据预算下表现不佳的结构性原因，并提出更适合该场景的模型架构。
AI.method: 在10M-100M词的预训练预算下，对标准Transformer的最优规模进行系统性研究；指出嵌入层占用大量参数预算且每token计算与表示容量耦合的问题；提出递归Transformer（跨深度共享模块以扩展计算量）和分解嵌入（减少词汇映射参数量）来解耦参数与计算。
AI.result: 最优模型规模高度依赖数据预算和下游任务目标；在10M和100M词预算下，递归Transformer优于标准Transformer，且与BabyLM挑战赛2025冠军模型具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 有限数据条件下的模型设计不应直接套用Web级扩展规律，递归计算共享与参数分解是低数据预算下更有效的架构设计方向。

title: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
summary: Recent video generation models are increasingly framed as world models. Many physical processes can unfold in more than one valid way. Therefore, a world model should reproduce not only a plausible trajectory, but also the distribution of possible behaviors under the same initial observation and action. We call this distribution-level requirement probabilistic alignment. However, existing evaluations largely assess individual-video plausibility and do not test whether repeated generations recover the correct distribution. This raises a central question: how far are current video generators from probabilistically aligned world modeling? To answer it, we formalize probabilistic alignment as a distributional criterion for world models and introduce PAWBench, a benchmark for evaluating video generators as stochastic samplers of world dynamics. We further introduce PAWEval, an outcome-level protocol that converts repeated video rollouts into empirical distributions over possible physical behaviors. Across 50 scenarios and eleven current systems, no model consistently matches the reference probabilities while recovering the range of valid behaviors. Having established this gap, we test whether language prompts, initial noise sampling, or model training can reshape the model's predictive distribution. We believe our work can serve as a foundation for future efforts to move towards probabilistically aligned world modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"概率对齐"（probabilistic alignment）作为世界模型的新分布级评估标准，并构建了PAWBench基准和PAWEval评估协议，用于检验视频生成模型作为随机采样器时能否恢复同一初始条件下物理行为的真实分布。在50个场景和11个系统的评估中发现，现有模型均无法同时匹配参考概率并覆盖有效行为范围。
AI.motivation: 现有视频生成模型常被框架化为世界模型，但物理过程在同一初始条件与动作下可以多种方式展开，因此理想的世界模型不仅要生成合理的单条轨迹，还要再现可能行为的分布。然而现有评估大多关注单视频的合理性，未检验重复生成是否恢复正确分布，这构成了概率对齐评估的空白。
AI.method: 作者将概率对齐形式化为世界模型的分布级准则，引入PAWBench基准，覆盖50个场景，评估11个视频生成系统；提出PAWEval协议，将重复视频生成的结果转换为可能物理行为的经验分布，并与参考概率进行比对。此外，还测试了语言提示、初始噪声采样和模型训练三种方式能否重塑模型的预测分布。
AI.result: 在50个场景和11个系统的评估中，没有任何模型能在匹配参考概率的同时恢复有效行为范围，说明现有视频生成模型在概率对齐方面存在系统性不足。进一步的干预实验表明，语言提示、初始噪声采样或模型训练可以在一定程度上影响预测分布，但尚未能完全实现概率对齐。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成模型距离概率对齐的世界建模仍有显著差距，本文构建的评估框架和基准可以作为未来研究的基础，推动视频生成模型向能够正确再现物理行为分布的方向发展。

title: BrailleBench: Investigating Multi-Criteria Braille Comprehension in Large Language Models
summary: Although Large language models (LLMs) mediate access to knowledge and computational assistance, their capabilities should benefit vulnerable groups in the same way. However, it is unclear whether existing AI systems are inclusive enough for blind and deafblind users to access the same functionality through Braille, whose indicators, contractions, and digital representations introduce distinct requirements for model comprehension. To this end, we introduce BrailleBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs in Braille comprehension from different Criteria. BrailleBench aligns 5,570 instances from five datasets, including mathematics, commonsense, and multi-hop question answering across English and Braille Grades 1 and 2. Different configurations are designed to understand whether the systems can comprehend Braille-authored content, express answers in Braille, and complete end-to-end Braille interaction. To ensure the quality and prevent evaluation bias, the benchmark is built through a deterministic, expert-reviewed pipeline via a self-created Braille Toolkit without using any data instances generated by LLMs. We evaluate six representative LLMs from various aspects. The results reveal a persistent gap between print-English capability and Braille accessibility. Braille understanding and expression are asymmetric, where Grade 2 is especially fragile on the input side compared to Grade 1, and fully Braille requests further reduce performance. The experimental observations provide valuable guidance for the development of future Braille AI systems. All related resources in BrailleBench are publicly available for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BrailleBench基准，用于评估LLM在布莱叶盲文（Grades 1和2）理解与生成方面的能力，涵盖数学、常识和多跳问答等任务。实验表明，现有LLM在盲文能力上与印刷英语存在显著差距，且盲文理解与表达不对称，Grade 2盲文在输入端尤其脆弱。
AI.motivation: LLM应公平服务于包括盲人和聋盲用户在内的弱势群体，但现有AI系统是否真正支持通过布莱叶盲文访问相同功能尚不明确。盲文的指示符、缩略语及数字表示对模型理解提出了独特要求，而这一方面缺乏系统性的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建BrailleBench基准：从五个数据集中对齐5,570个实例，涵盖数学、常识和多跳问答，覆盖英语及盲文Grades 1和2。设计了多种配置以测试系统对盲文内容的阅读理解、以盲文表达答案以及端到端盲文交互能力。基准通过确定性、专家审阅的流水线构建，自建Braille Toolkit，不使用任何LLM生成的数据以避免评估偏差。评估六个代表性LLM。
AI.result: 实验揭示了印刷英语能力与盲文可访问性之间持续存在的差距；盲文理解与表达呈现不对称性，Grade 2盲文在输入端尤其脆弱（相比Grade 1），完全盲文的请求进一步降低性能。
AI.conclusion: BrailleBench提供了系统化的盲文能力评估基准，实验结果对开发未来盲文AI系统具有重要指导价值，相关资源已公开供后续研究使用。

title: JudgeStealer: Extracting LLM Judging Capabilities across Evaluation Protocols
summary: Large language model (LLM) judges are increasingly used across various evaluation scenarios, making their judgment capabilities valuable intellectual property. However, black-box access exposes these capabilities to model extraction attacks. Existing extraction methods do not specifically target LLM judges and provide limited support for multiple evaluation protocols under restricted query budgets. In this study, we propose JUDGESTEALER, the first query-efficient model extraction framework for replicating judging capabilities across pointwise scoring, pairwise comparison, and listwise ranking protocols. JUDGESTEALER exploits the strong cross-protocol agreement to acquire pointwise scores and transform them into pairwise and listwise supervisions without additional victim queries. To capture informative judge patterns and improve query efficiency, JUDGESTEALER dynamically selects pointwise inputs based on semantic diversity, predictive uncertainty, and potential judge biases. It further applies score smoothing and multi-protocol review to preserve the ordinal structure of scores and mitigate catastrophic forgetting during surrogate adaptation. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLM-as-a-judge and reward models show that JUDGESTEALER consistently outperforms existing extraction baselines, achieving up to 73.3%, 87.0%, and 71.6% accuracy for pointwise, pairwise, and listwise evaluation, respectively. JUDGESTEALER also remains effective across different sur- rogate model scales, adaptation strategies, and reasoning settings. Moreover, JUDGESTEALER demonstrates robustness against representative extraction defenses.

AI.tldr: JUDGESTEALER是首个针对LLM评判能力的高效模型抽取框架，利用跨协议一致性将点式评分转换为配对和列表式监督，无需额外查询即可复制点式、配对和列表式三种评估协议的评判能力。
AI.motivation: LLM作为评判者（LLM-as-a-judge）的评判能力是宝贵的知识产权，但黑盒访问使其面临模型抽取攻击的风险。现有的抽取方法未专门针对LLM评判者，且在受限查询预算下对多种评估协议支持有限。
AI.method: JUDGESTEALER通过三个关键机制实现高效抽取：(1) 利用跨协议强一致性，获取点式分数并转换为配对和列表式监督，避免额外受害者查询；(2) 基于语义多样性、预测不确定性和潜在评判偏差动态选择点式输入，以捕获信息丰富的评判模式并提高查询效率；(3) 应用分数平滑和多协议回顾来保持分数序结构，缓解替代模型适应过程中的灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在SOTA的LLM评判者和奖励模型上进行的大量实验表明，JUDGESTEALER一致优于现有抽取基线，在点式、配对和列表式评估中分别达到73.3%、87.0%和71.6%的准确率。该方法在不同替代模型规模、适应策略和推理设置下均保持有效性，并对代表性抽取防御表现出鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: JUDGESTEALER是首个查询高效的LLM评判能力模型抽取框架，能够以较低查询预算跨三种评估协议复制评判能力，且对不同模型规模、适应策略及防御机制均展现出良好的泛化性和鲁棒性。

title: KnockGS:interaction-Grounded Calibrationof Physical Gaussian Representations
summary: Physics-integrated 3D Gaussian representations now allow reconstructed deformable objects to be simulated and rendered under explicit material models. Existing pipelines, however, assume that material parameters are known or manually specified, limiting their applicability when these parameters must be inferred from observed object dynamics. We propose KnockGS, an interaction-response PhysicalGS framework that estimates the elasticity and density scales of a 3D Gaussian object from its dynamics under a known applied force. Rather than treating physical simulation only as a forward process, we turn the force-induced response into a calibration signal: temporal response features are xtracted from the observed dynamics, the two material scales are estimated from those features, and the estimate is then frozen and written back into the same simulator so that it can be tested on an interaction it was never fitted to.We evaluate the framework on both parameter recovery and response-level fidelity. The estimated scales are compared against hidden ground truth, and the re-simulated object is measured against the target using 3D particle trajectories, response-curve statistics, and rendered-frame quality. Across five held-out material targets, our method recovers the scales substantially more accurately than response retrieval, global regression, or a fixed default material, and the frozen estimate remains predictive under interactions that differ in direction and in magnitude. Interaction response therefore carries enough information to calibrate material scales in physically grounded 3D Gaussian representations.Our study is a first step toward interactive PhysicalGS systems that calibrate a Gaussian asset whose rendered appearance and simulated response are consistent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出KnockGS，一个交互响应驱动的PhysicalGS框架，通过物体在外力作用下的动力学响应来估计3D高斯物体的弹性与密度标度，并将估计值写回模拟器以在未拟合过的交互上验证其泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理集成3D高斯表示（PhysicalGS）虽能对可变形物体进行模拟和渲染，但假设材料参数已知或需人工指定，限制了其在参数需从观测动力学中推断的场景下的适用性。
AI.method: 将力诱导的响应视为标定信号：从观测动力学中提取时域响应特征，据此估计弹性与密度两个材料标度，将估计值冻结并写回同一模拟器中，用于测试其在未参与拟合的交互（不同方向与幅度的外力）上的预测能力。
AI.result: 在五个隐藏材料目标上，KnockGS比响应检索、全局回归或固定默认材料方法更准确地恢复材料标度；冻结的估计值在方向和幅度不同的交互下仍保持预测能力。
AI.conclusion: 交互响应本身就包含足够的信息来标定物理接地3D高斯表示中的材料标度，是迈向渲染外观与模拟响应一致的交互式PhysicalGS系统校准的第一步。

title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms
summary:
We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Human input is minimal: we give one untuned prompt that describes the problem, and the model has access to a Python sandbox tool with a fixed compute budget.
  The strongest model we test, gpt-5.6-sol, matches or outperforms the best existing method on almost all evaluated instances. This holds even at level 2, where the returned algorithm is fixed before seeing the evaluation instances. Performance also improves sharply across models released less than eight months apart, suggesting that this capability is moving quickly. Thus, for the well-specified operations problems we study, a single untuned LLM query can already produce algorithms competitive with specialized methods. These results suggest that frontier LLMs can be a serious empirical baseline for algorithm design in well-specified OR problems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大型语言模型（LLM）能否为明确定义的运筹学（OR）问题设计有效算法。作者在库存控制、排队网络控制和品类优化三类问题上，评估了LLM在两种层级上的表现：层级1（给定单实例直接输出解）和层级2（仅给定问题类别描述和参数范围，返回一个算法）。最强模型gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有测试实例上匹配或超越了现有最佳方法，且模型性能在不到8个月间显著提升，表明前沿LLM可以作为明确定义OR问题中算法设计的严肃经验基线。
AI.motivation: 探索前沿LLM是否具备直接为明确定义的运筹学问题设计算法的能力，以评估其作为算法设计经验基线的潜力。现有方法通常需要专门设计，而LLM可能以极低的人工成本（单次未调优的提示词）即可生成具有竞争力的算法。
AI.method: 研究覆盖三类运筹学问题：库存控制、排队网络控制和品类优化。设计两个层级的LLM评估：层级1（模型接收单实例并直接返回解决方案）和层级2（模型仅接收问题类别描述和广义参数范围，返回一个将实例参数映射到解决方案的算法，且返回的算法在评估实例前已固定）。人类输入仅限于单一未调优的提示词，模型可通过Python沙盒工具执行计算，拥有固定计算预算。
AI.result: 最强模型gpt-5.6-sol在几乎所有评估实例上匹配或超越现有最佳方法，即使在层级2（算法在见到评估实例前已固定）下也是如此。此外，间隔不到8个月发布的模型之间性能提升显著，表明该能力正在快速进步。
AI.conclusion: 对于所研究的明确定义的运筹学问题，单次未调优的LLM查询已能生成与专门方法相竞争的算法。这表明前沿LLM可以成为明确定义OR问题中算法设计的严肃经验基线，且该能力正在快速演进。

title: ITL: Interpretable Document Alignment with Structured Reference Frameworks
summary: Measuring alignment between documents and structured reference frameworks requires identifying conceptual evidence distributed throughout the text and reporting it through measures that are quantitative, interpretable, and traceable. Many commonly used retrieval and classification approaches return either pairwise similarity scores or one or more class labels, whereas fewer methods provide concept-level scores that are directly traceable to the terminological evidence supporting them. We present \emph{Intelligent Target Locator} (ITL), a domain-agnostic and language-portable methodology that estimates the affinity between the textual units of a target document and the concepts defined in a \emph{Structured Reference Document} ($SRD$). From the $SRD$, ITL induces concept-specific terminological profiles built from independent terms, bigrams, trigrams, and co-occurrences. Each term is assigned an importance weight that combines concept membership, term-type specificity and inter-concept discriminability. The output is a textual-unit--concept affinity matrix that can be aggregated at different levels of granularity. We conduct an internal consistency assessment using the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), evaluating each official goal statement against the $SRD$ induced from the same set of descriptors. Every statement reached its highest affinity with the corresponding concept, and the mean affinity across the remaining concepts stayed marginal relative to the mean reference affinity. This separation indicates that ITL distinguishes the conceptual profiles of the framework. ITL thus offers a general basis for quantifying document alignment with structured frameworks while keeping each result traceable to the terminological evidence that supports it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出智能目标定位器（ITL），一种领域无关、语言可移植的方法论，用于估计目标文档文本单元与结构化参考文档（SRD）中概念之间的亲和度。ITL从SRD诱导概念特定的术语配置文件，输出文本单元-概念亲和度矩阵，并在17个可持续发展目标（SDGs）上进行了内部一致性评估，验证了其区分概念轮廓的能力。
AI.motivation: 文档与结构化参考框架之间的一致性度量需要识别文本中分布的概念性证据，并以定量、可解释和可追溯的度量方式报告。现有的检索和分类方法大多返回成对相似度分数或类别标签，而缺少能够直接追溯至支持性术语证据的概念级评分方法。
AI.method: ITL从结构化参考文档（SRD）中诱导概念特定的术语配置文件，包括独立术语、二元组、三元组和共现模式。每个术语分配一个重要性权重，该权重综合了概念成员资格、术语类型特异性和概念间可区分性。最终输出一个文本单元-概念亲和度矩阵，可在不同粒度级别聚合。方法具备领域无关性和语言可移植性。
AI.result: 使用17个可持续发展目标（SDGs）进行内部一致性评估：每个官方目标声明与其对应概念的亲和度最高，而跨其余概念的平均亲和度相对于参考亲和度保持边际水平，表明ITL能够有效区分框架的概念轮廓。
AI.conclusion: ITL为量化文档与结构化框架之间的一致性提供了通用基础，同时保持每个结果可追溯至支持它的术语证据，实现了可量化、可解释和可追溯的概念级对齐度量。

title: Successive Capacity Growth: Task-Complexity-Driven Width and Depth Expansion for Vision Transformer Encoders in JEPA World Models
summary: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) for world modeling typically employ fixed-size Vision Transformer encoders that are over-provisioned for simple tasks and under-provisioned for complex ones, with significant redundancy across attention heads. We propose Successive Capacity Growth (SCG), a method that starts from a minimal encoder (1 head, 2 layers, 283K parameters) and grows incrementally in width (adding attention heads for low-level semantic capacity) or depth (adding transformer blocks for higher-order semantic abstraction), driven by a task-agnostic test-and-verify mechanism that exploits function-preserving expansion to safely trial architectural changes and roll back if they do not improve prediction loss. The Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg) ensures that all learned semantic dimensions remain statistically independent and aligned with the predictive objective, preventing collapse even as the architecture grows. On a 60-dimensional multi-object dynamics task, SCG naturally triggers depth expansion, improving prediction loss by 20.3% over the fixed small baseline with 56 times greater parameter efficiency than scaling to the fixed large model; on a 2D navigation task, a single width expansion yields even an 23% improvement over the fixed large model. Across all three tested environments of increasing complexity, the adaptive encoder matches or exceeds the fixed small baseline, with zero false-positive expansions and bit-exact function preservation (ratio = 1.0, absolute difference = 0.0). The take-away is that JEPA world model encoders need not be pre-allocated at maximum capacity - they can grow successively as the task demands, achieving significant compute and data efficiency while maintaining representation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Successive Capacity Growth (SCG)，一种让JEPA世界模型编码器从极小型（28.3万参数、1头2层）逐步增长的方法，通过任务无关的test-and-verify机制（利用保函数扩展实现安全试错与回滚）在宽度（注意力头）和深度（Transformer层）两个维度上自适应扩展，并配合Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg)防止表示坍缩。实验表明该方法在三个不同复杂度任务上均匹配或超越固定小基线，在60维多物体动力学任务上预测损失改善20.3%，参数效率是固定大模型的56倍。
AI.motivation: JEPA世界模型通常使用固定尺寸的Vision Transformer编码器，但固定架构存在根本性缺陷：对小任务过度配置（浪费参数与计算），对大任务配置不足（容量不够），且注意力头之间存在显著冗余。因此需要一种能够根据任务复杂度自适应增长的编码器架构。
AI.method: SCG方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 从极小编码器（1头、2层、283K参数）出发，在宽度上增加注意力头以提升低层语义容量，或在深度上增加Transformer块以提升高层语义抽象能力；(2) 任务无关的test-and-verify机制，利用函数保持性扩展（function-preserving expansion）安全地尝试架构变更，若预测损失未改善则回滚；(3) Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularizer (SIGReg) 确保所有学到的语义维度统计独立且与预测目标对齐，防止架构增长过程中发生表示坍缩。
AI.result: 在60维多物体动力学任务中，SCG自然触发深度扩展，预测损失较固定小基线改善20.3%，参数效率比扩展到固定大模型高56倍；在2D导航任务中，单次宽度扩展即比固定大模型提高23%；在所有三个由简单到复杂的环境中，自适应编码器匹配或超过固定小基线，零假阳性扩展，函数保持比率为1.0且绝对差异为0.0（位精确保持）。
AI.conclusion: JEPA世界模型的编码器无需预先分配最大容量，可以在任务需求推动下逐步增长，在保持表示质量的同时显著提升计算和数据效率。这一"渐进式成长"范式为世界模型的架构设计提供了新的方向。

title: Verify Smarter, Evolve Further: Efficient Harness Evolution through Behavior-Aware Verification
summary: Agent harnesses shape how language-model agents use instructions, tools, and runtime components, but adapting these harnesses requires costly verification. Existing propose-and-verify methods typically score every candidate on a fixed task set, wasting rollouts on unrelated behaviors and allowing aggregate scores to obscure specific regressions. We introduce HarnessLens, a budget-aware framework for automated harness evolution. HarnessLens jointly explores the task space and user-configurable components, derives candidate modifications from execution trajectories, and selectively verifies each candidate on behavior-relevant tasks using an attributable-evidence gate. Across three agent harnesses and four benchmarks, HarnessLens improves average held-out performance by 7.6-13.6% while consuming substantially less evaluation budget than competing baselines. These results demonstrate that behavior-aware verification with explicit attribution enables more reliable and sample-efficient harness evolution under constrained interaction budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/jhxu5214/HarnessLens.

AI.tldr: HarnessLens 是一个预算感知的自动化智能体框架（agent harness）演化框架，通过联合探索任务空间与可配置组件、从执行轨迹中派生候选修改，并使用可归因证据门控对候选进行选择性验证，在三个智能体框架和四个基准上以更低的评估预算获得了 7.6-13.6% 的平均留出性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的 propose-and-verify 方法在固定任务集上对所有候选进行评分，导致大量计算浪费在无关行为上，且聚合分数会掩盖特定性能回退；此外，智能体框架的适应需要昂贵的验证成本，缺乏预算感知的演化机制。
AI.method: HarnessLens 包含三个核心机制：(1) 联合探索任务空间与用户可配置组件；(2) 从执行轨迹中自动派生候选修改；(3) 使用可归因证据门控（attributable-evidence gate）仅在行为相关任务上选择性验证每个候选。
AI.result: 在三个智能体框架和四个基准数据集上，HarnessLens 将平均留出（held-out）性能提升了 7.6-13.6%，同时相比竞争基线消耗了显著更少的评估预算。
AI.conclusion: 具有显式归因的行为感知验证（behavior-aware verification）能够在受限交互预算下实现更可靠且样本高效的智能体框架演化。

title: Representing and Parsing Korean Constituency Structure at Different Levels of Granularity
summary: Korean constituency parsing raises a representational challenge because the terminal units of a phrase-structure tree do not straightforwardly correspond to simple surface words. Korean eojeols are morphologically complex spacing units, and existing constituency resources differ in how they represent eojeol-internal morphology and non-overt elements. This paper compares three constituency parsing representations derived from the Penn Korean Treebank: Morpheme+XPOS, Eojeol+XPOS, and Eojeol+UPOS. We construct these representations by removing null elements, aligning Penn Korean phrase structure with overt eojeol tokens, preserving Penn Korean phrase labels where possible, and varying the terminal and preterminal layers. We then evaluate canonical non-binary transition-based constituency parsers in top-down, in-order, and bottom-up orders under a shared modeling and evaluation setup. All experiments use gold terminal segmentation and gold preterminal labels and therefore evaluate constituency parsing conditioned on gold morphosyntactic annotation. Eojeol terminals yield shorter transition sequences, but Eojeol+UPOS parsing substantially underperforms the morphologically richer conditions. Eojeol+XPOS narrows this gap, while Morpheme+XPOS gives the strongest results even after its predictions are projected to the eojeol terminal domain. Under these gold-annotation conditions, the results show that fine-grained morphological and XPOS representations provide valuable evidence for the evaluated parsers. This empirical finding concerns the information available for parsing and does not by itself determine the linguistically preferable terminal domain. Independently, linguistic and resource-design considerations motivate eojeol as a stable and interpretable surface domain for phrase-structure annotation, with morpheme-level and XPOS information retained as aligned morphosyntactic evidence.

title: LeVJEPA: Efficient & Scalable Video Pretraining without the Heuristics
summary: Video carries the temporal structure of the physical world, yet learning representations from it has remained computationally expensive: prevailing self-supervised methods either prevent representation collapse through architectural asymmetries, coupling an exponential-moving-average target encoder, a stop-gradient, and a capacity-limited predictor, or circumvent it by reconstructing masked content in pixel space. We introduce LeVJEPA, the first video encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective, which dispenses with both. A single encoder is trained with an invariance loss over global and local views of a clip, regularized by SIGReg, which excludes collapse with a provable guarantee. The architecture reduces to an encoder and a projector, and the objective to a single hyperparameter. This formulation admits two properties. First, the cost of pretraining is governed by the number of tokens the encoder observes; uniform random token dropping renders this number small while simultaneously improving downstream accuracy. At matched epochs on identical data, LeVJEPA matches or surpasses V-JEPA 2 across ViT-S/B/L at 5.6 to 20.8x less pretraining compute, and at matched total FLOPs it exceeds the strongest video baseline by 7.6 points on ImageNet-1K while remaining competitive on motion-centric benchmarks. Second, since no asymmetry between branches is required, the encoder can be trained with block-causal attention at no measurable accuracy cost: temporal ordering becomes a property of the encoder itself. Against a compute-matched DINOv2 trained on frames of the same videos, LeVJEPA approaches the image-pretrained encoder on appearance-centric evaluation while nearly doubling its motion-centric accuracy. These results indicate that, once its computational overhead is removed, video becomes a viable and in several respects preferable substrate for general-purpose visual pretraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LeVJEPA，首个在LeJEPA无坍缩目标下训练的视频编码器，摒弃了EMA目标编码器、stop-gradient和容量受限预测器，仅需单一编码器+投影器的架构和单一超参数，通过统一随机token丢弃大幅降低预训练计算成本（5.6-20.8倍），并支持块因果注意力使时序成为编码器自身的属性，证明视频在去除计算开销后是通用视觉预训练的可行且更优的基板。
AI.motivation: 从视频学习表征计算成本高昂：现有的自监督方法要么依赖架构不对称（EMA目标编码器、stop-gradient、容量受限预测器）来防止表征坍缩，要么通过在像素空间重建掩码内容来规避坍缩。作者希望利用视频丰富的时间结构进行预训练，同时消除这些昂贵的机制。
AI.method: LeVJEPA仅使用单一编码器和投影器，通过全局和局部视图的剪辑上的不变性损失进行训练，并用SIGReg正则化在可证明的保证下排除坍缩。目标仅含单一超参数。预训练成本由编码器观测的token数量决定，采用均匀随机token丢弃使token数量最小化并同时提升下游精度。由于分支间不需要不对称性，编码器可用块因果注意力训练且无精度损失。
AI.result: 在相同epoch和数据上，LeVJEPA在ViT-S/B/L上以5.6至20.8倍更少的预训练计算匹配或超越V-JEPA 2；在匹配总FLOPs时，它在ImageNet-1K上超过最强视频基线7.6点，同时在运动中心基准上保持竞争力。与计算匹配的、在相同视频帧上训练的DINOv2相比，LeVJEPA在外观中心评估上接近图像预训练编码器，同时在运动中心精度上几乎翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，一旦去除视频预训练的计算开销，视频就成为通用视觉预训练的一个可行且在多个方面更优的基板，优于图像数据预训练。

title: Not All Eval-Awareness Is Equal: Capabilities Framing Predicts Compliance
comment: 5 pages (14 appendices), 5 figures, presented at 2026 ICML Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop
summary: Steering interventions targeting eval-awareness, a model's recognition that it is being tested, are increasingly used in safety evaluation pipelines, where evaluation-awareness is treated as a single quantity to be suppressed. We show that verbalized eval-awareness in chain-of-thought can be identified as capabilities-flavored ("the user is testing my ability to follow instructions"), safety-flavored ("the user is testing my boundaries"), both, or neither: framings that predict compliance very differently. On Qwen3-32B over the FORTRESS dataset, capabilities-framing predicts compliance with a +24 to +46 percentage-point gap over safety-framing across all tested steering conditions. A CoT-prefill intervention on eval-awareness-negative rollouts suggests the link is causal, with 10 of 11 prefills shifting compliance in the predicted direction. Then, eval-awareness is not behaviorally uniform: aggregate suppression rates can move while the safety-relevant component does not, and the same "X% suppression of eval-awareness" can correspond to qualitatively different behavioral outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示评估感知（eval-awareness）并非单一可抑制的量，而是包含能力导向、安全导向、两者兼具或均非四种不同框架（framing），不同框架对模型遵从行为（compliance）的预测截然不同。在Qwen3-32B上的FORTRESS数据集实验中，能力框架比安全框架带来+24到+46个百分点的遵从率差距，且通过CoT预填充干预证明了因果性。这意味着聚合的评估感知抑制率可能掩盖行为上的异质性，对安全评估管线构成潜在风险。
AI.motivation: 现有安全评估管线将评估感知视为单一量进行抑制，但这一简化假设可能掩盖其内部结构的异质性，导致安全干预措施产生不可预测的行为后果。作者旨在揭示评估感知的语义多样性及其对遵从行为的差异化影响。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-32B模型上使用FORTRESS数据集，对思维链中语言化的评估感知进行分类，区分为能力框架、安全框架、两者兼具或均非。通过多种steering条件下的对比实验测量不同框架对遵从率的影响，并采用CoT预填充（prefill）干预实验来检验因果关系。
AI.result: （1）能力框架预测遵从率比安全框架高出+24到+46个百分点，在所有测试的steering条件下均成立；（2）11个预填充中有10个使遵从行为向预测方向偏移，支持因果性；（3）评估感知并非行为上均匀的：总体验抑制率的变化可能不伴随安全相关成分的变化，相同的\u201cX%评估感知抑制率\u201d对应着质上不同的行为结果。
AI.conclusion: 评估感知在安全评估中不应被视为单一可靠的调控目标。需要对评估感知进行细粒度的框架分解，并针对安全相关成分设计干预措施，否则聚合层面的抑制指标可能误导安全评估结论。

title: Reasoning about In-Context Samples for Machine-Translation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can be trained to perform chain-of-thoughts reasoning in order to improve the reliability of their responses. In this work, we investigate how explicit reasoning can be leveraged for LLM-Based Machine Translation (MT) with in-context samples. We introduce a novel fragment-based reasoning framework in which the model first extracts parallel source-target fragments from retrieved similar exemplars, and uses these fragments as intermediate reasoning traces to produce the final translation. To train our model, we distill silver fragments and drafts from a large teacher model. Our experiments with the Qwen3 model family, over 6 languages, including up to 5 domains per language, demonstrate that fragment-based MT significantly outperforms alternative methods like standard k-shot or basic drafting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于片段的推理框架，用于LLM机器翻译。该框架先从检索到的相似示例中提取平行的源-目标语言片段，再将这些片段作为中间推理轨迹来生成最终翻译。通过从大型教师模型中蒸馏银片段和草稿进行训练，实验表明该方法在6种语言和最多5个领域上显著优于标准k-shot和基础草稿方法。
AI.motivation: LLM可以通过链式推理训练来提高响应可靠性，但如何将显式推理应用于基于上下文样本的LLM机器翻译尚待研究。作者希望利用检索到的相似示例中的并行片段作为中间推理步骤，以提升翻译质量。
AI.method: 提出片段级推理框架：模型首先从检索到的相似示例中提取平行的源-目标语言片段，然后利用这些片段作为中间推理轨迹来产生最终翻译。训练采用从大型教师模型蒸馏得到的银片段和草稿，基于Qwen3模型家族进行实验。
AI.result: 在6种语言、每种语言最多5个领域的实验中，片段级机器翻译显著优于标准k-shot学习和基础草稿方法。
AI.conclusion: 片段级推理框架能够有效利用显式推理增强LLM机器翻译的性能，相比传统上下文学习方法具有明显优势。

title: Reconstructing Humans and Objects in Interaction using Large Reconstruction Models
comment: Accepted at ECCV 2026. Project Page: https://ac5113.github.io/MILO
summary: Estimation of Human-Object Interactions in 3D (3D HOI) is a fundamental problem in 3D computer vision with applications in AR/VR, robotics, and embodied AI. However, reconstructing these interactions in 3D remains challenging due to depth ambiguities, occlusions, and object shape variability. Existing approaches are primarily concerned with reprojection and contact constraints, fitting parametric human models and object templates to 2D images. In this paper, we explore a different avenue. We present MILO, a framework that leverages the visual capabilities of Large Reconstruction Models (LRMs) to recover detailed 3D human-object interactions from a single image. Our key observation is that LRMs provide a powerful geometric scaffold that preserves relative human-object arrangement and proximity cues. This significantly simplifies the reconstruction procedure, reframing the problem as interpreting the LRM mesh: we segment it into human and object components, fit a parametric body model to the human part, and optionally align an object template to the object part (if such a template is available). MILO achieves strong reconstruction accuracy and outperforms existing baselines across multiple benchmarks and interaction scenarios. Our code is available at https://ac5113.github.io/MILO.

AI.tldr: MILO是一个利用大型重建模型(LRM)的视觉能力从单张图像恢复详细3D人-物交互(HOI)的框架。其核心思想是利用LRM提供的几何骨架来保留人与物的相对空间排列和邻近线索，将重建问题简化为对LRM网格的解释：分割人体与物体部分、拟合参数化人体模型并可选地对齐物体模板。MILO在多个基准和交互场景中达到了强重建精度并超越了现有基线。
AI.motivation: 3D人-物交互重建是AR/VR、机器人和具身AI领域的基础问题，但现有方法主要依赖重投影和接触约束来将参数化人体模型和物体模板拟合到2D图像上，面临深度模糊、遮挡和物体形状多变等挑战，重建效果受限。
AI.method: MILO利用大型重建模型(LRM)的视觉能力从单张图像恢复3D人-物交互。关键思路是LRM提供了强大的几何脚手架，保留了人与物体的相对空间排列和邻近线索。该方法将重建问题重新定义为解释LRM网格：首先将网格分割为人体和物体两部分，然后将参数化人体模型拟合到人体部分，如果存在可用模板则进一步将物体模板对齐到物体部分。
AI.result: MILO在多个基准数据集和多种交互场景下取得了强的重建精度，并超越了现有基线方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: MILO展示了一种不同于传统重投影/接触约束的新方向，即借助大重建模型的几何先验来简化3D HOI重建流程，为后续研究提供了新的思路和开源代码。

title: Sophistication in GenAI Use: Field Evidence from a Large Firm
comment: 59 pages, 4 figures, 8 tables. Includes Appendix A (variable definitions), Appendix B (supplementary tables), and Online Appendix C (meta prompts)
summary: We study how sophistication in generative AI (genAI) use varies among the back-office workforce of a large firm. Using proprietary data, we observe 713,564 employee prompts and their corresponding large language model responses from nearly 4,000 back-office employees across 15 functional areas over eight months in 2025. We document three main findings. First, senior employees exhibit more sophisticated genAI use, consistent with domain expertise complementing genAI capabilities. Second, sophistication varies considerably across functions and is highest in Strategy, Digital Innovation, and Project Management, three groups that share a focus on firmwide strategic initiatives and organizational change. Third, we observe neither improvements in sophistication over time nor lasting improvements following formal AI training, suggesting that sophisticated use can be difficult to change. Together, our study provides measures of and insights into sophisticated genAI use that managers can use to improve outcomes and that researchers can use in future research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一家大型企业后台员工使用生成式AI（genAI）的成熟度差异。基于2025年八个月内近4000名员工、713,564条提示词及对应大模型回复的专有数据，发现：高资历员工使用genAI更成熟；不同职能领域差异显著，其中战略、数字创新和项目管理领域成熟度最高；同时，员工genAI使用的成熟度不会随时间自然提升，正式AI培训也未带来持久改善。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI已在企业中广泛部署，但关于员工如何"成熟地"使用genAI（而非简单地调用），缺乏系统性的实证研究。理解genAI使用成熟度在企业员工中的分布及其影响因素，对管理者优化AI投资回报和研究者深入探讨人机协作具有重要意义。
AI.method: 采用专有数据集，收集了2025年八个月内近4000名后台员工（覆盖15个职能领域）的713,564条提示词及对应的大语言模型回复，对员工使用genAI的成熟度进行量化度量，并从员工资历、职能领域差异、时间变化趋势及AI培训效果等维度进行系统分析。
AI.result: 研究发现三点主要结论：（1）高资历员工表现出更高的genAI使用成熟度，说明领域专业知识能补充genAI能力；（2）使用成熟度在不同职能间差异显著，战略、数字创新和项目管理三个聚焦公司战略举措和组织变革的领域成熟度最高；（3）使用成熟度既不随时间的推移而改善，正式AI培训也未带来持久的改进。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了衡量和洞察企业员工genAI使用成熟度的系统性方法，揭示了专业知识互补、职能特征及培训效果等关键机制。这些度量方法和见解可为管理者优化AI部署结果提供参考，也可供研究者开展后续研究使用。

title: Cascaded Batch Prompting
summary: Although batch prompting makes large language model inference more efficient by processing multiple instances simultaneously, it suffers from unpredictable downstream task performance. We propose cascaded batch prompting, a two-stage approach designed to resolve the unpredictability of conventional batch prompting by disentangling complex reasoning from symbol grounding. Experiments on multiple-choice question answering and natural language inference demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms the standard single prompting baseline while achieving a speedup proportional to batch size, establishing a new state of the art on the Pareto frontier.

AI.tldr: 提出级联批量提示（cascaded batch prompting）方法，通过将复杂推理与符号接地解耦，解决传统批量提示在LLM推理中下游任务性能不可预测的问题，在多项选择和自然语言推断任务上优于单提示基线，同时获得与批量大小成正比的加速，在帕累托前沿上达到新的最优状态。
AI.motivation: 批量提示虽然能通过同时处理多个实例提高LLM推理效率，但存在下游任务性能不可预测的问题。作者希望找到一种方法，既能保持批量推理的高效性，又能解决性能不稳定的缺陷。
AI.method: 提出级联批量提示（cascaded batch prompting）两阶段方法：第一阶段将复杂推理与符号接地解耦，第二阶段进行符号接地。通过这种两阶段设计，将推理过程与符号映射分离，以稳定批量提示的性能。
AI.result: 在多项选择问答（MCQA）和自然语言推断（NLI）任务上，该方法优于标准单提示基线，同时实现了与批量大小成正比的推理速度提升，在帕累托前沿上建立了新的最优性能点。
AI.conclusion: 级联批量提示通过解耦推理与符号接地，成功解决了传统批量提示的性能不可预测性问题，在不牺牲效率的前提下获得了更优的性能，为批量提示方法提供了新的优化方向。

title: Retrieval Heads Meet Vision: Uncovering How VLMs Locate and Extract Visual Information
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can locate an image region referred to by a text prompt and route the corresponding visual evidence to the output, yet the internal mechanism behind this behavior is not understood. Inspired by retrieval heads in large language models, we ask whether VLMs contain an analogous mechanism for visual retrieval. We answer affirmatively by introducing Visual Retrieval Heads (VRHs), a small subset of attention heads (about 1.7-2.6%) that are causally responsible for grounding text descriptions to image regions. To find them, we recast existing head-scoring methods under a unified design space over query tokens, key aggregation, and cross-sample aggregation. We then show that scoring attention from output prediction tokens with a sum over the ground-truth referent region most reliably identifies causal heads. Across eleven VLMs and five referring-expression benchmarks, masking only the top 20 VRHs reduces grounding accuracy by up to 80 percentage points, while masking the same number of random heads has little effect. Beyond replicating the causal-sparse-universal triad established for text retrieval heads, VRHs exhibit several properties not previously reported: they generalize across visual reference tasks, remaining causal on attribute, spatial, counting, and visual-math benchmarks despite being discovered through bounding-box prediction; they are functionally specific, preserving output format while corrupting localization; and they are architecturally shared, transferring causally across VLMs that share an LLM backbone but differ in vision encoder, projector, and instruction tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"视觉检索头"（Visual Retrieval Heads, VRHs）概念，发现视觉-语言模型（VLMs）中存在一小部分注意力头（约1.7-2.6%）因果性地负责将文本描述定位到图像区域。通过统一设计空间的评分方法识别这些头，并在11个VLM和5个指代表达基准上验证：仅屏蔽20个VRH即可使定位精度下降高达80个百分点，而随机屏蔽几乎无影响。VRHs还展现出跨任务泛化、功能特异性和架构共享性等新特性。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型能将文本提示所指的图像区域定位并路由视觉证据到输出，但其内部机制尚不明确。作者借鉴大语言模型中"检索头"（retrieval heads）的概念，探索VLMs中是否存在类似的视觉检索类比机制，以理解VLM实现指代表达定位的因果机理。
AI.method: 作者将现有的头部评分方法置于统一的解空间（涵盖查询标记、关键聚合和跨样本聚合三个维度）进行重构，发现从输出预测标记出发、对GT所指区域进行求和的注意力评分最可靠地识别因果头。基于此识别出VRHs，并进行masking实验验证其因果性、跨任务泛化、功能特异性和架构共享性。
AI.result: 在11个VLMs和5个指代表达基准上，仅屏蔽top 20个VRHs即可使定位精度下降高达80个百分点，而屏蔽同样数量的随机头几乎无影响。VRHs不仅复现了文本检索头中"因果-稀疏-通用"的三元组特性，还展现出新特性：跨视觉参考任务泛化（属性、空间、计数、视觉数学）、功能特异性（保输出格式而破坏定位）、以及跨架构因果迁移（共享LLM骨干但视觉编码器/投影器/指令微调不同）。
AI.conclusion: 本文证实VLMs中存在与LLM检索头类比的视觉检索头机制，为理解VLM的指代定位内部机理提供了因果层面的解释。VRHs的跨任务泛化、功能特异性和架构共享性为可解释性和模型编辑提供了新视角，但也暗示了VLM视觉定位能力的脆弱性——少量注意力头的破坏即可导致显著性能下降。

title: CorporateBench: Large-Scale Q&A Benchmarking with Temporal Knowledge Bases
summary: LLMs are increasingly able to answer complex questions about enterprise-scale document collections. But evaluation is hard: companies don't want to share internal communications, and synthetic datasets have been overly simple. We present CorporateBench (CB), a human-validated multi-task Q&A benchmark whose scale approaches the conditions LLMs encounter in corporate communication networks, with evaluation corpora surpassing 230,000 documents. CB evaluates LLMs across two dimensions (information extraction and knowledge base querying) through four synthetically generated firms ranging from 12 to 10,000 employees. Each corpus is sampled from a temporally evolving knowledge base describing a consistent world, guaranteeing cross-document logical consistency even across hundreds of thousands of documents. We evaluate five LLMs on CB, revealing increasingly poor performance as input size approaches realistic scales. CB provides LLM developers a metric for corporate communication reasoning, filling a crucial gap in the benchmarking ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CorporateBench (CB)，一个大规模、人工验证的多任务问答基准，用于评估LLM在企业级文档集合上的推理能力。其评估语料超过23万份文档，覆盖信息提取和知识库查询两个维度，通过四个虚拟企业（12至10,000名员工）进行评测。实验表明，随着输入规模接近现实场景，LLM性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 企业文档规模庞大但缺乏合适的评测基准：真实企业内部通信数据因隐私无法共享，而现有合成数据集过于简单，无法反映LLM在真实企业通信网络中遇到的复杂规模条件。
AI.method: 构建CorporateBench基准：1) 生成四个规模不同的虚拟公司（12至10,000名员工）；2) 每个语料库从随时间演化的知识库中采样，保证跨文档逻辑一致性；3) 从信息提取和知识库查询两个维度设计任务；4) 通过人工验证确保数据质量。
AI.result: 在CB上评估五个LLM，发现随着输入规模接近现实规模，模型性能越来越差。CB为LLM开发者提供了衡量企业通信推理能力的指标，填补了基准生态系统的关键空白。
AI.conclusion: 企业级文档推理是LLM面临的重要挑战，CB作为一个大规模人工验证基准揭示了当前模型在真实规模下的性能瓶颈，为未来模型改进提供评测依据。

title: Research Design Tracking and Assessment for the Social Sciences
comment: Paper accepted at EMNLP 2026 - Main Conference
summary: Reliable assessment of causal research designs in the social sciences is critical for evidence-based policy-making, yet has so far relied entirely on manual expert analysis. We introduce Automated Research Design Tracking and Assessment (ARDTrA), a task that involves detecting the research design used in a paper and assessing the quality of its application. We create an expert-annotated dataset of papers covering six families of counterfactual research designs and evaluate the task using a multi-turn RAG-based conversational pipeline. Across four retrieval strategies, four LLMs and six embedding models, we find that passage length is the main driver of performance, explaining 52-66% of the variance. A per-research-design analysis also shows that human and machine difficulty do not align: the designs that prove hardest for the system are not those on which expert annotators disagree most, pointing to two independent sources of task difficulty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ARDTra（自动研究设计追踪与评估）任务，用于自动检测社会科学论文中的反事实研究设计并评估其应用质量。作者构建了专家标注数据集，涵盖六类反事实研究设计家族，并采用多轮RAG对话流水线进行评估。实验发现段落长度是性能的主要驱动因素，解释了52-66%的方差；此外，人机难度不相关，系统最难的设计并非专家标注分歧最大的设计。
AI.motivation: 社会科学中依据因果研究设计进行可靠评估对循证决策至关重要，但迄今完全依赖人工专家分析，效率低且缺乏可扩展性，亟需自动化方法。
AI.method: 提出ARDTra任务，构建专家标注数据集覆盖六类反事实研究设计家族；设计多轮RAG对话流水线，组合四种检索策略、四种LLM和六种嵌入模型进行评估。
AI.result: 发现段落长度是性能的首要驱动因素（解释52-66%方差）；人机难度不一致，系统最难的场景与专家标注分歧最大的场景不重合，表明存在两个独立的任务难度来源。
AI.conclusion: ARDTra是迈向研究设计自动化评估的重要一步，但人机难度差异提示需要进一步探索弥补系统能力落差的方向，并考虑段落粒度等多因素对系统性能的影响。

title: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City
comment: 35 pages, 11 figures, 7 tables. Project Page: https://urbanground.github.io, Code Repository: https://github.com/UrbanGround/UrbanGround
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can interpret a street view, but urban agency depends on whether such local evidence remains useful after the agent starts to move. In this paper, we investigate how far current MLLM agents can turn local urban perception into reliable action in a complicated real-scale city. We propose UrbanGround, the first sandbox to make this question testable in a physically constrained replica of Hong Kong built from territory-wide 3D geospatial data. UrbanGround supports closed-loop interaction from a first-person view and provides an interactive map for navigation. Agents can directly enter the 3D city and explore from a first-person view. Our analysis follows the growth of the spatial problem through three research questions. We first test whether an agent can ground a local scene well enough to answer spatial questions after active observation. Then we ask whether that grounding supports navigation as destinations become farther away and less explicit. Finally, we examine whether the resulting behavior survives changes in route availability and pedestrian motion. Contemporary MLLM agents usually show useful atomic abilities in visual recognition and short-range spatial reasoning, while orientation and pedestrian-aware movement remain unreliable. Their central failure emerges over extended exploration, where local abilities do not compose into sustained goal-directed behavior and errors accumulate without effective correction. We hope UrbanGround will support broader study of how far current MLLM agents can explore reliably in complex, open-ended urban environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UrbanGround，一个基于香港真实3D地理空间数据构建的物理约束城市仿真沙盒，用于测试多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体在真实尺度城市中将局部视觉感知转化为可靠行动的能力。研究发现当代MLLM智能体在原子级视觉识别和短距离空间推理上表现尚可，但在方向感知、行人感知和长时间探索中的目标导向行为上存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有的MLLM智能体能够理解街景图像，但城市代理（urban agency）的关键问题在于局部证据在智能体移动后是否仍然有用。作者希望通过构建一个物理约束的真实尺度城市仿真环境，系统性地检验MLLM智能体能否将局部城市感知转化为可靠的行动决策。
AI.method: 构建UrbanGround沙盒——基于香港全境三维地理空间数据构建的物理约束复制体，支持第一人称视角的闭环交互，并提供交互式地图用于导航。通过三个递进的研究问题展开分析：(1) 智能体能否通过主动观察将局部场景足以回答空间问题；(2) 该空间定位能力能否支撑目的地越来越远、越来越不明确的导航任务；(3) 行为在路线可用性和行人运动变化下是否仍然稳健。
AI.result: 当代MLLM智能体在视觉识别和短距离空间推理等原子能力上表现尚可，但方向感知和行人感知运动仍然不可靠。核心失败模式出现在长时间探索中：局部能力无法组合为持续的目标导向行为，且错误累积而缺乏有效纠正机制。
AI.conclusion: UrbanGround为系统研究MLLM智能体在复杂开放城市环境中能可靠探索多远提供了测试平台，希望推动对该问题的更广泛研究。

title: Learning a Continuous Sepsis Severity Score Without Hour-by-Hour Supervision: A Two-Site Retrospective Study
summary:
Currently used sepsis severity indices rely on fixed variables and weights established decades ago, which are coarsely discretized and calibrated to a cohort that no longer reflects contemporary critical care. No alternative learned directly from patient trajectories is in routine use. We conducted a retrospective two-cohort study on a total of 29,116 and 7,691 adult patients meeting Sepsis-3 criteria from two hospital systems in Massachusetts and Georgie, respectively.
  We developed a sepsis index using 43 routinely charted variables over a 72-hour treatment window. Unlike previous studies, we use mortality as a treatment-level ranking signal rather than a per-state target, allowing credit to be redistributed non-uniformly across timesteps. Evaluation was done on a permanent 20% test holdout, using clinical vignettes and Spearman correlation. Uncertainty intervals were obtained by bootstrap resampling of whole patients. Under this ranking scheme, non-survivors scored 1.19-1.64 points higher than survivors on a 0-10 scale within all strata of baseline SOFA-2, with similar results stratifying within lactate, mean arterial pressure (MAP), and creatinine. Within-patient change in the index correlated with change in lactate (Spearman rho = 0.39; n = 1,854). Similar, weaker correlations were found for MAP and creatinine. On a cohort level, cross-institutional agreement measured by Spearman correlation between models trained on different sites, were 70-77% of same-site correlation. External within-patient correlations were 0.54 and 0.59 against ceilings of 0.92 and 0.90. Our index also correlated with established indices, while null controls stayed near zero.
  Our index demonstrated hourly prognostic information that meaningfully separates patient outcomes and is consistent with clinical expectation, indicating potential as a decision support tool complementing clinical judgement.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于43项常规记录的临床变量、在72小时治疗窗口内从患者纵向轨迹中直接学习的新型脓毒症严重程度指数。不同于传统指标依赖固定的变量和权重，该指数使用死亡率作为治疗层面的排序信号，允许信用在不同时间步上非均匀分配。在两个医院系统共36,807名Sepsis-3标准成人患者上验证，该指数在0-10量表中能区分幸存者与非幸存者，与乳酸等临床指标相关，跨机构一致性良好，显示出作为辅助临床决策支持工具的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有脓毒症严重程度指数（如SOFA）依赖数十年前基于固定变量和权重建立的评分体系，变量离散化粗糙，校准队列已不再反映当代重症监护实践。目前没有直接从患者轨迹中学习得到的替代指标被常规使用，因此需要一种能够从现代患者数据中自动学习、反映当代临床现实的新型脓毒症指数。
AI.method: 采用回顾性双队列研究设计，纳入马萨诸塞州和佐治亚州两个医院系统共29,116和7,691名符合Sepsis-3标准的成人患者。使用43项常规记录的变量，在72小时治疗窗口内建模。关键创新在于使用死亡率作为治疗层面的排序信号而非每状态目标，允许信用在时间步上非均匀重新分配。评估采用永久保留的20%测试集，使用临床小插图（vignettes）和Spearman相关性，通过bootstrap重采样获得不确定性区间。
AI.result: 在基线SOFA-2的所有分层内，非幸存者比幸存者得分高1.19-1.64分（0-10量表），在乳酸、MAP和肌酐分层内结果类似。指数变化与乳酸变化相关（Spearman rho=0.39，n=1,854），与MAP和肌酐的相关性较弱。跨机构一致性为同一机构相关性的70-77%，外部患者内相关性为0.54和0.59（上限分别为0.92和0.90）。该指数与既有指标相关，而零对照组接近零。
AI.conclusion: 该指数提供了每小时级别的预后信息，能有效区分患者结局并与临床预期一致，表明其作为补充临床判断的决策支持工具具有潜力。但跨机构一致性仍需提升，可能需要进一步验证和优化以进入常规临床使用。

title: DocTalkBN: A Novel Dataset of Expert Telemedicine Conversations in Bengali
summary: Reliable medical conversational AI requires authentic expert--patient interaction data, yet such datasets remain scarce, especially for low-resource languages such as Bengali. We present DocTalkBN, a large-scale multimodal dataset of real-world expert telemedicine conversations in Bengali, collected from nationally broadcast telemedicine programs featuring board-certified physicians. DocTalkBN contains 557.63 hours of paired audio and text, 1,515 multi-turn patient calls, 10,274 host--doctor question--answer exchanges, totaling 1.7M tokens, spanning 26 medical specialties. Unlike prior resources derived from medical forums, written health content, or synthetic data, our dataset preserves the spontaneity, contextual richness, and spoken characteristics of authentic medical interactions in a low-resource setting. To support benchmark-driven research, we further construct three downstream tasks from the corpus, medical triage classification, advice safety evaluation, and medical named entity recognition, and benchmark a diverse set of large language models and encoder-based baselines. Our results show that DocTalkBN is a practically useful resource, particularly for clinically grounded reasoning tasks. We release this resource to facilitate future research on reliable medical NLP and safer, more culturally grounded healthcare systems for low-resource languages. Our source codes and dataset are publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/doctalk.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了DocTalkBN，一个大规模孟加拉语真实医患远程医疗对话多模态数据集，包含557.63小时的音文配对数据、1,515次多轮患者呼叫、10,274组医患问答对及170万词元，覆盖26个医学专科。基于该语料构建了医疗分诊分类、建议安全性评估和医学命名实体识别三个下游任务，并对多种大语言模型和编码器基线进行了基准测试。
AI.motivation: 可靠的医疗对话AI需要真实的医患交互数据，但此类数据集严重匮乏，尤其对于孟加拉语等低资源语言。现有资源多来源于医疗论坛、书面健康内容或合成数据，缺乏真实对话的自发性、上下文丰富性和口语特征，无法支撑临床推理任务的开发与评估。
AI.method: 作者从全国播出的远程医疗节目中收集由持证医生参与的专家远程医疗对话，构建DocTalkBN多模态数据集（音频+文本配对）。基于该语料构建三个下游任务：医疗分诊分类、建议安全性评估和医学命名实体识别，并对多种大语言模型和基于编码器的基线模型进行基准测试。
AI.result: DocTalkBN被证明是一个实际可用的资源，尤其在临床基础推理任务上表现突出。数据集覆盖广泛（26个医学专科、1.7M词元），多个基准模型在三个下游任务上进行了系统评估。
AI.conclusion: DocTalkBN为低资源语言的医疗NLP研究提供了宝贵的真实对话数据资源，有助于推动更安全、更具文化适应性的医疗对话系统的开发。研究团队已公开数据及源代码以促进后续研究。

title: Mechanistic Reaction Prediction via Discrete Flow Matching on Graph-Structured Electron Occupation
summary:
Chemical reactions are fundamentally transformations in electron space, yet most machine learning approaches model them either through \textit{de novo} generation of product molecules or through heuristic graph edits that operate directly on molecular topology.
  We introduce MAELLE (\textbf{M}ech\textbf{A}nistic \textbf{E}dit f\textbf{L}ow-matching on e\textbf{L}ectron r\textbf{E}arrangements), which instead models reactions as discrete flow matching over electron occupation vectors.
  Concretely, we formulate the reactant-to-product mapping as a Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC) over the graph-structured integer-valued electron occupation space defined on all bonding, non-bonding, and hydrogen sites.
  To construct the intermediate edit trajectories, we generalize the discrete flow matching mixture path to discrete electron rearrangements using Optimal Transport, yielding a sequence of mechanistically interpretable edit moves without requiring elementary step annotations.
  MAELLE achieves competitive performance on the USPTO-480K benchmark compared with leading reaction prediction models.
  Beyond in-distribution accuracy, we evaluate robustness across two out-of-distribution settings - structural complexity and reaction type - and find that MAELLE maintains strong performance where existing methods degrade.
  Finally, because the learned flow operates over the full electron redistribution, MAELLE naturally recovers mechanistic trajectories that align with known chemistry and can predict side products of a reaction.

AI.tldr: MAELLE是一种将化学反应建模为电子占据向量上的离散流匹配（Discrete Flow Matching）的方法，通过Continuous-time Markov Chain在电子占据空间上建模反应物到产物的映射，在USPTO-480K基准上取得具有竞争力的性能，并在分布外场景下表现出更强的鲁棒性，同时能恢复符合化学机理的反应轨迹并预测副产物。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习反应预测方法要么通过从头生成（de novo generation）产物分子，要么通过对分子拓扑进行启发式图编辑来建模反应。然而化学反应本质上是电子空间的重新排列，现有方法没有在电子层面建模这一核心过程，缺乏机理解释性且在分布外场景下性能会显著下降。
AI.method: MAELLE将反应物到产物的映射建模为定义在图形结构的整数电子占据空间（包括成键位点、非键位点和氢位点）上的Continuous-time Markov Chain (CTMC)。为了构建中间编辑轨迹，作者将离散流匹配的混合路径推广到离散电子重排场景，利用最优传输（Optimal Transport）生成一系列机理上可解释的编辑步骤，且无需基元步骤（elementary step）的标注。
AI.result: MAELLE在USPTO-480K基准上与领先的反应预测模型相比取得具有竞争力的性能。在两种分布外设置（结构复杂度和反应类型）下，MAELLE在现有方法性能退化时仍保持强劲表现。此外，该模型能够自然恢复与已知化学相符的机理轨迹，并能预测反应的副产物。
AI.conclusion: 在电子层面而非分子拓扑层面建模化学反应是可行且有效的。基于电子占据空间上的离散流匹配不仅能在标准基准上达到竞争性表现，还提供了更强的分布外鲁棒性和天然的反应机理可解释性，为反应预测领域开辟了一个新的建模范式。

title: Cross-Lingual Alignment Without Joint Training: Do Monolingual Language Models Converge on Universal Representations?
summary: Cross-lingual alignment in multilingual language models is typically attributed to joint training: shared parameters, mixed-language batches, or explicit alignment objectives. We ask whether monolingual models trained on non-parallel data learn alignable representations without joint training. By testing on strictly monolingual language models, such as the Goldfish model families and independently developed models from different research labs, we find three results. Correlation: these models develop alignable representational geometry across layers, with alignment strengthening as data scale, model scale, or linguistic proximity increases. Construction: a single Procrustes rotation fit on parallel sentences maps hidden states between models. Causation: the same rotation transfers functional content; patching a rotated English residual into a German model on a factual cloze flips the prediction to the donor's capital in most cases. We confirm that cross-lingual alignment can emerge from the structure of language and the information it carries rather than from joint training, and this points to practical future directions including model stitching, merging, and modular multilingual systems built from monolingual components.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了纯单语模型（如Goldfish系列及不同实验室独立训练的模型）是否能在没有联合训练的情况下发展出跨语言可对齐的表示。研究发现：这些模型在层间发展出可对齐的表示几何结构，且对齐强度随数据规模、模型规模或语言亲缘度增加而增强；一个基于平行句拟合的Procrustes旋转即可映射模型间的隐状态；该旋转能够传递功能内容（如将旋转后的英文残差输入德语模型可翻转事实完形填空的预测）。证明跨语言对齐可从语言本身的结构及其承载的信息中自发涌现，而非必须依赖联合训练，为模型拼接、合并及模块化多语系统提供了方向。
AI.motivation: 多语言模型中的跨语言对齐通常被归因于联合训练（共享参数、混合语言批次或显式对齐目标）。作者质疑这一假设，探究仅经过单语数据训练、无任何联合训练的模型是否也能自发形成可对齐的表示，从而更深入地理解对齐现象的本质来源。
AI.method: 使用严格单语模型（Goldfish系列及不同实验室独立开发的模型）进行实验。首先对比各层表示的跨语言表征几何结构的相关性；其次用一个基于平行句拟合的Procrustes旋转映射不同模型间的隐状态；最后通过将旋转后的英文残差注入德语模型的事实完形填空任务，验证该旋转是否传递功能性内容。
AI.result: 三个核心发现：相关性——单语模型在各层间发展出可对齐的表征几何，且随数据规模、模型规模和语言亲缘度增加而对齐加强；构造性——一个Procrustes旋转即可跨模型映射隐状态；因果性——该旋转能传递功能内容，多数情况下可将事实完形填空的预测翻转为捐赠者（英文）的答案。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言对齐并非联合训练的独特产物，它可以从语言结构本身及其承载的信息量中自发涌现。这一发现为模型拼接（stitching）、模型合并以及基于单语组件构建模块化多语系统提供了实际的未来方向。

title: WikiSkill: Compiling Agent Experience into Persistent Knowledge for Skill Evolution
summary: Agent skills package specialized knowledge and workflows into reusable resources that extend AI agent capabilities. Recent work automatically discovers such skills from agent experience, which enables agents to progressively adapt through interaction. However, the insights that guide skill development typically remain scattered across optimization histories, limiting their systematic reuse across iterations. We introduce WikiSkill, a framework that co-evolves agent skills with a persistent knowledge base (wiki). At a high level, WikiSkill separates raw execution experience, accumulated knowledge, and executable skills, while continuously consolidating experience into the wiki, which subsequent skill updates can build on. Across diverse benchmarks and models, WikiSkill consistently outperforms state-of-the-art skill-evolution methods and improves over no-skill baselines in most model-benchmark settings. We find that skill evolution complements model scaling: larger models generally benefit more from evolved skills, while smaller models with skills can outperform substantially larger models without them. We also find that evolved skills transfer effectively across models and model families, and skills evolved by other models can outperform self-evolved skills. Finally, our ablation studies confirm that persistent knowledge accumulation in the wiki is critical for effective skill evolution. These results demonstrate the benefits of systematically accumulating and refining agent experience for developing reusable and transferable skills.

AI.tldr: 提出WikiSkill框架，将代理技能与持续更新的知识库（wiki）协同演化。WikiSkill将原始执行经验、累积知识与可执行技能分离，持续将经验整合进wiki，供后续技能更新使用。在多个基准和模型上，WikiSkill一致优于现有最先进的技能进化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的代理技能自动发现方法虽然能让代理通过交互逐步适应，但指导技能发展的洞察通常分散在优化历史中，难以在迭代间系统性地复用，导致知识浪费和技能演化效率低下。
AI.method: WikiSkill将代理学习过程分为三层：原始执行经验、累积知识（wiki）和可执行技能。通过将执行经验持续整合（consolidate）到wiki中，形成持久的知识基础，后续的技能更新可以基于该知识库进行迭代演化，实现经验→知识→技能的螺旋式提升。
AI.result: 1）在多个基准和模型上，WikiSkill一致超越SOTA技能演化方法，并在大多数模型-基准组合中优于无技能基线。2）技能演化与模型规模互补：更大的模型从演化技能中获益更多，小模型配技能可超越更大的无技能模型。3）演化技能可跨模型和模型家族迁移，其他模型演化的技能可优于自我演化的技能。4）消融实验证实wiki中持久知识积累对技能演化至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 系统性地积累和提炼代理经验对于开发可复用、可迁移的技能具有显著价值，WikiSkill证明了持久化知识沉淀在技能演化中的关键作用。

title: TwinKV: A Composable Repair Pass for KV Cache Eviction via Pairwise Key Redundancy
summary: Long-context inference is bottlenecked by the memory footprint of the key-value (KV) cache, especially for small models under tight resource budgets. Existing KV cache eviction methods score tokens using the model's attention distribution or, in attention-free variants, each key's distance from a global reference point. Using a controlled leave-one-out probe, we find that attention magnitude is unrelated to a token's causal contribution to the answer (Spearman $ρ=-0.004$), challenging the premise behind dominant eviction methods. We introduce TwinKV, a training-free, attention-free redundancy signal that detects whether a token's key has a near-duplicate elsewhere in context. Rather than replacing existing policies, TwinKV acts as a composable repair pass: given a policy's fixed retained set, it identifies evicted tokens with no surviving duplicate (\emph{orphans}) and retained tokens whose information is duplicated elsewhere (\emph{redundant donors}), then swaps them while preserving the original budget and scoring rule. We compose TwinKV with four recent eviction policies across LongBench, LooGLE, RULER, and a short-context MMLU-Pro no-harm control at compression ratios ${0.3,0.5,0.7}$. On Qwen3-4B, TwinKV improves a majority of configurations for two policies, is near-even for a third, and helps only a minority for a fourth adaptive baseline already near a performance ceiling; gains across the three non-ceiling policies are smallest at the loosest ratio. On RULER with Llama-3.2-1B, however, that fourth policy improves in every evaluated cell because its Alone score leaves substantial room to improve. More broadly, Llama-3.2-1B shows a smaller average LongBench gain but a higher fraction of improved cells on LongBench and LooGLE than Qwen3-4B, plus a clean RULER win. We also identify few-shot classification exemplars as a task structure where TwinKV does not help on either model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TwinKV，一种无需训练、无需注意力的冗余信号检测方法，用于检测上下文中关键词的键是否存在近似重复。TwinKV作为可组合的修复通道（repair pass），在保留既有策略固定保留集的前提下，将"孤儿"（被驱逐但无幸存重复的令牌）与"冗余捐赠者"（其信息在其他位置重复的已保留令牌）进行交换，在不改变预算和评分规则的情况下提升长上下文推理的KV缓存驱逐效率。实验表明TwinKV在多数配置下能改善多项基线策略。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理受限于KV缓存的内存占用。现有驱逐方法基于注意力分布或键与全局参考点的距离来评分令牌，但通过受控留一探针实验发现注意力大小与令牌对答案的因果贡献无关（Spearman ρ=-0.004），这挑战了主流驱逐方法的理论基础，需要更可靠的冗余信号。
AI.method: TwinKV是一个无需训练、无需注意力的冗余信号，通过检测令牌的键是否在上下文中存在近似重复来判断其冗余性。它作为可组合的修复通道，在给定策略的固定保留集后，找出被驱逐但无幸存近重复的"孤儿"令牌，以及信息被别处重复覆盖的已保留"冗余捐赠者"令牌，在保持原有预算和评分规则的前提下进行交换。
AI.result: 将TwinKV与四种近期驱逐策略在LongBench、LooGLE、RULER以及MMLU-Pro短上下文无伤害对照上组合测试（压缩比0.3/0.5/0.7）。在Qwen3-4B上，TwinKV对两项策略多数配置有改进，对第三项接近持平，对第四项（自适应基线，接近性能天花板）仅在少数配置有效；三项非天花板策略在最低压缩比时增益最小。在RULER + Llama-3.2-1B上，第四项策略每个测试单元格均有改进。Llama-3.2-1B在LongBench平均增益较小但改进单元格比例更高，且在RULER上有明显提升。少样本分类示例是TwinKV在两种模型上均无效的任务结构。
AI.conclusion: TwinKV通过识别并交换冗余信息，在不改变原有驱逐策略预算和评分规则的前提下，为多数缓存驱逐策略提供额外增益。其有效性依赖基线的性能余量和任务结构，在接近性能天花板的基线和少样本分类任务上帮助有限。

title: Said Aloud, Read Different: Cross-Modal Instability in Multimodal Models
summary: Multimodal foundation models are increasingly used in speech-first assistants that must interpret spoken queries and produce visually grounded decisions. Yet it remains unclear whether semantically equivalent queries yield consistent judgments across modality (text vs. speech) and language (English vs. Arabic). We introduce a speech-augmented visually grounded contrastive triplet benchmark spanning 10,150 culturally grounded images from 18 MENA countries, where each image is paired with one supported statement and two plausible but unsupported alternatives. We define contrastive instability as the conditional rate at which a model fails to resolve all statements within a triplet, isolating fragmented reasoning from complete failure. Evaluating recent multimodal models under text and speech in English and Arabic, we find that modality and language shifts introduce substantial triplet-level inconsistencies that are not fully captured by aggregate accuracy, with speech amplifying partial failures. We make the benchmark publicly available to the community.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个语音增强的视觉接地对比三元组基准，覆盖18个MENA国家的10,150张图像，以评估多模态基础模型在文本/语音模态和英语/阿拉伯语语言转换下的一致性，并定义"对比不稳定性"指标来衡量模型在解析三元组时的碎片化推理失败。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型越来越多地用于语音优先助手，需要解释语音查询并产生视觉接地决策。然而语义等价的查询在模态（文本vs语音）和语言（英语vs阿拉伯语）之间是否产生一致的判断尚不清楚，现有评估主要依赖聚合准确率，无法捕捉三元组层面的不一致性。
AI.method: 构建一个语音增强的视觉接地对比三元组基准，包含10,150张来自18个MENA国家的文化接地图像，每个图像配对一个受支持陈述和两个合理但不支持的替代陈述。定义对比不稳定性为模型无法解析三元组内所有陈述的条件比率，以区分碎片化推理与完全失败。在多模态模型上以文本和语音两种模态、英语和阿拉伯语两种语言进行评估。
AI.result: 研究发现模态和语言的转换会在三元组层面引入显著的不一致性，这种不一致性无法被聚合准确率完全反映；语音输入会放大部分失败（碎片化推理）的情况。
AI.conclusion: 模态和语言偏移给多模态模型的视觉接地推理带来了聚合指标无法完全捕捉的三元组级不稳定性，语音尤其会加剧碎片化推理失败。基准已公开供社区使用。

title: STAR : Sentence Translation Alignment Rate for Document-to-Document Machine Translation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled a shift from sentence-level to document-to-document (Doc2Doc) machine translation, promising improved global coherence. However, document-to-document generation in a single pass frequently suffers from structural misalignment, manifesting as sentence omissions or hallucinations that violate the core requirement of source-target correspondence. To address this, we introduce Sentence Translation Alignment Rate (STAR), an auxiliary metric that explicitly quantifies sentence-level structural fidelity. Building on this, we propose STAR-masked Preference Optimization (StarPO), a framework that ranks document-level hypotheses by structural quality and utilizes a dynamic alignment mask to focus optimization on misaligned segments. Experimental results across news and literary domains demonstrate that StarPO significantly enhances translation quality and structural integrity. Notably, StarPO allows compact models to surpass the performance of massive proprietary systems like GPT-4o while maintaining superior token efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STAR（句子翻译对齐率）作为辅助指标量化文档级翻译的结构保真度，并基于此构建StarPO（STAR掩码偏好优化）框架，通过结构质量排序和动态对齐掩码优化错位片段，使紧凑模型在新闻和文学领域的文档翻译中超越GPT-4o等大型专有系统。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型推动机器翻译从句子级转向文档到文档（Doc2Doc）模式，但单次文档级生成常出现结构错位问题（如句子遗漏或幻觉），违背源文-译文一一对应的核心要求。现有方法缺乏对句子级结构保真度的显式量化与针对性优化手段。
AI.method: 1) 提出STAR（Sentence Translation Alignment Rate）辅助指标，显式量化句子级结构保真度；2) 构建StarPO（STAR-masked Preference Optimization）框架，依据结构质量对文档级候选译文进行排序，并利用动态对齐掩码将优化聚焦于错位片段。
AI.result: 在新闻和文学两个领域上的实验表明，StarPO显著提升了翻译质量和结构完整性；紧凑模型在应用StarPO后能够超越GPT-4o等大型专有系统的性能，同时保持更优的token效率。
AI.conclusion: StarPO通过显式度量句子级结构对齐并针对性优化错位片段，有效解决了Doc2Doc翻译中的结构错位问题，验证了结构感知的偏好优化方法在文档级翻译中的价值，并展示了紧凑模型在此框架下具备超越大型专有系统的潜力。

title: Prediction of Prediction (PoP): Inter-Layer Activation Fusion for Single-Pass Hallucination Detection in Large Language Models
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 9 tables. Single-author preprint on white-box, single-pass hallucination detection using inter-layer activation divergence, cross-layer fusion, temporal drift, and calibrated risk scoring. Evaluated on TruthfulQA, HaluEval 2.0, and FaithDial with Llama-3, Qwen2.5, and Mistral backbones
summary: Autoregressive large language models (LLMs) routinely generate factually incorrect outputs with high decoding confidence, limiting their deployment in high-stakes workflows. Existing output-stage uncertainty metrics can fail when models are overconfident on false assertions, while multi-sample verification pipelines introduce substantial memory and latency overhead. This work evaluates whether internal hidden-state transition dynamics during generation can signal factual errors without auxiliary decoding calls. We introduce Prediction of Prediction (PoP), a mechanism that captures layer-transition uncertainty by fusing intermediate hidden representations across depth during a single forward pass. Evaluated on the TruthfulQA benchmark using autoregressive transformer backbones, PoP achieves an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 75.5% for factual-correctness classification. The mechanism operates within the base forward pass, adding less than 1.2% runtime latency and requiring zero additional generation passes. The numerical results are reported from the author-verified experimental implementation and are bounded by the evaluation scope described below.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PoP（Prediction of Prediction）机制，通过融合单个前向过程中不同深度的中间隐藏表示来捕获层间转换不确定性，从而在不增加额外解码调用的情况下检测LLM生成中的事实性错误。在TruthfulQA基准上达到75.5%的AUROC，额外延迟低于1.2%。
AI.motivation: 自回归大语言模型常以高置信度生成事实错误内容，限制了其在高风险场景中的部署。现有输出级不确定性度量在面对模型对错误断言过度自信时可能失效，而多样本验证管线虽能改善但引入大量内存和延迟开销。因此需要一种能在单次前向传播内识别事实错误的低开销机制。
AI.method: PoP通过融合生成过程中跨深度（层间）的中间隐藏表示，捕获层转换不确定性。它不需要辅助解码调用，而是在模型基础前向传播中实时操作，利用隐藏状态动态作为事实正确性分类的信号。
AI.result: 在TruthfulQA基准上使用自回归Transformer骨干模型评估，PoP在事实正确性分类任务上达到75.5%的AUROC。运行时开销极低，额外延迟小于1.2%，且不需要额外的生成通数。
AI.conclusion: PoP证明了内部隐藏状态转换动态可以有效地作为事实错误信号，在保持极低计算开销的同时实现了与多采样管线相当的错误检测能力，为LLM在高风险工作流中的可靠部署提供了一种轻量级解决方案。

title: When Text Misleads: Inconsistent-Aware Reasoning for Audio-Grounded Dialogue
summary: Understanding spoken dialogue requires joint reasoning over lexical content and paralinguistic acoustic signals such as emotion and conversational intent. However, existing evaluations often allow shortcuts based on transcripts or single-modality solutions, obscuring whether models genuinely ground predictions in speech. We formalize this failure mode as cross-modal disagreement, where transcripts suggest plausible but incorrect surface interpretations while acoustic cues such as prosody or speaking style support different answers. We develop a scalable framework that identifies text-biased surface interpretations and converts disagreement regions into conflict QA examples. We also include consistent cases where transcript-based and speech-grounded interpretations agree, enabling evaluation beyond adversarial audio dependence. This results in ContraTalk, a controlled benchmark containing 501 questions across five discourse dimensions: interaction behavior, emotion state, dialogue act, social stance, and conversational intent. We further develop an agentic-style reasoning framework that converts speech into an Audio Twin, a text-readable representation of localized acoustic cues that exposes acoustic evidence to the reasoning model. Experiments show that strong text-only LLMs exceed 90% accuracy in consistent cases but drop to 33-48% in conflict cases. Direct AudioLLMs provide only partial grounding, still selecting the transcript-biased trap in roughly 30-40% of conflict cases. Our Audio Twin framework improves conflict-case accuracy while reducing trap selection, but its consistent-case behavior remains backbone-dependent. These results identify transcript-based shortcuts as an important failure mode in spoken dialogue understanding and show that explicit acoustic evidence aggregation provides a more controllable interface for diagnosing and improving speech-grounded reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ContraTalk基准，用于检测和评估口语对话理解中的跨模态不一致问题（转录捷径）。通过识别文本偏置的表面解释并构造冲突QA样例，结合一致案例，系统评估模型是否真正将预测扎根于语音信号。实验表明强文本LLM在一致案例中准确率超90%，但在冲突案例中跌至33-48%；直接音频LLM仍约30-40%选择转录偏置陷阱；提出的Audio Twin框架能改善冲突案例性能但一致案例表现依赖于后端骨干。
AI.motivation: 现有口语对话理解评估常允许基于转录文本或单模态的捷径，无法确认模型是否真正基于语音信号进行预测。这种"跨模态不一致"失败模式——转录暗示看似合理但错误的表面解释，而韵律、说话风格等声学线索支持不同答案——被系统性地忽视了，需要一个可扩展的框架来形式化并检测该问题。
AI.method: 1）构建可扩展框架，识别文本偏置的表面解释并将不一致区域转化为冲突QA样例；2）同时包含转录与语音扎根解释一致的一致案例，避免评估过度依赖对抗性音频；3）提出ContraTalk基准，包含501个问题，覆盖互动行为、情绪状态、对话行为、社会立场和会话意图五个话语维度；4）开发基于智能体风格推理的Audio Twin框架，将语音转换为文本可读的局部声学线索表示，向推理模型暴露声学证据。
AI.result: 文本LLM在一致案例中准确率超90%，但在冲突案例中降至33-48%；直接AudioLLMs仅提供部分扎根，约30-40%冲突案例仍选择转录偏置陷阱；Audio Twin框架提升冲突案例准确率并减少陷阱选择，但一致案例表现依赖于后端骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: 转录基捷径是口语对话理解中的重要失败模式。显式声学证据聚合（Audio Twin）提供了更可控的接口来诊断和改进语音扎根推理，比直接音频建模更容易干预和解释。

title: BALMS: Benchmarking Agentic LLMs for Longitudinal Mental Health Sensing
summary: Mental health assessment relies on episodic self-report scales, which convert subjective states such as stress into numerical scores but provide only sparse snapshots of wellbeing. Wearable devices offer longitudinal behavioral and physiological signals for continuous, low-burden monitoring. Recent LLM-driven personal-health agents enable natural language queries over wearable signals, but mainly handle short-term, retrieval-based lookups (e.g., highest step count over a week). They do not evaluate whether agents can reason over long-term signals to predict wellbeing scores paired with evidence-grounded rationales. To address this gap, we introduce BALMS, the first systematic benchmark of LLM-based agentic systems for longitudinal mental health sensing. BALMS spans 3 real-world longitudinal datasets, 2 task families (closed-form wellbeing-score prediction and rationale generation auto-graded by an LLM-as-Judge), 3 agentic paradigms evaluated across 5 open- and closed-source LLM backbones. We find that zero-shot agents rarely outperform a simple mean baseline, except with stronger backbones or compact, semantically meaningful features. Chain-of-thought prompting improves reasoning-oriented backbones, but does not guarantee temporal grounding or numerical correctness.
